1: अ The first letter of the alphabet, and inherent short vowel.
2: अ ind. 	 1. NO, not. 	 2. A private, prohibitive, and diminutive particle. 	 3. An interjection of pity. It also implies degrees of difference, and similarity. As a negative prefix to words beginning with a vowel, अ is changed to अन्, as अ and अन्त form अनन्त.
3: अ m. (अः) A name of VISHṆU.
4: अऋणिन् mfn. (-णी-णिणी-णि) Free from debt or obligation; also अऋणिन्  E. अ neg. ऋणिन् a debtor.

6: अंश m. (-शः) 	 1. A share or portion. 	 2. A part. 	 3. A shoulder, the shoulder blade. 	 4. (In arithmetic) a fraction. 	 5. The nume-rator of a fraction. 6 A degree of latitude or longitude, &c. See अंस.  E. अंश to divide, अच् affix.
7: अंशक m. (-कः) A kinsman, a relation, a co-heir. 	 n. (-कं) A day. E. अंश to separate or divide, and वुन् affix.

280: अग्निमणि m. (-णिः) The sun-stone.  E. अग्नि and मणि a jewel or gem, brilliant as fire.

286: अग्निरक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Maintaining a sacred fire.  E. अग्नि and रक्षित preserved.
287: अग्निरहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Being without fire, especially a sacred fire. 2. Devoid of appetite.  E. अग्नि and रहित lost.
288: अग्निरजस् m. (-जाः) An insect of a scarlet color.  E. अग्नि and रजस् dust or farina.
289: अग्निरुहा f. (-हा) The name of a plant.
290: अग्निवर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Hot, scalding, scorching.  E. अग्नि and वर्ण quality; of the property of fire.
291: अग्निवर्द्धक mfn. (-कः-का-की-कं) 	 1. Tonic, stomachic. 	 2. Feeding or exciting fire.  E. अग्नि and वर्द्धक what augments.

293: अग्निवल्लभ m. (-भः) Resin, pitch.  E. अग्नि and वल्लभ a friend, from its exciting or befriending fire.

295: अग्निवाह m. (-हः) Smoke.  E. अग्नि and वाह what bears.
296: अग्निबाहु m. (-हु) Smoke.  E. अग्नि and बाहु the arm.
297: अग्निविसर्प m. (-र्पः) Pain from a boil.  E. अग्नि and विसर्प a boil.
298: अग्निवीज n. (-जं) Gold.  E. अग्नि and वीज seed.
299: अग्निवीर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Gold.  E. अग्नि and वीर्य्य power.
300: अग्निवृद्धि f. (-द्धिः) 	 1. Improved digestion, appetite. 	 2. Increase of fire. E. अग्नि and वृद्धि increase.
301: अग्निशिख m. (-खः) 	 1. A lamp. 	 2. An arrow. 	 3. A fiery arrow, a rocket. E. The Safflower plant, (Carthamus tinctorius.) 	 mn. (-खः-खं) Safforn, the plant and die. 	 f. (-खा) 	 1. Flame. 	 2. 309: अग्निसम्भव m. (-वः) Wild safflower. 	 mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Originating from fire. E. अग्नि and सम्भव born.

369: अघनाशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Purifying, freeing from sin.  E. अघ, and नाशक what destroys.

2391: अफल्गु mfn. (-ल्गुः-ल्गुः-ल्गु) Productive, profitable.  E. अ neg. फल्गु worthless.
2392: अफुल्ल mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं) Unblown.  E. अ neg. फुल्ल flowered.

2401: अबन्धुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Unlovely, displeasing.  E. अ neg. बन्धुर handsome.
2402: अबन्ध्य mfn. (-न्ध्यः-न्ध्या-न्ध्यं) Fruitfull, productive.  E. अ neg. and बन्ध्य bound, barren.

2407: अबान्धव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Having no relation or kindred, lone, unacknow-ledged, unowned.  E. अ neg. बन्धु kindred, अण् aff.
2408: अबुद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Ignorance. 	 mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) Ignorant, stupid.  E. अ neg. बुद्धि understanding.

2412: अबोधगम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) Incomprihensible.  E. अ neg. बोध knowledge, गम्य to be attained by.
2413: अबोधनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. Unintelligible. 	 2. Not to be awakened or aroused.  E. अ neg. बोधनीय to be understood, &c. also अबोधितव्य and अबोध्य.
2414: अब्ज m. (-ब्जः) 	 1. The moon. 	 2. A kind of tree, (Barringtonia acutangula.) 3. The physician of the gods. See धन्वन्तरि. 	 mn. (-ब्जः-ब्जं) A conch. 	 n. (-ब्जं) 	 1. A lotus. 	 2. 2416: अब्जनयन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Having fine eyes.  E. अब्ज, and नयन the eye.
2417: अब्जनेत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) Having fine eyes.  E. अब्ज and नेत्र eye.

2419: अब्जभोग m. (-गः) The root of a lotus.  E. अब्ज, and भोग enjoyment.

2427: अब्दसहस्र n. (-स्रं) A thousand years.  E. अब्द, सहस्र a thousand.

2467: अभव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 	 1. Not to be, not predestined. 	 2. Improper, what ought not to be.  E. अ neg. भव्य what is to be, also अभवनीय, &c.

2469: अभाग्य mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) Unfortunate, wretched.  E. अ neg. भाग्य fortunate. So अभाग्यवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्.)
2470: अभाव m. (-वः) 	 1. Non-existence, annihilation. 	 2. Death. 	 3. (In logic) Negation of two kinds, संसर्गाभाव universal negation, and अन्योन्याभाव relative or mutual negation. 	 4. 2473: अभाविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) 	 1. What is not to be, what will not be. 	 2. Void of temperament or natural disposition.  E. अ neg. भाविन् future, or having disposition.

2483: अभिगम m. (-मः) Approach, proximity.  E. अभि to, गम going.
2484: अभिगमन n. (-नं) Approaching, going near to.  E. अभि, and गमन going.

2607: अभिवादक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Civil, polite. 	 2. Uncivil, abusive.  E. अभि to, or against, वादक who speaks.

2612: अभिव्यक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 	 1. Plain, distinct, evident, manifest. 	 2. De-clared, revealed.  E. अभि, and व्यक्त plain.

2615: अभिशङ्कित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Frightened, alarmed.  E. अभि, and शङ्कित alarmed.

2617: अभिशप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 	 1. Falsely accused, calumniated. 	 2. Cursed, accursed.  E. अभि before शप with क्त aff.

E. अभि before सिच् to sprinkle, and घञ् affix; the word is often used for initiation, royal unction, &c. sprinkling with the water of the Ganges, or water in which various articles have been immersed, being an essential part of the rites; also for a religious ceremony, including the presentation of a variety of articles, fruits, gems, &c. along with water or fluid substances for the bathing of the deity to whom worship is offered.

2647: अभिसर्ज्जन n. (-नं) 	 1. Gift, donation. 	 2. Killing. See अतिसर्ज्जन.

2681: अभूषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unadorned.  E. अ neg. भूषित adorned.
2682: अभृशम् ing. A little, a few.  E. अ neg. भृशम् much.

2694: अभ्यक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Oiled, anointed.  E. अभि, and अञ्ज to anoint, affix क्त.

2697: अभ्यधिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Exceeding, surpassing (in number, power, or kind, &c.)  E. अभि, and अधिक more.
2698: अभ्यधीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Dependent.  E. अभि, and अधीन dependent.

3335: अर्थसिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 	 1. Effected by wealth. 	 2. Successful, one whose aim is accomplished.  E. अर्थ, and सिद्ध accomplished.

See As. R. Vol. viii. p. 442, COLEBROOKE on the Vedas.
4344: अश्वमेधिक m. (-कः) A horse fit for the sacrifice calld Aswamedha. E. अश्वमेध as above, कन् added, and इ inserted.
4345: अश्वमेधीय m. (-यः) A horse fit for an Aswamedha.  E. अश्वमेध and छ aff.

4363: अश्वसेन m. (-नः) A proper name, a king.

4379: अश्विनीसुत m. du. (-तौ) The twin sons of ASWINI by SURYA.  E. अश्विनी and सुत a son.

4385: अषडक्षीण m. (-णः) A secret.  E. अ neg. षट् six, अक्षि in eye, and ख affix; what is not seen by six eyes, that is known or determined by two persons to the exclusion of a third.

4389: अष्टकर्ण m. (-र्णः) A name of BRAHMA.  E. अष्ट eight, and कर्ण an ear; eight-eared, being four-headed.

4392: अष्टकोण m. (-णः) An octagon.  E. अष्ट and कोण angle.
4393: अष्टगाध् m. (-द् or -त्) 	 1. A fabulous animal supposed to have eight legs: see शरभ. 	 2. A spider.
4394: अष्टगव n. (-वं) A flock of eight cows.  E. अष्ट and गव kine.
4395: अष्टगुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Eight fold.  E. अष्ट eight, गुण number.

4399: अष्टधातु n. (-तु) The eight metals collectively, as gold, silver, copper, tin, lead, brass, iron and steel.  E. अष्ट and धातु a mineral.
4400: अष्टन् mfn. plu. only (अष्ट or अष्टौ) Eight.  E. असू to pervade, कनिन् Unādi affix, and तुद् inserted.

4402: अष्टी f. (-ष्टी) A metre consisting of four lines, and having sixteen sylla-bles in each; there are nine species of it.  E. अष्टन् eight, ङीप् fem. aff.
4403: अष्टम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) Eight. 	 f. (-मी) 	 1. The eighth day of the fortnight. 2. A medicinal plant: see क्षीरकाकोली, the last of a class of eight medicinal plants: see अष्टवर्ग.  E. अष्टन् with डट् affix and मट् augment.
4404: अष्टमङ्गल m. (-लः) A horse with a white face, tail, mane, breast, and hoofs. 	 n. (-लं) A Collection of eight lucky things to be assembled on certain occasions, as at a coronation, &c. as a lion, a bull, an elephant, a water-jar, a fan, a flag, a trumpet, and a lamp; or a Brahman, a cow, fire, gold, ghee, the sun, water, and a king. E. अष्ट eight, and मङ्गल auspicious.
4405: अष्टमांश m. (-शः) An eighth.  E. अष्टम and अंश a part.
4406: अष्टमान n. (-नं) A measure, one Kurava.  E. अष्ट eight, and मान measure.
4407: अष्टमिका f. (-का) A weight of four tolas.  E. अष्टम eighth, कन् added, fem. form.
4408: अष्टमूर्त्ति m. (-र्त्तिः) A name of SIVA.  E. अष्ट eight, and मूर्त्ति form: evident in the earth, water, &c.

4415: अष्टागव n. (-वं) A car or wain, one drawn by eight oxen.  E. अष्ट and गो a cow, अण् aff.

E. अष्ट eight, and अङ्ग a limb.

4864: अहस्कर m. (-रः) The sun.  E. अहन् and कर who makes.
4865: अहस्पति m. (-तिः) 	 1. The sun. 	 2. Swallow wort.  E. अहन् and पति master.
4866: अहह ind. A particle or interjection, as ah! aha! &c. implying: 1. Surprise: 2. Fatigue: 3. Pain: 4. Pleasure: 5. Calling.  E. अह from अहम् I, and ह from हा to abandon: self or pride-abandon-ment; also अहहा.
4868: अहार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Not to be stolen or taken away. 	 m. (-र्य्यः) A mountain.  E. अ neg. and हार्य्य future part. of हृञ् to take or con-vey.
4869: अहार्य्यत्व n. (-त्वं) Security, not being liable to be stolen or taken away. E. अहार्य्य and त्व affix; also अहार्य्यता.
4870: अहि m. (-हिः) 	 1. A snake or serpent. 	 2. The sun. 	 3. A traveller. 	 4. Lead. 	 5. The name of a demon: see वृत्रासुर. 	 6. A name of RĀHU, the ascending node.  E. आङ् prefixed to हन् to hurt, इन् Unādi affix; injuring all or every thing, the आ of आङ् is made short.
4871: अहिंसक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Harmless, innocuous.  E. अ neg. हिंसक mis-chievous: so अहिंस्र and अहिंस्रक.
4872: अहिंसा f. (-सा) Harmlessness, doing injury to nothing, one of the car-dinal virtues of most Hindu sects, but particularly of the Baud-dhas and Jainas.  E. अ neg. हिंसा hurt.
4873: अहिंसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Uninjured.  E. अ neg. हिंसित hurt.
4874: अहिंस्र mfn. (-स्रः-स्रा-स्रं) Innocuous, innocent, harmless. 	 f. (-स्रा) The name of a plant, commonly Kurkavali: see कर्कटा.  E. अ neg. and हिंस्रा in-jurious: than which there is none more so.
4875: अहिका f. (-का) The silk cotton tree, (Bombax heptaphyllum.)  E. अ neg. and हा to go or abandon, ङिक् and टाप् affs.
4876: अहिकान्त m. (-न्तः) Air, wind.  E. अहि a serpent, and कान्त beloved; snakes being supposed to feed upon air.
4877: अहिच्छत्र m. (-त्रः) 	 1. The name of a country. 	 2. A milky or thorny plant: see मेषशृङ्गी. 	 f. (-त्रा) 	 1. Sugar. 	 2. A city.  E. अहि a snake, and छत्र a parasol.
4878: अहिजित् m. (-जित्) 	 1. A name of KRISHNA. 	 2. Also of INDRA.  E. अहि and जित् who conquers, from जि with क्विप् affix; subduing a demon in the form of a snake.
4879: अहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Hostile, inimical. 	 2. Hurtful, prejudicial. 	 m. (-तः) An enemy. 	 n. (-तं) Food, &c. contra-indicated in a disease. E. अ neg. and हित friendly, fit, proper.
4880: अहितकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Adverse, inimical, acting unkindly. E. अहित unkind, कारिन् acting.
4881: अहितमनस् mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः) Hating, adverse, inimical.  E. अहित and मनस् mind.
4882: अहितुण्डिक m. (-कः) A snake-catcher or exhibiter.  E. अहि and तुण्ड face, इकन् aff.
4883: अहिद्विष् m. (-द्विट्) 	 1. A name of INDRA. 	 2. GARUDA the bird of VISHNU. 3. A peacock. 	 4. An ichneumon.  E. अहि and द्विष् who hates, from द्विष् to hate with क्विप् affix; serpent-hater or enemy.
4884: अहिनकुलिका f. (-का) The natural enmity subsisting between a snake and an ichneumon.  E. अहि, नकुल a mungoose, वुन् aff.
4885: अहिनिर्म्मोक m. (-कः) The slough of a snake.  E. अहि and निर्म्मोक the same.
4886: अहिपति m. (-तिः) 	 1. A name of SHESHA, the sovereign of the snakes; also of VASUKI and others. 	 2. Any large serpent.  E. अहि a snake, and पति lord; also similar compounds, as अहिनाथः, अहीन्द्रः, अहीशः, अहीश्वरः, &c.
4887: अहिपुत्रक m. (-कः) A kind of boat.  E. अहि and पुत्रक a son, resembling a snake.
4888: अहिफेन n. (-नं) 	 1. Opium. 	 2. The saliva or venom of a snake.  E. अहि a snake, and फेन foam.
4889: अहिब्रध्न m. (-ध्नः) 	 1. A name of SIVA. 	 2. One of the demigods called RUDRAS.  E. अहि and ब्रधि to bind, नक् Unādi affix; having his neck bound with snakes.
4890: अहिब्रध्नदेवता f. (-ता) The twenty-sixth constellation.  E. अहिब्रध्न and देवता presiding deity.
4891: अहिभय n. (-यं) Mistrust or apprehension of treachery.  E. अहि and भय fear; fear of a lurking snake as it were.
4892: अजिभुज् m. (-भुक्) GARUDA the bird of VISHNU. 	 2. A peacock.  E. अहि and भुज् who eats, from भुज् and क्विप् affix; snake-eater.
4893: अहिमांशु m. (-शुः) The sun.  E. अ neg. हिम cold, and अंशु a ray; also si-milar compounds, as अहिमकर, अहिमरुचि, अहिमतेजस्, &c.
4894: अहिविद्विष् m. (-द्विट्) 	 1. GARUDA. 	 2. INDRA.  E. अहि a snake or VRITRA-SURA, and विद्विष् foe.
4895: अहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Possessed of, not deprived of. 	 2. Not out-caste or vile.  E. अ neg. हीन deprived of. 	 m. (-नः) 	 1. A large snake, a serpent. 	 2. A particular sacrifice, one lasting twelve days.  E. अहि a snake, and इन superior, or अहन् a day, and ख aff.
4896: अहीनवादिन् m. (-दी) A witness who is not unfit to give evidence.  E. अ neg. हीनवादी a defective witness.
4897: अहीरणि m. (-णिः) A kind of snake, said to be two-headed.  E. अहि, इर to move, and अणि aff.
4898: अहुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unoffered, unsacrificed. 	 2. Uncalled, unsummon-ed. 	 m. (-तः) Religious meditation and prayer, considered as one of the five great sacraments.  E. अ neg. हु to sacrifice, or ह्वे to call, क्त aff.
4899: अहे ind. A particle implying, 1. Rejection. 	 2. Separation.
4900: अहेतु m. (-तुः) Absence of cause or reason.  E. अ neg. हेतु cause.
4901: अहेतुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Causeless, groundless.  E. अ neg. हेतुक having cause.
4902: अहेतुता f. (-ता) Absence of cause or necessity.  E. तल् added to अहेतु.
4903: अहेतुत्व n. (-त्वं) Absence of reason or cause.  E. त्व added to अहेतु.
4904: अहेरु f. (-रुः) A plant, (Asparagus racemosus:) see शतमूली.  E. अ neg. हि to go, and रु affix; immoveable; alluding to the number of its roots.
4905: अहो ind. A particle and interjection of, 1. Reproach, (fie !) 	 2. Compassion. 	 3. Regret, (ah ! oh !) 	 4. Calling, (ho ! hola !) 	 5. Praise, flattery, approbation. 	 6. Fatigue, weariness. 	 7. Surprise, (ah !) 	 8. Doubt, deliberation, (either, or.) 	 9. Contempt, sneer-ing. 	 10. An expletive.  E. अ neg. हा to go, and डो aff.
4906: अहोरात्र m. (-त्रः) A day of twenty-four hours or thirty Muhūrtas, from sun-rise to sun-rise. 	 n. or ind. (-त्रम्) Day and night, continually, always.  E. अहन् a day, and रात्रि a night.
4907: अहोवत ind. 	 1. A particle of calling; 2. Of compassion; 3. Of fatigue.
4908: अहोही ind. In a variegated or wonderful manner.
4909: अह्नाय ind. Soon, instantly.  E. अ neg. ह्नाय from ह्नु to take away or secrete, with घञ् affix, and य substituted for the व to which the radical त is changed.
4910: अह्नीक m. (-कः) A Bauddha mendicant.  E. अ neg. and ह्नीक bashful.
4911: अह्वला f. (-ला) The marking nut-plant, (Semecarpus anacardium.)  E. अ neg. ह्वे to emulate, and डल् aff.
4912: आ The second letter of the alphabet, corresponding to A long, as in far, and written in the Roman character Ā.
4913: आ ind. 	 1. A particle of reminiscence, (ah! oh!) 	 2. A conjunction disjunctive, (but) 	 3. A particle of compassion, (ah! alas!) 	 4. A conjunction copulative, (and.) This particle remains unaltered in orthography even before vowels.
4914: आ or आङ् A particle, and prefix to words, implying; 1. Diminu-tion, (a little.) 	 2. Limit inceptive, (from, from thence, or that time.) 	 3. Limit conclusive, (until, unto, as far as.) 	 4. Prefixed to verbs it extends or reverses their meaning, as रुह to rise, आरुह to ascend, to mount, and गम to go, आगम to come. 	 5. In composi-tion with nouns it forms indeclinables, either crude, as आजानु to the knee, or with the terminations of the objective or ablative case, as आसमुद्रं or आसमुद्रात् as far as to the ocean. 	 6. A particle of menace or of pain, (ah! alas!) this is more correctly written आस्  E. आप् to pervade, to obtain, and डाङ् affix, प is dropped.
4915: आ m. (आः) A name of MAHĀDEVA.
4916: आ ind. A particle of assent, yes, verily.  E. अम to go, क्विप् affix, अ be-comes आ
4917: आकम्पन n. (-नं) Shaking, trembling.  E. आङ् before कपि to tremble, ल्युट् aff.
4918: आकम्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shaken, trembling.  E. आङ् prefixed, कपि to shake, and क्त participial aff.
4919: आकम्प्र mfn. (-म्प्रः-म्प्रा-म्प्रं) Trembling, shaking, agitated.  E. आङ् before कपि to shake, रक् aff.
4920: आकर m. (-रः) 	 1. A mine. 	 2. A multitude. 	 3. Best, excellent.  E. आङ् prefixed, कृ to make, &c. अप् aff.
4921: आकरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Mineral, produced in a mine, &c.  E. आकर and इनि aff.
4922: आकर्णन n. (-नं) Hearing.  E. आङ् before कर्ण to hear, ल्युट् aff.
4923: आकर्णित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Heard.  E. आङ्, कर्ण to hear, affix क्त.
4924: आकर्ष m. (-र्षः) 	 1. Pulling, hawling. 	 2. Pulling to or towards, dragging, attracting. 	 3. Attraction, fascination. 	 4. Magnetic attraction. 	 5. A magnet, a loadstone. 	 6. A dice or die. 	 7. Playing with dice. 	 8. A board of such a game. 	 9. Drawing the bow. 	 10. An organ of sense. 11. Spasm.  E. आङ्, कृष् to draw or make furrows, घञ् aff.
4925: आकर्षक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Attractive, what draws or attracts. 	 m. (-कः) A magnet or loadstone.  E. आकर्ष attraction, and वुन् aff.
4926: आकर्षण n. (-णं) Pulling, drawing, attracting. 	 f. (-णी) 	 1. A crooked stick, for pulling down fruit, &c. 	 2. Any instrument for pulling.  E. आङ् before कृष् to pull, ल्युट् aff.
4927: आकर्षिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Magnetic, attractive.  E. आकर्ष and ष्ठल् aff.
4928: आकर्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Drawn, attracted.  E. आङ् before कृष् to draw, क्त aff.
4929: आकर्षिन् mfn. (-र्षी-र्षिणी-र्षि) Attractive. 	 f. (-णी) A rod with a hook at the end to pull down the boughs of trees, for the purpose of gathering the fruit.  E. आङ् before कृष् to draw, णिनि aff.
4930: आकलन n. (-नं) 	 1. Wish, desire. 	 2. Counting, reckoning. 	 3. Confinement, binding. 	 4. Laying hold of.  E. आङ्, कल to count, sound, &c. and ल्युट् aff.
4931: आकलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Counted, reckoned. 	 2. Seized, held, bound.  E. आङ् before कल to count, &c. क्त aff.
4932: आकल्प m. (-ल्पः) 	 1. Ornament, decoration. 	 2. Encreasing, adding to, improving. 	 3. Sickness, disease.  E. आङ् before कृप् to be able, to be weak, &c. घञ् aff.
4933: आकल्पक m. (-कः) 	 1. Remembering with regret, missing. 	 2. Fainting, loss of sense or perception. 	 3. Darkness. 	 4. A knot or joint.  E. आङ्, कल्प from कृप् to be able, to be weak, &c. and ण्वुल् aff.
4934: आकष m. (-षः) A touchstone.  E. आङ्, कष to injure, and अच् aff.
4935: आकषक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Touching, assaying.  E. वुन् added to the last.
4936: आकषिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Touching, testing.  E. आकष and ष्ठल् aff.
4937: आकस्मिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Sudden, unexpected, causeless.  E. अकस्मात् and ठञ् aff.
4938: आकाङ्क्षत् mfn. (-ङ्क्षन्-ङ्क्षन्ती-ङ्क्षत्) 	 1. Wishing, expecting. 	 2. Looking at, to, or towards.  E. आङ् before काङ्क्षि to desire, शतृ aff.
4939: आकाङ्क्षणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Desirable, to be desired or expected.  E. आङ् before काङ्क्षि to desire, अनीयर् affix; also आकाङ्क्षितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) and आकाङ्क्ष्य mfn. (-ङ्क्ष्यः-ङ्क्ष्या-ङ्क्ष्यं) with तव्य and यत् affs.
4940: आकाङ्क्षा f. (-ङ्क्षा) 	 1. Wish, desire. 	 2. Purpose, intention. 	 3. Looking at, to, or towards. 	 4. Enquiry, asking. 	 5. The presence of a word in a sentence indispensable to the sense. 	 6. The significancy of a word.  E. आङ् prefixed to काङ्क्षि to desire, अच् and टाप् affs.
4941: आकाङ्क्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Wished, desired. 	 2. Asked, enquired. 	 3. Regarded, looked at. 	 4. Wanted, necessary.  E. आङ् before काङ्क्षि to desire, क्त aff.
4942: आकाङ्क्षिन् mfn. (-ङ्क्षी-ङ्क्षिणी-ङ्क्षि) 	 1. Wishing, wishful. 	 2. Asking, enquiring, expectant.  E. आकाङ्क्षा and इनि aff.
4943: आकाय m. (-यः) 	 1. A funeral pile. 	 2. Abode, residence.  E. आङ् before चि to collect, घञ् affix, च changed to क.
4944: आकार m. (-रः) 	 1. Hint, sing, token. 	 2. Form. 	 3. The letter आ  E. आङ्, कृ to make, affix घञ्.
4945: आकारगुप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Dissimulation.  E. आकार and गुप्ति concealment, suppressing all sign or indication of the feelings.
4947: आकारण nf. (-णं-णा) Calling, a call or summons.  E. आङ्, कृ to make or do in the causal form, and ल्युट् affix, fem. affix टाप्; sometimes written आकरण.
4948: आकारवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Symmetrical, handsome, well formed. E. आकार form, and मतुप् aff.
4949: आकारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Called or summoned. 	 2. Stipulated, agreed. 3. Demanded, exacted.  E. आङ् before कृ to make, causal form, क्त aff.
4950: आकालिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Momentary, instantaneous. 	 2. Unseason-able, improper with respect to time. 	 f. (-की) Lightning.  E. अ neg. काल time, ठक् affix, fem. ङीप्.
4951: आकालिकत्व n. (-त्वं) Unseasonableness, suddenness.  E. त्व added to the last.
4952: आकाश mn. (-शः-शं) 	 1. The fifth element, æther, the sky or atmosphere. 2. Brahma as identical with æther. 	 3. Space, vacuity.  E. आङ् and काशृ to shine, घञ् affix; every where shining; Akash is the subtle and æthereal fluid, supposed to fill and pervade the universe, and to be the peculiar vehicle of life and sound.
4953: आकाशकक्षा f. (-क्षा) The horizon.  E. आकाश and कक्षा girdle.
4954: आकाशज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced in the sky.  E. आकाश and ज born.
4955: आकाशजननिन् m. (-नी) A loop-hole, a casement, an embrasure.  E. आकाश and जननिन् what generates, giving air and light.
4956: अकाशदीप m. (-पः) 	 1. A lamp or torch lighted in honour of LAKSHMI or VISHNU, and elevated on a pole in the open air at the Dewali festival, in the month Kartik. 	 2. A beacon, a lanthorn on a pole. E. आकाश and दीप a lamp; also आकाशप्रदीपः.
4957: आकाशभाषित n. (-तं) 	 1. Speaking outside or of the stage, or a supposi-tious speech, which is replied to as if it had been spoken, (in dramatic language.) 	 2. A voice or sound in the air.  E. आकाश and भाषित spoken.
4958: आकाशमण्डल n. (-लं) The celestial sphere.  E. आकाश and मण्डल a circle.
4959: आकाशमांसी f. (-सी) A plant, small Jatāmānsi, (Valeriana Jatamansi.)
4960: आकाशमूली f. (-ली) An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.)  E. आकाश and मूली having roots; having its root in air.
4961: आकाशयान n. (-नं) A heavenly car, one moving through the air. E. आकाश and यान vehicle.
4962: आकाशरक्षिन् m. (-क्षी) A warder, a watchman on the outer battlements. E. आकाश and रक्षिन् a guard.
4963: आकाशवर्त्मव् n. (-र्त्म) The atmosphere, the firmament, the air.  E. आकाश and वर्त्मन् a road.
4964: आकाशवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A sort of creeper, a parasite. (Cassyta filiformis.) E. आकाश and वल्ली pedicle.
4965: आकाशवाणी f. (-णी) A voice from heaven.  E. आकाश and वाणी speech.
4966: आकाशसलिल n. (-लं) Rain.  E. आकाश and सलिल water.
4967: आकाशस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Abiding in the sky.  E. आकाश and स्थ what stays.
4968: आकाशीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Atmospherical. Also आकाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि)
4969: आकाशे ind. In the air, a stage direction, implying something said by or to a person out of sight. E. 7th case of आकाश.
4970: आकाशेश m. (-शः) 	 1. INDRA, as ruler of the firmament. 	 2. (In law) A helpless person, as a child, a woman, a pauper or invalid.  E. आकाश and ईश lord.
4971: आकिञ्चन n. (-नं) Poverty.  E. अकिञ्चन poor, अण् aff.
4972: आकीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 	 1. Filled, overspread. 	 2. Crowded. 	 3. Impervious. 4. Spread. 	 5. Scattered.  E. आङ्, कॄ to scatter, part. affix क्त.
4973: आकीर्णता f. (-ता) 	 1. Fulness. 	 2. Crowd, multitude.  E. आकीर्ण filled, तल् affix; also आकीर्णत्वं
4974: आकुञ्चन n. (-नं) 	 1. Compression, contraction, shrinking. 	 2. Collecting, heaping. 	 3. Curving, flexure. 	 4. Contortion.  E. आङ् before कुचि to contract, ल्युट् aff.
4975: आकुञ्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Bent, contracted. 	 2. Twisted, contorted. E. आङ् before कुचि to contract, affix क्त.
4976: आकुण्ठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Confounded, abashed.  E. आङ् before कुण्ठित abashed.
4977: आकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Confounded, confused, flurried. 	 2. Confused (in order), disordered. 	 3. Incoherent, contradictory.  E. आङ्, कुल to accumulate, and क affix; not self-possessed.
4978: आकुलत्व n. (-त्वं) Confusion, perplexity, bewilderment.  E. आकुल and त्व affix; also with तल् affix आकुलता.
4979: आकुलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Bewildered, flurried, agitated. 	 2. Distressed. E. आङ् before कुल, क्त aff.
4980: आकुलीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bewildered, perplexed.  E. आकुल and कृत made with च्वि aff.
4981: आकुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Expelled, extracted.  E. आकुष to extract, क्त aff.
4982: आकूत n. (-तं) 	 1. Meaning, intention. 	 2. Wish, desire.  E. आङ्, कूङ् to cry, affix क्त.
4983: आकृति f. (-तिः) 	 1. Form, figure. 	 2. The body. 	 3. Tribe, species. 	 4. A metre: a stanza of four lines, with twenty-two syllables to each line.  E. आङ् before कृ to make or do, क्तिन् aff.
4985: आकृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Pulled, drawn. 	 2. Attracted.  E. आङ् before कृष् to drag, क्त aff.
4986: आकृष्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Drawing, attracting.  E. आकृष to draw, शानच् aff.
4987: आकृष्टवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 	 1. Pulling, dragging, pulling up or out. 	 2. Pulling to, attracting. 	 3. Charming, fascinating.  E. आकृष्ट and मतुप् aff.
4988: आकृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 	 1. Pulling, dragging. 	 2. Drawing, attraction.  E. आङ् before कृष् to drag, affix क्तिन्.
4990: आकौशल n. (-लं) Inexpertness, want of skill or practice.  E. अकुशल un-skilful, affix अण् and the initial optionally long.
4991: आक्रन्द mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं) Who checks or restrains. 	 m. (-न्दः) 	 1. Crying, crying out. 	 2. Calling. 	 3. Weeping, sobbing. 	 4. Sound. 	 5. Vio-lence. 	 6. Furious or violent combat. 	 7. A friend. 	 8. A brother. 	 9. A king, a lord. 	 10. A usurper. 	 11. A king who prevents an ally from aiding another.  E. आङ्, क्रन्द to cry, to sound, &c. अच् aff.
4992: आक्रन्दिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Going where sounds of distress are heard. E. आक्रन्द and ठञ् aff.
4993: आक्रम m. (-मः) 	 1. Going over or beyond. 	 2. Surpassing. 	 3. Spreading over or upon. 	 4. Overleading. 	 5. Attaining, overcoming, obtaining. 6. Invading, attacking, falling upon. 	 7. Might, valour.  E. आङ् be-fore क्रम to go, to mount, ascend, surpass, &c. affix अच्.

4995: आक्रमणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. To be attacked. 	 2. To be surpassed or over-come. 	 3. To be seized.  E. आङ् before क्रम to go, अनीयर् aff.
4996: आक्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 	 1. Surpassed, surmounted. 	 2. Overcome, over-run. 	 3. Pained, distressed. 	 4. Accompanied, attended. 	 5. Over-spread. 	 6. Obtained, possessed. 	 7. Agitated or overcome by, as a feeling.  E. आक्रम to mount, surpass, &c. and part. affix क्त.
4997: आक्रान्ति f. (-न्तिः) 	 1. Going over or beyond. 	 2. Overpowering. 	 3. Might, valour.  E. आङ् before क्रम to go, affix क्तिन्; see आक्रम.
4998: आक्रामक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Invading, assailing 2. Overrunning.  E. आङ् before क्रम to go, ण्वुल् aff.
4999: आक्रीड m. (-डः) 	 1. A royal garden. 	 2. Sport, pleasure.  E. आङ्, क्रीड to play, घञ् aff.
5000: आक्रीडन n. (-नं) Sporting, taking pleasure.  E. आक्रीड to sport, affix ल्युट्.
5001: आक्रीडिन् mfn. (-डी-डिनी-डि) Sporting, playing.  E. आक्रीड to play, घिनुण् aff.
5002: आक्रुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Cursed. 	 2. Accused, calumniated. 	 3. Abused. 4. Vociferated.  E. आङ् before क्रुश to call, affix क्त.
5003: आक्रोश m. (-शः) 	 1. Abuse, censuring, a curse or oath. 	 2. Vociferousness, calling aloud.  E. आङ्, क्रुश to call, घञ् aff.
5004: आक्रोशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Abusing, abusive. 	 2. Vociferous.  E. आक्रुश to call, वुञ् aff.
5005: आक्रोशन n. (-नं) Curse, imprecation.  E. आङ्, क्रुश to call, ल्युट् aff.
5006: अक्रोशनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be accursed, censurable, reprovable.  E. आङ् before क्रुश to cry, अनीयर् affix; also आक्रुश्य and आक्रोशितव्य.
5007: आक्षद्यूतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Effected or completed by gambling.  E. अक्षद्यूत and ठक् aff.
5008: आक्षपण n. (-णं) Fasting, or purification by fasting.  E. आङ् before क्षप to endure, ल्युट् aff.
5009: आक्षपाटिक m. (-कः) A judge.  E. अक्ष a law-suit, पट to go, causal form, उक affix; also अक्षपाटिक.
5010: आक्षपाद m. (-दः) A logician.  E. अक्ष dispute, पाद a division, अण् affix; also अक्षपाद.
5011: आक्षार m. (-रः) Accusation, calumny.  E. आङ् before क्षर to go, affix घञ्.
5012: आक्षारण nf. (-णं-णा) 	 1. Calumnious accusation. 	 2. Abuse, reviling. E. आङ्, क्षर to go, with युच् aff.
5013: आक्षारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Calumniated, falsely accused. 	 2. Accused of adultery or fornication. 	 3. Falsely accused, of such crimes in parti-cular. 	 4. Guilty, criminal. 	 5. Reviled, abused.  E. आङ्, क्षर to go, part. affix क्त.
5014: आक्षिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Relating or belonging to a die, to gambling, &c. 	 2. Won at dice. 	 m. (-कः) A tree, (Morinda tinctoria.) 	 n. (-कं) A gambling debt, money lost at play.  E. अक्ष a die, &c. and ठञ् aff.
5015: आक्षिकपण m. (-णः) A stake, a wager, a bet.  E. आक्षिक and पण a wager.
5016: आक्षिपत् mfn. (-पन्-पती-पत्) 	 1. Excelling, so as to reproach or put to shame others. 	 2. Reviling, abusing. 	 3. Tossing. 	 4. Sending.  E. आङ् before क्षिप to throw, affix शतृ.
5017: आक्षिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 	 1. Cast, thrown, tossed. 	 2. Thrown down or away. 3. Borne, carried. 	 4. Reviled, abused, blamed, ridiculed. 	 4. Equal or equivalent to.  E. आङ् before क्षिप् to throw, क्त aff.
5018: आक्षीव m. (-वः) A plant, (Morunga guilandina and hyperanthera:) see अक्षीव.
5019: आक्षेप m. (-पः) 	 1. Throw, toss. 	 2. Abuse, reviling. 	 3. Censure, blame, re-proach. 	 4. Attraction. 	 5. A figure in rhetoric, (irony.)  E. आङ्, क्षिप् to throw or send, घञ् aff.
5020: आक्षेपक m. (-कः) 	 1. Sickness, disease. 	 2. Convulsion, spasm. 	 3. A de-tractor, a calumniator or accuser. 	 4. A thrower.  E. आङ् before क्षिप् to toss, ण्वुल् aff.
5021: आक्षैत्रज्ञ n. (-ज्ञं) Spiritual ignorance.  E. अ neg. क्षेत्रज्ञ wise, and ष्यञ् affix, the initial optionally long.
5022: आक्षोट m. (-टः) A tree, (see पीलु,) growing in mountains: in Hindi, the corresponding name implies the walnut: see अक्षोट and आक्षोड.
5023: आक्षोड m. (-डः) A kind of Pilu, a tree so named, (Careya arborea:) see अक्षोड, अक्षोट and पीलु.
5024: आक्षोद m. (-दः) A Brahman of the Rikshoda mountain.  E. ऋक्षोद and अण् aff.
5026: आख m. (-खः) A spade, a hoe.  E. आङ्, खन् to dig, ड aff.
5027: आखण्डल m. (-लः) A name of INDRA.  E. आङ् and खण्ड to break, अलच् affix; mountain-breaking, foe-destroying.
5028: आखन m. (-नः) 	 1. A spade. 	 2. A digger.  E. आङ्, खन् to dig, घ aff.
5029: आखनिक m. (-कः) 	 1. A thief. 	 2. A rat. 	 3. A hog. 	 4. A spade. 	 5. A digger, a ditcher, a miner.  E. आङ्, खन् to dig, and इकन् Unādi aff.
5030: आखनिकवक m. (-कः) 	 1. A spade. 	 2. A digger.  E. आङ् before खन् to dig, इकवक aff.
5031: आखर m. (-रः) 	 1. A spade. 	 2. A digger.  E. आङ्, खन् to dig, डर aff.
5032: आखात mn. (-तः-तं) A natural pond: see अखात.
5033: आखान m. (-नः) 	 1. A spade. 	 2. A digger.  E. आङ्, खन् to dig. घञ् aff.
5034: आखु m. (-खुः) 	 1. A rat, a mouse. 	 2. A hog. 	 3. A thief. 	 4. A sort of tree: see देवताड.  E. आङ्, खन् to dig, and कु Unādi aff.
5035: आखुकर्णी f. (-र्णी) The name of a plant, (Salvinia cucullata.)  E. आखु a mouse, and कर्ण an ear; the leaves are compared to the ears of a mouse.
5036: आखुग m. (-गः) 	 1. A name of GANESA. 	 2. A name of KĀRTIKEYA. E. आखु a rat, and ग who goes; GANESA is represented riding on a rat.
5037: आखुघात m. (-तः) A Sudra or man of low caste and profession, lit. a rat-catcher.  E. आखु and घात a blow.
5038: आखुपर्णिका f. (-का) A plant: see आखुकर्णी.  E. आखु and पर्ण a leaf.
5040: आखुपाषाण m. (-णः) A kind of mineral, a loadstone.  E. आखु and पाषाण a stone.
5041: आखुभुज् m. (-भुक्) A cat.  E. आखु and भुज् who eats.
5042: आखुरथ m. (-थः) A name of GANESA.  E. आखु, and रथ a carriage; whose vehicle is a rat.
5043: आखुविषहा f. (-हा) A kind of grass, (Andropogon serratum.)  E. आखु, विष venom, and हा what destroys; considered as a remedy for the bite of a rat.
5044: आखूत्थ m. (-त्थः) The rising up or coming of rats, a swarm of rats. E. आखु and उत्थ from उत् and स्था with क aff.
5045: आखेट m. (-टः) 	 1. Chase, hunting. 	 2. Terror, fright.  E. आङ्, खिट to alarm, घञ् aff.
5046: आखेटक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Hunting, a hunter. 	 2. Frightening, fright-ful. 	 n. (-कं) Hunting.  E. आखेट and कन् pleonastic affix; or आङ् with खिट and ण्वुल् aff.
5047: आखेटशीर्षक n. (-कं) A cavern, a mine.  E. आखेट terrifying, and शीर्ष the head or principal, क affix: very gloomy and terrifying.
5048: आखेटिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Who or what hunts. 	 2. Terrible, frightful. m. (-कः) 	 1. A hound. 	 2. A hunter.  E. आखेट chase, and ठक् aff.
5049: आखोट m. (-टः) The walnut tree. E. See अक्षोट. &c.
5050: आख्या f. (-ख्या) A name or appellation.  E. ख्या to say, आङ् prefixed, अङ् and टाप् fem. affs.

5052: आख्यान n. (-नं) 	 1. A tale, a legend. 	 2. Saying, declaring.  E. आङ् before ख्या to tell, affix ल्युट्.
5053: आख्यायक m. (-कः) A messenger, a teller, an announcer or relater. 	 f. (-यिका) A tale, a true or probable story.  E. आख्या to say, खुल् affix, य inserted.
5054: आख्येय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fit or proper to be said.  E. आङ् before ख्या to say, affix यत्; also आख्यातव्य.
5055: आगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Arrived, come. 	 2. Received, obtained. 	 3. Living or residing in.  E. आङ् before गम् to go, क्त aff.
5056: आगत्य ind. Having arrived.  E. आङ् before गम् to go, ल्यप् aff.
5057: आगन्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) What will come, what is likely to arrive. E. आङ् and गम् to go, तव्य aff.
5058: आगन्तु mfn. (-न्तुः-न्तुः-न्तु) 	 1. Coming, arriving. 	 2. Incidental, adventi-tious. 	 m. (-न्तुः) 	 1. A guest. 	 2. A stranger, a new comer. 	 3. An accident, any accidental hurt or wound.  E. आङ् before गम् to go, to come, तु affix; म becomes न; also आगान्तु and आगन्तुक.

5061: आगमन n. (-नं) Arriving, coming.  E. आङ् before गम् to go, ल्युट् aff.
5062: आगमनिरपेक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Independent of a written voucher or title. E. आगम and निरपेक्षा disregard.

5066: आगमापायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Transient, of short duration.  E. आगम and अपायिन् separating, going at the time of arrival.

5068: आगम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) 	 1. To be approached, accessible. 	 2. To be acquired. E. आङ् before गम् with यत् aff.

5070: आगाध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Very deep: see अगाध.
5071: आगान्तु mfn. (-न्तुः-न्तुः-न्तु) A guest: see आगन्तु.
5072: आगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) 	 1. Arriving, coming. 	 2. Future.  E. आङ् before गम् to go, णिनि aff.
5073: आगार n. (-रं) A house, a dwelling: see अगार.
5074: आगारदाह m. (-हः) Arson, setting a house on fire.  E. आगार and दाह burn-ing.
5075: आगारदाहिन् m. (-ही) An incendiary.  E. आगारदाह arson, and इनि aff.
5076: आगुर् f. (-गूः) An agreement: see आगू.
5077: आगुरव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) 	 1. Consisting of or containing Agallochum. 	 2. Very heavy.  E. अगुरु and अण् aff.
5078: आगू f. (-गूः) An agreement.  E. आगम to come, डू affix or आङ् prefixed to गू to come and क्विन् affix; also आगुर्.
5079: आग्रीध्र n. (-ध्रं) The place where a sacrificial fire is kindled.  E. अग्नि fire, and इन्ध to kindle; see अग्नीध्र.
5080: आग्नेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Belonging or relating to fire or its deity. 	 n. (-यं) 1. The name of a city, (Devikotta, on the Coromandel Coast.) 	 2. Blood. 	 3. Ghee or boiled butter. 	 m. (-यः) A mane of the saint AGASTI. 	 f. (-यी) 	 1. The wife of AGNI. 	 2. The south-east quarter, of which AGNI is the regent.  E. अग्नि fire or its deity, ढक् affix which leaves एय.
5081: आग्रह m. (-हः) 	 1. Favour, patronage. 	 2. Seizing, taking. 	 3. Surpassing, surmounting. 	 4. Power, ability.  E. आङ्, ग्रह to take, अप् aff.
5082: आग्रहायण m. (-णः) A month so called, the first of the Hindu year ac-cording to some systems, (November-December.)  E. अग्र beginning, and हायन a year; also अग्रहायण, the अ being unchanged.

5084: आग्रहायणी f. (-णी) 	 1. The name of a constellation consisting of three stars, one of which is Orionis, figured by an antelope's head, hence also मृगशिरस्. 	 2. The day of full moon in the month Āgrahayana.  E. अग्रहायण and ङीप् aff.
5085: आग्रायण n. (-णं) A sacrifice offered when the new rice or wheat ripens. E. अग्र chief, अयन coming, अण् aff.
5086: आग्रायणेष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A particular ceremony: see the last.  E. आग्रायण and इष्टि a sacrifice.
5087: आघट्टक m. (-कः) 	 1. A tree, (the red sort of Achyranthes.) 	 2. A rubber, what effects friction.  E. आङ् before घट्ट to move, and वुन् aff.
5088: आघट्टन n. (-नं) 	 1. Friction, rubbing, contact. 	 2. Shaking.  E. आङ् before घट्ट to move, ल्युट् aff.
5089: आघट्टित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Touched, rubbed. 	 2. Shaken.  E. आङ् before घट्ट to move, affix क्त.
5090: आघर्ष m. (-र्षः) Rubbing, friction.  E. आङ् before घृष् to rub, affix घञ्.
5091: आघर्षण n. (-णं) Rubbing, friction. 	 f. (-णी) A brush, a rubber.  E. आङ् before घृष् to rub, affix ल्युट्.
5092: आघर्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Rubbed.  E. आङ् before घृष् to rub, क्त aff.
5093: आघाट m. (-टः) 	 1. A limit, a boundary. 	 2. A tree, (Achyranthes aspera.) E. आङ्, घट to endeavour, घञ् aff.
5094: आघात m. (-तः) 	 1. Killing, striking. 	 2. A blow, a wound. 	 3. A slaughter-house, a place for killing animals or victims.  E. आङ्, हन to kill or injure, in the participial form; घ is substituted for ह.
5095: आघातन n. (-नं) 	 1. Striking, killing. 	 2. A slaughter-house.  E. आङ्, हन to kill or injure, ल्युट् aff.

6161: इ m. (इः) A name of KAMADEVA. Ind. An interjection. 	 1. Of anger. 	 2. Of calling. 	 3. Of sorrow or distress. 	 4. Of compassion.  E. इ to go, क्विप् aff.
6162: इ r. 1st cl. (अयति) To go, to go to or towards: with उत् prefixed, to rise or ascend, as the sun, &c. with अभि and उत् the same, or to rise in the world, to prosper. (ङ) इङ् and अधि always prefixed अधीङ् r. 2nd cl. (अधीते) To study, to learn, to read over or through. (क) इक् and अधि prefixed r. 2nd cl. (अध्येति) To remember, to think of. (ण) इण् r. 2nd cl. (एति) To go. This root takes many prefixes, implying with अति, 1. To surpass, to surmount. 	 2. To pass, to spend time or to elapse as time. With अनु, 1. To go after, to follow. 	 2. To go like, to imitate in going. 	 3. To succeed. With अभि, 1. To obtain, to get. 	 2. To proceed, to go on. 	 3. To go. 	 4. To ap-proach. 	 5. To serve or worship. With अप, 1. To go away, to de-part. 	 2. To perish. With अभि and उप, To arrive. With उप, 1. To receive. 	 2. To aid or assist. 	 3. To approach or go near so. With निर्, To go forth or out from. With प्रति, 1. To trust, to confide. 	 2. To follow, to be added or subjoined to. 	 3. (In the passive verb,) To become evident or manifest. With वि, To expend, to waste, to de-part. With सम् and उप, To obtain, &c.

6295: इन्द्रच्छन्दस् n. (-न्दः) A necklace of a thousand strings.  E. इन्द्र best, and छन्दस् a necklace, &c.
6296: इन्द्रजाल n. (-लं) 	 1. Conjuring, juggling. 	 2. Deception, cheating. 	 3. Trick or stratagem in war.  E. इन्द्र an organ of sense, and जाल a net.
6297: इन्द्रजालिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. A juggler, a conjuror. 	 2. Deceptive, un-real.  E. इन्द्रजाल illusion, and ठक् aff.
6298: इन्द्रजित् m. (-जित्) The son of RAVANA.  E. इन्द्र and जित् who conquers: the conqueror of INDRA.
6299: इन्द्रजिद्विजयिन् m. (-यी) LAKSHMANA, the brother of RAMA.  E. इन्द्रजित् and विजयिन् a victor, the conqueror of INDRAJIT.
6300: इन्द्रतूल n. (-लं) A flock of cotton, a flocculent seed, &c. blown about in the air.  E. इन्द्र and तूल cotton: INDRA'S cotton.
6301: इन्द्रतूलक n. (-कं) See the preceding. E. As before, कन् added.
6302: इन्द्रदारु m. (-रुः) A tree, (Pinus devadaru.)  E. इन्द्र and दारु tree.
6303: इन्द्रद्रु m. (-द्रुः) A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna, Rox.)  E. इन्द्र and द्रु a tree a staff of which is fit to carry the banner of INDRA.
6304: इन्द्रद्रुम m. (-मः) See the preceding. E. As before.
6305: इन्द्रनील m. (-लः) A sapphire.  E. इन्द्र best, and नील blue.
6306: इन्द्रनीलक m. (-कः) An emerald. E. See the preceding.
6307: इन्द्रपुष्पा f. (-ष्पा) A medicinal plant; also अग्निजिह्वा.  E. इन्द्र and पुष्पा a flower; also इन्द्रपुष्पिका.
6308: इन्द्रपुरोहिता f. (-ता) The asterism Pushya.  E. इन्द्र and पुरोहिता priest, INDRA presiding over it.
6309: इन्द्रप्रस्थ m. (-स्थः) Ancient Dehli.  E. इन्द्र the deity, and प्रस्थ who presides.
6310: इन्द्रप्रहरण n. (-णं) INDRA'S thunderbolt.  E. इन्द्र and प्रहरण a weapon.
6311: इन्द्रभेषज n. (-जं) Dried ginger.  E. इन्द्र best, and भेषज medicament.
6312: इन्द्रमहकामुक m. (-कः) A dog.  E. इन्द्र, मह a sacrifice and कामुक desirous.
6313: इन्द्रमूल n. (-लं) A flock of cotton: see इन्द्रतूल.
6314: इन्द्रयव mn. (-वः-वं) The seed of the Wrightea antidysenterica.  E. इन्द्र the plant, and यव seed: it is used medicinally in cases of diarrhœa, dysentery, &c.
6315: इन्द्रलुप्त mn. (-प्तः-प्तं) Morbid, baldness, falling of the hair of the head: according to some authorities, loss of beard.  E. इन्द्र best, लुप्त lost.
6316: इन्द्रलप्तक m. (-कः) See the preceding. E. As before, वुन् aff.
6317: इन्द्रलोक m. (-कः) Swarga or paradise, the heaven of INDRA.  E. इन्द्र and लोक world.
6318: इन्द्रलोकेश m. (-शः) 	 1. INDRA. 	 2. A guest, hospitality to whom secures paradise.  E. इन्द्रलोक and ईश lord.
6319: इन्द्रवारुणिका f. (-का) Colocynth, a wild bitter gourd, (Cucumis colo-cynthis.)  E. कन् added to इन्द्रवारुणी.
6320: इन्द्रवारुणी f. (-णी) See the preceding.  E. इन्द्र and वरुण the two deities so called, affixes अण् and ङीप्; the favourite plant of INDRA and VARUNA.
6321: इन्द्रवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) A kind of fir: see देवदारु.  E. इन्द्र for any god, वृक्ष a tree.
6322: इन्द्रव्रत n. (-तं) One of the duties of a king, to distribute gratification, as INDRA pours down rain.  E. इन्द्र and व्रत observance.
6323: इन्द्रवृद्धा f. (-द्धा) A sore, an ulcer.
6324: इन्द्रशक्ति f. (-क्तिः) INDRANI, the wife or personified energy of INDRA. E. इन्द्र and शक्ति power.
6325: इन्द्रसावर्णि m. (-र्णिः) The last of the fourteen Menus.  E. इन्द्र and सावर्णि the son of the sun.
6326: इन्द्रसुत m. (-तः) The monkey king BALI.  E. इन्द्र and सुत a son; the son of INDRA: the epithet is also applied to ARJUNA and JAYANTA.
6327: इन्द्रसुरस m. (-सः) A shrub, the leaves of which are used in discutient applications, (Vitex negundo;) also सिन्दुवार.  E. इन्द्र best, सु good, and रस juice; whose juice is excellent.
6328: इन्द्रसुरिस m. (-सः) See the preceding. E. As before, the pen. being changed to इ.
6329: इन्द्रसूनु m. (-नुः) The son of INDRA: see इन्द्रसुत
6331: इन्द्राणिका f. (-का) Vitex negundo: see इन्द्रसुरस.  E. कन् added to the next word.
6332: इन्द्राणी f. (-णी) 	 1. The wife of INDRA. 	 2. A plant, (Vitex negundo:) see the preceding.  E. इन्द्र, ङीष् affix, and आनुक् augment.
6333: इन्द्रानुज m. (-जः) A name of VISHNU.  E. इन्द्र and अनुज younger born: the younger brother of INDRA.
6334: इन्द्रायुध m. (-धः) The rainbow. 	 f. (-धा) A kind of leech of various tints on the back.  E. इन्द्र and आयुध a weapon; INDRA'S weapon.
6335: इन्द्रारि m. (-रिः) An Asura or demon.  E. इन्द्र and अरि an enemy.
6336: इन्द्रावरज m. (-जः) VISHNU.  E. इन्द्र and अवरज after-born: the younger brother of INDRA.
6337: इन्द्राशन m. (-नः) 	 1. Hemp, dried and chewed. 	 2. The shrub which bears the seed used as a jeweller's weight, (Abrus precatorius.)  E. इन्द्र and अशन food: the food of INDRA.
6338: इन्द्रासन n. (-नं) 	 1. The throne of INDRA. 	 2. Any throne.  E. इन्द्र and असन a seat.
6339: इन्द्रिय n. (-यं) 	 1. An organ of sense divided into three classes, Jananendri-yas, Karmendriyas, and Antarindriyas, or organs of percep-tion and action, and the internal organs; the first are the eye, ear, nose, tongue, and skin; the second, the organ of speech or larynx, hand, foot, anus, and parts of generation; the last are, Manas the mind or organ of thought; Buddhi the organ of apprehension; Ahankara the organ of selfishness; and Chitta the heart or organ of feeling. 	 2. Semen virile. 	 mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Done, seen, given, &c. by INDRA.  E. इन्द्र the soul or self, and इयच् affix, deriv. irr. what is with difficulty restrained by the soul, or इन्द्र the deity, and घ aff.
6340: इन्द्रियगोचर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Perceptible, capable of being ascertained by the senses.  E. इन्द्रिय and गोचर perceptible.
6341: इन्द्रियग्राम m. (-मः) The senses or organs of sense collectively.  E. इन्द्रिय and ग्राम here, assemblage.
6342: इन्द्रियज्ञान n. (-नं) The faculty of perception, sense, consciousness. E. इन्द्रिय and ज्ञान knowledge.
6343: इन्द्रियनिग्रह m. (-हः) Restraining the organs of sense.  E. इन्द्रिय and निग्रह restraint.
6344: इन्द्रियबुद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Perception, the exercise of any sense, the faculty of any organ.  E. इन्द्रिय and बुद्धि knowledge.
6345: इन्द्रियबोधन n. (-नं) Any excitement of sense, an object of perception, a stimulus, &c.  E. इन्द्रिय and बोधन waking.
6346: इन्द्रियवर्ग m. (-र्गः) the organs of sense collectively.  E. इन्द्रिय and वर्ग a class.
6347: इन्द्रियविप्रतिपत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Erroneous or vicious perception.  E. इन्द्रिय and विप्रतिपत्ति perversion.
6348: इन्द्रियस्वाप m. (-पः) 	 1. Unconsciousness, insensibility. 	 2. The end of the world.  E. इन्द्रिय and स्वाप sleep.
6349: इन्द्रियागोचर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Imperceptible.  E. इन्द्रिय and अगोचर im-perceptible.
6350: इन्द्रियायतन n. (-नं) The body.  E. इन्द्रिय and आयतन a mansion: the resi-dence of the senses.
6351: इन्द्रियार्थ m. (-र्थः) An object of sense, as sound, smell, &c.  E. इन्द्रिय and अर्थ an object.
6352: इन्द्रियासङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Stoicism, philosophy, detachment from sensual objects.  E. इन्द्रिय and असङ्ग detachment.
6353: इन्द्रेज्य m. (-ज्यः) The name of VRIHASPATI, the preceptor of the gods. E. इन्द्र and इज्य to be worshipped; venerable to the deities.
6354: इन्ध r. 7th cl. (ई and ञि) ञिइन्धी (इन्धे) 1. To shine. 	 2. To kindle.
6355: इन्धन n. (-नं) Fuel; wood, grass, &c. used for that purpose.  E. इन्ध to kindle, and ल्युट् aff.
6356: इन्वका f. plu. (-काः) Stars in the head of Orion.  E. इवि to please, क्वुन् affix: see इल्वला and इल्वका.
6357: इभ r. 10th cl. (इ) इभि (इम्भयते) To collect or accumulate.
6358: इभ m. (-भः) 	 1. An elephant. 	 2. Best (in composition.)  E. इण् to go, भन् Unādi aff.
6359: इभकणा f. (-णा) A plant with an arometic seed, (Pothos officinalis,) E. इभ an elephant, and कणा pepper; being considered by Hindu writers, as a large species of pepper; see गजपिप्पली.
6360: इभदन्ता f. (-न्ता) A plant: see नागदन्ती.  E. इभ an elephant and दन्त a tooth: this and similar names are given, from its supposed resem-blance to an elephant's tooth.
6361: इभनिमीलिका f. (-का) Smartness, shrewdness, wittiness.  E. इभ and निमी-लिका winking; winking knowingly like an elephant.
6362: इभपालक m. (-कः) The driver or keeper of an elephant.  E. इभ, पालक a nourisher.
6363: इभपोटा f. (-टा) A young elephant, a cub.  E. इभ and पोटा any young animal.
6364: इभमाचल m. (-लः) A lion.  E. इभ an elephant, in the second case, आ and चल who attacks.
6365: इभयुवति f. (-तिः) An elephant's cub.  E. इभ and युवति young.
6366: इभाख्य m. (-ख्यः) A plant, (Mesua ferrea:) see नागकेशर.  E. इभ and आख्या an appellation; named from the elephant.
6367: इभोषणा f. (-णा) A kind of aromatic plant: see इभकणा.  E. इभ and उषणा pepper.
6368: इभ्य mfn. (-भ्यः-भ्या-भ्यं) Wealthy, opulent. 	 f. (-भ्या) 	 1. A female elephant. 2. The olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.)  E. इभ an elephant; here also implying excellence, and यत् affix of appropriation or fitness.
6369: इयत् mfn. (-यान्-यती-यत्) So much, thus much.  E. इदम् this, and वतुप् aff.
6370: इयत्ता f. (-त्ता) Fixed measure or quantity, so much.  E. इयत् and तल् affix; also with त्व, इयत्त्वं.
6371: इरण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 	 1. Desert. 	 2. Salt or barren, (soil.) E. See इरिण.
6372: इरम्मद m. (-दः) 	 1. A flash of lightning, or the fire attending the fall of a thunderbolt. 	 2. Submarine fire.  E. इरा water, here also watery clouds, and मद what plays or shines.
6373: इरा f. (-रा) 	 1. The earth. 	 2. Water. 	 3. Speech. 	 4. The goddess of speech, &c. 	 5. Ardent spirits.  E. इण् to go, and रन् Unādi affix, fem. affix टाप्.
6374: इराचर m. (-रः) Hail. 	 mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 	 1. Earth-born, terrestrial. 	 2. Aquatic.  E. इरा water, &c. and चर what goes.
6375: इराज m. (-जः) A name of KANDARPA the Hindu CUPID.  E. इरा water, and ज born.
6376: इरावत् m. (-वान्) 	 1. The ocean. 	 2. A cloud. 	 3. A king. 	 mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Watery, having or yielding water, &c.  E. इरा and मतुप् aff.
6377: इरावेल्लिका f. (-का) Pimples or pustules on the head.
6378: इरिण n. (-णं) 	 1. A desert, an inhospitable region. 	 2. Salt or barren soil. E. ऋ to go, इनन् Unādi affix, and the initial changed to इ.
6379: इरिमेद m. (-दः) A fetid mimosa: see विट्खदिर. E. See अरिमेद, अ being changed to इ.
6381: इरेश m. (-शः) 	 1. A name of VISHNU. 	 2. A king, a sovereign. 	 3. VARUNA.  E. इरा SARASWATI, &c. ईश lord.
6382: इर्व्वारु mf. (-रुः-रुः) 	 1. A cucumber, (Cumumis utilatissimus, Rox.) 2. Another kind, (Cucumis colocynthis.)  E. इरु a seed, and आरु what goes to or gets, from ऋ and उण् affix, or आलु, र becoming ल; also written इर्व्वालु, ईर्व्वारु, उर्व्वारु, &c.
6383: इर्व्वारुशुक्तिका f. (-का) A kind of melon; commonly Sphuti or Sphut, (Cucumis momordica.)  E. इर्व्वारु and शुक्तिका an oyster-shaped cu-cumber.
6385: इल r. 6th cl. (इलति) 	 1. To sleep. 	 2. To go. 	 3. To throw, send or direct: in this last sense, it is also r. 10th cl. (एलयति.)
6386: इलविला f. (-ला) The mother of KUVERA.
6387: इला f. (-ला) 	 1. The wife of BUDDHA, and daughter of IKSHWAKU. 	 2. The earth. 	 3. A cow. 	 4. Speech.  E. इल् to send, क and टाप् affixes; also इडा.
6388: इलागोल n. (-लं) The earth, the globe.  E. इला and गोल a sphere.
6389: इलातल n. (-लं) 	 1. The fourth place in the circle of the zodiac. 	 2. The surface of the earth.  E. इला and तल below.
6390: इलावृत n. (-तं) One of the nine Varshas or divisions of the known world, comprehending the highest and most centrical part of the old continent.  E. इला the earth, and आवृत chosen: the fairest part of the globe.
6391: इलिका f. (-का) The earth.  E. इल् to go, कन् and टाप् affixes.
6392: इली f. (-ली) A cudgel, a stick shaped like a sword or a short sword: see ईली.
6393: इलीश m. (-शः) A fish, commonly the Hilsa or Sable, (Clupea alosa.) E. इल् to go, (in the water,) and ईश chief, principal. The fish being one of high flavour, and very abundant at certain seasons, it is generally eaten both by the natives of Bengal, and by Europeans residing there.
6394: इल्लल m. (-लः) A bird.  E. इल् to go, and अल who is able.
6395: इल्लिश m. (-शः) The Hilsa fish: see इलीश also ईल्लीश.
6396: इल्वका f. plu. (-काः) Stars in Orion's head: see इल्वल.
6398: इल्वल m. (-लः) 	 1. The name of a demon. 	 2. Of a fish. 	 f. plu. (-लाः) Stars in Orin's head.  E. इल् to send or go, and वल Unādi affix; the last is also written इल्वका.
6399: इव r. 1st cl. (इ) इवि (इंवति) 1. To pervade. 	 2. (According to some,) to please. 	 3. To be satisfied.
6400: इव ind. So, even, as, like, in the same manner.
6401: इशीका f. (-का) An elephant's eye-ball: see इषीका.
6402: इष r. 4th cl. (इष्यति) To go. r. 6th cl. (इच्छति) 	 1. To wish, to desire. 	 2. To accept, to receive. With अभि, to desire: with प्रति, to engage, to promise. r. 9th cl. (इष्णाति) To repeat an act, to do anything again and again. With अनु prefixed, to search after, to investigate or enquire.
6403: इष m. (-षः) The month Āswin, (September-October.)  E. इष् to go, क affix; also ईष.
6404: इषिका f. (-का) 	 1. An elephant's eye-ball. 	 2. A painter's brush, &c. also इषीका.
6405: इषिर m. (-रः) Fire.  E. इष् to go, किरच् aff.
6406: इषीका f. (-का) 	 1. An elephant's eye-ball. 	 2. A painter's brush, &c. also इषिका. 	 3. A kind of reed, (Saccharum spontaneum.)  E. इष् to go, ईकन् Unādi aff.
6407: इषु mf. (-षुः-षुः) 	 1. An arrow. 	 2. A versed sine.  E. इष् to go, and उ Unādi aff.
6408: इषुधर m. (-रः) An archer.  E. इषु and धर who bears.
6409: इषुधि mf. (-धिः-धिः) A quiver.  E. इषु and धि what holds, from धा root, and कि aff.
6410: इष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Wished, desired. 	 2. Cherished, beloved. 	 3. Wor-shipped, reverenced, respected. 	 m. (-ष्टः) 	 1. A lover, a husband. 	 2. The Castor-oil tree. 	 n. (-ष्टं) 	 1. An act of sacrifice, an oblation, &c. 2. An essential ceremony, as ablution, investiture, &c. ind. (-ष्टम्) Voluntarily.  E. इष् to desire, or इष् substituted for यज् to sacrifice, and क्त aff.
6411: इष्टकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) (In arithmetic,) Rule of supposition, operation with an assumed number.  E. इष्ट wished, and कर्म्मन् act.
6412: इष्टका f. (-का) A brick; also इष्टिका.  E. इष् to wish, तकक् Unādi aff.
6413: इष्टकान्यास m. (-सः) Laying the foundation of a house.  E. इष्टका and न्यास order.
6414: इष्टकापथ n. (-थं) The root of a fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum.) E. इष्ट wished, and कापथ a bad road, growing in or preferring unfrequented places: this word is sometimes divided, कापथ being one name, and इष्ट added to अवदाह, another name: see अवदाहेष्ट and अवदाह.
6415: इष्टकाराशि f. (-शिः) A pile of bricks.  E. इष्टका and राशि a heap.
6416: इष्टगन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Fragrant, any fragrant substance. 	 n. (-न्धं) Sand. E. इष्ट and गन्ध a smell; of a desirable odor.
6417: इष्टतम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Beloved, best beloved, dearest, most desired. E. इष्ट and तमप् aff.
6418: इष्टतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Dearer, more dear, more desired.  E. इष्ट and तरप् aff.
6419: इष्टत्व n. (-त्वं) 	 1. Desirableness. 	 2. Reverence, &c. also इष्टता.  E. तल् or त्व added to इष्ट.
6420: इष्टदेव m. (-वः) A tutelary deity, one particularly worshipped.  E. इष्ट and देव a deity.
6421: इष्टदेवता f. (-ता) A person's chosen or tutelary. 	 2. divinity.  E. इष्ट and देवता divinity.
6422: इष्टापूर्त्त n. (-र्त्तं) Any religious duty, as oblation, sacrifice, penance, holy study, digging a well, planting a tree, &c.  E. इष्ट a sacrifice, and पूर्त्त liberal act, religiously considered; आङ् prefixed to the latter.
6423: इष्टार्थोद्युक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Zealously active, diligent for a desired object. E. इष्ट wished, अर्थ intention, and उद्युक्त diligent.
6424: इष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 	 1. Wish, desire. 	 2. A sacrifice, any sacrificial rite. 	 3. A compendious verse easily committed to memory.  E. इष् to wish, or इष् substituted for यज्, to sacrifice; affix क्तिन्.

6426: इष्टिन् mfn. (-ष्टी-ष्टिनी-ष्टि) Who wishes or desires, desirous, wishing. E. इष्ट and इनि aff.
6427: इष्टिपच m. (-चः) A demon.  E. इष्टि a sacrifice or oblation, and पच who digests: stealing oblations to the deities, and eating them.
6428: इष्टिमुष् m. (-मुट्) A demon.  E. इष्टि an oblation, and मुष् who steals; from मुष root, and क्विप् aff.
6429: इष्टु f. (-ष्टुः) Desire, wish.  E. इष् to wish, तु aff.
6430: इष्ट्वा ind. 	 1. Having sacrificed or worshipped. 	 2. Having wished.  E. इष with क्त्वाच् aff.
6431: इष्म m. (-ष्मः) 	 1. Love or the deity KAMA. 	 2. Spring.  E. इष् to desire, and मक् Unādi aff.
6432: इष्य m. (-ष्यः) The spring season.  E. इष् to wish, and क्यप् aff.
6433: इष्व m. (-ष्वः) A spiritual preceptor.  E. इष् to wish, वुन् Unādi aff.
6434: इष्वास mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) A thrower of arrows. 	 m. (-सः) 	 1. A bow. 	 2. An archer, a warrior.  E. इषु an arrow, and आस who throws.
6435: इस् ind. (इः) An interjection of anger, pain, or sorrow.
6436: इह ind. 	 1. Here, in this place. 	 2. Now, at this time.
6437: इहकाल m. (-लः) This life.  E. इह and काल time.
6438: इहलोक m. (-कः) This life, the world.  E. इह and लोक world.
6439: इहामूत्र ind. Here and there, in this world and in the next.  E. इह here, अमूत्र there or in that.
6440: ई The fourth letter of the alphabet, corresponding to I long, having the sound of ee in feel, and distinguished by an accent from the former, as ī.
6441: ई m. (ईः) A name of KANDARPA. 	 f. (ईः) A name of LAKSHMI. ind. An interjection of, 1. Pain. 	 2. Anger. 	 3. Consciousness or percep-tion. 	 4. Consideration. 	 5. Compassion.
6442: ई r. 2nd cl. (एति) 	 1. To go. 	 2. To pervade. 	 3. To conceive or become pregnant. 	 4. To desire. 	 5. To throw or direct. 	 6. To eat. This root is not generally admitted, though it occurs in composition, as with उत् (उदीते) To appear. r. 4th cl. (ङ) ईङ् (ईयते) To go.
6443: ईक्ष r. 1st cl. (ईक्षते) To see. It most usually occurs compounded with one or other of the prepositions, as with अप, to expect; with अभि, to gaze at; with अव, to inspect; with उत् or उप, to expect or await; with उप, to abandon; with निर्, to see; with परि, to try, to test, to assay; with प्र, to see, to resemble, or look like; with वि, to inspect; with प्रति, 1. to took for, to expect, 2. to venerate; with सम्, to compare, to contrast, to select; with प्रति and उत्, to look up at.
6444: ईक्षण n. (-णं) 	 1. Sight, seeing. 	 2. An eye.  E. ईक्ष् to see, ल्युट् aff.
6445: ईक्षणिका f. (-का) A female fortune-teller.  E. ईक्षण seeing, वुन् aff.
6446: ईक्षमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Looking at, surveying.  E. ईक्ष् to see, शानच् aff.
6447: ईक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Seen, beheld.  E. ईक्ष् and क्त aff.
6448: ईख r. 1st cl. (ङ) (ईखति) To go.; also (इ) ईखि (ईंखति.)
6449: ईज r. 1st cl. (ङ) (ईजते) 1. To go. 	 2. To blame or censure; also (इञ्) ईजिञ् (ईंजति-ते.)
6450: ईड r. 2nd cl. (ईट्टे) also 10th cl. (ईडयति) To praise.
6451: ईडण n. (-णं) Praising.  E. ईड and ल्युट् aff.
6452: ईडा f. (-डा) Praise.  E. ईड् to praise, क and टाप affs.
6453: ईडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Praised, commended.  E. ईड् to praise, क्त aff.
6454: ईड्य mfn. (-ड्यः-ड्या-ड्यं) To be praised, to be glorified.  E. ईड् to praise, क्यप् aff.

6457: ईत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone.  E. ई to go, क्त aff.

6459: ईदृक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Such.  E. ई for इदम् this, दृश् to see, क्विन् aff.

6461: ईदृश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Such, so like. E. As the last, with कञ् aff.
6462: ईप्सन n. (-नं) Desiring, wishing to obtain.  E. आप् to obtain, desiderative form, ल्युट् aff.
6463: ईप्सित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wished, desired.  E. आप् to obtain, desiderative form, क्त aff.
6464: ईप्सु mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु) Desirous, wishing to get or obtain.  E. आप् to ob-tain, desiderative form, उस् aff.
6465: ईर r. 2nd cl. (ईर्त्ते) 	 1. To go. 	 2. To shake. r. 1st and 10th cls. (ईरति, ईरयति) 	 1. To go. 	 2. To throw or direct, to drive or force on; with उत् prefixed, to say or speak; with प्र, to send, to make to go; with सम्, to go like the wind.
6466: ईयिवस् mfn. (-वान्-युषी-वस्) 	 1. Gone, having gone. 	 2. Having obtained. E. ईण् to go, क्वसु aff. form irr.
6467: ईरिण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 	 1. Desert. 	 2. Saline and barren (soil.)  E. ऋ to go, and इरन् aff.
6468: ईरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Sent, dispatched. 	 2. Said, uttered. 	 3. Gone. 4. Made.  E. ईर् to send, affix क्त.
6469: ईरिताकूत n. (-तं) Declared purpose or intention.  E. ईरित and आकूत purpose.
6470: ईर्क्ष्य r. 1st cl. (ईर्क्ष्यति) To envy, to feel impatient at another's prosperity.
6471: ईर्म्म n. (-र्म्मं) A sore or wound.  E. ईर् to send, and मक् aff.
6472: ईर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) Wandering about as a religious mendicant.  E. ईर् to go, affix क्यप्.
6473: ईर्व्वारु m. (-रुः) A cucumber, (Cucumis utilatissimus;) also ईर्व्वालु and ईर्व्वारु, &c.
6474: ईर्षा f. (-र्षा) Impatience, envy of another's success; more properly read ईर्ष्या.
6475: ईर्षालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Impatient of another's success, envious.  E. ईर्षा and आलुच् affix: see ईर्ष्यालु.
6476: ईर्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Envied. 	 n. (-तं) Envy.  E. ईर्षा and इतच् affix, or ईर्ष् with क्त aff.
6478: ईर्ष्य mfn. (-र्ष्यः-र्ष्या-र्ष्यं) Envious, envying. 	 f. (-र्ष्या) 	 1. Envy or impatience of another's success. 	 2. Spite, malice.  E. ईर्ष्य to envy, and अच् and टाप affixes; also, but according to the best writers, inaccurately written ईर्षा.
6479: ईर्ष्यक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Envious, envying.  E. ईर्ष्य and वुन् aff.
6480: ईर्ष्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Envying, envious.  E. ईर्ष्य and शानच् aff.
6481: ईर्ष्यालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Envious.  E. ईर्ष्य and आलुच् affix; also written ईर्षालु.
6482: ईर्ष्यावश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Being overcome with envy.  E. ईर्ष्या and वश subjection.

6485: ईलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Praised.  E. इड् to praise, affix क्त, and ड changed to ल.

6487: ईश r. 2nd cl. (ङ) ईशङ् (ईष्टे) To possess power, property, or authority.
6488: ईश m. (-शः) 	 1. A name of SIVA. 	 2. Also of the same deity as regent of the north-east quarter. 	 3. A ruler, a master. 	 f. (-शा) The shaft of a plough.  E. ईश् to rule, क aff.
6489: ईशसखि m. (-खा) A name of KUVERA.  E. ईश SIVA, and सखि a friend.
6490: ईशादन्त m. (-न्तः) 	 1. An elephant with large tusks. 	 2. The tusk of an elephant.  E. ईशा and दन्त a tooth; whose tooth is of the size of a plough-shaft, or the tooth which is so.
6491: ईशान m. (-नः) 	 1. A name of SIVA. 	 2. Also of the same deity as regent of the north-east quarter. 	 3. One of the Rudras. 	 4. The sun as a form of SIVA. 	 mf. (-नः-नी) The silk cotton tree, (Bombax heptaphyllum.) 	 n. (-नं) Light, splendor. 	 f. (-नी) A name of DURGA.  E. ईश a master, &c. and आनच् affix, and fem. ङीष्.
6492: ईशिता f. (-ता) Superiority, supremacy, one of the eight attributes of divinity.  E. ईश a master, and तल् abstract affix; also ईशित्वं.
6493: ईशितृ m. (-ता) 	 1. A master, an owner or proprietor. 	 2. A king.  E. ईश् to rule, and तृच् aff.
6495: ईश्वर m. (-रः) 	 1. The supreme ruler of the universe, GOD; it is therefore applied to all the different divinities, but mostly designates SIVA, in mythological and popular acceptation. According to the Sank-hyas, Iswara is the liberated spirit; finite, according to KAPILA; infinite, according to PATANJALI. In the Nyaya system, Iswara is also a finite spirit endowed with attributes. In the Vedanta, Iswara is infinite and universal spirit, the cause and substance of creation. 2. A name of SIVA, especially in a compound, when the form of the deity implied is a Linga, as Visweswara, Someswara, Rameswara, &c. 	 3. KAMADEVA. 	 mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 	 1. An owner, a proprietor, a chief or head. 	 2. Able, competent. 	 f. (-रा or -री) 1. A name of DURGA. 	 2. Of LAKSHMI, or of any other of the Raktis or female energies of the deities.  E. ईश् to rule, and वरट् or वरच् affix, consequently ङीप् or टाप् for the feminine.
6496: ईश्वरभाव m. (-वः) Royal or imperial nature.  E. ईश्वर a sovereign, and भाव disposition.
6497: ईश्वरसभा f. (-भा) Royal court or assembly.  E. ईश्वर and सभा an assembly.
6498: ईश्वराधीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Subject to a king, dependent on a master or on GOD, &c.  E. ईश्वर, अधि over, ख aff.
6499: ईश्वराधीनता f. (-ता) Dependance upon GOD, subjection to a ruler. E. ईश्वराधीन and तल् added; also with त्व, ईश्वराधीनत्वं.
6500: ईष r. 1st cl. (ङ) ईषङ् (ईषते) 1. To go or move. 	 2. To kill or hurt. 	 3. To see. 	 4. To give. (उ) ईषु (ईषति) To glean.

6507: ईषदुष्ण mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं) Tepid, slightly warm.  E. ईषत् and उष्ण warm.

6511: ईषदून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Not quite complete or entire.  E. ईषत् and ऊन less.

6549: उक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Sprinkled. 	 2. Cleansed, perfumed.  E. उक्ष् to wet, and क्त aff.

6599: उच्चारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pronounced, uttered, articulated.  E. उत् before चर् to go, causal form, क्त aff.

6785: उत्तरप्रच्छद m. (-दः) A coverlid, a quilt.  E. उत्तर and प्रच्छद what covers.
6786: उत्तरफाल्गुनी f. (-नी) The twelfth lunar mansion containing two stars, figured by a bed.  E. उत्तर subsequent, and फाल्गुनी or फल्गुनी an asterism; hence it also occurs उत्तरफल्गुनी.
6787: उत्तरभाद्रपद् f. (-द्) The twenty-seventh lunar mansion, figured dy a couch, and comprehending two stars, of which one is a Andro medœ.  E. उत्तर subsequent, and भाद्रपद् properly the constellation; also with a final vowel, उत्तरभाद्रपदा.
6788: उत्तरमात्र n. (-त्रं) Any reply, some reply.  E. उत्तर and मात्र only.
6789: उत्तररहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unable to reply, having no answer.  E. उत्तर and रहित devoid of.
6790: उत्तरलक्षण n. (-णं) The indication of an actual reply.  E. उत्तर and लक्षण mark.
6791: उत्तरवस्ति f. (-स्तिः) A small syringe, a urethra injection pipe.  E. उत्तर best, वस्ति syringe.
6792: उत्तरवादिन् m. (-दी) A defendant, a replicant.  E. उत्तर a reply, and वादिन् who speaks.
6793: उत्तरसंज्ञित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Designated in the reply, (a witness, &c.) E. उत्तर and संज्ञित named.
6794: उत्तरसाक्षिन् m. (-क्षी) Witness for the defence.  E. उत्तर reply, साक्षिन् a witness.
6795: उत्तरसाधक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Befriending, assisting, a help, a friend. 2. Who or what establishes a reply.  E. उत्तर and साधक what accom-plishes.
6796: उत्तरा ind. North, northerly, northward.  E. उत्तर and आच् aff.
6797: उत्तरात् ind. Northward.  E. उत्तर and आति aff.
6798: उत्तराधर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Superior and inferior, higher and lower. E. उत्तर upper, अधर lower.
6799: उत्तराधिकार m. (-रः) Right to property, &c. in succession to another person, heirship, inheritance.  E. उत्तर and अधिकार right.
6800: उत्तराधिकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) An heir, a claimant, subsequent to the death, &c. of the original owner.  E. उत्तराधिकार and इनि aff.
6801: उत्तराधिकारिता f. (-ता) Right of succession.  E. तल् added to उत्तराधिकारिन्; also with त्व, उत्तराधिकारित्वं.
6802: उत्तरापथ m. (-थः) The north, a northern road or direction.  E. उत्तर and पथिन् a road, the final of उत्तर lengthened.
6803: उत्तराभास m. (-सः) A false, indirect, or prevaricating reply, (in law.) E. उत्तर a defence, and आभास what resembles: apparently a defence, but not so in fact.
6804: उत्तराभासता f. (-ता) Inadequacy of a reply, the semblance without the reality.  E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, उत्तराभासत्वं.
6805: उत्तरायण n. (-णं) The period of the sun's progress to the north of the equator, the summer solstice.  E. उत्तर the north, and अयन going, progress.
6806: उत्तराशा f. (-शा) The north.  E. उत्तर and आशा region.
6807: उत्तराशाढा f. (-ढा) One of the lunar mansions. E. See उत्तराषाढा.
6808: उत्तराशापति m. (-तिः) A name of KUVERA.  E. उत्तर, आशा a quarter, पति a master; regent of the north.
6809: उत्तराषाढा f. (-ढा) The twenty-first of the lunar mansions, figured by an elephant's tooth or a bed, and containing two stars, one of which is in Sagittarius.  E. उत्तर subsequent, and आषाढा the constellation; to distinguish it from asterism, twentieth: see पूर्व्वाषाढा and आषाढा.
6810: उत्तरासङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) An upper and outer garment.  E. उत्तर upper, आङ् prefixed to षञ्ज् to surround, and घञ् aff.
6811: उत्तराहि ind. Northerly, from the north, implying distance.  E. उत्तर and आहिच् aff.
6812: उत्तरीय n. (-यं) An upper or outer garment.  E. उत्तर upper, and छ aff.
6813: उत्तरेण ind. Northward, posterior, subsequent.  E. उत्तर with एनप् aff.
6814: उत्तरेद्युस् ind. A subsequent day, a day following to-morrow.  E. उत्तर subsequent, and एद्युस् aff.
6815: उत्तरोत्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) More and more, further and further, &c. 	 n. (-रं) 1. A rejoinder, a reply to an answer. 	 2. Excess, exceeding quanti-ty or degree. 	 3. Succession, gradation, descending.  E. उत्तर re-peated.
6816: उत्तान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Shallow. 	 2. Sleeping supinely or with the face upwards. 	 3. Upright. 	 4. Concave.  E. उत् upwards, तन् to stretch, and घञ् aff.
6817: उत्तानक m. (-कः) A species of grass, (a cyperus:) see उच्चटा.  E. उत् much, तन् to spread, वुन् aff.
6818: उत्तानपाद m. (-दः) 	 1. A prince, son of SWAYAMBHU the Menu. 	 2. One of the stars of the little bear, (Ursi minoris.)
6819: उत्तानपादज m. (-जः) A name of DHRUVA.  E. उत्तानपाद, ज born: the son of UTTANAPADA.
6820: उत्तानशय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) One who sleeps with the face upwards. 	 mf. (-यः-या) An infant.  E. उत्तान and शय who sleeps.
6821: उत्ताप m. (-पः) 	 1. Great heat. 	 2. Affliction, distress. 	 3. Anxiety, excite-ment. 	 4. Effort, energy.  E. उत् before तप् to be hot, घञ् aff.
6822: उत्तापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Heated, made hot. 	 2. Pained, distressed. 	 3. Roused, excited.  E. उत् before तप् to be hot, causal form, क्त aff.
6823: उत्तार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Excellent, pre-eminent. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. Vomiting. 	 2. Passing away, instability. 	 3. Ejecting, getting rid of.  E. उत् above, and तार who passes, from तृ and घञ् aff.
6824: उत्तारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 	 1. Unsteady, changing, shaking. 	 2. Sick. E. उत् before तृ to go, णिनि affix; or उत्तार and इनि aff.

6826: उत्ताल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Best, excellent. 	 2. Arduous, difficult. 	 3. For-midable 4. Swift, speedy. 	 5. Lofty, tall. 	 m. (-लः) An ape.  E. उत् before तल् to fix, affix घञ्.
6827: उत्तिष्ठमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Getting up, rising. 	 2. Increasing, augment-ing.  E. उत् before स्था to stay, शानच् aff.

6830: उत्तुङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) High, lofty, tall.  E. उत् very, and तुङ्ग high.
6831: उत्तुङ्गता f. (-ता) Height, elevation.  E. तल् added to the last, or with त्व, उत्तुङ्गत्वं.

6837: उत्तोलन n. (-नं) Lifting up, raising, elevating.  E. उत् and तोलन weighting.
6838: उत्तोलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Raised, lifted up.  E. उत् before तुल to be equal, causal form, क्त aff.
6839: उत्त्यक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 	 1. Abandoned, left. 	 2. Thrown, tossed. 	 3. Free from passion or affection.  E. उत् and त्यक्त abandoned.
6840: उत्त्याग m. (-गः) 	 1. Abandonment, quitting. 	 2. Throwing, throwing up. 3. Succession from worldly feelings.  E. उत् and त्याग leaving.
6841: उत्त्रास m. (-सः) Eear, terror.  E. उत much, and त्रास fear.
6842: उत्थ mfn. (-त्थः-त्था-त्थं) Standing or being up.  E. उत् and स्था to stay, क aff.
6843: उत्थान n. (-नं) 	 1. Effort, exertion. 	 2. Manhood, manly exertion. 	 3. An army. 	 4. War, battle. 	 5. A book. 	 6. Joy, pleasure. 	 7. Rising, getting up. 	 8. A court yard. 	 9. 6844: उत्थानैकादशी f. (-शी) The eleventh lunation of the light half of Kartik or Agrahayana, when VISHNU rises from his sleep.  E. उत्थान rising, एकादशी eleventh.
6845: उत्थापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Lifting, causing to get up, who or what raises, &c. 	 2. Exciting, animating,  E. उत् before स्था to stay causal form, वुन् aff.
6846: उत्थापन n. (-नं) 	 1. Raising, elevating. 	 2. Causing to rise or get up. 	 3. Exciting, instigating. 	 4. (In arithmetic) Substitution of a value. E. उत् and स्था causal form, affix ल्युट्
6847: उत्थापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Raised, lifted up, elevated. 	 2. Made to get up, aroused from a seat, a bed, &c. 	 3. Instigated.  E. उत् and स्था causal form, क्त aff.
6848: उत्थाप्य ind. 	 1. Having raised or caused to rise. 	 2. Having roused or instigated.  E. उत् before स्था to stay, causal form, ल्यप् aff.
6849: उत्थाय ind. 	 1. Having risen (from a seat, &c.) 	 2. Having risen (in rank, &c.)  E. उत् before स्था to stand, affix ल्यप्.
6850: उत्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Born, produced. 	 2. Endeavouring, striving. 3. Happened, occurring. 	 4. Increasing, advancing, rising. 	 5. High, risen or rising as from a seat, &c.  E. उत् up, स्था to stay, and क्त aff.
6851: उत्थिताङ्गुलि m. (-लिः) The palm of the hand with the fingers extended. E. उत्थित increased, and अङ्गुलि a finger.
6852: उत्थिति f. (-तिः) Elevation, rising up.  E. उत् before स्था to stay, क्तिन् aff.
6853: उत्पत m. (-तः) 	 1. A bird. 	 2. Going upwards, or up.  E. उत् up, and पत who goes, from पत् to go, and अच् aff.
6854: उत्पतन n. (-नं) 	 1. Birth, production. 	 2. Going up, rising, ascending. E. उत्, पत् to go, and ल्युट् aff.

6856: उत्पतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Risen, ascended.  E. उत् up, पत् to go, क्त aff.

6859: उत्पत्तिप्रयोग m. (-गः) 	 1. Purport, meaning. 	 2. Production by the joint operation of cause and effect.  E. उत्पत्ति and प्रयोग act.
6860: उत्पत्तिव्यञ्जक m. (-कः) A type of birth, (as investiture.)  E. उत्पत्ति and व्यञ्जक figurative indication.
6861: उत्पथ m. (-थः) Error, bad way, evil.  E. उत् from, पथ for पथिन् a path.
6862: उत्पथम् ind. Astray, on the wrong road.  E. उत् from, पथिन् a path, अ aff.
6863: उत्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 	 1. Born, produced. 	 2. Known, ascertained. 	 3. Risen, gone up. 	 4. Acquired, gained. 	 5. Effected, accomplished. 	 6. Occurred, happened.  E. उत्, पद् to go, क्त aff.
6864: उत्पन्नतन्तु mfn. (-न्तुः-न्तुः-न्तु) Having progeny.  E. उत्पन्न and तन्तु line; des-cendants.

6866: उत्पलगन्धिक n. (-कं) A species of sandal of the colour of brass, and very fragrant.  E. उत्पल the lotus, गन्ध a smell, कन् affix of similitude.
6867: उत्पलचक्षुस् mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षुः) Lotus-eyed, fine-eyed.  E. उत्पल and चक्षुस् the eye.

6877: उत्पाटिन् mfn. (-टी-टिनी-टि) Eradicating, extirpating.  E. उत्पाट and इनि aff.
6878: उत्पात m. (-तः) 	 1. A portent, some natural prodigy or phœnomenon. 2. Any public calamity, as an eclipse, a meteor, an earthquake, &c.  E. उत् accidentally, पत् to happen, and घञ् aff.
6879: उत्पातवात m. (-तः) A whirlwind, a hurricane.  E. उत्पात a portent, and वात wind.

7271: उप ind. A particle and prefix to verbs and other words implying, 1. Excess, (over, above, &c.;) 	 2. Vicinity or assemblage, (near, by the side of, with, together with;) 	 3. Inferiority. (lesser, secondary, &c.;) 	 4. Likeness, resemblance; 5. Disease, extinction; 6. Orna-ment; 7. Command; 8. Reproof; 9. Astonishing; 10. Giving; 11. Killing; 12. Diffusion; 13. Wish, desire; 14. 7277: उपकल्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Prepared, made. 	 2. Secondary, substituted. E. उप and कल्पित prepared.
