7357: उपदर्शित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Perceived, distinguished.  E. उप before दर्शित seen.
7358: उपदा f. (-दा) A present, an offering to a king or great man, &c. a Nezer.  E. उप, दा a gift, from दा to give, अङ् and टाप् affs.
7359: उपदानक n. (-कं) A present, &c. see the preceding.  E. उप implying help, &c. दान a gift, and क affix: a gift which is for the purpose of pro-curing favour or protection.
7360: उपदिश्य ind. Having advised or instructed.  E. उप before दिश to shew, ल्यप् aff.
7361: उपदिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Instructed, advised. 	 2. Initiated. 	 3. Specified, particularised. 	 4. Assigned as a plea or reason. 	 n. (-ष्टं) Council, advice.  E. उप before दिश् to shew, क्त aff.
7363: उपदेवता f. (-ता) A minor divinity, as a Yaksha, Gandharba, Apsara, &c.  E. उप and देवता a divinity.
7364: उपदेश m. (-शः) 	 1. Advice, information, instruction. 	 2. Plea, pretext. 	 3. Specification. 	 4. Initiation, communication of the initiatory Man-tra or formula. 	 5. (In grammar,) An elementary term.  E. उप before दिश् to shew, affix घञ्.
7365: उपदेशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Giving instruction, instructing, instructive. 	 m. (-कः) An instructor, a guide, specially a spiritual guide.  E. उप be-fore दिश् to shew, ण्वुल् aff.
7366: उपदेशन n. (-नं) Advising, instructing.  E. उप before दिश् to shew, aff. ल्युट्.
7367: उपदेशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Advising, an adviser.  E. उपदेश advice, and इनि affix.
7368: उपदेष्टव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be advised. (fit, proper, &c.)  E. उप before दिश् to shew, तव्य affix; also उपदेश्य, उपदेशनीय.
7369: उपदेष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) One who points out, who orders or advises. 	 m. (-ष्टा) A Guru, a spiritual guide.  E. उप prefixed to दिश to shew, affix तृच्.
7370: उपदेह m. (-हः) 	 1. Liniment, ointment. 	 2. A minor or secondary body. E. उप and दिह plaster, or देह the body.
7371: उपदेहिका f. (-का) A kind of insect.  E. उप with, &c. देह the body, affixes कन् and टाप्; also उत्पादिका.
7372: उपद्रव m. (-वः) 	 1. Tyranny, oppression. 	 2. National distress, whether the act of the seasons or the king, famine, exaction, &c. 	 3. National commotion, rebellion. 	 4. Violence. 	 5. A supervenient disease, one brought on whilst a person labours under another.  E. उप, द्रु to go, अच् aff.
7373: उपद्रविन् mfn. (-वी-विणी-वि) 	 1. Tyrannical. 	 2. Violent, factious. 	 m. (-वी) 1. A tyrant, an oppressor. 	 2. A rebel.  E. उपद्रव and इनि aff.
7374: उपद्रष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) Supervisor, inspector, overseeing, overlooking. E. उप before दृश् to see, तृच् affix, the vowel changed to र.
7375: उपद्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Tyrannized over, oppressed, visited by calamities, &c.  E. उप before द्रु to go, क्त aff.
7376: उपधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) 	 1. A heretic, a schismatic. 	 2. A minor or inferior duty. E. उप and धर्म्म duty.
7377: उपधा f. (-धा) 	 1. A false pretence. 	 2. Trial or test of honesty, &c. of four kinds, of loyalty, disinterestedness, continence, and courage. 	 3. A penultimate letter.  E. उप, धा having, from धा to have, with अङ् and टाप् affs.
7378: उपधातु m. (-तुः) 	 1. An inferior mineral, a semi-metal: seven are speci-fied; pyrites, sulphate of copper, talc, antimony, red orpiment, yellow orpiment, and calx of brass. 	 2. Secondary secretion, as the milk, menses, adeps, sweet, teeth, hair, and lymph.  E. उप minor, and घातु mineral, &c.
7379: उपधान n. (-नं) 	 1. A pillow. 	 2. Kindness, affection. 	 3. Poison. 	 4. Reli-gious observance or obligation. 	 5. Excellence, excellent quality. 	 6. Resting or placing upon.  E. उप, धा to have or hold, ल्युट् aff.
7380: उपधानीय n. (-यं) A pillow.  E. उपधान a pillow, and छ aff.
7381: उपधाय ind. Having placed or rested upon.  E. उप before धा to hold, ल्यप् affix.
7382: उपधाशुचि mfn. (-चिः-चिः-चि) Approved, tried, of approved loyalty, &c. E. उपधा and शुचि pure.
7383: उपधि m. (-धिः) 	 1. Fraud, circumvention. 	 2. The wheel of a carriage. 	 3. Fear, terror.  E. उप, धा to have, and कि aff.
7384: उपधिक m. (-कः) 	 1. A cheat, a knave, especially one who extorts money by threats. 	 2. Fraud.  E. उपधि and कृ to make, ड affix or कन् pleonasm.
7385: उपधूपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Being at the point of death. 	 2. Suffering extreme pain.  E. उप near or much, धूपित pained.
7386: उपधृति f. (-तिः) A ray of light.  E. उप much, धृ to have, क्तिन् affix.
7387: उपनत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Approached, approximate, near, (either in time or place.)  E. उप near, नम् to bow, affix क्त.
7388: उपनय m. (-यः) The initiation of the three first classes; investiture with a peculiar thread or cord worn over the left shoulder, and under the right: the cord of the Brahman is of cotton, Munja, or Kusa grass; of the Kshetriya, of Sana or flax; and of the Vaisya, of wool: the youths should be invested respectively, from eight to sixteen, from eleven to twenty-two, and from twelve to twenty-four years of age. 	 n. (-नं) 	 1. Attaining, gaining. 	 2. Bringing to E. उप over, नीञ् to obtain, अच् affix; also with घञ् affix उपनाय, and with ल्युट् affix उपनयन.
7389: उपनयन n. (-नं) See the preceding. E. As before, affix ल्युट्; also with अण् added उपनायन.
7391: उपनाह m. (-हः) 	 1. A plaster, an unguent applied to a wound or sore. 2. The tie of a lute, the lower part of the tail piece where the wires are fixed. 	 3. Inflammation of the ciliary glands, stye.  E. उप, नह् to bind, घञ् aff.
7392: उपनाहन n. (-नं) Unction, anointing, plastering.  E. उप before नह् to tie, ल्युट् aff.
7393: उपनिक्षेप m. (-पः) A deposit, sealed or in a cover so that the contents are unknown.  E. उप and निक्षेप the same.
7394: उपनिधान n. (-नं) A deposit: see the next.  E. उप and नि before धा to have, ल्युट् affix.
7395: उपनिधि m. (-धिः) A deposit, a pledge, property put into the care of a creditor, friend, &c.  E. उप and नि before धा to have, क affix; in law this word ordinarily implies more especially a sealed or enclosed deposit, but according to some, it is any article entrusted to a friend which he may use whilst in his keeping.
7396: उपनिषद् f. (-षद् or -षत्) 	 1. A portion of the religious writings of the Hindus; the theological part, and the Vedanta or argumentative part of the Vedas, either detached from or comprised in the princi-pal work. 	 2. Virtue, moral merit. 	 3. Truth as the principle of divine being. 	 4. A neighbouring mansion. 	 5. A lonely place.  E. उप and नि prefixed to षद् to go, affix क्विप्; in which abide the essential parts of religion, &c.
7397: उपनिष्कर n. (-रं) 	 1. A street. 	 2. A principal or royal road.  E. उप and नि before कृ to make, affix अप्, and स inserted.
7398: उपनिष्क्रमण n. (-णं) 	 1. A main or royal road. 	 2. An instituted observance or Sanskara, taking a child in the fourth month of its age into the open air. 	 3. Going forth.  E. उप and नि before क्रम् to go, affix ल्युट्, and स inserted.
7399: उपनिहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Deposited with, entrusted to. 	 2. Placed near to. 	 3. Offered, presented.  E. उप and नि before धा to to have, क्त aff.
7400: उपनीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Brought near to, approximated. 	 2. Obtained, attained. 	 3. Citing, adducing. 	 4. Presented. 	 5. Known. 	 m. (-तः) The youth invested with the characteristic string; see उपनय.  E. उप be-fore नी to obtain, affix क्त.
7401: उपनीय ind. 	 1. Having brought. 	 2. Having invested.  E. उप before नी to bring, ल्यप् aff.
7402: उपनुन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 	 1. Sent or dispatched. 	 2. Wafted, driven, (by the wind.)  E. उप before नुद् to send, क्त aff.
7403: उपन्यस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 	 1. Pledged, deposited. 	 2. Given, communicated. 3. Brought forward, (as an example, &c.) adduced. 	 4. Placed near to, or in, or upon.  E. उप and नि before अस् to throw, affix क्त.
7404: उपन्यास m. (-सः) 	 1. A pledge, a pawn, a hostage. 	 2. An exordium or in-troduction. 	 3. A precept, a law. 	 4. Giving, imparting. 	 5. Juxta-position. 	 6. A suggestion, a hint.  E. उप and नि prefixed to अस् to throw or send, affix घञ्.
7405: उपन्यास्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) To be pledged.  E. उप and न्यास्य to be adduced.
7406: उपपति m. (-तिः) A paramour, a gallant.  E. उप in place of, पति a husband.
7407: उपपत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 	 1. Birth, production. 	 2. Association, connexion. 	 3. Fit-ness, propriety. 	 4. Cessation, end. 	 5. Possessing, having. 	 6. As-certained or demonstrated conclusion. 	 7. Cause, reason. 	 8. Effect-ing, doing. 	 9. Religious abstraction. 	 10. (In arithmetic or geo-metry,) Proof, demonstration.  E. उप before पद् to go, क्तिन् aff.
7408: उपपत्तिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 	 1. Right, fit, reasonable, proper. 	 2. Unit-ed, associated.  E. उपपत्ति and मतुप् poss aff.
7409: उपपद n. (-दं) 	 1. Small, diminutive. 	 2. The subsidiary term in a com-pound word. 	 3. The first member of a compound word. 	 4. 7410: उपपन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 	 1. Manifested. 	 2. Fit, suited to the occasion, adequate. 	 3. Done, shewn, proved, effected. 	 4. Endowed with, possessed of. 	 5. Produced from or by. 	 6. Physicked, cured.  E. उप before पद् to go, क्त aff.
7411: उपपातक n. (-कं) A great crime, as killing a cow, selling a daughter, atheism, &c.; it is considered as criminality in the second or third degree, and is of various kinds: see महापातक.  E. उप much, and पातक a crime.
7412: उपपातकिन् m. (-की) A sinner in any but the first degree.  E. उपपातक and इनि affix.
7413: उपपादन n. (-नं) 	 1. Effecting, doing. 	 2. Giving, delivering, presenting. 3. Proving or establishing by argument.  E. उप before पद् to go, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
7414: उपपादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Done, effected. 	 2. Given delivered, present-ed. 	 3. Proved, accomplished.  E. उप before पद् to go, causal form, क्त aff.
7415: उपपादुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Shod. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. A superhuman being, a god, a demon, &c. 	 2. Hell.  E. उप before पद् to go, उकञ् aff.
7416: उपपाप m. (-पः) A heinous crime, as killing a cow, &c.  E. उप excess, and पाप sin.
7417: उपपालित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Protected, nurtured.  E. उप and पालित protected.
7418: उपपीडन n. (-नं) 	 1. Pain, agony, torture. 	 2. Inflicting pain. 	 3. Devas-tating, laying waste.  E. उप before पीड to give pain, ल्युट् aff.
7419: उपपीडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Tortured, pained, distressed. 	 2. Devastated. E. उप before पीड to give pain, क्त aff.
7420: उपपुर n. (-रं) A suburb.  E. उप near, पुर a city.
7421: उपपुराण n. (-णं) A Purana, one not included in the eighteen principal: a similar number is reckoned, or 1. Adi. 	 2. Nrishinha. 	 3. Vayu. 4. Sivadhermma. 	 5. Durvasa. 	 6. Nārada. 	 7. Nandikeswara. 8. Usanas. 	 9. Kapila. 	 10. Varuna. 	 11. Sāmba. 	 12. Kālikā. 	 13. Maheswara. 	 14. Padma. 	 15. Deva. 	 16. Parāsara. 	 17. Marīcha. 18. Bhaskara.  E. उप minor, पुराण a Purāna.
7422: उपपुष्पिका f. (-का) Yawning, gaping.  E. उप much, पुष्प to flower, to open as a flower, वुन् aff.
7423: उपप्रदान n. (-नं) A bribe.  E. उप for assistance, प्र before दा to give, affix ल्युट्.
7424: उपप्लव m. (-वः) 	 1. Rahu, the ascending node. 	 2. A portent or natural phænomenon so considered. 	 3. An affray, or assault, a conflict without weapons. 	 4. Eclipse. 	 5. Misfortune.  E. उप over, &c. प्लु to go, अप् aff.

7426: उपभुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Used, enjoyed, possessed.  E. उप before भुज् to enjoy, क्त aff.
7427: उपभुञ्जान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Using, enjoying.  E. उप before भुज् to enjoy, शानच् aff.

7429: उपभोग m. (-गः) 	 1. Pleasure, satisfaction. 	 2. Enjoyment, use. 	 3. Cohabi-tation. 	 4. Use, usufruct.  E. उप excess, भुज् to eat, &c. affix घञ्.

7438: उपमेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Compared with. 	 m. (-तः) The Sal, a timber tree, (Shorea robusta.)  E. उपमा like, इत gone: high as a mountain, &c.
7439: उपमेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be compared with or to. 	 n. (-यं) The subject of a comparison, as the face is of the moon.  E. उप before मा to measure, य affix.

7443: उपयम m. (-मः) Marriage.  E. उप and यम् to stop, affix अप्.
7444: उपयाचक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A present solicitor, one who asks or begs. E. उप before याच् to beg, वुन् aff.
7445: उपयाचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Requested, solicited. 	 2. Offered especially to the deities to render them propitious.  E. उप much, याच् to ask or beg, affix क्त, or with कन् added उपयाचितक.
7446: उपयाम m. (-मः) Marriage.  E. उप, यम् to refrain, affix घञ्.
7447: उपयुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 	 1. Proper, right. 	 2. Adapted to, suitable, appro-priate, useful. 	 3. Touched by. 	 4. Taken. 	 5. Eaten.  E. उप before युज् to join, affix क्त.
7448: उपयुञ्जान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Taking, appropriating, attaching.  E. उप before युजि to join, शानच् aff.
7449: उपयोग m. (-गः) 	 1. Good conduct, observing established practices. 	 2. Any act tending to effect a desired object. 	 3. Fitness, suitableness. 	 4. Service, utility. 	 5. 7451: उपयोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) 	 1. Appropriate, suitable. 	 2. Conducive or contributing to, serviceable, useful. 	 3. Favourable, propitious. 	 4. Touching, in contact with  E. उपयोग and इनि aff.

7453: उपरक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Afflicted with pain or calamity. 	 m. (-क्तः) 	 1. Eclipsed, (the sun or moon.) 	 2. Rahu, (the ascending node.)  E. उप implying distress, रञ्ज् to colour, and क्त aff.
7454: उपरक्षण n. (-णं) A guard, an out post.  E. उप, रक्ष् to defend or protect, aff. ल्युट्.
7455: उपरचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made, prepared.  E. उप and रचित made.
7456: उपरत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Stopped, ceased. 	 2. Dead.  E. उप before रम् to please, क्त aff.
7457: उपरतस्पृह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Void of desire.  E. उपरत and स्पृहा desire.
7458: उपरति f. (-तिः) 	 1. Stopping, ceasing. 	 2. Refraining from sensual enjoy-ment. 	 3. Abstaining from prescribed acts. 	 4. Great or exquisite pleasure. 	 5. Death.  E. उप reverse or excess, रम् to please, क्तिन् affix; also with घञ् affix उपरम or उपराम.

7589: उपहूय ind Having called or addressed.  E. उप near, ह्वे to call, ल्यप् aff.
7590: उपहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Taken, collected, gathered. 	 2. Offered, presented. 	 3. Immolated, offered as a victim. 	 4. Served out as food.  E. उप before हृ to take, क्त aff.
7591: उपह्वर n. (-रं) 	 1. Solitary, private. 	 2. Near. 	 m. (-रः) A car, a carriage. E. उपह्वृ to bend, अप् aff.

7595: उपाकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Attended with evil omens, disastrous, calamitous. m. (-तः) 	 1. A victim slain or to be slain. 	 2. A portent, a phæno-menon announcing calamity.  E. उप and आङ् before कृत made.

7597: उपागत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Suffering, feeling. 	 2. Promised. 	 3. Approached arrived. 	 4. Occurred, happened.  E. उप and आङ् before गम् to go, aff. क्त.
7598: उपागम m. (-मः) 	 1. Promise, agreement. 	 2. Approach. 	 3. Occurrence, ar-rival. 	 4. Feeling, suffering.  E. उप near, आङ् before गम् to come, अच् aff.
7599: उपाग्रहण n. (-णं) Reading the Vedas after initiation.  E. उप and आङ् be-fore ग्रह् to take, ल्युट् aff.: see उपाकरण.
7600: उपाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. The sectarial mark made with Sandal, &c. on the forehead. 	 2. Any minor limb or member. 	 3. Secondary portion of science.  E. उप and अङ्ग the body.

7602: उपात्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Taken, received, gained, got. 	 m. (-त्तः) An ele-phant out of rut.  E. उप near, आत्त taken, seized.
7603: उपात्तरंहस् mfn. (-हाः-हाः-हः) Quick, fleet.  E. उपात्त acquired, रंहस् speed.
7604: उपात्तशस्त्र mfn. (-स्त्रः-स्त्रा-स्त्रं) Armed, taking up arms.  E. उपात्त and शस्त्र a weapon.
7605: उपात्यय m. (-यः) 	 1. Neglect or disobedience of ordinances or customs. 2. Disorder or disorderly behaviour.  E. उप and अति prefixed to इण् to go, अच aff.
7606: उपादान n. (-नं) 	 1. Taking away, abduction, taking. 	 2. Abstraction, res-training the organs of sense and perception. 	 3. Cause, motive. 4. Immediate or proximate cause. 	 5. The formal or distinct form, the material cause. 	 6. A double meaning, an expression convey-ing a sense besides that which appears intended. 	 7. Saying, speak-ing.  E. उप near, आदा to take, ल्युट् aff.
7607: उपादानकारण n. (-णं) A proximate cause.  E. उपादान and कारण cause.
7609: उपादेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. Acceptable, admissible, to be taken or received. 	 2. Excellent, admirable.  E. उप and आङ् before दा to give, यत् aff.
7610: उपाधि m. (-धिः) 	 1. Virtuous reflection. 	 2. A discriminative or dis-tinguishing property, an attribute. 	 3. Deception, disguise. (In the Vadanta this is especially applied to certain natural forms or properties, considered as disguises of the spirit.) 	 4. A title, a dis-criminative appellation, a nickname. 	 5. Careful or diligent for the support of a family, (always masculine, though with a feminine or neuter substantive.) 	 6. A purpose, an occasion, an object. 	 7. (In logic,) A special cause for a general effect. 	 8. (In rhetoric,) The natural character of species, quality, or action. E. उप and आङ् before धा to have, aff. कि.
7611: उपाध्याय m. (-यः) A spiritual preceptor. 	 f. (-या) A female preceptor. 	 f. (-यी or -यानी) The wife of a teacher.  E. उप and अधि before इण to go, घञ् aff. for the fem. टाप् aff. in the first instance, in the second ङीष् with or without आनुक् inserted.
7612: उपानह f. (-नत्) A shoe.  E. उप and आङ् before नह् to bind, aff. क्विप्.
7613: उपान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Near. 	 m. (-न्तः) The angle of the eye.  E. उप near, अन्त end.
7614: उपान्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Near, proximate, neighbouring.  E. उपान्त and ठञ् aff.
7615: उपान्त्य m. (-न्त्यः) The corner of the eye. 	 n. (-न्त्यं) Vicinity.  E. उप and अन्त्य end.
7616: उपाय m. (-यः) 	 1. A means, an expedient, a way. 	 2. A means of success against an enemy; four are usually enumerated, as, sowing dissension, chastisement, conciliation and gifts. 	 3. Approaching, approach.  E. उप and आङ् before इण् to go, affix घञ्.
7617: उपायज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Fertile in expedients, contriving, providing for.  E. उपाय and ज्ञ who knows.
7618: उपायन n. (-नं) 	 1. A present, a complementary or respectful gift. 	 2. Approaching, going near to. 	 3. Engaging in a religious observance. E. उप before अय् to go, ल्युट् aff.
7619: उपायिन mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Expert in the use of means.  E. उपाय and इनि aff.
7620: उपाययोग m. (-गः) Application of means, or combination of expedients. E. उपाय and योग union.
7621: उपार्ज्जन n. (-नं) Acquiring property, earning.  E. उप and अर्ज्जन gaining.
7622: उपार्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gained, acquired, earned.  E. उप and अर्ज्जित gained.
7623: उपारत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Engaged in, occupied by. 	 2. Frequenting, resorting to.  E. उप and आङ् before रम् to sport, क्त aff.
7624: उपारम m. (-मः) 	 1. Engaging in. 	 2. Going to or in.  E. उप and आङ् be-fore रम् to sport, affix अच्.
7625: उपालब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Reproached, reviled.  E. उप and आङ् before लभि to hurt, affix क्त.
7626: उपालम्भ m. (-म्भः) 	 1. Abuse, reviling. 	 2. Deferring, delaying.  E. उप and आङ् before लभि to injure, अच् aff.
7627: उपावर्त्तन n. (-नं) 	 1. Turning round, revolving. 	 2. Ceasing. 	 3. Turning back, returning. 	 4. Approaching.  E. उप and आङ् before वृत् to be, ल्युट् aff.
7628: उपावृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 	 1. Rolling on the ground. 	 2. Ceased, ceasing, refraining. 	 m. (-त्तः) A horse rolling himself on the ground.  E. उप and आङ् before वृत् to be, affix क्त.
7629: उपाश्रय m. (-यः) 	 1. Asylum, support. 	 2. Reliance, dependance upon. E. उप and आङ् before श्री to serve, affix अच्.
7630: उपाश्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Supporting, (literally or figuratively) bearing, holding, protecting. 	 2. Relying or depending upon.  E. उप near, and आश्रित giving support.
7631: उपासक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Worshipping, a worshipper. 	 2. Serving, a servant. 	 3. A Sudra.  E. उप before अस् to be, वुन् aff.
7632: उपासङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A quiver.  E. उप and आङ् before षञ्ज to embrace, घञ् aff.
7633: उपासन n. (-नं) 	 1. Archery. 	 2. Service. 	 3. A seat. 	 4. Assembling. 	 5. In-juring, hurting. 	 f. (-ना) 	 1. Service. 	 2. Worship, adoration.  E. उप before आस् to sit, or आङ् before अस् to throw or send, affix युच् and fem. टाप्.
7634: उपासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Served, honoured, worshipped. 	 2. Serving, paying worship or service.  E. उप inferiority, आस् to sit or remain, affix क्त.
7635: उपासितृ m. (-ता) A worshipper.  E. उप and आङ् before आस् to sit, तृन् aff.
7636: उपासीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Sitting with or near to. 	 2. Occupying.  E. उप before आसीन seated.
7637: उपास्ति f. (-स्तिः) Service, especially of a deity, worship.  E. उप before आस् to sit, क्तिन् aff.
7638: उपास्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) To be worshipped or served. ind. 	 1. Having served or worshipped. 	 2. Having associated or called together. E. उप before आस् to sit, यत् or ल्यप् aff.
7639: उपास्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being served or worshipped, receiving hom-age.  E. उप before आस् to sit, शानच् aff.
7640: उपाहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Joined, annexed. 	 2. Deposited, placed. 	 3. Put on, worn. 	 4. Agreed upon, made or done mutually. 	 m. (-तः) A fiery potent, a meteor, a comet.  E. उप and आङ् before धा to have or hold, affix क्त, deriv. irr.
7641: उपाहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Prepared. 	 2. Taken, seized.  E. उप and आङ् before हृ to take, क्त aff.
7642: उपेक्षक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Disregarding, neglecting, disdaining. 	 2. Patient, enduring.  E. उप before ईक्ष् to see, वुन् aff.
7643: उपेक्षण n. (-णं) 	 1. Leaving, abandoning. 	 2. Disregarding, neglecting, disdaining.  E. उप and ईणक्ष seeing.
7644: उपेक्षा f. (-क्षा) 	 1. Trick, deceit, one of the minor expedients in war. 	 2. Abandoning, leaving. 	 3. Dissent. 	 4. Negligence, neglect. 	 5. En-durance, patience. 	 6. Contempt, disdain.  E. उप before ईक्ष् to see, अङ् and टाप् affs.
7645: उपेक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Disregarded, disesteemed, neglected, disdained. E. उप before ईक्ष् to see, क्त aff.
7646: उपेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Endowed with, possessed of, having, possessing. 2. Arrived at, come to, come near to. 	 3. Invested.  E. उप and इत gone.
7647: उपेतृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) 	 1. Contriving, contriver, one who employs expedi-ents. 	 2. Approaching, going near to.  E. उप before इण् to go, तृच् aff.
7648: उपेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A name of VISHNU or KRISHNA.  E. उप after, इन्द्र INDRA: born subsequently to INDRA.
7649: उपेन्द्रवज्रा f. (-ज्रा) A species of the Trishtubh metre.
7650: उपेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. To be sought, to be had recourse to. 	 2. To be gone to or approached. 	 3. To be effected by any means.  E. उप be-fore इण् to go, यत् aff.
7651: उपेयिवस् mfn. (-वान्-युषी-वत्) 	 1. Accompanied or followed by, associated with, united. 	 2. Obtained, got.  E. उप near, इण् to go, क्वसु aff.
7652: उपेयुस् mfn. (-यूः-यूः-युः) Arrived at, gone to.  E. उप before इण् to go, उस् aff.
7653: उपोढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 	 1. Near, proximate. 	 2. Married. 	 3. Arrayed, ar-ranged.  E. उप before वह् to bear, aff. क्त.
7654: उपोती f. (-ती) A potherb, (Basella rubra or lucida.)  E. उप much, and उद water, deriv. irr.
7656: उपोदिका f. (-का) A potherb, (Basella rubra or lucida.)  E. उप and उद water, कन् and टाप् affs. and इ substituted for the pen. or ई being substituted उपोदीका.
7657: उपोद्घात m. (-तः) 	 1. A beginning, a thing begun. 	 2. An introduction, a preface. 	 3. An example, an apposite argument or illustration. 4. Analysis, the ascertainment of the elements of which a thing consists.  E. उप before हन् to injure, aff. घञ्.
7658: उपोषण n. (-णं) A fast, fasting.  E. उप before वस to abide, aff. ल्युट्.
7659: उपोषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fasted, fasting. 	 n. (-तं) Fast, fasting.  E. उप before वस् to abide, क्त aff.
7660: उप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Sown, (as seed.)  E. वप् to sow, affix क्त.
7661: उप्तकृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Ploughed after sowing.  E. उप्त and कृष्ट ploughed.

7663: उप्तिविद् m. (-वित् or -विद्) An agriculturist.  E. उप्ति and विद् who knows.
7664: उप्तिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Sown, cultivated.  E. वप् to sow, क्तिन् aff. and मम् added.
7665: उब्ज r. 6th cl. (उब्जति) To be straight: with नि prefixed, (त्युब्जति) To be crooked: this root is also written उज्ज and उद्ज.
7666: उभ r. 6th cl. (उभति) To fill; also उम्भ.
7667: उभ pron. 	 m. and dual only, (उभौ) Both.
7668: उभय pron. (sing. and plu. only,) (-यः-ये) Both.  E. उभ and य from या to obtain, aff. ड.
7669: उभयतस् ind. On both sides.  E. उभय both, and तसि aff.
7670: उभयतोदत् mfn. (-दन्-दती-दत्) Having a double row of teeth, (man, animal, &c.)  E. उभयतस् and दत् for दन्त a tooth.
7671: उभयतोमुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Looking either way, two-faced.  E. उभयतस् and मुख face.
7672: उभयत्र ind. In both places, on both sides.  E. उभय and त्रल् aff.
7673: उभयथा ind. In both ways.  E. उभय and थाल् aff.

7676: उभयवेतन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Serving two masters, being in the pay of both.  E. उभय and वेतन wages.
7677: उभयसम्भव m. (-वः) A dilemma.  E. उभय both, (conclusions,) सम्भव production.
7678: उभयानुमत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Agreed to or accepted mutually, or on both sides.  E. उभय and अनुमत assented to.
7679: उभयार्थम् ind. For a double object, (as for prosperity in earth and happi-ness in heaven.)  E. उभय and अर्थ an object.
7680: उम् ind. An interjection, 1. Of anger. 	 2. Interrogation. 	 3. Promise or assent; and 4. Of cordiality or pacification.
7681: उम m. (-मः) 	 1. A city, a town. 	 2. A wharf, a landing place. 	 f. (-मा) 	 1. A name of the goddess PARVATI or DURGA. 	 2. Light, splendor. 	 3. Fame, reputation. 	 4. Turmeric. 	 5. Flax, (Linum utilatissimum.) 6. Quiet, tranquillity.  E. उ particle of calling, and मा prohibition; i. e. “Practise not austerities,” the exclamation addressed to DURGA by her mother: in the other, senses it may be derived from मा to measure, or मा lustre.
7682: उमाकट m. (-टः) The cluster of flax.  E. उमा flax, कच् aff.
7683: उमागुरु m. (-रुः) The mountain Himalaya.  E. उमा the goddess, and गुरु a spiritual teacher: in mythology the personified mountain is the father of UMA.
7684: उमापति m. (-तिः) A name of SIVA.  E. उमा and पति master; the husband of UMA.
7685: उमावन n. (-नं) A name of Vanapura or Devi Kota, (Devi Cote.)  E. उमा and वन a grove; the residence of UMA.
7686: उमासुत m. (-तः) A name KARTIKEYA.  E. उमा and सुत a son, the son of PARVATI.
7687: उमेश m. (-शः) A title of SIVA.  E. उमा and ईश a lord: see उमापति.
7688: उम्भ r. 6th cl. (प) (उम्भति) To fill; also उभ.
7689: उम्य n. (-म्यं) A field of linseed, (Linum utilatissimum.)  E. उमा flax, and यत् affix; also औमीन.
7690: उम्बर m. (-रः) The upper-timber of a door-frame.  E. उद् up, above, वृ to screen, अप् aff.
7691: उम्बी f. (-म्बी) The stalks of wheat or barley fried over a fire of wet grass, considered as a tonic.

7694: उरःसूत्रिका f. (-का) A pearl-necklace.  E. उरस् the breast, and सूत्र thread, टच् aff.

7697: उरगस्थान n. (-नं) The infernal regions below the earth.  E. उरग and स्थान a place or country: the abode of the Nagas or serpents.
7698: उरगारि m. (-रिः) 	 1. GARUDA the bird of VISHNU. 	 2. A large crane. E. उरग a snake, and अरि the enemy.
7699: उरगाशन n. (-नं) 	 1. A name of GARUDA the bird of VISHNU. 	 2. The gigantic crane.  E. उरग and अशन food; whose food is of serpents.
7700: उरगेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) The king of snakes, SESHA or VASUKI.  E. उरग and इन्द्र chief.
7701: उरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A snake, a serpent: see उरग, the affix being खच्; also उरङ्गम.
7702: उरण m. (-णः) 	 1. A ram. 	 2. A cloud. 	 f. (-णी) A ewe.  E. ऋ to go, क्यु affix, leaving ण, and उ substituted for the antepenultimate.
7703: उरणाक्ष m. (-क्षः) Cassia, (Alata.)  E. उरण ram, अक्ष an eye: the flower being so compared: क being added, also उरणाक्षक.
7704: उरणाख्य m. (-ख्यः) Cassia: see the preceding.  E. उरण and आख्या a name; named from the ram; also उरणाख्यक, क being added.
7705: उरभ्र m. (-भ्रः) A ram.  E. उरु much, भ्रम् to wander, ड affix, and the final of उरु dropped.
7706: उररी ind. A particle implying, 1. Assent. 	 2. Expansion: (it chiefly occurs in composition.)  E. वे to weave, ररीक् aff.
7707: उररीकार m. (-रः) A promise, an agreement.  E. उररी, कार what makes.
7708: उररीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Promised, agreed. 	 2. Spread, diffused. E. उररी and कृत made.
7709: उरश्छद m. (-दः) Armour, mail.  E. उरस् the breast, and छद a covering.
7710: उरस् mfn. (-राः-राः-रः) Best, excellent. 	 n. (-रः) The breast, the bosom.  E. ऋ to go, Unādi affix असुन्, the pen. changed to उ; also उर a Soutra root, to go, and असुन् as before.
7711: उरसिज m. (-जः) The female breast.  E. उरस् the breast, in the 7th case, ज produced.

7713: उरसिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Broad-chested, having a full or broad breast. E. उरस् and इलच् aff.
7714: उरस्कट m. (-टः) The sacrificial thread hung round the neck and upon the breast, as it is sometimes worn.  E. उरस् the breast, कट् to encom-pass, अल् aff.
7715: उरस्तस् ind. From the breast.  E. उरस् and तसि aff.

7717: उरस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) From the breast. 	 mf. (-स्यः-स्या) A legitimate son or daughter, that is, one born from a married couple of the same tribe or cast.  E. उरस् the breast, and यत् aff.
7718: उरस्वत् mfn. (-स्वान्-स्वती-स्वत्) Broad-chested, full-breasted, strong. E. उरस् and मतुप् poss. aff.
7719: उराह m. (-हः) A horse of a pale colour, with dark legs.

7721: उरीकार m. (-रः) 	 1. Promise. 	 2. Extension.  E. उरी, and कार what makes.
7722: उरीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Promised. 	 2. Expanded, spread.  E. उरी and कृत made; also उररीकृत and ऊरीकृत.
7723: उरु mfn. (-रुः-रुः-र्व्वी-रु) 	 1. Large, great. 	 2. Much, excessive. 	 3. Long. 4. Valuable, precious.  E. ऊर्णु to cover, कु Unādi affix; ऊ is made short, and ण dropped by special rule.
7724: उरुकाल m. (-लः) A creeper, (Cucumis colocynthis.)  E. उरु and काल time, of long growth; also with कन् added उरुकालकः.
7725: उरुगाय m. (-यः) A name of KRISHNA.  E. उरग a snake, इ to go, and अच् aff.
7726: उरुतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Greater, larger.  E. उरु and तरप् aff.
7727: उरुतम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Greatest.  E. उरु and तमप् aff.
7728: उरुताप m. (-पः) Great heat.  E. उरु much, ताप heat.
7729: उरुत्व n. (-त्वं) Magnitude, vastness.  E. उरु and त्व affix; also उरुता.
7730: उरुमार्ग m. (-र्गः) A long road.  E. उरु and मार्ग a road.
7731: उरुरी ind. A particle, of 1. Assent. 	 2. Expansion: see उररी.
7732: उरुवुक m. (-कः) The castor-oil tree, (Palma christi or Ricinus commu-nis.)  E. उरु great or much, (disease,) वै to wither or dry, affix उक deriv. irr. or with ऊक affix उरुवूक.
7734: उरुव्यचस् m. (-चाः) A malignant sprite, an imp or goblin.  E. उरु much, व्यच् to deceive, असुन् Unādi aff.
7735: उरुसत्त्व mfn. (-त्त्वः-त्त्वा-त्त्वं) Magnanimous, of a lofty nature.  E. उरु and सत्त्व disposition.
7736: उरुहार m. (-रः) A valuable necklace.  E. उरु and हार a necklace.
7737: उरोगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) 	 1. Creeping, crawling, going on the belly as a reptile.  E. उरस् and गामिन् who goes.
7738: उरोग्रह m. (-हः) Pain of the chest, pleurisy.  E. उरस् and ग्रह what seizes.
7739: उरोघात m. (-तः) 	 1. Striking or beating the breast. 	 2. Pain in the chest. E. उरस् and घात a wound.
7740: उरोज m. (-जः) The female breast.  E. उरस् the breast, and ज produced.
7741: उर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Abandoned, left.  E. वर्ज्ज to abandon, क्त affix, and the vowel substituted.
7742: उर्णनाभ m. (-भः) A spider.  E. उर्ण wool, नाभि a navel, affix ड.
7743: उर्णा f. (-र्णा) 	 1. Wool, felt, the hair of camels, &c. 	 2. A circle of hair between the eye-brows.  E. उर्णु to cover, ड affix; the word is proper-ly ऊर्णा, q. v.
7744: उर्द r. 1st cl. (उर्दते) 	 1. To measure. 	 2. To play. 	 3. To be easy or cheerful.
7745: उर्द्र m. (-र्द्रः) An otter.  E. उर्द् to play, रन् aff.
7746: उर्व्व r. 1st cl. (ई,) उर्वी (उर्वति) To kill or hurt.
7747: उर्व्वट m. (-टः) A year.  E. उरु much, and अट् to go, अच् aff.
7748: उर्व्वरा f. (-रा) 	 1. Fertile soil, yielding every kind of crop. 	 2. Land in general.  E. उरु much, ऋ to go, अप् and टाप् affs.
7749: उर्व्वशी f. (-शी) The name of one of the courtezans of Swarga or INDRA'S heaven.  E. उरु great, वश् to tame, अच् and ङीष् affixes; also उर्व्वसी and ऊर्व्वसी.
7750: उर्व्वशीरमण m. (-णः) The name of AILA or PURURAVA, the second king of the line of the moon.  E. उर्व्वशी, and रमण the gallant or husband of the Apsara URVASI.
7751: उर्व्वशीवल्लभ m. (-भः) A name of AILA: see the preceding. E. As before, वल्लभ a friend, a lover, &c.
7752: उर्व्वारु m. (-रुः) A kind of cucumber, (Cucumis utilatissimus.) See इर्व्वारु.
7753: उर्व्वी f. (-र्व्वी) The earth.  E. उरु great, ङीष् aff.
7754: उर्व्वीधर m. (-रः) 	 1. A mountain. 	 2. The serpent SESHA.  E. उर्व्वी the earth, and धर what holds.
7755: उर्व्वीरुह m. (-हः) A tree.  E. उर्व्वी and रुह what grows on.
7757: उलप mn. (-पः-पं) 	 1. A creeping plant, a spreading creeper. 	 m. (-पः) A kind of grass or reed, (Saccharum cylindricum.)  E. बल् to be strong, अपच् affix; also उलुप.
7758: उलिन्द m. (-न्दः) The name of a country.  E. उल् to burn, किन्दच् aff.
7759: उलुप mn. (-पः-पं) A spreading creeper. 	 m. (-पः) A reed, (Saccharum cylindricum.)  E. बल् to be strong, उपच् affix; also उलप and उलूप.
7760: उलुपिन् m. (-पी) A porpoise, or fish resembling it.  E. उ for उत् up, लुप् to disturb, &c. णिनि affix; also उलूपिन्, ऊलुपिन्, उल्लुपिन्, &c.
7761: उलूक m. (-कः) 	 1. An owl. 	 2. A name of INDRA. 	 3. One of the heroes of the Mahabharata. 	 n. (-कं) A kind of reed, (Saccharum cylindri-cum.)  E. बल् to be strong, ऊक aff.
7762: उलूखल n. (-लं) 	 1. A wooden mortar used for cleaning rice. 	 2. Bdel-lium, a gummy substance.  E. उद् up, ख empty, and ल what takes: or उदू for उद्, and खल what goes; द is changed to लः see उदूखल.
7763: उलूखलक m. (-कः) A name of Bdellium, a gummy substance, or the plant which produces it.  E. कन् added to the preceding.
7764: उलूखलिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Pounded in a mortar, cleansed.  E. उलूखल and ठक् aff.
7765: उलूत m. (-तः) A large snake, the Boa.  E. उद् much, लू to cut, and क्त aff.
7766: उलूप m. (-पः) A spreading creeper. 	 n. (-पं) A sort of grass. 	 f. (-पी) A nymph of Patala married to ARJUNA. E. See उलुप.
7767: उलूपिन् m. (-पी) A porpoise, or fish resembling it: see उलुपिन्.
7768: उल्का f. (-ल्का) 	 1. A fire-brand. 	 2. Fire falling from heaven, a meteor, &c. 	 3. Flame. 	 4. Fire.  E. उष् to burn, कक् Unādi affix, ल substi-tuted for ष; or the root is a Sautra root, उल to burn.
7769: उल्कामुख m. (-खः) A ghost or goblin, with a face of fire, who eats what is vomited, and who was a negligent Brahman in his life-time. 	 f. (-खी) A fox.  E. उल्का a flame, मुख a mouth, ङीष् affix; the latter from the redness of his mouth.
7770: उल्मुक m. (-कः) 	 1. A fire-brand, wood burning or burnt as charcoal. 	 2. The name of a prince.  E. उष् to burn, मुक Unādi affix, ष is chang-ed to ल.
7771: उल्लकसन n. (-नं) Horripilation, erection of the hair of the body.  E. उद् up, लष् to injure, ल्युट् affix, and क inserted.
7772: उल्लग्न m. (-ग्नः) The Lagna of any particular place.  E. उत् over, लग्न the entrance of the sun into a sign.
7773: उल्लङ्घन n. (-नं) 	 1. Leaping or passing over or beyond. 	 2. Exceeding, transgression.  E. उद् before लघि to go, ल्युट् aff.
7774: उल्लङ्घित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Passed over or beyond, jumped across. 	 2. Exceeded, transgressed.  E. उद् before लघि to go, क्त aff.
7775: उल्लङ्घ्य mfn. (-ङ्घ्यः-ङ्घ्या-ङ्घ्यं) 	 1. To be crossed, to be passed over or beyond. 	 2. To be disregarded or neglected.  E. उद् before लघि to go, and यत् aff.
7776: उल्लङ्घितशासन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Refractory, rebellious, disobedient.  E. उल्लङ्घित and शासन order.
7777: उल्लल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Shaking, trembling.  E. उद् much, लल् to tremble, अच् aff.
7778: उल्ललत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्) Shaking, trembling. 	 2. Moving irregularly or convulsively.  E. उद् before लल् to tremble, affix शतृ.
7779: उल्ललित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shaken, trembling, agitated.  E. उद् much, लल् to tremble, affix क्त.
7780: उल्लस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) 	 1. Bright, shining. 	 2. Sporting, merry, happy. 	 3. Going out, issuing.  E. उद् before लस् to shine, अच् aff.
7781: उल्लसत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) 	 1. Brilliant, shining. 	 2. Sporting, wanton-ing.  E. उद् before लस् to shine, शतृ aff.
7782: उल्लसता f. (-ता) 	 1. Splendor, brilliancy. 	 2. Mirth, happiness. 	 3. Going forth, issuing.  E. उल्लस what shines, तल् aff.
7783: उल्लसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Bright, splendid, shining. 	 2. Happy. 	 3. Eject-ed, brought to the top or surface. 	 4. Drawn up.  E. उद् before लस् to shine, क्त aff.
7784: उल्लाघ mfn. (-घः-घा-घं) 	 1. Recovered from sickness, convalescent. 	 2. Dex-trous, clever, intelligent. 	 3. Pure. 	 4. Happy, delighted.  E. उद् much, लाघ to be able, अच् aff.
7785: उल्लाप m. (-पः) Change of voice in grief, sickness, &c.  E. उद् implying alteration, लप् to speak, घञ् aff.
7786: उल्लास m. (-सः) 	 1. Joy, happiness. 	 2. Light, splendor. 	 3. Increase. 	 4. The division of a book, a chapter, a section.  E. उद् much, लस् to shine, &c. घञ् aff.
7787: उल्लासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Delighted, rejoicing.  E. उद् before लस् to shine, causal form, क्त aff.
7788: उल्लिखत् mfn. (-खन्-खन्ती-खत्) 	 1. Painting, writing. 	 2. Making lines or streaks, above or on high. 	 3. Scratching, scraping. 	 4. Bearing, raising.  E. उद् before लिख् to write, शतृ aff.
7789: उल्लिखित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Thrown up, tossed. 	 2. Pared, made thin. 3. Scraped, scratched. 	 4. Painted, delineated. 	 5. Written over or above.  E. उद् and लिखित written.
7790: उल्लिङ्गित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Discriminated, distinguished, known.  E. उद् before लिगि to mark, and क्त aff.
7791: उल्लुञ्चन n. (-नं) 	 1. Plucking out hair. 	 2. Cutting the hair.  E. उद् up, लुचि to cut, affix ल्युट्.
7792: उल्लेख m. (-खः) 	 1. Utterance, pronunciation. 	 2. Speaking.  E. उद् before लिख् to write, घञ् aff.
7793: उल्लेखन n. (-नं) 	 1. Raising up, elevating. 	 2. Vomiting. 	 3. Digging. 4. Seraping, paring. 	 5. Uttering, utterance. 	 6. Writing, painting. E. उद् before लिखि to write, &c. ल्युट् aff.
7794: उल्लोच m. (-चः) An awning, a canopy.  E. उद् above, लोच् to see, अच् aff.
7795: उल्लोल m. (-लः) A surge, a large wave or billow.  E. उद् up, लोड् to be furious, अच् affix, and ड becomes ल.

7797: उल्वण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 	 1. Apparent, evident. 	 2. Much exceeding. 	 n. (-णं) An excess of either of the humors of the body, bile, phlegm or wind.  E. उद् up, ल्वी to join, deriv. irr.
7798: उब्ज r. 6th cl. (उब्जति) To be straight: see ऊब्ज.
7799: उशत् mfn. (-शन्-शती-शत्) Inauspicious, (as discourse.)  E. उष् to burn, शतृ part. affix; also उषत्.

7802: उशी f. (-शी) Wish, desire.  E. वश् to wish, ई Unādi aff.
7803: उशीनर m. (-रः) 	 1. The name of a country, (Candahar.) 	 2. A king, the father of SIVI.  E. उशी desire, नर a man.
7804: उशीर mn. (-रः-रं) The root of a fragrant grass, (Androdogon muricatum.) f. (-री) A sort of grass, a small sort of Saccharum.  E. वश् ta desire, ईरन् Unādi affix; also with कन् added उशीरक.
7805: उष r. 1st cl. (ओषति) To burn. (उ,) उषु (ओषति) To kill or injure: with प्र prefixed, this root makes प्रोषति, &c.
7806: उष m. (-षः) 	 1. Early morning, dawn, day-break. 	 2. A libidinous man. 3. Bdellium. 	 4. Saline earth. 	 f. (-षा) 	 1. A cow. 	 2. Burning, scorch-ing. 	 3. A proper name, the wife of ANIRUDDHA. 	 4. Night. 	 5. A pot; also उखा. ind. The end of night or day-break.  E. उष् to burn, क affix and fem. do टाप्; the affix of the particle is का.
7807: उषण n. (-णं) Black pepper. 	 f. (-णा) 	 1. Long pepper. 	 2. Chai, (Piper chavya.) 	 3. Dried ginger.  E. उष् to burn, कनच् aff.
7808: उषत् mfn. (-षन्-षती-षत्) Inauspicious, (as discourse:) see उशत्.
7809: उषप m. (-पः) 	 1. The sun. 	 2. Fire.  E. उष् to burn, पच् aff.
7810: उषर्बुध m. (-धः) Fire.  E. उषस् dawn, बुध् to know, क aff.
7811: उषस् n. (-षः) 	 1. The dawn, morning. 	 f. (-सी) The end of the day, twi-light.  E. उष् to burn, असि Unādi aff.
7812: उषस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Belonging to the dawn.  E. उषस् and य aff.

7815: उषारमण m. (-णः) ANIRUDDHA: see the preceding.  E. उषा and रमण a husband, &c.
7816: उषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Stale. 	 2. Burnt. 	 3. Quick, expeditious. 	 4. Fixed, remaining in or on. 	 5. Inhabited, dwelt.  E. उष् to burn, or वस् to abide, affix क्त.
7817: उषितङ्गवीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Formerly inhabited by cattle.  E. उषित inhabit-ed, गवीन appertaining to cattle, form गो with खश् affix: see अशितङ्गवीन.

7819: उषीर mn. (-रः-रं) The root of the Andropogon muricatum.  E. वश् to desire, ईरन् affix, श becomes षः see उशीर.
7820: उषेश m. (-शः) A name ANIRUDDHA.  E. उषा and ईश lord, husband: see उषापति.
7821: उष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) Fit to be dressed in a pot, or boiled, (meat, &c.) E. उषा a pot, यत् affix; also उख्य.
7822: उष्ट्र m. (-ष्ट्रः) 	 1. A camel. 	 2. A cart, a vehicle of burthen. 	 f. (-ष्ट्री or -ष्ट्रिका) An earthen vessel. 	 2. A she camel.  E. उष् to burn, and ष्ट्रन् Unādi affix, fem. affix ङीष् or टाप् with इक् inserted.

7828: उष्ट्रपादिका f. (-का) Arabian jasmin.  E. उष्ट्र and पाद a foot: from the shape of its flowers.

7836: उष्णवारण mn. (-णः-णं) An umbrella or parasol, a Chhattah.  E. उष्ण heat, and वृ to screen, affix ल्युट्.
7837: उष्णवाष्प m. (-ष्पः) 	 1. Hot vapour, steam. 	 2. Tears.  E. उष्ण and वाष्प vapour.
7838: उष्णवीर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) 	 1. The gangetic porpoise. 	 2. Any hot or pungent sub-stance.  E. उष्ण heat, वीर्य्य power, strength.
7839: उष्णांशु m. (-शुः) The sun.  E. उष्ण and अंशु a ray.
7840: उष्णागम m. (-मः) The hot season, consisting of two months, about June and July.  E. उष्ण heat, and आगम arrival.
7841: उष्णाभिगम m. (-मः) The hot season, as above.  E. उष्ण and अभिगम approach.
7842: उष्णालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Suffering from heat.  E. उष्ण and आलु aff.
7843: उष्णासह m. (-हः) The cold season.  E. उष्ण warmth, असह intolerant.
7844: उष्णिका f. (-का) Rice gruel.  E. उष्ण warm (rice,) वुन् aff.
7845: उष्णिह् f. (-ष्णिक्) A verse of four lines, each line being of seven syllables: it is used chiefly in the Vedas.  E. उत् prefixed to ष्णिह् to be unctu-ous or bland, क्विन् aff.
7846: उष्णीष mn. (-षः-षं) 	 1. A turban. 	 2. A diadem. 	 3. A distinguishing cog-nate mark. 	 4. The curly hair with which a Buddha is born, and which indicates his future sanctity.  E. उष्ण heat, ईष् to oppose or injure, क aff.
7847: उष्णीषधारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Turbaned.  E. उष्णीष and धारिन् who wears.
7848: उष्णोदक n. (-कं) Warm or hot water.  E. उष्ण and उदक water.
7849: उष्णोपगम m. (-मः) The hot season, summer.  E. उष्ण, उपगम arrival.
7850: उष्म m. (-ष्मः) 	 1. The hot season, (June and July.) 	 2. Spring, (April and May.) 	 3. Heat. 	 4. Anger, warmth of temper. 	 5. Ardor, eagerness. E. उष् to burn, मक् affix; also with कन् affix उष्मक, also उष्ण and उष्णक.
7851: उष्मन् m. (-ष्मा) 	 1. The hot season. 	 2. Heat.  E. उष् to burn, and मनिन् aff.
7852: उष्मपा m. (-पाः) A heavenly spirit of an inferior order.
7853: उष्मभास् m. (-भाः) The sun.  E. उष्म and भास् what shines.
7854: उष्मस्वेद m. (-दः) A vapour bath.  E. उष्म and स्वेद sweat.
7855: उष्मागम m. (-मः) The hot season: see उष्णागम.
7856: उस्र m. (-स्रः) 	 1. A bull. 	 2. A ray of light. 	 f. (-स्रा) 	 1. A cow. 	 2. A plant, (Anthericum tuberosum, Rox.)  E. वस् to dwell, रक् Unādi aff.
7858: उह r. 1st cl. (इर्) उहिर् (ओहति) or (इ) उहि (उंहति) 1. To hurt or give pain. 	 2. To kill, to destroy. With वि and अप, pre. to destroy, to remove.
7859: उहान m. (-नः) The name of a country.
7860: ऊ The sixth vowel of the Sanskrit alphabet, corresponding to U long, and having the sound of that letter in the word rule.
7861: ऊ ind. 	 1. An incipient particle. 	 2. An interjection of compassion. 	 3. Of regard. 	 m. (ऊः) The moon.  E. अव् to go, क्विप् affix, व becomes ऊ.
7862: ऊढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 	 1. Married. 	 2. Carried as load or burthen. 	 f. (-ढा) A bride, a wife espoused according to the ritual.  E. वह् to bear, क्त aff.
7863: ऊढकङ्कट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Armed, mailed.  E. ऊढ borne, कङ्गट armour.
7864: ऊत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Woven.  E. वेञ् to weave, affix क्त.
7865: ऊति f. (-तिः) 	 1. Preserving, protecting. 	 2. Sewing, weaving. 	 3. Distil-ling. 	 4. Speed. 	 5. Sport, play.  E. वेञ् to weave, &c. affix क्तिन्.
7866: ऊधन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Produced from the udder, milk, &c.  E. ऊधस्, यत् affix, and न substituted for स.
7867: ऊधस् n. (-धः) An udder.  E. वह् to bear, असि affix, deriv. irr.
7868: ऊधस्य n. (-स्यं) Milk.  E. ऊधस् and यत् aff.
7869: ऊन r. 10th cl. (न) ऊनत् (ऊनयति) 1. To deduct or lessen. 	 2. To mete out in small quantities. 	 3. To measure.
7870: ऊन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Less in number, size or degree, as fewer, smaller, inferior, &c.  E. ऊन to deduct, &c. affix क.
7871: ऊम ind. An interjection of, 1. Interrogation. 	 2. Anger. 	 3. Reproach, abuse. 	 4. Arrogance. 	 n. (-मं) A city.  E. अव् to preserve, &c. मन् Unādi aff.
7872: ऊय r. 1st cl. (ई) ऊयी (ऊयते) To sew, to weave.
7873: ऊररी ind. 	 1. A particle of assent. 	 2. Of expansion.  E. ऊय् to sew, &c. ररीक् affix: see उररी.
7874: ऊरव्य m. (-व्यः) A man of the third cast or tribe, the merchant or hus-bandman, the Vaisya.  E. ऊरु a thigh, and यत् affix; being born from the thighs of BRAHMA.
7875: ऊरी ind. A particle of, 1. Assent. 	 2. Of expansion: see उरी.
7876: ऊरीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Promised. 	 2. Expanded.  E. ऊरी and कृत made: see उरीकृत.
7877: ऊरु m. (-रुः) The thigh.  E. ऊर्णु to cover, कु aff.
7878: ऊरुग्लानि f. (-निः) Weakness of the thigh.  E. ऊरु and ग्लानि debility.
7879: ऊरुज m. (-जः) A Vaisya or man of the third tribe.  E. ऊरु and ज born; from the thigh of BRAHMA.
7880: ऊरुदघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्ना-घ्नं) As high as the thigh.  E. ऊरु and दघ्नच् affix; also ऊरुद्वयस and ऊरुमात्र, with द्वयसच् and मात्रच् affs.
7881: ऊरुपर्व्वन् n. (-र्व्व) The knee.  E. ऊरु and पर्व्वन् a joint.
7882: ऊरुरी ind. A particle of, 1. Promise. 	 2. Of expansion: see ऊररी.
7883: ऊरुस्तम्भ m. (-म्भः) 	 1. Paralysis of the lower extremities. 	 2. Rheumatism of the thigh. 	 f. (-म्भा) The plantain tree.  E. ऊरु and स्तम्भ a post.
7884: ऊर्ज् f. (-ऊर्क्) Strength, vigour.  E. ऊर्ज् to be strong, क्विप् aff.
7885: ऊर्ज r. 10th cl. (ऊर्जयति) 	 1. To be strong. 	 2. To live.
7886: ऊर्ज m. (-र्जः) 	 1. The month Kartik, (Oct.-Nov.) 	 2. Effort, exertion. 	 3. Power, strength. 	 4. Breath, breathing. 	 5. Procreative power. 	 n. (-र्जं) Water.  E. ऊर्ज to live, क aff.
7887: ऊर्जस्वत् mfn. (-स्वान्-स्वती-स्वत्) Strong, vigorous.  E. ऊर्ज and मतुप् affix, with स inserted.
7888: ऊर्जस्वल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Strong, powerful.  E. ऊर्ज strength, वलच् affix, and स inserted.
7889: ऊर्जस्विन् mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि) Very strong. 	 n. (-स्वि) Speaking of any thing with disdain, (a figure of rhetoric.)  E. ऊर्ज and विनि affix, स inserted.
7890: ऊर्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Powerful, mighty, great, excellent. 	 2. Exceed-ding, much.  E. ऊर्ज to be strong, क्त aff.
7891: ऊर्जिताश्रय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Spirited, magnanimous.  E. ऊर्जित great, आश्रय receptacle.
7892: ऊर्णनाभ m. (-भः) A spider.  E. ऊर्ण wool, नाभि the navel, ड affix; also ऊर्णनाभि, the final being retained.
7893: ऊर्णा f. (-र्णा) 	 1. Wool, felt, &c., the hair of sheep, deer, camels, &c. 	 2. A circle of the hair between the eye-brows, considered as a token of greatness.  E. ऊर्णु to cover, ड and टाप् affs.
7894: ऊर्णामय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Woolen, made of wool.  E. ऊर्णा and मयट् aff.
7895: ऊर्णायु m. (-युः) 	 1. A woollen blanket. 	 2. A ram. 	 3. A spider.  E. ऊर्णा wool, युस् aff.
7896: ऊर्णु r. 2nd cl. (ञ) ऊर्णुञ् (ऊर्णौति ऊर्णोति or ऊर्णुते) To cover, hide, con-ceal, &c. with प्र prefixed प्रोर्णौति.
7897: ऊर्णुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Covered.  E. ऊर्णु and क्त aff.
7898: ऊर्द्दर m. (-रः) 	 1. A hero, a champion. 	 2. A Rakshasa, a goblin or fiend. E. ऊर्ज to be strong, दरल Unādi affix; ज is dropped.
7899: ऊर्द्ध mfn. (-र्द्धः-र्द्धा-र्द्धं) 	 1. Above, upper. 	 2. High, elevated. 	 3. Abandoned: see ऊर्द्ध्व.
7900: ऊर्द्धक m. (-कः) A kind of drum: see ऊर्द्ध्वक.
7901: ऊर्द्ध्व mfn. (-र्द्ध्वः-र्द्ध्वा-र्द्ध्वं) 	 1. Above, superior, upper. 	 2. High. 	 3. Aban-doned. 	 4. After, subsequent.  E. ऊर् substituted for उद् above, हा to leave, and ड्व affix, or with ड only ऊर्द्ध.
7902: ऊर्द्ध्वक m. (-कः) A kind of drum.  E. ऊर्द्ध्व or ऊर्द्ध्व up, and क what sounds; from its making a loud noise, or being elevated in playing; also ऊर्द्धक.
7903: ऊर्द्ध्वकाय m. (-यः) The upper part of the body.  E. ऊर्द्ध्व and काय body.
7904: ऊर्द्ध्वग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Going up or above; ascending, hovering.  E. ऊर्द्ध्व and ग what goes; also ऊर्द्ध्वगामिन्, &c.
7905: ऊर्द्ध्वगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone up, risen, ascended.  E. ऊर्द्ध्व, गत gone.
7906: ऊर्द्ध्वगति f. (-तिः) Ascent, elevation.  E. ऊर्द्ध्व and गति going.
7907: ऊर्द्ध्वगपुर n. (-रं) The city of HARISCHANDRA, who with his subjects is supposed to be suspended in the atmosphere.  E. ऊर्द्ध्वग going above, and पुर a city: see हरिश्चन्द्रपुर.
7908: ऊर्द्ध्वगम m. (-मः) Upward motion of any kind  E. ऊर्द्ध्व and गम going; also ऊर्द्ध्वगति.
7909: ऊर्द्ध्वचरण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Supine, heels upwards.  E. ऊर्द्ध्व and चरण the foot; also ऊर्द्ध्वपाद, &c.
7910: ऊर्द्ध्वजानु mfn. (-नुः-नुः-नु) 	 1. Thick-kneed, long-shanked. 	 2. Sitting on the hams.  E. ऊर्द्ध्व high, large, जानु the knee, and with कन् added ऊर्द्ध्वजानुक.
7911: ऊर्द्ध्वज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Thick-kneed: see the preceding.  E. ऊर्द्ध्व and ज्ञ substituted for जानु; also ऊर्द्ध्वज्ञु.
7913: ऊर्द्ध्वत्व n. (-त्वं) Height, elevation.  E. त्व added to ऊर्द्ध्व; also with तल् ऊर्द्ध्वता.
7914: ऊर्द्ध्वदृष्टि mfn. (-ष्टिः-ष्टिः-ष्टि) Looking up or upwards.  E. ऊर्द्ध्व and दृष्टि sight.
7915: ऊर्द्ध्वदेव m. (-वः) A name of VISHNU.  E. ऊर्द्ध्व superior, and देव deity.
7916: ऊर्द्ध्वन्दम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Exalted, elevated.  E. ऊर्द्ध्व upper, दम् to tame. अप् aff.
7917: ऊर्द्ध्वपातन n. (-नं) 	 1. Causing to ascend. 	 2. Sublimation.  E. ऊर्द्ध्व and पातन Causing to go.
7918: ऊर्द्ध्वपात्र n. (-त्रं) A sacrificial vessel.  E. ऊर्द्ध्व and पात्र a vessel.
7919: ऊर्द्ध्वपाद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Heels upwards. 	 m. (-दः) A fabulous animal with eight legs.  E. ऊर्द्ध्व superior, exceeding, पाद a foot.
7920: ऊर्द्ध्वपुण्ड्र m. (-ण्ड्रः) A perpendicular line on the forehead made with Sandal, &c. a Vaishnava mark.  E. ऊर्द्ध्व above, पुण्ड्र a similar mark.
7921: ऊर्द्ध्वबाहु m. (-हुः) An ascetic, one who holds his arms above his head constantly till they are fixed in that position.  E. ऊर्द्ध्व and बाहु the arm.
7922: ऊर्द्ध्वरेतस् m. (-ताः) 	 1. A name of SIVA. 	 2. Of BHISHMA. 	 3. A description of saint, one who lives in perpetual chastity.  E. ऊर्द्ध्व up, above, and रेतस् semen virile.
7923: ऊर्द्ध्वलिङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A name of SIVA.  E. ऊर्द्ध्व and लिङ्ग the generative organ.
7924: ऊर्द्ध्वलोक m. (-कः) Swarga, the heaven of INDRA or paradise.  E. ऊर्द्ध्व and लोक a world; the world above.
7925: ऊर्द्ध्ववर्त्मन् m. (-त्मा) The atmosphere, heaven.  E. ऊर्द्ध्व above, and वर्त्मन् a path.
7926: ऊर्द्ध्ववायु m. (-युः) The wind in the upper part of the body.  E. ऊर्द्ध्व and वायु wind.
7927: ऊर्द्ध्ववृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Put on, above or over the head.  E. ऊर्द्ध्व and वृत worn.
7928: ऊर्द्ध्वशोधन n. (-नं) Vomiting.  E. ऊर्द्ध्व and शोधन purifying.
7929: ऊर्द्ध्वस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Above, superior, placed on high; also ऊर्द्ध्वस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)  E. ऊर्द्ध्व and स्थ what stays or is.
7930: ऊर्द्ध्वस्थिति f. (-तिः) 	 1. A horse's back, the part where the rider sits. 	 2. Elevation, superiority.  E. ऊर्द्ध्व above, and स्थिति being, staying.
7931: ऊर्द्ध्वासित m. (-तः) The name of a vegetable, (Momordica charantia.) E. ऊर्द्ध्व above, आसित thrown: raised above other fruits.
7932: ऊर्म्मि mf. (-र्म्मिः) or f. only, (-र्म्मी) 	 1. A wave. 	 2. A current, the flowing of water. 	 3. A fold or plait in a garment. 	 4. A Light, manifesta-tion. 	 5. Speed, velocity. 	 6. Mental suffering, distress, uneasiness. 	 7. Pain. 	 8. Missing, regretting. 	 9. Human infirmity, as grief, illusion, hunger, thirst, decay. death. 	 10. Association. 	 11. Number, quanti-ty.  E. ऋ to go, मि Unāadi affix, ऊ substituted for the initial letter.
7933: ऊर्म्मिका f. (-का) 	 1. A finger-ring. 	 2. A plait or fold in a garment. 	 3. A wave. 	 4. Regret, sorrowing for anything lost. 	 5. The buzzing of a bee. E. As the preceding, कन् &c. added.
7934: ऊर्म्मिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 	 1. Crooked. 	 2. Wavy, billowy.  E. ऊर्म्मि a wave, and मतुप् poss. aff.
7935: ऊर्म्मिमत्ता f. (-त्ता) 	 1. Undulation. 	 2. Crookedness.  E. ऊर्म्मिमत् and तल् added.
7936: ऊर्म्मिमालिन् m. (-ली) The ocean.  E. ऊर्म्मि a wave, माला a necklace, and इनि affix; whose necklace is the surge.
7937: ऊर्व्वरा f. (-रा) Fertile soil, land bearing any and every crop: see उर्व्वरा.
7938: ऊर्व्वष्टीवत् n. (-वत्) The thigh and knee.  E. ऊरु and अष्ठीवत् the knee pan.
7939: ऊर्व्वसी f. (-सी) A nymph of Swarga: see उर्व्वशी. Also written ऊर्व्वशी.
7940: ऊर्व्व्यङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) A mushroom.  E. ऊर्व्वी for उर्व्वी the earth, and अङ्ग body: earth-born.
7941: ऊर्षा f. (-र्षा) A kind of grass, (Andropogon serratum:) see देवताडक. E. वृष् to rain, अङ् and टाप् affixes, व changed to ऊ.
7942: ऊलूक m. (-कः) An owl.  E. बल् to be strong, and ऊक affix; ब become ऊ.
7943: ऊलूपिन् m. (-पी) A porpoise: see ऊलपिन्, &c.
7944: ऊष r. 1st cl. (ऊषति) To be diseased or disordered.
7945: ऊष m. (-षः) Salt-ground, soil impregnated with saline particles. 	 n. (-षं) Dawn, day-break. 	 f. (-षा) The wife of ANIRUDDHA.  E. ऊष् to be or make sick, क affix, fem. टाप्: see उषा.
7946: ऊषक n. (-कं) Dawn, day-break. E. As before, कन् added.
7947: ऊषण n. (-णं) Black pepper. 	 f. (-णा) Long pepper: see उषण.
7948: ऊषर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) A spot with saline soil.  E. ऊष such soil, रच् aff.
7949: ऊषवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Consisting of saline soil, (a place, &c.)  E. ऊष and poss. affix मतुप्.
7950: ऊह r. 1st cl. (ऊहते) To reason, to apprehend and infer: with प्र and वि to intermit; with वि, to array in order of battle; with सम् prefixed, (समूहति or -ते) to assemble or to be assembled.
7951: ऊह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 	 1. Reasoning. 	 2. Completing a defective sentence or verse, supplying an ellipsis.  E. ऊह् to deliberate, घञ् affix, or with ल्युट् affix, ऊहन.
7952: ऊहन n. (-नं) Reasoning, inferring, concluding.  E. ऊह् to deliberate, affix ल्युट्.
7953: ऊहनी f. (-नी) A broom.  E. वह् to carry, ल्युट् and ङीष् affixes; व is chang-ed to ऊ.
7954: ऊहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) 	 1. Who or what reasons. 	 2. Who or what assembles. 	 f. (-णी) An assemblage, a collection.  E. ऊह reasoning, इनि aff.
7955: ऊह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) To be investigated, to be supplied.  E. ऊह् to reason, यत् aff.
7956: ऋ The seventh vowel of the Sanskrit alphabet, and peculiar to it. It corresponds in sound with RI, in merrily.
7957: ऋ f. (आ) A name of ADITI, the mother of the gods. ind. 	 1. An expres-sion of abuse. 	 2. An articulate sound. 	 3. An expression of laugh-ter. 	 4. A sound inarticulate or reiterated as in stammering.
7958: ऋ r. 1st cl. (ऋच्छति) 	 1. To go, to approach. 	 2. To gain, to acquire; (the radical is changed to ऋछ before an initial mute श.) r. 3rd cl. (ईयर्त्ति) To go; (some confine this root to the Vedas.) r. 5th cl. (ऋणोति) To kill, to injure; also रि.
7959: ऋक्थ n. (-थं) 	 1. Wealth, possessions, property. 	 2. Gold.  E. ऋच् to praise, थक् Unādi aff.
7960: ऋक्थग्रहण n. (-णं) Receiving or inheriting property.  E. ऋक्थ wealth and ग्रहण taking.
7961: ऋक्थग्राह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Who inherits or takes property. 	 m. (-हः) in-heriting or receiving property.  E. ऋक्थ and ग्रह् to take, with घञ् affix; also with णिनि, ऋक्थग्राहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि.)

8227: एतर्हि ind. Now, at this time.  E. एत substituted for इदम्. and र्हिल् aff.
8228: एतश m. (-शः) A Brahman.  E. इण् to go, and तश Unādi aff.
8229: एतशस् m. (-शाः) A Brahman or man of the first class.  E. इण् to go, तशस् aff.
8230: एतादृश् mfn. (-दृक्) Such, such like.  E. एतद् this. दृश् to see, क्विप् aff.
8231: एतादृश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Such, such like.  E. एतद् this, दृश् to see, कञ् aff.
8232: एतावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) So many, so much, so far. ind. (-वत्) So far, thus far, so much, &c.  E. एतद्, and मतुप् or वति aff.
8233: एत्थ ind. Having gone to or approached.  E. इण् to go, ल्यप् aff.
8234: एध r. 1st cl. (एधते) To grow or increase.
8235: एध m. (-धः) Fuel, as wood, grass, &c.  E. एध् to increase, घञ् aff.
8236: एधतु mfn. (-तुः-तुः-तु) Increased, grown. 	 m. (-तुः) 	 1. Man. 	 2. Fire.  E. एध् to increase, तु Unādi aff.
8237: एधनीय mfn. (-तः-या-यं) To be enlarged or increased.  E. एध् to grow, and अनीयर् affix; also एधितव्य and एध्य.
8238: एधस् n. (-धः) Fuel: see एध.  E. एध् to grow, Unādi affix असुन्.
8239: एधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Increased, grown.  E. एध् to increase, affix क्त.
8240: एधितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Increasing, growing, enlarging.  E. एध् to grow, and तृच् aff.
8241: एनस् n. (एनः) 	 1. Sin, fault, offence. 	 2. Censure, blame.  E. इण् to go, असुन् Unādi affix, and नुम् inserted.
8242: एनस्विन् mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि) Sinful, a sinner.  E. एनस् and विनि aff.
8243: एरका f. (-का) A sort of grass of emollient and diluent properties.
8244: एरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A kind of fish; also एलङ्ग.
8245: एरण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The castor-oil plant, (Palma christi or Ricinus com-munis. ) 	 f. (-ण्डी) Long pepper.  E. इर् to go, &c. आङ् prefixed, अण्डच् affix, fem. affix ङीष्; also with कन् added एरण्डक.
8246: एरण्डक m. (-कः) Palma christi: see the preceding.
8247: एरण्डपत्रिका f. (-का) A plant, commonly Danti.  E. एरण्ड, and पत्र leaf, having similar leaves.
8248: एरण्डफला f. (-ला) A plant: see the preceding.  E. एरण्ड, and फल fruit.
8249: एर्वारु m. (-रुः) A kind of cucumber, (Cucumis utilatissimus.) E. See ईर्व्वारु.
8250: एलक m. (-कः) A ram: see एडक.  E. ड and ल being interchanged.
8251: एलङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A sort of fish, (Cyprinus marginatus, BUCH.) Also एरङ्ग.
8252: एलवालु n. (-लु) The name of a perfume: see the next word.
8253: एलवालुक n. (-कं) A granular substance apparently vegetable, of a red-dish brown colour, and used as a drug and as a perfume.  E. एला cardamoms, वल् to breathe, उण् affix, and कन् added, or without कन्, एलवालु.
8254: एलविल m. (-लः) A name of KUVERA: see ऐलविल.
8255: एला f. (-ला) Cardamoms, the seed of the Eletteria cardamomum, or Alpinia Cardamomum: it applies to both the large and small cardamom, but most commonly to the former.  E. इल् to send, &c. अच् aff.
8256: एलापत्र m. (-त्रः) One of the chiefs of the Nagas or serpent-race.
8257: एलापर्णी f. (-र्णी) A plant, (Mimosa octandra.)  E. एला cardamoms, and पर्ण a leaf, ङीष् fem. aff.
8258: एलीका f. (-का) Small cardamoms.  E. एला, and ईकन् added.
8259: एव mfn. (एवः एवा एवं) Going, moving. ind. As, like, &c.: see एवम्.  E. इण् to go, Unadi affix वन्: see the next.
8260: एवम् ind. A particle implying, 1. Likeness, (as, so, like.) 	 2. Assent, (yes, verily.) 	 3. Sameness of manner, (thus, in this way.) 	 4. Certainly, (indeed, assuredly, even so.) 	 5. Command, (so, thus, &c.) 	 6. An expletive.  E. इण् to go, वम् affix; also एव.
8261: एवम्भूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) So such, in such manner.  E. एवम्, and भूत been.
8262: एवम्विध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Such, in such form or manner, of such a kind E. एवम्, and विध sort, way.
8263: एष r. 1st. cl. (ऋ) एषृ (एषते) To go or approach.
8264: एषण m. (-णः) An iron arrow. 	 f. (-णी) 	 1. A goldsmith's balance, assay scales. 	 2. An iron or steel probe.  E. एष् to go, ल्युट् and ङीष् aff.
8265: एषणिका f. (-का) A goldsmith's balance. E. As before, with कन् and टाप् added.
8266: एषणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. To be desired, desirable. 	 2. To be aimed at. E. इष् to wish, affix अनीयर्.
8267: एषा f. (-षा) Desire.  E. इष् to wish, अङ् and टाप् aff.
8268: एषितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Wishing, desirous.  E. इष् to wish, तृच् aff.
8269: एष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) Wishing, desirous.  E. इष् to wish, तृच् aff.
8270: ऐ The twelfth vowel of the Nagari alphabet, or more properly a diphthong; corresponding in sound to Ei in height.
8271: ऐ ind. An interjection of, 1. Remembering, (aye, ha) 	 2. Calling, summoning, (hola, ho, heigh.)
8272: ऐ m. (ऐः) A name of SIVA.
8273: ऐकध्य n. (-ध्यं) Singleness of time or occurrence.  E. एक, and ध्यमुञ् aff.
8274: ऐकमत्य n. (-त्यं) Consent, concurrence, sameness of doctrine or opinion. E. एक one, मत minded, ष्यञ् aff.
8275: ऐकशफ mfn. (-फः-फा-फं) Produced by or belonging to animals with single hoofs.  E. एकशफ, and अण् aff.
8276: ऐकागारिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. A thief, a robber. 	 2. The possessor of one residence.  E. एक one, अगार a house, affix ठक्.
8277: ऐकाग्र्य n. (-ग्र्यं) Intentness on one object.  E. एकाग्र, and ष्यञ् aff.
8278: ऐकान्यिक m. (-कः) One who commits a single error in reading.  E. एक and अन्य other, ठक् aff.
8279: ऐकाहिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Ephemeral, quotidian, of one day, of the same day.  E. एक and अहन् a day, ठञ् aff.
8280: ऐक्य n. (-क्यं) 	 1. Unity, oneness. 	 2. A whole of various parts, an aggre-gate, a total.  E. एक, and ष्यञ् aff.
8281: ऐक्षव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Sugar, sugary, produced from or relating to the sugar-cane.  E. इक्षु sugar-cane, अण् aff.
8282: ऐक्षुक m. (-कः) A carrier of sugar-canes.  E. इक्षु, and ठञ् aff.
8283: ऐक्षुभारिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Carrying sugar-canes.  E. इक्षु, and भार a load, ठञ् aff.
8284: ऐक्ष्वाक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of the family of IKSHWAKU.  E. ईक्ष्वाकु, and अञ् affix, the final rejected.
8285: ऐक्ष्वाकव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Of the family of IKSHWAKU.  E. ईक्ष्वाकु, and अण् aff.
8286: ऐङ्गुद n. (-दं) The fruit of the plant called Inguda.  E. इङ्गुद the plant, affix अण्.
8287: ऐच्छिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Optional, voluntary, at will.  E. इच्छा wish, ठञ् aff.
8288: ऐडुक n. (-कं) A wall, &c. of bones and rubbish: see एडुक.
8289: ऐण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Belonging to a male antelope.  E. एण an antelope, अण् aff.
8290: ऐणिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging to a deer, &c. 	 m. (-कः) A hunter, a deer-killer.  E. एण, and ठञ् aff.
8291: ऐणेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Appertaining to a doe or the female antelope. E. एणी a doe, affix ढक्.
8292: ऐतरेयोपनिषद् f. (-षद् or -षत्) One of the Upanishads of the Vedas.
8293: ऐतिहासिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Historical. 	 m. (-कः) A historian.  E. इतिहास a story, and ठक् aff.
8294: ऐतिह्य n. (-ह्यं) Traditional instruction.  E. इतिहा tradition, ञ्य aff.
8295: ऐन्दव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Lunar. 	 n. (-वं) The asterism Mrigasiras. 	 f. (-वी) A plant, (Serratula anthelmintica.)  E. इन्दु the moon, अण् aff.
8296: ऐन्द्र mfn. (-न्द्रः-न्द्रा-न्द्रं) Sacred, or relating to the god INDRA. 	 m. (-न्द्रः) 1. A name of the monkey king BALI. 	 2. A name of ARJUNA. 	 f. (-न्द्री) 	 1. The wife of INDRA. 	 2. The goddess DURGA. 	 3. Misfortune, misery, (personified.) 	 4. The name of a plant, a kind of cucumber, (Cucumis madraspatanus.) 	 5. The constellation Jyeshṭha. 	 6. The east quarter, of which INDRA is regent.  E. इन्द्र, and अण् aff.
8297: ऐन्द्रजालिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Deceptive, illusory. 	 m. (-कः) A juggler. E. इन्द्रजाल Deception, and ठक् aff.
8298: ऐन्द्रलुप्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Afflicted with falling of the hair or morbid baldness.  E. इन्द्रलुप्त falling of the hair, and ठक् aff.
8299: ऐन्द्राग्न m. (-ग्नः) A ceremony, &c. addressed to INDRA and AGNI.  E. इन्द्र, and अग्नि, with अण् aff.
8300: ऐन्द्रायुध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Relating to INDRA'S bow or the rainbow. E. इन्द्रायुध, and अण् aff.
8301: ऐन्द्रावरुण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Sacred to INDRA and VARUNA.  E. इन्द्र, and वरुण with अण् aff.
8302: ऐन्द्रि m. (-न्द्रिः) 	 1. The patronymick of JAYANTA the son of INDRA. 	 2. A name of the monkey BALI. 	 3. A name of ARJUNA. 	 4. A crow. E. इन्द्र, इञ् patronymick aff.
8303: ऐन्द्रियक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Perceptible, perceived, present. 	 2. Of or belonging to the sense.  E. इन्द्रिय an organ of sense, and वुञ् aff.
8304: ऐरावण m. (-णः) INDRA'S elephant.  E. इरावत् the ocean, अण् affix of descent; ocean-born: न is changed irregularly to ण.
8305: ऐरावत m. (-तः) 	 1. INDRA'S elephant. 	 2. The same, considered as the elephant of the north quarter. 	 3. An orange. 	 4. A fruit, (Arto-carpus lacucha.) 	 5. A serpent, one of the chiefs of the Naga or serpent race, inhabiting the infernal regions. 	 f. (-ती) 	 1. Lightning. 2. A particular kind of it. 	 3. The female of INDRA'S elephant. 	 4. The Ravi river in the Panjab. 	 n. (-तं) INDRA'S bow unbent, the rainbow.  E. इरावत् water-having; that is, the ocean, a cloud, &c. अण् affix implying origin or descent; born from the ocean, (the elephant,) proceeding from watery clouds, (lightning, &c.)
8306: ऐरिण n. (-णं) Fossil or rock salt.  E. इरिन् earthly, अण् aff.
8307: ऐरेय n. (-यं) A spirituous liquor.  E. इरा wine, ढक् affix: see मैरेय.
8308: ऐल m. (-लः) The name of a king, also PURURAVA.  E. इला the wife of BUDDHA, अण् patronymick affix; the son of ILA.
8309: ऐलवालुक n. (-कं) A perfume: see एलवालुक.
8310: ऐलविल m. (-लः) A title of KUVERA.  E. इलविला the wife of PULASTYA, and the paternal grand-mother of the deity, affix अण्; also ऐड-विल, ऐडविड, एलविल, &c. ल and ड being interchanged.
8311: ऐलेय n. (-यं) A perfume: see एलवालुक.  E. एला cardamoms, ढक् aff.
8312: ऐश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) 	 1. Divine. 	 2. Regal.  E. ईश, and अण् aff.
8313: ऐशानी f. (-नी) The north-east quarter.  E. ईशान SIVA, as regent of the north-east, अण् and ङीष् affs.
8314: ऐशिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Divine, heavenly. 	 2. Regal, royal.  E. ईश, and ठक् aff.
8315: ऐश्वर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 	 1. Divine, relating to god, &c. 	 2. Royal, supreme. E. ईश्वर, and अण् aff.
8316: ऐश्वर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 	 1. Super-human power, the divine faculties of omni-presence, omnipotence, invisibility, &c. 	 2. Supremacy, dominion, away, power, might.  E. ईश्वर a master, a deity, ष्यञ् aff.
8317: ऐषमस् ind. The present year.  E. इदम् this, समसण् aff.
8318: ऐषमस्त्य mfn. (-स्त्यः-स्त्या-स्त्यं) Of or belonging to the present year. E. ऐषमस्, and त्यय affix; or with द्यु affix, ऐषमस्तन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं.)
8319: ऐष्टिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Sacrificial, ceremonial.  E. इष्टि a sacrifice, ठञ् aff.
8320: ऐष्टिकपौर्त्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Ceremonial and meritorious, (any act, &c.)  E. इष्टापूर्त्त any pious act, ठञ् aff.
8321: ऐहलौकिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of this world, terrestrial, sublunary. E. इह here, लोक world, ठञ् aff.
8322: ऐहिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Worldly, local, of this world, of this place. E. इह here, and ठञ् aff.
8323: ओ The vowel O, and the thirteenth of the Nagari alphabet.
8324: ओ ind. 	 1. A vocative particle, (ho.) 	 2. An interjection of calling, (ho, hola.) 	 3. Of reminiscence, (ho, ah.) 	 4. Of compassionating, (ah, oh.)
8326: ॐ ind. The mystical monosyllable Om: see ओम्.
8327: ओक m. (-कः) 	 1. A house. 	 2. An asylum, a refuge: see ओकस्. 	 3. A bird E. उच् to assemble, क aff.
8328: ओकण m. (-णः) A bug; also ओकणि.
8329: ओकस् n. (-कः) 	 1. An asylum, a place of refuge. 	 2. A house.  E. उच् to collect, असुन् Unadi affix, च becomes क.
8330: ओकुल m. (-लः) A cake of flour.
8333: ओख r. 1st. cl. (ऋ) ओखृ (ओखति) and with a prefix, as प्र प्रोखति) 	 1. To dry or arid. 	 2. To adorn. 	 3. To be able or competent, to suffice. 4. To refuse or prevent.
8334: ओघ m. (-घः) 	 1. A heap or quantity, flock or multitude. 	 2. A stream, a torrent, rapid flow of water, an inundation. 	 3. Quick time in music. 	 4. Tradition. 	 5. Advice, instruction.  E. उच् to collect, घञ् affix, and च is changed to घ.
8335: ओङ्कार m. (-रः) The mysterious name of the deity: see ओम्. 	 f. (-रा) A Bauddha Sakti, or female personification of divine energy.  E. ओम् and कार affix implying a letter, the compound letter ओ; other-wise ओम्, signifying assent, and कार who makes; what complies with our wishes.
8336: ओज (त) r. 1st. cl. (ओजति) 	 1. To live, to have the vital faculties and organs. 	 2. To be strong or able.
8338: ओजस् n. (-जः) 	 1. Light, splendor. 	 2. Manifestaion, appearance. 	 3. Strength. 	 4. Support, stay. 	 5. Metallic lustre. 	 6. Vitality, the principle of vital warmth and action diffused throughout the body. 	 7. Virility, the generative faculty. 	 8. A form of style, elabo-rate style, abounding with compounds. 	 9. (In astrology,) Each alternate sign of the zodiac, first, third, fifth, &c.  E. ओज to live, and असुन् affix; or with अच् affix ओज.
8339: ओजस्विन् mfn. (-स्वि-स्विनी-स्वि) 	 1. Mighty, powerful, strong. 	 2. Splendid, bright.  E. ओजस् and विनि aff.
8340: ओडक m. (-कः) A musical mode, which omits two of the notes of the scale, Ri and Pa.
8343: ओड्र m. (-ड्रः) 	 1. The China rose, (Hibiscus mutabilis.) 	 2. The name of of a country, the northern part of Orissa.  E. उड to embrace, रक affix, and उ is changed to ओ.
8344: ओड्रपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) The China rose, the plant or its flower.  E. ओड्र China rose, and पुष्प a flower.
8345: ओण r. 1st cl. (ऋ) ओणृ (ओणति) To remove, to take away or abstract.
8346: ओतु m. (-तुः) A cat.  E. अव् to go, &c. and तु Unadi affix, the radical is changed to ओ.
8347: ओदन mn. (-नः-नं) Boiled rice. 	 f. (-निका-नी) A plant, (Sida cordifolia, &c.) see वला  E. उन्द् to be wet, ल्युट् Unadi affix, and न dropped.
8348: ओद्म m. (-द्मः) Wetting, moistening.  E. उन्द् to be wet, मम् aff.
8349: ओम् ind. 	 1. The mystic name of the deity, prefacing all the prayers and most of the writings of the Hindus.  E. अ a name of VISHNU, उ of SIVA, and म of BRAHMA; it therefore implies the Indian triad, and expresses the three in one. 	 2. A particle of command or in-junction. 	 3. Of assent, (verily, amen.) 	 4. Of auspiciousness. 	 5. Of removal, (away, hence,) and, 6. It is an inceptive particle.  E. अव् to go, to preserve, &c. मन् Unadi affix, the radical being convert-ed into ओ.
8350: ओल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Wet, damp; also ओल्ल. 	 m. (-लः) An esculent root, (Arum campanulatum.)  E. वल or वल्ल to destroy, (complaints, es-pecially hœmorrhoids,) अच् affix, व changed to ओ.
8351: ओलड r. 1st and 10th cls. (इ) ओलडि (ओलण्डति or ओलण्डयति) To dart or throw up: some consider the initial vowel to be indicatory, and make the root लडि q. v.
8352: ओष m. (-षः) Burning, combustion.  E. उष् to burn, घञ् aff.
8353: ओषण m. (-णः) Pungency, pungent taste or flavour. 	 f. (-णी) A potherb, commonly Purya.  E. उष् to burn, and ल्युट् aff.
8354: ओषधि f. (-धिः) An annual plant or herb, one that dies after becoming ripe.  E. ओष heat, and धा to have, कि affix; or with ङीष्, ओषधी; or with इञ् affix, औषधि.
8355: ओषधी f. (-धी) An annual plant or deciduous herb: see the preceding.
8356: ओषधोपति m. (-तिः) The moon.  E. ओषधी and पति lord: presiding over annual plants.
8357: ओषधीश m. (-शः) The moon. E. See the preceding; ईश meaning lord.
8358: ओष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) The lip, especially the upper, &c. du. 	 m. (ओष्ठौ or ओष्ठाधरौ) The lips: see अधर. 	 f. (-ष्ठी) A creeper, bearing a red flower, to which the lip is commonly compared, (Bryonia grandis.)  E. उष् to burn, थन् Unadi affix, fem. affix ङीष्: see विम्ब.
8359: ओष्ठपल्लव n. (-वं) A lip or the lips.  E. ओष्ठ and पल्लव a new shoot.
8360: ओष्ठरोग m. (-गः) Any morbid affection of the lips.  E. ओष्ठ and रोग disease.
8361: ओष्ठोपमफला f. (-ला) The creeper, (Bryonia grandis:) see ओष्ठी.  E. ओष्ठ a lip, उपम like, फल a flower, अच् and टाप् affixes; whose flower resembles a lip.
8362: औ The diphthong Au or Ou, having the same sound as in Our, and considered as the fourteenth vowel of the Nagari alphabet.

9124: करपल्लव m. (-वः) A finger.  E. कर, and पल्लव a shoot.
9125: करपात्र n. (-त्रं) 	 1. The hand hollowed so as to hold anything. 	 2. The throwing of water in sport.  E. कर, and पात्र a cup.

9136: करभिन् m. (-भी) An elephant.  E. करभ and इनि aff.
9137: करभीर m. (-रः) A lion.  E. करभ a young animal, and ईर who destroys.

9143: करमाल m. (-लः) Smoke, probably an error or corruption for खतमाल.
9144: करमाला f. (-ला) The hand used as a rosary, the joints of the fingers corresponding to the beads.  E. कर, and माला a rosary.

9153: करवालिका f. (-का) A small club, &c. see करबालिका.

9155: करवीर m. (-रः) 	 1. A fragrant plant, (Oleander or Nerium odorum.) 	 2. The name of a demon. 	 3. A sword or scymitar. 	 4. A cemetery, a place for burning or interring the dead. 	 f. 9157: करशाखा f. (-खा) A finger.  E. कर the hand, and शाखा a branch.
9158: करशीकर m. (-रः) Water expelled by an elephant's trunk.  E. कर his trunk, and शीकर drizzling rain.
9159: करशुक m. (-कः) A finger-nail.  E. कर the hand, शुक the beard of corn.
9160: करशोथ m. (-थः) Œdematous swelling of the hands.  E. कर, and शोथ swelling.
9161: करहाट m. (-टः) 	 1. The fibrous root of a lotus. 	 2. A tree, (Vangueria spinosa.)  E. क water, and रह् to abandon, करह a lotus, अट what goes, or by what it goes; or कर the hand, हट् to illuminate or adorn, and अण् aff.
9162: करहाटक m. (-कः) The name of a tree, (Vangueria spinosa.)  E. कन् added to the preceding.
9163: कराघात m. (-तः) A thump, a blow with the hand.  E. कर, and आघात a blow.
9164: करामर्द्ध m. (-र्द्धः) A fruit-tree, (Carissa carondas:) see करमर्द्ध.
9165: करामुक m. (-कः) A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta, Rox.) See कृष्णपाक.
9167: करायिका f. (-का) A bird, a small kind of crane.
9168: करारोट m. (-टः) A finger ring.  E. कर the hand, रुट् to shine, with आङ् prefixed, affix अच्.
9169: कराल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Great, large. 	 2. High, lofty. 	 3. Formidable, terrible. 	 4. Having projecting teeth. 	 m. 9170: करालक m. (-कः) A sort of Basil, the dark kind.
9171: करालकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Having a large trunk, (an elephant.) 	 2. Having a powerful arm or hand.  E. कराल, and कर a hand.
9172: करालम्ब mfn. (-म्बः-म्बा-म्बं) One who stretches out his hand to support or pick up another, &c.  E. कर, and आलम्ब what supports.

9174: करालवदन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Of hideous aspect, ugly, frightful. 	 f. (-ना) A form or emanation of DURGA.  E. कराल, and वदन countenance; also करालानन, करालमुख, &c.
9176: करालित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Afraid of, alarmed by or at. 	 2. Rendered formidable. 	 3. Magnified.  E. कराल and इतच् aff.
9177: करिकणवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A species of pepper, (Piper chavya.)  E. करिकण elephant-pepper, वल्ली a vine.
9178: करिकुम्भ m. (-म्भः) The frontal globe of an elephant.  E. करि, and कुम्भ the same.

9182: करिज m. (-जः) A young elephant.  E. करि an elephant, and ज born.
9183: करिदन्त m. (-न्तः) 	 1. An elephant's tusk. 	 2. Ivory.  E. करिन्, and दन्त a tooth.

9193: करिर m. (-रः) The shoot of a bamboo: see करीर.

9198: करीन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 	 1. A large, or a state elephant. 	 2. INDRA'S elephant.  E. करि, and इन्द्र chief.
9199: करीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Who does much.  E. कर who does, ईथसुन् aff.
9200: करीर mn. (-रः-रं) The shoot of a bamboo; also करिर. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A thorny plant, described as growing in deserts, and fed upon by camels, commonly Karil, (Capparis aphylla, Rox.) 	 2. 9203: करीषङ्कषा f. (-षा) A strong wind, a gale.  E. करीष, कष् to disturb, खच् aff.

9206: करुणात्मक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Compassionate, tender-hearted.  E. करुणा, आत्म self, कन् added.

9209: करुणामय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Gentle, compassionate.  E. करुणा and मयट् aff.
9210: करुणार्द्र mfn. (-र्द्रः-र्द्रा-र्द्रं) Tender-hearted, soft, sensitive.  E. करुणा; and आर्द्र moist.

9236: कर्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Hard, firm. 	 n. (-रं) Stone, lime-stone, especially the nodule found in Bengal under the name of Kankar. 	 m. (-रः) A mirror. 	 f. (-री) A small water-jar.  E. कर्क beauty, from कर्क to smile, र from रा to give, fem. affix ङीष्.

9255: कर्केतर m. (-रः) A kind of gem or precious stone.

9258: कर्कोटकी f. (-की) A plant, a Ghosha with yellow flowers: see घोष.
9259: कर्घ r. 1st. cl. (कर्घति) To go, to move.

9261: कर्चूरक m. (-कः) Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet:) see कर्बूरक.
9262: कर्ज r. 1st cl. (कर्जति) To pain or make uneasy.

A plant, (Cassia fistula.) 	 7. A kind of swallow wort, (Colotropis gigantea.) E. कर्ण to hear, घञ् affix; or कृ to do, &c. न Unadi aff.

9267: कर्णक्ष्वेड m. (-डः) An affection of the ear, a roaring or constant noise in it.  E. कर्ण, and क्ष्वेड a buzzing in the ear.
