9270: कर्णगोचर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Capable of being heard, perceptible to the ear. E. कर्ण, and गोचर perceptible.
9271: कर्णग्राह m. (-हः) A helmsman.  E. कर्ण, the helm, and ग्राह who holds.
9272: कर्णग्राहवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having a helmsman.  E. कर्णग्राह and मतुप् aff.
9273: कर्णच्छिद्र n. (-द्रं) The outer auditory passage.  E. कर्ण, and छिद्र hole.
9274: कर्णजप m. (-पः) An informer.  E. कर्ण, and जप who whispers; also कर्णेजप.
9275: कर्णजलूका f. (-का) 	 1. An insect, (Julus.) 	 2. A small centipede: see कर्णकीटी.  E. कर्ण, and जलूका a leech.
9276: कर्णजलौकस् f. (-का) A worm: see the preceding; also कर्णजलौका.
9277: कर्णजलौका f. (-काः) A kind of insect, (Julus cornifex, &c.) 	 2. A small centipede; also कर्णजलौकस् and कर्णजलूका.
9278: कर्णजाह n. (-हं) The root of the ear.  E. कर्ण, and जाह affix in this sense.
9279: कर्णजित् m. (-जित्) A title of ARJUNA.  E. कर्ण, and जित् conqueror; KARNA having taken the part of the KURUS, was killed by ARJUNA in the great battle between them and the Pandus.
9280: कर्णताल m. (-लः) The flapping of an elephant's ears.  E. कर्ण, and ताल tune.
9281: कर्णदर्पण m. (-णः) An ear-ring, an ornament of the ear.  E. कर्ण, and दर्पण a mirror.
9282: कर्णदुन्दुभि f. (-भिः) A kind of worm: see कर्णकीटी.  E. कर्ण, and दुन्दुभि a sort of drum; making a noise in the ear like a drum.
9283: कर्णधार m. (-रः) A pilot, a helmsman.  E. कर्ण the helm, धृञ् to have or. hold, and अण् aff.
9284: कर्णनाद m. (-दः) Ringing in the ear.  E. कर्ण, and नाद sound.
9285: कर्णन्दु f. (-न्दुः) A woman's ear-ring: see कर्णान्दु and कर्णेन्दु.
9286: कर्णपाक m. (-कः) Inflamation of the outer ear.  E. कर्ण, and पाक ripening.
9287: कर्णपाली f. (-ली) An ornament of the ear, a garland or string of jewels pendent from it.  E. कर्ण, and पाल् to cherish.
9288: कर्णपुर m. (-रः) The capital of KARNA, the ancient name of Bhagalpur. E. कर्ण, and पुर city; also कर्णपुर् f. (-पूः).
9289: कर्णपूर m. (-रः) 	 1. A tree, (Mimosa sirisha.) 	 2. The blue lotus. 	 3. An ear-ring. 	 4. The Asoka tree.  E. कर्ण. and पूर to make full, to complete.
9290: कर्णपूरक m. (-कः) The Kadamba tree, (Nauclea kadamba.)  E. कर्णपूर an ear-ring, and कन् resembling, like the large round drop or pendant of a Hindustani ear-ring.
9291: कर्णप्रतिनाह m. (-हः) A disease of the ear, suppression of the excretion or wax, which is supposed to have dissolved and pass by the nose and mouth.  E. कर्ण, and प्रतिनाह suppression.
9292: कर्णफल m. (-लः) A sort of fish, (Ophiocephalus kurrawey.)  E. कर्ण, and फल fruit.
9293: कर्णमद्गुर m. (-रः) A sort of sheat fish, (Silurus unitus.)  E. कर्ण, and मद्गुर a sheat fish.
9294: कर्णमल m. (-लः) The excretion or wax of the ear.  E. कर्ण, and मल dirt.
9295: कर्णमुकुर m. (-रः) 	 1. An ornament of the ear. 	 2. An ear-ring.  E. कर्ण, and मुकुर a mirror; reflecting its beauty.
9296: कर्णमोटी f. (-टी) A name of DEVI or DURGA in one of her forms or in-carnations  E. कर्ण the ear, मुट् to rub, घञ् and ङीप् affixes; this is sometimes written कर्णमोटि.
9297: कर्णलतिका f. (-का) The lobe of the ear.  E. कर्ण, लता a creeping plant, कन् added.
9298: कर्णवंश m. (-शः) An elevated platform.  E. कर्ण, and वंश a bamboo.
9299: कर्णवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 	 1. Having ears. 	 2. Long-eared. 	 3. Having a helm.  E. कर्ण and मतुप् aff.
9300: कर्णवर्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Earless. 	 m. (-तः) A snake.  E. कर्ण, and वर्जित् deprived.
9301: कर्णविद्रधि f. (-धिः) Ulceration of the ear.  E. कर्ण, and विद्रधि a sore.
9302: कर्णवेध m. (-धः) 	 1. Boaring the ears: as a religious ceremony it is per-formed where there are three sons, to prevent one of them from dying. 	 2. Piercing the ear in general.  E. कर्ण, and वेध piercing.
9303: कर्णवेधनिका f. (-का) An instrument for perforating the ear.  E. कर्ण, विध् to pierce, ल्युट् and ङीष् affixes, with कन् added, and the fem. termina-tion टाप्.
9305: कर्णवेष्टक n. (-कं) An ear-ring: see the next.
9306: कर्णवेष्टन n. (-नं) An ear-ring.  E. कर्ण, and वेष्टन surrounding.
9307: कर्णशष्कुली f. (-ली) The outer part of the ear, the cartilage and depres-sions leading to the auditory passage.  E. कर्ण, and शष्कुल the hol-lows of the ear.
9308: कर्णशूल n. (-लं) Ear-ache.  E. कर्ण, and शूल pain.
9309: कर्णश्रव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Audible, loud.  E. कर्ण, and श्रव hearing.
9310: कर्णसंस्राव m. (-वः) Discharge of pus from the ear.  E. कर्ण, and संस्राव suppuration.
9311: कर्णस्राव m. (-वः) Discharge of ichorous matter from the ear.  E. कर्ण, and स्राव running.
9312: कर्णस्फोटा f. (-टा) A sort of creeper.  E. कर्ण, and स्फोट a boil.
9313: कर्णाट m. (-टः) A country, Karnata, whence the modern Karnatic: the name however was anciently applied to the central districts of the peninsula, including Mysur. 	 f. (-टी) 	 1. One of the Raginis or fe-male personification of the musical modes, the bride of the Raga MALAVA. 	 2. A plant.  E. कर्ण the ear, a prince, &c. and अट् to go, affix अच्.
9314: कर्णानुज m. (-जः) A name of Yudhishṭhira, the elder brother of the five Pandu princes.  E. कर्ण, and अनुज younger born; the younger brother of KARNA.
9315: कर्णान्तिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Near or close to the ear.  E. कर्ण, and अन्तिक near.
9316: कर्णान्दु f. (-न्दुः) 	 1. An ornament of the ear. 	 2. An ear-ring: see the next, and कर्णेन्दु.
9317: कर्णान्दू f. (-न्दूः) An ornament of the ear, an ear-ring, &c.  E. कर्ण, and अन्दू a chain.
9318: कर्णारा f. (-रा) An instrument for perforating the ear.  E. कर्ण the ear, ऋ to go, अच् and टाप् affs.
9319: कर्णारि m. (-रिः) A name of ARJUNA.  E. कर्ण, and अरि an enemy.
9320: कर्णालङ्कार m. (-रः) An ear-ring, an ornament of the ear.  E. कर्ण, and अलङ्कार ornament; also कर्णालङ्क्रिया, कर्णालङ्कृति, &c.
9321: कर्णास्फाल m. (-लः) The flapping of an elephant's ear.  E. कर्ण, and आस्फाल with the same import.
9322: कर्णिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Having large or long ears. 	 2. Having ears. 3. Having a helm. 	 m. (-कः) A steersman. 	 f. (-का) 	 1. An ear-ring or ornament of the ear. 	 2. The pericarp of a lotus. 	 3. The middle finger. 	 4. The tip of an elephant's trunk. 	 5. A fruit-stalk. 	 6. A pen or small brush. 	 7. A plant, (Premna spinosa, &c.) see अग्निमन्थ. E. कर्ण the ear, &c. इक affix; or कन् and टाप् affs.

9324: कर्णिकार m. (-रः) 	 1. The name of a tree, commonly Kaniyar, (Pteros-permum acerifolium.) 	 2. A sort of Cassia, (Cassia fistula.) 	 3. The pericarp of a lotus.  E. कर्णिका an ornament of the ear, ऋ to go, अण् affix; also with कन् added कर्णिकारक.
9325: कर्णिकिन् m. (-की) An elephant.  E. कर्णिका the tip of his trunk, and इनि aff.
9326: कर्णिन् mfn. (-र्णी-र्णिनी-र्णि) 	 1. Having an ear, relating to the ear, &c. 	 2. Long-eared. 	 3. Barbed, (as an arrow.) 	 4. Having a helm. 	 m. (-र्णनी) 	 1. The name of a mountain, one of the seven principal ranges of the mountains, dividing the universe. 	 2. The neck, the part near the ear. 	 3. A steersman. 	 f. (-र्णिनी) A disease of the uterus, prolapsus or polypus uteri.  E. कर्ण, and इनि aff.
9327: कर्णिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Long-eared.  E. कर्ण, and इलच् aff.
9328: कर्णीरथ mf. (-थः-था) A covered car, or according to some, a litter for the conveyance of woman, &c. borne on men's shoulders.  E. कर्णी the part near the ear, and रथ a carriage.

9330: कर्णेजप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) An informer, a tale-bearer.  E. कर्णे in the ear, and जप् to recite in a low voice, अच् aff.
9331: कर्णेन्दु f. (-न्दुः) 	 1. A semicircular ornament of the ear. 	 2. An ear-ring. E. कर्ण, and इन्दु the moon, a crescent, &c. see कर्णान्दु.

9333: कर्त्तन n. (-नं) 	 1. Cutting, cutting off or in pieces. 	 2. Spinning cotton or thread. 	 f. (-नी) Scissors.  E. कृत् to cut, ल्युट् aff.
9334: कर्त्तरिका f. (-का) 	 1. A knife. 	 2. A small sword or cutlass. 	 3. A hunter's knife or sword, a couteau de chasse. 	 4. A scissors.  E. कर्त्तरी, and कन् added.
9335: कर्त्तरी f. (-री) 	 1. A scissors or shears. 	 2. A knife. 	 3. A small sword or cutlass.  E. कृत् to cut, अरन् affix, and ङीप् fem. do.
9336: कर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 	 1. To be done or made. 	 2. What ought to be done.  E. कृ to make, तव्य aff.
9337: कर्त्तव्यता f. (-ता) Necessity, obligation, propriety, fitness.  E. कर्त्तव्य, and तल् affix; also with त्व affix कर्त्तव्यत्वं.

9341: कर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) 	 1. An agent, a doer, a maker, one who makes or does. 	 2. One who practises what he knows. 	 m. (-र्त्ता) 	 1. A name of BRAHMA. 	 2. (In grammar,) The active noun, the nominative case. E. कृ to do, and तृच् affix: it may also be read कर्तृ.
9342: कर्त्तृक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) An agent, one who does anything.  E. कन् added to the last.
9343: कर्त्तृकत्व n. (-त्वं) Agency, action.  E. कर्त्तृक, and त्व aff.
9344: कर्त्तृका f. (-का) A small sword.  E. कृत् to cut, कन् aff.
9345: कर्त्तृत्व n. (-त्वं) Agency, the act or property of an agent.  E. कर्त्तृ, and त्व affix; also with तल् affix कर्त्तृता.
9346: कर्त्तृवाच्य m. (-च्यः) (In grammar,) The active voice.  E. कर्त्तृ agent, and वाच्य to be said.
9347: कर्त्र r. 10th cl. (कर्त्रयति) To unloose, to remove: see कर्त्त.
9348: कर्त्री f. (-र्त्री) A scissors.  E. कृत् to cut, तृच् and ङीष् affs.
9349: कर्द r. 1st cl. (कर्दति) To grumble, as the bowels; to caw as a crow; or to make any such noise.
9350: कर्द m. (-र्दः) Mud, clay.  E. कर्द् to sound ill, अच् aff.
9351: कर्दट m. (-टः) 	 1. The fibrous root of the lotus. 	 2. Mud, dirt. 	 3. Any aquatic weed, as Vallisneria, &c.  E. कर्द mud, and अट what goes.
9352: कर्दन n. (-नं) Grumbling of the bowels, borborygmi.  E. कर्द् to make such noise, and ल्युट् aff.
9353: कर्दम m. (-मः) 	 1. Mud, mire, clay. 	 2. Sin. 	 3. A Prajapati, the son of BRAHMA by CHHĀYĀ, and the father of Kapila: (this personage appears to be an innovation in Hindu mythology.) 	 f. (-मी) A plant. n. (-मं) Flesh.  E. कर्द् to sound badly, and अम Unadi aff.

9355: कर्पट m. (-टः) Old and patched or ragged garments.  E. कृप् to be able, and अटन् aff.

9359: कर्पर m. (-रः) 	 1. The skull, the cranium. 	 2. An iron saucepan or frying pan. 	 3. A kind of weapon. 	 4. The Glomerous fig tree: see उडुम्बर. f. (-री) A collyrium extracted from the Amomum anthorhiza, Rox. E. कृप् to be able, अरन् aff.
9360: कर्पराल m. (-लः) A tree, described as a Pilu growing in the hills. E. कर्पर the skull, &c. and अल् to adorn, अण् aff.
9361: कर्पराश m. (-शः) Sand, gravel, a sandy soil.
9362: कर्परिकातुत्थ n. (-त्थं) A collyrium extracted from the Amomum author-hiza: see कर्परा.  E. कर्परिका for कर्परी, and तुत्थ any collyrium.
9363: कर्पास mn. (-सः-सं) Cotton. 	 f. (-सी) The cotton tree; also कार्पासी.  E. कृ to do, &c. पास Unadi aff.
9364: कर्पूर mn. (-रः-रं) Camphor.  E. कृप् to be able, ऊर Unadi aff.
9365: कर्पूरक m. (-कः) Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet, Rox.) See कर्पूरक and कर्चूरक.

9367: कर्पूरतैल n. (-लं) Camphor-liniment.  E. कर्पूर, and तैल oil.
9368: कर्पूरनालिका f. (-का) Rice dressed with spices, camphor and ghee.
9369: कर्पूरमणि m. (-णिः) A white mineral used medicinally.  E. कर्पूर, and मणि a gem.
9371: कर्ब r. 1st cl. (कर्बति) To go, to move or approach.
9373: कर्बुदार m. (-रः) 	 1. Mountain ebony: see कोबिदार. 	 2. Blue barleria: see नीलझिण्टी.
9374: कर्बुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Variegated, of a spotted or variegated colour. 	 f. (-रा) 	 1. Trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) 	 2. A sort of basil, (Ocymum gratissimum:) see वर्वरी. 	 f. (-री) A name of the goddess DURGA. 	 n. (-रं) 	 1. Gold. 	 2. Water. 	 3. Datura, (the fruit.) m. (-रः) 	 1. A demon, an imp or goblin. 	 2. A variegated colour. 	 3. E. कब to tinge or dye, उरच् Unadi affix and र inserted, or कर्ब to go, &c. and उरन् affix, also long कर्बूर; it is also often read with the dental व, but perhaps erroneously.
9375: कर्बूर mn. (-रः-रं) Gold. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A species of curcuma, (C. reclinata, Rox.) 	 2. Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet.) 	 3. A demon. 	 f. (-रा) A leech. 	 n. (-रं) Yellow orpiment. See कर्बुर and कर्बूरक.
9376: कर्बूरक m. (-कः) Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet, Rox.)  E. कन् added to the preceding: also कर्चूरक.
9377: कर्बूरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Variegated, many coloured.  E. कर्बूर, and इतच् aff.
9378: कर्म्म mn. (-र्म्मः-र्म्मं) Act, action; see कर्म्मन्.
9379: कर्म्मकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 	 1. A hired laborer. 	 2. A servant of any kind, (as a pupil, &c.) not a slave. 	 3. An agent, any one who does work or business. 	 m. (-रः) A name of YAMA, regent of the dead. 	 f. (-री) 	 1. A plant, (Aletris hyacinthoides.) See मूर्ब्बा. 	 2. Bryonia grandis: see निम्बिका. 	 3. A female servant or slave.  E. कर्म्म work, act, and कर who does or performs; also कर्म्मकार.
9380: कर्म्मकार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 	 1. A worker, one who does any business, an artisan, a mechanic. 	 2. One who performs any act. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A blacksmith, one of the progeny of the divine artist VISWAKARMA. 2. A bull.  E. कर्म्म an act, कृञ् to perform, affix अण्.
9381: कर्म्मकारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) One who does any work, one who performs any act.  E. कर्म्म, and कारक who does.
9382: कर्म्मकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Working, doing any work, who performs any act.  E. कर्म्म, and कारिन् who does.
9383: कर्म्मकार्म्मुक m. (-कः) A strong bow.  E. कर्म्म used to action, कार्म्मुक a bow.
9385: कर्म्मकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) 	 1. Having done work. 	 2. A workman, an artisan. E. कर्म्म, and कृत् who does.
9386: कर्म्मकृतवत् m. (-वान्) The director of a religious rite, the reciter of the Mantras or formula.  E. कर्म्म, and कृतवत् doing.
9387: कर्म्मक्षम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Competent to an act.  E. कर्म्म, and क्षम to be patient, अच् aff.
9388: कर्म्मचेष्टा f. (-ष्टा) Active exertion, action.  E. कर्म्म, and चेष्टा effort.
9389: कर्म्मचोदना f. (-ना) The object of acts, the inducement to ritual acts, or the combination of knowledge, the thing to be known, and the person who acquires knowledge.  E. कर्म्म, and चोदना impelling.
9390: कर्म्मज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Resulting from or produced by any act, especi-ally religious or moral, or unrighteous or immoral actions. 	 m. (-जः) The Kali-yug or fourth and present age of the world, the age of iniquity. 	 2. The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.)  E. कर्म्म, and ज produced.
9391: कर्म्मजगुण m. (-णः) A predicate or property resulting from human acts, as separation, reunion, &c.  E. कर्म्मज, and गुण quality.
9392: कर्म्मज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) 	 1. Skilled in any work. 	 2. Acquainted with reli-gious rites.  E. कर्म्म, and ज्ञ who knows.
9393: कर्म्मठ mfn. (-ठः-ठा-ठं) 	 1. Finishing carefully. 	 2. Accomplishing any rite. 	 m. (-ठः) The director and performer of a sacrifice.  E. कर्म्म, and ठच् aff.
9394: कर्म्मणिवाच्य m. (-च्यः) The passive voice, (in grammar.)  E. कर्म्मणि in the act or object, and वाच्य to be said.
9395: कर्म्मण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) Proper to any act, suitable to or fit for it. 	 f. (-ण्या) Wages, hire. 	 n. (-ण्यं) Energy, activity.  E. कर्म्मन्, and यत् aff.
9396: कर्म्मण्यभुज् mfn. (-भुक्) Working for hire.  E. कर्म्मण्य wages, and भुज् to eat, affix क्विप्ः see भरण्यभुज्.
9397: कर्म्मत्याग m. (-गः) Abandonment of worldly duties or ceremonial rites. E. कर्म्म, and त्याग abandonment.
9398: कर्म्मत्व n. (-त्वं) 	 1. Act, action, the active discharge of the duties and functions of life. 	 2. Any act.  E. कर्म्म, and त्व affix; also with तल्, कर्म्मता.
9399: कर्म्मदुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्ट) Following wicked or degrading practices immoral, disreputable.  E. कर्म्म, and दुष्ट defiled.
9400: कर्म्मदोष m. (-षः) 	 1. Error, blunder. 	 2. Sin, vice. 	 3. The evil consequence of human acts. 	 4. Discreditable conduct or business.  E. कर्म्म, and दोष fault.
9401: कर्म्मध्वंस m. (-सः) 	 1. Loss of benefits arising from religious acts. 	 2. De-struction of any work. 	 3. Disappointment.  E. कर्म्म, and ध्वंस loss.
9402: कर्म्मन् mn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्म) 	 1. Action in general. 	 2. The object of an action. 3. The subject of action in grammar, considered of three kinds, प्राप्य or व्याप्य when it is simple, as ग्रामं गच्छति he goes to the village; सूर्य्यं पश्यति he sees the sun; विकार्य्य when change of form is implied, as सुवर्णं कुण्डलं करोति gold forms the ear-ring; and निर्वर्त्य when some new product is evolved, as कटं करोति he makes a mat; पुत्रं प्रसूते she bears a son. 	 4. The objective noun. 	 5. Action specific, moral duty, the obligation imposed by peculiarities of tribe, occupation, &c. 	 6. Natural, active property, as maturity, of heat; support, of earth; dispersion, of wind, &c. 	 7. Religious action, as sacrifice, ablution, &c. especially as originating in the hope of future recompense, and as opposed to speculative religion or knowledge of spirit. 	 8. (In Logic.) Substantial action or motion of five kinds, upwards, downwards, extension, contraction, and going in general. 	 9. Action or act involving retribution or reward, virtue, vice, &c. 	 10. Fate, the certain consequence of previous acts.  E. कृञ् to do, मनिन् aff.
9403: कर्म्मनिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Engaged in active duties. 	 m. (-ष्ठः) A Brahman who performs sacrifices, &c.  E. कर्म्म, and निष्ठ who stays in.
9404: कर्म्मन्दिन् m. (-न्दी) The beggar, the religious mendicant, the member of the fourth order; see आश्रम, &c.  E. कर्म्म work, अन्द to abandon, or कर्म्मन्द the name of a saint, the founder of the sect, and इनि aff.
9405: कर्म्मफल n. (-लं) 	 1. Pain, pleasure, &c. considered as the consequence or fruit of human actions. 	 2. The name of a fruit; see कर्म्मरङ्ग.  E. कर्म्म, and फल fruit.
9406: कर्म्मफलोदय m. (-यः) The occurrence of consequences.  E. कर्म्मफल, and उदय rising.
9407: कर्म्मबन्धन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Bound by acts. 	 n. (-नं) Confinement to repeated existence, as the consequence of acts.  E. कर्म्म, and बन्धन binding.
9408: कर्म्मभू f. (-भूः) Tilled or cultivated ground.  E. कर्म्म, and भू earth, ground, &c. it may also mean the same as the next word.
9409: कर्म्मभूमि f. (-मिः) Aryavarta or the central part of India, Bharata Varsha, the hole of India, or any similar place considered as holy land.  E. कर्म्म, and भूमि earth: where men perform the ceremonies of the Hindu faith.
9410: कर्म्मभूल n. (-लं) Kusa or sacrificial grass, see कुश.  E. कर्म्म, and भूल a root: it being used in many religious and essential Karmas or sacred rites.
9411: कर्म्मयुग m. (-गः) The fourth and present age of the world, the iron age, the Kali-yug: see कलि, and above, कर्म्मज.  E. कर्म्म, and युग a Yuga or age.

9413: कर्म्मरङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) A plant bearing an acid fruit, (Averrhoa carambola.)
9414: कर्म्मरी f. (-री) The manna of the bamboo.
9415: कर्म्मवज्र m. (-ज्रः) A Sudra.  E. कर्म्म, and वज्र the thunderbolt.
9416: कर्म्मवश m. (-शः) 	 1. The necessary influence of acts. 	 2. Fate, considered as the inevitable consequence of actions done in a former life. E. कर्म्म, and वश subjection.

9418: कर्म्मविघ्न m. (-घ्नः) 	 1. Impediment, obstruction.  E. कर्म्म, and विघ्न hindrance.
9419: कर्म्मविधि f. (-धिः) 	 1. Rule of action, observance, practice. 	 2. Mode of conducting any ceremony.  E. कर्म्म, and विधि precept; also कर्म्मविधान.
9420: कर्म्मविपर्य्यय m. (-यः) 	 1. Succession of office or employment, revolving or alternating duty. 	 2. Contrariety or reverse of any act or business. E. कर्म्म, and विपर्य्यय contrariety.
9421: कर्म्मविपाक m. (-कः) 	 1. Future reward or punishment, the consequence of human acts in a subsequent birth. 	 2. 9422: कर्म्मविशेष m. (-षः) Variety of act or actions.  E. कर्म्म, and विशेष difference.
9423: कर्म्मशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Assiduous, laborious. 	 2. One who perseveres in his duties without looking forward to their reward.  E. कर्म्म, and शील attached.
9424: कर्म्मशुद्ध n. (-द्धं) Approved occupation.  E. कर्म्म, and शुद्ध pure, correct.
9425: कर्म्मशूर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Assiduous, laborious.  E. कर्म्म, and शूर dexterous, able.
9426: कर्म्मशौच n. (-चं) Humility.  E. कर्म्म, and शौच purity.
9427: कर्म्मसंग्रह m. (-हः) Collective acts, comprising the act, its performance, and the performer.  E. कर्म्म, and संग्रह assemblage.
9428: कर्म्मसचिव m. (-वः) A minister, a subordinate one employed upon active duties, as a judge, a deputy, &c.  E. कर्म्म, and सचिव an adviser, a friend.
9429: कर्म्मसन्न्यासिक m. (-कः) An ascetic, a religious person who has withdrawn from the world.  E. कर्म्म, and सन्न्यासिक a Sannyasi or religious men-dicant.

9431: कर्म्मसम्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced by, or the consequence of acts. E. कर्म्म, and सम्भव born.
9432: कर्म्मसाक्षिन् m. (-क्षी) The sun  E. कर्म, and साक्षिन् an evidence; who beholds all deeds.
9433: कर्म्मसाधन n. (-नं) 	 1. Implement, means. 	 2. Articles essential to the performance of a religious act.  E. कर्म्म, and साधन means of effecting.

9435: कर्म्महेतु mfn. (-तुः-तुः-तु) Arising from acts, caused by acts.  E. कर्म्म, and हेतु cause; also with कन् added कर्म्महेतुक.
9436: कर्म्माङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. Part or progress of any act. 	 2. Part of a sacrificial rite.  E. कर्म्म, and अङ्ग member.
9437: कर्म्मात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Endowed with principles of action, active, acting.  E. कर्म्म, and आत्मन् self.
9438: कर्म्मानुबन्ध m. (-न्धः) Connexion with or dependance upon acts.  E. कर्म्म, and अनुबन्ध attachment.
9439: कर्म्मानुबन्धिन् mfn. (-न्धी-न्धिनी-न्धि) Connected or confined by works.  E. कर्म्म, and अनुबन्धिन् what connects.
9440: कर्म्मानुरूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) 	 1. According to action or act. 	 2. According to function or duty.  E. कर्म्म, and अनुरूप according to.

9442: कर्म्मानुष्ठान n. (-नं) Practising one's duties discharging peculiar func-tions.  E. कर्म्म, and अनुष्ठान following.
9443: कर्म्मानुसार m. (-रः) Consequence of or conformity to acts.  E. कर्म्म, and अनुसार consequence.
9444: कर्म्मानुसारतस् ind. According to one's deeds.  E. कर्म्म, and अनुसार com-formity, तसि aff.
9445: कर्म्मानुस्थायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Practising duties, performing rites, &c. E. कर्म्म, and अनुस्थायिन् following.
9446: कर्म्मान्त m. (-न्तः) 	 1. Tilled or cultivated land. 	 2. The end or abandon-ment of ritual acts. 	 3. The end of any task or act.  E. कर्म्म, and अन्त an end or limit.
9447: कर्म्मान्तर n. (-रं) Difference or contrariety of action, re-action. 	 2. Penance, expiation. 	 3. Suspense, interval of action.  E. कर्म्म, and अन्तर differ-ence, &c.
9448: कर्म्मान्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Final, completing. 	 m. (-कः) A servant, one who finishes work.  E. कर्म्मान्त. and ठक् aff.
9449: कर्म्माभिधायक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Enjoining, or prescribing duties or acts. E. कर्म्म, and अभिधायक what shows: also कर्म्माभिधायिन्.
9450: कर्म्मार m. (-रः) 	 1. An artificer, a mechanic, a blacksmith, a brazier, a carpenter, &c. 	 2. A bamboo. 	 3. An acid fruit: see कर्म्मरङ्ग.  E. कर्म्म, ऋ to go. घञ् aff.
9451: कर्म्मारम्भ m. (-म्भः) Commencement of any act.  E. कर्म्म, and आरम्भ beginning.
9452: कर्म्मार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) 	 1. Fit for work, able to do anything. 	 2. Suitable to any rite, &c. 	 m. (-र्हः) A man.  E. कर्म्म, and अर्ह fit for.
9453: कर्म्मिन् mfn. (-र्म्मी-र्म्मिणी-र्म्मि) 	 1. Busy, active, engaged in any work. 	 2. Belonging or relating to any act.  E. कर्म्म, and इनि aff.
9454: कर्म्मिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Active, assiduous, diligent.  E. कर्म्म, and इष्ठन् aff.
9456: कर्म्मीरक m. (-कः) A small tree, (Trophis aspera.)
9457: कर्म्मेन्द्रिय n. (-यं) An organ of action; five are reckoned, the hand, the foot, the larynx or organ of the voice, the organ of generation, and that of fœculent excretion.  E. कर्म्म, and इन्द्रिय an organ of sense.
9458: कर्म्मोदार n. (-रं) Any honourable or valiant act, magnanimity, prowess. E. कर्म्म, and उदार lofty.
9459: कर्म्मोद्युक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Actively labouring, busily engaged.  E. कर्म्म, and उद्युक्त exerting.
9460: कर्म्मोद्योग m. (-गः) Engaging actively in any work.  E. कर्म्म, and उद्योग effort.
9461: कर्व r. 1st cl. (कर्वति) To be proud, to boast.
9462: कर्व्व m. (-र्व्वः) 	 1. Love, desire. 	 2. A rat.  E. कृ to injure, and व Unadi aff.
9463: कर्व्वट mn. (-टः-टं) 	 1. The capital of a district, (of two or four hundred villages,) in a pleasant site and of handsome construction, a market town, &c. 	 n. (-टं) A city.  E. कर्व्व to be proud, and अटच् aff.
9464: कर्व्वर m. (-रः) 	 1. A demon or imp. 	 2. A tiger. 	 f. (-री) 	 1. A name of DURGA. 	 2. The leaf of the asafœtida plant: see हिङ्गुपत्री.  E. कृ to in-jure, क्वरच् Unadi affix; if derived from कर्ब्ब to go, &c. this word is read कर्ब्बर, but such a reading is probably inaccurate: see कर्ब्बर, also कर्ब्बुर; it is sometimes considered as a various reading of this last, meaning, variegated.
9465: कर्ष mn. (-र्षः-र्षं) A weight of gold or silver, a Karsha equal to sixteen Mashas; this, according to the ancient division of five Rettis to the Masha, would make the Karsha equal to about 176 grains troy; in common use, eight Rettis are given to the Masha and the Karsha is therefore about 280 grains troy: see मास and रक्तिक. 	 m. (-षः) 	 1. Drawing, dragging, pulling. 	 2. Ploughing. 	 3. Attracting. 	 4. Beleric myrobalan: see विभीतक.  E. कृष् to plough, अच् aff.
9466: कर्षक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. A cultivator of the soil, one who lives by til-lage. 	 2. What draws or drags. 	 3. Attractive, what attracts.  E. कृष् to plough, बुन् aff.
9467: कर्षण n. (-णं) 	 1. Ploughing, cultivating the ground. 	 2. Pulling, drag-ging. 	 3. Attracting.  E. कृष् to plough, ल्युट् aff.
9468: कर्षणि f. (-णिः) A dishonest woman.  E. कृष्, and अनि aff.
9469: कर्षणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. To be drawn or pulled. 	 2. To be attracted, to be conciliated or won.  E. कृष् to plough, with अनीयर् aff.
9470: कर्षफल m. (-लः) Beleric myrobalan, (Terminalia belerica.)  E. कर्ष the same, and फल fruit.
9471: कर्षयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 	 1. Dragging, pulling. 	 2. Attracting. 	 3. Haras-sing, annoying.  E. कृष् to attract, causal form, शतृ aff.
9472: कर्षाह्व n. (-ह्वं) A Tola, a weight of sixteen Mashas.  E. कर्ष, and आह्वा appellation.
9473: कर्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Drawn. 	 2. Attracted. 	 3. Ploughed.  E. कृष् to draw, क्त aff.
9474: कर्षिन् mfn. (-र्षी-र्षिणी-र्षि) 	 1. What pulls or draws. 	 2. What ploughs or furrows. 	 3. Attractive, what attracts. 	 f. (-र्षिणी) 	 1. A medicinal sort of moon-plant: see क्षीरिणी. 	 2. The bit of a bridle.  E. कृष् to plough, &c. णिनि aff.
9475: कर्षू m. (-र्षूः) 	 1. A fire of dried cowdung. 	 2. Agriculture, cultivating, cultivation. 	 3. Livelihood. 	 f. (-र्षूः) 	 1. A river. 	 2. A canal. 	 3. A shallow trench for receiving the sacrificial fire.  E. कृष् to plough, &c. Unadi affix ऊ.
9476: कर्हि ind. When, at what time.

9478: कल r. 1st cl. (कलति) To sound. 1st and 10th cls. (कलति, कालयति) To throw or cast, to send; also 1st and 10th cls. (कलति, कलयति) 	 1. To go. 	 2. To count or reckon: with आङ् prefixed, 1. To take, 2. To bind or tie; with परि, To keep in mind, to think or remember; with वि, To maim, to separate a part, to make defective; with सम्, To sum up, to add.
9479: कल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Crude, undigested. 	 2. Weak. 	 m. (-लः) 	 1. A low or soft tone, as humming, buzzing, &c. 	 2. The Sal tree. 	 3. In poetry, time equal to four matras or instants. 	 n. (-लं) 	 1. Semen virile. 	 2. The jujube, Zizyphus jujuba.) 	 f. (-ला) 	 1. A small part of anything. 2. A digit or one sixteenth of the moon's diameter. 	 3. A division of time, equal to thirty Kashhas or about eight seconds. 	 4. The 60th part of one thirtieth of a zodiacal sign, a minute of a degree. 5. Interest on a capital. 	 6. Any practical art, mechanical or fine, sixty-four such are enumerated, as carpentering, architecture, jewel-lery, farriery, acting, dancing, music, medicine, poetry, &c. 	 7. The menstrual discharge. 	 8. A boat 9. Fraud, deceit.  E. कल् to sound, to count, &c. अच् affix or क pleasure, and ल what gives, from ला to bring, &c.
9480: कलक m. (-कः) 	 1. A kind of fish: see शकुल. 	 2. Name of species of prose composition.  E. कल् to count, &c. वुन् aff.

9743: काकतुण्डिका f. (-का) The Gunja-plant: see काकचिञ्चा.
9744: काकध्वज m. (-जः) Submarine fire, a personage in Hindu mythology: see और्व्व.  E. काक, and ध्वज a banner, whose symbol is a crow.
9745: काकनाशा f. (-शा) A plant, commonly Vakapushpa: see वकपुष्प.

9749: काकपक्ष m. 9756: काकमद्गु m. (-द्गुः) A water-hen, gallinule.  E. काक, and मद्गु another kind of bird, a Shag; resembling a crow in colour.

9763: काकरुहा f. (-हा) A parasite plant, (Epidendrum tesseloides, &c.) see वन्दा.  E. काक, and रुह what mounts; on which crows rest.

9768: काकशब्द m. (-ब्दः) The cawing of a crow.  E. काक, and शब्द sound.

9771: काकाङ्गा f. (-ङ्गा) A plant, (Leea æquata.)  E. काक, and अङ्ग form, body, टाप् affix; or with ङीष् affix, काकाङ्गी.
9773: काकाञ्ची f. (-ञ्ची) 	 1. A plant, (Leea æquata.) 	 2. An esculent vegetable, (Solanum Indicum.)  E. काक, अञ्च् to go, अच् and ङीप् affs.

9775: काकार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Scattering water.  E. क water, कॄ to scatter; with आङ् prefixed, and अण् aff.
9776: काकारि m. (-रिः) An owl.  E. काक, and अरि a foe; whose enemy is the crow.

9782: काकुत्स्थ m. (-त्स्थः) 	 1. A name of RAMA. 	 2. The name of a sovereing, also Puranjaya.  E. ककुद् pre-eminent, अण् affix, and स्थ who stays or is.
9783: काकुद m. (-दः) The palate.  E. ककुद् the head, and अण् aff.

9785: काकेन्दु m. (-न्दुः) A species of ebony, (Diospyros melanoxylon.)

9856: काण्डपृष्ट mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Of the military profession, a soldier. 	 m. (-ष्ठः) 1. The husband of a Vaisya female. 	 2. An adopted or any other than the natural son. 	 n. (-ष्ठं) The bow of KAMA.  E. काण्ड an arrow, and पृष्ठ the back: see काण्डस्पृष्ट.
9857: काण्डभग्न n. (-ग्नं) A fracture of either of the extremities.  E. काण्ड, and भग्न breaking.
9858: काण्डरुहा f. (-हा) A medicinal plant: see कटुकी.  E. काण्ड the stem of a tree, and रुहा what ascends; hence it appears to be a creeper.
9859: काण्डर्षि m. (-र्षिः) Rishi or divine saint of a peculiar class; Jaimini and others who teach a particular Kanda or section of Vedas.  E. काण्ड a section, and ऋषि a saint.
9860: काण्डवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Armed with an arrow, an archer.  E. काण्ड an arrow, and मतुप् poss. aff.
9861: काण्डसन्धि m. (-न्धिः) A knot, a joint in the stem of a tree, &c.  E. काण्ड a stem, and सन्धि union.

9864: काण्डीर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Armed with an arrow, an archer. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A creeping plant, commonly Kanda Bel, (Momordica charantia.) 	 2. A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.) 	 f. (-रा) Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith:) see मञ्जिष्ठा.  E. काण्ड an arrow, a stem, &c. and ईरच् aff.
9865: काण्डेक्षु m. (-क्षुः) 	 1. A plant, (Barleria longifolia.) 	 2. A kind of reed, (Saccharum spontaneum:) see काश.  E. काण्ड, and इक्षु sugar-cane; having a similar stem.
9866: कातर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Confused, perplexed, disordered. 	 2. Timid, gentle. 	 m. (-रः) A large kind of fish, commonly Katala (Cyprinus catla, HAM.)  E. का a little or badly, and तर what crosses.
9867: कातरता f. (-ता) Timidity, agitation.  E. तल् added to कातर; also with त्व, कातरत्वं.
9868: कातल m. (-लः) The name of a fish, commonly Katala, (Cyprinus catla, HAM.) E. See कातर, र changed to ल.
9869: कातीय m. (-यः) 	 1. A name of KATYAYANA. 	 2. A pupil of the same. E. कात्यायन with फक् affix and the middle syllable dropped; also कात्या-यनीय.
9870: कात्त्रयक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Produced from any bad triad.  E. कत्त्रय, and ढकञ् aff.
9871: कात्य m. (-त्यः) The name of a saint; also कात्यायन.  E. कत a proper name, and यञ् affix implying descent or lineage.
9872: कात्यायन m. (-नः) 	 1. The name of a celebrated lawgiver and divine sage. 	 2. An appellation of VARARUCHI a poet.  E. कात्य, and फक् pleonastic affix. 	 f. (-नी) 	 1. A name of DURGA. 	 2. 9873: कात्यायनीय m. (-यः) A pupil of KATYAYANA.  E. कात्यायन, and फक् aff.
9874: काथिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging to a story, told in it, &c. 	 m. (-कः) A narrator.  E. कथा, and ठक् aff.
9875: कादम्ब n. (-म्बं) 	 1. A tree, (Nauclea cadamba.) 	 2. A drake, or, accord-ing to some, a teal. 	 3. An arrow. 	 f. (-म्बा) A plant, commonly Mundiri: see कदम्बपुष्प.  E. अण् added to कदम्ब.
9876: कादम्बक m. (-कः) An arrow.  E. कन् added to the preceding.
9877: कादम्बर n. (-रं) The surface or skim of coagulated milk. 	 m. (-रः) A spirituous liquor distilled from the flowers of the Kadamba. 	 f. (-री) 	 1. Wine, spirituous liquor in general. 	 2. 9878: कादम्बरीवीज n. (-जं) Ferment, yeast, whatever occasions fermentation. E. कादम्बरी, and वीज seed.
9879: कादम्बर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) The Kadamba tree: see कादम्ब.  E. कादम्बरी a spirit, and यत् aff.
9880: कादम्बिनी f. (-नी) A long line of clouds.  E. कादम्ब the Kadamba flower, इनि and ङीप् affixes, implying a multitude; the clouds being com pared with the large white flowers of the Nauclea cadamba.
9881: कादाचित्क mfn. (-त्कः-त्की-त्कं) Produced sometimes, occasional, inciden-tal.  E. कदाचित् sometimes, with कन् added, and अण् aff.
9882: काद्रवेय m. (-यः) A Naga or serpent of the race that is supposed to people the lower regions.  E. कद्रु the mother of these beings, and ढक् aff.
9883: कानक n. (-कं) The seed of the croton.
9884: कानन nf. (-नं-नी) 	 1. A forest, a grove. 	 2. The face of BRAHMA. 	 3. A house.  E. कनि to shine, in the causal form, and ल्युट् affix, or क BRAHMA, and आनन a face.
9885: काननारि m. (-रिः) The Śami or Śain tree, (Mimosa albida:) see समी. E. कानन, and अरि enemy; injurious to a wood; being a thorny tree.
9886: कानीन mf. (-नः-नी) The son or daughter of a young and unmarried woman. 	 m. (-नः) 	 1. A name of VYASA. 	 2. Also of KARNA, (being both horn of mothers who were unmarried.)  E. कन्या a virgin or young girl, changed to कनीन् and अण् aff.
9887: कान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 	 1. Pleasing, agreeable. 	 2. Lovely, beautiful. 3. Dear, beloved. 	 m. (-न्तः) 	 1. A name of KRISHNA. 	 2. The moon. 3. A husband. 	 4. Spring. 	 5. A precious stone; in which case it is compounded with सूर्य्य, चन्द्र or अयस्, as सूर्य्यकान्त a crystal lens, &c. f. (-न्ता) 	 1. A wife, a mistress, any beloved or lovely woman. 2. A plant, commonly Priyangu: see प्रियङ्गु. 	 3. A grass, (Cyperus pertenuis.) 	 n. (-न्तं) 	 1. Iron. 	 2. Saffron.  E. कम् to desire, affix क्त.
9888: कान्तता f. (-ता) Loveliness, beauty, splendor.  E. कान्त pleasing, &c. तल् aff.
9889: कान्तपक्षिन् m. (-क्षी) A peacock.  E. कान्त beautiful, पक्षिन् a bird.
9890: कान्तपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) Mountain ebony, &c. (Bauhinia variegata.)  E. कान्त and पुष्प flower.
9891: कान्तलक m. (-कः) A tree, the wood of which something resembles mahogany, commonly Toon, (Cedrela tunna, Rox.)  E. कान्त beauty, and र what gives, कन् added, and र changed to ल.
9892: कान्ताङ्घ्रिदोहद m. (-दः) A tree, commonly Asoka, (Jonesia asoca.) E. कान्ता a woman, अङ्घ्रि a foot, and दोहद desire; the tree being supposed to blossom upon coming in contact with the foot of a handsome female.
9893: कान्ताचरणदोहद m. (-दः) The tree Asoka: see the preceding.
9894: कान्तायस n. (-सं) Iron-stone: see अयस्कान्त.  E. कान्त, and अयस् iron, अण् added.
9895: कान्तार mn. (-रः-रं) 	 1. A had or difficult road. 	 2. A wood, a forest. 	 3. A hole, a cavity. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A red variety of the sugar-cane. 2. A bamboo. 	 3. Mountain ebony. 	 n. (-रं) 	 1. A symptom or sympto-matic disease. 	 2. A lotus. 	 f. (-री) A sort of sugar-cane.  E. कान् for कञ्चित् any one, here meaning no one, तृ to go, in the causal, form, अच् affix; allowing none to pass; or क pleasure, &c. अन्त end, ऋ to go, अण् aff.
9896: कान्तारक m. (-कः) A sort of sugar-cane.  E. कान्त good, excellent (juice,) ऋ to go, to gain, अण् and कन् affixes: see the preceding.
9897: कान्तारग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Who or what goes into or in a wood.  E. कान्तार, and ग who goes.
9898: कान्ति f. (-न्तिः) 	 1. Beauty, splendor, light. 	 2. Female beauty. 	 3. Wish, desire. 	 4. A lovely or desirable woman. 	 5. Persoual decoration or embellishment.  E. कम् to desire or be desired, क्तिन् aff.
9899: कान्तिकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Beautifying, illumining, making handsome or splendid.  E. कान्ति, and कर what makes.
9900: कान्तिद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Beautifying, illuminating. 	 n. (-दं) Bile, the bilious humour.  E. कान्ति light, splendor, &c. and द what gives.

9902: कान्तिभृत् mfn. (-भृत्) 	 1. Handsome, beautiful. 	 2. Bright, shining. E. कान्ति, and भृत् what has.
9903: कान्तिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 	 1. Splendid. 	 2. Beautiful.  E. कान्ति, and मतुप् aff.
9904: कान्तिहर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Dimming, dulling, making dull or ugly. E. कान्ति, and हर what removes.
9905: कान्दव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Roasted or baked, (in an iron pan or oven, as bread, cakes, &c.)  E. कन्दु, and अण् aff.
9906: कान्दविक m. (-कः) A baker.  E. कान्दव baked bread, and ठक् aff.
9907: कान्दिशीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Flying, running away, put to flight.  E. कदि to fear, घञ् and इन् affixed, कन्दि; शीक् to go, to ooze. घञ् affix, कन्दिशीक; and again, अण् affix, कान्दिशीक.
9908: कान्यकुब्ज m. (-ब्जः) A country, the modern Konouj; also कन्याकुब्ज.
9909: कान्यजा f. (-जा) A kind of perfume, commonly Nali.
9910: कापटिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Wicked, bad, perverse. 	 2. Fraudulent, dis-honest. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. A student, a scholar. 	 2. A flatterer, a para-site.  E. कपट fraud, &c. ठक् aff.
9911: कापट्य n. (-ट्यं) Wickedness, fraud, dishonesty.  E. कपट, and ष्यञ् aff.
9912: कापथ m. (-थः) A bad road.  E. का for कु bad, vile, and पथिन् a road.

9914: कापालिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating or belonging to the skull. 	 m. (-कः) A worshipper of SIVA of the left-hand order, characterised by carrying a half of the skull as a cup, drinking spirituous liquors, &c.  E. कपाल, and ठञ् aff.
9915: कापिल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Of a tawny colour. 	 m. (-लः) 	 1. A follower of the Sankhya system of philosophy.  E. कपिल the founder of the school, and अण् affix. 	 2. Tawny, (the colour.)  E. अण् pleonastic added to कपिल, q. v.
9916: कापिश n. (-शं) A spirituous liquor, wine. 	 f. (-शी) A country.  E. कपिश brown, and अण् aff.
9917: कापिशायन m. (-नः) 	 1. A deity. 	 2. A kind of vinous liquor. 	 n. (-नं) Honey. 	 f. (-नी) A grape.  E. कपिश brown, or कापिशी a country, and ष्फक् aff.
9918: कापिशेय m. (-यः) A Pisacha, an imp or goblin.  E. कपिश, and ढक् aff.
9919: कापुरुष m. (-षः) A mean contemptible man, a coward, a wretch.  E. का for कु bad, vile, पुरुष a man.

9921: कापेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Belonging to or relating to a monkey.  E. कपि a monkey, and ढक् aff.
9922: कापोत mfn. (-तः-ती-तं) Of a dirty white colour. 	 m. (-तः) 	 1. Natron, fossile alkali. 	 2. Antimony. considered as a collyrium or applica-tion to the eyes. 	 3. A pale or dirty white colour. 	 n. (-तं) A flock of pigeons,  E. कपोत a pigeon, &c. अण् aff.

9926: काफल m. (-लः) A bitter seed; see कट्फल.  E. का bad, and फल fruit.

Following one's own desire, as कामवाद speaking what one lists; कामभक्ष eating whatever one likes; कामचार doing whatever one chuses; in law, a child previous to the imposi-tion of the characteristic cord is all these. 9929: कामकामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Following the dictates of passion of desire.  E. काम, and कामिन् desirous.

9934: कामग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Acting as one pleases.  E. काम, and ग who goes.
9935: कामगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Going as one lists.  E. काम the wish, and गामिन् who goes.
9936: कामगुण m. (-णः) 	 1. Passion, affection. 	 2. An object of sense. 	 3. Com-pletion, satiety, perfect enjoyment.  E. काम desire, and गुण a quality or property.

9942: कामजान m. (-नः) The Kokila or Indian cuckoo.  E. काम, and जान what produces, from जन् in the causal form, and घञ् affix; also read कामजनि.

10323: काश्मीरज n. (-जं) 	 1. A costus. 	 2. Saffron: see कश्मीर. 	 f. (-जः) Atis or Betula: see अतिविषा  E. काश्मीर and ज born; produced in Kashmir.

10327: काश्यपेय m. (-यः) The sun.  E. कश्यप the saint, and ढक् affix of decent, the son of KASYAPA.
10328: काश्वरी f. (-री) A plant: see काश्मरी.
10329: काषाय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Red, dyed of a reddish colour.  E. कषाय and अण् aff.

E. काश् to shine, Unadi affix क्थन् changed to ष, and थ after ष becomes ठ.

10335: काष्टकुद्दाल m. (-लः) A kind of wooden shovel or scraper used for baling water out of a boat. or for scraping and cleaning its bottom, &c. E. काष्ठ wood, and कुद्दाल shovel; also with the first vowel long कूद्दाल, काष्ठकूद्दाल.
10336: काष्ठखण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A stick, a spar, a piece of wood.  E. काष्ठ and खण्ड piece.
10337: काष्ठतक्ष् m. (-ट्) A carpenter.  E. काष्ठ wood, and तक्ष् to cut or pare, affix क्विप्.
10338: काष्ठाक्षक m. (-कः) A carpenter: see the preceding. E. As before वुन् aff.
10339: काष्ठतन्तु m. (-न्तुः) A small worm that is found in timber.  E. काष्ठ wood, and तन्तु what spreads, from तन् with तुन् aff.
10340: काष्ठदारु m. (-रुः) The Deodar tree, (Uvaria longifolia.)
10341: काष्ठद्रु m. (-द्रुः) A tree, (Butea frondosa.)  E. काष्ठ, and द्रु a tree.
10342: काष्ठमठी f. (-ठी) A funeral pile.  E. काष्ठ wood, and मठी a pile, an edifice.
10343: काष्ठमय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Wooden, made of wood.  E. काष्ठ and मयट् aff.
10344: काष्ठमल्ल m. (-ल्लः) A bier, a plank, &c. on which dead bodies are carried. E. काष्ठ wood, and मल्ल a vessel.
10345: काष्ठलेखक m. (-कः) A small worm found in wood.  E. काष्ठ and लेखक who writes or inscribes.
10346: काष्ठलौहिन् m. (-ही) A club, a short cudgel, especially if armed with iron.  E. काष्ठ, लौह iron, and इनि aff.
10347: काष्ठवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having wood for fuel, &c. ind. Like a piece of wood.  E. काष्ठ, and मतुप् or वति aff.
10348: काष्ठागार m. (-रः) A wooden house or enclosure.  E. काष्ठ and आगार a house.
10349: काष्ठाम्बुवाहिनी f. (-नी) A wooden bucket or baling vessel: see अम्बुवाहिनी.
10350: काष्ठिन् mfn. (-ष्ठी-ष्ठिनी-ष्ठि) 	 1. Of wood, wooden. 	 2. Having wood.  E. काष्ठ, and इनि aff.
10351: काष्ठीला m. (-ला) A large kind of Colotropis. 	 f. (-ला) A plantain: see रम्भा.  E. का for कु small, अस्थि bone or stalk, and ला to get or posses क and टाप् affixes; having a stem which is good for nothing.
10352: कास r. 1st cl. (ऋ) कासृ (कासते) 1. To make a bad sound, or one indi-cating disease; to cough. 	 2. To shine: see काश.
10353: कास m. (-सः) 	 1. Cough, catarrh. 	 2. A species of reed or long grass, (Saccharum spontaneum.) 	 3. Morunga, (Hyperanthera, &c.) see शीभाञ्जन.  E. कास् to cough, to make an unpleasant sound, अच् affix: also काश् to shine, &c. see काश.
10354: कासकुण्ठ mfn. (-ण्ठः-ण्ठा-ण्ठं) Afflicted with cough. 	 m. (-ण्ठः) YAMA.
10355: कासघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Removing or alleviating cough, pectoral. 	 f. (-घ्नी) A short or prickly nightshade: see कण्टकारी.  E. कास catarrh and घ्न from हन् to kill, removing cough.
10356: कासनाशिनी f. (-नी) A thorny plant: see कर्कटशृङ्गी.  E. कास catarrh, and नाशिनी removing, remedying.
10358: कासमर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) 	 1. A plant, (Cassia or Senna esculenta.) 	 2. An acid preparation, a mixture of tamarinds and mustard.  E. कास or काश cough, and मर्द्द what destroys; also काशमर्द्द.
10359: कासमर्द्दन m. (-नः) A sort of cucumber, (Trichosanthes dioeca.)
10360: कासर m. (-रः) A buffalo.  E. क water, and आङ् prefixed to सृ to go, affix अप्; who frequents water, this animal being partial to marshy places.
10361: कासार m. (-रः) A pond, a pool.  E. क water, सृ to go, आङ् prefix, and घञ् affix, or कास् to shine, आरन् Unadi aff.
10362: कासारि m. (-रिः) A plant, (Cassia esculenta:) see कासमर्द्द्र  E. कास cough, and अरि a foe.
10363: कासालु m. (-लुः) An esculent root, a sort of Yam.
10364: कासीस n. (-सं) Green vitriol, green sulphate of iron.  E. कास् to go, ईसण् aff.
10365: कासू f. (-सूः) 	 1. Indistinct speech. 	 2. Speech in general. 	 3. Understand-ing. 	 4. Devotion. 	 5. Light, lustre. 	 6. A sort of spear or lance.  E. कस् to go, to shine, or कास् to make a bad sound, क Unadi aff.
10366: कासूतरी f. (-री) A short spear, a javelin.  E. कासू, and ष्टरच् diminutive aff.
10367: काहका f. (-का) A musical instrument: see काहला.
10368: काहल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Dry, withered. 	 2. Mischievous. 	 3. Large, excessive. 	 f. (-ली) 	 1. One of the Apsaras or courtezans of INDRA'S heaven. 	 2. The sound of any tube, pipe or musical instrument. (-ला) A young woman. 	 mf. (-लः-ला) A horn, either a cow horn, or an instrument of that shape. 	 m. (-लः) 	 1. A cock. 	 2. Sound in general. 	 3. A cat. 	 n. (-लं) Indistinct speech. adv. Much, excessive-ly.  E. क pleasure, the head, &c. हल् to plough or divide, with आङ् prefixed, affix अच्.
10370: कि r. 3rd cl. (चिकेति) To know: with निर् prefixed, to attain certainly, to ascertain positively. किं See किम्.
10371: किंशारु m. (-रुः) 	 1. The beard of corn. 	 2. An arrow. 	 3. A heron.  E. किं what, or sometimes, शृ to injure, &c. रुण् Unadi aff.
10372: किंशुक m. (-कः) A tree bearing beautiful red blossoms, and hence often alluded to by the poets, (Butea frondośa;) also पलाश  E. किं what, something, शुक a parrot; its red flowers being of the colour of a parrot's beak.
10373: किंशुलुक m. (-कः) A species of the Kinsuka. see the preceding.
10374: किकि m. (-किः) A blue jay,  E. कि an imitative sound; the word being repeated; or कै to emit a sound, and कि affix; also किकीदीवि, किकी, &c.
10375: किकिदिवि m. (-विः) The blue jay.  E. किकि, an imitative sound and दिव् to play, कि affix; also in other forms किकि, किकिदिव, किकिदीवि, किकीदिवी.
10376: किकीदिव m. (-वः) See the preceding. E. As before, अच् aff.
10378: किखि m. (-खिः) A monkey, an ape. 	 f. (-खिः) A small jackal, a fox.  E. कु to sound, डिखि aff.
10379: किङ्कर mfn. (-रः-रा or -री-रं) A servant.  E. किं what or something, and कर who does.
10380: किङ्किणि f. (-णिः or -णी) 	 1. A girdle of small bells, or any tinkling orna-ment. 	 2. An acid sort of grape.  E. किं some, and किण an imitative sound, affix क, with इन् or ङीष् fem. affix; also with कन् added किङ्किणीका.

10382: किङ्किरात m. (-तः) 	 1. A name of KAMADEVA. 	 2. A parrot. 	 3. The Koil or Indian cuckoo. 	 4. A tree, (Jonesia asoka.) 	 5. A species of barleria: see झिण्टी.  E. किङ्किर as above, and अत who goes or is.

10384: किञ्च ind. 	 1. An inceptive or continuative particle, (moreover further, again.) 	 2. A particle of comprehension.  E. किं what, च and.

10387: किञ्चित् ind. 	 1. Something somewhat. 	 2. A part, a little. 	 n. किं what, चित् to think, affix क्विप्.
10389: किञ्चलुक m. (-कः) A worm.  E. किञ्चित् a little, and चल् to go, or चुल् to be high, वुन् affix, deriv. irr.; it is sometimes written किञ्चिलिक.

10394: किटि m. (-टिः) A hog.  E. किट् to go, and कि affix; also किटि.
10395: किटिभ m. (-भः) A bug.  E. किटि a hog, भ who resembles, from भा to shine, affix ड.

10397: किट्टवर्जित n. (-तं) Semen virile.  E. किट्ट dirt, &c. वर्जित deprived.
10398: किट्टाल m. (-लः) 	 1. A copper vessel. 	 2. Scoria, rust of iron, &c.  E. किट्ट dirt, अल् to be able, अच् aff.
10399: किण m. (-णः) 	 1. A wart, a mole. 	 2. A scar. 	 3. A corn, a callosity. 4. An insect found in wood.
10400: किणि f. (-णिः) A tree, (Achyranthes aspera:) see अपामार्ग.  E. किण् a scar, and कि affix; making scars; that is cicatrizing wounds, sores, &c.
10401: किणिही f. (-ही) Achyranthes aspera.  E. किणि a sore, and ह what re-moves, fem. affix ङीष्.
10402: किण्व mn. (-ण्वः-ण्वं) Ferment, a drug or seed used to produce fermenta-tion, in the manufacture of spirits from sugar, bassia, &c. 	 n. (-ण्वं) Sin.  E. कण् to sound, &c. क्वन् Unadi affix, and the इ irregularly in-serted: see कण्व.
10403: कित r. 1st cl. (चिकित्सति) 	 1. To cure, to administer remedies, to practise physic. 	 2. To remove, to destroy. 	 3. To chastise. 	 4. (Usually with वि prefixed,) To doubt; this root is regular. r. 3rd cl. (चिकेति) To know. r. 10th cl. (केतयति) 	 1. To dwell. 	 2. To desire; some authori-ties make it a regular root of the 1st cl. in these senses, and others deny its admitting of any conjugation.
10404: कितव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 	 1. A gamester, a gambler. 	 2. A cheat, cheating, fraudulent. 	 3. Mad, crazy. 	 4. Mischievous, malicious. 	 m. (-वः) 	 1. Thorn apple, (Datura metel.) 	 2. A kind of perfume, commonly Rochana.  E. किं what, तव your, (what is your stake or wager?) he who asks such a question, &c.
10405: किन्तनु m. (-नुः) An insect described as having eight legs and a very slender body, a species of spider.  E. किं for किञ्चित् a little, and तनु the body.
10406: किन्तमाम् ind. Whether, either of any.  E. किं, and तमप् with आमु added.
10407: किन्तराम् ind. Whether, either of two.  E. किं, and तरप् with आमु added.

10410: किन्धिन् m. (-न्धी) A horse: see किल्किन्.
10411: किन्नर m. (-रः) 	 1. A demigod attached to the service of KUVERA, a celestial quirister or musician. 	 2. A kind of flower or attendant on a Jina or Jaina saint. 	 f. 10412: किन्नरेश m. (-शः) A name of KUVERA.  E. किन्नर a Kinnara, and ईश master, lord; also other similar compounds, as किन्नरेश्वर.
10413: किन्नु ind. 	 1. A particle of interrogation, (what?) 	 2. Doubt, (how, what?) 3. Comparison, (thus, as, like, how much less) 	 4. Conjunction, (again, further.) 	 5. Place, location, and 6 Agency.  E. किम् and नु conjoined.
10414: किम् ind. (-किम् or किं) 	 1. What, how. 	 2. Either, or; a particle of doubt or interrogation. 	 3. A particle of contempt. The relative pronoun. mfn. 10415: किमर्थम् ind. What for, wherefore, why.  E. किम् and अर्थ object.

10418: किम्पच mfn. (-चः-चा-चं) Miserly, avaricious.  E. किम् what, (nothing,) पच who cooks.
10419: किम्पचान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Miserly, niggardly, avaricious.  E. किं what, used contemptuously, पच् to cook, and शानच् affix, or with अच् only, किम्पचः see मितम्पच, &c.

10421: किम्पुरुव m. (-षः) 	 1. A heavenly musician: see किन्नर. 	 2. 10424: किम्भरा f. (-रा) A kind of perfume, commonly Nali: see नली.
10425: किम्भूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) or n. only, (-तं) How, in what manner or degree, like what.  E. किम्, and भूत become.
10426: किंवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Poor, mean, insignificant.  E. किं a little, मतुप् possessive aff.
10427: किंवदन्ति f. (-न्तिः) Rumour, report.  E. किं what, वद् to say, and झिच् Unadi affix, or with झच् and ङीष् affixes किंवदन्ती.
10428: किंवा ind. Or, else, moreover.  E. किं what, वा or.

10430: कियदेतिका f. (-का) Effort, vigorous and persevering exertions. E. कियत् used contemptuously, and इति from इदम् this, affix ठक्; (how great a task is this, that it should not be effected, &c.) इह here, being employed in place of इति, the word is written कियदेहिका.

10433: किर m. (-रः) A hog.  E. कॄ to scatter, क affix; also किरि.
10434: किरक m. (-कः) A scribe.  E. कॄ to scatter, वुन् aff.
10435: किरण m. (-णः) 	 1. A ray of light, a sun or moon beam. 	 2. The sun. E. क to scatter, (light,) and क्यु Unadi aff.
10436: किरणमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Radiant, bright, refulgent.  E. किरण and मयट् aff.
10437: किरणमालिन् m. (-ली) The sun.  E. किरण, माला a garland, and इनि aff.
10438: किरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) 	 1. Scattering, spreading. 	 2. Lighting, shedd-ing light.  E. कॄ to scatter शतृ aff.

SIVA as a mountaineer opposed to ARJUNA, the account of which is the subject of the poem, the Kiratarjuniya. 	 3. A kind of gentian: see किराततिक्त. 	 4. A pigmy a dwarf. 	 5. 10738: कुद्मल n. (-लं) An opening bud: see कुद्मल.
10739: कुद्य n. (-द्यं) A wall: see कुड्य.

11054: कुशाङ्गुरीय n. (-यं) A ring of Kusa grass, worn at religious ceremonies. E. कुश, and अङ्गुरीय a ring; also कुशाङ्गुरीयकं.

11066: कुशीवश m. (-शः) A name of VALMIKI: see कुशिन्.
11067: कुशूल m. (-लः) A granary, a cupboard, a place in which rice or other grain is kept. 	 2. Conflagration of chaff.  E. कुश् to enfold, कुल affix; also कुसूल.

11083: कुष्ठनाशिनी f. (-नी) A plant, commonly Hakucha, (Psoralia corylifolia.) E. As above: see कुष्ठनाशन.

11085: कुष्ठसूदन m. (-नः) The cassia tree, (C. fistula.)  E. कुष्ठ and सूदन des-troying.

11088: कुष्ठारि m. (-रिः) 	 1. A fetid mimosa, (M. Farnesiana.) 	 2. The Khayar or Catechu: (M. catechu.) 	 3. A kind of Aristolochia: see अर्कपत्र. 	 4. A sort of gourd, (Trichosanthes diœca.) 	 5. Sulphur.  E. कुष्ठ the leprosy, and अरि an enemy.
11089: कुष्ठिन् mfn. (-ष्ठी-ष्ठिनी-ष्ठि) Leprous, a leper, &c.  E. कुष्ठ and इनि aff.

11118: कुसुमावचाय m. (-यः) Gathering flowers.  E. कुसुम, and अवचाय gathering.
11119: कुसुमावतंसक n. (-कं) A chaplet, a crown of flowers.  E. कुसुम, and अवतंसक a tiara.
11120: कुसुमासव n. (-वं) Honey.  E. कुसुम, and आसव spirit.
11121: कुसुमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Flowered, budded, in flower.  E. कुसुम, and इतच् aff.

11238: कृ r. 5th cl. (ञ) कृञ् (कृणोति, कृणुते) To hurt, to injure, to kill. (डु, ञ,) डुकृञ् r. 8th cl. (करोति, कुरुते) To do, to make, to perform any kind of action: this root admits most of the prepositions and a variety of significations; it is also active or deponent, according to its pre-fix and import; as, 1. With अति, (अतिकुरुते) To exceed, to do more. 2. With अधि, (अधिकुरुते) a. To surpass or overcome. b. To superint-end, to govern. c. To hold of right. d. To bear patiently. e. To re-frain from. 	 3. With अनु (अनुकरोति) To copy, to imitate, to act like or after. 	 4. With अप (अपकुरुते) a. To wrong, to injure. b. To do evil. 5. With आङ् (आकुरुते) a. To call. b. To take shape or form. 	 6. With उत् (उत्कुरुते) a. To kill or hurt dangerously. b. To collect, to assem-ble. 	 7. With उद्, and आङ् (उदाकुरुते) To reproach. 	 8. With उप (उपकुरुते) To befriend, to serve or assist. 	 9. With उप, and स inserted (उपस्कुरुते, or उपस्करोति) To alter. (उपस्करोति) a. To polish, to adorn. b. To assemble. c. To reply. 	 10. With तिरस् (तिरस्करोति) To abuse, to revile. 	 11. With दुर (दुष्करोति) To do evil. 	 12. With निर् and आङ (निराकुरुते) a. To make light of, to contemn. b. To expel. c. To annihilate. 	 13. With परि, and स inserted (परिष्करोति) To polish, to refine, to make elegant or perfect. 	 14. With पर and आङ् (पराकरोति) To act well. 	 15. With प्र (प्रकुरुते) a. To begin. b. To do anything quickly. c. To serve. d. To allot, to portion. e. To vio-late. 	 f. To chaunt, to recite. 	 16. With प्रति (प्रतिकुरुते) a. To counter-act. b. To retaliate. c. To remedy. 	 17. With प्रति and उप (प्रत्युपकुरुते) To requite, to return a kindness; with वि (विकुरुते) a. To utter, to sound. b. To seek, strive for. (विकरोति) a. To alter, to change in form. b. To disturb or agitate. 	 18. With वि and आङ् (व्याकुरुते) a. To explain, to expound. b. To make manifest or public. 	 19. With सम् (संस्करोति) a. To polish, to perfect. b. To assemble, to bring to-gether. 	 20. With सु (सुकरोति) To do well.

11658: केशोच्चय m. (-यः) Much or handsome hair.  E. केश hair, उच्चय heap, abundance.

11677: कैरविणी f. (-णी) A place abounding in lotus flowers, or an assemblage of lotuses.  E. कैरव a white lotus, इनि and ङीष् affs.

12003: क्रिमिशात्रव m. (-वः) A fetid mimosa, (M. farnesiana.)  E. क्रिमि a worm, and शात्रव inimical; an anthelmintic.

12028: क्रियेन्द्रिय m. (-यः) An organ of action, as the hand, foot, voice, organ of generation and that of excretion.  E. क्रिया acting, and इन्द्रिय an or-gan; also कर्म्मेन्द्रिय.
12029: क्री (डु, ङ,) डुक्रीङ r. 9th cl. (क्रीणाति, क्रीणीते) To buy, to barter or ex-change; with वि prefixed, to sell.
12030: क्रीड r. 1st cl. 12031: क्रीड mf. (-डः-डा) 	 1. Sport, play, pastime, pleasure, amusement. 	 f. (-डा) 1. Playing, as a ball, &c. 	 2. Disrespect.  E. क्रीड्. to play, अ affix, and fem. do टाप्.
12032: क्रीडन n. (-नं) Play, sport, &c.  E. क्रीड to play, affix युच्.
12033: क्रीडत् mfn. (-डन्-डन्ती-डत्) Playing, gamboling, sporting.  E. क्रीड and शतृ aff.
12034: क्रीडमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Sporting, playing.  E. क्रीड, and शानच् aff.

12036: क्रीडाकोप m. (-पः) Assumed anger, anger in sport.  E. क्रीडा, and कोप anger.

12038: क्रीडारथ m. (-थः) A car, a carriage.  E. क्रीडा sport, pleasure, and रथ a car.
12039: क्रीडावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्), Sporting, sportive.  E. क्रीडा, and मतुप् aff.

12088: क्रोधनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Provocative. 	 n. (-यं) An injury.  E. क्रुध् to be angry, (on account of,) अनीयर् aff.

12139: क्लीव (ऋ) क्लीवृ r. 1st. cl. (क्लीवते) 	 1. To be impotent. 	 2. To be timorous, to be modest or unassuming.
12140: क्लीव (ऋ) क्लीवृ r. 1st cl. (क्लीवते) 	 1. To be impotent. 	 2. To be timid or modest.
12141: क्लीव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 	 1. Weak, impotent. 	 2. Idle, slothful. 	 mn. (-वः-वं) 1. The neuter gender. 	 2. A eunuch.  E. क्लीव् to be weak or timid, affix क; also read क्लीवक.

12188: क्षणभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Momentary, short-lived.  E. क्षण and भूत been.

12345: क्षिप्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 	 1. Tossing, throwing 2. Casting aside, thro-wing off. 	 3. Sending, directing.  E. क्षिप and शानच् aff.
12346: क्षिप्र mfn. (-प्रः-प्रा-प्रं) Quickly, speedily, quick, swift. adv. 	 n. (-प्रं) Quickly.  E. क्षिप् to send or despatch, Unadi affix रक्.
12347: क्षिप्रपाकिन् m. (-की) A kind of tree, (Hibiscus populneoides:) see गर्द्ध्वभाण्ड  E. क्षिप्र quick, and पाकिन् what ripens.
12348: क्षिया f. (-या) Loss, waste, destruction.  E. क्षि to waste, अङ् and टाप् affix es, इ substituted for the penultimate.
12349: क्षिव (उ) क्षिवु r. 4th cl. (क्षीव्यति) To eject from the mouth, to vomit.
12350: क्षी r. 1st cl. (क्षयति-ते) To hurt or injure.
12351: क्षीज r. 1st cl. (क्षीजति) To sound inarticulately, to sigh or groan as in distress.
12352: क्षीजन n. (-नं) The whistling of hollow reeds or bamboos.  E. क्षीज् to sound inarticulately, affix ल्युट्.
12353: क्षीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 	 1. Thin, emaciated, feeble. 	 2. Thin, slender. 	 3. Wasted, diminished, worn away, expended. 	 4. Destroyed, lost. 	 5. Injured, broken, torn. 	 6. Subdued, suppressed. 	 7. Poor, miserable. E. क्षि to waste, affix क्त, deriv. irr.
12354: क्षीणता f. (-ता) 	 1. slenderness, delicacy. 	 2. Thinness, emaciation. 	 3. Diminution, decay.  E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, क्षीणत्वं.
12355: क्षीणपाप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Purified, having suffered the consequences of sin.  E. क्षीण, and पाप sin.
12356: क्षीणपुण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) 	 1. Abandoned. 	 2. Having enjoyed the fruits of virtue, and being doomed by another birth to labour for more. E. क्षीण, and पुण्य virtue.
12357: क्षीणमध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) Slender-waisted.  E. क्षीण, and मध्य middle.
12358: क्षीणवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Wasted, decayed.  E. क्षि to waste, and क्तवतु aff.
12359: क्षीणवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Inhabiting a destructible house. 	 m. (-सी) A dove or pigeon.  E. क्षीण, and वासिन् abiding.
12360: क्षीणविक्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Cowed, deprived of courage or prowess. E. क्षीण, and विक्रान्त valiant.
12361: क्षीणवृत्ति mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति) Out of employ. out of bread, having no maintenance.  E. क्षीण lost, and वृत्ति practice.
12362: क्षीणशक्ति mfn. (-क्तिः-क्तिः-क्ति) Weak, feeble, impotent.  E. क्षीण, and शक्ति vigour.
12364: क्षीणाष्टकर्म्मन् m. (-र्म्मा) A Jina, an inspired teacher according to the Jainas.  E. क्षीण, and अष्टकर्म्मन् eight natural acts.
12365: क्षीब (ऋ) क्षीबृ r. 1st cl. (क्षीबते) To be intoxicated, (literally or meta-phorically.)
12366: क्षीब mfn. (-बः-बा-बं) Drunk, intoxicated.  E. क्षीब् to be drunk, affix क्त, deriv. irr.
12367: क्षीबता f. (-ता) Intoxication.  E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, क्षीबत्वं
12368: क्षीयमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Perishing, wasting away.  E. क्षि to perish, शानच् aff.
12369: क्षीर n. (-रं) 	 1. Water. 	 2. Milk. 	 f. (-री) A small shrub (Asclepia rosea;) also दुग्धिका. 	 2. A tree, a species of Mimosa, (M. kauki, Rox) also क्षीरिका. 	 3. Gigantic swallow-wort. 	 4. Euphorbia; several kinds, particularly, E. hirta. E. thymifolia, and E. chamæsyce.  E. घस् to eat, ईरन् Unadi affix; the fem. nouns are derived from क्षीर milk. the plants yielding a milky juice or sap, upon expression or incision.
12370: क्षीरकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) An infant, a young child. F. क्षीर milk, and कण्ठ throat; also with कन् added क्षीरकण्ठक.
12371: क्षीरकन्दा f. (-न्दा) A kind of potherb, black Bhuincaonra, (Convolvulus paniculatus.)  E. क्षीर water, and कन्द root: having a watery root.
12372: क्षीरकाकोलिका f. (-का) A drug, and one of the eight principal medica-ments of the Hindus; it is a root from the Himalaya.  E. क्षीर milk, and काकोलि a drug, कन् added; yielding, when fresh, a milky juice; also क्षीरकाकोली.
12374: क्षीरकीट m. (-टः) An insect or animalcule generated by the fermenta-tion of milk  E. क्षीर milk, and कीट a worm.
12375: क्षीरज n. (-जं) Coagulated or curdled milk.  E. क्षीर milk, and ज pro-duced.
12376: क्षीरद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) What gives or yields milk.  E. क्षीर. and द what gives.
12377: क्षीरदल m. (-लः) Gigantic swallow-wort.  E. क्षीर milk, and दल leaf; the leaves, &c. yielding, on expression or incision, a milky juice.
12378: क्षीरनीर n. (-रं) Embracing, embrace.  E. क्षीर milk, and नीर water; mix-ing like milk and water.
12379: क्षीरप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Drinking milk. who or what drinks it.  E. क्षीर, and प who drinks.
12381: क्षीरपाण n. (-णं) drinking milk; also क्षीरपान. 	 m. plu. (-णाः) The name of a people, the milk-drinkers.  E. क्षीर, and पान drink; in the second sense, न is changed always to ण.
12382: क्षीरपायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिणी-यि) 	 1. Drinking milk, sucking, &c. 	 2. Drinking or imbibing water repeatedly.  E. क्षीर, and पायिन् who drinks.
12383: क्षीरपायिन् m. plu. (-यिणः) The people calld Usinaras, the milk-drink-ers.  E. क्षीर, पा to drink, णिनि affix, य inserted, and न final changed to ण.
12385: क्षीरमोरट m. (-टः) A plant, a kind of Murva: see मूर्व्वा.
12386: क्षीरयष्टिक n. (-कं) A dish of liquorice and milk.  E. क्षीर, and यष्टिक made of liquorice.
12387: क्षीरबल्ली f. (-ल्ली) The dark Bhuincaonra, (Convolvulus paniculatus) E. क्षीर water, and वल्ली pedicle: see क्षीरकन्दा.
12388: क्षीरविकृति f. (-तिः) Inspissated milk.  E. क्षीर milk, and विकृति change of form.
12389: क्षीरविदारिका f. (-का) The dark Bhuincaonra; also क्षीरविदारी.
12390: क्षीरविदारी f. (-री) The white or black Bhuincaonra, (Convolvulus pani-culatus:) see भूमिकुष्माण्डक.  E. क्षीर water, and विदारी the same plant.
12391: क्षीरवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) Glomerous fig tree, (Ficus glomerata;) also उडुम्बर. E. क्षीर, milk. and बृक्ष a tree, the leaves and bark yielding a white milky juice.
12392: क्षीरशर m. (-रः) Cream. the surface or skim of milk.  E. क्षीर milk, and शर what goes over or on.
12393: क्षीरशुक्ल m. (-क्लः) An aquatic plant, (Trapa bispinosa, Rox.) 	 f. (-क्ला) The pale Bhuincaonra: see भूमिकुष्माण्डक.  E. क्षीर milk, and शुक्ल white; white as milk, the fruit, &c.
12394: क्षीरसार m. (-रः) Butter.  E. क्षीर, and सार essence.
12395: क्षीरस्फटिक m. (-कः) A precious stone, described as a milky crystal, (opal or cat's eye)  E. क्षीर milk, and स्फटिक crystal.
12396: क्षीराद m. (-दः) An infant at the breast.  E. क्षीर, and अद who feeds.
12397: क्षीराब्धि m. (-ब्धिः) The sea of milk, one of the seven seas surrounding as many worlds.  E. क्षीर milk, and अब्धि the ocean.
12398: क्षीराब्धिज m. (-जः) The moon. 	 f. (-जा) A name of the goddess LAKSHMI. n. (-जं) 	 1. Sea salt. 	 2. A pearl.  E. क्षीराब्धि the sea of milk, and ज born.
12399: क्षीराब्धितनया f. (-या) A name of LAKSHMI:  E. क्षीराब्धि the sea of milk, and तनया daughter.
12400: क्षीरान्नाद m. (-दः) An infant both fed and suckled.  E. क्षीर, and अन्न food, अद who eats.
12401: क्षीराविका f. (-का) A sort of Asclepias; see the next.
12402: क्षीरावी f. (-वी) A sort of Asclepias, (A. rosia, Rox;) also दुग्धिका  E. क्षीर milk or milky juice, अव् to contain, affixes अण् and ङीप्.
12403: क्षीराह्व m. (-ह्वः) The Saral, a kind of pine.  E. क्षीर milk, and आह्व what is named; or it may mean that the tree is also named simply क्षीर, that which yields a milky juice or sap.
12404: क्षीरिका f. (-का) 	 1. A tree bearing an edible fruit, (Mimusops kauki, Rox.) 	 2. A potherb, Bhuicaonra, (Convolvulus paniculatus.)  E. क्षीर milk, affix ठक्.
12405: क्षीरिणी f. (-णी) 	 1. A milch cow. 	 2. A tree bearing an edible fruit, (Mi-musops kauki.) 	 3. A medicinal kind of the moon plant or acid Asclepias.  E. क्षीर milk, and इनि affix, alluding to its juice, fem. affix ङीप्.
12406: क्षीरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 	 1. Milky, yielding milk. 	 2. Having milk. 	 m. (-री) A sort of Mimusops: see क्षीरिका.  E. क्षीर milk, and इनि aff.
12407: क्षीरेयी f. (-यी) An oblation of milk, rice, and sugar.
12408: क्षीरोद m. (-दः) The sea of milk.  E. क्षीर milk, and उद water: it also implies the sea in general.
12409: क्षीरोदतनया f. (-या) A name of LAKSHMI.  E. क्षीरोद the sea of milk, and तनया daughter.
12410: क्षीरोदनन्दन m. (-नः) The moon.  E. क्षीरोद the ocean in general, and नन्दन a son.
12411: क्षीव (उ) क्षीवु r. 1st cl. (क्षीवति) 	 1. To spit or sputter, to eject from the mouth. 2, To be drunk: see क्षिव, also क्षीब.
12412: क्षीब mfn. (-बः-बा-बं) Drunk, intoxicated.  E. क्षीव, and क्त affix; also क्षीव.
12413: क्षीवता f. (-ता) Drunkenness, intoxication.  E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, क्षीवत्वं; also क्षीवता, &c.
12414: क्षु (टु) टुक्षु r. 2d cl. (क्षौति) To sneeze, to make any such sound.
12415: क्षुण m. (-णः) The soap berry plant, (Sapindus saponaria.)  E. क्षुद् to bruise, डुण aff.
12416: क्षुण्ण mfn. (-ण्णः-ण्णा-ण्णं) 	 1. Bruised, pounded. 	 2. Exercised, practiced, skil-ful. 	 3. One versed in sacred science, but described as unable to explain or teach it. 	 4. Defeated, overcame.  E. क्षुद् to bruise, &c. affix क्त, form irr.
12417: क्षुत् f. (-क्षुत्) 	 1. Sneezing; also क्षुत.  E. क्षु to sneeze, affix क्किप्, तुक् is add-ed.
12418: क्षुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sneezed, sneezing. 	 mf. (-तः-ता) 	 1. Sneezing. 	 2. Cough.  E. क्षु to sneeze, affix क्त.
12419: क्षुतवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Sneezing.  E. क्षु to sneeze, क्तवतु aff.
12420: क्षुताभिजनन m. (-नः) Black-mustard.  E. क्षुत sneezing, and अभिजनन what produces; also क्षुधाभिजनन.
12421: क्षुत्करी f. (-री) Black-mustard.  E. क्षुत् sneezing, करी making.
12422: क्षुत्तृणोपपीडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Hungry and thirsty.  E. क्षुध् with तृष्णा thirst, and उपपीडित distressed.
12423: क्षुत्पिपासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Hnngry and thirsty,  E. क्षुध्, and पिपासा thirst, इतच् aff.
12424: क्षुत्प्रतीकार m. (-रः) Allaying hunger, eating.  E. क्षुध्, and प्रतीकार counter-acting.
12425: क्षुद (ञ, इर, औ) औ क्षुदिर r. 7th cl. (क्षुणत्ति, क्षुत्ते) To pound, to bruise, to reduce, to powder.
12426: क्षुद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं) 	 1. Small, little. 	 2. Mean, low. 	 3. Mean, niggardly, avaricious. 	 4. Cruel. 	 5. Poor, indigent. 	 f. (-द्रा) 	 1. A woman maim-ed or crippled, wanting a limb, &c. 	 2. A dancing girl. 	 3. A whore, a harlot. 	 4. A fly. 	 5. A bee or wasp. 	 6. A gnat, &c. 	 7. A prickly nightshade: see कण्टकारी. 	 8. The egg plant, (Solanum melongena.) 9. Sorrel, (Oxalis monadelpha.)  E. क्षुद् to bruise or pound, Unadi affix रक्.
12427: क्षुद्रकम्बु m. (-म्बुः) A small shell.  E. क्षुद्र small, and कम्बु a shell.
12428: क्षुद्रघण्टिका f. (-का) A tinkling ornament, a girdle of small bells, &c. E. क्षुद्र small, घण्टा a clock or bell, affix कन्, and the fem. form.
12429: क्षुद्रचूड m. (-डः) A kind of small bird.  E. क्षुद्र small, and चूडा a crest, small-crested.
12430: क्षुद्रजन्तु m. (-न्तुः) 	 1. Any small animal. 	 2. A kind of worm, (Julus.) E. क्षुद्र small, and जन्तु animal.
12431: क्षुद्रजीर m. (-रः) Small cummin.  E. क्षुद्र small, and जीर cummin seed.
12432: क्षुद्रता f. (-ता) 	 1. Smallness, minuteness. 	 2. Inferiority, insignificance, meanness.  E. तल् added to क्षुद्र; also with त्व, क्षुद्रत्वं.
12433: क्षुद्रदंशिका f. (-का) A small gadfly.  E. क्षुद्र, and दंशिका a gadfly.
12434: क्षुद्रदंशी f. (-शी) A small gadfly.  E. क्षुद्र, and दंशी a gadfly.
12435: क्षुद्रनासिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Having a little nose.  E. क्षुद्र, and नासिका the nose.
12436: क्षुद्रपत्रा f. (-त्रा) Wood-sorrel, (Oxalis monadelpha.)  E. क्षुद्र, and पत्र a leaf, small-leaved.
12437: क्षुद्रफलक m. (-कः) A tree, (Celtis orientalis:) see जीवन.  E. क्षुद्र, and फल fruit, कन् added, bearing a small fruit.
12438: क्षुद्रफला f. (-ला) A plant. (Ardisia solanacea.)  E. क्षुद्र, and फल fruit.
12439: क्षुद्रबुद्धि mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) Simple, silly, ignorant.  E. क्षुद्र, and बुद्धि under-standing.
12440: क्षुद्ररोग m. (-गः) A minor disease, one of little importance.  E. क्षुद्र, and रोग disease.
12441: क्षुद्रवंशा f. (-शा) A plant (Dioscorea:) see वराहक्रान्ता.
12442: क्षुद्रशङ्ख m. (-ङ्खः) A small shell.  E. क्षुद्र, and शङ्ख a shell.
12443: क्षुद्रशीर्ष m. (-र्षः) A tree, (Celosia cristata.)  E. क्षुद्र, and शीर्ष the head, having a small head.
12444: क्षुद्रसहा f. (-हा) A plant, commonly Mugai: see मुद्गपर्णी.
12445: क्षुद्रहिङ्गुलिका f. (-का) A prickly nightshade, (Solanum jacquini.) a small species.  E. क्षुद्र small, and हिङ्गुली the plant.
12447: क्षुद्राण्डमत्स्यसङ्घात m. (-तः) Small fly.  E. क्षुद्र small, अण्ड an egg, मत्स्य a fish, and सङ्घात a heap.
12448: क्षुद्राम्लपनस m. (-सः) A tree, (Artocarpus lacucha:) see लकुच.
12449: क्षुद्राम्ला f. (-म्ला) Wood-sorrel, (Oxalis monadelpha.)  E. क्षुद्र, and अम्ल sour; a small and acid plant.
12450: क्षुध (ऌ औ) औक्षधॢ r. 4th cl. (क्षुध्यति) To be hungry, to hunger.
12451: क्षुध् f. (-क्षुत् or क्षुद्) Hunger.  E. क्षुध् to be hungry, affix क्विप्.
12452: क्षुधा f. (-धा) Hunger.  E. क्षुध् to be hungry, affixes अङ् and टाप्.
12453: क्षुधाकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Causing hunger, improving the appetite  E. क्षुधा, and कर what makes.
12454: क्षुधाध्वंस m. (-सः) Allaying hunger.  E. क्षुधा, and ध्वंस destruction.
12455: क्षुधापीडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Hungry, starving.  E. क्षुधा, and पीडित pained.
12456: क्षुधाभिजनन m. (-नः) Black mustard.  E. क्षुधा hunger, and अभिजनन caus-ing, promoting.
12457: क्षुधार्त्त m. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Hungry, hungered.  E. क्षुधा and आर्त्त pained.
12458: क्षुधाशान्ति f. (-न्तिः) Satisfaction, satiety, allaying hunger.  E. क्षुधा, and शान्ति appeasing.
12459: क्षुधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Hungered, hungry.  E. क्षुध् to be hungry, affix क्त.
12460: क्षुधुन m. (-नः) A savage, a barbarian.  E. क्षुध् to be hungry, Unadi affix उनन्.
12461: क्षुप m. (-पः) A small tree, one with short branches and roots, a bush, a shurb.  E. क्षु to sound, aff. प.
12462: क्षुब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) 	 1. Agitated, tossed, stirred. 	 2. Agitated men-tally, anxious, disturbed. 	 m. (-ब्धः) The churning stick.  E. क्षुभ् to stir, to agitate, affix क्त, form irr.
12463: क्षुभ r. 1st cl. (क्षोभति) 	 1. To be confused or agitated. 	 2. To stir or dis-turb. r. 4th cl. and 9th cl. (क्षुभ्यति and क्षुभ्नाति) 	 2. To shake, to-tremble, to be unsteady.
12464: क्षुभित mfn. (-तः-ता-त) 	 1. Frightened, alarmed, afraid. 	 2. Agitated, tossed, set in motion. 	 3. Agitated mentally, disturbed, anxious. 	 4. Angry, enraged.  E. क्षुभ् to shake, to be agitated, to stir, &c. affix क.
12465: क्षुमा f. (-मा) 	 1. Linseed, (Linum usitatissimum.) 	 2. A sort of flax, Ben-gal San. 	 3. The indigo plant. 	 4. A sort or creeper.  E. क्षु to sound, affix मक्.
12466: क्षुर r. 6th cl. (क्षुरति) 	 1. To cut. 	 2. To scratch, to make lines or furrows.
12467: क्षुर m. (-रः) 	 1. A razor. 	 2. A plant, (Barleria longifolia.) 	 3. Also Tribulus lanuginosus: see गोक्षुर. 	 4. A horse's hoof; also खुर 5. The hoof of a cow, &c. 	 6. The foot of a bedstead. 	 f. (-री) A knife. E. क्षुर् to scratch or cut, Unadi affix रन् and the final consonant rejected; also खुर.
