12857: खुज r. 1st cl. (-उ) खुजु (खोजति) To steal or rob.
12858: खुञ्जाक m. (-कः) A kind of grass: see देवताडक.
12859: खुड r. 6th cl. (-खडति) To cover. r. 1st. and 10th cls. (खोडति खोडयति) also (इ,) खुडि r. 1st. and 10th cls. (खुण्डति, खुण्डयति) To break in pieces, to sunder, to divide, tear, rend, &c. (इङ्) खुडिङ् r. 1st cl. (खुण्डते) To limp, to be lame.
12860: खुर r. 6th cl. (खुरति) To cut, to scratch.
12861: खुर m. (-रः) 	 1. A hoof, a horse's hoof, &c. 	 2. A razor. 	 3. The foot of a bedstead; also क्षुर 4. A sort of perfume, commonly Nakhi, ap-parently a dried shell fish, and of the shape of a hoof.  E. खुर् to cut, रन् Unadi affix, the radical र is dropped.
12862: खुरक m. (-कः) A plant commonly Tila.  E. कन् added to the preceding.
12863: खुरक्षेप m. (-पः) A kick, kicking.  E. खुर, and क्षेप throwing.
12864: खुरणस् mfn. (-णाः-णाः-णः) Flat-nosed, having a nose like a horse's hoof, E. खुर a hoof, and नस् deriv. of नासिका a nose; also with a final vowel खुरणस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं.)
12865: खुरपदवी f. (-वी) A horse's foot marks.  E. खुर, and पदवी vestige.
12866: खुरप्र m. (-प्रः) An arrow with a semicircular head: see क्षुरप्र.
12867: खुरली f. (-ली) Military exercise, practising archery, &c.  E. खुर् to cut, अलच् aff.
12868: खुराक m. (-कः) An animal in general.  E. खुर् to cut, and आक aff.
12869: खुराघात m. (-तः) A kick.  E. खुर, and आघात a blow.
12870: खुराभिघात m. (-तः) 	 1. A kick. 	 2. Kicking, pawing, (as a horse.)  E. खुर, and अभिघात striking.
12871: खुरालक m. (-कः) An iron arrow.  E. खुर a razor, and अल what is able, affix कन्.
12872: खुरालिक m. (-कः) 	 1. A barber's case. 	 2. An iron arrow. 	 3. A pillow. E. खुर a razor, &c. अल् to be equal to, affix ठक्; some read this खरा-लक, but to all appearance erroneously.
12873: खुर्द r. 1st cl. (खुर्दते or खूर्दते) To play, to sport.
12874: खुल्ल mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं) Small, little, low, mean, &c. 	 n. (-ल्लं) A kind of perfume: see खुर.  E. खुद् to divide, &c. and ल from ला to get, the radical द becomes ल.
12875: खुल्लक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Low, vile. 	 2. Little, small. 	 3. Poor, indigent. 4. Cruel, harsh. 	 5. Wicked, mischievous, malignant: see क्षुल्ल.
12876: खुल्लतात m. (-तः) A father's younger brother; also क्षुल्लतात.
12878: खूर्द r. 1st cl. (खूर्दते) To play: see खुर्द.
12879: खेखीरक m. (-कः) A hollow or sounding reed, or cane.
12880: खेगमन m. (-नः) A gallinule.  E. खे in the air, and गमन going.
12881: खेचर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Aerial, moving in the air. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A name of SIVA. 	 2. A Vidyadhara or kind of demigod. 	 3. Quicksilver.  E. खे in heaven, and चर who goes.
12882: खेट r. 1st cl. (खेटति) To alarm. r. 10th cl. (खेटयति) To eat.
12883: खेट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) 	 1. Vile, bad, low. 	 2. Armed, having a weapon or weapons. 	 mn. (-टः-टं) Hunting, the chase; also आखेट m. (-टः) 	 1. A shield. 	 2. A village, the residence of peasants or farmers. 	 3. A small town, half the Pura or town. 	 4. The club of BALARAMA. 	 5. Phlegm, the phlegmatic or watery humour. 	 6. The ascending node or RAHU. 	 7. A horse. 	 n. (-टं) Grass.  E. खिट् to terrify, &c. affix घञ्
12884: खेटक m. (-कः) 	 1. A village, the residence of agricultural peasants. 	 2. A shield. 	 3. The club of BALARAMA.  E. खिट् to terrify, &c. अच् affix, and कन् added.
12885: खेटिताल m. (-लः) A minstrel, a family bard or piper, whose business it is to awaken the Laird, with music and singing.  E. खेटि derived from खिट् to disturb, and ताल tune.
12886: खेटिन् m. (-टी) A lecher, a libertine.  E. खेट sport, affix इनि.
12888: खेडिताल m. (-लः) A minstrel: see खेटिताल.
12889: खेद m. (-दः) 	 1. Sorrow, affliction, distress. Lassitude, depression. 	 3. Pain. 	 4. Proverty.  E. खिद् to be distrest, affix घञ्.
12891: खेदान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Distressed, pained.  E. खेद, and अन्वित having.
12892: खेदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Annoyed, harassed. 	 2. Afflicted, distressed, pained.  E. खिद् to give pain, क्त aff.
12893: खेदिनी f. (-नी) 	 1. A plant, (Marsilea quadrifolia:) see असनपर्णी. 	 2. A creeper, a creeping plant.  E. खिद् to be distrest, affixes णिनि and ङीष्.
12894: खेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be dug. 	 n. (-यं) A ditch, a moat.  E. खन् to dig, affix क्यप्.
12895: खेल (ऋ) खेऌ r. 1st cl. (खेलति) To shake to tremble, to move.
12896: खेलन n. (-नं) Play, sport, pastime. 	 f. (-नी) A piece or man at drafts, chess, &c.  E. खेल् to shake or move, affix ल्युट्.
12897: खेला f. (-ला) Play, pastime, sport  E. खेल् to shake, अङ् and टाप् affs.
12898: खेलि f. (-लिः) 	 1. A song, a hymn. 	 2. An arrow. 	 3. The sun. 	 4. A bird. 	 5. Any animal.  E. खेल् to shake, कि aff.
12899: खेव (ऋ) खेवृ r. 1st cl. (खेवते) To serve.
12900: खेसर m. (-रः) A mule.  E. खे in air, सर who goes.
12901: खै r. 1st cl. (खायति) 	 1. To be firm or steady. 	 2. To kill, to injure or hurt. 	 3. To dig. 	 4. To mourn, to sorrow for.
12902: खोङ्काह m. (-हः) A white and brown horse.
12903: खोट r. 1st cl. (ऋ) खोट्ट (खोटति) To be lame or lamed. r. 10th cl. (खोटयति) 1. To eat. 	 2. To throw or cast.
12904: खोटि f. (-टिः) A cunning or scheming woman; also read खोरि.
12905: खोटी f. (-टी) The gum olibanum tree.
12906: खोड (ऋ) खोडृ r. 1st cl. (खोडति) To be or become lame. r. 10th cl. (खोड-यति) To throw or cast.
12907: खोड mfn. (-डः-डा-डं) Lame, limping.  E. खोड्. to be lame, affix अच्.
12908: खोडकशीर्ष n. (-र्ष) The arched roof of a house, the coping of a wall, &c. also खोडकशीर्षक.
12909: खोर (ऋ) खोरृ r. 1st cl. (खोरति) To be lame, to be prevented from moving.
12910: खोर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Lame.  E. खोर् to be lame, affix अच्; also खोड and खोल.
12911: खोल (ऋ) खोऌ r. 1st cl. (खोलति) To be lame, to limp, to be prevented from moving. खोड, खोर, &c. are conceived by some authorities to be mere variations in the form of this root.
12912: खोल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Lame.  E. खोल् to be lame, affix अच्; also खोर, &c.
12913: खोलक m. (-कः) 	 1. A helmet, armour for the head. 	 2. A pot, a sauce-pan. 	 3. An ant-hill. 	 4. The shell of the betel nut.  E. खुड्. to cover, affix ण्वुल्, ड changed to ल.
12915: खोल्क m. (-ल्कः) 	 1. A meteor. 	 2. A planet.  E. ख, and उल्का torch.
12916: खोल्मुक m. (-कः) The planet MARS.  E. ख heaven, उल्मुक a hot coal.
12917: ख्या r. 2nd cl. (ख्याति) 	 1. To relate, to recount, to say or tell. 	 2. To celebrate, to make known. With अभि prefixed, To shine or be glorious. With आ, To be famous. With वि, to celebrate. With सु, To be approved. With कु, To be infamous. With प्रति and आ, To reject, to refuse. With सम्, To count, to reckon. With सं and आ to denominate.
12918: ख्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Famous, celebrated, notorious.  E. ख्या to relate, affix क्त.
12919: ख्यातगर्हण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Notoriously vile, infamous.  E. ख्यात famous, गर्हण abuse; also ख्यातगर्हित.
12920: ख्यातगर्हित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Infamous: see the preceding.
12921: ख्याति f. (-तिः) Fame, celebrity.  E. ख्या to tell, affix क्तिन्.
12922: ख्यापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Declaring, making known, one who tells or declares. 	 2. One who confesses.  E. ख्या to say, causal form, ण्वुल् aff.
12923: ख्यापन n. (-नं) 	 1. Declaring, divulging. 	 2. Saying, avowing. 	 3. Confess-ing. 	 4. Explaining.  E. ख्या causal form, ल्युट् aff.
12924: ग The third consonant of the Nagri alphabet, the letter G.
12925: ग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Who or what goes, used chiefly in composition: as अध्वगः a traveller, who goes a road; अपगा what goes down, (a river, &c.) 	 m. (-गः) 	 1. A name of the deity GANESHA. 	 2. A Gand-harba or celestial musician. 	 f. (-गा) A song. 	 n. (-गं) Song, singing. E. गम् to go or गै to sing, affix ड, fem. affix टाप्.
12926: गगण n. (-णं) Sky, atmosphere, heaven.  E. गम् to go. Unadi affix युच् and the radical final changed to ग; the word and its derivatives are also sometimes read गगन.
12927: गगणध्वज (-जः) 1. A cloud. 	 2. The sun.  E. गगण the sky, and ध्वज a stand-ard or symbol.
12928: गगणाध्वग m. (-गः) 	 1. The sun. 	 2. A planet. 	 3. A heavenly spirit. E. गगण the sky, अध्वन् a road, and ग who goes.
12929: गगणपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A flower in the sky. i. e. an impossibility.  E. गगण, and पुष्प a flower; alse गगणकुसुम, &c.
12930: गगणविहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Sporting in heaven. 	 m. (-री) 	 1. The sun. 2. A heavenly luminary. 	 3. A divinity or celestial being,  E. गगण, and विहारिन् who sports.
12931: गगणसद् mf. (-सत् or -सद्) Going in the air. 	 m. (-सद्) A celestial being. E. गगण, and षद् to go, क्विप् aff.
12932: गगणस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Situated in the sky.  E. गगण and स्थ what stays in; also गगणस्थित, &c.
12933: गगणस्पर्शन m. (-नः) Air, wind.  E. गगण, and स्पर्शन who touches.
12934: गगणाग्र n. (-ग्रं) The highest heavens, the summit or highest part of heaven.  E. गगण, and अग्र end.
12935: गगणेचर m. (-रः) 	 1. A planet 2. An asterism. 	 3. A heavenly spirit. E. गगणे in the sky, चर who goes.
12936: गगणोल्मुक m. (-कः) The planet Mars.  E. गगण the sky, and उल्मुका a torch or coal.
12937: गग्घ r. 1st cl. (गग्घति) To laugh, to laugh at or deride: see घग्घ.
12938: गङ्गा f. (-ङ्गा) The river Ganges, or its personification as a goddess. E. गम् to go, Unadi affix गन्, or गां the accusative of गो the earth, and ग who goes, form irr.
12939: गङ्गाका f. (-का) The river Ganges.  E. कन् added to the preceding; also read गङ्गका.
12940: गङ्गाक्षेत्र n. (-त्रं) The river Ganges, and two Krosh on either of its banks.  E. गङ्गा, and क्षेत्र holy place; all dying within such limits going to heaven, whatever their crimes.
12941: गङ्गाचिल्ली f. (-ल्ली) The black headed gull, (Larus ridibundus.)  E. गङ्गा the Ganges, and चिल्ली a kite, considered by the Hindus as a species of that bird; the Gangetic kite.
12942: गङ्गाज m. (-जः) 	 1. A name of BHISHMA. 	 2. A name of the deity KARTI-KEYA.  E. गङ्गा the river goddess, and ज born; the son of GANGA.
12943: गङ्गाजल n. (-लः) The water of the Ganga.  E. गङ्गा, and जल water.
12944: गङ्गाटेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Going in or to the Ganges. 	 m. (-यः) A shrimp or prawn; also गलाविल.  E. गङ्गा the river, and अट् to go, अच् affix, गङ्गाट, and ढक् added.
12945: गङ्गाद्बार n. (-रं) The place where the Ganga enters the plains; also Haridwar.  E. गङ्गा, and द्वार gate.
12946: गङ्गातीर n. (-रं) The bank of the Ganga.  E. गङ्गा, and तीर a bank.
12947: गङ्गाधर m. (-रः) 	 1. An epithet of SIVA. 	 2. The ocean.  E. गङ्गा the Ganges, and धर who possesses or receives; according to the legend, the Ganges in its descent first alighted on the head of SIVA, and con-tinued for some period entangled in his hair.
12948: गङ्गापार n. (-रं) The bank of the Ganges.  E. गङ्गा, and पार the bank.
12949: गङ्गापुत्र m. (-त्रः) 	 1. BHISHMA. 	 2. A man of a mixed and vile caste, em-ployed to remove dead bodies. 	 3. A Brahman who conducts the ceremonies of pilgrimage at some places on the Ganges, especially at Benares.  E. गङ्गा, and पुत्र a son.
12950: गङ्गामध्य n. (-ध्यं) The bed or stream of the Ganges.  E. गङ्गा, and मध्य centre.
12951: गङ्गाम्बु n. (-म्बु) 	 1. Pure rain water, such as falls in Aswin. 	 2. Ganges water.  E. गङ्गा, and अम्बु water.
12952: गङ्गायात्रा f. (-त्रा) 	 1. Pilgrimage to the Ganga. 	 2. Carrying a sick per-son to the river side to die there.  E. गङ्गा, and यात्रा going.
12953: गङ्गासुत m. (-तः) 	 1. A name of KARTIKEYA. 	 2. A name of the hero BHISHMA: see गङ्गाज.  E. गङ्गा, and सुत a son; the son of GANGA.
12954: गङ्गिका f. (-का) The Ganges.  E. गङ्गा, and कन् affix fem. from; also गङ्गका, and गङ्गाका.
12955: गङ्गीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Become as the Ganges, as sacred, &c.  E. गङ्गा, and भूत become, च्वि augment.
12956: गच्छ m. (-च्छः) A tree.  E. गम् to go, and स Unadi affix, what goes or grows; also अगच्छ.
12957: गच्छत् mfn. (-च्छन्-च्छन्ती-च्छत्) Going.  E. गम् to go, शतृ aff.
12958: गज r. 1st cl. (गजति) To be drunk, to be confused or inebriated; r. 1st and 10th cls. (गजति, गजयति) also (इ) गजि r. 1st cl. (गञ्जति) To sound.
12959: गज m. (-जः) 	 1. An elephant. 	 2. A measure of length, the Gaz, a yard, a measure of two cubits. 	 3. A mound of earth sloping on both sides, on which a house may be created. 	 4. A small hole in the ground for a fire, over which to prepare medicines.  E. गज् to sound, to roar, affix अच्.
12960: गजकन्द m. (-न्दः) A large esculent root, a sort of arum.  E. गज, and कन्द root.
12961: गजकूर्म्माशिन् m. (-शी) A name of GARURA the bird and vehicle of VISHNU.  E. गज an elephant, कूर्म्म a tortoise, and अशिन् who eats; alluding to a legend of his swallowing both animals whilst engaged in a contest with each other.
12962: गजविर्भट mf. (-टः-टा) A kind of cucumber, (Cucumis Madraspatanus.)
12963: गजच्छाया f. (-या) A portion of time proper for a Sraddha,  E. गज, and छाया shadow.
12964: गजढक्का f. (-क्का) A kettle-drum carried on an elephant.  E. गज an ele-phant, and ढक्का a large drum.
12965: गजता f. (-ता) A multitude of elephants.  E. गज an elephant, तल् aff.
12966: गजदघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) As high or tall as an elephant  E. गज, and दघ्नच् aff.
12967: गजदन्त m. (-न्तः) 	 1. A name of GANESHA. 	 2. Ivory, the elephant's tooth. 3. A bracket or pin projecting from the wall.  E. गज a elephant, and दन्त a tooth; GANESHA is represented with an elephant's head.
12968: गजदान n. (-नं) The liquor exuding from an elephant's temples.  E. गज and दान the same.
12969: गजद्वयस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) As high as an elephant.  E. गज, and द्वयसच् aff.
12970: गजपति m. (-तिः) 	 1. A large state elephant. 	 2. A king.  E. गज, and पति a master.
12971: गजपिप्पली f. (-ली) A plant bearing a seed which resembles pepper, (Poth-os officinalis)  E. गज an elephant, and पिप्पली long pepper; consi-dered to be a large species of pepper: see similar names, as करि-पिप्पली, इभकणा, &c.
12972: गजपुङ्गव m. (-वः) A large and excellent elephant.  E. गज, and पुङ्गव implying eminence.
12973: गजपुट m. (-टः) A small hollow for a fire, over which to prepare medi-cal decoctions, extracts, &c.  E. गज, and पुट a hollow.
12974: गजप्रिया f. (-या) The gum olibanum tree, (Boswellia serrata.)  E. गज an elephant, and प्रिय beloved; also वल्लकी.
12975: गजबन्धनी f. (-नी) A post to which an elephant is bound.  E. गज, and बन्धन a binding.
12976: गजभक्षक m. (-कः) The sacred fig tree.  E. गज, and भक्षक eater; the young branches of the Pipal being the elephant's favourite food.
12977: गजभक्षा f. (-क्षा) The gum olibanum tree: see गजप्रिय.  E. गज an ele-phant and भक्षा food; also गजभक्ष्या.
12978: गजमण्डलिका f. (-का) A ring or circle of elephants surrounding a car. &c.  E. गज, मण्डल a circle, कन् affix fem. form.
12979: गजमाचल m. (-लः) A lion.  E. गज an elephant, मा fortune, and चल what goes: the destroyer of the elephant.
12980: गजमात्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं) As tall as an elephant.  E. गज, and मात्रच् aff.
12981: गजमुक्ता f. (-क्ता) A pearl, supposed to be found in the head of an ele-phant.  E. गज, and मुक्ता a pearl.
12982: गजमोटन m. (-नः) A lion.  E. गज an elephant, मुट् to run away, in the causal from, affix ल्युट्; or with मुच् to go, गजमोचन as it is some-times read.
12983: गजयूथ m. (-थः) A herd of elephants.  E. गज, and यूथ a herd.
12984: गजवदन m. (-नः) A name of GANESHA, who is represented always with the head of an elephant.  E. गज. and वदन a face.
12985: गजव्रज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Who walks like an elephant. 	 n. (-जं) 	 1. A troop of elephants. 2, The pace of an elephant.  E. गज, and व्रज a number or going, who goes, &c.
12986: गजसाह्वय n. (-यं) A famous city, Hastinapur the capital of the KuRUS. E. गज, स for सम् with, and आह्वय an appellation; named from its elephants; also गजाह्व, &c.
12987: गजाग्रणी m. (-णी) The elephant of INDRA.  E. गज and अग्रणी pre-eminent.
12988: गजाजीव m. (-वः) An elephant keeper or driver.  E. गज and आजीव who lives; who gets his livelihood by elephants.
12989: गजानन m. (-नः) The deity GANESHA.  E. गज an elephant, and आनन a face; see गजवदन.

13331: गर्भपातन n. (-नं) Producing abortion. 	 f. (-नी) Any plant or drug supposed to have that effect.  E. गर्भ, and पातन causing to fall.
13332: गर्भपातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) Producing abortion f. (-नी) A kind of potherb: see विशल्या. E. As in the last, affixes णिनि and ङीप्.
13333: गर्भपोषण n. (-णं) Gestation.  E. गर्भ, and पोषण nourishing.
13334: गर्भरूप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) A child, an infant.  E. गर्भ an embryo, and रूप form; also गर्भरूपकः.
13335: गर्भवती f. (-ती) A pregnant female.  E. गर्भ a fœtus, and मतुप् poss. aff.
13336: गर्भशङ्कु m. (-ङ्कुः) A kind of vectis or instrument for extracting the dead fœtus.  E. गर्भ and शङ्कु a probe.
13337: गर्भशय्या f. (-य्या) The uterus.  E. गर्भ, and शय्या a bed.
13338: गर्भस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 	 1. Situated in the womb. 	 2. Centrical, internal, within the centre of any thing.  E. गर्भ, and स्थ what abides.
13339: गर्भस्राव m. (-वः) Abortion, miscarriage.  E. गर्भ the embryo, and स्राव expulsion.
13340: गर्भस्राविन् mfn. (-वी-विणी-वि) Producing or occasioning abortion.  E. गर्भ, and स्राविन् what causes to issue.
13341: गर्भागार n. (-रं) 	 1. An inner and private room, the female apartments, the lying-in chamber. 	 2. The sanctuary of a temple. The chamber where the object of worship is placed.  E. गर्भ the fœtus, and आगार an abode, hence it is applied to the womb: see गर्भाशय.
13342: गर्भाधान n. (-नं) A ceremony performed prior to conception.  E. गर्भ the embryo, and आधान taking, being supposed conductive to future impregnation.
13343: गर्भाशय m. (-यः) The womb, the uterus.  E. गर्भ the embryo, and आशय asy-lum or abode.
13344: गर्भाष्टम m. (-मः) The eighth month of uterine gestation. 	 2. The eighth year reckoning from conception.  E. गर्भ the fœtus, and अष्टम eighth.
13345: गर्भिणी f. (-णी) 	 1. A pregnant woman. 	 2. A plant, (Asclepias rosea)  E. गर्भ embryo, and इनि poss. affix, fem. affix ङीप्.
13346: गर्भिण्यवेक्षण n. (-णं) Midwifery, attendance and care of pregnant women and new born infants.  E. गर्भिणी, and अवेक्षण care, looking to.
13347: गर्भोपघातिनी f. (-नी) A cow (or female), miscarrying from going unseason-ably.  E. गर्भ the fœtus, उप intensitive preffix, हन् to destroy, affixes णिनि and ङीप्.
13348: गर्म्मुटिका f. (-का) A species of rice.
13349: गर्म्मुत् f. (-र्म्मुत्) 	 1. A kind of grass. 	 2. Gold. 	 3. A reed.  E. गॄ to swallow, &c. Unadi affix उति, and म inserted.
13350: गर्व्व r. 1st cl. (गर्व्वति) To be proud or haughty; also (ङ) गर्वङ् r. 10th cl. (गर्व्वयते) To grow proud.
13351: गर्व्व m. (-र्व्वः) Pride, arrogance.  E. गर्व्व् to be proud, affix अच् or गॄ to swallow, &c. and व Unadi affix; this word is sometimes written गर्ब्ब.
13352: गर्व्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Proud, haughty, arrogant.  E. गॄ to reject, &c. Unadi affix खरच्.
13353: गर्व्वाट m. (-टः) A watchman, a doorkeeper, a sort of village constable, a headborough or beadle.  E. गर्व्व pride, अट् to go, and अच् aff.
13354: गर्व्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Proud, haughty. 	 2. Conceited.  E. गर्व्व pride, and इतच् aff.
13355: गर्ह r. 1st and 10th cls. (गर्हति-ते, गर्हयति) To blame, to censure to despise or contemn.
13356: गर्हण n. (-णं) Censuring, censure, blame, reproach.  E. गर्ह् reprove, affix ल्युट्.
13357: गर्हणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Censurable, contemptible, vile, bad.  E. गर्ह् to abuse, अनीयर् aff.
13358: गर्हा f. (-र्हा) Abuse, censure, reproach.  E. गर्ह् to revile, affixes अङ् and टाप्.
13359: गर्हित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Blamed, censured. 	 2. Contemned, despised. 3. Bad, vile.  E. गर्ह् to blame, क्त aff.
13360: गर्ह्य mfn. (-र्ह्यः-र्ह्या-र्ह्यं) Low, vile, contemptible.  E. गर्ह् to abuse, affix यत्.
13361: गर्ह्यवादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Speaking ill, speaking vilely or inaccurate-ly.  E. गर्ह्य vile, and वादिन् who speaks.
13362: गल r. 1st cl. (गलति) 	 1. To eat. 	 2. To ooze; also (ङ्) गलङ् r. 10th cl. (गलयते) To drop, to ooze or distil. With अव prefixed, To fall, to fall down or off; With वि, 1. To go, to approach. 	 2. To bear or support.
13363: गल m. (-लः) 	 1. The throat. 	 2. The resin of the Sal tree. 	 3. A reed, a large kind of the Saccharum cylindricum. 	 4. A rope. 	 5. A musical instrument. 	 6. A kind of fish, a small kind of cyprinus, a subgenus of that class, (Cyprinus garra. HAM.)  E. गल् to eat, to drop, &c. affix अच्, or गॄ to swallow, with अच्, गर, and र changed to ल.
13364: गलक m. (-कः) A kind of fish.  E. कन् added to the preceding.
13365: गलकम्बल m. (-लः) A bull's dewlap.  E. गल the neck, and कम्बल a soft substance as a blanket, &c.
13366: गलगण्ड m. (-ण्डः) Inflammation, enlargement of the glands of the neck. E. गल throat and गण्ड a swelling or boil.
13367: गलग्रह m. (-हः) 	 1. A sauce of fish ground up with salt, pepper, Ghee, &c. 	 2. A day on which a course of study is commenced, but imme-diately preceding a day on which study is prohibited. 	 3. The fourth lunation of the dark fortnight, the seventh eighth, and ninth, the thirteenth and three days following. 	 4. Seizing any one by the throat, throttling, choking.  E. गल the throat, and ग्रह what takes, &c.; also गलग्रहण.
13368: गलत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्) 	 1. Falling, dropping. 	 2. Oozing, trickling, flowing. 	 3. Melting.  E. गल् to flow, शतृ aff.
13369: गलन n. (-नं) 	 1. Melting, fusing. 	 2. Trickling, dropping, oozing. 	 3. Fall-ing. down or off. 	 4. Leaking.  E. गल् to drop, ल्युट् aff.
13370: गलनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fusible, liquefiable, to be melted, &c.  E. गल् to melt, अनीयर् affix; also गलितव्य and गल्य.
13371: गलन्तिका f. (-का) 	 1. A small pitcher. 	 2. A small water jar with small holes in the bottom, from which the water drops upon a Linga or Tulasi plant, placed beneath.  E. गड् to drop, affix झच्, गडन्ति कन् in the fem. form added, and ड changed to ल.
13372: गलमेखला f. (-ला) A thread worn round the neck, a necklace.  E. गल the throat, and मेखला a girdle.
13373: गलव्रत m. (-तः) A peacock.  E. गल the throat, व्रत holy observance. also the same as गरव्रत q. v. ल being substituted for र.
13374: गलशुण्डिका f. (-का) The uvula or soft palate.  E. गल the throat, and शुण्डिका the elephant's trunk, resembling it in being a pendulous, roundish, and fleshy substance.
13375: गलस्तनी f. (-नी) A she-goat.  E. गल the throat, and स्तन the breast; some species of the Bengal goat have small fleshy processes, resembling nipples depending from the throat; also गलस्तनी.
13376: गलहस्त m. (-स्तः) Throttling.  E. गल, and हस्त the hand.
13377: गलाङ्कुर m. (-रः) A disease of the throat, inflammation of the fauces, and enlargement of the tonsils.  E. गल the throat, and अङ्कुर a new sprout.
13378: गलाविल m. (-लः) A prawn or shrimp: see गङ्गाटेय. Some books read this गलानिल, and others गलानिक.
13379: गलि m. (-लिः) A strong and lazy ox.  E. गल् to eat, and इन् affix; who is good for nothing but eating.
13380: गलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Fallen, dropped. 	 2. Liquefied, melted. 	 3. Dis-tilled, oozing, flowing. 	 4. Decayed, impaired. 	 5. Lost, deprived. 6. Untied, loosed.  E. गल् to drop, to ooze, affix क्त.
13381: गलितकुष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) Advanced and incurable leprosy, when the fingers and toes fall off.  E. गलित, and कुष्ठ leprosy.
13382: गलितदन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Toothless.  E. गलित, and दन्त tooth.
13383: गलितनख mfn. (-खः-खा-खी-खं) Having no nails.  E. गलित, and नख the nail.
13384: गलितनयन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Blind.  E. गलित, and नयन the eye.
13385: गलेगण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A kind of bird, (the Adjutant or Ardea argala.)  E. गल the throat, in the seventh case, and गण्ड a boil; alluding to a pen-dulous fleshy purse hanging from the throat.
13386: गलेस्तनी f. (-नी) A she-goat; see गलस्तनी.
13387: गलू m. (-लूः) A sort of gem.
13388: गल्भ r. 1st cl. (गल्भते) To be bold or confident.
13389: गल्भ mfn. (-ल्भः-ल्भा-ल्भं) 	 1. Proud, haughty. 	 2. Confident, bold, auda-cious.  E. गल्भ् to be proud, &c. अच् affix, more commonly प्रगलभ.
13390: गल्या f. (-ल्या) 	 1. A multitude of throats. 	 2. A quantity of a kind of grass, or ropes made of it.  E. गल a throat, &c. य aff.
13391: गल्ल m. (-ल्लः) The cheek.  E. गल् to eat, and ल affix; from ला to get or receive.
13392: गल्लचातुरी f. (-री) A small round pillow to put underneath the cheek. E. गल्ल the cheek, and चातुर a pillow.
13393: गल्वर्क m. (-र्कः) 	 1. A goblet, a vessel for drinking spirituous liquor. 	 2. Lapis lazuli.  E. गल् to drop, deriv. irr.
13394: गल्ह r. 1st cl. (गल्हते) To blame, to censure or despise: see गर्ह.
13395: गवय m. (-यः) 	 1. A species of ox, the Gayal, erroneously classed by Hindu writers amongst the kinds of deer, (Bos gavæus.) 	 2. A monkey chief: the son of VAIVASWATA. 	 f. (-यी) The female Gayal. E. गु to sound, and अय affix, form irregular; or गो a cow, and य from या to obtain. affix ड, resembling a cow.
13396: गवराज m. (-जः) A bull.  E. गो a cow, affix अण् गव relating to a cow, and राजन् king, chief; the more direct compound makes गोराज.
13397: गवल m. (-लः) A wild buffalo. 	 n. (-लं) Buffalo's horn.  E. गु to sound, अलच् aff.
13398: गवाक्ष m. (-क्षः) 	 1. An air hole, a loop hole, a round window, a bull's eye, &c. 	 2. A monkey chief; one of the sons of VAIVASWATA. E. गो a ray of light, अक्ष् to spread, affix घञ्, or गो an ox, and अक्ष an eye; ox eyed. 	 f. (क्षी) A sort of cucumber, (Cucumis madraspata-nus.) 	 2. A plant, (Clitoria ternatea:) see अपराजिता.  E. गो the earth, अक्ष् to spread, affix अण् or ङीप्.
13399: गवाक्षजाल n. (-लं) A lattice, a jalousie, trellice work.  E. गवाक्ष, and जाल a net.
13401: गवादन n. (-नं) Pasture or meadow grass. 	 f. (-नी) 	 1. A hay rack, a trough for holding grass out of which cattle feed. 	 2. A species of cucum-ber, (Cucumis madraspatanus, or, according to some, C. coloquin-tida.) 	 3. A plant, (Clitoria ternatea:) see the preceding.  E. गो a cow, अदन food, fem. affix ङीप्.
13402: गवालूक m. (-कः) The Gayal, (Bos gavæus:) see गवय.  E. गो a cow, लोक to see, with आङ् prefixed, deriv. irr.; in appearance a cow.
13403: गवाशन m. (-नः) An outcaste.  E. गव, and अशन who eats, eating beef.
13405: गवाह्निक n. (-कं) A day's feed for a cow.  E. गो and आह्निक daily.
13406: गवीश्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Owner of kine.  E. गो a cow, ईश्वर a lord or master.
13407: गवेडु m. (-डुः) A cloud. 	 f. (-डुः) A kind of grain, (Coix barbata.)  E. गो a cow or the earth, एड् to preserve, उ affix, or with कन् added गवेडुका also गवेधु, &c.
13408: गवेधु f. (-धुः) Coix barbata: see the preceding; also with कन् added गवेधुका.
13409: गवेरुक n. (-कं) Red chalk.  E. गो light or colour, ईर् to send, affix वुन्, and the penultimate changed to उ irregularly; also read गवेधुक.
13411: गवेष r. 10th cl. (गवेषयति) 	 1. To seek, to hunt for, to search or inquire. 2. To make an effort.
13412: गवेषण nf. (-णं-णा) Research, inquiry after any thing, (physical or phi-losophical, &c.)  E. गवेष to inquire, affix युच्.
13413: गवेषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sought, inquired for.  E. गवेष to search or hunt, affix क्त.
13414: गवोद्व m. (-द्वः) An excellent cow.  E. गो a cow, and उद्व implying excel-lence; the compound remains masculine.
13415: गव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 	 1. Of or belonging to a cow, (as milk, curds, &c.) 2. Proper or fit for cattle. 	 nf. (-व्यं-व्या) A bowstring. 	 f. (-व्या) 	 1. A multitude of cows. 	 2. A measure of two Kos: see गव्यूति. 	 n. (-व्यं) A colouring substance, a yellow pigment or dye.  E. गो a cow, &c. and यत् aff.
13416: गव्यूत n. (-तं) 	 1. A Kos, a measure of length equal 4000 cubits. 	 2. A measure of two Kos: see the next.
13417: गव्यूति mf. (-तिः) A measure of two Kos, a league measured by 2000 Dands or fathoms.  E. गो the earth, यु to join, क्तिन् affix, deriv. irr.
13418: गह r. 10th cl. (-गहयति) To be thick or impervious as a forest, &c.
13419: गह m. (-ह) A cave. 	 2. A forest.  E. गह् to be impervious अच् aff.
13420: गहन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Impervious, inaccessible. 	 n. (-नं) 	 1. A wood, a thicket. 	 2. A cave. 	 3. Pain, distress.  E. गाह् to tremble, &c. affix युच्, and the radical vowel made short; or गह् to be thick, affix as before.
13421: गहीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Relating to a cave or a thicket, which is deep and difficult of access, impervious.  E. गह a thicket, छ aff.
13422: गह्वर nf. (-रं-री) A cave, a cavern, a grotto, a recess in a rock or moun-tain, &c. 	 n. (-रं) 	 1. A thicket, a wood. 	 2. Hypocrisy. 	 3. Weeping, crying, but not violently. 	 m. (-रः) An arbour, a bower.  E. गाह to be agitated, and ष्वरच् Unadi affix, the radical vowel made short.
13423: गा r. 1st cl. (ङ) गाङ् (गाते) To go, to go to or towards. r. 3rd. cl. but restricted to the Vedas. (जगाति) To praise.
13424: गा f. (-गा) A verse or metrical composition.  E. गै to sing, क and टाप् affixes: see ग.
13425: गाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Belonging or relating to the river Ganges. 	 m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. A name of KARTIKEYA. 	 2. A name of BHISHMA  E. गङ्गा the GANGA, अण् aff.
13426: गाङ्गट m. (-टः) A prawn or shrimp.  E. गाङ्ग relating to the Ganges, and अट what goes, form irr.; also गाङ्गाट or with कन् affix गाङ्गाटक.
13427: गाङ्गटय m. (-यः) A shrimp or prawn.  E. गङ्गा, अट् to go, and ढक् affix also गङ्गाटेय, and गाङ्गाट, &c.
13428: गाङ्गायनि f. (-निः) 	 1. A name of BHISHMA. 	 2. A name of KARTIKEYA, E. गङ्गा the personified river, (as the wife of SANTANU, in the first instance, and mother of the hero; and in the second, as the receiver of KARTIKEYA, the son of SIVA, from AGNI, the god of fire.) and फिञ् patronymic aff.
13429: गाङ्गेय m. (-यः) 	 1. BHISHMA. 	 2. KARTIKEYA: see the preceding. 	 3. The Hilsa or Illias fish, (Cluponodon ilisha, HAM.) 	 n. (-यं) 	 1. Gold. 	 2. A grass: see कशेरु. 	 3. A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) E. गङ्गा the Ganges, ढक् affix of descent, &c.
13430: गाङ्गेरुकी f. (-की) A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides, but it is vari-ously described.)  E. गाङ्ग Ganges water, ईर् to go or grow, उकन् aff.
13432: गाङ्गौघ n. (-घं) The current of the Ganges.  E. गाङ्ग Gangetic, and ओघ heap.
13434: गाढ adv. 	 n. (-ढं) adj. 	 mfn. (ढः-ढा-ढं) 	 1. Excessive, much, very much, heavy, oppressive, &c. 	 2. Firm, strong. 	 3. Hard. 	 4. Close.  E. गाह् to agitate, affix क्त, deriv. irr.
13435: गाढता f. (-ता) 	 1. Firmness, hardness. 	 2. Excess.  E. गाढ, and तल affix; also with त्व, गाढत्वं.
13436: गाढमुष्टि mfn. (-ष्टिः-ष्टिः-ष्टि) Miserly, niggard, avaricious, close-fisted m. (-ष्टिः) A scymitar, a large sacrificial knife.  E. गाढ heavy or close, and मुष्टि gripe.
13437: गाणपत mfn. (-तः-ती-तं) Relating to GANESHA, or the leader of a troop, &c.  E. गणपति, and अण् aff.
13438: गाणपत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्यी-त्यं) Relating to GANAPATI or GANESHA. 	 m. (-त्यः) A worshipper of him. 	 n. (-त्यं) 	 1. Worship of him. 	 2. Chieftainship, presidency.  E. गणपति, and ष्यण् aff.
13439: गाणिक्य n. (-क्यं) An assembly of harlots.  E. गणिका a whore, यञ् aff.
13440: गाण्डिव mn. (-वः-वं) 	 1. The bow of ARJUNA. 	 2. Any bow; also गाण्डीव.
13441: गाण्डीव mn. (-वः-वं) 	 1. The bow of ARJUNA. 	 2. Any bow.  E. गाण्डी what affects the cheek, from गण्ड with इञ् affix, then व added, and इ final lengthened; or continuing short, गाण्डिव.
13442: गाण्डीविन् m. (-वी) A name of ARJUNA.  E. गाण्डीव ARJUNA'S bow, and इनि aff.
13443: गातु mfn. (-तुः-तुः-तु) Angry, wrathful. 	 m. (-तुः) 	 1. A Gandharba or celestial quirister. 	 2. The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. 	 3. A large black bee. 	 4. A singer.  E. गै to sing, Unadi affix तु.
13444: गातृ mf. (-ता-त्री) A male or female singer.  E. गै to sing, तृच् aff.
13445: गात्र n. (-त्रं) 	 1. The body. 	 2. The fore quarter of an elephant. 	 3. A limb, a member.  E. गम् to go, ष्ट्रन् Unadi affix, the radical final is reject-ed, and the vowel made long.
13446: गात्रभङ्गा f. (-ङ्गा) Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.)  E. गात्र the body, and भङ्गा what breaks or hurts.

13559: गीति f. (-तिः) 	 1. Sing, singing, 2. A kind of poetical metre, a form of the Aryya metre, in which the stanza consists of four lines of twelve and eighteen syllabic instants alternately.  E. गै to sing, affix क्तिन्.
13560: गीरथ m. (-थः) A name of VRIHASPATI.  E. गी speech, and रथ a car, the conveyer of words.
13561: गीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 	 1. Praised. 	 2. Swallowed.  E. गॄ to swallow or make known, affix क्त.
13562: गीर्णि f. (-र्णिः) 	 1. Swallowing. 	 2. Fame, celebrity. 	 3. Praise, applause E. गृ to swallow, &c. affix क्तिन्.
13563: गीर्देवी f. (-वी) The goddess SARASWATI.  E. गी speech, and देवी a goddess, the goddess of language.
13564: गीर्व्वाण m. (-णः) A deity, a god.  E. गीः speech, and वाण an arrow or wea-pon in general, whose fiat or word is his weapon; or गी with वन to desire, affix अण्, desiring hymns, prayers, &c. it is also written गीर्ब्बाण.
13565: गीष्पति m. (-तिः) 	 1. A name of VRIHASPATI, regent of JUPITER and preceptor of the gods. 	 2. A Pandit or learned teacher.  E. गिर् speech, in the nominative case, गीः and पति master, Visarga becomes स and स is here changed irregularly to ष the compound however is sometimes written differently, thus गीःपति, गीर्पति or गीस्पति.
13566: गु(ओ, शि) r. 6th cl. (गुवति) To stool, to void excrement. (ङ) गुङ् r. 1st cl. (गवते) To sound inarticulately.
13567: गुग्गुल m. (-लः) A gum resin: see the next.
13568: गुग्गुलु m. (-लुः) 	 1. A fragrant gum resin, Bdellium or the exudation of the Amyris agallochum. 	 2. A species of morunga, (M. hyperanthe-ra.)  E. गुज् (here said to mean) disease, and गुड to perfume, affixes क and उ, ड change to ल; also गुग्गुल.
13569: गुच्छ m. (-च्छः) 	 1. A cluster of blossoms. 	 2. A clump of grass. 	 3. A neck-lace of thirty-two strings. 	 4. A pearl necklace. 	 5. A peacock's plumage or bundle of peacock's feathers. 	 6. A bundle. 	 f. (-च्छी) A species of Bonduz: see करञ्ज  E. गु to sound, च्छ affix, or गुध् to play, and च्छक् affix, where bees, &c. sport.
13570: गुच्छक m. (-कः) 	 1. A cluster of blossoms. 	 2. A clump of grass. 	 3. A kind of necklace. 	 4. A peacock's plumage, a bundle of peacock's feathers. E. कन् added to the preceding; also गुत्सक.
13571: गुच्छपत्र m. (-त्रः) The palm tree.  E. गुच्छ a cluster, and पत्र a leaf.
13572: गुच्छफला f. (-ला) 	 1. The plantain. 	 2. The vine.  E. गुच्छ a cluster, and फला fruit.
13573: गुच्छार्द्ध m. (-र्द्धः) A necklace of thirty-four strings.  E. गुच्छ a large neck-lace, and अर्द्ध a part; also गुत्सार्द्ध.
13574: गुच्छाल m. (-लः) A species of grass. (Andropogon schœnanthus.)  E. गुच्छ and अल to fit for, अच् aff.
13575: गुज r. 1st cl. (गोजति) or (शि) r. 6th cl. (गुजति) or (इ) गुजि r. 1st cl. (गुञ्जति) To sound, to sound inarticulately, to buz, to hum, &c.
13576: गुज्जरी f. (-री) One of the Raginis, perhaps more correctly गुर्ज्जरी.
13577: गुञ्ज m. (-ञ्जः) A cluster of blossoms, a nosegay. 	 f. (-ञ्जा) 	 1. A small shrub, (Abrus precatorius,) bearing a red and black berry, which forms the smallest of the jeweller's weights. 	 2. The berry which averages about 15-16 grains troy, or the artificial weight called by this name, weighing about 23. 16 grains: see रक्तिका &c. 	 3. A kettle drum. 	 4. A low murmuring sound. 	 5. A tavern. 	 6. Reflection, meditation.  E. गुजि to sound, affix क where the bees buz.
13578: गुञ्जकृत् m. (-त्) A large black bee.  E. गुञ्ज a low tone, and कृत् who makes.
13579: गुञ्जत् mfn. (-ञ्जन्-ञ्जन्ती-ञ्जत्) Buzzing, humming, making a low murmuring sound.  E. गुजि to sound, शतृ aff.
13580: गुञ्जन n. (-नं) Sounding low and deep, as buzzing, murmuring, &c. E. गुजि to sound, and ल्युट् aff.
13581: गुञ्जिका f. (-का) The Ratti or Gunja seed, considered as equal to three barley-corns: see गुञ्जा  E. गुञ्जा and कन् aff.
13582: गुञ्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Uttered in a low tone, murmured, &c. 	 n. (-तं) Sounding, murmuring, buzzing.  E. गुजि and क्त aff.
13583: गुटिका f. (-का) 	 1. A pill, a bolus, any small globe or ball. 	 2. A small pustule. 	 3. The cocoon of the silk worm.  E. गुड to surround, affix क्वुन्, ड changed to ट.
13584: गुठ (इ) गुठि r. 10th cl. (गुण्ठयति) To surround, to envelope or enclose: with अव, to veil, to screen.
13585: गुड(शि) r. 6th cl. (गुडति) To defend, to guard or preserve. (इ) गुडि r. 1st and 10th cls. (गुण्डति गुण्डयति) 	 1. To surround, to enclose, 2. To pound, to grind, to reduce to powder. 	 3. (According to some authorities,) To preserve.
13586: गुड mfn. (-डः-डा-डं) Round, globular, m. (-डः) 	 1. A globe or ball. 	 2. Treacle, molasses, the first thickening of the juice of the cane by boiling. 	 3. An elephant's trappings or armour. 	 4. A mouthful. 	 f. (-डा) 1. A plant, (Euphorbia tirucalli:) see स्नुही 2. Powder, pounded substance.  E. गुङ् to sound, affix ड.
13587: गुडक m. (-कः) A conserve, a drug prepared with treacle. 	 n. (-कं) Treacle E. गुड and कन् added.
13588: गुडकरी f. (-री) One of the female personifications of the musical modes.
13589: गुडची f. (-ची) A plant, (Menispermum glabrum:) see गुडुची.
13590: गुडतृण n. (-णं) Sugar cane.  E. गुड raw sugar, and तृण grass.
13591: गुडत्वच् n. (-त्वक्) The aromatic bark of the Laurus cassia.  E. गुड sugar, and त्वच् skin, bark, sweet-bark; also गुडत्वच.
13592: गुडत्वच n. (-चं) 	 1. Mace. 	 2. Cassia bark.  E. गुड sugar, sweet as sugar, त्वच् bark, and अच added in this form of the compound.
13593: गुडदारु m. (-रुः) Sugar cane.  E. गुड raw sugar, and दारु wood.
13594: गुडधेनु f. (-नुः) Sugar piled up for distribution at certain religious rites. E. गुड and धेनु a cow.
13595: गुडपिष्ट n. (-ष्टं) A sort of sweetmeat, flour or rice and sugar, ground and boiled together.  E. गुड and पिष्ट ground.
13596: गुडपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A kind of bassia, (B. latifolia.)  E. गुड sugar, and पुष्प flower; the flowers being full of saccharine matter.
13597: गुडफल m. (-लः) A tree, commonly Pilu, (Careya arborea, &c.) see पीलु E. गुड and फल fruit, the fruit yielding Gur or saccharine matter.
13598: गुडमिश्र n. (-श्रं) A sort of cake or sweetmeat, flour or rice and coarse sugar ground and boiled together.  E. गुड, and मिश्र mixed.
13599: गुडमूल m. (-लः) A kind of amaranth, (A. polygamus;) also अल्पमारिष. E. गुड, and मूल root; having a root as sweet as Gur.
13600: गुडल n. (-लं) A spirituous liquor distilled from molasses, a sort of rum. E. गुड sugar, and ल what requires.
13601: गुडशर्क्करा f. (-रा) Sugar, refined sugar.  E. गुड molasses, and शर्क्करा sugar or sand.
13602: गुडशिग्रु m. (-ग्रुः) A red sort of morunga: see शोभाञ्जन.  E. गुड sugar, शिग्रु morunga.
13604: गुडाकेश m. (-शः) 	 1. A name of SIVA. 	 2. A title of ARJUNA.  E. गुडा Eup-horbia, and केश the hair; the hair forming matted locks, resem-bling in shape the leaves of the Euphorbia: again, गुडिका sloth, and ईश paramount; subduing indolence.
13605: गुडाशय m. (-यः) A mountain Pilu: see गुडफल.
13606: गुडिका f. (-का) A pill, a bolus.  E. गुड to be round, वुन aff.
13607: गुडुची f. (-ची) A plant: see the next.
13608: गुडूची f. (-ची) A creeper, commonly called Guricha, (Menisperum glab-rum.)  E. गुड to preserve, (from disease,) ऊचट् affix; also with pen. vowel short गुडुची.
13609: गुडेर m. (-रः) A mouthful.  E. गुड to surround, एरक् Unadi aff.
13610: गुडेरक m. (-कः) A mouthful.  E. गुड to preserve, एरक् affix, and कन् add-ed; also गुडेर.
13611: गुडोद्भवा f. (-वा) Sugar.  E. गुड, and उद्भव produced.
13612: गुडौदन n. (-नं) Boiled rice and coarse sugar.  E. गुड, and ओदन rice.
13613: गुण r. 10th cl. (गुणयति) 	 1. To invite. 	 2. To advise. 	 3. To multiply.
13614: गुण m. (-णः) 	 1. A quality, attribute, or property in general. 	 2. A pro-perty of all created things; three are particularized, the Satwa, Raja and Tama, or principles of truth or existence, passion or foul-ness, and darkness or ignorance. 	 3. A means of defence, one of six expedients in government, as, peace, war, a march, a halt, a stra-tagem, and recourse to protection: see सन्धि &c. 	 4. Form, shape, &c. or property of the body. 	 5. Knowledge, ignorance, &c. or quality of the mind. 	 6. Heroism, valor, &c. 	 7. White, black, &c. or the attributes of color. 	 8. An organ of sense. 	 9. A string in general. 	 10. A bow-string. 	 11. Abandoning, leaving. 	 12. A cook. 	 13. A name of Bhima. 	 14. Secondary subordinate. 	 15. Excellence, merit, free-dom from fault or blemish. 	 16. (In arithmetic,) The given coeffici-ent of any number. 	 17. (In geometry,) The chord of an arc. 	 18. (In grammar,) The substitution of e, o, ar and al for i, u, ri, lri. 	 19. (In rhetoric,) Consistency of plan, elegance of expression, &c. as the merits of a composition. 	 20. In composition with numerals, multiplication, as द्विगुण twice, त्रिगुण thrice. 	 f. (-णा) A plant of the fibers of which bow-strings are made: see मूर्व्वा.  E. गुण to address or advice, affix क्त.
13615: गुणक m. (-कः) 	 1. A numerator, reckoner. 	 2. (In arithmetic,) The mul-tiplier.  E. गुण to count, क्कुन् aff.
13616: गुणकार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Who counts, &c. 	 m. (-रः) A name of BHIMASENA E. गुण and कार who makes; BHIMA performed the duties of a cook at the time when all the Pandava princes become servants to VIRAT.
13617: गुणगान n. (-नं) Panegyric, praise.  E. गुण, and गान singing.
13618: गुणग्रहण n. (-णं) Acknowledging or appreciating merit.  E. गुण, and ग्रहण taking.
13619: गुणग्राहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) Who judges or appreciates good qualities, E. गुण and ग्राहिन् who seizes.
13620: गुणगृह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) 	 1. Suited to good qualities. 	 2. Admiring or attached to merit.  E. गुण and गृह्य to be caught by.
13621: गुणघातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) A detractor, a calumniator, envious, cen-sorious.  E. गुण and घातिन् who destroys.
13622: गुणज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) One who knows how to appreciate men or thing, knowing or judging of their merits.  E. गुण, and ज्ञ who knows.
13623: गुणतस् ind. 	 1. According to property or quality. 	 2. According to desert. E. गुण, and तसि aff.
13624: गुणता f. (-ता) 	 1. Excellence, the possession of good qualities. 	 2. Subs-tantiality, possession of attributes or qualities in general. 	 3. Multiplication.  E. गुण and तल् affix; also with त्व affix गुणत्वं.
13625: गुणत्रय n. (-यं) The three properties of nature; purity, passion, and darkness.  E. गुण and त्रय triple; also गुणत्रितयं.
13626: गुणदोषपरीक्षण n. (-णं) Test or investigation of merits and faults.  E. गुण, दोष fault, परीक्षण trying.
13627: गुणधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) The virtue incident to the possession of certain qualities, as clemency is the virtue of royalty, &c.  E. गुण a property, and धर्म्म virtue.
13628: गुणन n. (-नं) 	 1. Describing, relating to qualities. 	 2. Enumerating. 	 3. Mulitiplication.  E. गुण to number, ल्युट् aff.
13629: गुणनिका f. (-का) 	 1. Dance, the science or profession of dancing, acting &c. 	 2. Determining the reading of a manuscript, &c. 	 3. A cypher. 4. The prologue or introduction to a drama. A necklace.  E. कन् added to गुणनी.
13630: गुणनी f. (-नी) Examining books, studying, collating, and correcting copies, &c.  E. गुण to advise, affix ल्यट् and ङीप्.
13631: गुणनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. To be advised. 	 2. To be multiplied. 	 3. To be enumerated. 	 m. (-यः) Practice, practising any thing, but especially science or study. 	 n. (-यं) The multiplicand.  E. गुण to advise, &c. अनीयर् aff.
13632: गुणपूग n. (-गं) Great merit.  E. गुण, and पूग a head.
13633: गुणप्रकर्ष m. (-र्षः) Great merit, excellence.  E. गुण and प्रकर्ष eminence.
13634: गुणप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Attached to merit, fond of excellence. E. and गुण, and प्रिय fond of.
13635: गुणभ्रंश m. (-शः) The loss of all good qualities.  E. गुण good property, and भ्रंश fall, loss.
13636: गुणमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) 	 1. Endowed with consisting of properties. 	 2. Possessed of merit.  E. गुण, and मयट् aff.
13637: गुणमहत् n. (-हत्) Great merit, superior qualities.  E. गुण, and महत् great.
13638: गुणयुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Having virtues or properties.  E. गुण, and युक्त joined.
13639: गुणलक्षण n. (-णं) Mark or indication of internal property.  E. गुण, and लक्षण mark.
13640: गुणलयनिका f. (-का) A tent.  E. गुण rope, ली to bind, ल्युट् and ङीप् affix, with कन् added; also गुणलयनी.
13641: गुणलुब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Desirous of merit, attached to excellence. E. गुण, and लुब्ध covetous.
13642: गुणवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 	 1. Possessing attributes. 	 2. Endowed with good qualities. 	 3. Tied, bound, &c.  E. गुण quality, and मतुप् poss. aff.
13643: गुणवत्तम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Excellent.  E. गुणवन् and तमप् aff.
13644: गुणवत्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Excellent.  E. गुणवत् and तरप् aff.
13645: गुणवत्ता f. (-त्ता) Excellence.  E. गुणवत् and तल् affix; also with त्त्व, गुणवत्त्वं.
13646: गुणवाचक n. (-कं) An adjective or attributive noun.  E. गुण, and वाचक a word.
13647: गुणवैशेष्य n. (-ष्यं) Preeminence of merit or of any property.  E. गुण, and वैशेष्य superiority.
13648: गुणवृक्षक m. (-कः) A mast.  E. गुण a rope, and वृक्ष a tree, कन् affix simi-litude; also गुणवृक्षः.
13649: गुणश्लाघा f. (-घा) Praise, encomium.  E. गुण, and श्लाघा praise.
13650: गुणसम्पद् f. (-पत् or -पद्) Great merit.  E. गुण, and सम्पद् wealth.
13651: गुणसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Association with properties or qualities.  E. गुण, and सङ्ग combination.
13652: गुणसङ्ग्रह m. (-हः) A collection of merits or properties.  E. गुण, and सङ्ग्रह collection.
13653: गुणसागर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Endowed with all good qualities. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A name of BRAHMA. 	 2. A form of BUDDHA, a Bauddha.  E. गुण excell-ence, and सागर the ocean; an ocean of desert.
13654: गुणस्तुति f. (-तिः) Panegyric, encomium.  E. गुण, and स्तुति praise.
13655: गुणहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Void of merit. 	 2. Free from properties.  E. गुण, and हीन void of.
13656: गुणाकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Possessing all excellences. 	 m. (-रः) A name of BUDDHA the founder of the Bauddha sect.  E. गुण attribute, espe-cially good, and आकर a mine; a mine of merit.
13657: गुणातीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Freed from or beyond all properties.  E. गुण, and अतीत passed.
13658: गुणानुरोध m. (-धः) Conformity or suitableness to good qualities, &c. E. गुण, and अनुरोध concurrence.
13659: गुणान्तर n. (-रं) 	 1. Species or sort of merit. 	 2. Variety of property or quality.  E. गुण, and अन्तर difference.
13660: गुणान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Having attributes or qualities. 	 2. Excellent, good, endowed with virtues.  E. गुण, and अन्वित possessed of.
13661: गुणापवाद m. (-दः) Detraction.  E. गुण, and अपवाद reproach.
13662: गुणाभास m. (-सः) Semblance of qualities.  E. गुण, and आभास appearance.
13663: गुणाश्रय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Virtuous, excellent, able, endowed with good qualities.  E. गुण, and आश्रय a Anasylum.
13664: गुणिगण m. (-णः) A number of virtuous persons.  E. गुणिन्, and गण a troop.
13665: गुणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Multiplied, (arithmetically.) 	 2. Collected, hea-ped together.  E. गुण to advise, &c. affix क्त.
13666: गुणिद्वैध n. (-धं) Equality of merit on two sides.  E. गुणिन् and द्वैध duality.
13667: गुणिन् mfn. (-णी-णिनी-णि) Endowed with good qualities. 	 m. (-णी) A bow. E. गुण a quality, &c. and इनि aff.
13668: गुणीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Made secondary or subordinate. 	 2. Invested with attributes, &c. 	 3. Varied according to its qualities. 	 4. Hav-ing a certain force or application, (a word, &c.)  E. गुण and भूत be-come, with च्वि augment.
13669: गुणेश्वर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Having good qualities, &c. 	 m. (-रः) The name of a mountain, according to some, Chitrakuta or Comptah in Bundelcund.  E. गुण qualities, and ईश्वर master or possessor.
13670: गुणोत्कर्ष m. (-र्षः) Excellence, endowment with superior qualities.  E. गुण and उत्कर्ष abundance.
13671: गुणोत्कीर्त्तन n. (-नं) Panegyric, eulogium.  E. गुण and उत्कीर्त्तन celebrating.
13672: गुणोत्कृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Superior in merit or in good qualities.  E. गुण, and उत्कृष्ट best.

14002: गोपीथ m. (-थः) preserving, protecting. 	 n. (-थ) A holy place, a place of pilgrimage.  E. गोप preserving, and थक Unadi affix, deriv. irr.
14003: गोपुच्छ m. (-च्छः) 	 1. A cowtail. 	 2. A sort of necklace, one of four or thirty-four strings. 	 3. A sort of monkey.  E. गो a cow, and पुच्छ a tail, resembling or possessing a cow's tail. गोः पुच्छ इव पुच्छो यस्य ।
14004: गोपुटी f. (-टी) Large cardamoms.  E. गोरिव पुट मस्याः स्थू लैलायाम् ।
14005: गोपुटिक n. (-कं) A temple or edifice consecrated to SIVA'S bull.  E. गो a cow, and पुट् to enclose, affix इकन्.
14006: गोपुर n. (-रं) 	 1. A town gate. 	 2. A gate in general. 	 3. The ornamented gateway of a temple. 	 4. A kind of grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) E. पर अग्रगमने क गवां पुरं गवा जलेन पूर्य्यते पॄ घञर्थे क वा ।
14007: गोपुरीष n. (-षं) Cow-dung.  E. गो, and पुरीष dung.
14008: गोपेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A name of KRISHNA or VISHNU.  E. गोप a cowherd, and इन्द्र lord or chief.
14009: गोपेश m. (-शः) 	 1. A name of SAKYA MUNI, a Buddha. 	 2. A name of KRISHNA. 	 3. A chief herdsman, the keeper or owner of kine. 	 4. A name of NANDA.  E. गोप cowherd, and ईश lord.
14010: गोप्तृ mfn. (-प्ता-प्त्री-प्तृ) A preserver, A protector, one who defends or cherishes.  E. गुप् to preserve, &c. affix तृच्.
14011: गोप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) 	 1. To be cherished or preserved. 	 2. To be kept secret or hidden. 	 3. To be kept, to be taken care of. 	 m. (-प्यः) 1. A slave. 	 2. The son of a female slave.  E. गुप् to preserve, &c. कर्मणि यत् aff.
14012: गोप्यक m. (-कः) A servant or slave.  E. कन् added to the proceding.
14013: गोप्याधि f. (-धिः) A pledge, that is not be used, but to be carefully preserved.  E. गोप्य to be preserved, and आधि a pledge.
14014: गोप्रकाण्ड n. (-ण्डं) An excellent cow.  E. गो a cow, and प्रकाण्ड excellent; the compound is always neuter. प्रशस्तो गौ नित्यसमासः परनिपातः ।
14015: गोप्रचार m. (-रः) Pasturage ground.  E. गो, and प्रचार going. प्रचरति अस्मिन् प्र + चर अधारे घञ् ।
14017: गोबध m. (-धः) Killing a cow.  E. गो, and बध killing.
14018: गोबाल m. (-लः) The hair of a cow.  E. गो, and बाल hair. षष्ठीतत्पुरुषः ।
14019: गोभण्डीर m. (-रः) A water fowl.  E. गो water, भटि to sound affix ईरन्.
14020: गोम r. 10th cl. (गोमयति) To smear, to anoint.
14021: गोमक्षिका f. (-का) A gadfly.  E. गो, a cow, and मक्षिका a fly stinging cattle. गोः क्लेशदायिका मक्षिका (डांँस्) ।
14022: गोमण्डल n. (-लं) The earth, the globe. गोसमूहे.  E. गो, and मण्डल sphere. षष्ठीतत्पुरुषः ।
14023: गोमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Possessing herds, rich in cattle. 	 f. (-मती) The name of a river, the Goomti, in the province of Oude. 	 2. A prayer or formula of the Vedas to be repeated during expiation for killing a cow.  E. गो a cow or water, and मतुप् aff. गौरस्ति अस्य ।
14024: गोमतल्लिका f. (-का) A tractable and good cow.  E. गो a cow, मतल्लिका excellent.
14025: गोमध्यमध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) Slender in the waist.  E. गो a cow &c. मध्य middle: repeated.
14026: गोमन्त m. (-न्तः) 	 1. The name of a mountain. 	 2. An owner of cattle. 3. A herd of cattle.  E. गो the earth, मन् to mind, झ aff.
14027: गोमय mn. (-यः-यं) 	 1. Cowdung. 	 2. The property or nature of a cow. E. गो a cow, and मयट् affix of relation or comprehension.
14028: गोमयच्छत्र n. (-त्रं) A mushroom, a fungus.  E. गोमय cowdung, and छत्र a Chatta or parasol.
14029: गोमयच्छत्रिका f. (-का) A kind of fungus or mushroom.  E. कन् and the fem. form added to the preceding.
14030: गोमयप्रिय n. (-यं) A sort of grass, (Andropogon schœnanthus.) भूतृणे, शिलीन्ध्रे  E. गोमय cow-dung, and प्रिय favourable to.
14031: गोमयोत्था f. (-त्था) A kind of beetle found in cowdung.  E. गोमय cow-dung, and उत्थ what rises or is generated. उद् + स्था-क टाप् ।
14032: गोमयोद्भव m. (-वः) Cassia fistula.  E. गोमय, and उद्भव born, produced, re-quiring manure. गोमयादुद्भवति उद् + भू अच् ।
14033: गोमायु m. (-युः) 	 1. A jackall. 	 2. A kind of Gandharba or celestial mu-sician. 	 3. The bile or bilious humor of the cow.  E. गो sound, &c. मा to measure, and उण् Unadi affix, य inserted, or गो a cow, and मायु bile. गां विकृतां वाचं मिनाति ।
14034: गोमिथुन n. (-नं) A pair of cattle.  E. गो, and मिथुन a couple.
14035: गोमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Rich in herds, &c. 	 m. (-मी) 	 1. The owner of cattle. 	 2. A jackal. 	 3. A worshipper. 	 4. An attendant on a Buddha.  E. गो a cow, &c. मिनि aff. गौरस्ति अस्य मिनि ।
14036: गोमिल m. (-लः) Name of a Muni.
14037: गोमीन m. (-नः) A sort of fish, the bull-fish.  E. गो, and मीन a fish.
14038: गोमुख n. (-खं) 	 1. A house build unevenly or crookedly, viz. with angles, projections, &c. 	 2. A kind of musical instrument, (a sort of horn or trumpet) 	 3. Spreading unguents, plastering, smear-ing. 	 4. A hole in a wall made by thieves, &c. a breach. 	 m. (-खः) 1. A shark. 	 2. A kind of Yaksha; according to the Jainas, a demigod subservient to their deified saints. 	 nf. (-खं-खी) A cloth-bag, containing a rosary into which the hand is thrust to count the beads. 	 f. (-खी) The chasm in the Himalaya mountains through which the Ganges flows, erroneously conceived by the Hindus to be of the shape of a cow's mouth. 	 2. A river in Bengal.  E. गो a cow, and मुख face, having the face of a cow, &c. गोमुखमिव मुखमस्य ।
14039: गोमूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Stupid as an ox.  E. गो, and मूढ foolish.
14040: गोमूत्र n. (-त्रं) Cow's urine.  E. गो, and मूत्र urine. षष्ठीतत्पुरुषः ।
14041: गोमूत्रिका f. (-का) 	 1. A kind of grass, described as growing in corn fields, of a reddish colour, and eaten by cattle, commonly Tam-bada (ताम्बड) 	 2. A verse the second half of which repeats nearly all the syllables of the first. 	 3. A form of calculation.  E. गो, मूत्र urine, ठन् affix; operating on cows as a diuretic. गोर्मूत्रस्येव गतिरस्ति अत्र ।
14042: गोमेद m. (-दः) A yellow gem: see the next.
14043: गोमेदक mn. (-कः-कं) 	 1. A gem or precious stone brought from the Himalaya and Indus, described as of four sorts, white, pale yellow, red, and dark blue, perhaps varieties of a gate. 2. A kind of poison: see काकोल. 	 6. Smearing the body with un-guents.  E. गो the eye, मिद् to anoint, &c. affix अच् and कन्.
14044: गोमेदसन्निभ m. (-भः) Chalcedony or opal.  E. गोमेद, and सन्निभ what resem-bles.
14045: गोमेध m. (-धः) The offering or sacrifice of a cow.  E. गो a cow, and मेध sacrifice. मेध-वधे आधारे घञ् । षष्ठीतत्पुरुषः ।
14046: गोयान n. (-नं) 	 1. A cart. 	 2. A carriage drawn by oxen.  E. गो, and यान a vehicle.
14047: गोयुग n. (-गं) A yoke of oxen.  E. गो, and युग a pair.
14048: गोरक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) A cow keeper, the cherisher or preserver of kine. m. (-क्षः) 	 1. The orange. 	 2. Keeping or tending cattle. 	 3. A name of SIVA. 	 f. (-क्षी) A small shrub.  E. गो a cow, and रक्ष who preserves.
14049: गोरक्षक m. (-कः) A cow keeper, one who tends cattle.  E. कन् added to the last.
14050: गोरक्षजम्बू f. (-म्बूः) 	 1. Wheat. 	 2. A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides;) also गाङ्गेरुकी. 	 3. The fruit of the jujube.  E. गोरक्ष, and जम्बू a rose-apple.
14051: गोरक्षण n. (णं) Tending or taking charge of cattle  E. गो, and रक्षण protecting.
14052: गोरक्षतण्डुला f. (-ला) A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.)  E. गोरक्ष cow-preserving, and तण्डुल grain, used in medicines for cattle.
14053: गोरक्ष्य n. (-क्ष्यं) Tending cattle.  E. गो, and रक्ष्य to be preserved.
14054: गोरङ्कु m. (-ङ्कुः) 	 1. A water-fowl. 	 2. A prisoner, a person or animal confined. 	 3. A naked man, a mendicant, &c. wandering about without clothes.  E. गो water, sky, &c. रङ्कु a kind of deer: as it were, the water deer, &c. गवा वाचा रङ्कुरिव ।
14055: गोरण n. (-णं) Effort, exertion.  E. गुर् to make effort, affix ल्युट्; also गुरण.
14056: गोरस mn. (-सः-सं) 	 1. Milk. 	 2. Curdled or coagulated milk. 	 3. Butter-milk.  E. गो a cow, and रस juice.
14057: गोरसज n. (-जं) 	 1. Butter-milk. 	 2. Curds,  E. गोरस, and ज produced.
14058: गोराज m. (-जः) A bull.  E. गो a cow, and राजन् a king, टच् aff.
14059: गोराटी f. (-टी) A small bird, (Turdus salica.  E. गो speech, रट् to utter, affix अच्, feminine affix ङीष्.
14060: गोरुत n. (-तं) A measure of distance equal to two Crosa or Cos: see गव्यूतिः ।
14061: गोरोच n. (-चं) Yellow orpiment.  E. गो, and रोच what shines. गवा किरणेन रोचते रोच-अच् ।
14062: गोरोचना f. (-ना) A bright yellow pigment prepared from the urine of a cow, or vomited in the shape of scibulæ by the animal; or accor-ding to some, found in the head of a cow; it is employed in paint-ing and dying, and is of especial virtue in marking the foreheads of the Hindus with the Tilaka or sectarial mark; it is also used in medicine as a sedative, tonic, and anthelmintic remedy, &c.  E. गो a cow, रुचि to shine, affix ल्युट्. गोभ्यो जाता रोचना हरिद्रा ।
14063: गोर्द्द n. (-र्द्दं) The brain.  E. गुर् to endeavor, and दन् affix; also गोद.
14064: गोल mn. (-लः-लं) A circle, a ball, any thing round or globular. 	 m. (-लः) 1. A widow's bastard. 	 2. Myrrh. 	 3. A tree, (Vangueria spinosa.) 4. A globe, celestial or terrestrial. 	 5. Conjunction of planets, or the presence of several in one sign. 	 f. (-ला) 	 1. A globe. a sphere, a Mandala. 	 2. A wooden ball with which children play. 	 3. A woman's female friend. 	 4. The Godavari river. 	 5. A large water jar. 	 6. Ink. 7. Red arsenic. 	 8. A name of the goddess DURGA.  E. गो heaven, water, &c. and ल what gets or receives; again, गुड् to be round, &c. affix अच् and ड changed to ल. डलयोरैक्यात् ।
14065: गोलक m. (-कः) 	 1. A wooden ball for playing with, or any thing globu-lar, a sphere, a globe, &c. 	 2. A widow's bastard. 	 3. A water jar. 4. Gum myrrh, 5. Pease. 	 n. (-कं) The heaven of KRISHNA.  E. कन् added to the preceding. गुड-ण्वुल् डस्य लः ।
14066: गोलाङ्गूल m. (-लः) A kind of monkey, described as of a black colour, and having a tail like a cow.  E. गो a cow, and लाङ्गूल a tail.
14067: गोलाध्याय m. (-यः) The division of mathematical science which treats of the spheres, spherics.  E. गोल the globe, and अध्याय chapter.
14068: गोलास m. (-सः) A mushroom, a kind of fungus springing from cowdung.
14069: गोलिह m. (-हः) A plant, commonly Ghantaparuli.  E. गो a cow, and लिह to lick, affix क; upon which kine graze. गोभिर्लिह्यते लिह-घञर्थे क ।
14070: गोलीढ m. (-ढः) A plant: see the preceding.  E. गो, and लिह as above, affix क्त. गोभिर्लिह्यते लिह क्त ।
14071: गोलोक n. (-कं) The heaven of KRISHNA.  E. गो a cow, and लोक world.
14072: गोलोमिका f. (-का) A kind of small shrub.  E. गोलोमन् cow's hair, कन् affix, fem. form.
14073: गोलोमी f. (-मी) 	 1. A kind of bent grass, with white blossoms; also श्वेत-दूर्ब्बा. 	 2. Root of sweet flag. Orris root. 	 4. A whore. a harlot. 	 5. A small shrub.  E. गो the earth, &c. and लोमन् hair, the hair of the earth.
14074: गोवन्दनी f. (-नी) A plant bearing a fragrant seed: see प्रियङ्गु  E. गो the earth, and वन्दनी praising.
14075: गोवर्द्धन m. (-नः) A celebrated hill in Brindaban or the country about Mathura: it was upheld by KRISHNA upon one finger, to shelter the cowherds from a storm excited by INDRA, as a test of the for-mer's divinity.  E. गो a cow, and वर्द्धन increasing; pasturing cattle.
14076: गोवर्द्धनधर m. (-रः) A name of KRISHNA or VISHNU.  E. गोवर्द्धन Gober-dhana, and धर who upholds: see the preceding.
14077: गोवशा f. (-शा) A barren cow.  E. गो a cow, and वशा barren.
14078: गोविन्द m. (-न्दः) 	 1. One of the most usual appellations of KRISHNA or VISHNU in that form. 	 2. A name of VRIHASPATI, regent of JUPITER. 	 3. A cow-keeper, one who protects, cherishes or owns cattle.  E. गो language, here the language of the Vedas especially, and विन्द who knows, from विद् to know, with श affix; also गो heaven, a cow, विद् to obtain, by whom heaven is obtained, or who obtains felicity by protecting kine. गां वेदमयीं वाणीं, भुवं धेनुं स्वर्गं वा विन्दति ।
14079: गोविष् f. (-विट्) Cow-dung.  E. गो a cow, and विष् ordure; also गोविष्ठा.
14080: गोवृन्द n. (-न्दं) 	 1. Property in cattle, possession of flocks and herds. 	 2. A herd, a drove of cattle.  E. गो a cow, and वृन्द a heap, a multitude.
14081: गोवृन्दारक m. (-कः) A capital cow.  E. गो a cow, and वृन्दारक affix of pre-eminence.
14082: गोवृष m. (-षः) A bull. N. गो a cow, and वृष best, pre-eminent.
14083: गोव्रज m. (-जः) A station for cattle.  E. गो and व्रज a pen. a fold.
14084: गोशकृत् n. (-कृत्) Cow. dung.  E. गो a cow, and शकृत् ordure.
14085: गोशाल mfn. sub. (-लः-ला-लं) A cow-house. adj. Born in a cow-house. E. गो a cow, and शाला a hall.
14086: गोशीर्ष n. (-र्षं) 	 1. A kind of Sandal, described as of the colour of brass, and of great fragrance. 	 2. The head of a cow.  E. गो a cow, and शीर्ष the head.
14087: गोशीर्षक m. (-कः) A plant; also called Drona pushpa.  E. कन् added to गोशीर्ष.
14088: गोशृङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A tree; also Berbera. 	 n. (-ङ्गं) The horn of a cow.  E. गो, and शृङ्ग a horn.
14089: गोष्ठ r. 1st cl. (गोष्ठते) To assemble, to collect, to heap together.
14090: गोष्ठ mn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठं) 	 1. A cowpen, a fold for cattle, any place where animals are kept. 	 2. A station of cow-herds. 	 f. (-ष्ठी) 	 1. An assembly, a meet-ing. 	 2. Conversation, discourse, dialogue, dispute. 	 3. Family con-nexions, but especially the dependent or junior branches. 	 4. A dramatic composition in one act.  E. गो a cow, and ष्ठ from स्था to stay, with क affix; here meaning the place of abiding, or गोष्ठ to assemble, affix अच्.
14091: गोष्ठवेदिका f. (-का) A mound or altar in a cowpen.  E. गोष्ठ, and वेदिका a mound.
14092: गोष्ठश्व mfn. (-श्वः-श्वं-श्व) Malignant, censorious, envious: especially appli-ed to a person who stays at home, and slanders his neighbours. E. गोष्ठ a cowpen, in the first case used for abode in general, and श्वि to increase, affix ड, who magnifies himself in his own house. 	 m. (-श्वः) A horse in a cowpen.  E. गोष्ठ, and अश्व a horse, the form is irregular.
14093: गोष्ठाष्टमी f. (-मी) A particular holiday: see गोपाष्टमी.
14094: गोष्ठीपति m. (-तिः) 	 1. The chief person in an assembly, a president. 	 2. The master of a family.  E. गोष्ठी, and पति master.
14095: गोष्पद n. (-दं) 	 1. A spot frequented by kine. 	 2. A measure, as much as a cow's footstep will hold. 	 3. The mark or impression of a cow's foot. 	 4. A cow's foot or hoof.  E. गो a cow, and पद for पाद a foot.
14096: गोस m. (-सः) 	 1. Gum myrrh. 	 2. The last watch of the night, early morning or day-break.  E. गो water, dew, and सो to destroy, to absorb; affix ड.
14097: गोसंख्य m. (-ख्यः) A herdsman, a cowherd.  E. गो a cow, and सम् pre-fixed to ख्या to count, affix ड.
14098: गोसगृह n. (-हं) The inner part of a house, an inner or sleeping room, a bed-chamber.
14099: गोसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Dawn, day-break.  E. गो a cow, and सङ्ग meeting, junc-tion; the herd assembling at that time.
14100: गोसदृक्ष m. (-क्षः) The Gayal, (Bos gavæus.)  E. गो a cow, and सदृक्ष like, from सदृश with स aff. गोः सदृक्षः । गोतुल्ये, गवये ।
14101: गोसन्दाय m. (-यः) Ono who gives a cow.  E. गो a cow, दा to give, with सम् prefixed, युक् augment, affix अच्.
14102: गोसम्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced from or by a cow.  E. गो, and सम्भव born.
14103: गोसर्ग m. (-र्गः) Dawn, day-break.  E. गो a cow, and सर्ग going forth, the cattle then going forth to pasture.
14104: गोसव m. (-वः) The sacrifice of a cow, one of the grand sacrifices of the Hindus in former times, and not permitted in the present or Kali yuga age: see गोमेध.  E. गो a cow, and सब sacrifice.
14105: गोशशस m. (-शः) Myrrh: गवि जले शशति शश-वा असच् सप्तमी तत्पुरुषः । वोलि ।

14201: ग्रहामय m. (-यः) Epilepsy, convulsions, demoniac possession which the complaint is supposed to be.  E. ग्रह an imp, and आ मय sickness.
14202: ग्रहाशिन् m. (-शी) A plant, (Echites scholaris:) see ग्रहनाश.  E. ग्रह taking, and अश् here meaning to hurt, affix इनि.
14203: ग्रहीतव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 	 1. To be taken or accepted. 	 2. To be learned or acquired.  E. ग्रह् to take, तव्य affix, and ई inserted.
14204: ग्रहीतृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Taking, disposed to take.  E. ग्रह् to take, तृच् affix, and ई inserted.
14205: ग्राम m. (-मः) 	 1. A village, a hamlet, an inhabited and unfortified place in the midst of fields and meadow land, where men of the servile class mostly reside, and where agriculture thrives. 	 2. A scale in music. 	 3. (In composition,) A multitude.  E. गम् to go, affix घञ्, and deriv. irr. or ग्रस् to eat, Unadi affix मन् and आच् substituted for the radical final. ग्रस-मन् आदन्तादेशः ।
14206: ग्रामकुक्कुट m. (-टः) A tame or domestic cock.  E. ग्राम, and क्ककुट a cock.
14207: ग्रामकूट m. (-टः) A man of the fourth tribe, a Sudra.  E. ग्राम a village, and कूट a number, the crowd or population of the village. ग्रामस्य कूट इव वञ्चनाप्रघानत्वात् । शूद्रे ।
14208: ग्रामग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Who or what goes to a village.  E. ग्राम, and गम् to go, ड aff.
14209: ग्रामगमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Going in or to a village.  E. ग्राम, and गमिन् who goes.
14210: ग्रामगृह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) Being or remaining outside the village. E. ग्राम, and गृह्य to be taken out. ग्राम-वाह्यार्थे क्यप् ।
14211: ग्रामघात m. (-तः) Plundering a village.  E. ग्राम, and घात attacking.
14212: ग्रामङ्गमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Who or what goes to a village.  E. ग्राम in the 2nd case, गमिन् what goes.
14213: ग्रामज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Village, rustic, village-born or produced.  E. ग्राम, and ज born; also ग्रामजात, &c. ग्रामे जायते जन-ड ।
14214: ग्रामणी mfn. (-णीः-णीः-णि) 	 1. Best, excellent. 	 2. Chief, pre-eminent, superintendent. 	 3. One who only thinks of enjoyment. 	 m. (-णीः) A barber. 	 f. (-णीः) 	 1. A whore, a harlot. 	 2. A female peasant or villager. 	 3. The indigo plant.  E. ग्राम a village, नी to get or obtain, affix क्विप्. ग्रामं समूहं नयति प्रेरयति स्वस्वकार्य्येषु ।
14215: ग्रामणीपुत्र m. (-त्रः) The son of a whore, a bastard.  E. ग्रामणी, and पुत्र a son; also read ग्रामणिपुत्र.
14216: ग्रामतक्ष m. (-क्षः) The village carpenter.  E. ग्राम a village, and तक्ष car-penter.
14217: ग्रामतस् ind. From the village.  E. ग्राम and तसि aff.
14218: ग्रामता f. (-ता) A multitude of villages.  E. ग्राम, and तल् affix of multi-tude; also ग्रामत्वं with त्व aff.
14219: ग्रामदशेश m. (-शः) The head of ten villages.  E. ग्राम, दश ten, and ईश chief; also ग्रामदशाधिपति, &c.
14220: ग्रामभृत m. (-तः) The village messenger or servant.  E. ग्राम, and भृत sup-ported.
14221: ग्राममद्गुरिका f. (-का) 	 1. A kind of fish, (Silurus singio, HAM.) 	 2. A riot, a fray, a village war, (ग्रामयुद्ध.)  E. ग्राम, and मद्गुर a fish, &c.
14222: ग्राममुख m. (-खः) A market town, a fair, a market.  E. ग्राम a village, and मुख chief.
14223: ग्राममृग m. (-गः) A dog.  E. ग्राम, and मृग deer, the village deer.
14224: ग्रामयाजक m. (-कः) The village priest, one who conducts the ceremonies for any or all classes, and is consequently considered as a degrad-ed Brahman; it also applies to the attendant of an idol.  E. ग्राम a village, यज् to sacrifice, in the causal form, affix वुन्; also with णिनि affix ग्रामयाजिन्.
14225: ग्रामलुण्ठन n. (-नं) Plundering or pillaging a village.  E. ग्राम, and लुण्ठन robbing.
14226: ग्रामवास m. (-सः) 	 1. A villager. 	 2. Living in a village.  E. ग्राम, and वास abode; also ग्रामेवास.
14227: ग्रामवासिन् m. (-सी) A villager.  E. ग्राम, and वासिन् who inhabits; also ग्रामेवासिन्.
14228: ग्रामविशेष m. (-षः) Variety of the scales in music.  E. ग्राम, and विशेष dif-ference.
14229: ग्रामशत n. (-तं) A hundred villages, a province.  E. ग्राम and and शत a hundred.
14230: ग्रामशतेश m. (-शः) The governor of a province.  E. ग्राम, शत and ईश chief also ग्रामशताधिपतिः, ग्रामशताध्यक्षः, &c.
14231: ग्रामसङ्कर m. (-रः) The common sewer or drain of a village.  E. ग्राम and सङ्कर a narrow place.
14232: ग्रामसङ्घ m. (-ङ्घः) A village corporation, a municipality.  E. ग्राम, and सङ्घ assembly.
14233: ग्रामस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Being or residing in a village, belonging to it &c. 	 m. (-स्थः) A village.  E. ग्राम, and स्थ what stays. ग्रामे तिष्ठति स्था-क ।
14234: ग्रामहासक m. (-कः) A sister's husband.  E. ग्राम a village, and हास who delights, from हस् to laugh, &c. and ण्वुल् aff. ग्रामं हासयति हम-णिच्. ण्वुल् ।
14235: ग्रामाधान n. (-नं) Hunting.  E. ग्राम a village, and आधान what supports.
14236: ग्रामाधिकृत m. (-तः) The head man or chief of a village.  E. ग्राम and अधि-कृत set over.
14237: ग्रामाधिपति m. (-तिः) Chief or head of a village.  E. ग्राम, and अधिपति chief.
14238: ग्रामाध्यक्ष m. (-क्षः) Superintendent or chief of a village.  E. ग्राम and अध्यक्ष superior.
14239: ग्रामान्त n. (-न्तं) Space near a village.  E. ग्राम and अन्त a boundary.
14240: ग्रामान्तीय n. (-यं) Space near a village.  E. ग्राम and अन्त end, छ aff.
14241: ग्रामिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Village, rude, rustic. 	 2. Chromatic. 	 m. (-कः) 1. The head-man of a village 2. A village.  E. ग्राम and ठञ् aff.
14242: ग्रामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Village, villager. 	 m. (-मी) The head-man of a village. 	 f. (-मिनी) The indigo plant.  E. ग्राम a village, इनि and ङीप् affixes; also ग्रामीणा.
14243: ग्रामीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 	 1. A villager, a rustic. 	 2. Produced in or pecu-liar to a village. 	 3. Vulgar, rude. 4, Chromatic. 	 m. (-णः) 	 1. A dog. 2. A crow. 	 f. (-णा) The indigo plant.  E. ग्राम and खञ् aff.
14244: ग्रामीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Belonging to a village, produced in or derived from it. 	 m. (-यः) A villager.  E. ग्राम and ढक् affix; also with कन् add-ed ग्रामीयक.
14245: ग्रामेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) A villager, rustic, village-born, &c.  E. ग्राम and ढक् affix; also with कन् added ग्रामेयक.
14246: ग्रामेवास m. (-सः) 	 1. A villager. 	 2. A village abode.  E. ग्रामे seventh case, and वास abode.
14247: ग्रामेवासिन् m. (-सी) A villager.  E. ग्रामे seventh case, वासिन् who dwells.
14248: ग्रामेश m. (-शः) The head-man of a village.  E. ग्राम and ईश a master.
14249: ग्रामेश्वर m. (-रः) The head-man or ruler over a village.  E. ग्राम, and ईश्वर a master.
14250: ग्राम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) 	 1. Village-born, produced in or relating to a village. 	 2. Vulgar, rude, rustic. 	 3. Relating to a musical scale. 	 m. (-म्यः) A hog, a tame or a village hog. 	 n. (-म्यं) 	 1. Rustic or homely speech. 	 2. The Prakrit, and the other dialects of India, except the Sanskrit.  E. ग्राम and यत् aff.
14251: ग्राम्यकर्क्कटी f. (-टी) A pumpkin gourd.  E. ग्राम्य village, and कर्क्कटी gourd.
14252: ग्राम्यकन्द m. (-न्दः) A common species of Arum.  E. ग्राम्य, and कन्द root.
14253: ग्राम्यकुङ्कुम n. (-मं) A yellow dye, safflower, (Carthamus tinctorius.)  E. ग्राम्य and कुङ्कुम saffron, village saffron. कुसुम्भे ।
14254: ग्राम्यधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) Copulation. 	 n. ग्राम्य and धर्म्म virtue, village virtue.
14255: ग्राम्यमद्गुरिका f. (-का) A kind of fish, (Silurus singio, HAM.) Also ग्राममद्गु-रिका.
14256: ग्राम्यमांस n. (-सं) Meat of tame animals.  E. ग्राम्य rural, and मांस flesh.
14257: ग्राम्यमृग m. (-गः) A dog.  E. ग्राम्य and मृग a deer, the village deer; also ग्राममृग.
14258: ग्राम्यराशि f. (-शिः) A name of several of the signs of the zodiac.  E. ग्राग्य, and राशि a sign.
14259: ग्राम्यशूकर m. (-रः) A village hog, a tame hog, a pig.  E. ग्राम्य, and शूकर a hog.
14260: ग्राम्याश्व m. (-श्वः) An ass.  E. ग्राम्य, and अश्व a horse, the village horse.
14261: ग्रावन् mfn. (-वा-वा-व) Hard, solid. 	 m. (-वा) 	 1. A stone or rock. 	 2. A mountain. 	 3. A cloud.  E. ग्रसते ग्रस ड ग्रः आवनति वन सम्भक्तौ विच् कर्म ।
14262: ग्रास m. (-सः) A mouthful or a quantity equivalent to a mouthful, a lump of rice, &c. of the size of a peacock's egg.  E. ग्रस् to eat, affix कर्मणि घञ्.
14263: ग्रासाच्छादन n. (-नं) Bare subsistence, food and clothing.  E. ग्रास, and आच्छादन covering.
14264: ग्राह m. (-हः) 	 1. Taking, either by seizure or acceptance. 	 2. A shark; according to some, the Gangetic alligator, (Lacerta Gangetica;) according to others, the water elephant, (the hippopotamus.) 	 3. Any large fish or marine animal.  E. ग्रह् to take, affix घञ् or ण.
14265: ग्राहक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) One who takes or seizes, one who accepts or receives. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. A hawk, a falcon. 	 2. A police officer, a cons-table, a bailiff.  E. ग्रह् to take, णिच् ण्वुल् aff.
14266: ग्राहवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Containing or abounding with alligators. E. ग्रह्, and मतुप् aff.
14267: ग्राहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) 	 1. Taking, seizing, accepting, who or what takes. 	 2. Astringent, binding, constipating. 	 m. (-ही) 	 1. A seda-tive, a narcotic. 	 2. The elephant or wood apple: see कपित्थ. 	 f. (-णी) A small kind of Jawasa, perhaps a species of Hedysarum. E. ग्रह् to take, णिनि aff.
14268: ग्राह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) 	 1. To be seized, to be taken, to be accepted. 	 2. To be accepted as a rule or a law, to be acknowledged or assented to. 	 3. To be attended to or obeyed. 	 4. To be admitted in evidence, &c. 	 5. To be apprehended or arrested.  E. ग्रह् to take, ण्यत् aff.
14269: ग्रीवा f. (-वा) 	 1. The neck. 	 2. The back part of the neck, the nape, the tendon of the Trepazium muscle.  E. गॄ to swallow, वनिप् Unadi affix गिरति अनया गॄ वनिप् निपातने ।
14270: ग्रीविन् mfn. (-वी-विणी-वि) Long-necked, handsome-necked. 	 m. (-वी) A camel.  E. ग्रीवा a neck, and इनि poss. aff. दीर्घा ग्रीवा अस्ति अस्य ।
14271: ग्रीष्म mfn. (-ष्मः-ष्मा-ष्मं) Hot, warm. 	 m. (-ष्मः) 	 1. The hot season, compre-hending two months, about June July. 	 2. Heat, warmth. 	 f. (-ष्मी) Jasmin.  E. ग्रस् to take, &c. मनिन् Unadi affix, and the deriv. irr. ग्रसते रसान् ।
14272: ग्रीष्मज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 	 1. Produced by heat. 	 2. Produced in the hot season. 	 f. (-जा) A kind of fruit, (Annona reticulata.)  E. ग्रीष्म the hot season, and ज produced.
14273: ग्रीष्मभव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced by heat or in the hot season. 	 f. (-वा) Double jasmin: see नवमल्ली.  E. ग्रीष्म the hot season, and भव being, flourishing.
14274: ग्रीष्मसुन्दरक m. (-कः) A kind of potherb, (Chironia centauroides; it is also applied to Pharnaceum mollugo.)  E. ग्रीष्म the hot season, and सुन्दर handsome, affix कन्.
14275: ग्रीष्महास n. (-सं) The flocculent seeds, blown down, about in the air.  E. ग्रीष्म the hot season, and हास a smile, considered from their white colour, as the smiles of the season.
14276: ग्रीष्मोद्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced by heat or in the hot season. 	 f. (-वा) Double jasmin.  E. ग्रीष्म, and उद्भव produced. ग्रीष्मकाले उद्भवति उद् + भू-अच् ।
14277: ग्रुच (इर उ) इर ग्रुचु r. 1st. cl. (ग्रोचति) To steal or rob. भ्वा-पर-सक-सेट् ।
14278: ग्रैव mfn, (-वः-वी-वं) Belonging to the neck, &c. 	 n. (-वं) 	 1. A necklace, a close necklace or collar. 	 2. A chain worn round the neck of an elephant, &c.  E. ग्रीवा the necklace, and अण् aff.
14279: ग्रैवेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Belonging to the neck. 	 n. (-यं) 	 1. A collar, a neck-lace. 	 2. A chain on the neck of an elephant or horse.  E. ग्रीवा, and ढक् affix; also ग्रैवेयक.
14280: ग्रैवेयक n. (-कं) A collar, an ornament for the neck.  E. ग्रीवा and ढकङ् affix: see ग्रैव and ग्रैवेय.
14281: ग्रैष्म mfn. (-ष्मः-ष्मी-ष्मं) Belonging or relating to, or produced by heat or hot season. of. (-ष्मी) Double jasmin.  E. ग्रीष्म the hot season, &c. affix अण्.
14282: ग्लपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Distressed, pained. 	 2. Exhausted, overpower-ed.  E. ग्लै to be weary, causal form, क्त aff.
14283: ग्लस (उ) ग्लसु r. 1st cl. (ग्लसते) To eat: see ग्रस.
14284: ग्लस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Eaten.  E. ग्लस् to eat, affix क्त.
14285: ग्लह (उ) ग्लहु r. 1st and 10th cls. (ग्लहति-यति) To take, to receive or ac-cept: see ग्रह आदाने वा चुरा-उभ पक्षे भ्वा-सक-वेट् ।
14286: ग्लह m. (-हः) Gaming, playing with dice.  E. ग्लह् to take, &c. affix अच् or it is derived irregularly from ग्रह, and with अप् aff.
14287: ग्लान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Wearied, languid, feeble, exhausted by fatigue, disease, &c.  E. ग्लै to be feeble, and कर्त्तरि क्त aff.
14288: ग्लानि f. (-निः) Langour, lassitude, fatigue of body or depression of mind.  E. ग्ला or ग्लै to be weary, Unadi affix भावे नि.
14289: ग्लायत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Being exhausted, languid, faint, &c.  E. ग्लै to be weary, शतृ aff.
14290: ग्लास्नु mfn. (-स्नः-स्नुः-स्नु) Exhausted by disease or fatigue, wearied, lan-guid.  E. ग्लै to be weak, affix स्नु.
14291: ग्लुच (इर उ) इर ग्लुचु r. 1st cl. (ग्लोचति) 	 1. To steal, to rob. 	 2. To go; see ग्रुच. भ्वा-पर-सक-सेट् ।
14292: ग्लुञ्च (इर उ) इर ग्लुञ्चु r. 1st cl. (ग्लुञ्चति) To go, to move. भ्वा-पर-सक-सेट् ।
14293: ग्लेप (ऋ) ग्लेपृ r. 1st cl. (ग्लेपते) 	 1. To be poor or dependent. 	 2. To shake to tremble. 	 3. To move. सक-भ्वा-आ-सेट् ।
14294: ग्लेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be made weary or exhausted, exhaustible, fatiguable.  E. ग्ला or ग्लै to be weary, affix यत्.
14295: ग्लेव (ऋ) ग्लेवृ r. 1st cl. (ग्लेवते) To serve, to worship, to gratify by service or devotedness. भ्वा-आ-सक-सेट् ।
14296: ग्लेष (ऋ) ग्लषृ r. 1st cl (ग्लेषते) To inquire, to search, to investigate.
14297: ग्लै r. 1st cl, ग्लायति 1. To be languid or weary, to be exhausted, faded, &c. 	 2. To yawn, this root is sometimes considered to be ग्ला. making ग्लायति as above, and in the causal form ग्लपयति or ग्लापयति. भ्वा-पर-अक-अनिट् ।
14298: ग्लैतृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Wearied, exhausted.  E. ग्लै to be weary, तृच् aff.
14299: ग्लौ m. (-ग्लौः) 	 1. The moon. 	 2. Camphor.  E. ग्ला to be weary, Unadi affix डा.
14300: घ The fourth consonant of the Sanskrit alphabet, being the aspirate of the preceding letter, and corresponding to Gh.
14301: घ m. (-घः) 	 1. A bell. 	 2. A rattling or gurgling sound. 	 f. (-घा) 	 1. A tin-kling ornament worn by women round the waist. 	 2. Strikling, kill-ing. 	 3. Wetting, sprinkling,  E. हन् to kill, affix ड, and घ substi-tuted for the radical letter, or the same affix, with घृ to sprinkle, &c.
14302: घग्घ r. 1st cl. (घग्घति) To laugh, to laugh at or deride also; घघ and गग्घ.
14303: घघ r. 1st cl. (घघति) To laugh or to laugh at: see the preceding.
14304: घट r. 1st cl. (घटते) To act, to strive or endeavour. r. 10th cl. (घाटयति) 1. To unite or to put together. 	 2. To injure or kill. 	 3. To shine (इ) घटि r. 10th cl. (घण्टयति) To shine. घट भ्वा-आ-अक-सेट् घटादि ।
14305: घट m. (-टः) 	 1. A large earthen water jar. 	 2. The sign Aquarius. 	 3. A measure; see कुम्भ. 	 4. An elephant's frontal sinus. 	 5. Suspending the breath as a religious exercise. 	 6. A man who makes effort or exer-tion. 	 f. (-टा) 	 1. A troop of elephants assembled for martial purposes. 2. Effort, endeavour. 	 3. An assembly. 	 4. A number, a collection, an assemblage. 	 f.
