14412: घर्म्मान्त m. (-न्तः) The rainy season.  E. घर्म्म and अन्त end.
14413: घर्म्मान्तकामुकी m. (-की) A small white bird; a kind of crane.  E. घर्म्मान्त, and कामुकी who wishes for.
14414: घर्म्मार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Suffering from heat.  E. घर्म्म and आर्त्त pained by.
14415: घर्म्माम्बु n. (-म्बु) 	 1. Perspiration, sweat. 	 2. Warm water.  E. घर्म्म and अम्बु water.
14416: घर्म्मोदक n. (-कं) 	 1. Perspiration. 	 2. Warm water.  E. घर्म्म and उदक water.
14417: घर्ष m. (-र्षः) Rubbing friction.  E. घृष् to rub, घञ् aff.
14418: घर्षण n. (-णं) 	 1. Grinding, pounding. 	 2. Rubbing, friction. 	 f. (-णी) Tur-meric.  E. घृष् to grind, affix भावे ल्युट्.
14419: घर्षणाल m. (-लः) A roller or pestle for grinding, &c.  E. घर्षण rubbing, and अल what is fit for. घर्षणाय अलति अल अच् । (नोडा) ।
14420: घर्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Rubbed. 	 2. Ground.  E. घृष् to rub, affix क्त.
14421: घष (इ) घषि r. 1st cl. (घंषते) To render handsome or brilliant. क्षरणे भ्वा-आत्म-अक-सेट् इदित् ।
14422: घस (आ ऌ) औघसॢ r. 1st cl. (घसति) To eat: this root is in many tenses a substitute for अद and is itself imperfect in others. (इ) घसि r. 1st cl. (घंसते) To sprinkle or drop; this root is not generally admitted. भक्षणे भ्वा-पर-सक-अनिट् ।
14423: घसि m. (-सिः) Food, victuals.  E. घस् to eat, भावे इन् aff.
14424: घस्मर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Gluttonous, voracious,  E. घस् to eat, क्मरच् aff. मक्षण-शीले ।
14425: घस्र mfn. (-स्रः-स्रा-स्रं) Mischievous, hurtful. 	 m. (-स्रः) A day. 	 n. (-स्रं) Saffron.  E. घस् to eat, and रक् aff. घसति अन्धकारम् ।
14426: घाट mf. (-टः-टी) The nape or back of the neck.  E. घट् to unite, affix अच्; the radical is of the 10th class of roots, whence the penul-timate is long. ग्रीवयोः पश्चाद्भागे अवटौ (घाड्) ।
14427: घाटिका f. (-का) The nape of the neck.  E. स्वाथ क added to the prece-ding. घाटायाम् ।
14428: घाण्टिक m. (-कः) 	 1. A bard, who sings in chorus, but especially in honour of the gods, and rings a bell in presence of their images. 	 2. Datura fastuosa.  E. घण्टा a bell affix ठक् घण्टया चरति ।
14429: घात n. (-तं) 	 1. Striking, wounding, killing. 	 2. A bruise, a blow. 	 3. An arrow. 	 4. Product (of a sum in multiplication.)  E. हन to to kill, घञ् affix, and the radical letters changed respectively, to घ and त.
14430: घातक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A murderer, a maimer, &c.  E. हन् as above, with ण्वुल् aff. हननकर्त्तरि.
14431: घातन n. (-नं) A murderer, a killer. 	 n. (-नं) 	 1. Killing, slaughter. 	 2. Stri-king. 	 3. Immolating victims.  E. हन् to kill, ल्युट् affix, and घात sub-stituted for the radical. हस्त्यर्थत्वात् स्वार्थे णिच् भावे ल्युट् ।
14432: घातयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Striking, hurting, killing.  E. हन् to kill, causal form, शतृ aff.
14433: घातव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be killed, what may be or ought to be killed &c.  E. हन् to kill, तव्य affix, and घा substituted.
14434: घातस्थान n. (-नं) 	 1. A slaughter house. 	 2. A place of execution.  E. घात, and स्थान place. श्मशाने ।
14435: घाति m. (-तिः) 	 1. Catching or killing birds, fowling. 	 2. killing in gener-al. 	 3. Striking.  E. हन् to kill or hurt, affix इण्, and the radical changed: see घात.
14436: घातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) Murderous, felonious, who or what strikes or kills.  E. हन् to kill, णिनि aff. हन-ताच्छील्यार्थे णिन् ।
14437: घातिपक्षिन् mf. (-क्षी-क्षिणी) A hawk or falcon.  E. घाति fowling, and पक्षिन् a bird. श्येनखगे ।
14438: घातुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Mischievous, hurtful. 	 2. Cruel, savage. vio-lent, ferocious.  E. हन् to kill, changed to घात, and उकञ् aff. हिंसे, क्रूरेच.
14439: घात्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) Proper or fit to be killed.  E. हन् and ण्यत् aff.
14440: घार m. (-रः) Sprinkling, wetting.  E. घॄ to sprinkle, and घञ् aff.
14441: घार्त्तिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Pulse ground and fried with clarified butter. E. घृत ghee, and ठञ् aff. घृतप्रचुरे छिद्रबहुले पक्कान्नभेदे । (घिओड्) ।
14442: घास m. (-सः) Meadow or pasture grass.  E. घस् to eat. कर्मणि घञ् affix; what is eaten by animals.
14443: घासि m. (-सिः) Fire or its deity.  E. घस् to devour, and इण् Unadi aff. भक्ष्ये तृणादौ-त्रि ।
14444: घिण r. 1st cl. (इ) घिणि (घिणते) To take, to seize or accept. ग्रहणे भ्वा-आ-सक-सेट् ।
14445: घु 1st cl. (घवते) To sound. ध्वनौ भ्वा-आ-अक-अनिट् ।
14446: घु m. (-घुः) Sound.  E. घु to sound, aff. डु । घु-ध्वनौ वा डु ।
14447: घुट r. 1st cl. (घोटते) 	 1. To come back, to return. 	 2. To barter or ex-change. r. 6th cl. (घुटति) 	 1. To strike again or retaliate, to resist or oppose. 	 2. To prevent. 	 3. To protect or preserve. भ्वा-आत्म-सक-सेट् ।
14448: घुट m. (-टः) The ankle.  E. घुट् to resist, and क affix; also घुटि, &c.
14449: घुटि f. (-टिः-टी) The ankle.  E. घुट् to resist, affix इन् and वा ङीप् may be added, also with कन् added घुटिका.
14450: घुटिक mf. (-कः-का) The ankle, &c. see घुट and घुटि; also घुण्ट. घुट अस्त्यर्थे ठन् ।
14451: घुण r. 1st and 6th cls. (घोणते घुणति) To roll, to whirl, to turn round, (इ) घुणि r. 1st cl. (घुणते) To take or accept. भ्वा-आ-सक-सेट् । तु-प-अक ।
14452: घुण m. (-णः) 	 1. An insect that is found in timber. 	 2. The pangolin or armadillo.  E. घुण् to turn round, affix क.
14453: घुण्ट m. (-ण्टः) The ankle.  E. घुट् to resist, affix क and नुम् inserted; also with कन् added घुण्टक, or without the augment घुट &c. as above.
14454: घुण्टिक n. (-कं) Cowdung found in thickets. घुण्ट-स्तदाकारोऽस्ति अस्य ठन् ।
14455: घुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A large black bee.  E. घुण् to roll, Unadi affix ड.
14456: घुर r. 	 6. th cl. (घुरति) 	 1. To be frightful or terrible. 	 2. To sound.
14457: घुर (ई) घुरी r. 4th cl. (घुर्य्यते) 	 1. To be ignorant. 	 2. To inquire.
14458: घुर्घुर m. (-रः) A kind of worm borrowing in the skin, guinea worm, Dracunculus. 	 f. (-री) The mole cricket. 	 f. (-रा) Growling, as of dog or cat.  E. घुर् imitative sound, and घुर् to sound, with क aff.
14459: घुष (इ) घुषि r. 1st cl. (घुंषते) To render beautiful or brilliant (इर) घुषिर r. 1st cl. (घोषति) To do any act except manifest sentiment by sound. r. 10th cl. (घोषयति) 	 1. To manifest sentiment or thought by sound, to speak, to affirm, to declare or proclaim. 	 2. To make various sounds. 	 3. To praise. With आङ् prefixed, To weep in-cessantly.
14460: घुषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Manifested by sound, proclaimed.  E. घुष् as above, affix क्त इट् augment; also घुष्ट.
14461: घुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Sounded, proclaimed,  E. घुष् to sound, क्त aff.
14462: घुष्टान्न n. (-न्नं) Food given away by proclamation.  E. घुष्ट and अन्न food. घुष्टं को भोक्ता इति उद्घुष्य देयमन्नम् ।
14463: घुष्ट्र m. (-ष्ट्रः) A car, a carriage.
14464: घुसृण n. (-णं) Saffron.  E. घुषि to beautify, ऋणक् aff.
14465: घूक m. (-कः) An owl.  E. घू an imitative sound, and कै who sounds, from कै with क aff.
14466: घूकारि m. (-रिः) A crow.  E. घूक an owl, and अरि an enemy.
14467: घूर (ई) घूरी r. 4th cl. (घूर्य्यते) 	 1. To kill, to hurt or injure. 	 2. To become old, to decay. सक-जीर्णतायाम् अक-दि-आ-सेट् ।
14468: घूर्ण r. and 6th cls. (घूर्णते, घूर्णति) To roll, to whirl, to turn round. भ्रमणे अक-तु-उभ-सेट्.
14469: घूर्ण m. (-र्णः) 	 1. A kind of potherb, (Chironia centauroides:) see ग्रीष्मसुन्दरक 2. Turning round, whirling, rolling, &c.  E. घूर्ण to roll, affix अच्.
14470: घूर्णन n. (-नं) Revolving, whirling turning round.  E. घूर्ण to whirl, भावे ल्युट् aff.
14471: घूर्णायमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Whirling, revolving, rolling, tossing  E. घूर्ण and शानच् aff. घूर्णः भ्रान्त इव आचरति भृशा-च्वर्थे वा क्यङ् कर्त्तरि शानच्.
14472: घूर्णि f. (-र्णिः) Rolling, revolving, going round or over.  E. घूर्ण and भावे इन् aff.
14473: घूर्णित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Rolling, turning, tossing.  E. घूर्ण to turn round, affix कर्त्तरि क्त.
14474: घूर्ण्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Agitated, set in motion, made to go round. E. घूर्ण to revolve, pass, voice, शानच् affix also घूर्णमान middle voice.
14475: घृ r. 1st, 3rd and 10th cls. (घरति जिघर्त्ति and घरयति) 	 1. To sprinkle, to wet or moisten. 	 2. To drop or distil. 	 3. To shine. भासे-अक-सेके-सक-भ्वा-जु-पर अनिट् घृ सेके छादने च चु-उभ-सक-सेट् ।
14476: घृण (उ) घृणु r. 8th cl. (घर्णोति घृणोति घर्णुते) To shine. (इ) घृणि r. 1st. cl. (घृणते) To take or accept. दीप्तौ तना-उभ-अक-सेट्. ग्रहणे भ्वा-आ सक-सेट् ।
14477: घृणा f. (-णा) 	 1. Reproach, blame, censure, &c. 	 2. Compassion, tender-ness, pity.  E. घृण् to shine, अङ् and टाप् affixes, or घृ to sprinkle, with नक् and टाप् affs.
14478: घृणावास m. (-सः) A pumpkin gourd. कूष्माण्डे ।
14479: घृणि m. (-णिः) 	 1. A ray of the sun or moon. 	 2. The sun. 	 3. Water. E. घॄण to shine, affix इन्; or घृ to sprinkle, Unadi नि.
14480: घृणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Abused, hated. 	 2. Pitied  E. घृणा pity इतच् aff.
14481: घृणिन् mfn. (-णी-णिनी-णि) 	 1. Censorious, abusive. 	 2. Compassionate. E. घृणा and इनि aff.
14482: घृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Sprinkled. 	 2. Illumined. 	 n. (-तं) 	 1. Ghee, clarified butter, or butter which has been boiled gently, and allowed to cool: it is then used for culinary and religious purpose and is highly esteemed by the Hindus. 	 2. Water. 	 f. (-ता) The name of a tree: see घृतमण्डा.  E. घृ to sprinkle Unadi affix क्त.
14483: घृतकुमारी f. (-री) The aloe, (Aloes perfoliata)  E. घृत ghee, to which the extact is compared, and कुमारी a virgin, which the plant is sup-posed to resemble in delicacy and elegance; also घृतकुमारिका. घुतमिव कुमारी सुन्दरी ।
14484: घृतकुम्भ m. (-म्भः) A jar of ghee.  E. घृत and कुम्भ a jar.
14485: घृतदीधिति m. (-तिः) The deity of fire.  E. घृत ghee, and दीधिति light; of-ferings to fire, always comprehending clarified butter.
14486: घृतपशु m. (-शुः) Ghee made into or supposed to resemble an animal to be offered at a sacrifice or eaten at a meal, for which it is substi-tuted.  E. घृत, and पशु an animal.
14487: घृतपूर m. (-रः) A sweetmeat composed of flour, milk, cocoanut and ghee, &c.  E. घृत ghee, and पूर what is full of.
14488: घृतपूर्णक m. (-कः) A tree. (Caledupa arborea, &c.) see करञ्ज  E. घृत ghee, and पूर्ण full, कप् added.
14489: घृतप्राश m. (-शः) Swallowing ghee.  E. घृत and प्राश eating.
14490: घृतप्राशन n. (-नं) Tasting or swallowing ghee.  E. घृत and प्राश eating.
14491: घृतप्लुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sprinkled or smeared with ghee,.  E. घृत, and प्लुत bathed.
14492: घृतमण्डा f. (-ण्डा) A tree; also वायसोली.  E. घृत, and मण्ड scum; the scum of its infusion resembling ghee.
14493: घृतलोलीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Mixed with ghee, steeped in it or wet with it, &c.  E. घृत लोल desirous. कृत made, च्वि augment.
14494: घृतवर m. (-रः) A sweetmeat, or flour, &c. baked with ghee, and sugar. E. घृत and वर what excels.
14495: घृतविक्रयिन् m. (-यी) A vender of ghee.  E. घृत विक्रय to sell, इनि aff.
14496: घृतस्पृश् mfn. (-स्पृक्) Who or what touches ghee.  E. घृत स्पृश to touch, क्विन् aff.
14497: घृताक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Smeared with ghee.  E. घृत and अक्त smeared.
14498: घृताची f. (-ची) One of the Apsaras or courtezans of Swarga.  E. घृत ghee, अञ्च to worship, क्विप् and ङीप् affs.
14499: घृताचीगर्भसम्भवा f. (-वा) Large cardamoms.  E. घृताची गर्भ the womb, and सम्भव born from.
14500: घृताभ्यक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Smeared or anointed with ghee.  E. घृत and अभ्यक्त anointed.
14501: घृताह्व m. (-ह्वः) Turpentine.  E. घृत ghee, and आह्वा and appellation, named from ghee.
14502: घृतेली f. (-ली) A cock-roach.  E. घृत ghee. इल् to go, अच् affix, र changed to ल fem. affix ङीष् । घृते स्नेहद्रव्ये इलति शेते इल शाये-अच् गौरा-ङीष् । (तेलापोका) ।
14503: घृतोद m. (-दः) The sea of ghee surrounding Kusa Dwipa.  E. घृत and उद water. घृतमिव स्वादु उदकमस्य । उदकस्य उदः ।
14504: घृतोदङ्कः m. (-ङ्कः) A leather vessel holding ghee.  E. घृत उद up, अञ्च् to go, affix घञ्.
14505: घृष (उ) घृषु r. 1st cl. (घर्षति) To grind or pound. सक-पर-सेट् ।
14506: घृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Ground, rubbed, pounded. 	 2. Frayed, grazed, rubbed off.  E. घृष् to rub, कर्मणि क्त aff.
14507: घृष्टि mf. (-ष्टिः) A hog; also गृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 	 1. A plant, commonly Varaha-cranti, (Lycopodium imbricatum, Rox.) 	 2. Grinding, pounding. 	 3. Emulation, contest.  E. घृष् to grind, affix कर्त्तरि क्तिच्.
14508: घृष्टिला f. (ला) A plant: see पृश्निपर्णी  E. घृष्टिं लाति लाक घर्षति भूमिं तुण्डेन ।
14509: घृष्वि mf. (-ष्विः-ष्वी) A hog.  E. घृष् to rub, Unadi affix क्विन् घर्षति भूमिं तुण्डेन ।
14510: घेञ्चलिका f. (-का) An esculent root, (Arum orinense.)
14513: घोट m. (-टः) a horse: see the next.
14514: घोटक m. (-कः) A horse. 	 f. (-टिका) A mare.  E. घुट to strike again, (to spurn the ground,) अच् and कन् ण्वुल् वा affixes, or without the latter affix घोट.
14515: घोणा f. (णा) 	 1. The nose. 	 2. The nose or nostrils of a horse.  E. घुण् to roll, to turn, and अच् and टाप् affs.
14516: घोणिन् m. (-णी) A hog.  E. घोणा nose or snout, and इनि aff.
14517: घोण्टा f. (-ण्ठा) 	 1. The jujube, (Zizyphus jujuba.) 	 2. The betelnut tree: see गुवाक. 	 3. A timber tree, (Schrebera swietenioides.)  E. घुट् to resist, affix अच् and नुम् inserted or घुण वा ट ।
14518: घोन[ण्]स m. (-सः) A large kind of snake.  E. घो for गो a cow, and नस a nose. see गोनस according to others the word is घोणस, from घुण् to roll, and असच् aff.
14519: घोर r. 1st cl. (घोरति) To go as a horse.
14520: घोर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Frightful, horrible, terrific. 	 m. (-रः) A name of SHIVA. 	 f. (-रा) Night. 	 n. (-रं) 	 1. Horror, horribleness. 	 2. Poison. E. घुर् to be frightful, affix अच or गुर् substituted for हन् to injure or kill, and अच् Unadi aff.
14521: घोरदर्शन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Terrific, of horrid or frightful appearance. 	 m. (-नः) An owl.  E. घोर as above, and दर्शन sight.
14522: घोरपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) Bellmetal.  E. घोर and पुष्प a flower.
14523: घोररासन m. (-नः) A jackal.  E. घोर frightful, and रासन cry or sound, from रास् to sound, affix ल्युट.
14524: घोररासिन् m. (-सी) A jackal. E. See the last, णिनि aff.
14525: घोररूप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) Frightful, hideous. 	 n. (-पं) A hideous. appearance. E. घोर and रूप form.
14526: घोररूपिन् mfn. (-पी-पिणी-पि) Frightful, horrible, hideous.  E. घोररूप and णिनि aff.
14527: घोरसङ्काश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Dreadful, horrible.  E. घोर, and सङ्काश like.
14528: घोराकृति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Frightful, hideous, of horrible aspect or form.  E. घोर, and आकृति form.
14529: घोल n. (-लं) Buttelmilk.  E. घुड substituted for हन् to strike, (i. e. with the churn,) and घञ् affix, ड changed to ल.
14530: घोष m. (-षः) 	 1. A station of herdsmen. 	 2. A herdsman. 	 3. A creeping plant, commonly called by the same name Ghosha, and bearing white or yellow flowers, (Luffa pentandra and acutangula.) 	 4. Bellmetal, tutenague, &c. 	 5. Low thunder or the muttering of clouds. 	 6. Sound. 	 7. A proclamation. 	 8. A gnat, a musquito 9. A term proper for the name of a Kayastha. 	 f. (-षा) A kind of fennel, (Anethum sowa:) see मधुरिका.  E. घुषि to shine, to sound, &c. affix. आधारे घञ्.
14531: घोषक m. (-कः) 	 1. A cryer, a proclaimer. 	 2. Ghosha, described as a cree-king plant, (Luffa pentangula, &c.)  E. कन् added to the preceding.
14532: घोषकाकृति f. (-तिः) A plant commonly called Hatighosha, and perhaps a species of the preceding.  E. घोषक Ghosha, and आकृति shape, ap-appearance of similar appearance.
14533: घोषण nf. (-णं-णा) 	 1. Speaking loud, making a great noise. 	 2. Crying, proclaiming.  E. घुष् to sound, affixes णिच् भावे ल्युट् and टाप्.
14534: घोषयित्नु m. (-त्नुः) 	 1. A Brahman. 	 2. The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. 	 3. A captive. 	 5. A cryer, a herald.  E. घोष sound, इत्नुच् affix, and य inserted.
14535: घोषवती f. (-ती) A lute, a Vina.  E. घोष sound, and मतुप् poss. aff.
14536: घौर n. (-रं) Horror, horribleness.  E. घोर and अण् aff.
14537: घ्नत् mfn. (-घ्नत्-घ्नन्ती-घ्नत्) Striking, beating, hurting.  E. हन् to strike, &c. शतृ aff.
14538: घ्रति f. (-तिः) The nose.  E. घ्रा to smell, डति aff.
14539: घ्रा r. 1st cl. (जिघ्रति) To smell, to receive smell.
14540: घ्राण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Smelled. 	 n. (-णं) 	 1. The nose. 	 2. Smell, odour. 	 3. Smelling.  E. घ्रा to smell, करणे ल्युट् ।
14541: घ्राणतर्पण m. (-णः) Fragrance, odour, a fragrance, a perfume.  E. घ्राण the smell, and तर्पण what satisfies.
14542: घ्राणदुःखदा f. (-दा) Sneezing.  E. घ्राण, and दुःखदा paining.
14543: घ्रात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Smelled.  E. घ्रा to smell, affix क्त.
14544: घ्रात्वा ind. Having smelled.  E. घ्रा to smell, क्त्वाच् aff.
14545: घ्राति f. (-तिः) 	 1. The nose. 	 2. Smelling.  E. घ्रा and करणे क्तिन् aff.
14546: ङ The fifth consonant of the Sanskrit alphabet, and the nasal of the first class; the sound of this letter corresponds with that of the nasal N in Song, &c. or in the French word bon.
14547: ङ m. (-ङः) 	 1. An object of sense. 	 2. Desire, wish for any sensual object. E. ङु to sound, affix. ड । विषये विषयस्पृ हायां भैरवे च ।
14548: ङु (ङु) r. 1st cl. (ङवते) To sound. भ्वा-आत्म-अक-अनिट् ।
14549: च The twentieth letter of the alphabet, and first of the second or palatial class of consonants, having the sound of Ch in church.
14550: च mfn. (चः-चा-चं) 	 1. Seedless. 	 2. Vile, base. 	 m. (-चः) 	 1. A name of SHIVA. 	 2. The moon. 	 3. A theif. 	 4. A tortoise. Ind A particle and conjunction copulative or disjunctive. corresponding to. 	 1. And. 	 2. Also, 3. Moreover. 	 4. Mutually. 	 5. Equally. 	 6. Otherwise. 	 7. For, on account of. 	 8. But. &c. 	 9. An expletive.  E. चर् to go, or चि to collect, &c. ड aff.
14551: चक r. 1st cl. (चकते) To repel, to resist. To be satiated or satisfied. 	 2. To shine. चक तृप्तौ प्रतिधाते च भ्वा-आ-अक-सेट् । भ्रान्तौ सौत्र-पर-अक-सेट् इदित् । चङ्कति ।
14552: चकास (ऋ) चकासृ r. 2nd cl. (चकास्ति) To shine. अदा जक्षा पर-अक-सेट् ।
14553: चकासयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Beautifying, illuminating.  E. चकास to shine, causal form, शतृ aff.
14554: चकासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Illuminated, shining, splendid, beautiful. E. चकास, and क्त aff.
14555: चकित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Timid, fearful. 	 2. Frightened at, afraid of. 	 n. (-तं) Timidity, groundless alarm. 	 f. (-ता) A species of the Ashti metre.  E. चक् to repel, affix भावे क्त.
14556: चकोर m. (-रः) The bartavelle or Greek partridge, (Perdix rufa or Tetrao rufus.)  E. चक् to be satisfied, ओरन् Unadi affix; also with कन् add-ed चकोरक; what is satisfied with the moonbeams, upon which the bird is fabulously said to subsist.
14557: चकोरक m. (-कः) The Greek partridge: see the preceding.
14558: चकोरदृश् mfn. (-दृक्) Fine-eyed.  E. चकोर, and दृश् the eye.
14559: चक्क r. 10th cl. (चक्कयति) to give or inflict pain.
14560: चक्रस m. (-सः) 	 1. Crookedness. 	 2. Dishonesty,  E. क्रस् to be crooked, अप् affix, and the root repeated.
14561: चक्र m. (-क्रः) 	 1. The ruddy or Brahmani goose, (Anas casarca.) 	 n. (-क्रं) 1. An army, a host. 	 2. A realm, a region. 	 3. A multitude, a heap 4. A wheel. 	 5. A potter's wheel. 	 6. An oil mill, &c. 	 7. A discus or sharp circular missile weapon. 	 8. A whirlpool. 	 9. A province, a number of villages, a district. 	 10. A form of military array, a circular position. 	 11. A diagram of various sorts for calculating nativities or foretelling events. 	 12. A ring, circle or depression of the body for mystical, astrological or cheiromantic purposes; six such are enu-merated, or Muladhara the parts about the pubis, above that is the Swadhishthanam or umbilical region, and above that the Munipuram or pit of the stomach or epigastrium, Anahatam is the root of the nose, Visuddham the hollow between the frontal sin-uses, and the Ajnyakhyam the fontenelle or union of the coronal and sagittal sutures; various faculties and divinities are supposed to be present in these hollows. 	 13. A cycle, a cycle of years. 	 14. (In Astronomy,) A sphere or circle, as राशिचक्रं the zodiac; प्राक्चक्रं an epicycle. 	 15. The horizon. 	 16. The spiral marks of the Salagram or ammonite.  E. कृ to do or make, with the reduplicate initial letter, affix क, or चक् to repel, &c. with रक् aff.
14562: चक्रक m. (-कः) A logical form or proposition, arguing in a circle. E. कन् implying resemblance, added to the last.
14563: चक्रकारक m. (-कः) A kind of perfume, apparently a dried shellfish: see नखी.  E. चक्र a heap, and कारक what makes.
14564: चक्रकुल्या f. (-ल्या) A species of fern, commonly Chakuliya, (Hemionites cordifolia, Rox.)
14565: चक्रगण्डु m. (-ण्डुः) A round pillow.  E. चक्र, and गण्डु a pillow.
14566: चक्रगुच्छ m. (-च्छः) A tree, (Jonesia asoca.)  E. चक्र a wheel, and गुच्छ a cluster.
14567: चक्रजीवक m. (-कः) A potter.  E. चक्र a wheel, and जीवक who lives by; also चक्रजीविन्.
14568: चक्रदंष्ट्र m. (-ष्ट्रः) A hog.  E. चक्र and दंष्ट्र a tusk, having a curved tusk.
14569: चक्रधर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Having a wheel, &c. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A village or common tumbler or juggler. 	 2. One who holds a wheel, discus, &c. 3. The manager or owner of many villages. 	 4. A name of VISHNU or KRISHNA, who is represented as holding a discus in one hand. 5. A snake.  E. चक्र a wheel, &c. and धर who holds. धृ अच् ।
14570: चक्रनामन् m. (-मा) A pyritic ore or iron: see माक्षिक.  E. चक्र a wheel, &c. and नामन् appellation. चव्रवाके माक्षिकधातौ च ।
14571: चक्रपद्माट m. (-टः) Cassia tora: see चक्रमर्द्दक.  E. चक्र a wheel, पद्म a lotus, and अट what goes or is अच् aff.
14572: चक्रपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A plant commonly Chakuliya, (Hemionites cordifolia, Rox.)  E. चक्र a wheel, and पर्ण a leaf, the leaves being nearly round.
14573: चक्रपाणि m. (-णिः) A name of VISHNU.  E. चक्र and पाणि the hand, being always represented with a discus in one hand.
14574: चक्रपाद m. (-दः) 	 1. A carriage, 2. An elephant.  E. चक्र a wheel, and पाद a foot; also चक्रपादक.
14575: चक्रपाल m. (-लः) 	 1. Superintendent of a province. 	 2. One who carries a discus. 	 3. A circle. 	 4. The horizon.  E. चक्र and पाल who or what protects.  E. पालि + अण् ।
14576: चक्रफल n. (-लं) A missile weapon, a kind of discus.  E. चक्र and फल fruit, bearing a discus as it were for fruit.
14577: चक्रबान्धव m. (-वः) The sun.  E. चक्र the ruddy goose, and बान्धव a friend; these birds being supposed to couple only in the day time.
14578: चक्रभृत् m. (-भृत्) A name of VISHNU.  E. चक्र a discus, and भृत् who cher-ishes: see चक्रपाणि, &c. चक्रं विभर्त्ति भृ-क्विप् ।
14579: चक्रभेदिनी f. (-नी) Night.  E. चक्र the ruddy goose, and भेदिनी what di-vides, (male and female;) these birds being condemned, according to the Hindus, to be separated at night. भिद-णिनि ङीप् ।
14580: चक्रमण्डलिन् m. (-ली) A large snake, (Boa constrictor.)  E. चक्र a wheel, and मण्डल a circumference, implying either that the body of the snake, or the spots on the body may be compared to a wheel.
14581: चक्रमर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) Cassia tora.  E. चक्र a wheel, here meaning figuratively a large leprous spot, and मर्द्द what cleanses or removes, from मृद् with अण् added; or with ण्वुल् affix चक्रमर्द्दक.
14583: चक्रमुख m. (-खः) A hog.  E. चक्र a discus, and मुख face; cutting the ground as it were with a sharp weapon.
14584: चक्रयान n. (-नं) Any wheel carriage.  E. चक्र a wheel, and यान a carriage.
14585: चक्ररद m. (-दः) A hog, a boar.  E. चक्र and रद a tooth or tusk: see चक्रमुख.
14586: चक्रलक्षणा f. (-णा) A plant, (Menispermum glabrum:) see गुडूची.
14587: चक्रला f. (-ला) A plant, (Kyllinga monocephala.)  E. चक्र a wheel, and ल what gets. लाति ला-क । उच्चटायाम् ।
14588: चक्रवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 	 1. Circular, being in a ring or circle. 	 2. Armed with a discus. 	 3. Wheeled, &c. 	 m. (-वान) 	 1. The proprietor of an oil mill, or any one in which seeds are bruised. 	 2. VISHNU. 3. An emperor.  E. चक्र a wheel. &c. मतुप् poss. aff.
14589: चक्रवत् ind. In rotation, going round or revolving like a wheel.  E. चक्र, and मतुप् aff. मस्य वः ।
14590: चक्रवर्त्तिन् m. (-त्तीं) An emperor, a sovereign of the world, the ruler of a Chakra or country described as extending from sea to sea; twelve princes beginning with Bharata are especially considered as Chakravartis.  E. चक्र a reign, and वृत् to abide, affix णिच् वा णिन् ।
14591: चक्रवर्त्तिनी f. (-नी) A fragrant plant, commonly Chakawat.  E. चक्र a heap, and वर्त्तिन् what abides or grows, fem. affix ङीप्,
14592: चक्रवाक m. (-कः) The ruddy goose. commonly called in India, the Brah-many duck or goose, (Anas casarca.)  E. चक्र an imitative sound, and वाक speech. वच परिभाषणे कर्मणि घञ् ।
14593: चक्रवाट m. (-टः) 	 1. Limit, boundary. 	 2. A lamp stand. 	 3. Engaging in any action.  E. चक्र and वट् वेष्टने to surround, affix घञ्.
14594: चक्रवाड m. (-डः) See चक्रवाल. चक्रमिव वाडते वेष्टयति वाड-अच् ।
14595: चक्रवात m. (-तः) A whirlwind, a hurricane.  E. चक्र a circle, and वात wind.
14596: चक्रवाल m. (-लः) A range of mountains supposed to encircle the earth, and to be the limit of light and darkness. 	 n. (-लं) The sensible horizon.  E. चक्र a region, वल् to encompass, and अण् affix; girding the world; or वाड to emerge, &c. affix अच् what emerges (from darkness), in the shape of a wheel; ड changed to ल also चक्रवाड.
14597: चक्रव्यूह m. (-हः) The circular array of troops.  E. चक्र and व्यूह array.
14598: चक्रवृद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Compound interest.  E. चक्र a wheel, वृद्धि increase.
14599: चक्रश्रेणी f. (-णी) A plant bearing a crooked fruit: see अजशृङ्गी  E. चक्र a wheel, and श्रेणी a line or row.
14600: चक्रसंज्ञ n. (-ज्ञं) Tin.  E. चक्र and संज्ञा a name.
14601: चक्रसंवर m. (-रः) The name of a Bauddha deity; also हेरम्ब.  E. चक्र a discus, and संवर who holds.
14602: चक्रहस्त m. (-स्तः) VISHNU.  E. चक्र and हस्त hand: holding a discus.
14603: चक्राङ्की f. (-ङ्की) A wild goose.  E. चक्र a number, and अकि to go, affixes अच् and ङीष् flying in large flocks.
14604: चक्राङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. A gander. 	 2. A carriage. 	 f. (-ङ्गी) 	 1. A goose. 	 2. A drug: see कटुकि. 	 3. A potherb, (Hilancha repens:) see हिलमोचिका. E. चक्र a wheel, &c. and अङ्ग a limb or the body.
14605: चक्राट m. (-टः) 	 1. A juggler, a snake-catcher, one who exhibits snakes and pretends to cure their bites. 	 2. A knave, a cheat, a rogue. 	 3. A gold coin or certain weight of gold, a Dinar.  E. चक्र a number of villages, and अट who goes, i. e. a vagabond, &c. चक्राकारमटति अट-अण् उप-सः ।
14606: चक्राण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 	 1. Doing. 	 2. Done.  E. कृ to do, काणच् aff.
14607: चक्राधिवासिन् m. (-सी) The orange tree.  E. चक्र a heap, and अधिवस् to abide, णिनि aff.
14608: चक्रावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) Turning round, whirling or rotatory motion.  E. चक्र a wheel, and आवर्त्त revolving.
14609: चक्रि m. (-क्रिः) An agent, a maker, a doer.  E. कृ to do, कि affix the root reduplicate and the deriv. irr.
14610: चक्रिका f. (-का) The knee. चक्रं तदाकारोऽस्ति अस्य ठन् । जानुनि ।
14611: चक्रिन् mfn. (-क्री-क्रिणी-क्रि) 	 1. Having or holding a discus, &c. 	 2. Wheeled, having a wheel. 	 3. Circular. 	 m. (-क्री) 	 1. A name of VISHNU. 	 2. A potter. 	 3. The ruddy goose. 	 4. A snake. 	 5. An informer. 	 6. A tumb-ler, one who exhibits tricks with a discus or a wheel. 	 7. An oil grinder. 	 8. An emperor, a Chakravarti: see चक्रवर्त्तिन् 9. One who rides in a carriage. 	 10. A crow. 	 11. An ass. 	 12. Cassia, (the tree.) E. चक्र a wheel, &c. and इनि poss. aff.
14612: चक्रीवत् m. (-वान्) 	 1. An ass. 	 2. The name of a king.  E. चक्र a wheel, वतु affix, and deriv. irr. rolling over like a wheel.
14613: चक्रु m. (-क्रुः) An agent, a maker, a doer.  E. कृ to make or do, with the reduplicate initial, and कु Unadi aff.
14614: चक्रेश्वरी f. (-री) A female deity peculiar to the Jainas, one of their Vidya Devis or goddesses of wisdom.  E. चक्र the universe and ईश्वरी mistress.
14615: चक्ष (इङ्) चक्षिङ् r. 2nd cl. (चष्टे) 	 1. To speak, to tell. 	 2. To see; (in this sense आङ् is usually prefixed.) 	 3. To eat. ख्या or कश are substitu-ted for the radical letters in several tenses of this verb. कथने त्यागे च अदा-आ-सक-सेट् ।
14616: चक्षण n. (-णं) 	 1. Eating a relish to promote drinking. 	 2. Speaking, saying.  E. चक्ष् to speak, to eat, affix ल्युट्.
14617: चक्षस् m. (-क्षाः) 	 1. A name of VRIHASPATI the preceptor of the gods. 	 2. A spiritual teacher, an instructor in sacred science.  E. चक्ष् to speak affix असि न ख्यादेशः ।
14618: चक्षुःश्रवस् m. (-वाः) A snake.  E. चक्षुस् an eye, and श्रवस् an ear; whose eyes are ears. चक्षुषा शृणोति श्रु-असुन् चक्षुरेव श्रवः कर्णौ यस्य वा ।
14619: चक्षुर्दान n. (-नं) The ceremony of anointing the eyes of the image at the time of consecration.  E. चक्षुस् and दान giving.
14620: चक्षुर्विषय m. (-यः) 	 1. Presence, sight. 	 2. An object of sight, any visible object. 	 3. Visibility  E. चक्षुस् and विषय object.
14621: चक्षुष्मान् mfn. (-ष्मान्-ष्मन्ती-ष्मत्) 	 1. Having eyes, seeing. 	 2. Having fine eyes.  E. चक्षुस् and मतुप् aff.
14622: चक्षुष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) 	 1. Beautiful, pleasing or well looking. 	 2. Fit or agreeable for the eyes. 	 m. (-ष्यः) 	 1. A flower, (Pandanus odora-tissimus.) 	 2. A plant: see पुण्डरीक. 	 3. collyrium or application to the eyes, extracted from the Amomum anthorhiza. 	 f. (-ष्या) 	 1. A blue stone, or according to some, the calx of brass used as coll-yrium. 	 2. A pleasing or interesting woman.  E. चक्षुस् the eye, affix यत् । चक्षुषे हितः यत् ।
14623: चक्षुस् n. (-क्षुः) The eye.  E. चक्ष् to speak, and करणे उसि aff.
14624: चक्षूरोग m. (-पः) Ophthalmia.  E. चक्षुस् and रोग disease.
14625: चघ r. 5th cl. (चघ्नोति) To smite or slay. स्वा-सक-सेट् घातने ।

14655: चटुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Tremulous, trembling. 	 2. Shaking, moving. 	 3. Beautiful. 	 f. (-ला) Lightning.  E. चट् to hurt, to break, and उलच् Unadi aff.
14656: चटुलालस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Pleased with or desirous of flattery.  E. चटु, and लालस desirous.

14662: चणकाम्लक n. (-कं) Pease with salt.  E. चणक, and अम्ल acid.

(-ण्डी) 	 1. A passionate woman. 	 2. A mischievous or furious woman. 	 3. A species of the Atijgati verse. 	 n. (-ण्डं) 	 1. Heat, warmth. 	 2. Passion, wrath. 14741: चन्दिर m. (-रः) 	 1. An elephant. 	 2. The moon.  E. चदि to shine, &c. Unadi affix किरच्.

14746: चन्द्रकान्त m. (-न्तः) A fabulous gem, the moon-stone, supposed to be formed of the congelation of the rays of the moon; a kind of crystal may perhaps be meant. 	 mn. (-न्तः-न्तं) 	 1. Sandal. 2, The white water lily. 	 f. (-न्ता) 	 1. Night. 	 2. The wife of the moon.  E. चन्द्र the moon, and कान्त splendid or beloved.
14747: चन्द्रकिन् m. (-की) A peacock.  E. चन्द्रक the eye of the peacock's tail, and इनि poss. aff.
14748: चन्द्रगुप्त m. (-प्तः) 	 1. The registrar of YAMA'S court. 	 2. CHANDRAGUPTA a king of Pataliputra.

14750: चन्द्रगोलस्थ m. (-स्थः) A deceased and defied progenitor.  E. चन्द्रगोल and स्थ who stays or abides; an inhabitant of the lunar sphere.
14751: चन्द्रगोलिका f. (-का) Moonlight.  E. चन्द्रगोल the lunar orb, and कन् affix; derived from the moon.
14752: चन्द्रचञ्चल mf. (-लः-ला) A small fish, (Chanda, HAM.)  E. चन्द्र and चञ्चल trembling, quivering, and glistering like the moon.
14753: चन्द्रदार plu. 	 m. (-राः) The twenty-seven lunar mansions, which in mythology, are so many nymphs, daughters of DAKSHA, and wed-ded to CHANDRA, or the moon.  E. चन्द्र and दार a wife.
14754: चन्द्रनिभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Like the moon, bright, handsome.  E. चन्द्र and निभ what resembles.

14756: चन्द्रप्रभ m. (-भः) The eight Jina or Jaina pontiff. 	 f. (-भा) 	 1. Moonlight. 2. A compound of various drugs used in jaundice, piles, &c. E. चन्द्र and प्रभा light. चन्द्रस्य प्रभा इव प्रभा अस्य ।
14757: चन्द्रमणि m. (-णिः) The Chandrakanta or moon-gem: see चन्द्रकान्त. E. चन्द्र the moon, and मणि a gem.
14758: चन्द्रमण्डल n. (-लं) The orb or disc of the moon, the lunar sphere.  E. चन्द्र and मण्डल circle.
14759: चन्द्रमस् m. (-माः) The moon.  E. चन्द्र camphor, मा to mete or measure, and असुन् Unadi affix, मा देशः rendering all objects white like camphor.
14760: चन्द्रमौलि m. (-लिः) A name of SIVA.  E. चन्द्र and मौलि a crest; this deity being represented with a half moon on his fore-head.
14761: चन्द्ररेखा f. (-खा) A digit of the moon.  E. चन्द्र and रेखा a line.
14762: चन्द्ररेणु m. (-णुः) A plagiarist, a poetical thief, (काव्यचौर)  E. चन्द्र the moon, and रेणु dust.
14763: चन्द्रलेखा f. (-खा) 	 1. A plant, (Serrantula anthelmintica:) see सोमराजी. 2. A digit of the moon.  E. चन्द्र and लेखा a line or mark.
14764: चन्द्रलोक n. (-कं) The sphere or heaven of the moon.  E. चन्द्र and लोक world.
14765: चन्द्रलौह n. (-हं) Silver.  E. चन्द्र and लौह metal; also चन्द्रलौहकं.

14767: चन्द्रवंशिन् m. (-शी) A member of the lunar dynasty.  E. चन्द्रवंश and इनि aff.
14768: चन्द्रवल्लरी f. (-री) 	 1. A kind of asclepias, (A. acida:) see सोमलता. 	 2. Rue. See ब्राह्मी.  E. चन्द्र the moon, and वल्लरी a creeper. सोमलतायां माधवी-लतायाम् च ।
14769: चन्द्रवाला f. (-ला) Large cardamoms.  E. चन्द्र camphor, and वाला a child, a diminutive term in general.
14770: चन्द्रविहङ्गम m. (-मः) A kind of crane.  E. चन्द्र the moon, (as white,) and विहङ्गम a bird.
14771: चन्द्रव्रत n. (-तं) 	 1. A regal property or virtue. 	 2. A kind of penance. see चान्द्रायण.  E. चन्द्र the moon, and व्रत religious observance.
14772: चन्द्रशाला f. (-ला) 	 1. Moonlight. 	 2. An upper room, an apartment on the top of the house.  E. चन्द्र the moon, and शाला a hall. चन्द्रः शाला इव आधारो यस्याः । ज्योत्स्नायाम्, प्रासादोपरिस्थे गृहे (चिलेर घर) ।

14775: चन्द्रसंज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) Camphor.  E. चन्द्र and संज्ञा a name: having all the synonimes of the moon.
14776: चन्द्रसम्भव m. (-वः) Budha, the planet MERCURY.  E. चन्द्र and आत्मज son.
14777: सन्द्रसम्भवा f. (-वा) Small cardamoms.  E. चन्द्र the moon, and सम्भव produced.
14778: चन्द्रसालोक्य n. (-क्यं) Attainment of the lunar heaven.  E. चन्द्र and सालोक्य domicile.
14779: चन्द्रहास m. (-सः) 	 1. A scimitar. 	 2. the sword of RAVANA. 	 f. (-सा) Moon plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) 	 n. (-सं) Silver.  E. चन्द्र the moon, and हास what derides: outvieing the moon in brightness.

14790: चन्द्रोदय m. (-यः) 	 1. An awning, a cloth spread over the large open courtyard of Hindu houses, upon festival occasions. 	 2. Moon-rise 3. A mercurial preparation used in medicine.  E. चन्द्र the moon, and उदय rising, (of a planet, &c.)
14791: चन्द्रोपल m. (-लः) Moongem; see चन्द्रकान्त.  E. चन्द्र, the moon, and उपल a stone. चन्द्रप्रियः उपलः । चन्द्रकान्तमणौ ।

14808: चमरिक m. (-कः) A species. of ebony, (Bauhinia variegata.)  E. चमर a Chowri, and ठन् affix, growing in clusters, resembling a Chowri.

14825: चम्पोपलक्षित m. (-तः) The district of champa or Bhāgulpnr, or m. plu. (-ताः) The inhabitants.  E. चम्प the ebony, and उपलक्षित designated: see चम्पावती.
14826: चम्ब r. 1st cl. (चम्बति) To go, to move. भ्वा-पर-सक-सेट् गतौ ।
14827: चय r. 1st cl. (चयते) To go to or towards, to go, to move, भ्वा-आ-सक-सेट् ।
14828: चय m. (यः) 	 1. An assemblage, a multitude. 	 2. A heap, a collection. 	 3. A mound of earth, raised to form the foundation of a building. 4. 14829: चयन n. (-नं) Collecting, gathering.  E. चि to collect, ल्युट् aff.
14830: चयनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be collected or gathered.  E. चि to collect, अनीयर aff.
14831: चर r. 1st cl. (चरति) 	 1. To go. 	 2. To eat. 	 3. To behave or act, (in this sense आङ् is usually prefixed;) With अति, and आङ् prefixed, To transgress, to go astray. With अभि, 1. (उच्चरति) To go up, to rise. With उप, 1. To approach. 	 2. To worship. With परि, To serve. With प्र, 1. To prevail as a custom. 	 2. To declare, to manifest. With वि and अभि, To go astray, to act wickedly. With सम् (सञ्चरते) 1. To ride upon. 2. (सञ्चरति) To accompany. With सम् and आङ् 1. To perform. 	 2. To announce. r. 10th cl. (चारयति) 	 1. To doubt 2. To be free from doubt. With वि prefixed, To discuss, to dispute, to reason upon or respecting any doubtful points. भ्वा-पर-सक-सेट् । चु-उभ-सक-सेट् ।
14832: चर mfn. (-रः-रा or -री-रं) 	 1. Moveable, locomotive. 	 2. Trembling, shak-ing, unsteady. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A spy, a secret emissary or agent. 	 2. The planet Mars. 	 3. A game played with dice and men, similar to backgammon. 	 4. A wagtail. 	 5. A cowri. 	 6. The seventh Karana, (in Astrology.) 	 7. The Karanas collectively. 	 f. (-री) A young wo-man.  E. चर् to go, affix अच् or टच् and in the latter case the fem. affix is ङीप्.
14833: चरक m. (-कः) 	 1. The author of a treatise upon medicine: applied also to the work. 	 2. A spy or secret emissary, &c.  E. चर to go, Unadi affix. स्वार्थे क संज्ञायां कन् वा ।
14834: चरट mf. (-टः-टी) A wagtail; also चर.  E. चर वा अटच् । खञ्जनखगे ।
14835: चरण mn. (-णः-णं) 	 1. A foot. 	 2. The root of a tree. A race, a family. 	 4. A portion of the Vedas, 5. Fixed or instituted observance. 	 6. Wandering, roaming, going round or about. 	 2. Eating. E. to चर् go affix करणे ल्युट्.
14836: चरणकिशलय n. (-यं) The foot of a lover, or deity, &c.  E. चरण and किशलय lotus filament.
14837: चरणगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fallen at one's feet, prostrate.  E. चरण and गत gone.
14838: चरणग्रन्थि f. (-न्थिः) The ankle.  E. चरण the foot, and ग्रन्थि a joint.
14839: चरणपतन n. (-नं) Prostration, falling at the feet.  E. चरण and पतन falling.
14840: चरणपतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Prostrate, fallen at the feet.  E. चरण and पतित fallen.

14842: चरणयुग n. (-गं) 	 1. Both the feet. 	 2. Two lines of a stanza.  E. चरण, and युग a pair.
14843: चरणसेवा f. (-वा) Service, devotion.  E. चरण and सेवा service.
14844: चरणार्द्ध n. (-र्द्धं) 	 1. The half of the foot. 	 2. Half of the fourth of a stanza E. चरण and अर्द्ध half.
14845: चरणानमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Trodden down, bent or bowed under the feet.  E. चरण and आनमित bowed.
14846: चरणाभरण n. (-णं) An ornament on the feet.  E. चरण and आभरण orna-ment.
14847: चरणामृत n. (-तं) The water in which the feet of a venerable Brahman or teacher have been washed.  E. चरण and असृत nectar.
14848: चरणायुध m. (-धः) A cock.  E. चरण the foot, and आयुध a weapon, whose foot is his weapon.  E. चरणम् आयुधं यस्य । कुक्वुटे ।
14849: चरणारविन्द n. (-न्दं) The foot (of a deity, a lover, &c.)  E. चरण and अर-विन्द a lotus; also many similar compounds, as चरणपद्मं, चरणकमलं, चरणनलिनं, &c.
14850: चरणास्कन्दन n. (-नं) Trampling, trading on.  E. चरण and आस्कन्दन going.
14851: चरणोदक n. (-कं) Water in which the feet of a venerable Brahman or spiritual teacher have been washed.  E. चरण and उदक water.
14852: चरणोपग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) In contact with the feet, at the feet.  E. चरण. and उपग approached.
14853: चरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती रत्) Going, going. to.  E. चर् to go, शतृ aff.
14855: चरम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 	 1. Last, ultimate, final. 	 2. West, western. चर् to go, अमच् Unadi aff.
14856: चरमक्ष्माभृत् m. (-भृत्) The western mountain behind which the sun is supposed to set.  E. चरम western, and क्ष्माभृत् a mountain; also चरमाचल, &c.
14858: चरमाद्रि m. (-द्रिः) See चरमक्ष्मामृत्; also other similar compounds.
14859: चराचर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 	 1. Moveable, locomotive. 	 2. Shaking, trem-bling, unsteady. 	 3. Wished, desired. 	 4. Moveable and immove-able. 	 n. (-रं) 	 1. The world. 	 2. Sky, atmosphere. 	 3. Heaven, paradise. 4. The aggregate of all things, whether inanimate or animate. E. चर् to go, affix अच् and the derivative reiterated, आङ् inserted; or चर what goes and अचर what does not go.
14860: चरि m. (-रिः) An animal in general.  E. चर locomotive, and इ Unadi aff.
14861: चरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone, gone to, attained. 	 n. (-तं) Fixed institute, proper or peculiar observance: see चरण. 	 2. Story, adventures. 	 3. Practice, behaviour. 	 4. Nature.  E. चर् to go, affix क्त.
14862: चरितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be followed or observed.  E. चर and तव्य aff
14863: चरितार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 	 1. Effected, accomplished. 	 2. Successful. E. चरित and अर्थ object.
14864: चरितगुणत्व n. (-त्वं) 	 1. Accompaniment, assistance. 	 2. Meritorious con-duct.  E. चरित and गुणत्व faculty.

14866: चरित्रबन्धक n. (-कं) A friendly pledge, one of unequal value to the loan. E. चरित्र and बन्धक a pledge.
14867: चरिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) 	 1. Moveable, locomotive. 	 2. Wandering about. E. चर् to go, and इष्णुच् aff.
14868: चरीत्र n. (-त्रं) Practice conduct behaviour: see चरित्र.
14869: चरु m. (-रुः) 	 1. An oblation of rice barley, and pulse, boiled with butter and milk for presentation to the gods or manes. 	 2. The vessel in which such an oblation is prepared.  E. चर् to eat, उण् Unadi affix, what the gods feed upon.
14870: चरुव्रण m. (-णः) A kind of cake.  E. चर् to eat, उ affix, edible, and व्रण what is ground or pounded.
14871: चरुश्रपण n. (-णं) Sprinkling an oblation of milk and ghee.  E. चरु and श्रपण scattering.
14872: चरुस्थाली f. (-ली) The vessel in which an oblation is prepared.  E. चरु and स्थाली a pot.

14876: चर्चरीक m. (-कः) 	 1. A form of SIVA. 	 2. A potherb. 	 3. Decorating or curling the hair.  E. चर्चरी noise, &c. and क who utters, from कै to sound, affix ड; or चर्च ईकन् some authorities substitute बर्चरीक for this word.

14881: चर्त्त्य mfn. (-र्त्त्यः-र्त्त्या-र्त्त्यं) 	 1. To be hurt or injured. 	 2. To be strung or tied in order.  E. चृत् to hurt, &c. and कर्मणि यत् affix from special.

14883: चर्ब r. 1st cl. (चर्बति) To go to move. भ्वा-पर-सक-सेट् ।

14888: चर्म्मकार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) The shoe-maker, a currier or worker in leather, the offspring of the Chandala woman by a man of the fisherman caste, or of a Vaideha female by a Nishadha. 	 f. 14891: चर्म्मकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Working in leather or skins.  E. चर्म्म and कार्य्य business.

14898: चर्म्मतरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A wrinkle, a fold of skin.  E. चर्म्म and तरङ्ग a wave. चर्मणि तरङ्ग इव । जरया पलिते बलौ ।

14900: चर्म्मदूषिका f. (-का) 	 1. Leprosy. 	 2. Cutaneous disease.  E. चर्म्म and दूष् to vitiate, ण्वुल् aff. चर्म दूषयति ।
14901: चर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 	 1. Skin, hide, bark, &c. 	 2. A shield. 	 3. A student's hide, usually that of an antelope.  E. चर् to go, to obstruct, Unadi affix मनिन्.
14902: चर्म्मनासिका f. (-का) A whip.  E. चर्म्म, and नासिका the nose or end.
14903: चर्म्मपट्टिका f. (-का) A piece or strap of leather, for playing upon with dice, a leather backgammon board, &c.  E. चर्म्म, and पट्टिका a fillet.
14904: चर्म्मपत्रा f. (-त्रा) A bat, the small house-bat.  E. चर्म्म leather, and पत्र a wing, the fem. form implies diminutiveness. चर्म इव पत्रं पक्षोऽस्याः । (चाम्चिका) ।

14909: चर्ममय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Leather, made of leather.  E. चर्म and मयट् aff.
14910: चर्ममुण्डा f. (-ण्डा) A form of the goddess DURGA.  E. चर्म a shield, and मुण्डा, a bald head whose head is round like a shield.
14911: चर्मयष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A whip.  E. चर्म, and यष्टि a stick.
14912: चर्मरु m. (-रुः) A shoe-maker, a worker in leather.  E. चर्म leather, and रु to make a noise, affix क्विप्.
14913: चर्मसम्मवा f. (-वा) Cardamoms: see एला.  E. चर्म skin, and सम्भव produced.

14915: चर्माच्छादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Covered with skin.  E. चर्म and आच्छादित covered.

14918: चर्मावनद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 	 1. Covered with skin. 	 2. Tied with leather, &c. E. चर्म and अवनद्ध bound.
14919: चर्मावृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Covered with skin or leather.  E. चर्म and आवृत covered.
14920: चर्माम्भस् n. (-म्भः) Lymph, serum.  E. चर्म and अम्भस् water.
14921: चर्मार m. (-रः) A worker in leather.  E. चर्म and ऋ to go, with अण् aff.
14922: चर्मिन् mfn. (-र्मी-र्मिणी-र्मि) 	 1. Having a hide or skin. 	 2. Leather, made of leather, &c. 	 m. (-र्मी) 	 1. A soldier armed with a shield, a shield bearer. 	 2. 14923: चर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be gone, (in or by) 	 nf. (-र्य्यं-र्य्या) 	 1. Persever-ance in religious austerities. 	 2. Due and regular observance of all rites or custom. 	 3. 14926: चर्व्वन् m. (-र्व्वा) Striking with the flat of the hand.  E. चर् to go, affix वुन्.
14927: चर्व्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Eaten. 	 2. Chewed.  E. चर्व्व् to eat, and कर्मणि क्त aff.
14928: चर्व्वितपात्र n. (-त्रं) A spitting pot.  E. चर्व्वित chewed, (pan or tobacco,) पात्र a vessel; also चर्व्वितपात्रकं. (पिकदानी) ।
14929: चर्व्व्या mfn. (-र्व्व्यः-र्व्व्या-र्व्व्यं) To be chewed. 	 n. (-र्व्व्यं) Solid food, requiring mastication.  E. चर्व्व् to chew, ण्यत् यत् वा affix; also चर्व्वणीय चर्व्वितव्य.
14930: चर्षणि m. (-णिः) A man. कृष-अनि आदेश्च चः उणादि । मनुष्ये ।
14931: चल r. 1st. cl. (चलति) To tremble, to shake or totter. r. 6th cl. (चलति) To sport, to play. to frolic or wanton. r. 10th cl. (चालयति-ते) To cherish, to foster, (चालयति चालयते) To shake to cause to shake. With प्र, To fall as from a seat. भ्वा-पर-सक-सेट् । तुदा-पर-अक-सेट् । चुरा-सक-उभ-सेट् ।
14932: चल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Trembling tremulous, unfixed or unsteady. 	 m. (-लः) Trembling, shaking. 	 f. (-ला) 	 1. The goddess of fortune, LAKSHMI. 2. Lightning. 	 3. Incense.  E. चल् to go, affix अच् fem. affix टाप्.
14933: चलकर्ण m. (-र्णः) The true distance of a planet from the earth.  E. चल and कर्ण hypothenuse.
14934: चलचञ्चु mf. (-चञुः) The Greek partridge: see चकोर  E. चल tremulous, and चञ्चु a beak. चला चञ्चुरस्य । चकोरे ।
14935: चलचित्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Fickle, inconstant. 	 n. (-त्तं) Fickleness, muta-bility.  E. चल, and चित्त mind.
14936: चलचित्तता f. (-ता) Fickleness, unsteadiness, inconstancy.  E. तल् added to the last: also with त्व, चलचित्तत्वं.
14937: चलत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्तो-लत्) Going, moving.  E. चल् to go, शतृ aff.
14938: चलत्पद n. adv. (-दं) Moving, walking.  E. चलत् and पद a step.
14939: चलत्पूर्णिमा f. (-मा) A small fish, (Chanda, HAM)  E. चलत् trembling, and पूर्णिमा full moon, being of a white glistering colour, like that of the moon. चलन्ती पूर्णिमा तदुपलक्षितः चन्द्र इव ।
14940: चलदङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A fish, a sort of gilt-head.  E. चलत् trembling, and अङ्ग body; also with कन् added चलदङ्गक.
14941: चलदल m. (-लः) The holy fig tree.  E. चल shaking, and दल a leaf. चलानि दलानि अस्य । अश्वत्थ-वृक्षे ।
14942: चलद्विष m. (-षः) The Kokila or Indian cuckoo.
14943: चलन mfn. (-नः-ना-नी-नं) 	 1. Who or what goes or moves. 	 2. Trembling, tremulous, shaking. 	 m. (-नः) 	 1. A foot. 	 2. A deer, an antelope. 	 f. (-नी) 	 1. A short petticoat worn by common women. 	 2. The tye of an elephant. 	 n. (-नं) 	 1. Wandering, roaming. 	 2. Trembling, shak-ing. 	 3. Going.  E. चल् to go, affix भावे or करणे ल्युट् or युच् or कर्त्तरि ल्यु ।
14944: चलनक n. (-कं) A short petticoat worn by women of some rank,  E. चलन and कन् added. संज्ञायां कन् । चण्डातके ।
14945: चलमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Going, moving, proceding.  E. चल् to go शानच् aff.
14946: चलस् n. (-लः) Wood sorrel; see अम्ल.  E. चल् to go, असुन् Unadi affi.
14947: चलसन्धि m. (-न्धिः) Moveable articulation of the bones, Diarthrosis. E. चल and सन्धि a joint.
14948: चलाचल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Tremulous, unsteady, unfixed. 	 2. Moveable and stationary. 	 m. (-लः) A cow.  E. चल् to go, affix अच् deriv. re-iterated, and the first final vowel made long, or चल and अचल immoveable.
14949: चलि m. (-लिः) A cover, a wrapper, a surtout: see निचोल.
14950: चलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Shaking, trembling. 	 2. Gone, departed. 	 3. Went, proceeded.  E. चल् to go, affix क्त.
14951: चलु m. (-लुः) A handful of water, water taken up in the hollowed palm of the hand for rincing the mouth, &c.  E. चल् to go, affix उन्, गण्डूषे ।
14952: चलुक m. (-कः) 	 1. The hand hollowed as for holding a little water, &c. 2. A small pot, a gallipot, &c. 	 n. (-कं) A handful of water: see चलु E. चल् to go कन् affix: see चुलक । चलुना मीयते कन् । प्रसृतौ, भाण्डभेदे च ।
14953: चलेन्द्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Sensitive, sensual, not having subdued senses or passions.  E. चल and इन्द्रिय organ of sense.
14954: चवि f. (-विः-वी) The pepper plant or a kind of it.  E. चर्व् to eat इन् affix; also sometimes ङीष्, deriv. irr. also चव्य and चविका.
14955: चविक mf. (-कः-का or -की) A plant that yields a sort of long pepper, (Piper chavya.)  E. चर्व् to eat, and क्कुन् affix, र rejected.
14956: चव्य nf. (-व्यं-व्या) A variety of pepper, (Piper chavya, Rox.) 	 f. (-व्या) Orris root.  E. चर्व् to be eaten, कर्मणि ण्यत् affix and deriv. irr.
14957: चष r. 1st cl. (चषति) To kill or hurt, (चषति-ते) To eat. भ्वा-उभ-सक-सेट् ।
14958: चषक mn. (-कः-कं) 	 1. A vessel for drinking spirits with, a wine glass, &c. 	 2. Any drinking vessel. 	 3. Spirituous liquor. 	 4. Honey.  E. चष् to eat, करणे क्वुन् Unadi aff.
14959: चषति m. (-तिः) Decay, infirmity.  E. कृष् to plough, ति Unadi affix, and च substituted for the radical initials. चष-भक्षे बधे वा भावे अति ।
14960: चषाल m. (-लः) 	 1. A wooden ring on the top of a sacrificial post. 	 2. An iron ring at the base of the post. 	 3. A hive.  E. चष् to eat, &c. आलच् Unadi aff.
14961: चह r. 1st and 10th cls. (चहति, चहयति-ते) 	 1. To be wicked, to commit wickedness. 	 2. To cheat. 	 3. To be proud, &c. r. 10th cl. (चहयति-ते) To grind or pound. भ्वा-पर-सक-सेट् । चुरा-उभ-सक-सेट् ।
14962: चाक्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Circular. 	 2. Belonging to a wheel or discus. 3. Relating to a company or circle. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. A chorister, a bard who chaunts in chorus the praises of kings heroes, gods, &c. 2. An oil maker. 	 3. A coach-man, a driver.  E. चक्र a multitude, &c. and ठक् aff. चक्रेण समूहेन यन्त्रभेदेन चक्रयुक्तशकटेन वा चरति ।
14963: चाक्षुष mfn. (-षः-षी-षं) Visible, perceptible, seen. 	 m. (-षः) The sixth Manu. E. चक्षुष the eye, अण् aff. चक्षुषा गृह्यते ।
14964: चाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Whiteness or beauty of the teeth.  E. चङ्ग handsome, affix ड । ची-ड चमङ्गमस्य । चाङ्गेय्याम् दन्तपटुत्वे च ।
14965: चाङ्गेरी f. (-री) Wood sorrel, (Oxalis monadelpha, Rox.)  E. चाङ्ग as above, and इर् to send or cause, affixes अण् and ङीष्.
14966: चाचलि mfn. (-लिः-लिः-लि) Moving much or repeatedly.  E. चल् to go, intents from, कि aff.
14967: चाञ्चल्य n. (-ल्यं) 	 1. Tremulousness, unsteadiness. 	 2. Transitoriness. E. चञ्चल, and ष्यञ् aff.
14968: चाट m. (-टः) A cheat, a rogue, a peculator, one who makes away with money &c. entrusted to him.  E. चट् to injure, affix अच् ।
14969: चाटकैर m. (-रः) A young sparrow.  E. चटक a sparrow, and ऐरक् aff.
14970: चाटु mn. (-टुः-टु) 	 1. Pleasing or grateful discourse. 	 2. Distinct speech. 3. Flattery.  E. चट् to break, (anger,) Unadi affix ञुण्; also चटु.
14971: चाटुकार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Speaking agreeably or kindly. 	 m. (-रः) A flat-terer.  E. चाटु and कार who makes. चाटुं करोति ।
14972: चाटुपटु m. (-टुः) A jester, a buffoon.  E. चाटु agreeable speech, and पटु clever; also चाटुवटु. भण्डे । (भांँड) ।
14973: चाटुलोल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Elegantly tremulous.  E. चाटु for चटु beautiful, and लोल trembling.
14974: चाटुवटु m. (-टुः) A jester.  E. चाटु wit and वटु who utters: see चाटुपटु.
14975: चाटुशत n. (-तं) Repeated coaxing, a hundred entreaties.  E. चाटु and शत a hundred.
14976: चाटूक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 	 1. Service. 	 2. Agreeable language. 	 3. Flattery.  E. चाटु agreeable speech, and उक्ति saying.
14977: चाणकीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fit for or sown with the chickpea, (a field, &c.) E. चणक chickpea, and खञ् aff. चणकस्य भवनं क्षेत्रम् ।
14978: चाणक्य m. (-क्यः) 	 1. A name of the sage VATSYAYANA. 	 2. Name of a Brahman, the reputed author of a work on polity, and minister of CHANDRAGUPTA. 	 n. (-क्यं) The work of Chanakya, detached stanzas original or compiled, on morals and polity.  E. चणक a saint, and यञ् affix of descent. चणकस्य मुनेः गोत्रापत्यम् ।
14979: चाणूर m. (-रः) A wrestler in the service of KANSA.
14980: चाणूरसूदन m. (-नः) KRISHNA.  E. चाणूर and सूदन destroyer.
14981: चाण्डाल m. (-लः) A name of an impure or degraded tribe, a Chandala, a Pariah, an outcaste. 	 f. (-ली) A woman of the same tribe.  E. चडि to be angry, Unadi affix आलञ् and according to some अण् added also चण्डाल.
14982: चाण्डालिका f. (-का) 	 1. A vulgar lute. 	 2. A name of DURGA. 	 3. A kind of herb: see चण्डालिका.
14983: चातक m. (-कः) A bird, a kind of cuckoo, (Cuculus melanoleucus.) E. चत् to beg, affix कर्त्तरि ण्वुल्; begging water from the clouds, the supposed sole source of the fluid which this bird drinks.
14984: चातकानन्दन m. (-नः) The rainy season.  E. चातक and आनन्दन delighting.
14985: चातुर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 	 1. Perceptible, visible. 	 2. Speaking well or amiably. 3. Driving, one who drives, a driver, a charioteer, &c. 	 4. Clever, able, ingenious. 	 5. Relating to four. 	 f. (-री) Dexterity, ability, cleverness. 	 m. (-रः) A small round pillow for resting the cheek upon. 	 n. (-रं) a four-wheeled carriage, a cart holding four people. E. चतुर dexterous, or चतुर् four, अण् affix; also with कन् added चातुरक.
14987: चातुराश्रम्य n. (-म्यं) The aggregate of the four orders of a Brahmana such as religious studentship, house-holder, mendicant and ascetic.  E. चतुर् four, आश्रम order, ष्यञ aff.
14988: चातुरिक m. (-कः) A charioteer, a coachman.  E. चातुर a carriage, and ठक् aff.
14989: चातुर्यक m. (-कः) A quartan ague.  E. चतुर्य अण् affix, and कन् added.
14990: चातुर्मास mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Produced in four months.  E. चतुर्मास, and अण् aff.
14991: चातुर्मास्य n. (-स्यं) A sacrifice performed every four months.  E. चतुर् and मास a month, यञ् aff.
14992: चातुर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Dexterity, cleverness.  E. चत्र and ष्यञ् aff.
14993: चातुर्वर्ण्य mfn. (-र्ण्यः-र्ण्या-र्ण्यं) Suited to the four tribes, belonging to them &c. 	 n. (-र्ण्यं) The aggregate of the four original castes, the Brahman, Kshetriya, Vaisya and Sudra.  E. चतुर् four, and वर्ण a class, ष्यञ् aff.
14994: चातुर्विध्य n. (-ध्यं) Four kinds collectively.  E. चतुर्विध and ञ aff.
14995: चातुर्वैद्य m. (-द्यः) A priest, &c. versed in the four Vedas.  E. चतुर four, वेद a Veda, and ष्यञ् affix; it is also derived from विद्या Know-ledge, and is optionally as here given, or चातर्विद्य.
14996: चातुर्होतृक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Performed by four priests, read or sacrificed by, &c.  E. चतुर् होतृ a priest, ठक् aff.
14997: चात्वाल m. (-लः) 	 1. A hollow made in the ground to receive, a burnt off-ering or sacrificial fire. 	 2. Any hole in the ground.  E. चत् to ask, (to solicit the gods) and वालञ् Unadi affix; also चत्वाल q. v.
14998: चान्दनिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Made of or derived form Sandal, perfumed with it, &c.  E. चन्दन, and ठक् aff.
14999: चान्द्र mfn. (-न्द्रः-न्द्री-न्द्रं) Lunar, relating to the moon, regulated by it, &c. 	 m. (-न्द्रः) 	 1. The Chandrakanta or moongem. 	 2. A month, a lunar month. 	 3. The light fortnight or half month, during which the moon is on the increase. (-न्द्रं) The Chandrayana observance: see चान्द्रायण f. (-न्द्री) Moonlight.  E. चन्द्र the moon, and अण् affix of relation. चन्द्रस्य इदम् ।
15000: चान्द्रक n. (-कं) Dried ginger.  E. कन् added the last. शुण्ठ्यास् ।
15001: चान्द्रभागा f. (-गा) A river, the Chinab: see चन्द्रभागा; also चान्द्रभागी.
15002: चान्द्रमस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Lunar, relating or belonging to the moon, &c. n. (-सं) The constellation Mrigasira: stars in Orion.  E. चन्द्रमस् the moon, and अण् affix; the moon being its ruling deity.
15003: चान्द्रमसायन m. (-नः) A name of BUDDHA, regent of mercury, and son of CHANDRA or the moon.  E. चन्द्रमस् the moon, फक् affix: or with फिञ् affix चान्द्रमसायनि.
15004: चान्द्रमास m. (-सः) A lunar month, from new moon to new moon, when it is called Mukhya, and from full moon to full moon it is termed Gouna.  E. चान्द्र lunar, मास month.
15005: चान्द्रायण m. (-णः) A religious or expiatory observance regulated by the moon's age; diminishing the daily consumption of food every day, by one mouthful, for the dark half of the month beginning with fif-teen at the full moon, until is it reduced to one at the now moon, and then increasing it in like manner during the fortnight of the moon's increase: there are other forms of this penance.  E. चन्द्र the moon, and स्वार्थे अण् aff. चन्द्रस्य अयनमिव अयनमत्र ।
15006: चान्द्रायणव्रत n. (-तं) The penance called Chandrayana.  E. चान्द्रायण as be-fore, and व्रत observance.
15007: चान्द्रायणविधान n. (-नं) The penance called Chandrayana.  E. चान्द्रायण as before, and विधान rite.
15008: चाप m. (-पः) 	 1. A bow. 	 2. (In Gemetry,) An are or portion of a circle. 3. Sagittarius, the ninth sign of the Zodiac.  E. चप् to cast, (arrows,) affix अण्.
15009: चापपट m. (-टः) A tree, (Buchanania latifolia, Rox.) See पियाल.  E. चाप a bow, and पट what goes.
15010: चापल n. (-लं) 	 1. Unsteadiness, (literally or metaphorically.) 	 2. Transi-toriness.  E. चपल trembling, अण् affix; also with यञ् affix चापल्य n. (-ल्यं.)
15011: चापलाश्रय n. (-यं) Unsteadiness: transitoriness.  E. चापल. and आश्रय support.
15013: चाबुका f. (-का) A small circular pillow.
15014: चामर nf. (-रं-रा or -री) A Chowri, the bushy tail of the Bos grunniens, used to whisk off flies, also as an emblem or insignia of princely rank.  E. चमर the Yak or Bos grunniens, and अण् aff.
15015: चामरपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) 	 1. The betel-nut tree, (Areca faufel or catechu.) 	 2. A kind of grass, (Saccharum cylindricum.) 	 3. The mango tree. 	 4. A flower, (Pandanus odoratissimus.) 	 5. Ketaka plant.  E. चामर a Chowri, and पुष्प a flower; whose flowers grow in clusters like the Indian chowri.
15016: चामरपुष्पक m. (-कः) A kind of grass: see काश.  E. कन् added to the pre-ceding.
15017: चामरिन् m. (-री) A horse.  E. चामर a Chowri, and इनि affix. Either allud-ing to his bushy tail, or the custom of whisking off flies, &c. from the animal.
15018: चामीकर n. (-रं) 	 1. Gold. 	 2. The Dhutura plant. Gold.  E. चमीकर said to mean a kind of mine, and अण् affix implying production.
15019: चामुण्डा f. (ण्डा) 	 1. A terrific form of DURGA. 	 2. One of the Matrikas. E. च the moon, and मुण्ड the head, having a head like the moon; or चा for चण्ड the name of a demon, and मुण्ड the skull; having seized the decapitated head of the demon: in either case the deriv. is irregular: see चर्ममुण्डा &c.
15020: चाम्पिला f. (-ला) The champa river. (Probably the mordern Chambal).
15021: चाम्पेय mn. (-यः-य) 	 1. The Champaca, (Michelia champaca.) 	 2. A plant commonly Nageshwar, or Naga kesara (Mesua ferrea.) 	 3. The filament of flower. 	 4. gold. 	 5. Dhutura plant.  E. चम्पा the district, and ढक् aff.
15022: चाम्प n. (-म्पं) Food, &c.  E. चम् to eat, ण्यत् aff.
15023: चाय (ऋ) चायृ r. 1st cl. (चायति-ते) 	 1. To worship, to revere. 	 2. To discern, to perceive. भ्वा-सक-उभ-वेट् ।
15024: चार m. (-रः) 	 1. Going in motion. 	 2. A spy, a secret agent or emissary. 3. Binding, a binding, a fetter, &c. 	 4. A prison, a house of confine-ment. 	 5. A kind of tree, the Piyal, (Buchanania latifolia, Rox.) see पियाल 6. Wandering about, travelling. 	 n. (-रं) A factitious poison.  E. चर going, &c. affix अण्.
15025: चारक m. (-कः) 	 1. A groom, a horseman, a cavalier. 	 2. A binding, a fetter. 	 3. An associate, a companion. 	 4. A spy. 	 5. A herdsman E. चर् to go, in the causal form, and णिच्-ण्वुल् aff.
15026: चारकाण्ड n. (-ण्डं) Ascenscional difference, (in Astronomy.)  E. चार and काण्ड part.
15027: चारचक्षुस् n. (-क्षुः) Espionage. 	 m. (-क्षुः) One (a king, &c.) who employs spies.  E. चार and चक्षुस् eye. चारश्चक्षुरस्य । नृपे ।
15028: चारचण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Graceful in gait or motion.  E. चार and चणप् aff.
15029: चारचुञ्चु mfn. (-ञ्चुः-ञ्चुः-ञ्चु) Remarkable in walking, of graceful carriage. E. चार and चुञ्चुप् aff.
15030: चारज्या f. (-ज्या) The sine of the ascensional difference. (In astronomy.) E. चार, and ज्या sine.
15031: चारटी f. (टी) A plant: see पद्मचारिणी.  E. चर in the causal, what makes go or disperses, (disease,) अटन् aff.
15032: चारण m. (-णः) 	 1. A dancer, a mime. 	 2. An actor of note. 	 3. A reader of scripture. 	 4. A panegyrist of the gods. 	 5. A bard, a herald. 	 6. A celestial singer. 	 7. A spy. 	 8. A pilgrim.  E. चर in the causal, to cause to go, to diffuse, (fame, &c.) and णिच् ल्युट् aff.
15033: चारणदारा f. plur. (-राः) Female dancers, actresses, &c.  E. चारण and दारा wives.
15034: चारपथ m. (-थः) A meeting of two roads.  E. चार a passenger, and पथिन् a road ष affix, which leaves final अच् समासान्तः ।
15035: चारभट m. (-टः) A hero, a chief or a warrior.  E. चार diffusion, (of praise, &c.) and भट who desires.
15036: चारयित्वा ind. 	 1. Having enjoined or prescribed, having caused to observe. 	 2. Having made to go.  E. चर् to go, causal form, क्त्वा aff.
15037: चारवायु m. (-युः) Summer air, zephyr.  E. चार causing to go, and वायु air or wind. चारेण रवेरुदग्गतिभेदेन कृतो वायुः ।
15038: चारान्तरित m. (-तः) A secret emissary or spy.  E. चार and अन्तरित con-cealed.
15039: चारिका f. (-का) 	 1. A female attendant. A cockroach.
15040: चारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Caused to go. 	 2. Distilled.  E. चर् to go, causal form क्त aff.
15041: चारिवाच् f. (-क्) A plant: see कर्क्कटशृङ्गी.
15042: चारित्र n. (-त्रं) 	 1. Peculiar observance or practice, peculiarity of customs or condition. 	 2. Conduct. 	 3. Reputation: see चरण f. (-त्रा) The tamarind tree.  E. चर् to go णित्रन् Unadi affix; also चरित्र &c. चरित्र-मेव स्वार्थे अण् वा ।
15043: चारित्र्य n. (-त्र्यं) Becoming practices moral conduct or instituted obser-vance.  E. चरित्र and स्वार्थे ष्यञ् aff.
15044: चारु mfn. (-रुः-र्वी-रु) 	 1. An agreeable, welcome, dear. 	 2. Beautiful, elegant. 	 m. (-रुः) A name of VRIHASPATI, regent of JUPITER, and preceptor of the gods.  E. चर् to go, Unadi affix उण्.
15045: चारुक m. (-कः) The seed of the Sara cane.  E. चारु + संज्ञायां कन् added to the last.
15046: चारुगर्भ m. (-र्भः) A son of KRISHNA.  E. चारु and गर्भ asylum.
15047: चारुगुप्त m. (-प्तः) A son of KRISHNA.  E. चारु and गुप्त preserved.
15048: चारुता f. (-ता) Loveliness, beauty.  E. तल् added to चारु; also with त्व added चारुत्वम्.
15049: चारुदेष्ण m. (-ष्णः) The son of KRISHNA by RUKMINI.
15050: चारुधामन् m. (-मा) A plant: see शठी.
15051: चारुधारा f. (-रा) A name of Sachi the wife of Indra.  E. चारु beautiful, and धारा fame, splendor, &c. चारुं चारुतां धारयति धारि अण् । चार्वी धारा अस्या वा । शच्याम् । some authorities read चारुधामा, from चारु and abode.
15052: चारुफला f. (-ला) A grape.  E. चारु beautiful, and फल fruit.
15053: चारुमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Lovely, beautiful. 	 f. (-ती) The daughter of KRISHNA by RUKMINI.  E. चारु and मतुप् aff.
15054: चारुलोचन m. (-नः) A deer. 	 f. (-ना) A woman with fine eyes.  E. चारु beautiful and लोचन an eye.
15055: चारुवर्द्धना f. (-ना) A woman.  E. चारु and वर्द्धन increasing.
15056: चारुबाहु m. (-हुः) One of KRISHNA'S sons.  E. चारु and बाहु an arm.
15057: चारुव्रता f. (-ता) A female who observes a month of fasting.  E. चारु ele-gant, and व्रत religious observance.
15058: चारुशिला f. (-ला) A jewel, a gem.  E. चारु and शिला a stone.
15059: चारुशील mfn. (-ल-ला-लं) Lovely. beautiful.  E. चारु and शील having.
15060: चारुहासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Smiling sweetly.  E. चारु and हासिन् smil-ing. चारु हसति हस-णिनि ।
15061: चारेक्षण m. (-णः) A statesman, a minister or king.  E. चारु a spy, and ईक्षण seeing.
15062: चार्च्चिक्य n. (-क्यं) 	 1. Perfuming the person, smearing it with Sandal, &c. 	 2. An unguent  E. चर्च् to beautiful, धात्वर्थे ण्वुल् affix, and चर्चिका एव स्वार्थे ष्यञ् added: see चर्चिका, &c.
15063: चार्म mfn. (-र्म-र्मी-र्मं) 	 1. Covered with leather, (a car, &c.) 	 2. Defended by a hide or skin. 	 3. Shielded, having a shield.  E. चर्म leather, and अण् aff. चर्मणा परिवृतो रथः ।
15064: चार्मण n. (-णं) A multitude of hides, or of shields, f. (-नी) covered with skin or leather &c.  E. चर्मण् a hide. &c. and अण् affix of aggre-gation. चर्मणां समूहः । चर्मसमुदाये ।
15065: चार्मिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Leather, made of leather. 	 2. Belonging to the skin, &c.  E. चर्म, and ठक् aff.
15066: चार्मिण n. (-णं) A number of men armed with shields.  E. चर्मिन् A shield-bearer, and अण् aff. चर्मिणां समूहः ।
15067: चार्व्वङ्गी f. (-ङ्गी) A beauty.  E. चारु, and अङ्ग the body.
15068: चार्व्वाक m. (-कः) 	 1. A sophist, a philosopher; one acquainted with the doctrines of the schools, a sceptic n many matters of Hindu faith, and considered by the orthodox as an atheist or materialist. 	 2. Name of an old philosopher a pupil of Brihaspati who taught the rankest form of Atheism  E. चारु good, beautiful, and वाक discourse. चारुः लोकसम्मतो वाको वाक्यं यस्य पृषो० । वृहस्पतिशिष्ये ।
15069: चार्व्वाघाट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Destructive of beauty.  E. चारु, and हन् to des-troy, affix अण् and घट substituted for the radicals; also with घात, चार्व्वाघात । चारु आहन्ति आ + हन् चारुः वाहनोऽण् अन्त्यस्य च टः संज्ञायाम् चारौ वा वार्त्ति-अण् वा टान्तादेशः ।
15070: चार्व्वी f. (-र्व्वी) 	 1. A beautiful woman, a beauty. 	 2. The wife of KUVERA. 3. Understanding, intellect. 	 4. Moonlight. 	 5. Light, splendour. E. चारु beautiful, fem. affix ङीप्. चारु + गुणवचनत्वात् स्त्रियां ङीप् ।
15071: चाल m. (-लः) 	 1. The thatch or roof of a house. 	 2. The blue jay. 	 3. Shaking, moving.  E. चल् to go, affix ण.
15072: चालक m. (-कः) A restive elephant.  E. चल् to go, ण्वुल् aff.
15073: चालन nf. (-नं-नी) A sieve, a strainer. 	 n. (नं) 	 1. Causing to move or go. 2. Muscular action.  E. चल in the causal, to make go, (grain, &c. through its pores,) णिच् भावे ल्युट् and ङीप् affs.
15074: चाष m. (-षः) 	 1. The blue jay, (Coracias Indica.) 	 2. A kingfisher, (ac-cording to some.)  E. चष् to injure, (fish. &c.) affix; स्वार्थे णिच् अच् also चास.
15075: चास m. (-सः) 	 1. The blue jay. 	 2. Sugar cane: see the preceding. चष् हिंसायां णिच् अच् पृषो० चाषखगे, इक्षुभेदे च ।
15076: चि (चिञ) चिञ् r. 1st, 5th and 10th cls. (चयति-ते चिनोति चययति or चपयति) To collect, to gather together, to heap, to assemble, to accumulate, &c. With अप, To lose, to squander. With उप or सम्, To collect or acquire. With निर्, To determine. With वि and निर्, To deter-mine exactly (ईरण) ईरणिच् r. 1st cl. (चयति) to injure, (peculiar to the Vedas.) भ्वा उभ-अनिट् । चुरा-उभ । स्वा-उभ-द्विक-अनिट् ।
15077: चिकरिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Desirous to cast or throw.  E. कृ to throw, de-siderative form, उ aff.
15078: चिकर्त्तिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Desiring or intending to cut or cut off.  E. कृत् to cut, desiderative form, उ aff.
15079: चिकित्सक m. (-कः) A physician, a practiser in medicine.  E. कित् to cure, affix स्वार्थे सन् ण्वुल् and the root reiterated.
15080: चिकित्मन n. (-नं) Healing, practising medicine.  E. कित् to relieve, rei-terative form, ल्युट् aff.
15081: चिकित्सा f. (-त्सा) The practice of medicine, healing, curing, administer-ing or applying remedies.  E. कित् to relieve, (disease,) in the redu-plicate form, affixes अ and टाप् । कित-स्वार्थे सन् भावे अ ।
15082: चिकित्सित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Remedied, healed, physicked, cured. 	 n. (-तं) Healing, remedying.  E. कित, &c.: see the preceding, affix क्त स्वार्थे सन् कर्मणि क्त । भावे क्त वा ।
15083: चिकिन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Flat-nosed.  E. नि preposition, इनच् affix in this sense, and नि changed to चिकः निनता नासिका इनच् ‘पिटाच्चिकचि च’ वार्त्ति० इनच प्रकृतेश्च चिक्यादेशः । निनतनासिके (खांँदा) ।
15084: चिकिल m. (-लः) Mud, mire.  E. चिक् to obstruct, इलच् affix deriv. irr. चि वा इलच् कुक् च । पङ्के ।
15085: चिकीर्षत् mfn. (-र्षन्-र्षन्ती-र्षत्) Wishing, purposing, meaning to do.  E. कृ to do, desiderative form, शतृ aff.
15086: चिकीर्षा f. (-र्षा) Desire to do any thing.  E. कृ to do, in the desiderative form, अ aff.
15087: चिकीर्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wished, designed. purposed. 	 n. (-तं) Purpose, intention.  E. कृ to do, desiderative form, क्त aff.
15088: चिकीर्षु mfn. (-र्षुः-र्षुः-र्षु) Desirous to do any thing.  E. कृ to do, reiterated, and उ aff.
15089: चिकुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Rashly criminal, inconsiderately guilty, punishing or injuring others without consideration. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. Hair. 	 2. A mountain. 	 3. A snake, a reptile. 	 4. A musk rat. 	 5. A kind of bird. 6. A kind of tree. 	 f. (-रा) Moving.  E. चि imitative sound, and कुर् to utter, affix क । चि इति अव्यक्तशब्दं कुरति कुर-क ।
15090: चिकुरपाश m. (-शः) Abundance of hair.  E. चिकुर &c. and पाश affix in this sense: see केशपाश; also with other affixes चिकुरपक्ष, and चिकुरहस्त, &c.
15091: चिकूर m. (-रः) Hair. E. See चिकुर; the vowel made long.
15092: चिक्क r. 10th cl. (चिक्कयति-ते) To give pain. पीडने । चु-उभ-सक-सेट् ।
15093: चिक्क mfn. (-क्कः-क्की-क्कं) Flat-nosed. 	 m. (-क्कः) A musk rat. 	 f. (-क्का) A mouse. E. चिक् imitative sound, and क who utters, from कै with ड affix; or चिक्क् to give pain, and क affix; or in the last sense, नि preposi-tion changed. to चिक् and कच् added चिक् इति अव्यक्तेन शब्देन कायति कै क ।
15094: चिक्कण mfn. (-णः-णा-णी-णं) 	 1. Unctuous, greasy. 	 2. Bland, emollient. 	 3. Smooth, glossy. 	 4. Slippery. 	 m. (-णः) The betel-nut tree. 	 nf. (-णं-णा or -णी) 	 1. The betel nut. 	 2. A good cow.  E. चित् to think of, Unadi affix अच्, the final of the radical changed to क. or चिक्क-क्विप् चिक् तं कणति कण + शब्दे अच् ।
15095: चिक्कणता f. (-ता) Smoothness, greasiness, oiliness.  E. तल् added to to the last; also with त्व चिक्कणत्वम्.
15096: चिक्कस m. (-सः) Barley meal.  E. चिक्क् to give pain, असच् aff. यवचूर्णे ।
15097: चिक्किण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 	 1. Unctuous, greasy. 	 2. Bland, emollient. 	 3. Glossy, shining, smooth. 	 4. Slippery. 	 f. (-णा) An excellent cow: see चिक्कण.
15098: चिक्रंसा f. (-सा) Wish to go or to approach.  E. क्रम् to go, desiderative form, अङ् and टाप् affs.
15099: चिक्लिद n. (-दं) Moisture, freshness.  E. क्लिद् to be wet, यङ लुक् अच् नि० । affix, root redup. अतिशयक्लेदयुक्ते ।
15100: चिङ्गेट mf. (-टः-टी) A shrimp or prawn.  E. चिङ्ग handsome, and अट what goes, the radical vowel changed; also चिङ्गड.
15101: चिचिण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A sort of gourd, commonly Chichinda, (Trichosanthes anguinæ) चि-वा इण्डच् चुक् च ।
15102: चिचीषत् mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्) Wishing to gather or collect.  E. चि to collect desiderative form, शतृ aff.
15103: चिञ्चा f. (-ञ्चा) 	 1. The tamarind tree or its fruit. 	 2. The gunja plant. E. चम् to eat, affix क्विप् and the radical vowel changed, चिम् then, चर् to go, with ड affix, and the fem. form what becomes edible. चिम् इति अव्यक्तं शब्दं चिनोति चि ड ।
15104: चिञ्चाटक m. (-कः) A sort of grass, commonly Chenchra. चिञ्चा इव अटति अट ण्वुल् । (चेंच् को) तृणभेदे ।
15105: चिञ्चाम्ल m. (-म्लः) An acid potherb, (Rumex vesicatorius.)  E. चिञ्चा and अम्ल sour. चिञ्चा इव अम्लम् अम्लशाके (आमरुल्) ।
15106: चिञ्चासार m. (-रः) A sort of potherb. (Rumex vesicatorius.)  E. चिञ्चा and सार essence. चिञ्चाया इव सारोऽस्य । अम्लशाके (आमरुल्) ।
15107: चिट r. 1st and 10th cls. (चेटति चेटयति-ते) 	 1. To be another's messenger or servant. 	 2. To order as a servant भ्वा-पर-सक-चुरा-उभ वा सेट् ।
15108: चित (ई) चिती r. 1st cl. (चेतति) चित r. 10th cl. (चेतयति-ते) also (इ) चिति r. 10th cl. (चिन्तयति) To think or reflect on, to be sensible or rational, to weigh, to remember, to consider, &c. भ्वा-पर-सक-सेट् । चु-आत्म-सक-सेट् । स्मृतौ चु-उभ-सक-सेट् ।
15109: चित् f. (-चित्) Intellect, understanding. ind. A particle and affix to words giving them an indefinite signification, as कश्चित् some one, कस्यचित् of some one, &c. see चन.  E. चित् to remember, affix भावे क्विप्
15110: चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Covered, veiled, concealed. 	 2. Collected, accum-ulated. 	 3. Piled, heaped. 	 f. (-ता) 	 1. A funeral pile. 	 2. A heap, an assemblage.  E. चि to collect, &c. affix कर्मणि क्त; also चिति and चिती
15111: चिताग्नि m. (-ग्निः) The funeral fire.  E. चिता the pile, and अग्नि fire.
15112: चिताचूडक n. (-कं) A mark where funeral pile has been, a mausoleum, a monument, &c.  E. चिता a pile, and चूडक a crest.
15113: चिति f. (-तिः) Collecting, gathering. (-तिः-ती) 	 1. funeral pile. 	 2. A heap, a quantity. 	 3. A pile, a stack. 	 4. An oblong with quadrangular sides.  E. चि to collect, affix आधारे क्तिन् and optionally ङीष् is added.
15114: चितिका f. (-का) 	 1. A funeral pile. 	 2. A small chain worn as an ornament round the loins.  E. चित् to think of, इकन् affix and fem. form. चितिरिव कायति कै क वा चिति स्वार्थे क ।
15115: चित्कार m. (-रः) A cry, a scream.  E. चित् imitative sound, and कार making. चित् + कृ भावे यञ् । पृषो वा दीर्घः । Also चीत्कार.
15116: चित्कारशब्द m. (-ब्दः) A cry, a scream.  E. चित्कार the same, and शब्द sound.
15117: चित्त n. (-त्तं) The mind or faculty of reasoning, the heart considered as the seat of intellect.  E. चित् to consider, and करणे क्त aff.
15118: चित्तकलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Anticipated, expected, calculated. 	 2. Known  E. चित्त and कलित computed.
15119: चित्तजन्मन् m. (-न्मा) Love.  E. चित्त and जन्मन् birth.
15120: चित्तनिर्वृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Contentment, happiness.  E. चित्त and निर्वृत्ति repose.
15121: चित्तप्रशम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Tranquil, content.  E. चित्त and प्रशम calmness.
15122: चित्तप्रसन्नता f. (-ता) Happiness, gaiety, joy.  E. चित्त the heart, प्रसन्नता happiness.
15123: चित्तराग mn. (-गः-गं) Passion. desire.  E. चित्त and राग passion.
15124: चित्तवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Kind-hearted, amiable.  E. चित्त and मतुप् aff.
15125: चित्तविकार m. (-रः) Change of thoughts or feelings.  E. चित्त, and विकार alteration.

15244: चिरकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Dilatory, tedious, slow.  E. चिर, and कारिन् who acts. चिरेण करोति कृ-णिनि । दीर्घसूत्रे, गौतमपुत्रभेदे च ।
