16260: जिगीषा f. (-षा) 	 1. Emulation, wish to excel or overcome. 	 2. Eminence. 3. Usage, profession or habit of life.  E. जि to conquer, in the desi-derative form, अङ् and टाप् affs.
16261: जिगीषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Striving to overcome, vieing or contending with. E. जि to conquer; desiderative form, affix उ.
16262: जिघत्सत् mfn. (-त्स्यन्-त्सन्ती-त्सत्) Wishing to eat.  E. अद् to eat, desiderative form, शतृ aff.
16263: जिघत्सा f. (-त्सा) Hunger.  E. अद् to eat, in the desiderative form, अङ् and टाप् affs.
16264: जिघत्सु mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सु-त्सु) Hungry. E. See the preceding, affix उ.
16265: जिघांसा f. (-सा) Wish or intention to kill.  E. हन् to kill, desiderative form, अङ् and टाप् affs.
16266: जिघांसु mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु) Mischievous, murderous, seeking to hurt or kill. 	 m. (-सुः) An enemy.  E. हन् to kill &c. in the desiderative form, form, उ aff.
16267: जिघांसत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) Wishing to kill, murderous, felonious. E. हन् to kill, desiderative form, शतृ aff.
16268: जिघांसियस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Very desirous or determined to kill, E. जिघांस, and ईयसुन् aff.
16269: जिघृक्षत् mfn. (-क्षन्-क्षन्ती-क्षत्) Desirous to take, greedy, avaricious. E. ग्रह् to take, desiderative form, शतृ aff.
16270: जिघृक्षा f. (-क्षा) Greediness, covetousness, wish to seize or take.  E. ग्रह् to take, desiderative form, सन् भावे अ and टाप् affs.
16271: जिघृक्षु mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु) Wishing to seize or take.  E. ग्रह् to take, desi-derative form, उ aff.
16272: जिघ्र mfn. (-घ्रः-घ्रा-घ्रं) Smelling,  E. घ्रा to smell, श affix, root reiterated.
16273: जिघ्रत् mfn. (-घ्रन् घ्रन्ती-घ्रत्) Smelling  E. घ्रा to smell, शतृ aff.
16274: जिङ्गशल्य m. (-ल्यः) A tree, (Mimosa catechu:) see जिह्मशल्य.
16275: जिङ्घि f. (-ङ्घिः or ङ्घी) Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith, Rox.)  E. इङ्ग going. from इगि to go, &c. added to जि to excel, fem. affix ङीष्; excelling all other plants.
16276: जिजीविषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Desirous of life.  E. जीव् to live, desiderative form, उ aff.
16277: जिजीषत् mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्) Wishing or striving to overcome, emulous, ambitious, a warrior.  E. जि to conquer, desiderative form, शतृ aff.
16278: जिज्ञापयिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing or seeking to inform.  E. ज्ञा to know, desiderative form of the causal. उ aff.
16279: जिज्ञासमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Inquiring, investigating.  E. ज्ञा to know, desi-derative form, शानच् aff.
16280: जिज्ञासा f. (-सा) 	 1. Asking, inquiring. 	 2. Search, investigation.  E. ज्ञा to know, desider. form, अङ् and टाप् affs.
16281: जिज्ञासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Asked, inquired, sought.  E. ज्ञा to know, de-sid. form, क्त aff.
16282: जिज्ञासु mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु) Inquiring, inquisitive.  E. ज्ञा to know, desid. form, उ aff.
16283: जित् mfn. (-जित्) Who or what conquers or surpasses.  E. जि to conquer, affix क्विप्.
16284: जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Conquered, subdued, surpassed, overcome. 	 m. (-तः) One of the attendants upon a Jina or Jaina saint.  E. जि to con-quer, aff. कर्मणि क्त.
16285: जितकाशि m. (-शिः) The fist doubled. जित conquered, काश to shine, इनि aff.
16286: जितकाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Victorious.  E. जित conquered, and काशिन् who shines, from काशृ, with णिनि aff. जितेन जयेन काशते प्रकाशते ।
16287: जितक्रोध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Of subdued passion, not to be provoked or made angry.  E. जित, and क्रोध wrath. जितः क्रोधः येन ।
16288: जितनेमि m. (-मिः) A staff made of the wood of religious fig tree. E. जित excelled, (by which,) and नेमि circumference of a wheel, (of any other wood.) जिता नेमिः अत्र ।
16289: जितशत्रु mfn. (-त्रुः-त्रुः-त्रु) Victorious, triumphant. 	 m. (-त्रुः) The father Ajita, the 2nd Jaina saint.  E. जित, and शत्रु a foe: see other simi-lar compounds, जितामित्र, जितारि, &c. जितः शत्रुः येन ।
16290: जितश्रम m. (-मः) One who is free from worldly cares, a stoic.  E. जित, and श्रम fatigue, exertion.
16291: जिताक्षर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Reading well or readily.  E. जित mastered, and अक्षर a letter. जितानि आयत्तीकृतानि अक्षराणि येन.
16292: जितात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Self-subdued, void of passion.  E. जित, and आत्मन् spirit. जितः वशीकृतः आत्मा इन्द्रियं मनः वा येन ।
16293: जितामित्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) Triumphing, victorious over an enemy. 	 m. (-त्रः) VISHNU.  E. जित subdued, by whom, and अमित्र a foe. जितः अमित्रः येन ।
16294: जितारि mfn. (-रिः-रिः-रि) Victorious, triumphant. 	 m. (-रिः) 	 1. A Jina or Jaina deified saint. 	 2. The father of SAMBHAVA, the third of the Jaina pontiffs of this age. 	 3. A conqueror.  E. जित conquered, (by whom,) and अरि an enemy.
16295: जिताहव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Victorious, triumphant.  E. जित conquered, and and आहव war, battle. जितः शत्रुः आहवे येन ।
16296: जितेन्द्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Having subdued the senses, calm, unmoved. m. (-यः) An ascetic, a sage, one who has completely subdued his passions.  E. जित subdued, इन्द्रिय an organ of sense. जितानि वशीकृतानि इन्द्रियाणि येन ।
16297: जितेन्द्रियत्व n. (-त्वं) Continece, subjugation of the senses or passions.  E. त्व added to the last.
16298: जित्तम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Most victorious, first of the victors. 	 m. (-मः) The constellation, Gemini.  E. जित, and तमप् aff.
16299: जित्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) Conquerable, vincible. 	 m. (-त्वः) A harrow. 	 f. (-त्या) A ploughshare.  E. जि to excel, क्यप् affix, तुक् augment.
16300: जित्वर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Victorious, triumphant. 	 f. (-री) The city of Benares.  E. जि to conquer or excel, क्वरप् affix, तुक् inserted, fem. affix ङीप्.
16301: जित्वा ind. Having conquered or excelled.  E. जि to conquer, क्त्वाच् aff.
16302: जिन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Victorious, triumphant. 	 m. (-नः) 	 1. A Jina, the generic name of the personage peculiar to the Jaina sect, who is ranked by them as superior to the gods of the other sects: a saint and teacher: twenty-four Jinas are supposed to flourish in an Avasarpini or Jaina age, and their writers enumer-ate those of the ages past, present, and to come. 	 2. A Buddha; a generic term applied to the chief saints of the Buddha sect, in the same manner as to those of the Jainas. 	 3. A name of VISHNU. 4. A very old man. 	 5. A sage, one who is omniscient.  E. जि to conquer or excel, नक् Unadi aff.
16303: जिनयोनि m. (-निः) A deer.  E. अजिन the skin of a deer, and योनि a place of production; the initial of the first word rejected; also अजिनयोनि.
16304: जिनसद्मन् n. (-द्म) A Jaina temple, or monastery.  E. जिन a Jina, and सद्मन् abode.
16305: जिनेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A Jaina or Jina saint.  E. जिन a Jaina teacher, and इन्द्र a lord or master.
16306: जिम (उ) जिमु r. 1st cl. (जेमति-ते) To eat: see जम भ्वा० प० सक० सेट् ।
16307: जिरि r. 5th cl. but restricted to the Vedas (जिरिणोति) To injure, wound or kill. स्वा-प-सक-सेट् । अयं वैदिकधातुः ।
16308: जिव (इ) जिवि r. 1st cl. (जिन्वति) 	 1. To please, to delight or charm. 	 2. To be pleased, or charmed. 	 3. To loose. भ्वा० प० सक० सेट् इदित् ।
16309: जिवाजिव m. (-वः) 	 1. A pheasant. 	 2. The Chakora bird: see जीवञ्जीव.
16310: जिवि r. 5th cl. (जिविनोति) To seek, to hurt or kill.
16311: जिव्रि m. (-व्रिः) 	 1. Time. 	 2. A bird.  E. जॄ to decay, Unadi affix रिक् रस्य वः and व substituted for the conversion of र.
16312: जिष (उ) जिषु r. 1st cl. (जेषति) To sprinkle. भ्वा० प० सक० सेट् ।
16313: जिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) 	 1. Victorious, triumphant. 	 2. Winning. 	 3. Ex-celling m. (-ष्णुः) 	 1. A name of VISHNU or KRISHNA. 	 2. An epithet of INDRA. 	 3. A name of ARJUNA. 	 4. The sun.  E. जि to conquer, ण्स्नु aff.
16314: जिहान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Going, going to, attaining, obtaining. 	 2. Abandoning, leaving.  E. हा to go, शानच् aff.
16315: जिहानक m. (-कः) The destruction of the world: see जहानक.
16316: जिहीर्षा f. (-र्षा) Wish to take or seize.  E. हृ to take, desiderative form, चङ् and टाप् affs.
16317: जिहीर्षु mfn. (-र्षुः-र्षुः-र्षु) Wishing to take, seizing, carrying off.  E. हृ to take, desiderative form, उ aff.
16318: जिह्म mfn. (-ह्मः-ह्मा-ह्मं) 	 1. Morally Crooked. 	 2. Dishonest. 	 3. Slow, lazy. 4. Dim, dark. 	 5. Oblique squint. 	 m. (-ह्मः) A tree, (Tabernæmontana coronaria.)  E. हा to quit, (a straight line,) मन् Unadi affix, and the root reduplicated, deriv, irr. हा मन् सन्वत् आलोपश्च ।
16319: जिह्मग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Going tortuously or lazily. 	 m. (-गः) A snake. E. जिह्म as above, and ग what goes. जिह्मं कुटिलं मन्दं वा गच्छति गम-ड ।
16320: जिह्मता f. (-ता) 	 1. Crookedness, curvature. 	 2. Dishonesty.  E. तल् added to जिह्म; also with त्व, जिह्मत्वं.
16321: जिह्ममोहन m. (-नः) A frog.  E. जिह्म slowly, and मोहन copulation.
16322: जिह्मशल्य m. (-ल्यः) The Khadira, (Mimosa catechu.)  E. जिह्म crooked, शल्य a dart.
16323: जिह्मित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Bent, bowed, curved. 	 2. Turned away.  E. जिह्म, and इतच् aff.
16324: जिह्व mf. (-ह्वः-ह्वा) The tongue.  E. लिह् to lick, Unadi affix वन्, and the initial changed do ज.
16325: जिह्वल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Greedy.  E. जिह्वा the tongue, ल to take, क affix, deriv. irr.
16326: जिह्वाग्र n. (-ग्रं) 	 1. The tip of the tongue.  E. जिह्वा, and अग्र end.
16327: जिह्वानिर्लेखन n. (-नं) 	 1. Scraping the tongue. 	 2. A tongue-scraper. E. जिह्वा, and निर्लेखन scraping.
16328: जिह्वाप m. (-पः) 	 1. A dog. 	 2. A cat. 	 3. A tiger. 	 4. The hunting leopard. 5. A bear.  E. जिह्वा the tongue, and प who drinks, who laps. जिह्वया पिबति पा-क ।
16329: जिह्वामल n. (-लं) The fur of the tongue.  E. जिह्वा, and मल dirt, excretion.
16330: जिह्वामूल n. (-लं) The root of the tongue.  E. जिह्वा, and मूल a root.
16331: जिह्वामूलीय m. (-यः) 	 1. A term applied to the Visarga before क, and ख, and also to the guttural class of consonant. 	 2. A character substi-tuted for the Viserga as हरिःकाम्य, and with a like sound.  E. जिह्वा-मूल, and छ aff.
16332: जिह्वारद m. (-दः) A bird.  E. जिह्वा, and रद a tooth; whose tooth, (i. e. beak,) is like a tongue. जिह्वा रदः इव यस्य । पक्षिणि ।
16333: जिह्वालिह m. (-लिट्) A dog.  E. जिह्वा, and लिह् who licks or laps, from लिह् with क्विप् aff.
16334: जिह्वास्वाद m. (-दः) Licking, lapping.  E. जिह्वा the tongue, and आस्वाद eating.
16335: जिह्वाशत n. (-तं) A hundred tongues.  E. जिह्वा, and शत a century.
16336: जिह्वोल्लेखन n. (-नं) Scraping the tongue. 	 f. (-नी) A tongue-scraper, made of a thin piece of wood of the Mimusops Kauki or other trees. E. जिह्वा, and उल्लेखन scraping; also in the second sense. with कन् added, जिह्वोल्लेखनिका ।
16337: जीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Old, aged.  E. ज्या to become old, क्त affix, deriv. irr.
16338: जीमूत m. (-तः) 	 1. A cloud. 	 2. A mountain. 	 3. A grass, (Andropogon serratus.) 	 4. A name of INDRA. 	 5. A nourisher, a sustainer. 	 6. A plant: see घोषक. 	 7. A species of the Dandaka metre.  E. जि to excel or surpass, Unadi affix तन् and मूट् augment, or जी for जीव life, and मूत who urines. जयति नभः जीयते अनिलेन वा ।
16339: जीमूतकुट m. (-टः) A small hill near a mountain.  E. जीमूत a mountain, and कुट a house.
16340: जीमूतवाहन m. (-नः) 	 1. INDRA. 	 2. The author of “Dayabhaga” a celebrated work on inheritance.  E. जीमूत a cloud, and वाहन vehicle. जीमूतः मेघः वाहनम् अस्य ।
16341: जीमूतवाहिन् m. (-ही) Smoke.  E. जीमूत a cloud, and वह् to bear, affix णिनि.
16342: जीर m. (-रः) 	 1. Cumin-seed. 	 2. A sacrificial knife or sword, a scymitar. 3. A sort of panic seed: see अणु.  E. जु to go, or grow quickly, रक् Unadi affix, and the radical vowel changed.
16343: जीरक m. (-कः) Cumin seed.  E. कन् added to the preceding.
16344: जीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 	 1. Old, ancient. 	 2. Withered decayed. 	 3. Digest-ed. 	 m. (-र्णः) 	 1. An old man. 	 2. Cumin seed. 	 n. (-र्णं) Benjamin. E. E. जॄ to become old or decayed, affix क्त.
16345: जीर्णज्वर m. (-रः) Fever of some continuance and diminished intensity. E. जीर्ण, and ज्वर fever.
16346: जीर्णता f. (-ता) 	 1. Old oge. 	 2. Infirmity, decay.  E. जीर्ण and तल् affix; also with त्व, जीर्णत्वं.
16347: जीर्णदारु m. (-रुः) A potherb, (Convolvulus argentaceus.)  E. जीर्ण and दारु wood.
16348: जीर्णपर्ण m. (-र्णः) The Kadamba: see कदम्बक. 	 n. (-र्णं) A withered leaf. E. जीर्ण old, withered, and पर्ण a leaf.
16349: जीर्णवज्र n. (-ज्रं) A particular gem, said to be a sort of diamond.  E. जीर्ण decayed, वज्र diamond.
16350: जीर्णवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Old, decayed.  E. जॄ to grow old, क्तवतु aff.
16351: जीर्णवस्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) Old, worn or tattered raiment.  E. जीर्ण old, and वस्त्र cloth or clothes.
16352: जीर्णवाटिका f. (-का) A ruined mansion.  E. जीर्ण, and वाटिका a house.
16353: जीर्णब्रध्नक m. (-कः) A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.)  E. जीर्ण old, and ब्रध्न a root, affix कन्.
16354: जीर्णि f. (-र्णिः) 	 1. Old age, infirmity, decay. 	 2. Digestion.  E. जॄ to be-come old, क्तिन् aff.
16355: जीर्णोद्यान n. (-नं) A neglected garden.  E. जीर्ण, and उद्यान a garden.
16356: जीर्णोद्धार m. (-रः) Repairing, renewal, repairs.  E. जीर्ण and उद्धार lifting up.
16357: जीर्णोद्धृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Repaired, renewed.  E. जीर्ण, and उद्धृत lifted up.
16358: जीर्वि m. (-र्विः) 	 1. An axe. 	 2. A cart. 	 3. The body.  E. जॄ to decay, Unadi affix क्विन्.
16359: जीव (ऋ) जीवृ r. 1st cl. (जीवति) To live. With आङ् To use or enjoy, to get a living. With उप, To be dependent on for a living. With सं or प्र To live agreeably. भ्वा० अक० प० सेट् ।
16360: जीव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 	 1. Life, the vital breath, existence. 	 mf. (-वः-वा) 	 1. Livelihood, profession, specific occupation. 	 2. A tree: see जीवन्ती. m. (-वः) 	 1. The sentient soul, the emanation of the deity, which is incorporated with the animal body, and gives it life, motion and sensation; hence also called जीवात्मन्; it is opposed to that abstract state of the soul परमात्मन् in which, by meditating upon its own divine nature and origin, the spirit is set at liberty from human feelings and passions. 	 2. A name of VRIHASPATI. 	 3. A name of the prince KARNA. 	 4. The constellation called Pushya. f. (-वा) 	 1. A bow string. 	 2. The earth. 	 3. The tinkling of metallic ornaments. 	 4. Orris root. 	 5. (In Geometry.) The chord of an arc. E. जीव् to live, affix घञ् or क and fem. affix टाप्.
16361: जीवक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. A servant, a slave, one who gets a livelihood by service. 	 2. A snake-catcher, one whose business is catching snakes, curing their bites, &c. 	 3. An usurer, or one who lives by lending money at high interest. 	 4. A mendicant or one who lives by begging. 	 5. One whose life is prolonged by blessings. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa:) see असन. 	 2. A medicinal plant, com-monly called by the same name Jivaca, and considered as one of the eight principal drugs, classed together under the name अष्टबर्ग. 3. An animal, any being endowed with life.  E. जीव् to live, affix णिच् ण्वुल् or वुन्.
16362: जीवग्राह m. (-हः) A prisoner, one taken alive.  E. जीव, and ग्राह capture.

16469: जेह (ऋ) जेहृ r. 1st cl. (जेहते) 	 1. To resolve, to attempt resolutely, to endeavour diligently or perseveringly. 	 2. To go, to move.  E. भ्वा-आ-अक-सेट् ।
16470: जै r. 1st cl. (जयति) To wane or decline.  E. भ्वा-प-अक-अनिट्.
16471: जैत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं) 	 1. Victorious, triumphant. 	 2. Leading to victory. 	 m. (-त्रः) 	 1. A conqueror, a victor. 	 2. Quicksilver. 	 f. (-त्री) A tree, (Æs-chynomene sesban.)  E. जेतृ to conquer or excel, प्रज्ञा० अण् aff.
16472: जैत्ररथ m. (-थः) A hero, a victor, a conqueror.  E. जैत्र victorious, and रथ a car; whose chariot is triumphant जैत्रः रथः अस्य ।
16473: जैन m. (-नः) A Jaina, a follower of the principles of a Jina or teacher of heterodox notions, the chief of which are, the supremacy of certain religious pontiffs over the gods of the Hindus, a denial of the divine authority of the Vedas, and a disregard of the distinc-tion of castes.  E. जिन a Jina, and अण् aff. जिनः देवता अस्य ।
16474: जैपाल m. (-लः) A plant, (Croton tiglium): see जयपाल, the diphthong being considered as a substitute for the semivowel and vowels of the first members of the compound; it is most probably a corrup-tion borrowed from the dialects in which such a substitution is common.
16475: जैमिनि m. (-निः) The name of a celebrated saint and philosopher, the pupil of VYASA, and founder of the Purva Mimansa school, which is commented by Savaraswami.
16476: जैवातृक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Long-lived. 	 2. Thin, spare. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. The moon. 	 2. A drug, a medicament. 	 3. Camphor. 	 4. A son. 	 f. (की) 	 1. Longlived. 	 2. Thin, lean.  E. जीव life, आतृ कन् Unadi affix, and the radical vowel changed.
16477: जैष्णव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Relating to a conqueror, to ARJUNA, &c.  E. जिष्ण as above, and अण् aff.
16478: जैह्म्य n. (-ह्म्यं) Crookedness, moral or physical.  E. जिह्म crooked, ष्यञ् aff.
16479: जोङ्गक n. (-कं) Alœ wood or Agallochum.  E. जुगि to remove, ण्वुल् affix; dissipating bad smells.
16480: जोङ्गट m. (-टः) 	 1. Longing for, wishing earnestly or eagerly. 	 2. The longings of a pregnant woman.  E. जुगि to abandon, (all objects save that desired,) and अटन् aff.
16481: जोटिङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. A name of SIVA. 	 2. A devotee, an ascetic, who sub-jects himself to the severest penances.  E. जुट the braided hair of SIVA, ग who goes, from गम् to go, the form is irregular.
16482: जोन्ताला f. (-ला) A kind of grain: see देवधान्य.
16483: जोष n. (-षं) Happiness, felicity, pleasure, enjoyment, satisfaction. 	 f. (-षा) A woman: see जोषा; also जोषित्, जोषिता, &c.  E. जुष् to delight, affix भावे घञ् fem. affix टाप्.
16484: जोषम् ind. 	 1. Silently. 	 2. In happiness, delightedly at ease, &c. 	 3. Well, excellently. 	 4. Excessively, beyond bounds.  E. जुष् to please or be pleased, affix अमु, संज्ञायां कन् ।
16485: जोषिका f. (-का) 	 1. A bud, a germ. 	 2. A woman.  E. जुष् to please, affix कन्. and fem form; some copies have more accurately perhaps कोषिका.
16486: जोषित् f. (-षित्) A woman.  E. जुष् to delight, affix इति; also योषित, जोषिता, &c.
16487: जोषिता f. (-ता) A woman,  E. जुष् to please, affix क्त; also योषित, योषिता, &c.
16488: ज्ञ A compound letter, considered to be composed of ज and ञ; it is usually expressed by jn or gn, but its peculiar nasal sound is not well conveyed by any combination of the Roman alphabet.
16489: ज्ञ mfn. (ज्ञः ज्ञा ज्ञं) Who or what knows. 	 m. (ज्ञः) 	 1. A wise and learned man; it especially applies to one possessed of sacred learning, and religious knowledge. 	 2. A name of BRAMHA. 	 3. The moon. 	 4. Bu-dha, first of the line of the moon, and regent of the planet MER-CURY. 	 5. The planet MARS or its regent. 	 6. The Sentient soul. E. ज्ञा to know, to possess knowledge, affix क.
16490: ज्ञप r. 10th cl. (ज्ञपयति-ते) 	 1. To know. 	 2. To cause to be known: see ज्ञा. 3. To whet or sharpen. 	 4. To beat. 	 5. To please.  E. चुरा० उभ० सक० सेट् घटादि ।
16491: ज्ञपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Taught, expounded, made known.  E. ज्ञप् to make known, affix क्त, नि-वा-इट् optionally inserted, otherwise ज्ञप्त.
16492: ज्ञप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Made known: see the preceding.
16493: ज्ञप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Understanding, comprehension, the exercise of the intel-lectual faculty.  E. ज्ञप् to make known, affix भावे क्तिन्, deriv. irr.
16494: ज्ञा r. 9th cl. (जानाति जानीते) To know, to understand. With अनु, prefix-ed, 1. To assent or conform to. 	 2. To acknowledge. With अप, To conceal. With अव, To disrespect, to despise. With उप, To deny knowledge of any thing. With परि, To ascertain. With प्र, To know well. With प्रति or सम्, To assent, to admit, to agree, to pro-mise. With प्रति and अभि, To recognise. With वि, To discriminate, to know. With सम्, To recollect or possess the power of knowing. (In combination, it usually takes the deponent form, as अनुजानीते, अपजानीते, &c.) r. 10th cl. (ज्ञापयतिते) To command, to direct; आङ् is usually prefixed in this sense. r. 1st cl. but occurring in the form of the causal, (ज्ञपयति) 	 1. To slay. 	 2. To gratify or please. 	 3. To exhibit 4. To sharpen. 	 5. To praise. In these senses the root is, in general. combined with a prefix. क्र्या-प-सक-अनिट् । चु-उभ-सक-सेट् ।
16495: ज्ञात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Known, comprehended, understood fully.  E. ज्ञा to know, affix कर्मणि क्त.
16496: ज्ञातव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be known or understood.  E. ज्ञा, and तव्य aff.
16497: ज्ञातसिद्धान्त m. (-न्तः) A man completely versed in any science or Shastra. E. ज्ञात what is known, and सिद्धान्त completion.
16498: ज्ञातान्वय m. (-यः) A name of Varddhamana, the last Jina or Jaina pon-tiff.  E. ज्ञात known, and अन्वय lineage.
16499: ज्ञाति m. (-तिः) 	 1. A father. 	 2. A kinsman in general. 	 3. A distant kins-man, one who does not participate in the oblations of food or water offered to deceased ancestors.  E. ज्ञा to know, affix कर्त्तरि करणे वा क्तिच्; who is known, an acquaintance.
16500: ज्ञातिकर्मन् n. (-र्म) Duty of kindred.  E. ज्ञाति, and कर्म act; also ज्ञातिकार्य्य.
16501: ज्ञातित्व n. (-त्वं) Relationship, kin.  E. त्व added to ज्ञाति.
16502: ज्ञातृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Knowing, wise, intelligent, who or what knows. E. ज्ञा to know, तृच् active aff.
16503: ज्ञातेय n. (-यं) Relationship, affinity.  E. ज्ञाति a kinsmen, and ढक् aff.
16504: ज्ञात्वा ind. Having known.  E. ज्ञा to know, क्त्वाच् aff.
16505: ज्ञान n. (-नं) 	 1. Knowledge in general. 	 2. Knowledge of a specific and religious kind, that which is derived from meditation, and the study of philosophy, which teaches man the divine nature and origin of his immaterial part, with the unreality of corporal en-joyments or worldly forms, and which, separating him during life from terrestrial objects, secures him, after death, a final eman-cipation from existence, and reunion with the universal spirit. 	 3. Cognizance, consciousness. 	 4. The organ of intelligence, sense. 	 5. Learning.  E. ज्ञा to know, aff. भावे ल्युट्.
16506: ज्ञानगम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) Attainable by knowledge.  E. ज्ञान, and गम्य attainable.
16507: ज्ञानचक्षुस् mn. (-क्षुः) 	 1. (Intellect, intellectual vision.) A learned & wise-man.  E. ज्ञान, and चक्षुस् the eye.
16508: ज्ञानतपस् n. (-पः) Cultivation of sacred knowledge.  E. ज्ञान, and तपस् religious austerity.
16509: ज्ञानतस ind. 	 1. By or 2. Knowingly, intentionally, through knowledge. E. ज्ञान, and तसिल् aff.
16510: ज्ञानदर्पण m. (-णः) One of the Jaina saints.  E. ज्ञान true knowledge, and दर्पण a mirror.
16511: ज्ञानदीप m. (-पः) Knowledge, the lamp of knowledge.  E. ज्ञान, and दीप a lamp.
16512: ज्ञाननिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Cultivating spiritual knowledge.  E. ज्ञान, and निष्ठ engaged in.
16513: ज्ञानपर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Versed in spiritual wisdom.  E. ज्ञान, and पर attentive to.
16514: ज्ञानपूर्व mfn. (-र्वः-र्वा-र्वं) Preceded by the acquirement of divine wis-dom.  E. ज्ञान, and पूर्व prior.
16515: ज्ञानमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) 	 1. Consisting of knowledge, made up of it. 	 2. Spiritual.  E. ज्ञान, and मयट् aff.
16516: ज्ञानमुद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं) Having the impress of wisdom, wise, making wise.  E. ज्ञान, and मुद्रा a seal.
16517: ज्ञानमूल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Founded on spiritual knowledge.  E. ज्ञान, and मूल root.
16518: ज्ञानलक्षण nf. (-णं-णा) 	 1. Indication, sign, means of knowing or inferring. 2. (In Logic.) Sign or proof of knowledge, or subsequent derived from antecedent knowledge.  E. ज्ञान, and लक्षण indication.
16519: ज्ञानवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Wise, especially in spiritual things.  E. ज्ञान, and मतुप् aff.
16520: ज्ञानविज्ञान n. (-नं) 	 1. Sacred and profane knowledge. 	 2. The Vedas and their subordinate parts, as medicine, war, &c.  E. ज्ञान, and विज्ञान miscellaneous knowledge.
16521: ज्ञानानुत्पाद m. (-दः) Folly, ignorance.  E. ज्ञान, and अनुत्पाद nonproduction.
16522: ज्ञानावस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Occupied by wisdom.  E. ज्ञान, and अवस्थित placed.
16523: ज्ञानिन् mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि) 	 1. Wise, intelligent. 	 2. Knowing, who or what knows. 	 m. (-नी) 	 1. An astrologer, a fortune-teller, a man prescient of future events. 	 2. A sage, one possessing religious wisdom or Jnan (ज्ञान) as above.  E. ज्ञान knowledge, affix इनि.
16524: ज्ञानेन्द्रिय n. (-यं) An organ of preception or consciousness, the skin, tongue, eye, ear and nose (intellect.)  E. ज्ञान, and इन्द्रिय an organ. ज्ञायते अनेन ज्ञा-करणे ल्युट् । ज्ञानसाधनम् इन्द्रियम् ।
16525: ज्ञापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Making or causing to know. 	 m. (-कः) An in-structor. 	 2. A commander, a master. 	 n. (-कं) A rub or precept imply-ing something not expressly mentioned or laid down (In Philspay) E. ज्ञा to know, causal form, णिच् ल्युट् aff.
16526: ज्ञापन n. (-नं) Making known, apprising, informing.  E. ज्ञा to know, causal form, णिच् ल्युट् aff.
16527: ज्ञाप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Making known, informing.  E. ज्ञा to know, causal form, क्तिन् aff.
16528: ज्ञीप्सा f. (-प्सा) The desire of knowing.
16529: ज्ञेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be known, what may be or ought to be known. E. ज्ञा, and कर्मणि यत् aff.
16530: ज्यका f. (-का) The chord of an are.  E. ज्या the same, कन् added.
16531: ज्या r. 9th cl. (जिनाति) To decay, to be or become old. क्य्रा० प्वा० पर० अक० अनिट् ।
16532: ज्या f. (ज्या) 	 1. A mother. 	 2. The earth, 3. A bowstring. 	 4. The chord of an are.  E. ज्या to become old, to decay, affixes अघ्न्या० यक् ।
16533: ज्याघोष m. (-षः) Twang of a bow.  E. ज्या, and घोष sound.
16534: ज्यानि f. (-निः) 	 1. Old age, decay, infirmity. 	 2. Abandoning, quitting, leaving. 	 3. A river, a stream.  E. ज्या to decay, &c. Unadi aff. नि.
16535: ज्यायस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) 	 1. Very old. 	 2. Very excellent, best. 	 3. Su-perior, Elder, elder born. 	 4. In law, one independent (come of age) and answerable for his own conduct.  E. ज्या to be old, ईयसुन् affix. अतिशयेन प्रशस्यः वृद्धः वा ।
16536: ज्यु r. 1st cl. (ज्यवते) To go or approach.  E. भ्वा-आ-सक-अनिट् ।
16537: ज्युत r. 1st cl. (ऋ) ज्युतृ (ज्योतते;) also (इर) ज्युतिर r. 1st cl. (ज्योतति) To shine. see द्युत । भ्वा० आ० अक० सेट् । भ्वा-पर-सक-सेट् ।
16538: ज्येष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठी-ष्ठं) 	 1. Best, most excellent, pre-eminent. 	 2. Very old, oldest. 	 3. most senior Elder, elder born. 	 f. (-ष्ठा) 	 1. One of the aste-risms, considered as lunar mansions; the eighteenth, comprising three stars, of which one is a Scorpionis, figured by a ring or ear-ring. 	 2. The middle finger. 	 3. Misfortune, personified as a goddess. 4. The Ganges, (-ष्ठा or ष्ठी) A small house lizard. 	 m. (-ष्ठः) The month Jyeshtha or Jeyte, (May-June.) 	 n. (-ष्ठं) Age, oldness.  E. ज्या to decay, to grow infirm or old, affix इष्ठन्, fem. affixes टाप् and ङीष्.
16539: ज्येष्ठता f. (-ता) Seniority. 	 2. Superiority.  E. ज्येष्ठ, and तल् affix; also ज्येष्ठत्व.
16540: ज्येष्ठतात m. (-तः) A father's elder brother.  E. ज्येष्ठ elder born, and तात a father; the usual order of composition is here irregularly inverted.
16541: ज्येष्ठभार्य्या f. (-र्य्या) 	 1. An elder brother's wife. 	 2. The elder or chief wife. E. ज्येष्ठ, and भार्य्या wife.
16542: ज्येष्ठवर्ण m. (-र्णः) A Brahman.  E. ज्येष्ठ elder born or best, वर्ण tribe.
16543: ज्येष्ठवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) The duties of age or seniority.  E. ज्येष्ठ, and वृत्ति practice.
16544: ज्येष्ठावाप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) To be obtained by virtue or seniority, &c. E. ज्येष्ठ, and आवाप्य obtainable.
16545: ज्येष्ठश्वश्रू f. (-श्रू) A wife's elder sister.  E. ज्येष्ठ elder, श्वश्रू mother-in-law.
16546: ज्येष्ठसामन् n. (-म) 	 1. A portion of the Sama Veda. 	 2. A religious rite of which its perusal is a part.
16547: ज्येष्ठांश m. (-शः) 	 1. The elder brother's share. 	 2. The best share.  E. ज्येष्ठ, and अंश a share.
16548: ज्येष्ठामूलीय m. (-यः) The month of Jyeshtha.  E. ज्य्येष्ठा the constellation, (as above,) मूल root, origin, and छ aff.
16549: ज्येष्ठाम्बु m. (-म्बुः) The scum of boiled rice, or water in which grain has been washed.  E. ज्येष्ठ, and अम्बु water.
16550: ज्यष्ठाश्रम m. (-मः) 	 1. The order of the householder. 	 2. A householder. E. ज्येष्ठ, and आश्रम order.
16551: ज्येष्ठाश्रमिन् m. (-मी) A householder, a man of the second order. E. ज्येष्ठ best, आश्रम order, इनि aff.
16552: ज्यैष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) The month Jyeshtha or Jeyte, (May-June.) 	 f. (-ष्ठी) 1. The day of full moon in Jeyshta. 	 2. A house lizard. E. ज्यैष्ठा the mansion or asterism which the moon is in this month, and अण् aff.
16553: ज्यैष्ठसामन् m. (-मा) A Brahman versed in that portion of the Sama Veda called Jyeshtha Sama. ज्येष्ठसामन् as above. aff. अण्.
16554: ज्यैष्ठिनेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Born of the elder or principal wife.  E. ज्यैष्ठा, and ढक् affix, इनङ् inserted.
16555: ज्यैष्ठ्य n. (-ष्ठं) Seniority, age.  E. ज्यैष्ठ, and यञ् aff.
16556: ज्यो r. 1st cl. (ज्यवते) 	 1. To advise or instruct. 	 2. To order. 	 3. To ob-serve a vow or any religious obligation.  E. भ्वा-आ-सक-अनिट् ।
16557: ज्योतिःशास्त्र n. (स्त्रं) 	 1. The science of Astronomy or astrology. E. ज्योतिस् and शास्त्र a Scripture.
16558: ज्योतिरिङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) A fire-fly.  E. ज्योतिस् light, इगि to go, affix क; also with युच् affix, ज्योतिरिङ्गण n. (-णं).
16559: ज्योतिर्गण m. (-णः) The heavenly bodies collectively.  E. ज्योतिस् a planet, and गण a class.
16560: ज्योतिर्विद् m. (-त्) An astrologer, an arithmetician.  E. ज्योतिस्, and विद् who knows. ज्योतिषां मूर्य्यादीनां गत्यादिकं वेत्ति विद्-क्विप् ।
16561: ज्योतिर्विद्या f. (-द्या) The science of computation, from arithmetic to as-tronomy and astrology.  E. ज्योतिस्, and विद्या science.
16562: ज्योतिर्वीज n. (-जं) A fire-fly.  E. ज्योतिस् light, and वीज seed.
16563: ज्योतिश्चक्र n. (-क्रं) 	 1. The zodiac. 	 2. The lunar mansion.  E. ज्योतिस्, pla-net, and चक्र a sphere.
16564: ज्योतिष mfn. (-षः-षी-षं) Astrological, astronomical, relating to the hea-venly bodies. 	 mf. (-षः-षी) An astrologer. 	 n. (-पं) Mathemetical, as-tronomical and astrological science, astronomy. 	 f. (-षी) A star, a planet, a asterism.  E. ज्योतिस् light, especially of the heavenly bodies, affix अच्, fem. ङीष्.
16565: ज्योतिषिक m. (-कः) An astrologer: see ज्योतिषिक.
16566: ज्योतिष्क m. (-ष्कः) 	 1. A planetary or heavenly body; the generic term for the sun, the moon, a planet, an asterism, a star: the word in the m. plu. (-ष्काः) implies all these five. 	 2. A tree, the wood of which is used to produce fire by attribution: see गणिकारिका f. (-का) Heart-pea: see ज्योतिष्मती.  E. ज्योतिस् light, and क what makes, from कृ, with ड aff.
16567: ज्योतिष्कल्प mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं) Blazing, radient, like flame or fire. E. ज्योतिस्, and कल्प affix, implying resemblance.
16568: ज्योतिष्टोम n. (-मं) A particular sacrifice at which sixteen officiating priests are required. It is a sacrifice considered as the typical form of a whole class of sacrificial ceremonies.  E. ज्योतिस् light, and स्तोम a sacrifice.
16569: ज्योतिष्मत् m. (-ष्मान्) The sun. 	 f. (-ष्मती) Heart-pea, (Halicacabum cardios-permum)  E. ज्योतिस् light or splendor, and मतुप् poss. aff.
16570: ज्योतिस् n. (-तिः) 	 1. Light. 	 2. A star. 	 3. The pupil of the eye. The faculty of seeing. 	 4. The light regarded as the supreme spirit. 	 5. The lightening. 	 6. A heavenly body. 	 m. (-तिः) 	 1. The sun. 	 2. AGINI or fire.  E. द्यत् to shine, to be or give light इसुन् Unadi affix, and ज substituted for the radical initial.
16571: ज्योतिस्मात् ind. In flame or fire.  E. ज्योतिस्, and साति aff.
16572: ज्योतीरथ m. (-थः) The pole star, or in mythology DHRUVA, the son of UTTANAPADA.  E. ज्योतिस् a star, and रथ a vehicle.
16573: ज्योत्स्ना f. (-त्स्ना) 	 1. Moonlight. 	 2. Amoonlight night. 	 3. A small cucum-ber: see ज्योत्स्नी.  E. ज्योतिस् light, त affix, and the penultimate re-jected, deriv. irr. fem. affix टाप्; also with ङिष्, ज्योत्स्नी q. v.
16574: ज्योत्स्नाप्रिय m. (-यः) The Chakora or Greek partridge.  E. ज्योत्स्ना moon-light, and प्रिय fond of; this bird is said to feed upon the moon-beams.
16575: ज्योत्स्नावृक्ष m. (-क्षः) The tripod or tree of a lampstand, a candle-stick. E. ज्योत्स्ना moonlight, (put for lamp-light,) and वृक्ष a tree.
16576: ज्योत्स्नी f. (-त्स्नी) 	 1. A moonlight night. 	 2. A small cucumber, (Tricho-santhes diæca;) it is also applied to Luffa acutangula, &c. 	 3. A kind of perfume: see रेणुका. E. See ज्योत्स्ना.
16578: ज्यौतिषिक m. (-कः) An astrologer or astronomer.  E. ज्योतिस् a star, affix ठक्; also the the vowel being unchanged optionally, ज्योतिषिक.
16579: ज्यौत्स्न mfn. (-त्स्नः-त्स्नी-त्स्नं) Light, especially with moonlight, &c. E. ज्योत्स्ना moonlight, अण् affix: see ज्योत्स्नी and ज्यौत्स्निका.
16580: ज्यौत्स्निका f. (-का) A moonlight.  E. ज्योत्स्नी, and कन् added.
16581: ज्यौत्स्नी f. (-त्स्नी) A moonlight night, or a night on which the moon is full. 	 2. A kind of cucumber: see ज्यीत्स्नी.  E. ज्यौत्स्नी as above, and अण् pleonastic aff.
16582: ज्रि r. 1st cl. (ज्रयति) 	 1. To conquer, to reduce. 	 2. To be conquered or reduced.  E. भ्वा-प-सक-अनिट् ।
16583: ज्री r. 1st cl. (ज्रिणाति) r. 1st and 10th cls. (ज्रयति-ज्राययति-ते) To grow old, to be or become old or decayed.  E. क्र्या-प्वा-प-अक-अनिट् । भ्वा-वाचुरा-उभ ।
16584: ज्वर r. 1st cl. (ज्वरति) To be diseased, to be feverish, &c. भ्वा-प-अक ।
16585: ज्वर m. (-रः) 	 1. Fever, intermitting or continued. 	 2. Mental Pain, affli-ction, Distress.  E. ज्वर to be feverish, affix भावेघ ।
16586: ज्वरघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Anti-febrile, febrifuge. 	 f. (-घ्नी) 	 1. A plant, (Men-ispermum glabrum.) 	 2. A potherb, (Chenopocium album)  E. ज्वर, and घ्न what destroys. ज्वरं हन्ति हन-ठक् ।
16587: ज्वरनाशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Febrifuge.  E. ज्वर, and नाशक what destroys.
16588: ज्वरहन्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) Febrifuge.  E. ज्वर, and हन् what destroys; ज्वरहन् m. (-हा)
16589: ज्वराग्नि m. (-ग्निः) Feverish heat, or the hot paroxysm of fever.  E. ज्वर fever, and अग्नि fire.
16590: ज्वरान्तक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Febrifuge. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. A kind of Nimb from Nepal. 	 2. Casia fistula.  E. ज्वर, and अन्तक what removes.
16591: ज्वरापहा f. (-हा) A plant, (Medicago esculenta.)  E. ज्वर fever, अपहा removing.
16592: ज्वरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Febrile, feverish, affected with fever.  E. ज्वर् to be feverish, क्त aff.
16593: ज्वरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Febrile, feverish, fevered.  E. ज्वर, and इनि.
16594: ज्वल r. 1st cl. (ज्वलति,) or with a prefix, r. 10th cl. (प्रज्वलयति-ते) 	 1. To shine to blaze, to flame. 	 2. To be ardent. 	 3. To kindle  E. भ्वा-प-अक-सेट् चु० उ० ।
16595: ज्वल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Blazing, shining. 	 m. (-लः) Flame, blaze, light.  E. ज्वल् to blaze, affix अच्; also ज्वाल.
16596: ज्वलका f. (-का) A large Flame.  E. ज्वल् to blaze, affix वुन्.
16597: ज्वलत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्) 	 1. Burning, blazing. 	 2. Shining, radient, brilliant.  E. ज्वल् to burn, शतृ aff.
16598: ज्वलन n. (-नं) 	 1. Burning, blazing. 	 2. The fire. 	 m. (-नः) AGNI, or fire. 3. The number “Three.”  E. ज्वल् to blaze, affix ताच्छील्यादौ युच् ।
16599: ज्वलनाश्मन् m. (-श्मा) The sun-stone.  E. ज्वलन, and अश्मन् a stone.
16600: ज्वलन्मणि mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि) Blazing with jewels. 	 m. (-णिः) A brilli-ant gem.  E. ज्वलत्, and मणि a jewel.
16601: ज्वलयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 	 1. Burning, blazing. 	 2. Radient.  E. ज्वल् to burn, r. 10th cl. शतृ aff.
16602: ज्वलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Burnt. 	 2. Blazing, flaming.  E. ज्वल् to flame, affix क्त.
16603: ज्वलितनयन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fiery-eyed, looking angrily or fiercely. E. ज्वलित, and नयन the eye; also ज्वलितचक्षुस्, ज्वलितनेच, &c.
16604: ज्वलिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) 	 1. Burning, flaming. 	 2. Shining.  E. ज्वल, and इनि aff.
16605: ज्वाल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Burning, blazing. 	 mf. (लः-ला) Flame, blaze. 	 f. (-ला) Burnt rice.  E. ज्वल् to blaze, affix अण्, fem. affix टाप् or ङीप्.
16606: ज्वालाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) Flame.  E. ज्वाल, and अग्नि fire.
16607: ज्वालजिह्व m. (-ह्वः) AGNI, or fire.  E. जाला, and जिह्वा a tongue; whose tongue is flame.
16608: ज्वालामुखी f. (-खी) A place where subterraneous fires break forth; an object of veneration to the Hindus: a celebrated Jwalamukhi exists in Punjab, to which pilgrimages are made; the soil abound-ing with carburetted hydrogen, which takes fire upon coming in contact with the external air; otherwise vents being made, a light is applied to the orifice, and flame being kindled, is fed by the stream of gas that escapes. The tongue of PARVATI is said to have fallen at this place.  E. ज्वाला flame, and मुख chief, principal, fem. affix ङीष् ।
16609: ज्वालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) 	 1. Flaming, blazing. 	 2. An Epithet of Siva. E. ज्वल्, and णिनि aff.
16610: झ The ninth consonant of the Deva Nagara alphabet; the aspirate of the preceding letter, and corresponding in power to Jh.
16611: झ mfn. (झः झा झं) 	 1. Asleep, sleeping. 	 2. Lost, destroyed. 	 m. (झः) 1. A name of VRIHASPATI, preceptor of the gods. 	 2. A name of the chief of the Daityas or demons. 	 3. Sound or a sort of sound like the splashing of water, or the classing of cymbals, jangling, clanging, &c. 	 4. High wind. 	 5. A stray, a thing lost or mislaid. 	 6. Playing a tune, beating time. 	 f. (झा) The descent of a cascade, a water fall.  E. झट to collect, affix ड.
16612: झङ्कार m. (-रः) A low inarticulate sound, as the buzzing of bees, &c. E. झ, and कार a making. कृ-घञ् ।
16613: झञ्झन n. (-नं) An indistinct noise, like the jangling of metallic orna-ments, a ringing, a rattling, &c.
16614: झञ्झा f. (-ञ्झा) 	 1. Wind, wind and rain, a hurricane, a gale. 	 2. A sharp clanging sound, jangling. 	 3. Raining in large drops. 	 4. A stray, any thing lost. झमिति कृत्वा झटति झट-ड ।
16615: झञ्झानिल m. (-लः) Wind with rain, a high wind in the rainy season, a typhoon or the sort of tempest frequent during the south-west monsoon.  E. झञ्झा heavy rain, and अनिल wind; also झञ्झा-मरुत्, &c.
16616: झञ्झावात m. (-तः) Wind with rain, a storm, a squall.  E. झञ्झा heavy rain, and वात wind.
16617: झट r. 1st. cl. (झटति) To clot, to be entangled, (as hair:) see जट. E. भ्वा-पर-अक-सेट् ।
16618: झटा f. (-टा) A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta.)  E. झट् to entangled, affix अत्र्.
16619: झटि m. (-टिः) A small tree, a shrub, a bush.  E. जट् to be entangled, इन् Unadi aff.
16620: झटिति ind. Quickly, speedily, instantly.  E. झटि entangling, confusing, affix इन् क्तिन्; also जटिति.
16621: झनत्कार m. (-रः) The clanging of metallic ornaments, &c.  E. झनत् imi-tative sound, &c. कार making.
16622: झम (उ) झमु r. 1st cl. (झमति) To eat: see जमु, &c.  E. भ्वा-प-सक-सेट् ।
16623: झम्प mf. (-म्पः-म्पा) Jumping, springing, plunging.  E. झं imitative sound, and पत् to fall, affix ड.
16624: झम्पाक m. (-कः) A monkey or ape.  E. झम्प, and अक to go. झम्पेन आकायति आ + कै-क । वानरे ।
16625: झम्पारु m. (-रुः) A monkey, an ape.  E. झम्प plunging, and अश् to go, उण् aff.
16626: झम्पाशिन् m. (-शी) A kingfisher.  E. झम्प plunging, and अश् to eat, affix णिनि.
16627: झम्पिन् m. (-म्पी) A monkey, an ape.  E. झम्प springing, इनि aff.
16628: झर m. (-रः) 	 f. (-रा or -रिः-री) A cascade, a water-fall. 	 f. (-री) A river. E. झॄ to waste or decay, affix अप्, fem. affix टाप्, इन् or ङीष्; also निर्झर.
16629: झर्च r. 6th cl. (झर्च्चति) 	 1. To say. 	 2. To blame, to abuse or menace; also झर्छ झर्ज, &c.  E. तुदा० प० सक० सेट् ।
16630: झर्छ r. 6th cl. (झर्छति) 	 1. To say. 	 2. To blame, to abuse or menace; also झर्च.  E. तुदा-प-सक-सेट् ।
16631: झर्ज r. 6th cl. (झर्जति) 	 1. To say, to speak. 	 2. To censure, to blame. E. तुदा-पर-सक-सेट् ।
16632: झर्झ r. 1st and 10th cls. (झर्झति झर्झयति-ते) 	 1. To speak or say. 	 2. To censure or reprove. r. 1st cl. (झर्झति) To kill or hurt.
16633: झर्झर mf. (-रः-री) A sort of drum. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. The Kaliyuga, the pre-sent Yug or age of the world. 	 2. The name of a river. 	 3. A cane-staff. 	 4. A cymbal f. (-रा) A whore. 	 n. (-रं) A sound as of splashing or dropping.  E. झर्झ an imitative sound like that of water splash-ing, &c. and र what makes, from रा with ड affix, or झर्झ to cen-sure, and करच् Unadi aff.
16634: झर्झरक m. (-कः) The Kaliyug.  E. कन् added to the preceding.
16635: झर्झरीक m. (-कः) 	 1. The body. 	 2. A country. 	 3. A picture.  E. झर्झ to injure or destroy, ईकन् affix, and र inserted.
16636: झलञ्झला f. (-ला) The flapping of an elephant's ears, or loose breasts, &c. the word is considered as merely imitative of the noise made.
16637: झलरी f. (-री) 	 1. A sort of drum. 	 2. A curl.  E. झल imitative sound, र from रा to get or make, affixes ड and ङीप्; also झल्लरी and झल्ली.
16638: झला f. (-ला) 	 1. A daughter, a girl. 	 2. Sunshine, splendour, brilliant or glistering light. 	 3. A cricket; also झाला.
16640: झल्ल m. (-ल्लः) A prize fighter, a cudgel player, a man of a tribe follow-ing such a profession; one of the degraded classes, being sprung from the outcaste Kshetriya  E. जल् to surround or embrace, ल added, and ज changed to झ.
16641: झल्लक n. (-कं) Cymbals.  E. झल्ल imitative sound, a clash, and क what emits, from कै to sound, affix ड.
16642: झल्लकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) A pigeon.  E. झल्ल imitative sound, and कण्ठ a throat.
16643: झल्लरी f. (-री) 	 1. A sort of drum. 	 2. A curl, a lock of hair: see झलरी. 	 3. A ball, &c. of perfumed substances used for cleaning the hair. 	 4. Moisture. 	 5. Purity.
16644: झल्लिका f. (-का) 	 1. Light, splendour, lustre. 	 2. A rag or cloth used for applying colour or perfumes. 	 3. Dirt brought off the body by rub-bing it with perfumes.  E. झर्झ ण्वुल् पृषो० ।
16645: झल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A kind of drum: see झलरी.
16646: झल्लोल m. (-लः) A ball or protuberance at the lower end of a spindle.
16647: झष r. 1st. cl. (झषति-ते) 	 1. To kill or hurt. 	 2. To take. 	 3. To put on, to wear.  E. भ्वा-पर-सक-सेट् । ग्रहणे पिधाने च भ्वा-उभ-सक-सेट् ।
16648: झष m. (-षः) 	 1. A fish. 	 2. The sign “Pisces” of the Zodiac. 	 3. Heat, warmth. 	 4. A forest, a thicket. 	 f. (-षा) A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.) 	 n. (-षं) Waste land.  E. झष् to injure, affix कर्मणि घ ।
16649: झषकेतन m. (-नः) A name of KANDARPA.  E. झष a fish, and केतन a ban-ner, who bears a fish on his banner.
16650: झषाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A name of Kandarpa झष, E. a fish and अङ्क a mark or symbol.
16651: झषाशन m. (-नः) The gangetic porpoise.  E. झष fish, and अशन food.
16652: झषोदरी f. (-री) An epithet of Satyabati the mother of the poet VYASA. E. झष a fish, and उदर the belly: born from the belly of a fish.
16653: झांकृत n. (-तं) 	 1. A tinkling ornament worn on the toes or the feet. 	 2. A gurgling or rattling noise.  E. झां a jungling or jingling, and कृत made (by which.)
16654: झाट m. (-टः) 	 1. An arbour, a bower, a place overgrown with creepers. 2. A wood, a thicket. 	 3. Cleaning sores or wounds. 	 f. (-टा-टी) 	 1. Jasmine. 	 2. A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta:) see झाट n. (-टं) A wood, a thicket.  E. झट् to be entangled, affix णिच् अच् । निकुञ्जे कान्तारे व्रणादीनां मार्ज्जने भूम्यामलक्यायां यूथिकायां च ।
16655: झाटाल m. (-लः) A kind of flower: see घण्टापाटलि.  E. झट् to entangle, affix णिच् अलच ।
16658: झामक n. (-कं) A burnt or vitrified brick.  E. झम् to eat, affix कर्मणि ण्वुल् being fed upon by fire. (झामा) ।
16659: झामर m. (-रः) A small whetstone, used chiefly by housewives for sharpening their spindles, needles, &c.  E. झाम eating, wearing away, from झम् to eat, affix भावे घञ्, and र what gets, from रा with ड aff.
16660: झार्झर mf. (-रः-री) A tabor player, a drummer.  E. झर्झर a cymbal, affix अण्; also with ठक् affix झार्झरिक.
16661: झालरी f. (-री) A kind of drum or tabor.  E. झलरी the same, अण् pleo-nastic aff.
16663: झालि f. (-लिः) A sort of sour or unripe mangoes, fried with salt, mus-tard, and asafœtida.
16664: झावु m. (-वुः) A tree, (Tamarix Indica;) also with कन् added झावुक m. (-कः) and with a long final vowel झावू m. (-वूः) The words are con-sidered as irregular or foreign. झा-इति वाति गच्छति वा डु (झाउ) स्वार्थे कन् ।
16665: झिङ्गाक n. (-कं) A sort of cucumber, (Luffa acutangula.) (भिङ्गा).
16666: झिङ्गिनी f. (-नी) 	 1. A torch, a firebrand, The fire falling from heaven. 	 2. A sort of cucumber (Luffa acutangula.) or the tree. लिगि-णिनि पृषो० । जिङ्गिनीवृक्षे, उल्कायाम् च ।
16667: झिङ्गी f. (-ङ्गी) 	 1. A cricket. 	 2. The wick of a lamp. 	 3. light, lustre. 	 4. The Jhingine tree. see झिल्ली.  E. लिगि अच् गौरा० ङीष् ।
16668: झिञ्जिम m. (-मः) A forest on fire.
16669: झिण्टी f. (-ण्टी) A shrub, (Barleria cristata.)  E. झि imitative sound, रट् to utter, affix अच्, deriv. irr.
16670: झिरी f. (-री) A cricket.  E. झि imitative of the cricket's chirp, रा to make, affixes ड and ङीष्: also झिल्ली; भिरिका, and (कन् being add ed); also इ pen. being made long झिरीका, or changed to उ, झिरुका the first vowel also being lengthened झीरिका, and झीरुका, &c. झिरिति अव्यक्तशब्दोऽस्ति अस्या इन् ।
16671: झिरुका f. (-का) A cricket: see the last.
16672: झिल्लि f. (ल्लिः) 	 1. Cymbals. 	 2. A cricket. 	 3. Membrane: see झिल्ली. चिल्लति चिल-अच् पृ-गौरा-ङोष् आतपरुचौ, कीटभेदे वर्त्त्याञ्च ।
16673: झिल्लिका f. (-का) 	 1. A cricket. 	 2. The light of sunshine, strong light, splendour. 	 3. Dirt taken off the body in rubbing it with perfumes. 4. A cloth or rag used for applying colour, unguents, &c. 	 5. A cricket's cry. 	 6. Membrane, thin skin, parchment.  E. झिल्ल for चिल्ल imitative sound, expressing the cricket's chirp, and ङीष् being added झिल्ली, and कन् again added झिल्लिका; also with the penulti-mate long झिल्लीका.
16674: झिल्ली f. (-ल्ली) 	 1. A cricket. 	 2. Sunshine, light, lustre. 	 3. The wick of a lamp. 	 4. A cloth or rag for applying unguents, colour, &c. 	 5. A musical instrument, cymbals. 	 6. Membrane. E. See the preceding.
16675: झिल्लीकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) A pigeon.  E. झिल्ली a cricket, and कण्ठ the throat, chirping as it were in the throat.
16676: झीरिका f. (-का A cricket: see झिरी.
16677: झीरुका f. (-का) A cricket: see झिरी.

A Tantra, a religious treatise teaching peculiar and mystical formulæ and rites for the worship of the deities, or the attainment of superhuman power: it is mostly in the form of a dialogue between SIVA and DURGA, who are the peculiar gods of the Tantrikas: there is a great number of these works, and their authority, in many parts of India, seems to have, in a great measure, superseded that of the Vedas: according to one account, a Tantra comprises five subjects, the creation and destruction of the world, the worship of the gods, the attainment of all objects, magical rites for the acquirement of six (superhuman) faculties, and four modes of union with spirit by meditation; a variety of subjects are, however, introduced many of them, whilst some are limited to a single topic, as the mode of breathing in certain rites, the language of birds, beasts, &c. 	 2. 17230: ताड m. (-डः) 	 1. Beating, whipping, inflicting bodily chastisement. 	 2. Sound, noise. 	 3. A handful of grass, corn, &c. a sheaf. 	 4. A moun-tain. 	 5. A kind of grass, (Andropogon serratus.) 	 f. (-डि or -डी) A kind of palm, (Coripha talliera, Rox.) See ताली.  E. तड् to give pain, to beat, &c. affix भावे अच् कर्मणि अच् वा ।
17231: ताडका f. (-का) A female demon, killed by RAMA.
17233: ताडङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A kind of ear-ring: see तालपत्र.  E. तड् to shine, अङ्कन् affix; also ड being changed to ट, ताटङ्क.
17234: ताडघ mfn. (-घः-घा-घं) Beating with a whip or with strokes of any kind. E. ताड, and घ who strikes.
17235: ताडघात m. (-तः) An artificer who beats or hammers any thing.  E. ताड, and घात a blow.
17236: ताडन n. (-नं) Beating, whipping, &c. 	 f. (-नी) A whip.  E. तड् to beat, भावे ल्युट् affix, fem. affix ङीष् ।
17237: ताडनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be beaten, punishable.  E. तड् to beat, अनी-यर् affix; also ताड्य and ताडयितव्य.
17238: ताडपत्र n. (-त्रं) An ornament of the ear.  E. ताड the Tal tree, and पत्र a leaf, an earring resembling this: see तालपत्र.
17239: ताडयितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Who or what beats or strikes.  E. तड् to beat, तृच् aff.
17240: ताडयित्वा ind. Having beaten.  E. तड् to beat, क्त्वा aff.
17241: ताडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Struck, beaten.  E. तड् to beat, क्त aff.
17242: ताडुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Beating, who or what beats or strikes.  E. तड् to give pain, उल Unadi aff.
17243: ताड्य mfn. (-ड्यः-ड्या-ड्यं) To be beaten or chastised, what may or ought to be punished, punishable.  E. तड् to beat, ण्यत् aff.
17244: ताड्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being beaten or struck. 	 m. (-नः) A musical instrument, which is struck, as a drum, &c.  E. तड् to beat or strike, शानच् affix, यक् inserted.
17245: ताण्डव mn. (-वः-वं) 	 1. Dancing, especially with violent gesticulation, and particularly applied to the frantic dance of the god SIVA, and his votaries. 	 2. A sort of grass, (Saccharum procerum.) 	 m. (-वः) In prosody, a tribrach or foot of three sort syllables.  E. तण्डु the name of the Muni, by whom the style of dancing was first taught, affix अण्, or तडि to beat, and अव aff.
17246: ताण्डवतालिक m. (-कः) A name of NANDI, one of SIVA'S principal attendants.  E. ताण्डव SIVA'S dancing. and तालिक accompanied with music, from ताल tune or time, and ठञ् aff.
17247: ताण्डवप्रिय m. (-यः) A name of SIVA.  E. ताण्डव dancing, and प्रिय fond of.
17248: ताण्डि f. (-ण्डिः) The science of dancing.  E. तण्डु the teacher of this art, and इञ् off.
17249: तात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Venerable, reverend, respectable. 	 m. (-तः) 	 1. A father. 	 2. A term of affection addressed to any person, but especi-ally to a junior or inferior, as हे तात oh! child, &c.  E. तन् to extend, (his race or fame,) क्त affix, and the vowel made long.
17250: तातगु mfn. (-गुः-गुः-गु) Paternal, relating or belonging to the father. 	 m. (-गुः) A paternal uncle.  E. तात a father, गु who goes or is, from गम् to go, with डु aff.
17251: तातजनयित्री f. du. always (-त्र्यौ) Father and mother, parents.  E. तात father, and जनयितृ mother.
17252: ताततुल्य m. (-ल्यः) A paternal uncle, or the most respectable of the male relations.  E. तात a father, and तुल्य like, equal to.
17253: तातन m. (-नः) A wagtail. तातं प्रशस्तं नृत्यति नृत-ड । खञ्चनखगे ।
17254: तातल m. (-लः) 	 1. A fatherly relative, one who may be considered as a father. 	 2. Sickness, disease. 	 3. An iron club or spike. 	 4. Cooking or maturing. 	 5. Heat, physical or morbid.  E. तापं लाति ला-क पृषो० ।
17255: ताति m. (-तिः) A son.  E. ताय to spread, (the race,) क्तिच् aff.
17256: तात्कालिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to any particular moment of time. E. तत्काल and ठङ् aff. ञिठ वा ।
17257: तात्पर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 	 1. Object, purpose, intent, design. 	 2. Meaning, purport. 3. Explanation.  E. तत्पर intent, ष्यञ् aff. तत्परस्य भावः ।
17258: तात्पर्य्यार्थ m. (-र्थः) The meaning or purpose of a sentence.  E. तात्पर्य्य pur-pose, and अर्थ meaning.
17259: तादर्थ्य n. (-र्थ्यं) 	 1. Sameness or precision of meaning. 	 2. Identity of ob-ject.  E. तदर्थ, ष्यञ् aff.
17260: तादात्म्य n. (-त्म्यं) Identity, unity, sameness.  E. तदात्म same, and ष्यञ् aff.
17261: तादृश् mfn. (-दृक्) Such like, like him or it, &c.  E. तद् that, दृश् to see, affix क्विप्; also with ट affix तादृश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) or with क्स affix, तादृक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं.)
17262: तान m. (-नः) A tune. 	 n. (-नं) 	 1. Expanse, extension. 	 2. An object of sense.  E. तन् to extend, affix घञ्.
17263: तानव n. (-वं) Thinness, spareness.  E. तनु, and अण् aff.
17264: तानूर m. (-रः) A whirlpool.  E. तन् to spread, ऊरण् aff.
17265: तान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 	 1. Wearied, fatigued, distressed. 	 2. Languid, lan-guishing. 	 3. Faded, withered, blighted.  E. तम् to be distressed, affix क्त.
17266: तान्तव n. (-वं) Spinning, weaving.  E. तन्तु a thread, अञ् aff.
17267: तान्त्र mfn. (-न्त्रः-न्त्री-न्त्रं) 	 1. Stringed, having wires or strings, (as a musical instrument.) 	 2. Relating to the Tantras, &c.  E. तन्त्र, and अण् aff.
17268: तान्त्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Relating to the Tantras, taught by them, following them, &c. 	 2. Relating to a thread, &c. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. A scholar, a man completely versed in any science. 	 2. A follower of the doctrine taught by the Tantras.  E. तन्त्र truth, &c. and ठक् aff. तन्त्रं सिद्धान्तं वेत्ति शास्त्रमधीते वा ।
17270: ताप m. (-पः) 	 1. Heat, burning, (moral or physical.) 	 2. Pain, sorrow, distress.  E. तप् to burn or inflame, affix घञ्. 	 f. (-पी) A name of the Tapti or Surat river. 	 2. A name of the Yamuna or Jamna river.  E. तप the sun, affix of descent अच्, ङीष् ।
17271: तापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Burning, inflaming, heating. 	 m. (-कः) Fever, morbid heat.  E. तप् to burn, ण्वुल् aff.
17272: तापत्य m. (-त्यः) ARJUNA.  E. तपती, and ण्य affix of descent.
17273: तापन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) What heats or inflames. 	 m. (-नः) 	 1. The sun. 2. Of KAMA'S arrows, the inflamer. 	 3. Sun-shine. 	 4. Heating, in-flaming.  E. तप् to heat, in the causal form, and णिच् and भावे ल्युट् affs. or तापि-कर्त्तरि ल्यु । सूर्य्ये ।
17274: तापनीय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Golden, made of gold.  E. तपनीय, and अण् aff. उपनिषद्भेदे च । यथा गोपालतापनीयः, नृसिंहतापनीयः ।
17275: तापस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Performing penance, a practiser of devout aus-terities, a devotee, an ascetic. 	 m. (-सः) A kind of crane, (Ardea nivea.) 	 n. (-सं) The leaf of the Laurus cassia.  E. तपस् penance, affix अण् । तपश्चरणं शीलमस्य छत्रादि० ण or तपोऽस्त्यस्य अण् ।
17276: तापसक m. (-कः) A contemptible devotee, one not long engaged in austerities.  E. तापस, and कन् depreciative aff.
17277: तापसतरु m. (-रुः) A tree, commonly Ingua or Jiyaputa, (Nagelia pu-tranjiva.)  E. तापस an ascetic, and तरु a tree; also similar com-pounds, as तापसद्रुम, तापसवृक्ष, &c.
17278: तापसप्रिय m. (-यः) A tree, (Chiranjia sapida:) see पियाल. 	 f. (-या) A grape.  E. तापस an ascetic, प्रिय beloved by. तापसानां प्रियः छाया-प्रदत्वात् ।
17279: तापहर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 	 1. Cooling, removing heat. 	 2. Consoling, alle-viating distress. 	 f. (-री) A dish, a sort of soup, of pulse and grain, first fried with ghee and turmeric, and afterwards boiled with salt and sugar.  E. ताप, and हर what removes. तापं हरति हृ-ट ।
17280: तापिच्छ m. (-च्छः) A tree bearing dark blossoms, the Tamala: see the next, तापिनं छादयति छद-ड पृषो० । तमालवृक्षे ।
17281: तापिञ्छ m. (ञ्छः) The Tamala tree, (Xanthocymus pictorius.)  E. तापिन् a person heated, and छद what covers or shelters, ड affix, deriv. irr. also the final being dropped तापिच्छ, and with जि to conquer or remove तापिञ्ज ।
17282: तापिञ्ज m. (-ञ्जः) The Tamala tree. 	 n. (-ञ्जं) Sulphate of iron: see the preceding.
17283: तापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Inflamed. 	 2. Distressed, pained.  E. तप् to inflame, affix क्त.
17284: तापिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) Oppressed by heat, morbid, moral or physical; any thing heated or growing. 	 m. (-पी) One of the defied saints of the BAUDDHA.  E. तप् to heat, affix णिनि.
17285: ताप्य mn. (-प्यः-प्यं) A mineral substance, sulphate of iron.  E. तापी the river, and यत् affix; said to be procured from the Tapi river; also with कन् added ताप्यकम् ।
17286: ताम m. (-मः) An object of terror. 	 2. Fault, defect, vice. 	 3. Anxiety, distress. 	 4. Desire.  E. तम् to be distressed, affix करणे भावे वा घञ् ।
17287: तामर n. (-रं) 	 1. Water. 	 2. Ghee or oiled butter.  E. ताम desire, and र from रा to get or have; desirable for drinking, &c. तामं ग्लानिं रवते हिनस्ति रुङ् बधे वा ड ।
17288: तामरस n. (-सं) 	 1. A lotus, (Nymphæa nelumbo.) 	 2. Copper. 	 3. Gold. 4. A species of the Jagati metre.  E. तामर water, सम् to abide, and ड affix; or ताम desire, and रस here implying object. तामरे जले सलि सस-ड ।
17289: तामलकी f. (-की) A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta:) see मूम्यामलकी. E. तम् to desire, to be as it were, or resemble, आमलकी the Amalaki, तम णिच् क्विप् तान् कर्मधा० ।
17290: तामलिप्त nf. (-प्तं-प्ती) A district in the south of Bengal, commonly Tam-look.  E. ताम distress, trouble, and लिप्त smeared, affected.
17291: तामस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) 	 1. Affected by or appertaining to the third qua-lity, that of darkness or vice: belonging to it as a Purana, a sys-tem of philosophy, a ceremonial rite, &c. 	 2. Dark, of or belong-ing to darkness. 	 m. (-सः) 	 1. A snake. 	 2. An incendiary, a malignant and mischievous man, a villain. 	 3. An owl. 	 4. The fourth Menu. 	 f. (-सी) A dark night. 	 2. A name of the goddess DURGA. 	 n. (-सं) The quality of darkness.  E. तमस् the quality of drakness, &c. affix अण् । तमः अस्ति अस्य ।
17292: तामसिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Of belonging to the quality of darkness, derived from it, teaching lessons so characterised, &c. 	 2. Of or be-longing to physical drakness.  E. तमस्, and ठञ् aff. तमसा निर्वृत्तम् ।
17293: तामिस्र n. (-स्रं) 	 1. Great darkness. 	 2. A hell, that of deep gloom. 	 m. (-स्रः) Indignation at being disappointed or slighted.  E. तमिस्र, and अण् added. तमिस्रा तमस्ततिः अस्ति अत्र ।
17294: ताम्बूल nf. (-ल-ली) 	 1. Areca, (Areca faufel or catechu.) 	 2. Betel, (Piber betel,) or its pungent leaf, which together with the areca nut and catechu, and sometimes caustic lime and spices, is eaten very generally by the natives of the east. 	 n. (-लं) The areca nut. 	 m. (-लः) San, a plant, (Crotolaria juncea.)  E. तम् to desire, affix ऊलच् and वुक् augment, the radical vowel made long.
17295: ताम्बूलकरङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) The Pan-dan or betel-box.  E. ताम्बूल as above, and करङ्क a hollowed cocoanut, &c. which the Pan-box usually resem-bles. (पानेर डिपा) ।
17296: ताम्बूलद m. (-दः) The betel-bearer; kings and great men being attended by an officer of this description.  E. ताम्बूल betel, and द who gives. ताम्बूलं ददाति दा-क ।
17297: ताम्बूलपेटिका f. (-का) A betel-box.  E. ताम्बूल, and पेटिका a casket.
17298: ताम्बूलराग m. (-गः) A kind of pulse, (Ervum lens.)  E. ताम्बूल betel, and राग colour. ताम्बूलकृतो रागः ।
17299: ताम्बूलवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A small plant bearing a pungent leaf, which with the areca nut, a small quantity of caustic lime (or Chunam) and catechu, and occasionally cloves, cardamoms, &c. form the Pan or betel of the Asiatic, (Piper betel.)  E. ताम्बूल the same, and वल्ली root-stalk; also with कन् added ताम्बूलवल्लिका.
17300: ताम्बूलवाहक m. (-कः) A betel-bearer, a servant attached to men of rank to prepare the Pan, and carry the betel-box.  E. ताम्बूल, and वाहक who carries; also ताम्बूलवाहिन् m. (-ही.)
17301: ताम्बूलिक mf. (-कः-की) A seller of betel.  E. ताम्बूल, and ठक् aff. ताम्बूलं तद्रचनं शिल्पमस्य ।
17302: ताम्बूलिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Relating or belonging to a Pan having one, giving one, &c. 	 m. (-ली) The Pan-bearer, a servant who prepares and furnishes the Pan.  E. ताम्बूल as above, इनि aff. ताम्बूलं पण्यतया अस्ति अस्य ।
17303: ताम्यत् mfn. (-म्यन्-म्यती-म्यत्) Distressing, afflicting, annoying.  E. तम् to distress, शतृ aff.
17304: ताम्र mfn. (-म्रः-म्री-म्रं) Of a coppery red colour. 	 n. (-म्रं) 	 1. Copper. 	 2. A kind of sandal, represented as of a dark red colour, and smelling like a lotus. 	 3. A dark or coppery red. 	 m. (-म्रः) A leprosy with large red spots. 	 f. (-म्री) A copper or metallic cup of prescribed capacity, and perforated by a small hole at the bottom, answering the purpose of an hour glass: it is put into a vessel of water; the water gradually filling it, and the cup sinking, marks the time that has elapsed.  E. तम् to desire, Unadi affix रक्, and the vowel made long; or ताम्र copper, अण् and ङीष् affixes, implying analogy or derivation.
17305: ताम्रक n. (-कं) Copper.  E. ताम्र as above, and कन् pleonastic aff.
17306: ताम्रकर्णी f. (-र्णी) A name of the female elephant of the west.  E. ताम्र coppery, and कर्ण ear.
17307: ताम्रकार m. (-रः) A brazier, a copper-smith.  E. ताम्र copper, and कार worker. ताम्रं ताम्रपात्रादिकं करोति कृ-अण् उप० स० ।
17308: ताम्रकिलि m. (-लिः) A small worm of a red colour.  E. ताम्र red, and किलि a worm.
17309: ताम्रकुट्ट m. (-ट्टः) A brazier or copper-smith.  E. ताम्रं कुट्टयति कुट्ट-अण् उप० स० ।
17310: ताम्रकुट्टक m. (-कः) A brazier.  E. ताम्र, and कुट्ट a point: the word is imitative of the foreign original, ण्वुल्प्रत्ययः ।
17311: ताम्रकृमि m. (-मिः) A kind of red insect.  E. ताम्र red, and कृमि a worm. इन्द्रगोपकीटे ।
17312: ताम्रगर्भ n. (-र्भ) Blue vitriol or sulphate of copper.  E. ताम्र copper, and गर्भ womb or source.
17313: ताम्रचूड m. (-डः) A cock.  E. ताम्र, and चूडा a crest. ताम्रा रक्ता चूडा यस्य ।
17314: ताम्रतनु mfn. (-नुः-नुः-नु) Having a ruddy or fair complexion, copper-co-loured.  E. ताम्र, and तनु body.
17315: ताम्रपट्ट n. (-ट्टं) A copper-plate, such as Hindu grants of land, &c. are frequently inscribed on.  E. ताम्र copper, and पट्ट a cloth.
17316: ताम्रपर्णी f. (-र्णी) 	 1. A large point or lake. 	 2. The name of a river in the peninsula, and of the district in its vicinity.
17317: ताम्रपत्र n. (-त्रं) A plate of copper. 	 m. (-त्रः) A potherb: see जीव.  E. ताम्र, and पत्र a leaf.
17318: ताम्रपाकिन् m. (-की) A tree: see गर्द्दभाण्ड.  E. ताम्र red, and पाकिन् ripen-ing, the fruit being of this colour.
17319: ताम्रपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) 	 1. A kind of ebony, (Bauhinia variegata.) 	 2. A plant, (Kæmpfera rotunda.) 	 f. (-ष्पा) Trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) 	 f. (-ष्पी) 	 1. Lythrum or uticosum: see धातृ-पुष्पिका. 	 2. Trumpet flower. 	 3. Red Teori: see त्रिकृत्.  E. ताम्र coppery red, and पुष्प a flower, bearing red blossoms. ताम्रं पुष्पं यस्य ।
17320: ताम्रफल m. (-लः) A tree, (Alangium hexapetalum.)  E. ताम्र copper, and फल fruit. ताम्रं रक्तं फलमस्य ।
17321: ताम्रफलक n. (-कं) A copper-plate.  E. ताम्र, and फलक a plank or board.
17322: ताम्रमुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Copper-coloured, fair-complexioned. 	 m. (-खः) A European.  E. ताम्र, and मुख face.
17323: ताम्रमूला f. (-ला) A plant: see ग्राहिणी.  E. ताम्र copper, and मूल root. ताम्रं रक्तं मूलं यस्याः टाप् ।
17324: ताम्रमृग m. (-गः) The red deer.  E. ताम्र, and मृग deer.
17325: ताम्रवर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं) Red, copper-coloured. 	 f. (-र्णी) The blossom of sesamum.  E. ताम्र, and वर्ण colour.

17327: ताम्रवीज m. (-जः) A kind of vetch: see कुलत्थ.  E. ताम्र copper, and वीज the seed. ताम्रं वीजं यस्य ।

17332: ताम्राकु m. (-कुः) One of the eighteen minor divisions of the known continent.
17333: ताम्राक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) Red-eyed. 	 m. (-क्षः) The Koil or Kokila, the Indian cuckoo.  E. ताम्र, and अक्षि an eye. ताम्रे अक्षिणी यस्य ।
17334: ताम्राभ n. (-भं) Red sandal wood.  E. ताम्र copper, and resembling. ताम्रस्य आभा इव आभा यस्य । रक्तचन्दने ।

17338: तायिक m. (-कः) A country; or plu. 	 m. (-काः) 1ts inhabitants.  E. ताय् to cherish, ठञ् aff. ताये वृद्धौ साधु ठञ् ।

17340: तारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. A protector, a preserver. 	 2. One who causes or enables to pass or go over. 	 n. (-कं) 	 1. The eye. 	 2. 17341: तारकजित् m. (-जित्) A name of KARTIKEYA.  E. तारक a demon, and जित् conqueror: also similar names, as तारकारि, तारकहन्, तारकरिपु, &c. तारकं दैत्यं जयति जि-क्विप् ।
17342: तारकारि m. (-रिः) The deity KARTIKEYA.  E. तारक and अरि a foe: see the preceding.
17343: तारकित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Starry.  E. तारक a star, इतच् aff.

17345: तारण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Who or what causes or enables to cross. 	 m. (-णः) A raft, a float. 	 n. (-णं) Carrying or conveying across.  E. तॄ to cross, affix ल्युट् तारयति अनेन ।
17346: तारणि f. (-णिः) A boat.  E. तॄ to pass over, णि or अणि aff.
17347: तारतम्य n. (-म्यं) 	 1. More or less, the state or condition. 	 2. Dependance of larger numbers on smaller in a progressive series.  E. तर, and तम affixes of the comparative and superlative degrees, and ष्यञ् aff तरतमयोर्भावः ।
17348: तारनाद m. (-दः) A loud sound or noise.  E. तार, and नाद sound.
17349: तारल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Libidinous, dissipated, a lecher.  E. तरल un-steady, affix अण् । तरल एव ।
17350: तारविमला f. (-ला) A sort of mineral said to be of the colour of silver. F. तार a star, and विमल pure, clean.
17351: तारशुद्धिकर n. (-रं) Lead.  E. तार silver, and शुद्धिकर what refines.
17352: ताराधिपति m. (-तिः) The moon.  E. तारा a star, and अधिपति a ruler.
17353: तारापथ m. (-थः) The atmosphere, the firmament, heaven or sky. E. तारा a star, and पथ for पथिन् a path. ताराणां पन्थाः ।
17354: तारापीड m. (-डः) The moon.  E. तार a star, and आपीड a chaplet. ताराणां आपीडः भूषणमिव । चन्द्रे ।
17355: ताराभूषा f. (-षा) Night.  E. तारा, and भूषा ornament. तारा भूषा यस्याः । रात्रौ ।
17356: ताराभ्र m. (-भ्रः) Camphor.  E. तारा, and अभ्र talc.
17357: तारामण्डल m. (-लः) 	 1. A large splendid temple. 	 2. The region of the stars.  E. तारा a star, and मण्डल a region; shining with gold and jewels as with stars.
17358: तारारि m. (-रिः) A pyritic ore of iron: see विट्माक्षिक.  E. तारा the pupil of the eye, and अरि hostile.
17359: तारिक n. (-कं) Fare, freight, toll. 	 f. (-का) 	 1. A star; also तारका. 	 2. The juice of the palmyra tree, especially when become a spirit by spontaneous fermentation.  E. तर fare, ठक् affix, of तारक fem. form or ताली and कन् added, ल changed to र.

17361: तारीष m. (-षः) 	 1. Swarga or paradise. 	 2. The ocean. 	 3. Gold. 	 f. (-षी) The daughter of INDRA.  E. तॄ to cross, ईषन् affix, fem. affix ङीष्ः see तरीष and तरिष.
17362: तारुण्य n. (-ण्यं) Youth.  E. तरुण young, ष्यञ् aff. तरुणस्य भावः ।
17363: तारेय m. (-यः) The son of BALI, the monkey.  E. तारा the wife of BALI, and ढक् aff. तारायाः अपत्यम् ।
17364: तार्कव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Spun, made with or belonging to a spindle. E. तर्कु, and अण् aff. तर्कोर्विकारः ।
17365: तार्किक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating or attached to the science of reason-ing or logic. 	 m. (-कः) A philosopher, a sophist, a follower of either of the six schools of Hindu philosophy.  E. तर्क doubt, disputation, affix ठञ्.
17366: तार्क्ष m. (-र्क्षः) A name of KASYAPA.  E. तृक्ष एव स्वार्थे अण् ।
17367: तार्क्ष्य m. (-र्क्ष्यः) 	 1. A horse. 	 2. A name of GARUDA, the bird and vehicle of VISHNU. 	 2. A name of ARUNA, or the dawn personified, consi-dered as the elder brother of GARUDA. 	 4. A car, a chariot. 	 5. A snake. 	 6. Gold. 	 7. A tree, the Sal, (Shorea robusta.) 	 n. (-र्क्ष्यं) A sort of collyrium. 	 f. (-र्क्ष्यी) A wild creeper.  E. तृक्ष् to go, घञ् affix तार्क्ष and यञ् added; again, तृक्ष or तार्क्ष considered as a name of KASYAPA the father of ARUNA, &c. ष्यञ् or अण् aff.
17368: तार्क्ष्यध्वज m. (-जः) A name of VISHNU.  E. तार्क्ष्य GARUDA, and ध्वज emblem or symbol. तार्क्ष्यः ध्वजः अस्य ।
17369: तार्क्ष्यनायक m. (-कः) GARUDA.  E. तार्क्ष्य, and नायक leader.
17370: तार्क्ष्यशैल n. (-लं) A substance prepared from the calx of brass, or from the Amomum Anthorrhiza, and used as a medical application to the eyes: see रसाञ्जन.  E. तार्क्ष्य a collyrium, and शैल derived from शिला a rock or stone. तार्क्ष्य शैले भवम् अण् ।
17371: तार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be crossed or carried across, to be ferried over. 	 n. (-र्य्यं) Toll, fare, freight.  E. तॄ to cross. कर्मणि ण्यत् aff.

17373: तालक n. (-कं) 	 1. A bolt, a latch, a kind of lock for fastening a door with. 	 3. Yellow orpiment. 	 3. A fragrant earth.  E. कन् added to the preceding.
17374: तालकाभ adj. 	 mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Green. 	 m. (-भः) Green, the colour. E. तालक yellow orpiment, and आभ what resembles.
17375: तालकी f. (-की) Toddy, or the fermented exudation of the palm trees. E. ताल to palmyra, कन् aff. or तालकस्य इयम् अण्-ङीष् ।
17376: तालजटा f. (-टा) The fibres of the palm tree under the outer bark. E. ताल, and जटा matted hair.
17377: तालध्वज m. (-जः) A name of BALARAMA. 	 f. (-जा) The name of a city. E. ताल the palm, and ध्वज a banner. तालः ध्वजः अस्य ।

17379: तालपर्ण nf. (-र्णं-र्णीं) 	 1. A kind of vegetable perfume: see मुरा. 	 f. (-र्णी) A sort of anise, (Anethum pammorium, Rox.)  E. ताल the palm, and पर्ण a leaf, palm-leaved. ताल इव खङ्गमुष्टिरिव पर्णमस्य ।
17380: तालपुष्पक n. (-कं) A medicinal application to the eyes.  E. ताल the pal-myra, पुष्प a flower, and कप् affix; perhaps prepared from the blos-soms of the palmyra. तालः खङ्गमुष्टिरिव पुष्पमस्य ।
17381: तालप्रलम्ब n. (-म्बं) The fibres that grow on the cocoanut and other palms under the outer rind and from which Coir a sort of cordage, prepared.  E. ताल, and प्रलम्ब what depends. ताले वृक्षे प्रलम्बते प्र + लम्ब-अच् । तालवृक्षस्य जटायाम् ।
17382: तालभृत् m. (-भृत्) A name of BALARAMA.  E. ताल the palm, and भृत् who retains, (as his banner or symbol:) see तालध्वज, &c. तालं ध्वजरूपेण बिभर्त्ति भृ-क्विप् । वलदेवे ।

17386: ताललक्ष्मन् m. (-क्ष्मा) A name of BALARAMA.  E. ताल, and लक्ष्मन् a mark or sign: see तालध्वज.
17387: तालवृन्त m. (-न्तः) A fan.  E. ताल the palm of the hand, and वृन्त a root-stalk, expanding from the hand like a leaf from its stem; also with कन् added तालवृन्तक, ताले करताले वृन्तं बन्धनमस्य ।
17388: तालवृन्तक n. (-कं) A fan, a Pankha: see the preceding.
17389: तालवेचनक m. (-कः) A dancer, an actor.  E. ताल musical tone, विच् to ob-served, ल्यु affix, तालवेचन and कन् pleonasm added; also read तालरेचनक.

17391: तालाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 	 1. A name of BALARAMA. 	 2. A saw. 	 3. A book. 	 4. A name of SIVA. 	 5. A man marked with every fortunate spot or sign &c. 	 6. A sort of vegetable.  E. ताल the tree, and अङ्क mark or em-blem. तालः तालचिह्नितः अङ्कः ध्वजोऽस्य । वलरामे ।

17395: तालित n. (-तं) 	 1. Any musical instrument. 	 2. Dyed or coloured cloth. 3. A string, a tie.  E. ताल musical time, &c. इतच् aff. or तड-क्त डस्य ल ।
17396: तालिश m. (-शः) A mountain.  E. ताल् to be fixed, ईश Unadi affix, the radical vowel made long.
17397: तालीश n. (-शं) A tree, commonly Talis or its leaf.  E. ताल the corypha, ईश what resembles. तालीव रीगान् शवति शो-ड ।
17398: तालीशपत्र n. (-त्रं) 	 1. A plant, (Flacourtia Cataphracta.) 	 2. A tree, Talisa or its leaf, which is used in medicine.  E. तालीश as above, and पत्र a leaf.
17399: तालु n. (-लु) The palate.  E. तॄ to pass, to go, Unadi affix ञुण् । by which words, &c. proceed.
17400: तालुका f. (-का) The palate.  E. तालु, and कन् added.
17401: तालुजिह्व m. (-ह्वः) 	 1. The uvula. 	 2. A crocodile.  E. तालु the palate, and जिह्वा the tongue.

17403: तालूर m. (-रः) A whirlpool, an eddy.  E. तल् to be deep, ऊरन् affix; also read तालुर.
17404: तावक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Thine.  E. तवक, and अण् added युष्मद् + अण्-एकवचने तवकादेशः ।
17405: तावकीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Thine.  E. तवक for तव thine, and खञ् aff. तव इदं युध्मद् + खञ् एकवचने तवकादेशः ।
17406: तावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 	 1. So many, as many, as much. 	 2. All. ind. So much, so far, so many, unto, until, the correlative to यावत्. E. तत् that, then, and डावत् affix: see यावत्.
17407: तावतिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Of so much, worth so much, &c. see the next. E. तावता क्रीतः संख्यात्वात् कन् वतोरिड् वा पा० वा इट् ।
