17607: तुण्डिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Having a prominent or elevated navel. 	 2. Speaking harshly or severely.  E. तुण्डि the navel, and ल affix; also तुन्दिल, &c.
17608: तुत्थ r. 10th cl. (तुत्थयति-ते) 	 1. To screen, to veil, to cover. 	 2. To spread.  E. चुरा० उभ० सक० सेट् ।
17609: तुत्थ m. (-त्थः) Fire. 	 f. (-त्था) 	 1. Indigo. 	 2. Small cardamoms. 	 n. (-त्थं) 	 1. A collyrium extracted from the Amomum zanthorrhiza. 	 2. Blue vitriol, sulphate of copper, especially medicinally considered as an Anjan, or application to the eyes.  E. तुद् to pain, थक् Unadi aff.
17610: तुत्थक n. (-कं) Blue vitriol.  E. कन् added to तुत्थ.
17611: तुत्थाञ्जन n. (-नं) Blue vitriol, considered as a medicinal application to the eyes.  E. तुत्थ the same, and अञ्चन a collyrium.
17612: तुद (औ) r. 6th cl. (तुदति-ते) To pain, to wound, to vex or harass, to tease, to torture or torment, (इ) तुदि r. 1st cl. (तुन्दति) To search, to seek.  E. तुदा० उभ० सक० अनिट् ।
17613: तुन्द n. (-न्दं) The belly. 	 f. (-न्दी) The navel: see तुण्डि.  E. तुद् to torment, क affix, and नुम् augment.
17614: तुन्दकूपी f. (-पी) The navel.  E. तुन्द the belly, and कूप a pit, a well, dim. affix ङीष्; also with कन् added तुन्दकूपिका f. (-का).
17615: तुन्दपरिमार्ज m. (-र्जः) A lazy man, a sloth, a sluggard: see the next.
17616: तुन्दपरिमृज m. (-जः) A lazy man, a sluggard.  E. तुन्द the belly, मृज to rub, with परि prefixed, and क affix; also with the affix घञ्, तुन्द-परिमार्ज as above; passing his whole time in stroking his sides.
17617: तुन्दवत् mfn. (-वान् वती-वत्) Corpulent, fat.  E. तुन्द, and मतुप् aff. also from तुन्दि, तुन्दिवत् ।
17618: तुन्दि n. (-न्दि) The belly. 	 f. (-न्दिः) The navel. 	 m. (-न्दिः) One of the Gandharbas or quiristers of Swarga.  E. तुद् to vex or harass, affix इन्, and नुम् inserted.
17619: तुन्दिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Having a large or prominent navel, fat, corpu-lent. 	 f. (-का) The navel.  E. तुन्दी the naval. कन् affix, or तुन्द with ठन् aff.
17621: तुन्दित mfn. (तः-ता-तं) Having a large or prominent naval.  E. तुन्द with इतच् affix; also तुन्दिक, तुन्दिल, &c.
17622: तुन्दिन् mfn. (-न्दी-न्दिनी-न्दि) Having a large or prominent navel.  E. तुन्द with इनि affix; also तुन्दिक, &c.
17625: तुन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 	 1. Tormented, vexed, injured. 	 2. Cut, broken, cut down, &c. 	 m. (-न्नः) Toon or Tuna, a tree of which the wood bears some resemblance to mahogany, and is used for furniture, &c. (Cedrela tunna.)  E. तुद् to vex, affix क्त ।
17626: तुन्नवाय m. (-यः) A taylor.  E. तुन्न cut, (cloth, &c.) and वे to sew, affix अण्.
17627: तुन्नसेवनी f. (-नी) A suture of the skull.  E. तुन्न cut, and सेवनी a suture. तुन्नं छिन्नं सीव्यते अनया सिव-करणे ल्युट् ङीष् ।
17628: तुप r. 1st, 6th and 10th cls. (तोपति तुपति, तोपयति) (इ) तुपि r. 1st and 10th cls. (तुम्पति, तुम्पयति-ते) To injure, to hurt or kill; also तुफ, तुम्ब, तुम्प, &c.  E. भ्वा० पर० सक० सेट् । तुदा० बधे० सक० क्लेशे-मुचादि-पर-सेट् । अदने चुरा० उभ-सक-सेट् इदित् ।
17629: तुफ r. 1st, 6th and 10th cls. (तोफति, तुम्फति, तोफयति-ते) To hurt or kill. E. भ्वा-सक-सेट् । बधे सक-क्लेशे अक-तुदा-मुचा-पर-सेट् ।
17630: तुब(इ)तुबि r. 1st and 10th cls. (तुम्बति तुम्बयति-ते) To kill or hurt. r. 10th cl. (तुम्बयति-ते) To disappear.  E. भ्वा-पर-सेट् इदित् । पक्षे चुरा-उभ-सक ।
17631: तुभ r. 1st cl. (तोभते) 4th cl. (तुभ्यति) 9th cl. (तुभ्नाति) To kill, to hurt, to injure in any manner.  E. भ्वा-आत्म-लुङि उभ-सक-सेट् । दिवा-क्य्रा च पर-सक सेट् ।
17632: तुमुर mn. (-रः-रं) Mingled combat: see तुमुल.
17633: तुमुल mn. (-लः-लं) 	 1. Mingled or tumultuous combat. 	 2. Uproar, clangour, tumult, tumultuous sound or noise. 	 m. (-लः) Beleric myrobalan.  E. तु a Sautra root, to kill, to injure, &c. मुलक् affix; or with the vowel long तुमूल. 	 mn. (-लः-लं) and ल being changed to र, तुमुर as above.
17634: तुम्प r. 1st and 6th cls. (तुफति, तुम्पति) 	 1. To hurt or kill. 	 2. To be distressed.  E. भ्वा-सक-पर-सेट् । बधे सक-क्लेशे अक-तुदा-पर-सेट् ।
17635: तुम्फ r. 1st. cl. (तुफति, तुम्फति) To hurt or kill.  E. भ्वा-पर-सक-सेट् । बधे सक-क्लेशे अक-तुदा-पर-सेट् ।
17636: तुम्ब mf. (-म्बः-म्बा or -म्बी) A long gourd, &c. See तुम्बि. 	 f. (-म्बा) a cow disposed to be milked.  E. तुबि to destroy, (bile, &c.) affix अच्.
17637: तुम्बक m. (-कः) A long gourd. 	 n. (-कं) The gourd. कन् added to the preceding: see तुम्बि.
17638: तुम्बि f. (-म्बिः or -तुम्बी) A long gourd, (Cucurbita lagenaris.)  E. तुबि to destroy, (bile, sickness, &c.) अच् affix; fem. affix इन् or ङीष् also with कन् added तुम्बिका.
17639: तुम्बीपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) The flower of the Cucurbita lagenaris.  E. तुम्बी, and पुष्प a flower.
17640: तुम्बुरी f. (-री) 	 1. Coriander. 	 2. A bitch: see तुम्बुरु.  E. शम्यां धन्याके च ।
17641: तुम्बुरु m. (-रुः) 	 1. One of the Gandharbas or singers of heaven. 	 2. A celestial inhabitant and attendant upon the sanctified Jaina teach-ers. 	 n. (-रु) Coriander.  E. तुबि to hurt, &c. उरन् affix; also with the pen. long तुम्बूरु.
17642: तुर r. 3rd cl. (तुतोर्त्ति) To go quick, to hurry, to make haste; this root is restricted to the Vedas: see त्वर जुहो० पर० अक० सेट् ।
17643: तुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Quick, swift.  E. तुर् to make haste, क aff.
17644: तुरग m. (-गः) 	 1. A horse. 	 2. The mind.  E. त्वर speed, velocity, and ग what goes, व changed to उ. 	 f. (-गी) 	 1. A plant, (Physalis flexuosa:) see अश्वगन्ध. 	 2. A mare.  E. ङीष् added to तुरग तुरेण वेगेन गच्छति गम-ड ।
17645: तुरगगन्धा f. (-न्धा) A plant: see the preceding.  E. तुरग a horse, and गन्ध smell, smelling like a horse; also अश्वगन्ध, &c.
17646: तुरगब्रह्मचर्य्यक n. (-कं) Necessary celibacy, leading a life of continence, in consequence merely of being without female society.  E. तुरग a horse, and ब्रह्मचर्य्यक the practice of a religious student, one of whose duties is continence.
17647: तुरगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि) Equestrian, riding, mounted or carried in a horse. 	 m. (-गी) A horse-man, cavalier, &c.  E. तुरग a horse, and इनि aff.
17648: तुरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. A horse. 	 2. The mind, considerd as the seat of feeling as well as intellect, the heart.  E. त्वर speedily, and ग what goes. 	 f. (-ङ्गी) 	 1. A plant: see तुरगी and तुरगगन्धा. 	 2. A mare.  E. ङीष् added to the preceding.
17649: तुरङ्गक m. (-कः) A plant, a kind of Ghosha, commonly हस्तिधोष.  E. तुरङ्ग a horse, and कन् affix analogy; coursing through the body.
17650: तुरङ्गद्विषणी f. (-णी) A she buffalo.  E. तुरङ्ग, and द्विषणी disliking.
17651: तुरङ्गप्रिय m. (-यः) Barley.  E. तुरङ्ग, and प्रिय fond of.
17652: तुरङ्गम m. (-मः) A horse.  E. तुर speed, and गम् to go, with खच् and मुम् affs.
17653: तुरङ्गयायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Going on horse-back.  E. तुरङ्ग, यायिन् who goes.
17654: तुरङ्गवक्त्र m. (-क्त्रः) A Kinnara or quirister of INDRA'S heaven.  E. तुरङ्ग a horse, and वक्त्र a face.
17655: तुरङ्गवदन m. (-नः) A celestial quirister.  E. तुरङ्ग a horse, and वदन a face; these beings are described as having the bodies of men, and the heads of horse; also similar compounds, as तुरङ्गानन, तुरङ्गवक्त्र, तुरङ्गास्य, अश्ववक्त्र, &c.
17656: तुरङ्गारि m. (-रिः) 	 1. A buffalo. 	 2. Oleander.  E. तुरङ्ग, and अरि foe.
17657: तुरङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) 	 1. A horse-man, a rider. 	 2. A groom.  E. तुरङ्ग, and इनि aff.
17658: तुरायण subst. 	 mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Attachment to any object or pur-suit. adj Attached to any object or pursuit. 	 m. (-णः) A particular sacrifice.  E. तुर speed, haste, अय् to go, affix ल्यु; speeding towards a given end or in a certain cause: see परायण.
17659: तुरासाह m. (-षाट् or षाड्) A name of INDRA.  E. तुर for त्वर haste, सह् to bear, in the causal form, and क्विप् affix, स being changed to ष in-flexion. हलादौ षत्वं । अजादौतु न षत्वम् ।
17660: तुरि f. (-रिः) See the next; also तुलि.  E. तुर-इन् ।
17661: तुरी f. (-री) 	 1. A brush or a fibrous stick used by weavers to clean and separate the threads of the woof. 	 2. A painter's brush, &c. see तुली.
17662: तुरीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fourth, a fourth. 	 m. (-यः) A fourth part, a quarter. n. (-यं) The divine being, or universal spirit. E. irr. derived from चतुर् four, with छ affix; also तूर्य्य and तुर्य्य । तुरीय-अच् । चतुर्णां पूरणः चतुर् + छ आद्यलोपश्च ।
17663: तुरीयभाग m. (-गः) A fourth part or share.  E. तुरीय, and भाग share.
17664: तुरीयभाज् mfn. (-भाक्) A sharer of a fourth.  E. तुरीय, and भाज् who divides.
17665: तुरीयवर्ण m. (-र्णः) The Sudra or fourth tribe of the Hindus.  E. तुरीय fourth, and वर्ण tribe.
17666: तुरीयांश m. (-शः) A fourth part, a quarter share.  E. तरीय, and अंश a share.
17667: तुरुष्क m. (-ष्कः) 	 1. Incense. 	 2. A country, or m. plu. (-ष्काः) 1ts inhabit-ants; Turan or Turkestan, the original country of the Turks. E. तुर् to haste, (into smoke, &c.) affix उसिक्, and कन् added.
17668: तुर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Fourth. E. irr. derived from चतुर् four, with यत् aff.
17669: तुर्व(ई)तुर्वी r. 1st cl. (तुर्वति) To hurt, to injure, to kill.  E. भ्वा-पर-सक-सेट् ।
17670: तुर्व्वसु m. (-सुः) One of the sons of YAYATI, king of the south and eastern portion of India, reigning over the Mlechcha tribes.
17671: तुल r. 1st and 10th cls. (तोलति तुलति तोलयति-ते or irr. तुलयति) To weigh or measure.  E. भ्वा-पर-सक-सेट् । पक्षे-चुरा-उभ० ।
17672: तुलयित्वा ind. Having weighed, having counterpoised, mode equal or like, &c.  E. तुल् to weigh, क्त्वा. aff.
17674: तुलसी f. (-सी) A small shrub held in veneration by the Hindus, Tulasi or holy basil, (Ocymum sanctum.)  E. तुला resemblance, and षो to destroy, affixes ङ and ङीप्; being unparalleled: this plant is said to be a female metamorphosed. तुलां सादृश्यं स्यति सो-क गौरा० ङीष् ।
17675: तुला f. (-ला) 	 1. Measure by weight. 	 2. A measure or weight of gold and silver, 100 Palas, or about 145 ounces troy. 	 3. Any balance, es-pecially a fine balance, goldsmith's or assay scales. 	 4. The sign of the zodiac, Libra. 	 5. Resemblance, likeness, equality, similarity. 6. A vessel. 	 7. Sloping beams or timbers in the roof of a house. E. तुल् to weigh or to resemble, affix अङ्.
17676: तुलाकोटि f. (-टिः-टी) 	 1. An ornament of the feet or toes. 	 2. A certain weight. 	 3. A hundred millions.  E. तुला a balance, कुट् to measure, affixes अङ् and इन् or ङीप्; what is valued by weight, &c. or तुला a measure, &c. and कोटि Crore, or million. तुलया तुलां वा कोटयति कुट परितापे इन् वा ङीप् ।
17677: तुलाकोश m. (-शः) A sort of ordeal, in which the accused is tried by being weighed repeatedly in a scale: if he is lighter the second time he is pronounced innocent; if equipoised still, or heavier, he is guilty.  E. तुला a scale, and कोश ordeal.
17678: तुलाधट m. (-टः) 	 1. An oar, a paddle. 	 2. The scale or cup of a balance. E. तुला, and धट a scale. तुलायै तोलनाय धटः ।
17679: तुलाधर m. (-रः) The sun.  E. तुला the sign, and धर who has or possesses. तुलाया मानदण्डस्य धरः धृ-अच् ।
17680: तुलाधार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) A trader, a dealer, trafficking, trading. 	 m. (-रः) 1. The sign Libra. 	 2. The string of a balance. 	 3. The beam.  E. तुला the scales, &c. आधार what or who supports.
17681: तुलापरीक्षा f. (-क्षा) Ordeal by the balance, the weight of the accused being first taken, certain prayers and ceremonies are performed, after which he is weighed again: if lighter, he is innocent, if heavy, or as at first, guilty.  E. तुला, and परीक्षा test.
17682: तुलापुरुष m. (-षः) A person weighed in a balance, or an effigy of him used as a weight.  E. तुला, and पुरुष a man.
17683: तुलापुरुषदान n. (-नं) Gift of gold or valuables of the weight of the donor. E. तुलापुरुष, and दान gift.
17684: तुलाप्रग्रह m. (-हः) The string of a balance.  E. तुला, and प्रग्रह holding; also तुलाप्रग्राह ।
17685: तुलामान n. (-नं) Measure by weight.  E. तुला, and मान measure.
17686: तुलावीज n. (-जं) The Gunja or berry of the Abrus precatorius, from which the goldsmith's or jeweller's weight in India is taken; the berry weighs about 1(5/16) grain troy, the factitious weight about 2(3/16).  E. तुला weight, and वीज seed.
17687: तुलासूत्र n. (-त्रं) The string of a balance.  E. तुला, and सूत्र thread.
17688: तुलि f. (-लिः or -ली) 	 1. A fibrous stick or brush used by weavers for cleaning the threads of the woof. 	 2. A painter's brush, or fibrous stick used for that purpose: see तूलिका,  E. तुल् to resemble, &c. affix क, fem. affix इन् or ङीष्; also with ल changed to र, तुरि, तुरी.
17689: तुलिका f. (-का) A small bird said to resemble the wagtail.
17690: तुलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Made equal or like, equalled, compared. 	 2. Weighed, counterpoised.  E. तुल् to weigh, णिच् and कर्मणि क्त affs.
17691: तुलिफला f. (-ला) The Simul or silk cotton tree.  E. तुलि for तूलि cotton, and फल fruit. तुलि तुलयुक्तं फलमस्याः ।
17692: तुल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Like, resembling, equal or analogous to.  E. तुला resemblance, and यत् aff.
17693: तुल्यता f. (-ता) Likeness, sameness, equality.  E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, तुल्यत्वं.
17694: तुल्यपान n. (-नं) Drinking together.  E. तुल्य alike, and पान drinking.
17695: तुल्यबल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Of equal strength.  E. तुल्य, and बल strength.
17696: तुल्यभावन n. (-नं) Combination of like series, (in calculation.)  E. तुल्य, and भावन computing.
17697: तुल्यरूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पी-पं) 	 1. Like, similar, analogous. 	 2. Of like or equal form.  E. तुल्य, and रूप nature, &c.
17698: तुल्यवृत्ति mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति) Following the same or similar occupation. E. तुल्य, and वृत्ति business.
17699: तुल्यशुद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Equal substraction, transposition, (in Arithmetic.) E. तुल्य, शुद्धि substraction.
17700: तुल्याकृति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Alike, of the same form.  E. तुल्य, and आकृति form.
17701: तुवर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 	 1. Astringent. 	 2. Beardless. 	 mn. (-रः-रं) An astringent taste. 	 f. (-री) 	 1. A fragrant earth. 	 2. A kind of lentil, (Cytisus cajan:) see आढकी.  E. तु a Sautra root, to remove, (disease, &c.) ष्वरच् and affix ङीष्; also कन् being added, in the fem. form तुवरिका f. (-का.)
17702: तुवरीशिम्ब m. (-म्बः) A kind of cassia.  E. तुवरी the pulse so called, and शिम्ब Cassia tora.
17703: तुवि f. (-विः) A long gourd: see तुम्बी ।
17704: तुष r. 4th cl. (ञि, औ) ञिऔतुष (तुष्यति) To be satisfied or content, to be pleased or delighted.  E. दिवा-प-ऌदित् अक-सेट् ।
17705: तुष mf. (-षः-षा) 	 1. The husk or chaff of rice, &c. 	 2. Beleric myrobalan. E. तुष् to please or be pleased, affix क.
17706: तुषग्रह m. (-हः) Agni or fire.  E. तुष chaff, and ग्रह who seizes. तुषेण गृह्यते गृह-कर्मणि अप् ।
17707: तुषसार m. (-रः) Agni or fire.  E. तुष chaff, and सार who embraces, from सृ to go, with अण् aff. तुषं सरति अनुसरति ।

17709: तुषार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Cold, frigid, frosty. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. Frost. 	 2. Cold. 	 3. Thin rain, mist. 	 4. Ice or snow. 	 5. The name of a country.  E. तुष् to please, Unadi affix आरन्.
17710: तुषारकण m. (-णः) 	 1. A dew drop. 	 2. An icicle. 	 3. Hoar frost.  E. तुषार, and कण a particle.
17711: तुषारकाल m. (-लः) Winter, the cold season.  E. तुषार, and काल time.
17712: तुषारपात m. (-तः) 	 1. Thin rain, a sprinkling, a shower. 	 2. A fall of snow.  E. तुषार, and पात falling.

17714: तुषित m. (-तः) A Tushita, a kind of subordinate deity, one of a class of thirty-six. F. तुष् to please, इतच् aff. तारका० इतच् ।
17715: तुषोदक n. (-कं) Rice gruel.  E. तुष to satisfy, and उदक water.
17716: तुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Pleased, satisfied.  E. तुष् to be pleased, कर्त्तरि क्त. ।

17718: तुष्टिकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Pleasing, satisfying.  E. तुष्टि, and कर what makes.

17720: तुष्टिद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Pleasing, ‘satisfying.’  E. तुष्टि, and द what gives.
17721: तुष्टु m. (-ष्टुः) A jewel worn in the ears.  E. तुष् to please, तुक् aff.
17722: तुष्ट्वा ind. Having pleased or gratified.  E. तुष्, and क्त्वा aff.

17724: तुस m. (-सः) The husk of corn or rice: see तुष.
17725: तुस्त n. (-स्तं) Dust.  E. तुस् to sound, affix क्तः see तूस्त.
17726: तुह (इर) तुहिर r. 1st cl. (तोहति) To hurt or give pain, to kill.  E. भ्वा-पर-सक-सेट् ।
17727: तुहिन n. (-नं) 	 1. Frost. 	 2. Moonlight, moonshine.  E. तुह् to give pain, इनन् Unadi aff.
17728: तुहिनशैल m. (-लः) The Himalaya mountains.  E. तुहिन, and शैल a moun-tain; also similar compounds, as तुहिनपर्व्वत, &c.
17729: तुहिनांशु m. (-शुः) The moon.  E. तुहिन cold, अंशु a ray.
17730: तुहिनांशुतैल n. (-लं) Camphor.  E. तुहिनांशु, and तैल oil.
17731: तुहिनाद्रि m. (-द्रिः) The Himalaya mountains.  E. तुहिन, and अद्रि a moun-tain; also तुहिनशैल, &c.
17732: तूण r. 1st cl. (तूणयते) To fill, to fill up. (तूणयति) To shrink, to contract, to close as the eye-lids or wink.  E. पूरणे चुरा-आ । सङ्कोचे उभ-सक-सेट् ।

17735: तूणिन् mfn. (-णी-णिनी-णि) Having a quiver, quivered. 	 m. (-णी) The Tun tree.  E. तूण, and इनि aff.
17736: तूणीर m. (-रः) A quiver.  E. तूण to be filled (with arrows), ईरण् aff.
17738: तूनी f. (-नी) Sharp pain in the perinœum and lower part of the abdomen.
17739: तूर् f. (तूः) Speed. 	 m. (तूः) A courier.  E. तुर् to make haste, क्किप् affix, and the semivowel changed to ऊ.
17740: तूर (ई) तूरी r. 4th cl. (तूर्य्यते) To go quick, to make haste. 	 2. To kill, to hurt or injure.  E. दिवा-आत्म हिंसायां सक० वेगे अक-सेट् ।
17741: तूर n. (-रं) Any musical instrument. 	 f. (-री) A trumpet.  E. तूर् to speed, affix क । तूर्य्यते ताड्यते मुखमारुतेन तूर-घञर्थे कर्मणि क ।
17742: तूर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Quick, expeditious n. adv. (-र्णं) Quick, swift, quickly.  E. त्वर् to go swiftly, affix कर्त्तरि भावे वा क्त ।
17743: तूर्णि m. (-र्णिः) 	 1. Speed, velocity, expedition. 	 2. Dirt, excrement. 	 3. A stanza. 	 4. The mind.  E. त्वर् to make haste, Unadi affix नि.

17745: तूर्य्यखण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A musical instrument, a sort of tabor.
17746: तूल r. 1st cl. (तूलति) 	 1. To dismiss, to send forth or turn out. 	 2. To ascertain quantity or weight; some make this a root of the tenth class (तूलयते.)  E. भ्वा-पर-सक-सेट् । चु-आ-सक-सेट् ।
17747: तूल n. (-लं) 	 1. The mulberry. (Morus Indica.) 	 2. Æther, the heaven or atmosphere. 	 mn. (-लः-लं) Cotton. 	 f. 17748: तूलक n. (-कं) Cotton.  E. कन् added to the preceding.
17749: तूलकार्म्मुक n. (-कं) A bow which is used for cleaning cotton.  E. तूल cotton, and कार्म्मुक bow; also similar compounds, as तूलचाप, तूलधनुः, &c.
17750: तूलनाली f. (-ली) A thick roll of cotton, from which it is drawn out in spinning.  E. तूल cotton, नाल a tube, affixes अण् and ङीप्; also with कन् added तूलनालिका f. (-का.)
17751: तूलपिचु m. (-चुः) Cotton.  E. तूल cotton, and पिचु the same.
17752: तूलशर्करा f. (-रा) A pod or seed of the plant, any seed yielding a similar substance.  E. तूल cotton, and शर्करा sand or gravel.
17753: तूलसेवन n. (-नं) Spinning.  E. तूल cotton, सिव्-ल्युट् aff. तूलसूत्रकर्त्तने । (काट्नाकाटा) ।
17754: तूलि f. (-लिः) A painter's brush, or a fibrous stick used as one, and for other purposes.  E. तूल् to send forth or cut, affix इन्ः see तूल and तूली.
17755: तूलिका f. (-का) A pencil, a painter's brush, or a stick with a fibrous extremity used as one. 	 2. A mattress or quilt, a bed, a down or cot-ton bed. 	 3. An ingot mould. 	 4. 17756: तूलिनी f. (-नी) The silk cotton tree.  E. तूल cotton, इनि and ङीष् affs.
17757: तूवर m. (-रः) 	 1. A bull without horns, though of an age to have them. 2. A beardless man. 	 3. A eunuch. 	 4. An astringent taste. 	 f. (-री) A fragrant earth.  E. तू to injure, वरच् affix, and the vowel option-ally long, hence also तुवर and तुवरी; with कन् added तूवरिका and तूवरीका.
17758: तूष r. 1st cl. (तूषति) 	 1. To satisfy. 	 2. To be satisfied or happy  E. भ्वा-पर-सक-सेट् ।
17759: तूष्णीशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Silent, taciturn.  E. तूष्णीम् silent, and शील practising.
17760: तूष्णीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Silent, taciturn.  E. तूष्णीम् silent, कन् affix, and म dropped. तूष्णीं शीलं यस्य शीले अर्थे कन् मलोपश्च ।

17763: तूष्णीम्भूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Silent.  E. तूष्णीम्, and भूत become.
17764: तूस्त n. (-स्तं) 	 1. Dust. 	 2. Clotted hair. 	 3. Sin. 	 4. An atom, a very thin or delicate substance.  E. तूस् to sound, Unadi affix तन्, and the ra-dical vowel made long.
17765: तृक्ष r. 1st. cl. (तृक्षति) To go, to move or approach.  E. भ्वा-पर-सक-सेट् ।
17767: तृढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Hurt, injured, wounded.  E. तृह् to hurt, क्त aff.
17768: तृण (उ) तृणु r. 8th cl. (तर्णोति तर्णते or तृणोति तृणुते) To eat, especially grass, to graze.  E. तना-उभ-सक-सेट् ।
17769: तृण n. (-णं) Grass, any gramineous plant.  E. तृह् to hurt, Unadi affix णक्, and ह rejected; what is consumed by cattle, &c.
17770: तृणकुङ्कम n. (-मं) A short of perfume.  E. तृण grass, कुङ्कुम saffron.
17771: तृणकुटी f. (-टी) A hovel, a hut of grass, or straw.  E. तृण grass, and कुटी a small house.
17772: तृणकूर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) A long gourd, (Cucurbita lagenaria.)  E. तृण grass, and कूर्म्म a tortoise.
17773: तृणकेतु m. (-तुः) A bamboo.  E. तृण grass, and केतु a banner.
17774: तृणगोधा f. (-धा) 	 1. A kind of newt. 	 2. A chameleon. 	 3. A worm.  E. तृण grass, and गोधा a lizard.
17775: तृणग्राहिन् m. (-ही) 	 1. Amber, &c. or any gem which being rubbed be-comes electrically attractive. 	 2. Sapphire.  E. तृण grass, and ग्राहिन् what seizes.

17777: तृणजाति m. (-तिः) The vegetable kingdom.  E. तृण, and जाति genus.
17778: तृणता f. (-ता) 	 1. A bow. 	 2. The aggregate properties of grass or her-bage, gramineousness.  E. तल् affix of the abstract, added to तृण; also तृणत्व n. (-त्वं.)
17779: तृणद्रुम m. (-मः) A palm tree, any of the various species, any of the various species, as the palmyra, cocoanut, date, &c.  E. तृण grass, and द्रुम a tree; pre-eminent amongst gramineous plants.
17780: तृणधान्य m. (-न्यः) Grain growing wild or without cultivation.  E. तृण grass, and धान्य grain, corn.
17781: तृणध्वज m. (-जः) A bamboo.  E. तृण grass, and ध्वज a flag or banner.
17782: तृणपूली f. (-ली) A mat, a seat made of reeds or basket-work.  E. तृण grass, पूल् to gather together, affixes अण् and ङीष् ।

17789: तृणषट्पद m. (-दः) A wasp.  E. तृण grass, and षट्पद six-foot; an insect haunting meadows, &c. having six-feet.
17790: तृणस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Grassy, made, &c. with grass.  E. तृण grass, and स aff.

17792: तृणसिंह m. (-हः) An axe.  E. तृण grass, and सिंह a lion.
17793: तृणहर्म्म्य m. (-र्म्म्यः) A hovel, a house or upper-room of grass or straw. E. तृण grass, and हर्म्म्य a mansion.

17798: तृणोल्का f. (-ल्का) A firebrand made of a wisp of straw.  E. तृण grass, उल्का a firebrand.
17799: तृणौकस् n. (-कः) A hovel, a hut, a house of straw or mats.  E. तृण grass, and ओकस् abode.

17801: तृण्या f. (-ण्या) A heap or quantity of grass.  E. तृण grass, यत् and टाप् affs.

18042: त्रिणाचिकेत n. (-तं) A portion of the Yajur Veda. 	 m. (-तः) A follower of that branch of the Vedas. It is also sometimes read तृणाचिकेत ।
18043: त्रितक्ष nf. (-क्षं-क्षी) An assemblage of three carpenters.  E. त्रि three, तक्ष a carpenter, affix अच् समा० ।
18044: त्रितय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Third.  E. त्रि three, तयप् aff.
18045: त्रिदण्ड n. (-ण्डं) 	 1. Three staves collectively. 	 2. Triple subjection of words, thoughts, and acts; the state of a religious ascetic.  E. त्रि three, दण्ड a staff, &c.
18046: त्रिदण्डधारण n. (-णं) Carrying three staves tied together, (as done by some mendicants.)  E. त्रिदण्ड, and धारण holding.
18047: त्रिदण्डिन् m. (-ण्डी) 	 1. A wandering devotee, one who carries three long bamboo staves in his right hand. 	 2. The religious man who has ob-tained a command over his words, thoughts, and actions, or mind, body, and speech.  E. त्रि three, and दण्ड a punishment, a staff, &c. इनि aff.
18048: त्रिदला f. (-ला) A creeping plant, (Cissus pedata.)  E. त्रि three, and दल a leaf.
18049: त्रिदश m. (-शः) A god, a deity, an immortal.  E. त्रि the third, and दशा state, being, (youth;) enjoying perpetual youth, or त्रि three, and दश state, subject as well as mortals to the three conditions, of birth, being, and destruction.
18050: त्रिदश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Thirteenth. 	 f. (-शी) The thirteenth day of the fortnight; also त्रयोदश ।
18051: त्रिदशदीर्घिका f. (-का) The heavenly Ganges.  E. त्रिदश a deity, and दीर्घिका a long pool.
18052: त्रिदशन् mfn. plu. (-श) Thirteen.  E. त्रि three, and दशन् ten.
18053: त्रिदशनदी f. (-दी) The heavenly Ganges.  E. त्रिदश, and नदी a river.
18054: त्रिदशपति m. (-तिः) INDRA.  E. त्रिदश, and पति chief.
18055: त्रिदशबधू f. (-धूः) A nymph of INDRA'S heaven.  E. त्रिशद, and बधू wife.
18056: त्रिदशवनिता f. (-ता) A nymph of INDRA'S heaven.  E. त्रिदश, and वनिता a wife.
18057: त्रिदशाङ्कुश n. (-शं) The thunderbolt.  E. त्रिदश a deity, and अङ्कुश a goad.
18058: त्रिदशाचार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) The preceptor of the gods, VRIHASPATI.  E. त्रिदश a deity, and आचार्य्य a teacher.
18059: त्रिदशायुध n. (-धं) The thunderbolt of INDRA.  E. त्रिदश a deity, and आयुध a weapon.
18060: त्रिदशारि m. (-रिः) An Asura or infernal being hostile to the gods, a Titan, a Giant.  E. त्रिदश a deity, and अरि a foe.
18061: त्रिदशालय m. (-यः) 	 1. Swarga, INDRA'S heaven or paradise. 	 2. The moun-tain Sumeru.  E. त्रिदश a deity, and आलय an abode.
18062: त्रिदशावास m. (-सः) Swarga, the heaven of INDRA.  E. त्रिदश a god, and आवास abode.
18063: त्रिदशाहार m. (-रः) Amrita or ambrosia.  E. त्रिदश a deity, and आहार food.
18064: त्रिदालिका f. (-का) A plant, commonly Charmaghasa.
18065: त्रिदिन n. (-नं) Three days collectively.  E. त्रि, and दिन a day.
18066: त्रिदिनस्पृश् m. (-स्पृक्) Conjunction or concurrence of three lunations with one solar day.  E. त्रिदिन, and स्पृश् contact.
18067: त्रिदिव mn. (-वः-वं) 	 1. Swarga or paradise. 	 2. Sky, atmosphere, heaven. f. (-वा) The name of a river.  E. त्रि the three, BRAMHA, VISHNU, and SIVA, दिव् to sport, affix क; the place where these three gods take divine pleasure.
18068: त्रिदिवेश m. (-शः) A god, a deity.  E. त्रिदिव heaven, and ईश master or lord.
18069: त्रिदिवौकस् m. (-काः) A god, a celestial.  E. त्रिदिव heaven, and ओकस् asylum.
18070: त्रिदृश् mfn. (-दृक्) Tri-ocular, three-eyed. 	 m. (-दृक्) A name of SIVA. E. त्रि three, and दृश् an eye.
18071: त्रिदोष n. (-षं) Disorder of the three humours of the body, vitiation of the bile, blood, and phlegm.  E. त्रि three, and दीष a fault.
18072: त्रिदोषघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Correcting the vitiated state of the three hu-mours.  E. त्रिदोष, and घ्न what destroys.
18073: त्रिदोषज m. (-जः) Disease, &c. proceeding from disorder of the three hu-mours of the body.  E. त्रिदोष, and ज produced.
18074: त्रिधा ind. In three ways.  E. त्रि, and धाच् aff.
18075: त्रिधातु m. (-तुः) A name of GANESA. 	 n. (-त) Three minerals, &c.  E. त्रि three, and धातु mineral, &c. त्रीन् धर्मार्थकामान् दधाति पुष्णाति धा-तुन् ।
18076: त्रिधामन् mfn. (-मा-मा-म) Having three residences, &c. 	 m. (-मा) 	 1. A name of VISHNU. 	 2. An appellation of SIVA. 	 3. Agni or fire. 	 4. Death.  E. त्रि three (worlds,) and धामन् abode.
18077: त्रिनयन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Three-eyed, tri-ocular. 	 m. (-नः) A name of SIVA. E. त्रि three, and नयन an eye; this deity is represented with a third eye in his forehead; also similar compounds, as त्रिदृश्, त्रिनेत्र, त्र्यक्ष, &c.
18078: त्रिनेत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) Tri-ocular. 	 m. (-त्रः) SIVA.  E. त्रि, and नेत्र eye.
18079: त्रिनेत्रचूडामणि m. (-णिः) The moon.  E. त्रिनेत्र SIVA, चूडा a crest, and मणि a gem; being worn by that deity as his crest.
18080: त्रिपक्ष n. (-क्षं) A period of six weeks.  E. त्रि, and पक्ष a fortnight.
18081: त्रिषताक m. (-कः) 	 1. The forehead marked naturally with three horizon-tal lines. 	 2. The hand with three fingers erect.  E. त्रि three or three-fold, and पताका a banner, a symbol.
18082: त्रिपत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) Three-leaved trefoil. 	 m. (-त्रः) A bell tree, (Ægle marmelos.)  E. त्रि, and पत्र leaf.
18083: त्रिपत्रक m. (-कः) The Kinsuka tree, (Butea frondosa.)  E. त्रि three, and पत्र a leaf; having three leaves on each stalk.
18084: त्रिपथ n. (-थं) 	 1. A place where three roads meet. 	 2. Three ways or paths.  E. त्रि, and पथ a road.
18085: त्रिपथगा f. (-गा) The Ganges.  E. त्रिपथ three roads, and गा who goes, flowing through earth, heaven, and hell.
18086: त्रिपद mfn. (-दः-दा-दी-दं) 	 1. Three-footed. 	 2. Having three lines or divi-sions, (a stanza.) 	 3. (In Arithmetic,) Trinomial. 	 n. (-दं) 	 1. A tripod. 	 f. (-दा) A verse of three lines, as the Gayatri. 	 f. (-दी) 	 1. A creeper, (Cissus pedata.) 	 2. The girth of an elephant.  E. त्रि three, and पद a foot.
18087: त्रिपर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं) Three leaved trefoil. 	 f. (-र्णी) Wild cotton.  E. त्रि three, and पर्ण a leaf.
18088: त्रिपाद् m. (-पाद्) 	 1. A name of VISHNU. 	 2. Fever, (personified.)  E. त्रि three, and पाद foot or part, three-footed, alluding to VISHNU'S three steps which paced the universe; and the demon of fever is described in the Puranas, with three feet, and three heads, allud-ing probably to its three stages of cold, hot, and sweating.
18089: त्रिपिव m. (-वः) A long-eared goat.  E. त्रि, and पिव who drinks, touching water with both ears as he laps.
18090: त्रिपिष्टप n. (-पं) 	 1. Heaven, Swarga or paradise. 	 2. Sky, æther.  E. पिष्टप a world, and त्रि three, or the third; also त्रिविष्टप ।
18091: त्रिपिष्टपसद् m. (-सद्) A deity.  E. त्रिपिष्ठप heaven, and सद् who goes, from सद् with क्विप् affix; also त्रिविष्ठपसद् ।
18092: त्रिपुट m. (-टः) 	 1. Pulse, pease of three kinds. 	 2. A bank or shore. 	 3. A kind of vetch, (Cicer arietinum.) 	 4. A cubit. 	 5. A plant, (Ruellia longifolia) 	 f. (-टा-टी) A plant, (Convolvulus turpethum.) f. (-टा) Small cardamoms. 	 2. Arabian jasmine. 	 3. A goddess. E. त्रि three, and पुट skin or coat of a seed, &c.
18093: त्रिपुटक m. (-कः) A triangle.  E. कन् added to the last.
18094: त्रिपुटिन् m. (-टी) The castor-oil plant.  E. त्रि three, पुट the Seed vessel, and इनि aff.
18095: त्रिपुटीफल m. (-लः) The castor-oil plant.  E. त्रिपुटी as above, and फल fruit.
18096: त्रिपुण्ड्र n. (-ण्ड्रं) Three curved horizontal marks, made across the fore-head with cowdung, &c.; they are worn especially by the fol-lowers of SIVA, or SAKTI, and are indispensable in proceeding to worship the former.  E. त्रि three, triple, and पुण्ड्र a line; also with कन् added त्रिपुण्ड्रक ।
18098: त्रिपुर nf. (-रं-री) 	 1. The three cities gold, silver and iron erected by the demon Maya and burnt down by SIVA. 	 2. A district, the modern Tipperah, &c. 	 m. (-रः) The name of an Asura, and king of Tripura.  E. त्रि three, and पुर a city, the district and dominion of that Asura, consisting of three strong and famous cities.
18099: त्रिपुरदहन m. (-नः) A name of SIVA.  E. त्रिपुर the country of Tripura, and दहन burning, consuming; the Asura and his three cities being destroyed by MAHADEVA; also similar names, as त्रिपुरजित्, त्रिपुरसूदन, &c.
18100: त्रिपुरमल्लिका f. (-का) A medicinal plant, apparently a kind of jasmine. E. त्रिपुर Tipperah, and मल्लिका jasmine.
18101: त्रिपुरान्तक m. (-कः) A name of SIVA.  E. त्रिपुर, and अन्तक ender, destroyer: see त्रिपुरदहन ।
18102: त्रिपुरुष n. (-षं) Three generation collectively.  E. त्रि three, पुरुष a man.
18103: त्रिपुरुषागत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Enjoyed or inherited through three genera-tions.  E. त्रिपुरुष, and आगत come.
18104: त्रिपुषा f. (-षा) Black Teori. त्रीन् वातादिदोषान् पुष्णाति पुष-क ।
18105: त्रिपौरुष mfn. (-षः-षी-षं) Relating or belonging to three persons or generations, offered to three, (the funeral cake, &c.) inherited from three, (an estate, &c.)  E. त्रिपुरुष, and अण् aff.
18106: त्रिपृष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A king, and one of the Vasudevas, or descendants of VASUDEVA, according the Jainas.
18107: त्रिफला f. (-ला) The three myrobalans collectively.  E. त्रि three, फल fruit, fem. affix टाप्; also with ङीष् affix त्रिफली ।
18108: त्रिबलीक n. (-कं) The anus.  E. त्रि three, (the three humors,) तिस्रो बलो यत्र कप् ।
18109: त्रिभण्डी f. (-ण्डी) A plant, (Convolvulus turpethum.)  E. त्रि three, (ailments, or bile, phlegm, and fever,) भडि to oppose, affixes अण् and ङीष्. त्रीन् वातादिदोषान् भण्डति ।
18110: त्रिभद्र n. (-द्रं) Copulation, cohabitation.  E. त्रि three, and भद्र pleasurable.
18111: त्रिभुज m. (-जः) A triangle.  E. त्रि, and भुज an arm.
18112: त्रिभुवन n. (-नं) Three worlds, or heaven, earth and hell.  E. त्रि three, and भुवन a world.
18113: त्रिमधु m. (-धुः) 	 1. A portion of the Rig Veda. 	 2. A follower or student of the Trimadhu section of the Rig Veda. 	 n. (-धु) Ghee, honey, and sugar.  E. त्रि, and मधु honey.
18114: त्रिमार्गी f. (-र्गी) The meeting of three roads.  E. त्रि three, and मार्ग a road.
18115: त्रिमुकुट m. (-टः) A mountain with three peaks.  E. त्रि three, and मुकुट a crest.
18116: त्रिमुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Having three faces. 	 m. (-खः) A divine attendant upon a Jaina saint. 	 f. (-खा) A female deity of the Jaina sect.  E. त्रि three, and मुख a face, three-faced, or त्रि three (worlds,) and मुख principal.
18117: त्रिमूर्त्ति m. (-र्त्तिः) 	 1. A Jina or Jaina saint. 	 2. The united form of BRAMHA, VISHNU, and SIVA, or the Hindu triad. 	 3. One possessing three forms or modes of being.  E. त्रि thee, and मूर्त्ति form, matter.
18118: त्रिमूर्द्ध mfn. (-र्द्धः-र्द्धी-र्द्धं) Three-headed.  E. त्रि, and मूर्द्धन् the forehead, ष aff.
18119: त्रियव n. (-वं) A Ratti or weight of three barley-corns.  E. त्रि, and यव barley.
18120: त्रियष्टि m. (-ष्टिः) 	 1. A medicinal plant. 	 2. A necklace of three strings. (Mollugo pentaphylla.)  E. त्रि three, and यष्टि a line; having three stalks.
18121: त्रियामक n. (-कं) Sin.  E. त्रि the three objects of life, and यामक impeder, from यम् with ण्वुल् aff.
18122: त्रियामा f. (-मा) 	 1. Night. 	 2. The YAMUNA or Jumna river. 	 3. Indigo. 4. Black Teori, a plant so called. 	 5. Turmeric.  E. त्रि three (times, or past, present and future,) या to go, affix मन्.
18123: त्रियूह m. (-हः) A brown or chesnut horse. कपिलाश्वे ।
18124: त्रिरात्र n. (-त्रं) Three nights collectively, or the duration of three nights. E. त्रि three, and रात्रि night; compounded with a numeral रात्रि sub-stitutes अ for its final, and becomes neuter. तिसृणां रात्रीणां समाहारः ।
18125: त्रिरेख m. (-खः) A conch.  E. त्रि, and रेखा a line; this shell being mark-ed with three lines. तिस्रो रेखा यत्र । शङ्के ।
18126: त्रिलोकी f. (-की) The aggregate of the three worlds, or heaven, earth, and hell, collectively.  E. त्रि three, and लोक a world, and ङीप् affix, with the sense of aggregation. त्रयाणां लोकानां समाहारः ।
18127: त्रिलोकेश m. (-शः) 	 1. The sun. 	 2. God.  E. त्रिलोक the three worlds or the universe, and ईश lord. त्रयाणां लोकानाम् ईशः ।
18128: त्रिलोचन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Tri-ocular, three-eyed. 	 m. (-नः) A name of SIVA. 	 f. (-ना) A female deity of the Jainas. 	 f. (-नी) A name of DURGA.  E. त्रि three, and लोचन an eye: see त्रिदृश्, &c.
18129: त्रिलोहक n. (-कं) Gold, silver, and copper.  E. त्रि, and लोहक metal.
18130: त्रिवर्ग m. (-र्गः) 	 1. Three human objects or pursuits as love, duty, and wealth. 	 2. Three conditions of a king or state; prosperity, even-ness, and decay; or loss, gain, equality, &c. 	 3. The three qualities of nature, purity, blindness, and depravity. 	 4. The three myroba-lans. 	 5. The three spices: see त्रिकटु. 	 6. propriety, good behavior. E. त्रि three, and वर्ग a class; a class or aggregate of three.
18131: त्रिवर्गपारीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Having passed through the three condi-tions, or attained the three objects of life.  E. त्रिवर्ग, and पारीण gone to the opposite shore.
18132: त्रिवर्णक n. (-कं) 	 1. The three myrobalans. 	 2. The three spices. 	 3. A plant, (Ruellia longifolia:) see गीक्षुरक.  E. त्रि three, वर्ण a class, and कन् added.
18133: त्रिवर्षिका f. (-का) A three years old heifer.  E. त्रि, and वर्ष a year, affix ठन्.
18134: त्रिवली f. (-ली) Three folds of skin on the abdomen, from obesity.  E. त्रि, and वली a wrinkle.
18135: त्रिविक्रम m. (-मः) A name of VISHNU.  E. त्रि, and विक्रम going; crossing over the three worlds in three steps, to the discomfiture of BALI.
18136: त्रिविद्या f. (-द्या) Three branches of knowledge, especially that of the three Vedas.  E. त्रि, and विद्या knowledge.
18137: त्रिविध mfn. (धः-धा-धं) In three ways, of three kinds.  E. त्रि, and विध sort.
18138: त्रिविष्टप n. (-पं) 	 1. Heaven or paradise. 	 2. The three worlds, or heaven, earth, and hell: see त्रिपिष्टप ।
18139: त्रिविष्टपसद् m. (-सद्) A deity; also त्रिपिष्टपसद् ।
18140: त्रिवृत् mfn. (-वृत्) Triple, tri-form, three-fold. 	 m. (-वृत्) 	 1. A plant of valuable purgative properties, commonly called Teori, and distin-guished into two species, white and black, (Convolvulus turpe-thum.) 	 2. Combining any thing by three. 	 3. A triple cord, a girdle, &c. of three strings. 	 4. A kind of sacrifice.  E. त्रि three, (three seed vessels,) वृ to cherish, affix क्विप्, and तुक् added: also with टाप् added त्रिवृता f. (-ता.)
18141: त्रिवृत्करण n. (-णं) Combining earth, water, and fire, in the proportion of half of one with a quarter of each of the others.  E. त्रिवृत्, and करण making.
18142: त्रिवृत्पर्णी f. (-र्णी) A potherb, (Hilancha repens.)  E. त्रिवृत् Teori, and पर्ण a leaf; having similar leaves.
18143: त्रिवेणी f. (-णी) A name of the Ganges.  E. त्रि three, वेणी a braid of hair: the name is especially applied to the river at Allahabad, where it receives the Jumuna, and is supposed to receive under ground the Saraswati; it is also that of a village in Bengal, above Hugli.
18144: त्रिवेद n. (-दं) The three Vedas collectively.  E. त्रि, and वेद a Veda.
18145: त्रिवेदिन् m. (-दी) A Bramhan acquainted with three Vedas.  E. त्रिवेद, and इनि aff.
18146: त्रिशङ्कु m. (-ङ्कुः) 	 1. The name of a king of the solar race, famous for attempting to go to heaven in his mortal frame, by the aid of VISWAMITRA. 	 2. A cat. 	 3. A grasshopper. 	 4. A bird, the Chataka, (Cuculus melanoleucos.) 	 5. A fire-fly.  E. त्रि three, शङ्कु a dart, ट aff.
18147: त्रिशङ्कुज m. (-जः) A name of HARISCHANDRA, a prince.  E. त्रिशङ्कु, and ज born, descended from TRISANKU.
18148: त्रिशङ्कुयाजिन् m. (-जी) VISWAMITRA, a celebrated sage and saint.  E. त्रिशङ्कु the king so named, and याजिन् causing to worship; being the family priest of the monarch.
18149: त्रिशरण m. (-णः) A Jina, a sanctified teacher of the Jaina sect.  E. त्रि three, (the three worlds,) and शरण protection.
18150: त्रिशला f. (-ला) The mother of VARDDHAMANA, the last of the Jaina pontiffs.
18151: त्रिशिख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) Three-crested, three-headed. 	 n. (-खं) 	 1. A crest, a tiara with three points. 	 2. A trident, a three pronged spear. 	 m. (-खः) The son of RAVANA, a demon with three heads.  E. त्रि three, and शिखा a crest.
18152: त्रिशिरस् mfn. (-राः-राः-रः) Three-headed. 	 m. (-राः) A name of KUVERA. 2. Fever personified as a demon with three heads: see त्रिपाद. 	 3. A son of RAVANA.  E. त्र three, and शिरस् a head.
18153: त्रिशीर्षक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Three-headed. 	 m. (-कः) A trident, tri-pointed spear.  E. त्रि three, and शीर्ष a head, affix कन्.
18154: त्रिशूल n. (-लं) A trident, a three-pointed pike or spear, especially the weapon of SIVA.  E. त्रि three or Tri, and शूल a dar.
18155: त्रिशूलिन् m. (-ली) A name of SIVA.  E. त्रिशूल, and इनि affix, armed with a trident.
18156: त्रिशृङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. A hill with three peaks. 	 2. A triangle.  E. त्रि three, and शृङ्ग a horn.
18157: त्रिशृङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) A sort of fish, commonly Rohi, (Cyprinus rohita, HAM.)
18158: त्रिषवण n. (-णं) The three ablutions to be performed in the day or at dawn, noon, and sun-set.  E. त्रि three, षवन bathing; also read त्रिसवन ।
18159: त्रिषवणस्नायिन् m. (-यी) A man performing regularly the prescribed ablu-tions, at morning, noon, and night.  E. त्रि three, सवन time or period of ablution, and स्नायिन् who bathes.
18160: त्रिष्टुभ् f. (-ष्टुप्) A form of metre, the stanza consisting of four lines of eleven syllables each, or of five lines, one of eleven and four of eight each, forming altogether forty-four syllables; there are other varieties.
18161: त्रिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Situated in three places.  E. त्रि, and स्था to be, क aff.
18162: त्रिसन्ध्य mfn. (-न्ध्यः-न्ध्या or न्ध्यी-न्ध्यं) The three periods of the day, or dawn, noon, and eve.  E. त्रि three, and सन्ध्य either of the periods.
18163: त्रिसम n. (-मं) An aggregate of three like or equal things.  E. त्रि, and सम same.
18164: त्रिसर subst. 	 mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) A dish of sesamum, rice, &c.  E. त्रि three, three-fold, and सर what is, from सृ to go or get, affix अप् ।
18165: त्रिसवन n. (-नं) Bathing thrice: see त्रिषवण ।
18166: त्रिसीत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) Thrice ploughed, (a field, &c.)  E. त्रि thrice, and सीत्य ploughed.
18167: त्रिसुपर्ण m. (-र्णः) 	 1. A portion of the Rig and Yajur Vedas. 	 2. A ob-servance enjoined by it. 	 3. A Brahman following it.
18168: त्रिसुपर्णिक m. (-कः) A Tri Suparna Brahman: see the last.
18169: त्रिस्रोतस् f. (-ताः) 	 1. The Ganges. 	 2. Another river.  E. त्रि three, and स्रोतस् a river, the river of the three worlds, or one with three channels.
18170: त्रिहल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Thrice ploughed, (a field, &c.)  E. त्रि thrice, हल्य ploughed.
18171: त्रिहायण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Three years, (old, &c.) 	 f. (-णी) A three-years-old heifer.  E. त्रि, and हायन a year; also read त्रिहायन ।
18172: त्रुट r. 4th cl. (त्रुट्यति) r. 6th cl. (त्रुटति) and 10th cl. (त्रोटयते) To cut, literally or metaphorically; to cut, (wood, &c.) to cut or solve, (difficulties, doubts, &c.) दिवा० तुदा० प० अक० सेट् । चुरा० आत्म० सक० सेट् ।
18173: त्रिटि f. (-टिः-टी) 	 1. Cutting, breaking. 	 2. Loss, destruction. 	 3. Breaking a promise, &c. 	 4. Small cardamoms, (Alpinia cardamomum). 5. A short time, a moment. 	 6. Doubt, uncertainty. 	 7. (Always feminine, though used attributively.) Little, small. 	 8. An atom, or a visible atom composed of three subtler elementary par-ticles.  E. त्रुट् to cut or divide, affix इन् and ङीप् optionally added.
18174: त्रुटित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Cut, broken, divided. 	 2. Hurt, wounded.  E. त्रुट, and क्त aff.
18175: त्रुटितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Chapped, chafed, cut.  E. त्रुट, and क्तवतु aff.
18176: त्रुटिवीज m. (-जः) An esculent root: see कचु.  E. त्रुटि small, and वीज a seed.
18177: त्रुप r. 1st cl. (त्रोपति) To hurt, to injure or kill.
18178: त्रुफ r. 1st cl. (त्रोफति) To hurt, to kill or injure; also तुफ, तुम्फ, &c.
18179: त्रुम्प r. 1st cl. (त्रुम्पति) To hurt or injure: see तुप, तुम्प, &c. भ्वा० पर० सक० सेट् ।
18180: त्रुम्फ r. 1st cl. (त्रुम्फति) To kill or injure; also त्रुफ, &c. भ्वा० पर० सक० सेट् ।
18181: त्रेता f. (-ता) 	 1. The second Yuga or age of the Hindus, consisting of 1,296,000 years. 	 2. The three sacred fires collectively, or the southern, household, and sacrificial fires.  E. त्र preservation, &c. derived from त्रै to preserve, इत obtained, got.
18182: त्रेताग्नि m. (-ग्निः) A man who has preserved the three sacred fires.  E. त्रेता as above, and अग्नि fire.
18183: त्रेतायुग n. (-गं) The second or Treta age.  E. त्रेता, and युग age.
18184: त्रेधा ind. Triple, three-fold, in three ways.  E. त्रि three, धा affix, and ए substituted for the vowel.
18185: त्रै (ङ) त्रैङ् r. 1st cl. (त्रायते) To preserve, to protect, to cherish, to de-fend, &c.  E. भ्वा० आ० सक० अनिट् ।
18186: त्रैगुणिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Giving three times, relating to thrice, three qualities, &c.  E. त्रिगुण, and ठक् aff.
18187: त्रैगुण्य n. (-ण्यं) 	 1. The quality of three Gunas or properties collectively. 2. A trine, a multiplication by three.  E. त्रिगुण, and ष्यञ् aff.
18188: त्रैदशिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Sacred to the gods, belonging or relating to them. त्रिदश, and ठञ् aff. त्रिदशा देवता अस्य ।
18189: त्रैधम् ind. In three ways, three-fold.  E. त्रि three, धमञ् affix; also ड being added, the word becomes an attributive, and may be in-flected in the three genders, also त्रैध, mfn. (-धः-धी-धं) ।
18190: त्रैपुर m. (-रः) Tripura or Tipperah: see त्रिपुर.  E. स्वार्थे अण् added to त्रिपुर ।
18191: त्रैराशिक mf. (-कः-का) (In Arithmetic,) The rule of three: it is of two kinds क्रमत्रैराशिकः Rule of three direct, व्यस्त or विलोमत्रैराशिकः Rule of three inverse.  E. त्रि three, राशि quantity, ठञ् aff.
18192: त्रैरूप्य n. (-प्यं) Three ways or forms.  E. त्रि, रूप form, ष्यञ् aff.
18193: त्रैलोक्य n. (-क्यं) The three worlds, or heaven, hell, and earth.  E. त्रिलोक and ष्यञ् aff. त्रिलोकी एव स्वार्थे ष्यञ् ।
18194: त्रैलोक्यविजया f. (-या) A sort of hemp from which an intoxicating infu-sion, &c. is prepared.  E. त्रैलोक्य and विजय subduing; alluding to its inebriating properties.
18195: त्रैवर्गिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to the three objects of life.  E. त्रिवर्ग, and ठञ् aff. त्रिवर्गाय हितम् ।
18196: त्रैवर्णिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating or belonging to three castes, the first three.  E. त्रि, वर्ण cast, स्वार्थे ठञ् aff. त्रिषु वर्णेषु विहितः ।
18197: त्रैवार्षिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Triennial, three years old, &c.  E. त्रिवर्ष three years, aff. ठञ् । त्रिवर्षे भूतो भवति वा ठञ् ।
18198: त्रैविद्य m. (-द्यः) A scholar in the three Vedas, or one who possesses three sciences. 	 n. (-द्यं) A collection or assembly of learned Brahm-ans.  E. त्रि three, विद्या knowledge, and अण् aff.
18199: त्रैविध्य n. (-ध्यं) Three ways or kinds.  E. त्रिविध, and यञ् aff.
18200: त्रैवेदिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Scriptural, enjoined by the Vedas.  E. त्रिवेद, and ठक् aff. त्रिषु वेदेषु तदध्ययनार्थं विहितः ।
18201: त्रैष्टुभ mfn. (-भः-भी-भं) Relating to or written in the Trishtubha metre. E. त्रिष्टुभ्, and अण् aff.
18202: त्रैस्वर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) The three accents collectively.  E. त्रि, and स्वर vowel sound, स्वार्थे ष्यञ् aff.
18203: त्रैहायण n. (-णं) A period or age of three years.  E. त्रिहायण अण् affix; also read तैहायन. त्रिहायणस्य इदम् ।
18204: त्रोटक n. (-कं) 	 1. Angry speech. 	 2. A minor drama, such as the Vikra-morvasi.  E. त्रुट् to cut, ण्वुल् aff.
18205: त्रोटकी f. (-की) A Ragini or one female personifications of music.
18206: त्रोटि f. (-टिः or -टी) 	 1. The beak or bill of a bird. 	 2. A bird in general. 3. A kind of pike, (Esox kankila.) 	 4. A medicinal plant: see कट्फल. E. त्रुट् to cut, affix अच्, and fem. affix इन् or ङीप् ।
18207: त्रोटिहस्त m. (-स्तः) A bird in general.  E. त्रोटि a beak, and हस्त a hand.
18208: त्रोत्र n. (-त्रं) 	 1. A goad. 	 2. A weapon.  E. त्रै to preserve, उत्र Unadi aff.
18209: त्रौक (ऋ) त्रौकृ r. 10th cl. (त्रौकयते) To go, to move. चुरा० आ० सक० सेट् ।
18210: त्र्यंश m. (-शः) Three-fourths, three shares.  E. त्रि, and अंश part.
18211: त्र्यक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) Tri-ocular. 	 m. (-क्षः) A name of SIVA.  E. त्रि three, अक्षि an eye, अच् substituted for the final: see त्रिदृश् ।
18212: त्र्यक्षर m. (-रः) 	 1. A genealogist, the Ghataka or person whose business it is to form alliances. 	 2. A word, &c. of three letters.  E. त्रि three, and अक्षर a letter.
18213: त्र्यङ्गट mn. (-टः-टं) 	 1. A sling or three strings like those of a balance, suspended to either end of a pole for the purpose of carrying burthens. 	 2. A sort of collyrium. 	 m. (-टः) A name of SIVA.  E. त्रि three, अङ्ग body, and अट what goes, deriv. irr.
18214: त्र्यञ्जन n. (-नं) Combination of three, or Kalanjana, Pushpanjana, and Karanjana collyria.  E. त्रि, and अञ्जन a collyrium.
18215: त्र्यधिष्ठान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Situate in or affected by three places, (as body, mind, speech.)  E. त्रि, and अधिष्ठान site.
18216: त्र्यध्वगा f. (-गा) A name of the Ganges.  E. त्रि three, अध्व a road, and ग what goes; going through the three worlds.
18217: त्र्यब्द n. (-ब्दं) A period of three years.  E. त्रि, and अब्द a year.
18218: त्र्यम्बक m. (-कः) A name of SIVA.  E. त्रि three, (the three Vedas,) अबि to speak or sound, and कन् added; or त्रि may mean the three letters, अ, उ, म, combined in the mystical word ओम् ।
18219: त्र्यम्बकसख m. (-खः) KUVERA the god of wealth.  E. त्र्यम्बक SIVA, and सखि a friend.
18220: त्र्यवर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Having three inferiors or followers.  E. त्रि, and अवर inferior.
18221: त्र्यसरेणु m. (-णुः) A grass atom, one composed of three subtle atoms: see त्रसरेणु.
18222: त्र्यस्र n. (-स्रं) A triangle.  E. त्रि, and अस्र an angle.
18223: त्र्यह n. (-हं) Three days collectively.  E. त्रि, and अहन् a day.
18224: त्र्यहस्पर्श n. (-र्शं) Meeting of three lunations in one solar day.  E. त्र्यह, and स्पर्श contact; also त्र्यहस्पृश् m. (-स्पृक्) and त्र्यहस्पृश.
18225: त्र्यहैहिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Providing for three days.  E. त्र्यह, and ऐहिक who makes an effort for.
18226: त्र्याहिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Produced or performed, &c. in three days. 2. Quartan, (fever.)  E. त्रि, and आहिक diurnal.
18227: त्र्युषण n. (-णं) The three spices collectively, or black pepper, long pep-per, and dry ginger.  E. त्रि three, and उषण a spice or pungent sub-stance; also with ऊषण the same, त्र्यूषण, n. (-णं) ।
18228: त्व mfn. (-त्वः-त्वा-त्वं) Other, different.  E. तन् to divide or spread, and व substituted for the final letter of the radical.
18229: त्वक्कूण्डुर m. (-रः) A sore or wound.  E. त्वक् the skin, कण्डु itching or irritation, and र what excites.
18230: त्वक्क्षीरा f. (-रा) The manna of the bamboo.  E. त्वच् the bark of the bam-boo, and क्षीर milk; also with ङीप् affix, त्वक्क्षीरी.
18231: त्वक्छद m. (-दः) A plant, commonly Kshirakanchuki.  E. त्वक् bark, and छद a leaf.
18232: त्वक्छेद m. (-दः) A cut, a scratch.  E. त्वक्, and छेद a cut.
18233: त्वक्त्र n. (-क्त्रं) Armour.  E. त्वक् and त्र what preserves.
18234: त्वक्पत्र n. (-त्रं) Woody cassia. 	 f. (-त्री) A medicinal and vegetable sub-stances: see हिङ्गुपत्री.  E. त्वक् bark, and पत्र a leaf.
18235: त्वक्परिपुटन n. (-नं) Desquamation, pealing of the skin.  E. त्वक्, and परि-पुटन pealing.
18236: त्वक्पुष्प n. (-ष्पं) Erection of the hairs of the body, horripilation.
18237: त्वक्पुष्प nf. (-ष्पं-ष्पी) Blotch, scab, cutaneous eruption, &c.  E. त्वक् the skin and पुष्प a flower.
18238: त्वक्पुष्पिका f. (-का) Scab, blotch: see the preceding.  E. कन् added to त्वक्पुष्पी.
18239: त्वक्सार m. (-रः) 	 1. A bamboo. 	 2. Woody cassia. 	 f. (-रा) Bamboo manna. E. त्वक् bark, and सार essence.
18240: त्वक्सुगन्ध m. (-न्धः) An orange. 	 f. (-न्धा) A perfume, commonly Elabalu-ka.  E. त्वक् skin or rind, and मुगन्ध fragrant.
18241: त्वग्भेद m. (-दः) A flesh wound, a scratch.  E. त्वच्, and भेद breaking.
18242: त्वग्भेदक m. (-कः) A stabber, a scratcher, one who draws blood from the skin.  E. त्वच्, and भेदक who cuts.
18243: त्वक्ष (ऊ) त्वक्षू r. 1st cl. (त्वक्षति) 	 1. To pare, to make thin. 	 2. To be thin. 3. To peel, to skin. भ्वा० सक० पर० सेट् ।
18244: त्वग (इ) त्वगि r. 1st cl. (त्वंगति) To go, to move. भ्वा० पर० सक० सेट् इदित् ।
18245: त्वगङ्कुर m. (-रः) Erection of the hairs of the body.  E. त्वच् or त्वक् skin, and अङ्कुर a sprout.
18246: त्वगस्थिमात्रशेष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Reduced to a skeleton, to mere skin and bone.  E. त्वच् skin, अस्थि bone, मात्र mere, and शेष end.
18247: त्वगाक्षीरी f. (-री) The manna of the bamboo.  E. त्वक् bark, आङ् limitative, and क्षीरी milk, being of a milky colour.
18248: त्वग्गन्ध m. (-न्धः) An orange.  E. त्वच् rind, गन्ध smell.
18249: त्वग्दोष m. (-षः) Leprosy.  E. त्वक्, and दोष fault.
18250: त्वग्रोग m. (-गः) 	 1. Leprosy. 	 2. Any cutaneous disease.  E. त्वच्, and रोग disease.
18251: त्वङ्कार n. (-रं) The expression, ‘thou.’  E. त्व, and कार making.
18252: त्वङ्मय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of bark or skin.  E. त्वक् skin, and मयट् aff.
18253: त्वच r. 6th cl. (त्वचति) To cover, to clothe, to invest. तुदा-पर-सक-सेट् ।
18254: त्वच् f. (त्वक्) 	 1. Skin. 	 2. Bark, rind, peel, &c. 	 3. Woody cassia.  E. तन् to spread, to encircle or cover, Unadi affix चिक्, and व substituted for the final letters of the radical; also अच् being added त्वच and त्वचा.
18255: त्वच nf. (-चं-चा) 	 1. Skin. 	 2. Bark, rind. 	 3. Woody cassia: see the preceding.
18256: त्वचापत्र n. (-त्रं) Woody cassia.  E. त्वचा bark, and पत्र a leaf; also त्वक्पत्र.
18257: त्वचिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Having abundant skin or bark. त्वच्, skin, इष्ठन् affix of the superlative; also with ईयसुन् and त्वचीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) ।
18258: त्वचिसार m. (-रः) A bamboo.  E. त्वचि seventh case of त्वच् the bark, and सार strength, pith; also त्वक्सार ।
18259: त्वचिसुगन्धा f. (-न्धा) Small cardamoms.  E. त्वचि in the bark, सुगन्ध fragrance.
18260: त्वञ्च (उ) तञ्चु r. 1st cl. (त्वञ्चति) To go, move.  E. भ्वा-पर-सक-सेट् ।
18261: त्वत् mfn. (त्वत्) Other, different: see त्व.
18262: त्वत्क mfn. (-त्कः-त्का-त्कं) Thine, your.  E. त्वत् thine, and कन् added.
18263: त्वदीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Thine.  E. त्वत् from त्वं thou, and ईय added.
18264: त्वर (ञि आ) ञित्वरा r. 1st cl. (त्वरते) To hurry, to make haste, to go or move with speed, to do any thing readily or precipitately. भ्वा-आ-अक-सेट् ।
18265: त्वरण n. (-णं) Making haste, speed, velocity.  E. त्वर् to haste, and ल्युट्. aff.
18266: त्वरमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Hastening, making haste, going speedily. E. त्वर् to be quick, शानच् aff.

18370: दण्डन n. (-नं) Punishing, inflicting punishment.  E. दण्ड to tame, ल्युट् aff.
18371: दण्डनायक m. (-कः) 	 1. General, a commander-in-chief. 	 2. A magistrate, a head police officer.  E. दण्ड a column of troops, and नायक a leader.
18372: दण्डनीति f. (-तिः) Polity, the system of civil and military administration taught by CHANAKYA and others.  E. दण्ड (by) punishment or sub-jection, नी to get or obtain, and क्तिच् aff.
18373: दण्डनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Punishable, deserving punishment.  E. दण्ड to punish, अनीयर् aff.
18374: दण्डनीयत्व n. (-त्वं) Demerit, desert of punishment.  E. त्व added to the last; also with तल्, दण्डनीयता ।
18375: दण्डपांशुल m. (-लः) A porter, a warder or door-keeper.  E. दण्ड a staff, पा to cherish or bear, affix ड, दण्डपः again, अंशुल for अंशल strong, sturdy.
18376: दण्डपाणि m. (-णिः) 	 1. YAMA. 	 2. A staff-bearer. 	 3. One of SIVA'S atten-dants worshipped at Benares.  E. दण्ड, and पाणि a hand.
18377: दण्डपातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) Awarding punishment, fining.  E. दण्ड, punishment and पातिन् causing.
18378: दण्डपारुष्य n. (-ष्यं) 	 1. Assault and battery, a title of jurisprudence. 	 2. Infliction of cruel punishment, one of the seven vices of kings and rulers.  E. दण्ड punishment, पारुष्य severity.
18379: दण्डपाल m. (-लः) 	 1. A door-keeper, a porter. 	 2. A small kind of fish, (Cyprinus danrica, HAM.) See अर्द्धसफर.  E. दण्ड a staff, &c. and पाल who cherishes. दण्डं देहं पालयति भक्षणात् पालि-अण् ।
18380: दण्डपालक m. (-कः) 	 1. A sort of fish: see the preceding, which it is supposed to resemble. 	 2. A door-keeper.  E. कन् implying likeness, or pleonastic added.
18381: दण्डपाशिक m. (-कः) A hangman, an executioner.  E. दण्ड, and पाश a noose, ठक् aff.
18382: दण्डप्रणयन n. (-नं) Inflicting punishment.  E. दण्ड, and प्रणयन leading.
18383: दण्डभीति f. (-तिः) Fear of punishment.  E. दण्ड, and भीति fear.
18384: दण्डभृत् mfn. (-भृत्) 	 1. Having a staff or stick. 	 2. Inflicting punishment. m. (-भृत्) 	 1. A potter. 	 2. An epithet of Yama.  E. दण्ड the stick or handle of his wheel, and भृत् who possesses or works with.
18385: दण्डमानव m. (-वः) 	 1. An ascetic, one who used a staff. 	 2. A leader. E. दण्ड, and मानव a man.
18386: दण्डयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Punishing, amercing, chastising.  E. दण्ड to punish, शतृ aff.
18387: दण्डयात्रा f. (-त्रा) 	 1. Subjection or conquest of a region or quarter. 	 2. A bridal procession. 	 3. Procession, moving in state or with attend-ants.  E. दण्ड punishment, &c. and यात्रा going.
18388: दण्डयाम m. (-मः) 	 1. A name of YAMA. 	 2. The saint AGASTYA. 	 3. A day.  E. दण्ड punishment, &c. यम् to refrain, in the causal form, and घञ् aff. दण्डेन यच्छति यम वा कर्त्तरि यम घञ् ।
18389: दण्डयोग n. (-गं) Infliction of punishment.  E. दण्ड, and योग application.
18390: दण्डलेश n. (-शं) A small fine.  E. दण्ड, and लेश a little.
18391: दण्डवत् ind. Prostrate, falling or lying prostrate.  E. दण्ड a stick, and वति aff.
18392: दण्डवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having a stick, carrying a staff.  E. दण्ड, and मतुप् aff.
18393: दण्डवादिन् m. (-दी) 	 1. A door-keeper or a warder. 	 2. One who threatens another with punishment or castigation.  E. दण्ड castigation, and वद् to speak, to threaten, affix णिनि.
18394: दण्डवालधि m. (-धिः) An elephant.  E. दण्ड a stick, and वालधि a tail.
18395: दण्डवासिन् m. (-सी) 	 1. A door-keeper, a warder, a chamberlain. 	 2. The magistrate or the head of a village.  E. दण्ड a staff or mace, or punishment, &c. वस् to abide, affix णिनि ।
18396: दण्डविकल्प m. (-ल्पः) Appropriate punishment or sentence.  E. दण्ड, and विकल्प alternative.
18397: दण्डविधि f. (-धिः) Criminal law, mode of punishment.  E. दण्ड, and विधि rule.
18398: दण्डविशेष m. (-षः) Kind or degree of punishment.  E. दण्ड, and विशेष sort.
18399: दण्डविष्कम्भ m. (-म्भः) A post or stake, round which plays the string that works the churning stick.  E. दण्ड a stick, स्कम्भ to stop, with वि pre-fixed, and अण् aff. दण्डं मन्थानदण्डं विष्कभ्राति । (घोलमयार खुंँटि) ।
18400: दण्डहस्त m. (-स्तः) 	 1. A staff-bearer. 	 2. A door-keeper. 	 n. (-स्तं) A tree, (Tabernæmontana coronaria.)  E. दण्ड, and हस्त the hand.
18401: दण्डाजिन n. (-नं) Deceit, fraud, cheating, roguery.
18402: दण्डादण्डि ind. Single stick, cudgelling, fighting with sticks or staves. E. दण्ड a stick, repeated, with आ inserted, and इच् added.
18403: दण्डार m. (-रः) 	 1. A carriage, a vehicle. 	 2. A potter's wheel. 	 3. A bow or any instrument for casting arrows or darts. 	 4. An elephant in rut, a furious or intoxicated elephant.  E. दण्ड a stick, ऋ to go, and अण् aff. दण्डं ऋच्छति ।
18404: दण्डाहत m. (-तः) Buttermilk.  E. दण्ड a churning stick, and आहत struck, churned.
18405: दण्डिक m. (-कः) 	 1. A mace-bearer, &c. one carrying a stick or staff. 	 2. A fish, (Cyprinus dankena, HAM.)  E. दण्ड a staff, and ठन् aff.
18406: दण्डिका f. (-का) 	 1. A kind of necklace. 	 2. A string.  E. दण्ड a measure, and इकन् aff.
18407: दण्डित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Punished, chastised, sentenced, fined.  E. दण्ड to punish, affix क्त.
18408: दण्डिन् mfn. (-ण्डी-ण्डिनी-ण्डि) Having a staff or stick. 	 m. (-ण्डी) 	 1. A door-keeper, a warder, a porter, a staff or mace-bearer. 	 2. A name of YAMA. 	 3. A man of the fourth order or beggar. 	 4. A mendicant carrying a staff. 	 5. A mendicant of a particular order, derived from SANKARACHARYA. 	 6. A Jina or Jaina saint.  E. दण्ड a staff, &c. and इनि aff.
18409: दण्डोत्पला f. (-ला) A small shrub; also सहदेवा । मत्स्यभेदे च ।
18410: दण्ड्य mfn. (-ण्ड्यः-ण्ड्या-ण्ड्यं) Punishable, deserving punishment.  E. दण्ड punishment, and कर्मणि यत् affix implying fitness.
18411: दत् m. (-दन्तः-दन्तौ-दन्तः) 2nd case plu. (दतः) A tooth: see दन्त; the nasal is dropped after the 2nd case.  E. दम् to subdue, affix डत्.
18412: दत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 	 1. Given, presented, made over, assigned. 	 2. Preserved, guarded, protected. 	 m. (-त्तः) 	 1. The name of a king. 	 2. A saint; also दत्तात्रेय. 	 3. A common surname or title of a man of the Vaisya or third tribe, at present common to the Kayeth class. 	 n. (-त्तं) A gift, a donation.  E. दा to give, affix कर्मणि क्त.
18413: दत्तक m. (-कः) A son given: see the next.  E. कन् added to the last.
18414: दत्तकपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) A son given away by his natural parents, to persons engaging to adopt him; one of the twelve heirs acknowledged by the old Hindu law.  E. दत्तक, and पुत्त्र a son; also simply दत्तक, and sometimes दत्त्रिम.
18415: दत्तवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Gave, was giving.  E. दा to give, क्तवतु aff.
18416: दत्तशुल्का f. (-ल्का) A bride for whom a sum of money has been paid to her father.  E. दत्त, and शुल्क dower.
18417: दत्तात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Self-given. 	 m. (-त्मा) A youth or orphan, who gives himself to persons disposed to take the place of parents. E. दत्त given, and आत्मन् self.
18418: दत्तात्रेय m. (-यः) A sage, the son of ATRI given to him by three deities BRAMHA, VISHNU and SIVA.  E. दत्त, and आत्रेय son of ATRI: also दत्त.
18419: दत्तादत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Given and received.  E. दत्त, and आदत्त taken.
18420: दत्तादर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Treated with respect.  E. दत्त, and आदर respect.
18421: दत्तानपकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Nonresumption of gifts.  E. दत्त a gift, अन for अ neg. before अपकर्म्मन् resuming.
18422: दत्तापहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Given and taken again.  E. दत्त, and अपहृत taken back.
18423: दत्ताप्रदानिक n. (-कं) Resumption of gifts; one of the eighteen titles of law.  E. दत्त, and अप्रदानिक not giving.
18424: दत्तावधान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Attentive.  E. दत्त and अवधान attention.
18425: दत्तासन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Having a seat given, requested to sit.  E. दत्त, and आसन a seat.
18426: दत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Gift, donation.  E. दा to give, क्तिन् aff.
18427: दत्त्रिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 	 1. Given. 	 2. Produced or effected by gifts. 	 m. (-मः) 1. A slave who is given by another. 	 2. A son given by his parents. E. दा to give, क्त्रिम aff.
18429: दत्त्वा ind. Having given.  E. दा to give, क्त्वाच् aff.
18430: दद r. 1st cl. (ददते) 	 1. To give. 	 2. To relinquish. भ्वा० आ० सक० सेट् ।
18431: ददत् mfn. (-दन्-दती-दत्) Giving.  E. दा to give, शतृ aff.
18432: दद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Who gives or bestows.  E. दद to give, and श aff.
18433: ददन n. (-नं) Gift, giving, donation.  E. दद to give, affix भावे ल्युट् ।
18434: ददि mfn. (-दिः-दिः-दि) Who or what gives or bestows.  E. दा to give, कि aff.
18435: ददिवस् mfn. (-वान्-दुषी-वः) Giving, who or what gives.  E. दा to give, वसु aff.
18436: ददृत् mfn. (-दृत्) Fearful, alarmed.  E. दॄ to fear, क्विप् affix, and the radi-cal vowel made short.
18437: ददृशिवस् mfn. (-वान्-शुषी-वः) Seeing, looking.  E. दृश् to see, वसु affix, इट् inserted.
18438: ददृश्वस् mfn. (-श्वान्-शुषी-श्वः) Seeing, looking.  E. दृश् to see, वसु aff.
18439: दद्रु m. (-द्रुः) Cutaneous and herpetick eruptions; also दद्रूः or with कन् added दद्रुक m. (-कः).
18440: दद्रुघ्न m. (-घ्नः) A kind of cassia, (C. tora.)  E. दद्रु herpes, and घ्न destroy-ing, remedying; also दद्रूघ्न । हन्ति हन-टक् ।
18441: दद्रण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Herpetick, afflicted with herpes.  E. दद्रु, and न affix; also दद्रूण.
18442: दद्रुरोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि) Herpetick, diseased by herpes.  E. दद्रु herpes, रोग a disease, and इनि aff.
18443: दद्रू m. (-द्रूः) Herpetick eruptions: see दद्रु.
18446: दध r. 1st cl. (दधते) 	 1. To hold, to possess or retain. 	 2. To give, to present, to assign or make over. (इ) दधि (दन्धति) To nourish. भ्वा० आ० सक० सेट् ।
18447: दध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Who has or possesses.  E. धा to have, श aff.
18448: दधत् mfn. (-धन्-धती-धत्) Having, holding, possessing.  E. धा to have, शतृ aff.
18449: दधान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Having, holding, possessing.  E. धा to have, शानच् aff.
18450: दधि mfn. (-धिः-धिः-धि) Holding, having, who or what has or possesses. n. (-धि) 	 1. Milk curdled or coagulated spontaneously by heat, or by the addition of buttermilk; it is an article of food of general use, and is held in high estimation amongst the Hindus, and is con-sidered, medicinally, as the remedy or preventative of most disorders. 	 2. Resin, turpentine; (all the synonimes are common to these two senses.) 	 3. A house, an abode.  E. धा to have, कि affix, and the root reiterated.
18451: दधिकूर्च्चिका f. (-का) A mixture of boiled and coagulated milk, or of water and sour curds.  E. दधि as above, and कूर्च्चिका inspissated milk. (छाना) ।
18452: दधिचार m. (-रः) The churning stick.  E. दधि curdled milk, and चर् to move, in the causal form, affix णिच् अण् ।
18453: दधिज n. (-जं) Fresh butter.  E. दधि curdled milk, and ज born.
18454: दधित्थ m. (-त्थः) The wood-apple: see कपित्थ.  E. दधि, स्था to stand or be, affix ड; the root yielding a juice compared to curdled milk.
18455: दधिधेनु f. (-नुः) A quantity of curds given away at any sacrifice.  E. दधि, and धेनु a cow.
18456: दधिपुष्पिका f. (-का) A flower, (Clitorea ternata.)  E. दधि curdled milk, and पुष्प a flower, कन् added in the fem. form.
18457: दधिफल m. (-लः) The elephant or wood-apple; also दधित्थ.  E. दधि curdled milk, and फल fruit, the fruit having the acid taste of Dahi or Dadhi.
18458: दधिभाण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A vessel for holding curds, a pail.  E. दधि, and भाण्ड a vessel.
18459: दधिमण्ड m. (-ण्डः) Whey.  E. दधि, and मण्ड scum.
18460: दधिमण्डोद m. (-दः) The sea of curds, or rather of whey.  E. दधिमण्ड, and उद water.
18461: दधिशोण m. (-णः) A monkey.  E. दधि, and शोण crimson; of a colour composed of that of curdled milk and crimson.
18462: दधिसक्तु m. plu. always (-क्तवः) Barley meal mixed with curds.  E. दधि, and सक्तु the meal of barley, after frying and grinding.
18463: दधिसर m. (-रः) The skim of coagulated milk; also सर only.  E. दधि Dahi, and सर which goes on or upon.
18464: दधिसार m. (-रः) Fresh butter.  E. दधि curdled milk, and सार essence.
18465: दधिस्नेह m. (-हः) Skim of Dahi, or curdled milk whey.  E. दधि curdled milk, and स्नेह oily substance.
18466: दधिस्वेद m. (-दः) Buttermilk.  E. दधि as above, and स्वेद exudation.
18467: दधीच m. (-चः) The name of a Muni or saint, famous for having devoted himself to death, that the gods might be armed with his bones in the shape of thunderbolts; they being the only effective weapons against the demon VRITRA; also दधीचि.
18468: दधीचि m. (-चिः) A Muni or saint: see the last.
18469: दधीच्यस्थि n. (-स्थि) 	 1. The diamond. 	 2. The thunderbolt.  E. दधीचि a saint, and अस्थि a bone; the bones of the saint were converted into thunderbolts, which are of the same substance with the diamond, according to the Hindus.
18470: दधृच् mfn. (धृक्) Shameless, impudent.  E. धृष् to be vain, affix क्विन्, deriv. irr.
18471: दध्न m. (-ध्नः) A name of YAMA.  E. धा to have, reiterated, and न aff.
18472: दध्याकर m. (-रः) The sea of curds.  E. दधि, and आकर a mine.
18473: दध्यानी f. (-नी) A medicinal plant: see कटुकी.  E. दधि curdled milk, नी with आङ् prefixed, affix क्विप् ।
18474: दध्याह्व m. (-ह्वः) The wood-apple.  E. दधि, and आह्वा name.
18475: दध्युत्तर n. (-रं) The skim of curdled milk, whey.  E. दधि, and उत्तर upper part; also with कन् added दध्युत्तरक n. (-कं.)
18476: दध्युद m. (-दः) The sea of curds.  E. दधि, and उद water; that which has curds for water.
18477: दनु f. (-नुः) A daughter of DAKSHA, wife of KASYAPA, and mother of the demons or Daityas, the Titans of Hindu mythology.
18478: दनुज m. (-जः) An Asura.  E. दनु the mother of the giant race, and ज born.
18479: दनुजद्विष् m. (-द्विट्) A god, a deity.  E. दनुज a demon, and द्विष् the hater.
18480: दनुजारि m. (-रिः) A god, a deity.  E. दनुज, and अरि enemy.
18481: दनुसूनु m. (-नुः) An Asura or infernal deity.  E. दनु as above, and सूनु off-spring; also similar compounds, as दनुज, &c.
18482: दन्त m. (-न्तः) 	 1. A tooth. 	 2. The peak of a mountain. 	 3. The side or ridge of a mountain. 	 4. An arbour. 	 5. Ivory, elephant's tooth. 	 f. (-न्ती) A medicinal plant, commonly known by the same name Dan-ti, (Croton polyandrum.)  E. दम् to subdue, तन् Unadi aff.
18483: दन्तक m. (-कः) 	 1. A crooked peak or projecting in a rock or mountain. 2. A bracket, a pin or shelf projection from a wall. 	 3. A tooth. कन् implying resemblance, added to दन्त ।
18484: दन्तकर्षण m. (-णः) The common lime, (Citrus acida.)  E. दन्त a tooth, and कर्षण attracting, drawing.
18485: दन्तकाष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) A piece of stick, or of the small branch of a tree used as a tooth brush.  E. दन्त, and काष्ठ wood.
18486: दन्तच्छद m. (-दः) A lip.  E. दन्त a tooth, and छद a cover.
18487: दन्तजात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Toothed, having teeth.  E. दन्त, and जात produced.
18488: दन्तधावन n. (-नं) 	 1. A tooth brush, or a fibrous stick used for cleaning the teeth. 	 2. Cleaning the teeth. 	 m. (-नः) 	 1. A tree yielding an astringent resin, (Mimosa catechu.) 	 2. A plant, (Mimusops elengi) see वकुल.  E. दन्त a tooth, and धाव् to clean, affix ल्युट् ।
18489: दन्तपत्र n. (-त्रः) An ear-ring.  E. दन्त a tooth, and पत्र a leaf or plate set with studs, resembling teeth.
18490: दन्तपत्रक n. (-कं) A kind of jasmine, (J. pubescens.)  E. दन्त a tooth, and पत्र a leaf: the petals or leaves of the flower resembling teeth in colour and shape; this comparison is frequent among the poets.
18491: दन्तपवन n. (-नं) A dentifrice, or any thing taken to clean the teeth. E. दन्त, and पवन purifying. दन्तं पुनाति अनेन पू करणे ल्युट् ।
18493: दन्तपुष्प m. (-प्पः) A plant, the flower of which is compared to a tooth, (Strychnos potatorum.)  E. दन्त a tooth, and पुप्प a flower. कुन्दे ।

18755: दाक्ष्य n. (-क्ष्यं) Cleverness, dexterity, ability.  E. दक्ष, and ष्यञ् aff.
18756: दाडक m. (-कः) A tooth, a tusk.

18758: दाडिमपुष्पक m. (-कः) A medicinal plant, (Andersonia rohitaka.) E. दाडिम as above, पुष्प a flower, and कन् affix of resemblance; bearing flowers like those of the pomegranate.

18770: दातृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) A donor, a giver, giving, bestowing.  E. दा to give, तृच् aff.

18857: दार्व्वट n. (-टं) A court or council-house.  E. दारु timber, and अट् to go or be, affix अच् । दारु इव निश्चलतया निरुपणीयविषयनिश्चयार्थम् अटन्ति अत्र अट-घञर्थे क ।
18858: दार्व्वण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A peacock.  E. दारु wood, and अण्ड an egg. दारु इव कठिनः अण्डोऽस्य । मयूरे ।

18860: दार्व्वाघात m. (-तः) The wood-pecker: see the preceding.

18862: दार्व्विपत्रिका f. (-का) Gojihwa, a sort of wild potherb.  E. दार्व्वी Curcuma, पत्र a leaf, and ठन् aff. दार्व्व्या दारुहरिद्रायाः पत्रमिव पत्रमस्ति अस्याः ।

18864: दार्षद mfn. (-दः-दी-दं) 	 1. Ground on a flat stone, (meal, &c.) 	 2. Stony, of stone, mineral.  E. दृषद् a stone or slab on which condiments are prepared, affix अण् ।
18865: दाल n. (-लं) Wild or unprepared honey. 	 m. (-लः) A sort of grain, (Pas-palum frumentaceum.) 	 f. (-ला) Colocynth.  E. दल a sheath, affix अण्.
18866: दालन n. (-नं) Toothache.  E. दल् to tear, causal v. णिच् and ल्यु affs.

18870: दाव m. (-वः) 	 1. A forest. 	 2. A forest on fire. 	 3. Fire in general. 	 4. Heat.  E. दु to go or run, affix कर्त्तरि णः see दव ।

18875: दाश m. (-शः) 	 1. A fisherman, the son of a Nishada by a woman of the Ayogava caste. 	 2. A servant. 	 f. (-शी) 	 1. A female slave, &c.  E. दाशृ to give, affix घञ् । see दास ।
18876: दाशनन्दिनी f. (-नी) The mother of VYASA: see दासनन्दिनी ।
18877: दाशपुर n. (-रं) A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus:) see दशपुर; also दाशपूर, n. (-रं).
18878: दाशरथ m. (-थः) A name of RAMA.  E. दशरथ the father of RAMA, and अण् patronymic affix; also with इञ् affix दाशरथि m. (-थिः) ।
18879: दाशार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्ही-र्हं) Produced in Dasarha, (the country.) 	 m. (-र्हः) A name of KRISHNA.  E. दशार्ह a country or one of KRISHNA'S an-cestors, अण् aff.
18880: दाशेय m. (-यः) A servant. 	 f. (-यी) The mother of VYASA: see दासेय. E. दाश्या धीवर्य्या अपत्यम् ढक् ।
18881: दाशेर m. (-रः) 	 1. A servant. 	 2. A camel: see दासेर.  E. दास्या अपत्यम् ढ्रक् ।
18882: दाशेरक m. (-कः) Malwa, the province. दाशेरकप्रधानः देशः संज्ञायां कन् ।
18883: दाश्व mfn. (-श्वः-श्वा-श्वं) Liberal, giving, a doner, a giver.  E. दाश to give, वन् aff.
18884: दाश्वत् mfn. (-श्वन्-श्वती-श्वत्) Liberal, munificent.  E. दा to give, श्वत् aff.
18885: दास (ऋ) दासृ r. 1st cl. (दासति-ते) To give; also दाश r. 5th cl. (दास्नोति) To hurt, to injure, to wound or kill: this and दाश, in the last sense, are restricted by some authorities to the Vedas. भ्वा० उभ० सक० सेट् । स्वा० पर० ।

E. दास् to give, affix घञ्, to whom wages, &c. are given; also दाश; otherwise, दश or दंश to bite, &c. Unadi affix ठन्, and the short vowel and nasal changed to आ ।
18887: दासत्व n. (-त्वं) Slavery, servitude.  E. दास, and त्व affix,; also with तल् affix, दासता ।
18888: दासनन्दिनी f. (-नी) A name of SATYAVATI, the mother of the poet VYASA.  E. दास a fisherman, and नन्दिनी daughter; also दाशनन्दिनी ।
18889: दासदासी f. (-सी) The female slave of a slave.  E. दास, and दासी the female.
18890: दासपूर n. (-रं) A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.)  E. दास a fisher-man, and पूर what nourishes, from पृ to nourish, affix क also दाशपूर ।
18891: दासिका f. (-का) A female servant or slave.  E. कन् added to दासी.
18892: दासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Thrown, lost. 	 2. Lost, destroyed.  E. दस् to toss, affix क्त, इट् inserted, and the vowel made long.
18893: दासीपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) 	 1. The son of a slave. 	 2. A bastard.  E. दासी a female slave, and पुत्त्र a son.

18896: दासेर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Born or sprung from a servant or slave. 	 m. (-रः) 1. A servant. 	 2. A fisherman. 	 3. A camel.  E. दास as above, and ढ्रक् affix; also दाशेर, or with कन् added दासेरक ।
18897: दास्य n. (-स्यं) Slavery, servitude.  E. दास a slave, affix ष्यञ् ।

18899: दाहक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Burning, inflammatory. 	 3. Cauterising, caus-tic. 	 m. (-कः) A plant, (Plumbago zeylanica.)  E. दह् to burn, and ण्वुल् aff.

18901: दाहन n. (-नं) 	 1. Burning, reducing to ashes. 	 2. Cauterising.  E. दह् to burn. ल्युट् aff.
18902: दाहवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Burning, heated on fire.  E. दाह, and मतुप् aff.

18905: दाह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) To be burnt, inflammable.  E. दह् to burn, ण्यत् aff.

18909: दिक्पाल m. (-लः) A regent of a quarter of the universe, INDRA of the east; AGNI of the south-east; Yama of the south; NAIRRIT of the south-west; VARUNA of the west; MARUTA of the north-west; KUVERA of the north; ISANA of the south-east. 18911: दिगन्त m. (-न्तः) The horizon.  E. दिक्, and अन्त end.

E. दिक् inflection of दिश् space, अम्बर vestment; whose only garment is the atmosphere. दिक् शून्य-मम्बरं यस्य ।
18915: दिग्गज m. (-जः) An elephant of a quarter or point of the compass, one of eight attached to the north, north-east, &c. supporting the globe.  E. दिश् a quarter, and गज an elephant.
18916: दिग्दाह m. (-हः) Preternatural redness of the horizon, as if on fire. E. दिश्, and दाह burning.
18917: दिग्ध mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं) Smeared, anointed. 	 m. (-ग्धः) 	 1. A poison-ed arrow. 	 2. A name of fire. 	 3. Oil, unguent, oily substance. 4. A tale, true or false.  E. दिह् to smear or anoint, affix क्त ।
18918: दिग्वासस् mfn. (-साः-साः-सः) Naked. 	 m. (-साः) A name of SIVA.  E. दिक् for दिश् space, and वासस् vesture: see दिगम्बर ।
18919: दिग्विजय m. (-यः) Subjugation of an extensive country, either in arms or controversy.  E. दिश्, and विजय triumph.
18920: दिग्विजयक्रम m. (-मः) Invasion, going forth to conquer the world. E. दिग्विजय, and क्रम march.
18921: दिग्विभाग m. (-गः) A quarter or point of the compass.  E. दिक्, and विभाग division.
18922: दिग्विभावित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Famous, celebrated, known in all quarters. E. दिक्, and विभावित made known.
18923: दिग्व्यापिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) Spreading through all space.  E. दिक्, and व्यापिन् what pervades.
18925: दिङ्मण्डल n. (-लं) The circle of the heaven, or any point of the compass. E. दिश्, and मण्डल sphere.
18926: दिङ्मुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Looking to, or facing any point or quarter. 	 n. (-खं) Any part of the heavens.  E. दिश्, and मुख face.
18927: दिङ्नाग m. (-गः) An elephant of the quarter: see दिग्गज.
18928: दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cut, torn, divided.  E. दी to cut, affix क्त.
18929: दिति f. (-तिः) 	 1. One of the wives of KASYAPA, and mother of the Dai-tyas or infernal race, opposer of the gods. 	 2. Cutting, splitting, dividing. 	 m. (-तिः) A king, a prince.  E. दो to cut, affix क्तिच् ।
18930: दितिज m. (-जः) An Asura, a sort of Titan or giant.  E. दिति as above, and ज born.
18931: दितिसूत m. (-तः) 	 1. Titan or giant.  E. दिति as above, and सुत a son.
18932: दित्य m. (-त्यः) 	 1. Titan, a demon or giant.  E. दिति as above, affix यत्, and the vowel unchanged: see दैत्य ।
18933: दित्सा f. (त्सा) Desire or purpose to give.  E. दा to give, desid. form, अ and टाप् affs.
18934: दित्सु mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु) Wishing to give.  E. दा to give, desid. form, affs. सन् and उ ।
18935: दिदृक्षमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Wishing to see.  E. दृश् to see, desid. form, शानच् aff.
18936: दिदृक्षा f. (-क्षा) Desire or wish to see.  E. दृश् to see, desid. form, सन् भावे अ and टाप् affs.
18937: दिदृक्षु mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु) Desirous of seeing.  E. दृश् to see, desid. form, सन् and उ affs.
18938: दिदृक्षावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Wishing to see.  E. दिदृक्षा, and मतुप् aff.
18939: दिदेविषत् mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्) Wishing to play or sport.  E. दिव् to play, desid. form, शतृ aff.
18940: दिद्युत् mfn. (-द्युत्) Shining, blazing, bright.  E. द्यु to shine, शतृ affix, intens. form.
18941: दिद्योतिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to shine.  E. द्यू to shine, desid. form, उ aff.
18942: दिधक्षमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Wishing to burn.  E. दह to burn, desid. v. शानच् aff.

18945: दिधिषाय्य m. (-य्यः) A pretended friend, an intimate.  E. धा to have, Unadi affix आय्य, the root reduplicated, इट् and षुक् augments.
18946: दिधिषु m. (-षुः) The second husband of a woman twice married. 	 f. (-षुः) A virgin widow remarried.  E. धा to have (sin), or धिष् to be re-proached, root reduplicate, affix कु or कू; in the first case, इट् and षुक् augments; also दिधिषू.

The husband of a woman married a second time: see दिधिषु. 2. Instability, want of firmness.  E. दिधि firmness, षो to abandon, कू Unadi aff.
18948: दिधिषुपति m. (-तिः) The husband of a woman remarried.  E. दिधिषू as above, and पति a husband.
18949: दिन mn. (-नः-नं) A day.  E. दी to waste, नक् affix, and the vowel made short; or दो to destroy, (darkness,) किनन् Unadi aff.
18950: दिनकर m. (-रः) The sun.  E. दिन day, and कर who makes, कृ-ट ।
