18952: दिनकृत् m. (-कृत्) The sun.  E. दिन, and कृत् who makes.
18953: दिनकेशव m. (-वः) Darkness.  E. दिन day, and केशव hair.
18954: दिनज्योतिस् n. (-तिः) Sunshine, day-light.  E. दिन day, and ज्योतिस् night.
18955: दिनदुःखित m. (-तः) The ruddy goose.  E. दिन day, and दुःखित pained; regretting throughout the day, the approaching nocturnal separa-tion from its female.
18956: दिनप्रणी m. (-णीः) The sun.  E. दिन day, and प्रणी leading, bringing.
18957: दिनबल m. (-लः) A name of certain signs of the zodiac, the fifth to the eighth; also the eleventh and twelfth.  E. दिन, and बल strong.
18958: दिनमणि m. (-णिः) The sun.  E. दिन day, and मणि jewel or gem.
18959: दिनमूर्द्धन् m. (-र्द्धा) The eastern mountain, behind which the sun is sup-posed to rise.  E. दिन day, and मूर्द्धन् the forehead.
18960: दिनांश m. (-शः) A portion of the day, a watch, an hour, or the three seasons of dawn, moon, and evening.  E. दिन and अंश part or portion.
18961: दिनादि m. (-दिः) Dawn, day-break.  E. दिन, and आदि commencement.
18962: दिनान्त m. (-न्तः) Evening, sun-set, close of day.  E. दिन day, and अन्त end.
18963: दिनान्तक m. (-कः) Darkness.  E. दिन day, and अन्तक ender.
18964: दिनारम्भ m. (-म्भः) Morning.  E. दिन, and आरम्भ beginning.
18965: दिनावसान n. (-नं) Evening, close of day.  E. दिन day, and अवसान expiration.
18966: दिनिका f. (-का) A day's wages, hire for a day or by the day.  E. दिन a day, and ठक् aff.
18967: दिभ (इ) दिभि r. 10th cl. (दिम्भयति-ते) To order, to direct. चुरा० उभ० सक० सेट् इदित् ।
18968: दिम्प r. 1st and 10th cls. (दिम्पति-ते दिम्पयति-ते) To order, to command. भ्वा० उभ० । चुरा० उभ० सक० सेट् ।
18969: दिम्भ r. 10th cl. (दिम्भयति-ते) 	 1. To command, to direct. 	 2. To collect.
18970: दिलीप m. (-पः) The name of a king and ancestor of RAMA.  E. दिली said to be the barbarous name of Hastinapur of the modern Dehli, and प who protects or rules.
18971: दिलीपराज् m. (-राट्) King DILIPA: see the preceding.  E. दिलीप as above, and राज् a king.
18973: दिव (उ) दिवु r. 4th cl. (दीव्यति) 	 1. To play, to sport, to play with, to romp or gambol. 	 2. To desire, to overcome, to be ambitious of surpassing, &c. 	 3. To deal, to traffic, to buy or sell. 	 4. To shine, to be splendid or beautiful. 	 5. To praise. 	 6. To be glad, to rejoice. 7. To be mad, to be wild or inflated with pride, passion, &c. 	 8. To be sleepy or sluggish. 	 9. To love, to desire. 	 10. To go. r. 10th cl. (देवयति-ते) 	 1. To suffer pain. 	 2. To ask, to beseech or beg. 	 3. To move, to go. 	 4. (-ति-ते) To lament, to wail, to mourn audibly. (इ) दिवि r. 1st cl. (दन्वति) 	 1. To please. 	 2. To be pleased. जिगीषायां व्रीडायां च अक० पणे व्यवहारे, इच्छायां स्तुतौ च सक० दिवा० पर० सेट् । चुरा० कूजने आत्मने० सक० सेट् । अर्दे चुरा० उभ० सक० सेट् । प्रीतौ भ्वा० पर० सक० सेट् इदित् ।
18974: दिव् f. (द्यौः दिवौ दिवः) 	 1. Heaven, paradise. 	 2. Air, sky.  E. दिव् to play, affix क्विप्, where sport immortals; also दिव ।
18975: दिव n. (-वं) 	 1. Heaven, paradise. 	 2. Heaven, sky, atmosphere. 	 3. A day. 4. A wood, a thicket.  E. दिव् to play, to shine, &c. affix घञर्थे आधारे वा कः see the preceding.
18976: दिवन् m. (-वा) A day.  E. दिव् to play, Unadi affix कनिन् ।
18977: दिवस mn. (-सः-सं) A day.  E. दिव् to play, असच् Unadi aff. किच्च.
18978: दिवसकर m. (-रः) The sun.  E. दिवस day, and कर who makes.
18979: दिवसमुख n. (-खं) Dawn, day-break.  E. दिवस day, and मुख beginning.
18980: दिवसात्यय m. (-यः) Evening, close of day.  E. दिवस and अत्यय loss.
18981: दिवसावसान n. (-नं) Evening, close of day.  E. दिवस, and अवसान end.
18982: दिवस्पति m. (-तिः) A name of INDRA the Indian JOVE.  E. दिवः of day, and पति lord, Divespiter.
18983: दिवस्पृथिबी f. du. (-व्यौ) Heaven and earth.  E. दिव heaven, and पृथिवी earth, स inserted for the sake of euphony.
18984: दिबा ind. By day, the day.  E. दिव् to play, &c. affix का.
18985: दिवाकर m. (-रः) 	 1. The sun. 	 2. A crow. 	 3. A flower, the sun-flower. E. दिवा the day, and कर who makes.
18986: दिवाकीर्त्ति m. (-र्त्तिः) 	 1. A man of a low or impure caste, a Chandala. 2. A barber. 	 3. An owl.  E. दिवा by day, and कीर्त्ति credit, (the bar-ber is not allowed to operate at night,) or दिवा day, अकीर्त्ति dis-repute; the Chandala and owl coming abroad only in the dark. दिवा एव कीर्त्तिः कृत्यं यस्य रात्रौ क्षुरकर्मनिषेधात् नापिते चण्डाले पेचके च ।
18987: दिवाकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Done by day.  E. दिवा, and कृत done.
18988: दिवाचर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Going about by day.  E. दिवा, and चर who or what goes.
18989: दिवाटन m. (-नः) A crow.  E. दिवा by day, अट् to go, affix ल्यु ।
18990: दिवातन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Daily, diurnal, of or belonging to the day. E. दिवा by day, ट्यु aff. तुट् च ।
18991: दिवानिश n. (-शं) Day and night.  E. दिवा, and निशा night.
18992: दिवान्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Being blind by day. 	 m. (-न्धः) An owl.  E. दिवा by day, and अन्ध dark or blind.
18993: दिवाभीत m. (-ताः) 	 1. An owl. 	 2. A thief or house-breaker. 	 3. The white lotus (कुमुदाकर;) perhaps any such flower, the petals of which open at night, and close in the day time.  E. दिवा day, and भीत afraid.
18994: दिवाभीति m. (-तिः) An owl.  E. दिवा by day, and भीति fear: see the pre-ceding.
18995: दिवामणि m. (-णिः) The sun.  E. दिवा, and मणि a jewel.
18996: दिवामध्य n. (-ध्यं) Mid-day, noon.  E. दिवा and मध्य middle.
18997: दिवारात्र n. (-त्रं) A day and night.  E. दिवा, and रात्र for रात्रि night.
18998: दिवारात्रि f. (-त्रिः) 	 1. Day or night. 	 2. A day and night.  E. दिवा, and रात्रि night.
18999: दिवास्वप्न m. (-प्नः) A sleep by day.  E. दिवा, and स्वप्न sleep.
19000: दिवि m. (-विः) The blue jay.  E. दिव् to play, affix कि । चाष खगे ।
19001: दिविज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Celestial, heavenly, of heavenly origin. E. दिवि in heaven, and ज born. दिवि जायते जन-ड अलुक् स० ।
19002: दिविषद् m. (-द्) A deity.  E. दिवि in heaven, सद् to go, affix क्विप् ।
19003: दिविष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Celestial, heavenly, situated in heaven.  E. दिवि in heaven, and स्थ what stays.
19004: दिवी f. (-वी) A sort of insect; also उपजिह्विका.  E. दिव् to play, वा ई affix, fem. affix ङीप् ।
19005: दिवोकस् m. (-काः) 	 1. A deity. 	 2. A kind of cuckoo, the Chataka: see दिवौकस् । द्यौः स्वर्गः आकाशो वा ओको यस्य ।
19006: दिवोदास m. (-सः) DIVODASA, a king so named, king of Benares, and founder of the Indian school of medicine.  E. दिवः of heaven, दास the slave. or दिवः स्वर्गात् दासो दानं यस्मै ।
19007: दिवोद्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Born or produced in heaven. 	 f. (-वा) Cardamoms. E. दिव heaven, उद्भव born.
19008: दिवौकस् m. (-काः) 	 1. A deity. 	 2. The Chataka, (Cuculus melanoleucos.) 3. A deer. 	 4. A bee. 	 5. An elephant.  E. दिव heaven either, ओकस् a mansion; also with the vowel unaltered दिवोकस् ।
19009: दिव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 	 1. Divine, celestial. 	 2. Beautiful, agreeable, charming. 	 m. (-व्यः) 	 1. Barley. 	 2. A fragrant resin, (Bdelliun.) 	 3. 19010: दिव्यकारिन् m. (-री) One who undergoes an ordeal.  E. दिव्य, and कारिन् who makes.
19011: दिव्यगन्ध m. (-न्धः) Sulphur. 	 n. (-न्धं) Cloves. 	 f. (-धा) Large cardamoms. E. दिव्य, and गन्ध smell.
19012: दिव्यगायन m. (-नः) A Gandharba or singer of heaven.  E. दिव्य divine, and गायन a singer.
19013: दिव्यचक्षुस् mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षुः) 	 1. Beautiful-eyed. 	 2. Blind. 	 m. (-क्षुः) 	 1. A sort of perfume. 	 2. A monkey. 	 n. (-क्षुः) The faculty of seeing what is invisible by the human eye.  E. दिव्य divine, and चक्षुस् an eye. दिव्यं चक्षुः यस्मात् ५ ब० ।
19014: दिव्यदोहद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Fit for an offering or oblation.  E. दिव्य divine, and दोहद wish, that which is the subject of a deity's desires.
19015: दिव्यधर्म्मिन् mfn. (-र्म्मी-र्म्मिणी-र्म्मि) Virtuous, agreeable.  E. दिव्य, and धर्म्मिन् virtuous.
19016: दिव्यपञ्चामृत n. (-तं) A mixture of five articles, ghee, curd, milk, but-ter, and sugar.  E. दिव्य divine, पञ्च five, and अमृत ambrosia.
19017: दिव्यरत्न n. (-त्नं) The fabulous gem Chintamani.  E. दिव्य divine, and रत्न jewel.
19018: दिव्यरथ m. (-थः) The car or vehicle of any deity.  E. दिव्य divine, and रथ a carriage.
19019: दिव्यरस m. (-सः) Quicksilver.  E. दिव्य divine, and रस juice. पारदे, मनोज्ञे रसे, रुचिररसयुक्ते त्रि० ।
19020: दिव्यवस्त्र mfn. (-स्त्रः-स्त्रा-स्त्रं) 	 1. Clothed or invested in celestial raiment. 2. Handsomely dressed. 	 m. (-स्त्रः) A plant, commonly Suryasobha, a sort of sun-flower.  E. दिव्य divine, वस्त्र cloth or clothes. दिव्यं वस्त्रं यस्मात् ।
19021: दिव्यादिव्या f. (-व्या) The heroine of a poem, as SITA, &c. of mixed origin or character, a demigoddess.  E. दिव्य divine, अदिव्य not divine, partaking of both natures.
19022: दिव्योघ m. (-घः) A form of SIVA, worshipped by the Tantrikas.  E. दिव्य, and ओघ heap.
19023: दिव्योदक n. (-कं) Rain-water, dew, &c.  E. दिव्य heavenly, and उदक water.
19024: दिव्योपपादुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Divine, celestial, of heavenly birth or being.  E. दिव्य divine, पद् to go, with उप prefixed, and उकञ् aff.
19025: दिश (औ) दिशौ r. 6th cl. (दिशति-ते) 	 1. To show, to exhibit, to explain or make intelligible. 	 2. To order, to command, to direct or send. 	 3. To say, to speak. 	 4. To give. With अप prefixed, To change, to dis-guise. With आङ्, 1. To order or command. 	 2. To show. 	 3. To summon. With उद्, 1. To proclaim, to make known or public. 2. To show. With उप, To point out (literally or metaphorically), to show, to advise. With निर्, 1. To speak aloud. 	 2. To specify, to show. With प्र, To appoint, to order. With प्रति and सम्, To command, to return, to send back. With वि and अप, To plead in excuse, to state as a plea or pretext. With वि and निर्, To declare. With सम्, 1. To exhibit, to show, &c. 	 2. 19026: दिश् f. (-दिक् दिशौ दिशः) Region, space, quarter, part.  E. दिश् to show, affix क्विन्ः also with टाप् added, दिशा, f. (-शा) or with ङीप्, दिशी.
19027: दिशस् f. (-शाः) Region, quarter.  E. दिश्, and कसुन् affix: see the preceding.
19028: दिश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) Situated, bearing, lying in a particular tract or quarter, as पूर्व्वदिश्य eastern, bearing east.  E. दिश् a quarter, यत् aff.
19029: दिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Shown, pointed out. 	 2. Delineated, described. 3. Counselled, advised, enjoined. 	 m. (-ष्टः) 	 1. Time. 	 2. A sort of Curcuma: see दारुहरिद्रा. 	 n. (-ष्टं) Fate, destiny, fortune, good or ill luck.  E. दिश् to show, affix कर्मणि क्त ।
19030: दिष्टान्त m. (-न्तः) Death, dying.  E. दिष्ट fortune, and अन्त end.
19031: दिष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 	 1. Pleasure, happiness. 	 2. A sort of measure.  E. दिश् to point out, affix भावे क्तिन्, संज्ञायां कर्त्तरि क्तिच् वा ।
19032: दिष्ट्या ind. An exclamation, indicative of joy or auspiciousness, luckily, fortunately.  E. दिश् pointing out, स्त्र्यै to sound, affix भावे क्विप् ।
19033: दिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) Giving, one who gives, a donor.  E. दा to give. इष्णु Unadi affix: see देष्णु.
19034: दिह (औ) दिहौ r. 2nd cl. (देग्धि दिग्धे) 	 1. To increase, to augment, to accumulate. 	 2. To smear. अदा० उभ० सक० अनिट् ।
19035: दी r. 4th cl. (ओ ङ) ओदीङ (दीयते) To waste, to diminish, to be reduced, to decay. दिवा० आ० अक० अनिट् ।
19036: दी f. (दीः) Wasting, destruction.  E. दी to waste, क्विप् aff.
19037: दीक्ष r. 1st cl. (दीक्षते) 	 1. To be shaved. 	 2. To perform a sacrifice. 	 3. To initiate. 	 4. To teach religious observances. 	 5. To be selfres-trained भ्वा० आ० सक० सेट् ।
19038: दीक्षणीयेष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A particular sacrifice, that preceded by the Diksha; see the next.  E. दीक्षा as below, छ affix, and इष्टि a sacrifice.
19039: दीक्षा f. (-क्षा) 	 1. Sacrificing, offering oblations. 	 2. Worshipping in general. 	 3. Engaging in a course of austerities. 	 4. Certain cere-monies preliminary to a cacrifice. 	 5. 19040: दीक्षान्त m. (-न्तः) A supplementary sacrifice, one made to atone for any defects in a preceding one.  E. दीक्षा sacrifice, and अन्त completion, end.
19041: दीक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Initiated. 	 2. Performed, (as the Diksha cere-mony.) 	 3. One by whom the preparatory ceremonies have been observed. 	 m. (-तः) 	 1. 19043: दीद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Destroying.  E. दी, and द who or what gives.
19044: दौदिवि mfn. (-विः-विः-वि) Risen, ascended. 	 mn. (-विः-वि) Boiled rice. 	 m. (-विः) A name of VRIHASPATI.  E. दिव् to play, Unadi affix क्विन्, the radical reduplicate, deriv. irr.
19045: दीधिति f. (-तिः) 	 1. A ray of light, a sun or a moonbeam. 	 2. Light in general.  E. दीधी to shine, affix क्तिन्.

19048: दीनचेतन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Distressed, dejected.  E. दीन, and चेतन feeling.
19049: दीनमुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Down-cast, of melancholy aspect.  E. दीन, and मुख mouth.
19050: दीनार m. (-रः) 	 1. A gold ornament. 	 2. A seal. 	 3. 19272: दुर्ग mfn. (-र्गः-र्गा-र्गं) 	 1. Difficult of access or approach, inaccessible, im-pervious, impermeable. 	 2. Difficult of attainment, unattainable. 	 n. (-र्गं) 	 1. (-र्गः) The name of an Asura slain by DURGĀ. 	 f. (-र्गा) 	 1. The goddess DURGĀ, the wife of SIVA, and mother of KARTIKEYA, and GANESA; also called UMĀ, and PĀRVATI, &c.: as DURGĀ, she is a goddess of terrific form, and irascible temper, and particularly worshipped at the DURGĀ Pujā, held in Bengal in the month of Āswin, or about October. 	 2. The indigo plant. 	 3. A creeping shrub, (Clitotia ternata.) 4. A singing bird, the Syama.  E. दुर् bad, ill, with difficulty, गम् to go, affix ड; the etymology of goddess is thus given, दुर् with diffi-culty; गम् to be known; a knowledge of whom is obtained only by the severest austerities; or दुर् bad, गै to sing, who is especially hymned by the wicked; or दुर्ग the Asura slain by the goddess.
19273: दुर्गकर्म्म mn. (-र्म्मः-र्म्मं) Enterprize, difficult undertaking.  E. दुर्ग, and कर्म्म act.
19274: दुर्गकारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Making difficult or impassable. 	 n. (-कं) The Bhurjpatra or birch.  E. दुर्ग an impervious thicket, and कारक making.
19275: दुर्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Poor, indigent, distressed. 	 2. Suffering pain or affliction.  E. दुर् ill, गत gone, become. दुर् + गम् कर्त्तरि क्त ।
19276: दुर्गति f. (-तिः) 	 1. Hell. 	 2. Poverty, indigence. 	 3. A difficult path or site.  E. दुर् bad, ill, गति going.
19277: दुर्गतिनाशिनी f. (-नी) DURGĀ.  E. दुर्गति hell, नाशिनी who destroys.
19278: दुर्गनिवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Staying in a stronghold.  E. दुर्ग, and निवा-सिन् who abides.
19279: दुर्गन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Ill-smelling, ill-scented. 	 m. (-न्धः) 	 1. Any Ill-smelling substance. 	 2. The mango tree. 	 n. (-न्धं) Soubarchala salt. E. दुर् bad, vile, and गन्ध smell. दुःस्थितः गन्धः अस्य ।
19280: दुर्गन्धिन् mfn. (-न्धी-न्धिनी-न्धि) Ill-smelling.  E. दुर्गन्ध a bad smell, and इनि aff.
19281: दुर्गपुर n. (-रं) A fortified city.  E. दुर्ग, and पुर a city.
19282: दुर्गपुष्पी f. (-ष्पी) A plant, commonly Kesapushpa.  E. दुर्ग with difficulty, पुष्पी a flower.
19283: दुर्गम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 	 1. Inaccessible, difficult of access or approach. 	 2. Unattainable, difficult of attainment.  E. दुर् with pain or difficulty, गम् to go, affix खल्; see दुर्ग । दुःखेन गम्यते दुर् + गम कर्मणि खल् ।
19284: दुर्गमार्ग m. (-र्गः) A defile, a difficult pass or way.  E. दुर्ग, and मार्ग a road.
19285: दुर्गलङ्घन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) 	 1. Overcoming difficulties, making way through arduous passages or affairs, &c. 	 m. (-नः) A camel.  E. दुर्ग, and लङ्घन who traverses.
19286: दुर्गव्यसन n. (-नं) Defect in a citadel, its being ill-guarded, &c.  E. दुर्ग, and व्यसन misfortune.
19287: दुर्गसञ्चर m. (-रः) 	 1. Progress or passage through an almost impervious or inaccessible spot. 	 2. A bridge, &c. or any contrivance for pass-ing a river, a defile, &c.  E. दुर्ग a defile, &c. सञ्चर going; also with संचार, दुर्गसंचार m. (-रः) सम् + चर करणे अप् ।
19288: दुर्गसम्पद् f. (-द् or -त्) Essential part of a fortress.  E. दुर्ग, and सम्पद् wealth.
19289: दुर्गाधिकारिन् m. (-री) The governor of a fort.  E. दुर्ग, and अधिकारिन् who superintends.
19290: दुर्गाध्यक्ष m. (-क्षः) The governor of a fortress.  E. दुर्ग, and अध्यक्ष super-visor.
19291: दुर्गानवमी f. (-मी) The ninth of the light half of Kārtik, sacred to DURGĀ as JAGADDHĀTRI form.  E. दुर्गा, and नवमी the ninth.
19292: दुर्गावरोध m. (-धः) Investing or besieging a fortress.  E. दुर्ग, and अवरोध investing.
19293: दुर्गाश्रयण n. (-णं) Taking refuge in a fortress.  E. दुर्ग, and आश्रयण seeking shelter.
19294: दुर्घोष (-षः-षा-षं) Harsh-voiced, roaring, bellowing. 	 m. (-षः) 	 1. A bear. 2. A loud or disagreeable cry.  E. दुर्, and घोष sound.
19295: दुर्जन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Bad, wicked, vile. 	 2. Malicious, mischief-mak-ing. 	 m. (-नः) A bad man.  E. दुर् bad, vile, जन a man. दुष्टो जनः प्रा० स० ।
19296: दुर्जनत्व n. (-त्वं) Wickedness, villainy.  E. त्व added to दुर्जन; also with तल् affix दुर्जनता ।
19297: दुर्जय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Invincible, difficult to be subdued or overcome, E. दुर्, and जय victory. दुःखेन जीयते दुर् + जि कर्मणि खल् ।
19298: दुर्जर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Difficult of digestion, indigestible.  E. दुर्, and जर digesting. दुःखेन जीर्य्यति जॄ-अच् ।
19299: दुर्जात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Inauspiciously born or produced. 	 2. Improper. 	 n. (-तं) 	 1. Misfortune, calamity. 	 2. Disparity, unconformity, impro-priety.  E. दुर् bad, जात born. दुष्टं जातम् प्रा० स० ।
19300: दुर्जाति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) 	 1. Vile, wicked. 	 2. Low, outcaste.  E. दुर्, जाति kind.
19301: दुर्ज्ञेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Difficult to be known or understood.  E. दुर्, and ज्ञेय to be known. दुःखेन ज्ञायते ज्ञा + कर्मणि यत् ।
19302: दुर्णय m. (-यः) Want of conduct, impropriety, impolicy.  E. दुर्, and नय policy.
19303: दुर्णीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Ill-behaved, ill-governed. 	 2. Impolitic. 	 n. (-तं) 	 1. Misconduct. 	 2. Impolicy.  E. दुर and नीत conducted.
19304: दुर्णीति f. (-तिः) 	 1. Impolicy. 	 2. Misconduct.  E. दुर्, and नीति policy.
19305: दुर्दम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Difficult to be subdued.  E. दुर्, and दम taming. दुःखेन दम्यते असौ दुर + दम-कर्मणि खल् ।
19306: दुर्दर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Tearing. 	 2. Distressing. 	 m. (-रः) A kind of drug, Rishabha.  E. दुर्, and दर what tears.
19307: दुर्दर्श mfn. (-र्शः-र्शा-र्शं) Dazzling painful to the sight. 	 2. Difficult to be seen or met with.  E. दुर्, and दृश seeing. दुःखेन दृश्यते असौ दुर् + दृश्-कर्मणि खल् ।
19308: दुर्दान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Untameable, intractable, difficult to be res-trained or disciplined. 	 m. (-न्तः) 	 1. Strife, tumult. 	 2. A caff.  E. दुर्, and दान्त daunted. दुःखेन दान्तः दमितः दमि + क्त वा नि० ।
19309: दुर्दिन n. (-नं) 	 1. A dark or cloudy day. 	 2. Rain, or cloudy and rainy weather.  E. दुर् bad, vile, दिन a day. दुष्टं दिनम् प्रा० स० ।
19310: दुर्दुरुट m. (-टः) An atheist.  E. दुर् vile, repeated, अट् to go or be, affix घञ्, and उ substituted for the penultimate.
19311: दुर्दृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Ill seen, (literally or figuratively) ill-examined, imperfectly investigated. 	 2. Looked at with an evil eye.  E. दुर् bad, दृष्ट seen.
19312: दुर्दैव n. (-वं) Bad luck, misfortune.  E. दुर्, and दैव fate.
19313: दुर्द्धरुट m. (-टः) A pupil who obeys his teacher only after judging of the propriety or obedience.
19315: दुर्द्रुम m. (-मः) A green onion.  E. दुर् bad, and द्रुम a tree: see दुद्रुम.
19316: दुर्द्धर्ष mfn. (-र्षः-र्षा-र्षं) 	 1. Difficult of attainment or approach. 	 2. Haughty, distant.  E. दुर्, pride. दुःखेन धृष्यते असौ दुः + धृष-कर्मणि खल् ।
19317: दुर्धर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Difficult to be sustained or borne, troublesome, unbearable. 	 2. Irresistible, difficult to be restrained. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A division of hell. 	 2. A kind of drug, commonly Rishabha. 	 3. The name of an Asura or Titan.  E. दुर् bad, ill, धर having, possessing; it is also written दुर्द्धर । दुःखेन धार्य्यते दुर् + धृ-कर्मणि खल् ।
19318: दुर्नामक n. (-कं) Hæmorrhoids.  E. दुर्, bad नामन् a name, and कप् added; see the next.
19319: दुर्नामन् mf. (-मा-म्नी) A cockle. 	 n. (-म) Piles or hæmorrhoids. E. दुर्, bad and नामन् a name, fem. affix, टाप् or ङीष्; also in the first sense, with a final vowel दुर्नामा. 	 f. (-मा) ।
19320: दुर्निग्रह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Ungovernable, difficult of restraint.  E. दुर्, and निग्रह restraint.
19321: दुर्निवार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Difficult to be stopped, hindered, condradict-ed, &c. Invincible, unconquerable.  E. दुर्, and निवार resistance.
19322: दुर्निरीक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) Hard to be looked at, as the sun, &c. E. दुर and निरीक्ष्य to be seen.
19323: दुर्ब r. 1st cl. (इ) दुर्बी (दूर्बति) To hurt, to injure, to wound, to kill दूर्ब, &c.
19324: दुर्बल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Feeble, thin, emaciated. 	 2. Weak, impotent. 	 m. (-ल्) One who is circumcised, or whose glans penis is void of pre-puce.  E. दुर् implying depreciation or diminution, and बल strong, potent. दुःस्थितं बलमस्य ।
19325: दुर्बुद्धि mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) Silly, ignorant.  E. दुर्, and बुद्धि under-standing.
19326: दुर्भक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) To be eaten with difficulty.  E. दुर्, and भक्ष्य eating.
19327: दुर्भगा f. (-गा) 	 1. A wife not loved or liked by her husband. 	 2. A bad or ill tempered woman.  E. दुर् little or ill, भग affection.
19328: दुर्भर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Burdensome, troublesome, hard to be supported. E. दुर्, and भर what bears.
19329: दुर्भिक्ष n. (-क्षं) Dearth, famine.  E. दुर्, and भिक्षा alms; when charity ceases.
19330: दुर्भाग्य mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) Unfortunate, unlucky.  E. दुर्, and भाग्य fortune.
19331: दुर्भेद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) 	 1. To be broken with difficulty. 	 2. Firm, con-stant, not easily disunited.  E. दुर्, and भेद्य to be broken.
19332: दुर्मति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Silly, ignorant, simple, a blockhead.  E. दुर्, and मति mind.
19333: दुर्मनस् mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः) Sad, distressed, meditating or thinking sor-rowfully.  E. दुर् distress, मनस् the mind.
19334: दुर्मर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Dying. with difficulty, retentive of life: f. (-र्) Bent grass: see दूर्व्वा.  E. दुर् with difficulty, मृ so perish, affix अच् ।
19335: दुर्मल्लिका f. (-का) A minor drama, a comedy, a farce.
19336: दुर्मुख mfn. (-खः-खा-खी-खं) 	 1. Scurrilous, foul-mouthed. 	 2. Hideous ugly. 	 m. (खः) 	 1. One of the monkey chiefs. 	 2. One of the principal Nagas or serpents. 	 3. A horse. 	 4. An Asura.  E. दुर् bad, ill, मुख mouth or face.
19337: दुर्मूल्य n. (-ल्यं) Any thing of high price or value.  E. दुर्, and मूल्य price.
19338: दुर्मेधस् mfn. (-धाः-धाः-धः) Of little or contemptible understanding, dull, stupid, ignorant, uninformed.  E. दुर् bad, मेधस् understanding.
19339: दुर्योधन m. (-नः) The elder of the Kuru princes, and leader in the war against his cousins, the Pāndus and KRISHNA.  E. दुर् vile, ill, युध् to make war, affix युच्; the author and leader of an unjust warfare.
19340: दुर्योनि mfn. (-निः-निः-नि) Of low or impure origin.  E. दुर्, and योनि place of birth.
19341: दुर्लभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) 	 1. Difficult of attainment. 	 2. Excellent, eminent. 3. Dear, beloved. 	 m. (-भः) A plant, (a sort of Hedysarum:) see
19342: दुरालभा f. (-भा) A prickly nightshade.  E. दुर् difficult, लभ् to gain, affix खल् but without any nasal.
19343: दुर्वच mfn. (-चः-चा-चं) 	 1. Speaking ill or improperly. 	 1. Speaking in pain. 	 3. Difficult of utterance or articulation. 	 4. What ought not to be spoken. 	 n. (-चं) 	 1. Abuse, censure. 	 2. Evil or unlucky speech.  E. दुर्, वच् to speak. दुःखेन उच्यते दुर् + वच्-कर्मणि खल् ।
19344: दुर्वचस् n. (-चः) Abuse, bad language.  E. दुर् bad, वचस् speech.
19345: दुर्वर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Of a bad species or class. 	 n. (-र्णं) 	 1. Silver. 	 2. A sort of perfume, commonly Elabāluka: see एलवालुक.  E. दुर् bad, vile, and वर्ण species; the reduplication of the व is optional in this and the following words. हेमापेक्षया निकृष्टो वर्णोऽस्य । रजते ।
19346: दुर्वर्णक n. (-कं) Silver.  E. दुर् inferior, वर्ण species, कन् pleonasm; in-ferior as compared with gold.
19347: दुर्वह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Difficult to be borne or supported.  E. दुर्, and वह bearing. दुःखेन उह्यते असौ दुर् + वह-कर्मणि खल् ।
19348: दुर्वाच् mfn. (-वाक्) An ill speaker, morally or physically. 	 f. (-वा) Speak-ing ill, either inelegantly or abusively.  E. दुर् ill, वाच् speech. गर्हिता वाक् प्रा० स० ।
19349: दुर्वाच्य n. (-च्यं) Any unlucky or ill omened speech. 	 2. censure, abuse. E. दुर् improperly, वाच्य to be spoken. दुष्टं निन्द्यं वाच्यम् प्रा० स० ।
19350: दुर्वाद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) One who speaks ill, (grammatically, &c.) or one who utters abusive or unbecoming language.  E. दुर् ill, bad, वाद speaking. दुष्टो वादः प्रा० स० ।
19351: दुर्वार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Irresistible, not to be prevented or checked. E. दुर् and वार preventing. दुःखेन वार्य्यते असौ दुर् + वारि-कर्मणि खल् ।
19352: दुर्वासस् mfn. (-साः-साः-सः) Ill dressed. 	 m. (-साः) The name of a Rishi or saint, the son of ATRI, and an incarnation or portion of SIVA, famous for his choleric temperament.  E. दुर्, and वासस् vesture.
19353: दुर्विध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) 	 1. Poor, pauper, indigent. 	 2. Wicked, melevo-lent. 	 3. Foolish, stupid.  E. दुर् bad, ill, विध habit, custom.
19354: दुर्विनीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ill mannered, ill trained or behaved. 	 m. (-तः) A restive horse.  E. दुर् with difficulty, विनीत led, managed.
19355: दुर्विभाव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Incomprehensible, inconceivable.  E. दुर्, and विभाव्य to be observed.
19356: दुर्विवाह m. (-हः) A bad mode or form of marriage.  E. दुर् and विवाह marriage.
19357: दुर्विषह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Difficult to be sustained or supported.  E. दुर् and वि before, सह to bear. दुःखेन विषह्यते असौ दुर् + वि + सह कर्मणि खल् ।
19358: दुर्वृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Vile, wicked, leading a low or infamous life, following disreputable habits or business, a cheat, a juggler, a rogue, a blackguard, &c.  E. दुर् bad, वृत्त to be or abide. दुष्टं वृत्तम् प्रा० स० ।
19359: दुर्वृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 	 1. Leading a disreputable life, following a degrading business, &c. 	 2. Juggling, fraud.  E. दुर्, and वृत्ति maintenance.
19360: दुर्हन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) What is killed with difficulty.  E. दुर् before, हन् to kill. दुःखेन हन्यते असौ दुर् + हन-कर्मणि खल् ।
19361: दुर्हृद् mfn. (-द् or -त्) Inimical, ill disposed. 	 m. (-द् or -त्) An enemy. E. दुर् bad, हृद् heart. दुःस्थं हृद् हृदयमस्य प्रा० स० ।
19362: दुर्हृदय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Evil-minded, bad-hearted.  E. दुर् bad, ill, हृदय the heart.
19363: दुल r. 10th cl. (दोलयति-ते) 	 1. To raise, to throw up. 	 2. To excite. 	 3. To shake, to swing. चुरा० उभ० सक० सेट् ।
19364: दुलि m. (-लिः) A Muni or saint. 	 f. (-लि or -ली) A small or female tortoise.  E. दुल् to throw up, (mud, &c.) affix कि fem. affix option-ally ङीष् ।
19365: दुश्चर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 	 1. Going with trouble of difficulty. 	 2. Acting ill, behaving wickedly. 	 3. Unattainable. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A bivalve shell. 2. bear.  E. दुर् bad, चर् to go, अच् or टच् aff.
19366: दुश्चरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Misbehaving, abandoned, wicked. 	 m. (-तं) Misbehaviour, ill conduct, wickedness.  E. दुर् and चरित conduct.
19367: दुश्चर्म्मन् m. (-र्म्मा) A circumcised man, or one whose prepuce is naturally or artificially wanting.  E. दुर् bad, difficult, चर्म्मन् skin.
19368: दुश्चेष्टित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Misbehaving, doing or besieging evil. 	 n. (-तं) Evil purpose or action, misconduct, error.  E. दुर् and चेष्टित exerted.
19369: दुश्च्यवन m. (-नः) A name of INDRA.  E. दुर् ill, च्यवन the name of a saint: INDRA having raised his arm to hurl his thunderbolt at Chyavana had it fixed in that position by the curse of the saint; other ety-mologies are given.
19370: दुश्छद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Tattered, hardly covered.  E. दुर् and छद covering.
19371: दुश्शासन m. (-नः) One of the Kaurava princes.  E. दुर्, and शासन government.
19372: दुष (इर, औ) इरदुषौ r. 4th cl. (दुष्यति) 	 1. To do or act wrong or impro-perly. 	 2. To be impure. With प्र and आङ prefixed, To become manifest or apparent. दिवा० पर० अक० अनिट् ।
19373: दुष्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 	 1. Difficult to be done. 	 2. One who behaves ill, does wrong, &c. wicked, bad. 	 n. (-रं) 	 1. Æthen atmo-sphere. 	 2. Doing any thing with pain or difficulty. E. दुर् bad, and कर what does from कृ with कर्मणि खल् aff. दुःखेन क्रियते ।
19374: दुष्कर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 	 1. Wickedness, sin. 	 2. Any difficult or painful act. E. दुर् and कर्म्मन् act.
19375: दुष्कुल n. (-लं) A low family or race.  E. दुर bad, कुल race.
19376: दुष्कुलीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Of a low or degraded family. 	 m. (-नः) A sort of perfume, commonly Chor.  E. दुर् bad and कुलीन family or species.
19377: दुष्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Done wrong or wickedly. 	 2. Done with diffi-culty or pain. 	 n. (-तं) Sin, crime, guilt.  E. दुर् evil, कृत done, commit-ted. दुष्टं कृतम् प्रा० स० ।
19378: दुष्कृतकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Wicked, reprobate. 	 n. (-र्म्म) Wickedness. E. दुष्कृत, and कर्म्मन् act.
19379: दुष्कृतवहिष्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Holy, free from sin. दुष्कृत, and वहिष्कृत excluded.
19380: दुष्कृतिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) Wicked, an evil doer.  E. दुष्कृत, and इनि aff.
19381: दुष्क्रम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 	 1. Difficult of access. 	 2. Going ill or laboriously. 2. Ill arranged, unmethodical.  E. दुर्, and क्रम going.
19382: दुष्क्रीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dear, bought too dearly or unadvisedly.  E. दुर् bad, क्रीत purchased: a bad bargain.
19383: दुष्ख n. (-ष्खं) Pain in general: see दुःख ।
19384: दुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Low, vile, 2. Weak, impotent. 	 3. Wicked, depraved. 	 4. spoiled, injured. 	 5. violated. 	 6. Contaminated, degraded. 	 7. Worthless. 	 f. (-ष्टा) A harlot, a wanton. 	 n. (-ष्टं) A kind of Costus, (C. speciosus:) see कुष्ठ.  E. दुष् to be corrupt. &c. affix क्त.
19385: दुष्टचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Wicked.  E. दुष्ट, and चारिन् practising. दुष्टं चरति चर-णिनि ।
19386: दुष्टचेतस् mfn. (-ताः-ताः-तः) 	 1. Melevolent. 	 2. Stupid.  E. दुष्ट, and चेतस् the heart or mind.
19387: दुष्टता f. (-ता) 	 1. Wickedness, badness. 	 2. Contamination, defilement. 	 3. Violation.  E. तल् added to दुष्ट; also त्वं दुष्टत्वम् ।
19388: दुष्टभाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Innately bad.  E. दुष्ट, and भाव nature.
19389: दुष्टभावता f. (-ता) Wickedness, innate depravity.  E. दुष्टभाव, and तल् aff.
19390: दुष्टमति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Wicked, depraved.  E. दुष्ट, and मति mind.
19391: दुष्टवृष m. (-षः) A lazy ox.  E. दष्ट as above, and वृष an ox.
19392: दुष्टव्रण m. (-णः) A dull boil or sore, a sinus.  E. दुष्ट bad, and व्रण sore.
19393: दुष्टान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Defiled, rendered impure.  E. दुष्ट, and अन्वित possessed of.
19394: दुष्ठु ind. Ill, bad. 	 2. Improperly, incorrectly. 	 mfn. (-ष्ठुः-ष्ठुः-ष्ठु) Ill behaved, unprincipled, depraved.  E. दु ill, स्था to be, affix कु ।
19395: दुष्पत्र m. (-त्रः) Chor, a perfume.  E. दुर् bad, पत्र a leaf.
19396: दुष्पर्श mfn. (-र्शः-र्शा-र्शं) Not to be touched, unpleasant to the touch. m. (-र्शः) A plant, (Hedysarum alhaji:) see दुस्पर्श । दुर् + स्थल-कर्मणि खल् ।
19397: दुष्पान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Difficult to be drunk.  E. दुर्, and पान drinking. दुःखेन पीयते असौ खलर्थे कर्मणि युच् । भावे युच् वा ।
19398: दुष्प्रकृति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Of a bad nature or disposition.  E. दुर्, and प्रकृति naure दुःस्था प्रकृतिरस्य प्रा० ब० ।
19399: दुष्प्रधर्षणी f. (-णी) The egg plant, (Solanum melongena.)  E. दुर् with difficulty, प्र before, धृष् to show, to guide, affix ल्युट्; also with णिनि affix दुष्प्रधर्षिणी ।
19400: दुष्प्रधर्षा f. (-र्षा) A plant, (Hedysarum alhaji.) 	 2. The date tree. E. दुर्, and प्र before, धृष् to guide, affixes अङ् and टाप्.
19401: दुष्प्रमय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Immeasurable, difficult to be measured.  E. दुर्, and प्र before, मी to measure, खल् aff.
19402: दुष्प्रलम्भ mfn. (-म्भः-म्भा-म्भं) Difficult of attainment.  E. दुर्, and प्र before, लभ् to gain, खल् affix, नुम् inserted.
19403: दुष्प्राप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Difficult of attainment, difficult to be got or reached.  E. दुर्, and प्राप obtaining.
19404: दुष्प्राप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) Remote, unattainable, difficult of approach or attainment.  E. दुर्, and प्राप्य obtainable.
19405: दुष्मन्त m. (-न्तः) A prince of the lunar line, the husband of SAKUNTALĀ. E. दुर्, and झ affix, मुम्, aug; also read दुष्यन्त.
19406: दुष्यन्त m. (-न्तः) A prince: see that last.  E. दुष् to do wrong, झ aff.
19407: दुस्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Difficult to be crossed.  E. दुर्, and तर crossing.
19408: दुस्त्यज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Difficult to be relinquished or parted with. E. दुर् and त्यज abandoning.
19409: दुस्सथ m. (-थः) 	 1. A dog. 	 2. A cock.
19410: दुह (औ) दुहौ r. 2nd cl. (दोग्धि, दुग्धे) 3rd pers. plu. (दुहन्ति) To milk, (इर) दुहिर r. 1st cl. (दोहति) 	 1. To hurt, to afflict, to give pain. 	 2. To kill. अदा० उभ० द्विक० अनिट् । भ्वा० पर० सक० सेट् ।
19411: दुह m. (धुक्) A milker.  E. दुह्, and क्विप् aff.
19412: दुहत् mfn. (-हन्-हन्ती-हत्) 	 1. Relinquishing, parting with. 	 2. Milking. E. दुह to milk, शतृ aff.
19413: दुहितुःपति m. (-तिः) A son-in-law, a daughter's husband.  E. दुहितृ a daughter, in the possessive case, and पति a husband.
19414: दुहितृ(-ता) A daughter.  E. दुह् to milk, (the mother,) Unadi affix तृच्, and इट् inserted.
19415: दुह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) To be milked, milkable.  E. दुह् to milk, affix क्यप्; also ण्यत्प्रत्ययं कृत्वा दोह्य ।
19416: दू (ओ, ङ) ओदूङ r. 4th cl. (दूयते) 	 1. To suffer or be consumed with pain. 	 2. To inflict pain or anxiety. दिवा० आ० अक० सेट् ।
19417: दू f. (-दूः) Pain, distress.  E. दू, and क्विप् aff.
19418: दूडभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Unfortunate, distressed.  E. दूर् difficult, दन्भ to deceive, deriv. irr. दुःखेन दभ्यते असौ दन्भ-कर्मणि खल् ।
19419: दूडाश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Pained, afflicted.  E. दुर bad, painful, दशि to hurt, deriv. irr. दुःखेन दाश्यते दुर् + दाश्-कर्मणि खल् ।
19420: दूढ्य mfn. (-ढ्यः-ढ्या-ढ्यं) Bad, vile.  E. दुर्, and ध्यै to meditate, क aff. दुष्टं ध्यायति दुर् + ध्यै-क ।
19421: दूणाश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Destroyed or annihilated with trouble or difficul-ty  E. दूर् before, णश् to destroy, deriv. irr. दुःखेन नाश्यते दुर् + नाशि-कर्मणि खल्.
19422: दूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sent, despatched. 	 m. (-तः) 	 1. A messenger or envoy, a news-carrier. 	 2. An ambassador. 	 f. (-तिः-ती) A female messenger, a confidante, a procuress, a go-between. &c.  E. दु to go, Unadi affix क्त, and the vowel made long; or दू to suffer, affix क्त fem. affix क्तिन् or क्तिच् and optionally ङीप् ।
19423: दूतघ्नी f. (-घ्नी) A plant, resembling the Kadamba: see कदम्बपुष्पी.  E. दूत a messenger, घ्नी what destroys. दूतं खेदं हन्ति हन-टक् । ङीप् ।
19424: दूति f. (-तिः) See दूत दु-वा ति दीर्घश्च ।
19425: दूतिका f. (-का) A female messenger, a confidante, &c. see दूत, &c.  E. कन् added to दूति; also with the penultimate, vowel made long, दूतीका ।
19426: दूत्य n. (-त्यं) 	 1. An embassy, a message. 	 2. The abstract state or condi-tion of a message or a messenger.  E. दूत a messenger, and यत् aff.
19427: दूद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Afflicting, harassing.  E. दू, and द what gives or occasions.
19428: दून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Suffering pain or fatigue. 	 2. Going, moving. 	 3. Shaken, agitated.  E. दु उपतापे to suffer, affix क्त ।
19429: दूनवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 	 1. Being agitated or distressed. 	 2. Gone, having gone.  E. दू to be agitated, क्तवतु aff.
19431: दूर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Distant, remote. 	 n. adv. (-रं) Far, far off. 	 2. Widely. deeply.  E. दुर with difficulty, इण् to go, Unadi affix रक्, deriv. irr. or दैप् शुद्धौ वा कू ।
19432: दूरग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) 	 1. Going afar or a long way. 	 2. Remote.  E. दूर, and ग what goes.
19433: दूरगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Going far. 	 m. (-मी) An arrow, &c.  E. दूर, and गामिन् what goes.
19434: दूरतस् ind. Afar, far off, from a distance, from afar.  E. दूर, and तसि aff.
19435: दूरता f. (-ता) Remoteness, distance.  E. दूर, and तल्; also with त्वं दूरत्वम् ।
19436: दूरदर्शन n. (-नं) 	 1. Foresight. 	 2. Long-sightedness. 	 m. (-नः) A vulture. E. दूर, and दर्शन seeing.
19437: दूरदर्शिन् mfn. (-र्शी-र्शिनी-र्शि) Long-sighted, far-seeing, (literally or metaphorically.) 	 m. (-र्शी) 	 1. A Pandit, a learned man, a teacher. 2. A prophet, a seer. 	 3. A vulture.  E. दूर far, and दर्शिन् who sees, from दृश् to see, with णिनि affix; also with क्विप् affix दूरदृश् ।
19438: दूरदृश् m. (-दृक्) 	 1. A learned man. 	 2. A vulture: see the preceding.
19439: दूरदृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 	 1. Long-sightedness. 	 2. Foresight.  E. दूर, and दृष्टि sight.
19440: दूरपातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) Far going.  E. दूर, and पातिब् who goes.
19441: दूरभाज् mfn. (-क् or -ज्) Distant.  E. दूर, and भाज् what shares.
19442: दूरभिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Struck or wounded deeply.  E. दूर, and भिन्न divided.
19443: दूरयायिन mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Going far.  E. दूर, and यायिन् what goes.
19444: दूरवस्त्रक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Naked, undressed.  E. दूर, and वस्त्र clothes.
19445: दूरवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Residing in a foreign land, outlandish. E. दूर, and वासिन् who or what abides.
19446: दूरविभिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Unconnected by the ties of nature, of a differ-ent nature.  E. दूर, and विभिन्न separated.
19447: दूरवेधिन् mfn. (-धी-धिनी-धि) Missile, projectile, (weapons, &c.)  E. दूर afar, and वेधिन् what pierces or wounds.
19448: दूरसंस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Remote, distant.  E. दूर, and संस्थ what stays.
19449: दूरसंस्थान n. (-नं) Being or residing at a distance.  E. दूर, and संस्थान site.
19450: दूरस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Remote, far off.  E. दूर, and स्थ what stays or is; also दूरस्थित, and दूरस्थायिन्, &c.
19451: दूराप्लाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Jumping far.  E. दूर, and आप्लाव a leap.
19452: दूरावस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Standing being or afar off.  E. दूर, and अवस्थित situated.
19453: दूरीकरण n. (-णं) Removing, placing at a distance.  E. दूर, and करण making, च्वि aff.
19454: दूरीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Removed, placed afar off.  E. दूर, and कृत made, च्वि aff.
19455: दूरीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Remote, far off.  E. दूर, and भूत become, च्वि aff.
19456: दूरेत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) Far, distant.  E. दूर, and एत्य aff.
19457: दूरेरितेक्षण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Squint-eyed.  E. दूर afar, ईरित sent, and ईक्षण sight.
19458: दूर्वा f. (-र्वा) Bent grass, commonly Durbā, (Panicum dactylon.)  E. दूर्व to hurt or be hurt, affix अच् or घञ्; fem. affix टाप् what hurts sin, or is injured by cattle. दूर्वति रोगान् अनिष्टं वा ।
19459: दूर्वावण n. (-णं) A thicket of Durbā grass.  E. दूर्वा and वन wood; also with the final unchanged, दूर्वावन ।
19460: दूर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Fæces, ordure.  E. दूर far, या to go, aff. यत् । पुरीषे, शट्याम् च ।
19461: दूलाश m. (-शः) Which is to be injured with difficulty.  E. दूडाश + डस्य वा लः । दःखेन हिंस्ये ।
19462: दूश्य n. (-श्यं) A tent. see दूष्य । दू-खेदे सम्पदा, भावे क्विप् तां श्यायते गमयति अन्तर्भूतण्यर्थे श्यै गतौ क ।
19463: दूष r. 4th cl. (दूष्यति) 	 1. To be or become bad. 	 2. To make bad.
19464: दूषक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Ill, low, contemptible, infamous. 	 2. Spoiling, corrupting, contaminating, who or what does so.  E. दुष् to be vile, affixes णिच् and ण्वुल् ।
19465: दूषण m. (-णः) Rakshasa, the brother of RĀVAṆA. 	 n. (-णं) 	 1. Blame, fault, defect, offence. 	 2. Spoiling, ruining, vitiating. defiling. 	 3. Violating, (as a girl.) 	 4. Breaking, (as an agreement.)  E. दूष् to become vile or wicked. affix भावे ल्युट् ।
19466: दूषणारि m. (-रिः) RĀMA.  E. दूषण the brother of RĀVANĀ, and अरि a foe.
19467: दूषयाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Vitiating, defiling, spoiling.  E. दूष् to make bad, शानच् aff.
19468: दूषि f. (-षिः-षी) The rheum of the eyes.  E. दूष् to make bad, affix इन् or क with ङीष् added; also दूषिका and दूषीका ।
19469: दूषिका f. (-का) 	 1. The rheum of the eyes. 	 2. A pencil or painting brush.  E. दूष् to make bad, (the eyes, &c.) affix ण्वुल्, or स्वार्थे क वा, fem. form; also दूषी, दूषि and दूषीका ।
19470: दूषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Calumniated, falsely accused, especially of adultery. 	 2. Contaminated, corrupted, spoiled. 	 3. Violated. 	 4. Blamed censured. 	 f. (-ता) A girl who has been violated or deflower-ed.  E. दूष् to become or make bad, affix क्त ।
19471: दूषीका f. (-का) The secretion or rheum of the eyes.  E. दूष् to hurt, (the eyes,) Unadi affix ईकन्ः see दूषिका ।
19472: दूषीविष n. (-षं) Poison that may be overcome by drugs or charms, or that does not act upon the system.  E. दूषी rheum, and विष venom.
19473: दूष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) Reprehensible, contemptible, vile, bad. 	 f. (-ष्या) An elephant's leathern-girth. 	 n. (-ष्यं) 	 1. Clothes. 	 2. A tent. 	 3. Pus, matter.  E. दूष् to be or become wicked or bad, यत् or ण्यत् affix, fem. affix टाप् ।

19475: दृंहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Grown, increased.  E. दृहि to increase, क्त affix.

19477: दृकाण m. (-णः) A demigod, presiding over the third part of a sign of the zodiac, (in Astrology.)
19478: दृक्कर्ण m. (-र्णः) A snake.  E. दृश् an eye, and कर्ण an ear; whose eyes are his ears in the opinion of the Hindus, the snake has no visible external ear.
19480: दृक्प्रिया f. (-या) 	 1. Beauty. 	 2. Splendor.  E. दृश् and प्रिय amiable.
19481: दृक्श्रुति m. (-तिः) A snake.  E. दृश्, and श्रुति the ear; see दृक्कर्ण ।

19485: दृङ्मण्डल n. (-लं) A small circle within the great circles of the armillary sphere, accompanying each planetary circle or orbit.  E. दृश्, and मण्डल sphere.

19488: दृढकण्टक m. (-कः) A plant, commonly Dhaliākāra.  E. दृढ much or many and कण्टक a thorn.
19489: दृढकाण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A bamboo.  E. दृढ, and काण्ड a stem.
19490: दृढकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Persevering, determined.  E. दृढ and कारिन् who does, (any act.)
19491: दृढगात्रिका f. (-का) Granulated sugar.  E. दृढ firm, गात्र substance, affix कप् ।
19492: दृढग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) A bamboo.  E. दृढ, and ग्रन्थि a knot.
19493: दृढता f. (-ता) 	 1. Firmness, hardness. 	 2. Steadiness. 	 3. Solidity. 	 4. Strength.  E. तल् added to दृढ; also with त्वं दृढत्वम् ।
19494: दृढदंशक m. (-कः) A shark.  E. दृढ hard, दंशक a biter.
19495: दृढधन्वन् m. (-न्वा) A good archer.  E. दृढ, and धन्वन् a bow.
19496: दृढधुर् mfn. (-धूः-धूः-धु) Strong, able to bear a weight or load.  E. दृढ, and धुर् a burthen.
19497: दृढनिश्चय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Certain, confirmed, corroborated, undoubted. E. दृढ, and निश्चय certainty.
19498: दृढफल m. (-लः) The cocoanut.  E. दृढ hard, and फल fruit.
19499: दृढबद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Bound or tied tightly.  E. दृढ, and बद्ध bound.
19500: दृढबन्धिनी f. (-नी) A creeper, (Echites frutescens.)  E. दृढ firmly, बन्ध to bind, affixes णिनि, and ङीप्; winding closely round a tree or stem.
19501: दृढभक्ति mfn. (-क्तिः-क्तिः-क्ति) Faithful, devoted.  E. दृढ and भक्ति faith.
19502: दृढमुष्टि mfn. (-ष्टिः-ष्टिः-ष्टि) Miserly, niggardly close-fisted, m. (-ष्टिः) A sword, any weapon with a hilt or handle.  E. दृढ firm, and मुष्टि a handle, a fist.
19503: दृढमूल m. (-लः) The cocoanut.  E. दृढ, and मूल root.
19504: दृढलोमन् mfn. (-मा-मा-मं) Having coarse hair on the skin. 	 m. (-मा) 	 1. A wild hog. 	 2. Coarse hair, bristles.  E. दृढ firm, stiff, and लोमन् the hair of the body.
19505: दृढव्रत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Observing steadily a religious vow or obligation, E. दृढ, and व्रत a vow.
19506: दृढसन्धि mfn. (-न्धिः-न्थिः-न्धि) 	 1. Strong knit, well fixed or compact, (the person, &c.) 	 2. Close, compact, free from interstices. 	 3. Closely connected or allied.  E. दृढ firm, and सन्धि union, a joint, &c.
19507: दृढसूत्रिका f. (-का) A plant from the fibres of which bow strings are made: see सूर्व्वा.  E. दृढ firm, and सूत्र a thread, a fibre, affix क ।
19508: दृढसौहृद mfn. (-दः-दी-दं) Firm in friendship, constant.  E. दृढ, and सौहृद friendship.
19509: दृढस्कन्ध m. (-न्धः) A plant, a sort of Mimusops: see क्षीरिका.  E. दृढ firm, and स्कन्ध stem.
19510: दृढाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Firm-bodied, hard, strong. 	 n. (-ङ्गं) A dia-mond.  E. दृढ, and अङ्ग body.
19511: दृढार्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) 	 1. The end of a bow. 	 2. Great pain.  E. दृढ, and आर्त्ति end of a bow, &c.
19512: दृढाभक्ति f. (-क्तिः) A faithful mistress or wife.  E. दृढा fem. form, and भक्ति attachment.
19513: दृढायुध m. (-धः) A hero, one firm in battle.  E. दृढ, and आयुध war.
19514: दृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Respected, honoured. 	 f. (-ता) Cumin.  E. दृ to res-pect, affix क्त.
19515: दृति f. (-तिः) 	 1. A bellows. 	 2. A fish. 	 3. A skin of leather, or a leather bag for holding water. 	 4. Skin, hide.  E. दृ to divide, क्तिन् aff.
19516: दृतिधारक m. (-कः) A plant, commonly Acanpātā.  E. दृति a bellows, and धारक having; having leaved compared to a leather bellows.
19517: दृतिहरि m. (-रिः) A dog.  E. दृति here said to mean skin in general, and हरि who steals, from हृ with इन् aff.
19518: दृतिहार m. (-रः) A carrier of skins or bags, a water carrier, &c.  E. दृति, and हृ to take, अण् aff.
19519: दृन्भू m. (-न्भूः) 	 1. The thunderbolt. 	 2. The sun. 	 f. (-न्भूः) 	 1. A snake in general. 	 2. A wheel.  E. दृभ् to fear, Unadi affix कू, क्विप् and नुम् inserted; न being optionally changed to म, before भ, the word is also read दृम्भू ।
19520: दृप r. 4th cl. (ञि ईर ऊ) ञि ईरदृपू (दृप्यति) 1. To be glad, to rejoice. 	 2. To be arrogant. to be vain or proud. r. 6th cl. (दृपति) To pain, to inflict pain, to torture. r. 1st and 10th cls. (दर्पति दर्पयति-ते) To light, to kindle or inflame. हर्षे गर्वे च अक० दिवा० वेट् । तुदा० पर० सक० सेट्० । भ्वा० पर० । चुरा० उभ० ।
19521: दृप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Proud, arrogant.  E. दृप् to be proud, affix क्त.
19522: दृप्यत् mfn. (-प्यन्-प्यती-प्यत्) Being proud or arrogant.  E. दृप् to be proud, शतृ aff.
19523: दृप्र mfn. (-प्रः-प्रा-प्रं) 	 1. Strong, powerful. 	 2. Proud, arrogant.  E. दृप् to be proud Unadi affix रक् ।
19524: दृफ r. 6th cl. (दृम्फति) To pain, to hurt. तुदा० मुचादि० अक० पर० सेट् ।
19525: दृब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) 	 1. Strung, tied. 	 2. Afraid, frightened. 	 3. Pained, tortured.  E. दृभ् to pain, to string, affix कर्मणि कर्त्तरि वा क्त ।
19526: दृभ (ई) दृभी r. 6th cl. (दृभति) 	 1. To string, to arrange. 	 2. To give pain. r. 1st and 10th cls. (दर्भति दर्भयति-ते) To fear, to be afraid. तुदा० पर० सक० सेट् । भ्वा० पर० अक० । चुरा० उभ० ।
19527: दृम्प r. 6th cl. (दृम्पति) To inflict pain, to torture. तुदा० पर० अक० सेट् ।
19528: दृम्फ r. 6th cl. (दृम्फति) To pain, to torture. तुदा० पर० अक० सेट् ।
19529: दृम्फू f. (-म्फूः) A snake, in general.  E. दृम्फ to give pain, affix कूः see दृन्भू ।
19530: दृम्भू f. (-म्भूः) A snake, &c.: see दृन्भू ।

19532: दृश् mfn. (दृक्) 	 1. A seer, a looker. 	 2. Wise, possessed of knowledge f. (-दृक्) 	 1. The eye. 	 2. Sight, seeing.  E. दृश् to see, affix क्विप्ः also दृशा and दृशि, &c.
19533: दृशद् f. (-शद्-शत्) 	 1. A stone, a rock. 	 2. A flat stone for grinding condiments upon.  E. दॄ to divide, Unadi affix अदि, augment षुक्, and ष changed to श; the crude form may also be दृषत् or दृषद्, &c.
19534: दृशद्वती f. (-ती) 	 1. The name of a river which forms the eastern bound-ary of the Āryāvarta or holy land of the Hindus, running on the north-east of Delhi. 	 2. A name of the goddess DURGĀ. E. दृशद् a stone or rock, and मतुप् poss. aff.
19535: दृशा f. (-शा) The eye. E. See दृश, टाप् being here added.
19536: दृशाकाङ्क्ष्य n. (-ङ्क्ष्यं) A lotus, or rather a kind of nelumbium. E. दृश् the eye, काङ्क्ष्य to desire, with आङ् prefix, and यत् affix; desirable as an object of comparison to the eye.
19537: दृशान n. (-नं) Light. 	 m. (-नः) 	 1. The name of an Asura; also VIROCHANA 2. A holy or spiritual teacher. 	 3. A king, a ruler, a protector or cherisher of the world. 	 4. A Brāmhan.  E. दृश् to see, आनच् Unādi affix; by whom or which, sight, &c. is enjoyed.
19538: दृशि f. (-शिः or -शी) The eye. 	 2. A Sāstra.  E. दृश् to see, affix कि, ङीष् is optionally added.
19539: दृशोपम n. (-मं) The white lotus, (Nelumbium speciosum.)  E. दृशा the eye, उपमा resemblance; what resembles the eye.
19540: दृश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) 	 1. Visible, to be seen. 	 2. Beautiful, pleasing. 	 m. (-श्यः) (In Arithmetic,) A given quantity or number.  E. दृश् to see, क्यप् aff.
19541: दृश्यत्व n. (-त्वं) Vision, sight.  E. त्व added to the last.
19542: दृषद् f. (-पद् or -षत्) 	 1. A stone or rock. 	 2. A flat stone or plate on which spices, &c. are ground.  E. दॄ to divide, Unadi affix अदि, and षुक् augment; also दृशद्.
19543: दृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Seen, visible, apparent. 	 n. (-ष्टं) Obvious danger or calamity.  E. दृश् to see, affix क्त ।
19544: दृष्टकूट n. (-टं) A riddle, an enigma.  E. दृष्ट seen, कूट trick.
19545: दृष्टदोष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Found out, exposed detected.  E. दृष्ट, and दोष fault.
19546: दृष्टरजस् f. (-जाः) A girl arrived at puberty.  E. दृष्ट seen, (by whom,) and रजस् the menstrual discharge.
19547: दृष्टवन् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Seeing, beholding, having seen.  E. दृश् to see, क्तवतु aff.
19548: दृष्टान्त m. (-न्तः) 	 1. A science, a Sāstra. 	 2. An example, an illustration. 3. Death, dying.  E. दृष्ट obvious or seen, and अन्त end.
19549: दृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 	 1. The eye. 	 2. Sight, seeing. 	 3. Knowledge, wisdom. 	 4. The sight of the eye, the pupil. 	 5. Aspect, (of the stars.)  E. दृश् to see, affix भावे क्तिन्.
19550: दृष्टिकृत् n. (-कृत्) A flower, (Hibiscus mutabilis.)  E. दृष्टि the eye, कृ to make, affix क्विप् and तुक् added; also with क्त affix दृष्टिकृत n. (-तं) दृष्टिं करोति ।
19551: दृष्टिगुण m. (-णः) A butt, a mark for archers, &c.  E. दृष्टि the eye, and गुण object.
19552: दृष्टिनिपात m. (-तः) A look, a look at or on.  E. दृष्टि, and निपात alighting.

19554: दृष्टिपूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Kept pure by the sight, i. e. watched, that no impropriety is committed, or impurity contracted.  E. दृष्टि, and पूत purified.
19555: दृष्टिबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) A fire-fly.  E. दृष्टि sight, and बन्धु a friend.
19556: दृष्टिविक्षेप m. (-पः) A leer, a side glance.  E. दृष्टि the eye, विक्षेप casting.
19557: दृष्टिविष m. (-षः) A snake.  E. दृष्टि, and विष poison, venomous in his look.
19558: दृष्ट्वा ind. Having seen.  E. दृश् to see, क्त्रा aff.
19559: दृह r. 1st cl. (दर्हति) also (इ) दृहि r. 1st cl. (दृंहति) To grow, to increase, to prosper. भ्वा० पर० अक० सेट् ।
19560: दृहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Grown, increased, thriven.  E. दृह् to grow, affix क्त with इट् inserted; also from दृहि, दृंहित ।
19561: दॄ r. 9th cl. (दृणाति) To tear, to rend, to divide or pull to pieces. r. 1st cl. (दरति) To fear, to dread. क्या-प्वा० पर० अक० सेट् । भ्वा० पर० सक० सेट् । दिवा० पर० सक० सेट् । दीर्य्यति ।
19562: दे (ङ) देङ् r. 1st cl. (दयते) To preserve, to cherish or protect. भ्वा० आ० सक० अनिट् ।
19563: देदीप्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Shining repeatedly or intensely, glowing, blazing.  E. दोप to kindle, intense, form, शानच् aff.
19564: देय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To given, fit or proper for a gift.  E. दा to give, कर्मणि यत् affix, and the vowel changed.
19565: देव (ऋ) देवृ r. 1st cl. (देवते) To sport or play. भ्वा० आ० अक० सेट् ।
19566: देव m. (-वः) 	 1. A deity, a god. 	 2. A king, in poetical language. 	 3. A husbands's brother: see देवृ. 	 4. A cloud. 	 5. A fool, a dolt. 	 6. A child. 	 7. A man following any particular line or business. 	 8. A spear-man, a lancer. 	 9. Emulation, wish to excel or overcome. 10. Sport, play. 	 11. A term or surname applicable to a Bramhan; also to a man of the kayestha class. 	 n. (-वं) An organ of sense. 	 f. (-वी) 	 1. A flower, (Hibiscus mutabilis.) 	 2. A plant, (Marsilea quadrifolia.) 	 f. (-वी) 	 1. A goddess, the wife of any deity of divine being. 	 2. A name very commonly applied to the goddess DURGĀ. 3. 19568: देवकर्दम m. (-मः) A fragrant paste of sandal, agallochum, camphor, and safflower.  E. देव, and कर्दम mud.
19569: देवकात्मजा f. (-जा) The mother of KRISHNA.  E. देवक as above, and आत्मजा daughter.
19570: देवकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Worship of, or oblations to the gods.  E. देव,, and कार्य्य business.
19571: देवकाष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) A kind of pine: (Pinus devadaru.)  E. देव divine, and काष्ठ wood.
19572: देवकिरी f. (-री) One of the female personifications of the modes of music.
19573: देवकी f. (-की) DEVAKĪ, the daughter of DEVAKA, wife of VĀSUDEVA, and mother of KRISHNA.  E. देवक, अञ् patronymic affix, fem. affix ङीष्; also with the vowel changed by the affix, दैवकी.
19574: देवकीनन्दन m. (-नः) A name of KRISHNA.  E. देवकी as above, and नन्दन a son.
19575: देवकीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Divine, belonging or relating to a divinity. E. देव, and छ aff.

19577: देवकुण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A natural spring.  E. देव, and कुण्ड a well.
19578: देवकुल n. (-लं) A temple.  E. देव a god, and कुल a house.
19579: देवकुसुम n. (-मं) Cloves.  E. देव a deity, and कुसुम a flower fit for a deity.
19580: देवखात n. (-तं) 	 1. A cave or hollow a midst mountains. 	 2. A natural pond or reservoir.  E. देव a deity, and खात dug; not the work of men.
19581: देवखातक mn. (-कः-कं) 	 1. A natural pond or one in front of a temple. 2. A natural cavern, a grotto.  E. देव a deity, खात dug, and कन् affix; dug by divine hands, or in honour of a god.
19582: देवखातविल n. (-लं) A cavern, a chasm.  E. देवखात, and विल a hole.
19583: देवगान्धारी f. (-री) One of the Rāginis, or female personification of the modes of music.
19584: देवगायन m. (-नः) A Gandharba, a celestial quirister.  E. देव a god, and गायन a singer.
19585: देवगिरी f. (-री) One of the female personifications of the modes of music.
19586: देवगुरु m. (-रुः) A name of VRIHASPATI.  E. देव, and गुरु teacher; the preceptor of the gods.
19587: देवगृह n. (-हं) 	 1. A celestial or planetary sphere, the dwelling of the gods. 	 2. A temple.  E. देव, and गृह house.
19588: देवचिकित्सक m. du. (-कौ) The two sons of ASWINĪ, and physicians of heaven.  E. देव a god, and चिकित्सक a physician.
19589: देवच्छन्द m. (-न्दः) A garland or necklace of pearls, &c. composed of 100 strings.  E. देव a deity, and छदि to cover, affix घञ् ।
19590: देवजग्ध n. (-ग्धं) A fragrant grass.  E. देव a deity, and जग्ध eaten.
19591: देवजग्धक n. (-कं) A fragrant grass.  E. कन् pleonastic, added to the preceding.
19592: देवट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) An artist, an artisan.  E. दिव् to sport, अटन् Unādi aff.
19593: देवट्टी f. (-ट्टी) A sort of gull, (Larus ridibundus.) गङ्गाचिल्ल्याम् ।
19594: देवतरु m. (-रुः) The holy fig tree. 	 2. A tree of Swarga or paradise, the Mandāra tree. 	 3. The tree of plenty. 	 4. Any venerable and ancient tree: usually the place of assembling in a village.  E. देव a deity, and तरु a tree.
19595: देवता f. (-ता) 	 1. A god, a deity or divine being. 	 2. Divinity; see देवत्व. E. देव divine, स्वार्थे तल् affix of the abstract: in the first case, अन् added; of whom the attribute is divinity.
19596: देवतागार m. (-रः) A temple.  E. देवता, and आगार a house.
19597: देवताड m. (-डः) 	 1. A kind of grass, (Andropogon serratus.) 	 2. A name of Rāhu, the personified ascending node. 	 3. A name or fire. 	 4. A sort of creeper: see घोषक.  E. देव a deity, &c. तड् to torment, affix अण्.
19598: देवताडक m. (-कः) A grass: see the preceding.  E. कन् added to देवताड ।
19599: देवताधिप m. (-पः) A name of INDRA.  E. देवता a deity, अधिप ruler or chief.
19600: देवताभ्यर्च्चन n. (-नं) Worshipping an idol.  E. देवता, and अभ्यर्च्चन wor-shipping.
19601: देवतायतन n. (-नं) A temple.  E. देवता, and आयतन dwelling.
19602: देवतीर्थ n. (-र्थं) The part of the hand sacred to the gods, the tips of the fingers.  E. देव, and तीर्थ a shrine.
19603: देवत्व n. (-त्वं) 	 1. Divinity, the abstract attribute of divine being. 	 2. Identification with a deity, deification.  E. देव a deity, and त्व abs-tract affix; also with तल् देवता ।
19604: देवदत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Given by the gods, god-given. 	 m. (-त्तः) 1. The younger brother of Buddha. 	 2. The conch of ARJUNA. 	 3. One of the vital airs that which is exhaled in yawning E. देव a deity, and दत्त given; the name is often used in gram-matical and other examples, in the place of some one, a certain person, &c.
19605: देवदत्ताग्रज m. (-जः) A name of Buddha.  E. देवदत्त as above, and अग्रज elder born.
19606: देवदानी f. (-नी) A sort of creeper, commonly Hātighoshā.  E. देव a deity, and दान a gift, भावे ल्युठ् । fem. affix ङीष् ।
19607: देवदारु mn. (-रुः-रु) A species of pine, (Pinus devadaru;) in Bengal it is usually applied to the Uvaria longifolia, and in the Peninsula to another tree, (Erythroxylon sideroxylloides.)  E. देव a deity, and दारु timber.
19608: देवदासी f. (-सी) A courtezan, especially one employed as a dancer, &c. in a temple.  E. देव a deity, and दासी a female slave.
19609: देवदीप m. (-पः) An eye.  E. देव an organ of sense, and दीप a lamp.
19610: देवदूती f. (-ती) 	 1. A female messenger of the gods. 	 2. A sort of plant; also मधुकुक्कुटी.  E. देव, and दूती a messenger.
19611: देवदेव m. (-वः) 	 1. A name of BRAMHĀ. 	 2. A name of SIVA.  E. देव god, repeated; god of gods.
19612: देवद्रोणी f. (-णी) The procession of a deity or idol.  E. देव a deity, द्रुण्, to go, affixes घञ् and ङीप् ।
19613: देवद्र्यञ्च् mfn. (-द्र्यङ्-द्रीची-द्र्यक्) Approaching or adoring a deity.  E. देव an idol, अञ्च् to go to or to worship, affix क्विप्, and द्रि inserted.
19614: देवधान्य n. (-न्यं) A sort of grain cultivated in many parts of Hindustan, (Andropogon saccharatus.)  E. देव a deity, and धान्य corn.
19615: देवधूप m. (-पः) A fragrant resin, (Bdellium,) used in the incense.  E. देव a deity, and धूप incense.
19616: देवन् m. (-वा) A husband's brother.  E. दिव् to play. अन् Unādi aff.
19617: देवन n. (-नं) 	 1. Sport, play, pastime, &c. 	 2. Emulation, desire to excel or overcome. 	 3. Affair, business, profession. 	 4. Gaming. 	 5. Splen-dour, lustre, beauty. 	 6. Light. 	 7. Praise. 	 8. Motion. 	 9. Grief, sorrow. 	 10. A garden, a play or pleasure ground. 	 11. A lotus. 	 m. (-नः) A die or dice. 	 f. (-ना) 	 1. Service. 	 2. Sport, wanton sport or pastime.  E. दिव् to play, &c. affix ल्युट्, or युच्, fem. aff टाप् ।
19618: देवनन्दिन् m. (-न्दी) One of INDRA'S doorkeepers.  E. देव a deity, and नन्दिन् who pleases.
19619: देवनल m. (-लः) A kind of reed, (Arundo bengalensis)  E. देव, and नल a reed; also read देवनाल ।
19620: देवनारक m. (-कः) A superhuman being, also देवनामक ।
19621: देवनिकाय m. (-यः) A heaven, a paradise, the residence of a divinity. E. देव, and निकाय abode.
19622: देवनिन्दक m. (-कः) A heretic, an unbeliever, a reviler of the gods. E. देव, and निन्दक a calumniator.
19623: देवनिन्दा f. (-न्दा) Heresy. atheism.  E. देव, and निन्दा abuse.
19624: देवनिर्मित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Natural, created.  E. देव, and निर्मित made by.
19625: देवपति m. (-तिः) A name of INDRA.  E. देव a deity, and पति master.
19626: देवपत्नी f. (-त्नी) 	 1. The wife of a deity. 	 2. Sweet potato.  E. देव a deity, &c. and पत्नी wife.
19627: देवपथ f. (-थः) Heaven, the firmament, the celestial path or way.  E. देव a deity, and पथिन् a road, final affix अ ।
19628: देवपद n. (-दं) The royal presence.  E. देव, and पद for पाद a foot; also देवपाद ।
19629: देवपर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Addicted to play. 	 2. Future, what will be, (predestined, &c.) see दैवपर ।
19630: देवपशु m. (-शुः) An animal consecrated to a deity.  E. देव, and पशु an animal.
19631: देवपुत्त्री f. (-त्त्री) A medicinal plant: see पृक्का.  E. देव a deity, and पुत्त्री a daughter.
19632: देवपुर f. (-पूः) The capital of INDRA.  E. देव a god, and पुर् a city.
19633: देवप्रतिमा f. (-मा) An idol.  E. देव, and प्रतिमा image.
19634: देवप्रश्न n. (-श्नं) Astrology, consulting the stars or gods.  E. देव a deity, and प्रश्न asking.
19635: देवबल्लभ m. (-भः) A tree used in dying, (Rottleria tinctoria, Rox.) See पुन्नाम.  E. देव a deity, and बल्लभ a friend.
19636: देवब्रह्मन् m. (-ह्मा) A name of the Muni NĀRADA.  E. देव a deity, ब्रह्मन् BRAMHĀ; BRAMHĀ amongst the saints and demigods.
19637: देवब्राह्मण m. (-णः) A venerable Brahman, one esteemed by deities. E. देव, and ब्राह्मण a Brahman or देवपूजकः ब्राह्यणः । देवले ।
19638: देवभवन n. (-नं) 	 1. The holy fig tree. 	 2. Paradise. 	 3. A temple.  E. देव a deity, and भवन a dwelling.
19639: देवभाज् mfn. (-क् or -ग्) Belonging to a god.  E. देब, and भाज् what has.
19640: देवभू m. (-भूः) 	 1. A deity. 	 2. Swarga or paradise.  E. देव divine, and भू being.
19641: देवभूति f. (-तिः) The Ganges of heaven.  E. देव a deity, and भूति being, abiding. देवानामैश्वर्य्येच ।
19642: देवभूय n. (-यं) 	 1. Divinity, godhead. 	 2. Inferior deification or identifica-tion with a deity.  E. देव a deity, and भूय being, becoming.
19643: देवमञ्जर n. (-रं) The jewel of KRISHNA suspended on his breast.
19644: देवमणि m. (-णिः) 	 1. A name of SIVA. 	 2. The jewel of KRISHNA. 	 3. A twist of hair on a horse's neck.  E. देव a deity, मणि a jewel.
19645: देवमातृ f. (-ता) A name of ADITI.  E. देव, and मातृ a mother; the mother of gods.
19646: देवमातृक mfn. (-कः-का-की-कं) Watered by rain, (corn, land, &c.)  E. देव a cloud, मातृ a mother, and कप् affix; cherished by the clouds as by a parent.
19647: देवमानक m. (-कः) The jewel worn by KRISHNA: see कौस्तुभ.  E. देव a deity, मान respect, affix कन्. or कप्
19648: देवमास m. (-सः) The eighth month of pregnancy; also देवमासक.  E. देव divine, and मास a month.
19649: देवयज् m. (-यक्) A worshipper of the gods.  E. देव, and यज् to worship, क्विप् aff.
19650: देवयजि m. (-जिः) 	 1. A worshipper of the gods. 	 2. A Muni.  E. देव, and यजि who worships. देवं यजते यज्-इन्.
19651: देवयज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) The Homa or burnt sacrifice.  E. देव, and यज्ञ sacrifice; the sacrifice appropriated to the gods.
19652: देवयात्रा f. (-त्रा) The procession of a deity or idol, or sacred festival when the images are carried in procession.  E. देव a god, and यात्रा going. देवानां यात्रा ।
19653: देवयान n. (-नं) The car or vehicle of god. 	 f. (-नी) The daughter of SUKRA.  E. देव a deity, and यान going. यायते अनेन या-करणे ल्युट् ।
19654: देवयितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Sporting, playing.  E. देव to play, शतृ aff.
19655: देवयु mfn. (-युः-युः-यु) 	 1. Pious, righteous, virtuous. 	 2. Frequenting holy festivals. 	 m. (-युः) A deity.  E. देव a deity, या to go, Unadi affix कु ।
19656: देवयोनि m. (-निः) A superhuman being, a demon or demigod.  E. देव a deity, and योनि place of production.
19657: देवर m. (-रः) A husband's brother, especially his younger brother. E. देव् to play, &c. affix अरच् । दीव्यते अनेन दिव-करणे अरच् ।
19658: देवरथ m. (-थः) The car or vehicle of a deity.  E. देव a deity, and रथ a carriage.
19659: देवराज m. (-जः) INDRA.  E. देव a deity, राजन् a king, and टच् aff.
19660: देवरात m. (-तः) 	 1. A sort of crane. 	 2. The name of a king; also Parikshit.
19661: देवरूपिन् mfn. (-पी-पिणी-पि) Godlike, of divine form.  E. देव, and रूप form. इनि aff.
19662: देवर्षि m. (-र्षिः) A Rishi, a saint of the celestial class, as NĀRADA, ATRI, MARĪCHĪ, BHARADWĀJA, PULASTYA, PULAHA, KRATU, BHRIGU, VASISHTHA, PRACHETAS; also BHARATA, TUMBURU, KANĀDA, and others.  E. देव divine, and ऋषि a saint: see ऋषि, and राजर्षि ।
19663: देवल m. (-लः) 	 1. An attendant upon an idol; a Brahman of an inferior order, who subsists upon the offerings made to the images which he attends, and who conducts the ceremonies of all sorts of people for hire. 	 2. A Muni; according to some authorities, a name of NĀ-RADA; to others, of a different saint, who is also a legislator, the son of ASITA and also named ASHTĀVAKRA. 	 3. A husband's bro-ther: see देवर. 	 4. A holy or virtuous man.  E. देव a deity, ला to bring, and क aff. or देव-कलच् ।
19664: देवलक m. (-कः) The attendant on an idol: see the preceding.  E. कन् added to देवल ।
19665: देवलता f. (-ता) Double jasmine.  E. देव divine, and लता a creeper.
19666: देवलोक m. (-कः) 	 1. Heaven or paradise. 	 2. Any one of the seven superior worlds, from earth to the highest or Satya loka, in op-position to those below the earth. 	 3. The particular sphere or heaven of any divinity.  E. देव, and लोक a world.
19667: देववक्त्र m. (-क्त्रः) Fire or its deity AGNI.  E. देव a deity, and वक्त्र a face, here implying, mouth; the mouth of the gods, eating or con-suming the oblations made to them.
19668: देववल्लभ m. (-भः) A tree: see पुन्नाग ।
19669: देववर m. (-रः) A superior or supreme deity. 	 n. (-रं) A divine boon or blessing.  E. देव, and वर best.
19670: देववर्द्धकि m. (-किः) A name of VIŚWAKARMĀ, the divine architect. E. देव a deity, वर्द्धकि a carpenter.
19671: देववृक्ष m. (-क्षः) 	 1. A tree, (Echites scholaris.) 	 2. A tree of heaven or paradise. 	 3. A plant yielding a fragrant resin, (Bdellium.)  E. देव a god, वृक्ष a tree.
19672: देवव्रत m. (-तः) 	 1. A worshipper of the gods. 	 2. A name of BHĪSHMA. n. (-तं) Any obligation or vow of a deity.  E. देव a deity, and व्रत religious obligation.
19673: देवश्रुत m. (-तः) A god. 	 2. A sacred treatise or branch of scripture. 	 3. A name of NĀRADA.  E. देव divine, and श्रुत heard.
19674: देवसभा f. (-भा) An assembly of the gods.  E. देव a deity, and सभा assembly.
19675: देवसभ्य m. (-भ्यः) 	 1. A player, a gambler, a frequenter of clubs or assem-blies. 	 2. An attendant on a deity.  E. देव sport in general, or gam-bling, सभा an assembly, and यत् aff.
19676: देवसन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Divine, relating to a deity.  E. देव, and सन्ध con-nected.
19677: देवसहा f. (-हा) A small shrub: see सहदेवा.  E. देव a deity, सह् to bear, affixes टाप् and अञ् ।
19678: देवसात् ind. In or on a deity, becoming as a deity, appropriate or offer-ed to one.  E. देव, and साति aff.
19679: देवसायुज्य n. (-ज्यं) 	 1. Inferior deification, the state or being of the infe-rior gods. 	 2. Absorption into or identification with a deity.  E. देव a god, स with युज् to join or be joined, affix क्विप्, देवसयुज् junc-tion with a deity, ष्यञ् added, implying the state or condition.
19680: देवसृष्टा f. (-ष्टा) Spirituous liquor.  E. देव, and सृष्ट created, made by the gods.
19681: देवसेना f. (-ना) 	 1. The daughter of INDRA. 	 2. An army or host of celes-tials.  E. देव Indra or any deity, and सेना an army.
19682: देवसेनापति m. (-तिः) A name of SKANDA.  E. देवसेना as above, and पति ruler; commander of the hosts of heaven.
19683: देवस्व n. (-स्वं) The property applicable to religious purpose, endowment, &c.  E. देव divine, and स्व wealth.
19684: देवाजीव m. (-वः) An attendant upon an idol, a low Brahman, subsist-ing by attendance upon an image, and upon the offerings made to it.  E. देव a deity, and आजीव who gets a livelihood; also इनि added देवाजीविन् m. (-वी.)
19685: देवात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) 	 1. One with or identified with a deity. 	 2. Belonging to a deity, consecrated, sacred. 	 m. (-त्मा) The holy, fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.)  E. देव, and आत्मन् the self or soul.
19686: देवानाम्प्रिय m. (-यः) 	 1. A goat. 	 2. An ascetic, one who relinquishes or abandons the world. 	 3. A fool, an ideot.  E. देव in the second case plural, and प्रिय beloved; the beloved of the gods.
19687: देवान्न n. (-न्नं) Rice or food that has been first presented to an idol. E. देव, and अन्न food.
19688: देवापि m. (-पिः) The son of PRATĪPA, supposed to be still alive, near the Sumeru mountain.
19689: देवाभीष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Sacred, dedicated to a deity. 	 f. (-ष्टा) Betel, (Piper betel.)  E. देव, and अभीष्ट wished.
19690: देवायतन n. (-नं) A temple.  E. देव, and आयतन abode.
19691: देवायुध n. (-धं) The rainbow.  E. देव, and आयुध a weapon.
19692: देवालय n. (-यं) 	 1. A division of heaven, the residence of the gods. 	 2. A temple.  E. देव, and आलय an asylum.
19693: देवाला f. (-ला) One of the female personifications of the modes of music.  E. देव a deity, and अल adopted to, fem. affix टाप् ।
19694: देवार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) Divine, worthy of the gods.  E. देव, and अर्ह fit for.
19695: देवावास m. (-सः) 	 1. A temple. 	 2. The holy fig tree.  E. देव a deity, and आवास abode.
19696: देवाश्व m. (-श्वः) The horse of INDRA.  E. देव a deity, and अश्व a horse.
19697: देविक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Appertaining to or derived from a deity. E. देव, and ठन् affix; also देविय and देविल ।
19698: देविका f. (-का) The name of a river, the Saraju or Deva.  E. देवी, and कन् affix, fem form.
19699: देविल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Virtuous, pious, just. 	 2. Appertaining to a deity: see देविक.  E. देव, and इलच् Unādi aff.
19701: देवीकोट्ट m. (-ट्टः) A town, the city of VĀNA, probably DEVICOTTA, on the Coromandel coast.  E. देवी a name of DURGA, and कोट्ट a house or abode.
19702: देवृ m. (-वा) 	 1. A husbands's brother, but especially his younger brother. 2. The husband of a woman previously married.  E. दिव् to play, Unādi affix ऋण्.
19703: देवेज्य m. (-ज्यः) A name of VRIHASPATI.  E. देव a deity, and इज्य a tea-cher, the Guru or spiritual preceptor of the gods.
