20049: द्वय mn. (-यः-यं) A pair, a couple, two, chiefly used in composition, as पुरुषद्वयं two men.  E. द्वि two, तयप् aff.
20051: द्वयातिग m. (-गः) A saint, a holy or virtuous man.  E. द्वय a pair, the two bad qualities, passion and ignorance, अति beyond, and ग who goes.
20052: द्वाःस्थ m. (-स्थः) 	 1. A warder, a porter. 	 2. NANDI, one of SIVA'S door-keepers.  E. द्वार् a door, and स्थ who stays; also द्वास्थ ।
20053: द्वाःस्थित m. (-तः) A door-keeper, a warder.  E. द्वार् a door, and स्थित staying; also द्वास्थित ।
20054: द्वाःस्थितदर्शक m. (-कः) A warder, a porter, a chamberlain.  E. द्वार् a door, स्थित staying, and दर्शक who shows, who introduces to the prince or great man to whom the mansion belongs; also द्वाःस्थित, and दर्शक severally; also द्वाःस्थितदर्शीन् m. (-र्शी.)
20055: द्वात्रिंशदक्षरिन् m. (-री) A book or composition.  E. द्वात्रिंशत् thirty-two, अक्षर a letter, a consonant, इनि affix; formed of thirty-two letters.
20056: द्वात्रिंशल्लक्षणोपेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Having thirty-two auspicious marks, illustrious, great.  E. द्वात्रिंशत् thirty-two, लक्षण a mark, उपेत possess-ing, endowed with.
20057: द्वादश mf. (-शः-शी) Twelfth. 	 f. (-शी) The twelfth day of the half month E. द्वादशन्, and टच् aff.
20058: द्वादशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Consisting of twelve, amounting to twelve, &c. E. कन् added to the last.
20059: द्वादशकर m. (-रः) 	 1. A name of VRIHASPATI. 	 2. A name of KĀBTIKEYA. E. द्वादश twelve, and कर a hand or ray.
20060: द्वादशन् mfn. plu. (-श) Twelve.  E. द्वा for द्वि two, and दशन् ten.
20061: द्वादशपत्रक n. (-कं) A particular religious observance.  E. द्वादश, and पत्र leaf or part, कन् added.
20062: द्वादशलोचन m. (-नः) The god KĀRTIKEYA.  E. द्वादश twelve, and लोचन an eye; the twelve-eyed, or six-headed deity.
20063: द्वादशांशु m. (-शुः) The deity VRIHASPATI, or planet Jupiter, over which he presides.  E. द्वादश twelve, and अंशु a ray.
20064: द्वादशाक्ष m. (-क्षः) 	 1. The god KĀRTIKEYA. 	 2. The deity or sage Buddha. E. द्वादश twelve, and अक्ष an eye: the word is sometimes read in the second sense, द्वादशाख्य m. (-ख्यः) the twelve named.
20065: द्वादशाक्षरमन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) A prayer of twelve syllables, especially as address-ed to VISHNU, or Om, BHAGAVATE, VASUDEVAYA, RĀMĀYA. E. द्वादश, अक्षर a letter, and मन्त्र formulæ.
20066: द्वादशाङ्गुल m. (-लः) A measure of twelve fingers.  E. द्वादश, and अङ्गुल a finger.
20067: द्वादशात्मन् m. (-त्मा) The sun.  E. द्वादश twelve, and आत्मन् identity; being represented in and identified with the twelve Adityas, or the sun in each month of the year; also द्वादशात्मक ।
20068: द्वादशायुस् m. (-युः) A dog.  E. द्वादश twelve, (years,) and आयुस् life.
20069: द्वादशार्च्चिस् m. (-र्च्चिः) VRIHASPATI, regent of Jupiter, and precepter of the gods.  E. द्वादश twelve, and अर्च्चिस् a ray of light.
20070: द्वादशास्र nf. (-स्रं-स्री) A parallelopipedon, a dodecagonal figure.  E. द्वादश, and अस्र an angle.
20071: द्वापर m. (-रः) 	 1. The third of the four Yugas or great periods, compris-ing 864,000 years. 	 2. The age personified as a god. 	 3. Doubt, un-certainty.  E. द्वा for द्वि two, पर after.
20072: द्वार् f. (-द्वाः) 	 1. A door, a gate. 	 2. A means, an expedient, a medium or way by which any thing takes place or is effected.  E. द्वृ to cover or hold, in the causal form, affix विच् ।
20073: द्वार n. (-रं) 	 1. A door, a gate, or rather the door or gateway, a passage, an entrance. 	 2. A way, a means, a medium or vehicle.  E. द्वृ to cover, affix अच् ।
20074: द्वारक mf. (-कः-का) Dwarakā the capital of KRISHNA, supposed to have been submerged by the sea, but represented by a small island of the north part of the Malaber coast.  E. द्वार a way, (to salvation,) affix कन्; also द्वारिका, द्वारवती, &c.
20075: द्वारकण्टक m. (-कः) A door, gate, the door itself.  E. द्वार a doorway, and कण्टक a thorn.
20076: द्वारकेश m. (-शः) A name of KRISHNA.  E. द्वारक as above, and ईश master.
20077: द्वारपाल m. (-लः) A warder, a door-keeper.  E. द्वार a door, and पाल who protects; also with कन् added द्वारपालक, or with the radical finals dropped द्वारप ।
20078: द्वारपिण्डी f. (-ण्डी) the threshold of a door.  E. द्वार a door, and पिण्ड a ball.
20079: द्वारयन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) A lock, a bolt.  E. द्वार a door, and यन्त्र an instrument.
20080: द्वारवती f. (-ती) The city Dwārakā.  E. द्वार a door, and मतुप् poss. affix; also द्वारावती ।
20081: द्वारवलिभुज् m. (-भुक्) The Vaka, a sort of crane, (Ardea nivea.)  E. द्वार a door, वलि offal or fragments, and भुज् who eats.
20082: द्वारशाखा f. (-खा) The leaf of a door.  E. द्वार a door, and शाखा a branch.
20083: द्वारस्तम्भ m. (-म्भः) A door-post.  E. द्वार, and स्तम्भ a post.
20084: द्वारस्थ m. (-स्थः) A door-keeper.  E. द्वार a gate, and स्थ who stays.
20086: द्वारिक m. (-कः) A door-keeper, a warder.  E. द्वार a door, and ठक् affix f. (-का) Dwārakā, KRISHNA'S capital: see द्वारक.  E. द्वार, and ठन् aff.
20087: द्वारिन् m. (-री) A porter, a warder, a door-keeper.  E. द्वार, and इनि aff.
20088: द्वास्थ m. (-स्थः) A door-keeper, a warder.  E. द्वार् a door, स्थ who stays, and र rejected; also र being changed to Visarga, द्वाःस्थ ।
20089: द्वास्थित m. (-तः) A door-keeper.  E. द्वार, and स्थित who stays; also द्वाःस्थित; see the last.
20090: द्वास्थितदशक m. (-कः) A door-keeper: see द्वाःस्थितदर्शक, &c.
20091: द्वि dual only. 	 mf. (-द्वौ) 	 n. (-द्वे) Two. 	 m. (-द्विः) Two, (of times, &c.) is only used in composition, as अतिद्वि a thing more than two, and inflected like other nouns in इः in composition with other nume-rals, it is changed to द्वा, as द्वादश twelve, द्वाविंशति twenty-two, द्वात्रिंशत् thirty-two, &c.
20092: द्विक m. (-कः) 	 1. A crow. 	 2. The ruddy goose.  E. द्वि two, and क the letter क, as in काक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Two. 	 2. Twice. 	 3. Two-fold. E. द्वि two, कन् pleonastic aff.
20093: द्विककार m. (-रः) A crow.  E. द्वि two or twice, and ककार the letter क, as in काक.
20094: द्विककुद् m. (-द्) A camel.  E. द्वि two, and ककुद् a hump.
20095: द्विकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Who or what makes two of any thing.  E. द्वि and कृ to make, अच् aff.
20096: द्विगु m. (-गुः) A form of grammatical combination, that in which the first member of the compound is a numeral.
20097: द्विगुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 	 1. Twice, two times. 	 2. Multiplied by two, doubled.  E. द्वि two, and गुण number.
20098: द्विगुणाकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Twice ploughed.  E. द्विगुणा twice, and कृत ploughed.
20099: द्विगुणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Doubled, multiplied by two. 	 2. Folded, doubled. 	 3. Inverted, enveloped.  E. द्वि, and गुण a time, इतच् aff.
20100: द्विगुणीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Doubled. 	 2. Increased.  E. द्विगुण twice, कृत made, च्वि augment.
20101: द्विगुणीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Doubled. 	 2. Augmented.  E. द्विगुण twice, भूत become, च्वि augment.
20102: द्विज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 	 1. Twice born. 	 2. Oviparous. 	 m. (-जः) 	 1. A man of either of the three first classes, a Brahman, a Kshetriya or a Vaisya whose investiture with the characteristic string, at years of puberty, constitutes, religiously and metaphorically, their second birth. 	 2. Any oviparous animal, as a bird, a snake, a fish, &c. first born in the shell, and in the second instance produced from it. 	 3. A tooth. 	 4. Coriander seed. 	 f. (-जा) 	 1. A sort of perfume also called Renukā. 	 2. A plant. (Siphonanthus Indicus.) 	 3. Kundur or gum olebanum.  E. द्वि two, and ज born. द्विः जायते । जन ड ।
20103: द्विजकुत्सित m. (-तः) A tree, (Cordia myxa.)  E. द्विज a bird, कुत्सित reviled, disregarded. द्विजैः कुत्सितः । (नोना आता) द्विजानां तद्भक्षण निषेधात् तथात्वम् ।
20104: द्विजन्मन् mfn. (-न्मा-न्मा-न्म) 	 1. Twice born, regenerate. 	 2. Oviparous m. (-न्मा) 	 1. A tooth. 	 2. A Brahman. 	 3. A bird. 	 4. A man of the three first classes. 	 5. Any oviparous animal: see द्विज.  E. द्वि twice, जन्मन् birth.
20105: द्विजदास m. (-सः) A Sudra or man of the fourth and servile tribe. E. द्विज a man of either of the three first castes, and दास a slave.
20106: द्विजपति m. (-तिः) The moon.  E. द्विज a Brahman, and पति master. १ चन्द्रे २ कर्पूरे ४ द्विजश्रेष्ठे ५ पक्षिश्रेष्ठे ६ गरुडे ।
20107: द्विजप्रपा f. (-पा) A trough near a well for watering birds, cattle, &c. E. द्विज a bird, &c. and प्र prefixed to पा to drink, affixes अङ् and टाप्. द्विजार्थं पक्षिणमुद्दिश्य प्रषा । आलवाले ।
20108: द्विजप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Acceptable or friendly to a man of the three first classes, or a Brahman especially. 	 f. (-या) The moonplant, (Asclepias acida.)  E. द्विज a Brahman, and प्रिय beloved, the acid juice being drank at certain sacrifices.
20109: द्विजब्रुव m. (-वः) A Brahman by birth only, one not studied or not practising the duties of his caste.  E. द्विज a Brahman, and ब्रुव who speaks.
20110: द्विजराज m. (-जः) 	 1. The moon. 	 2. The great serpent ANANTA. 	 3. The bird and vehicle of VISHNU. 	 4. Camphor.  E. द्विज a snake or bird, and राज king. see द्विजपति.
20111: द्विजलिङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) 	 1. A Kshetriya or man of the military tribe 2. An impostor, a pretended Brahman, wearing the distinguishing mark of that tribe without belonging to it.  E. द्विज twice born, and लिङ्ग a mark, इनि aff.
20112: द्विजवर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) An excellent or superior Brahman.  E. द्विज and वर्य्य excellent.
20113: द्विजब्रण m. (-णः) Gumboil, toothache.  E. द्विज a tooth, ब्रण a sore.
20114: द्विजशप्त m. (-प्तः) A sort of pulse; also called Rāja-māsh-kalai and Barbatti, (Dolichos catjang.)  E. द्विज a Brahman, and शप्त cursed; it is a prohibited food on some occasions.
20115: द्विजशुश्रूषा f. (-षा) Service of the three first classes, especially of the Brahmans, by the forth.  E. द्विज and शुश्रूषा service.
20116: द्विजसत्तम m. (-मः) A respectable Brahman.  E. द्विज and सत्तम best; also द्विजवर द्विजप्रवर &c.
20117: द्विजसेवक m. (-कः) A Sudra or man of the fourth and servile class. E. द्विज a man of the three first classes, and सेवक a servant.
20118: द्विजसेवा f. (-वा) Service of the three first classes, especially of the Brahman by the fourth.  E. द्विज, and सेवा service.
20119: द्विजाग्र्य m. (-ग्र्यः) A chief or respectable Brahman.  E. द्विज, and अग्र्य first.
20120: द्विजाङ्गी f. (-ङ्गी) A medicinal plant; also कटुरोहिणी ।
20121: द्विजाति f. (-तिः) 	 1. A Brahman. 	 2. A man of either of the three first classes. 	 3. Any oviparous animal, as a bird, a snake, &c.  E. द्वि two, जाति birth. द्विः जातिः जन्म यस्य ।
20122: द्विजानुलोम n. (-मं) The regular order or series of the three first classes. E. द्विज, and अनुलोम with the hair.
20123: द्विजायनी f. (-नी) The characteristic thread or cord which designates the three first classes of the Hindus.  E. द्विज twice-born, ल्युट् affix, fem. affix ङीप् । द्विजः अय्यते ज्ञायते अनया । यज्ञोपवीते ।
20124: द्विजालय m. (-यः) 	 1. The hollow of a tree. 	 2. The residence of Brah-mans.  E. द्विज a bird, or a Brahman, and आलय an asylum.
20125: द्विजिह्व (mfn.) (-ह्वः-ह्वा-ह्वं) Double-tongued, (literally or figuratively.) 	 m. (-ह्वः) 	 1. A snake. 	 2. An informer. 	 3. A rogue, a scoundrel, a bad man. 	 4. A thief.  E. द्वि two, जिह्वा the tongue. द्वे जिह्वे यस्य ।
20126: द्विजिह्वता f. (-ता) Insincerity, dishonesty.  E. तल् added to the last.
20127: द्विजोत्तम m. (-लः) 	 1. A Brahman. 	 2. A superior or excellent Brahman. E. द्विज the twice-born, (three first classes,) and उत्तम best.
20128: द्विज्या f. (-ज्या) The sine or chord of an arc.  E. द्वि, and ज्या sine.
20129: द्विज्यामार्ग m. (-र्गं) A horizontal line.  E. द्विज्य, and मार्ग road.
20130: द्विट्सेवा f. (-वा) Treachery.  E. द्विष् a foe, सेवा service.
20131: द्विट्सेविन् n. (-वी) A traitor.  E. द्विट् an enemy, and सेविन् who serves.
20132: द्विठ m. (-ठः) Swāhā, the expression used with an oblation to fire. द्वौ ठकारौ लेखनाकारे यस्य । विसर्गे स्वाहायाम् । ठकारद्वये ।
20133: द्वितय n. (-यं) A couple, a pair, two.  E. द्वि two, तयप् aff.
20134: द्वितीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. Second. 	 2. Two. 	 m. (-यः) A son, a second or successor. 	 f. (-या) 	 1. A wife, according to the ritual, a woman wedded after the ceremony prescribed by the Vedas, a second self as it were. 	 2. The second day of the fortnight.  E. द्वि two, and तीय affix, fem. affix टाप्; also with कन् added, द्वितीयक ।
20135: द्वितीयत्व n. (-त्वं) The circumstance or state of second.  E. द्वितीय, and त्व affix; also with तल्, द्वितीयता ।
20136: द्वितीयत्रिफला f. (-ला) A set of three fruits, the grape, the date, and the Gāmbhāri.  E. द्वितीय second, त्रिफल three fruits.
20137: द्वितीयाकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Twice ploughed, &c. (a field)  E. द्वितीय a second time, and आकृत made.
20138: द्वितीयाभा f. (-भा) A scitamineous plant, (Curcuma zanthorrhiza)  E. द्वितीय second, आभा lustre.
20139: द्वितीयीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Second.  E. द्वितीय, and ईकक pleonasm added.
20140: द्वित्र mfn. plu. always (-त्राः-त्राः-त्राणि) Two or three.  E. द्वि two and त्र for त्रि three.
20141: द्विदत् mfn. (-दन्-दती-दत्) Two-toothed.  E. द्वि two, दत् for दन्त a tooth; in marking age or period the compound is द्विदन्त.
20142: द्विदन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ती-न्तं) Old enough to have two teeth, &c.  E. द्वि, and दन्त a tooth, see the last.
20143: द्विदण्डि ind. Single stick, quarter staff, as द्विदण्डि प्रहरणं fighting with two sticks.  E. द्वि, दण्ड a staff, इच् affix; also similar compounds, as द्विमुषलि, &c.
20144: द्विदश m. plu. (-शाः) Twenty, two tens.  E. द्वि, and दश ten.
20145: द्विदाम्नी f. (-म्नी) A cow tied with two ropes.  E. द्वि, and दामन् a rope.
20146: द्विदेह m. (-हः) A name of GANESA.  E. द्वि two, and देह a body; having the head of an elephant, with the figure of a man. द्वाभ्यां देहोऽस्य ।
20147: द्विदैवत्या f. (-त्या) The constellation Viśākhā.  E. द्वि two, दैवत a deity, and क्यप् affix; INDRA and AGNI jointly presiding over the asterism.
20148: द्विघा ind. Of two kinds, in two ways.  E. द्वि two, धा aff.
20149: द्विधाकरण n. (-णं) Dividing into two parts, arranging in two ways, &c. E. द्विधा, and करण making.
20150: द्विधागति m. (-तिः) A crocodile.  E. द्विधा of two sorts, गति going; amphibious.
20151: द्विधातु mfn. (-तुः-तुः-तु) Having two natures, two roots, &c. 	 m. (-तुः) A name of GANESA.  E. द्वि two or double, धातु nature: see द्विदेह । द्वौ धातू यत्र । धातुद्बयघटिते कांस्यरैत्यादौ, गणेशे च ।
20152: द्विधात्मक n. (-कं) A nutmeg.  E. द्विधा two sorts, and आत्मक being.
20153: द्विधालेख्य mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं) To be written in two ways. 	 m. (-ख्यः) The marshy date tree.  E. द्विधा, and लेख्य to be written or described. द्विप्रकारे लेखनीये हिन्तालवृक्षे च ।
20154: द्विनग्नक m. (-कः) A circumcised man, one having no prepuce.  E. द्वि two, नग्न naked, कन् added; exposed either by want of clothes or skin.
20155: द्विनिष्क mfn. (-ष्कः-ष्का-ष्कं) Bought, &c. with two Nishkas.  E. द्वि, and निष्क a measure of value; also द्विनैष्किक mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
20156: द्विप m. (-पः) 	 1. An elephant. 	 2. A plant, (Mesua ferrea.)  E. द्वि two, and प who drinks, the elephant imbibing fluids by his trunk, and thence conveying them into his mouth. द्वाभ्यां मुखशुण्डाभ्यां पिबति पा-क ।
20157: द्विपथ n. (-थं) A place where two roads meet.  E. द्वि two, पथिन् a road.
20158: द्विपद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 	 1. Two-footed. 	 2. Having two parts. 	 3. Binomial. m. (-दः) A biped, including four genera, gods, demons. men, and birds.  E. द्वि, and पद for पाद a foot.
20159: द्विपदराशि f. (-शिः) Either of the signs, Gemini, Libra, Aquarius, Virgo, and half of Sagittarius.  E. द्विपद, and राशि a sign.
20160: द्विपमद m. (-दः) The elephant's temporal juice.  E. द्विप, and मद the exudation.
20161: द्विपर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं) Two leaved, opposite-leaved.  E. द्वि, and पर्ण a leaf.
20162: द्विपात्त्व n. (-त्त्वं) The having of two feet, two parts, &c.  E. द्विपाद्, and त्व affix; also with तल्, द्विपात्ता.
20163: द्विपाद् mfn. (-पाद्-पती-पत्) Biped, two-footed.  E. द्वि two, and पाद् for पाद a foot.
20164: द्विपाद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Bought, &c. with two quarters. 	 n. (-द्यं) A double penalty, an amercement of twice the common amount. E. द्वि two, पाद a division, and यत् aff.
20165: द्विपायिन् m. (-यी) An elephant.  E. द्वि two, and पायिन् who drinks: see द्विप.
20166: द्विपृष्ट m. (-ष्टः) A proper name; also VASUDEVA. ब्रह्मसम्भवे राजभेदे ।
20167: द्विप्रतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Bought, &c. with two Karshas.  E. द्वि, प्रति for कार्षापण, and ठन् added.
20168: द्विबाहु mfn. (-हुः-ह्वी-हु) Two armed.  E. द्वि, and वाहु an arm.
20169: द्विभुज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 	 1. Two armed. 	 2. An angle or the lines which form it.  E. द्वि two, and भुज an arm.
20170: द्विमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made or consisting of two, (parts of any thing.) E. द्वि, and मयट् aff.
20171: द्विमातृज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Having two mothers, born in two ways; it may be said of some of the deities, thus GANESA was the son of PĀRVATI, but not born in the usual way, being made of the scur of her body; see द्वैमातुर.  E. द्वि two, मातृ a mother, and ज born. द्वाभ्यां मातृभ्यां जायते जन-ड ।
20172: द्विमुख m. (-खः) A serpent. 	 f. (-खा) 	 1. A small water jar. 	 2. A leech. E. द्वि, and मुख mouth; double-headed.
20173: द्विमुखाहि m. (-हिः) A sort of serpent, (Amphisbœna.)  E. द्वि two, मुख face, अहि a snake; the double-headed snake.
20174: द्विमुखोरग m. (-गः) A sort of snake: see the last.  E. द्विमुख as above, and उरग a snake.
20175: द्विमूर्द्ध mfn. (-र्द्धः-र्द्धा-र्द्धं) Two-headed.  E. द्वि two, मूर्द्धन् the fore-head, and यच् aff.
20176: द्विर m. (-रः) A bee: see द्विरेफ.
20177: द्विरद m. (-दः) An elephant.  E. द्वि two, and रद a tooth, having tusks and teeth,
20178: द्विरदान्तक m. (-कः) A lion.  E. द्विरद, and अन्तक destroyer.
20179: द्विरशन n. (-नं) Eating twice a day.  E. द्वि, and अशन् eating.
20180: द्विरसन m. (-नः) A snake in general.  E. द्वि two, रसना the tongue; double or forky-tongued.
20181: द्विरात्र n. (-त्रं) A period of two nights.  E. द्वि, and रात्र for रात्रि night.
20182: द्विराप m. (-पः) An elephant.  E. द्विर् for द्वि two, आङ् prefixed to पा to drink, affix ड; drinking with the trunk and mouth: see द्विप ।
20183: द्विरुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 	 1. Repeated, said twice. 	 2. Said or told in two ways.  E. द्वि, and उक्त said.
20184: द्विरुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 	 1. Tautology, repetition. 	 2. Variety of narration, telling any thing in two ways. 	 3. (In Grammar,) Repetition of a syllable.  E. द्वि, and उक्ति saying.
20185: द्विरुढा f. (-ढा) A woman who has been twice married.  E. द्वि two, उढ a married woman.
20186: द्विरूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पी-पं) 	 1. Of two forms, having a different shape. 2. Spelled or written in two ways. 	 m. (-पः) 	 1. A word that may be correctly spelled in two ways. 	 2. Variety of interpretation or reading.  E. द्वि, and रूप form.
20187: द्विरेफ m. (-फः) A large black bee.  E. द्वि two, रेफ the letter र; having two rs, in the most common name, भ्रमर, Bhramara.
20188: द्विरेफवृन्द n. (-न्दं) A flight or swarm of bees.  E. द्विरेफ, and वृन्द a number.
20189: द्विवर्ष mfn. (-र्षः-र्षी-र्षं) Two years old, &c. 	 f. (-र्षा) A cow two years old. E. द्वि two, वर्ष a year.
20190: द्विवर्षिका f. (-का) A cow two years old.  E. द्विवर्ष, and कन् added.
20191: द्विवर्षीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Two years old, two years standing, &c.  E. द्वि two, वर्ष a year, ख affix; also with ठञ् affix द्विवार्षिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) when futurity is implied, the first vowel is usually changed, as द्वैवार्षिक.
20192: द्विवाहिका f. (-का) A swing, a swinging cot, a litter.  E. द्वि two, वाह to bear, affix ण्वुल्; born usually by two men.
20193: द्विविद m. (-दः) The name of monkey, slain by RĀMA or VISHNŪ in that incarnation.
20194: द्विविदारि m. (-रिः) VISHNŪ.  E. द्विविद as above, अरि the foe.
20195: द्विविध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Of two kinds, in two ways.  E. द्वि, and विध sort.
20196: द्विवेशरा f. (-रा) A kind of carriage.
20197: द्विशफ m. (-फः) Any cloven-footed animal.  E. द्वि and शफ a hoof.
20198: द्विशस् ind. Two, respectively.  E. द्वि two, and शस् aff.
20199: द्विशीर्षक m. (-कः) A name of AGNI.  E. द्वि two, शीर्ष a head, and कन् added.
20200: द्विशूर्प्प mfn. (-र्प्प-र्प्पी-र्प्पं) Bought with two winnowing baskets of any-thing.  E. द्वि, and शूर्प्प a basket; also with ठञ्, द्विशौर्प्पिक, mfn. (-कः-की-कं.)
20201: द्विशृङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) A sort of fish, commonly called Marmaka.  E. द्वि two, शृङ्ग a horn, and इनि aff.
20202: द्विष r. 1st cl. द्विषति also (औ) औद्विष r. 2nd cl. (द्वेष्टि-ष्टे) plu. (द्विषन्ति) To hate, to dislike, to be hostile or unfriendly. अदा० उभ० सक० अनिट् ।
20203: द्विष् mfn. (द्विट्) Inimical, hostile. 	 m. (द्विट्) An enemy.  E. द्विष् to hate, affix क्विप्; also with क affix द्विष m. (-षः) or mfn. (-षः-षा-षं.)
20204: द्विषत् mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्) 	 1. Hating or detesting, hostile. 	 2. Inimical, unfriendly. 	 m. (-न्) An enemy.  E. द्विष् to hate, participal aff. शतृ.
20205: द्विषतीताप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Vexing or harassing an enemy.  E. द्विषत् and ताप who afflicts, with च्वि augment.
20206: द्विषन्तप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Punishing or annoying an enemy, revenging, retaliating.  E. द्विष an enemy, तप् to burn, affix खच्.
20207: द्विष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Hated, dislike. 	 n. (-ष्टं) Copper: see द्व्यष्ट.  E. द्विष् to hate, affix क्त.
20208: द्विष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Staying in two shapes or places, &c.  E. द्वि two, and स्थ what is or abides. द्वयो स्तिष्ठति स्था-क ।
20209: द्विसप्ताह m. (-हः) A fortnight.  E. द्वि twice, सप्त seven, and अह a day. twice seven days.
20210: द्विसम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Consisting of two equal portions, &c.  E. द्वि two, सम equal. द्वि समे परिमाणमस्य ठञ् तस्य लुक् । द्विवर्षपरिमाणे.
20211: द्विसमत्रिभुजा f. (-जा) An isosceles triangle.  E. द्वि, सम equal, त्रिभुजा triangle.
20212: द्विसहस्राक्ष m. (-क्षः) The great serpent, sovereign of the snake race, and the couch of VISHNŪ.  E. द्विसहस्र two thousand, and अक्षि an eye: the two thousand-eyed. द्विरावृत्तं सहस्रमक्षोणि यस्य, अनन्ते ।
20213: द्विसीत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) Twice ploughed.  E. द्वि twice, सीता a plough. and यत् aff.
20214: द्विस्तन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Two-breasted, two-uddered.  E. द्वि and स्तन breast.
20215: द्विहन् m. (-हा) An elephant.  E. द्वि two ways, with tusks and teeth, and हन् who kills.
20216: द्विहल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Twice ploughed.  E. द्वि two, हल a plough, affix यत्.
20217: द्विहायन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Two years old. 	 f. (-नी) A cow two years old. E. द्वि two, हायन a year, affixes अण् and ङीष्.
20218: द्विहृदया f. (-या) A pregnant woman.  E. द्वि two, हृदय a heart; having, one of her own and one in the fœtus.
20219: द्विन्द्रियग्राह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) Perceptible by two senses or forms, by sight and touch, &c.  E. द्वि, इन्द्रिय an organ of sense, ग्राह्य to be seized.
20220: द्वीप mn. (-पः-पं) 	 1. An island, any land surrounded by water; the word is hence applied to the seven grand divisions of the terrestrial world, each of these being separated from the next, by a peculiar and circumambient ocean: the seven Dwīpas, reckon-ing from the central one are, Jambu, Kusa, Plaksha, Sālmalī, Krauncha, Sāka, and Pushkara: the central Dwīpa, or the known continent, is again portioned into ten divisions, likewise termed Dwīpas: viz. Kuru, Chandra, Varuna, Saumya, Naga, Kumārikā, Gabhastiman, Tāmrāpurna, Kaseru and Indra. 	 2. A tiger's skin. E. द्वि two, (on both sides,) and आप water, आ dropped and इ made long. द्विर्गता द्वयो र्वा दिशोर्गता आपोऽत्र । अ० समा० ।
20221: द्वीपकर्पूरक m. (-कः) China camphor.  E. द्वीप and कर्पूर camphor.
20222: द्वीपवत् m. (-वान्) The ocean. 	 mf. (-वान्-वती) A river. 	 f. (-वती) The earth. E. द्वीप an island, मतुप् possessive aff.
20223: द्वीपिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) Island, islander. 	 m. (-पी) 	 1. A tiger. 	 2. An ounce or panther.  E. द्वीप an Island, इनि affix; haunting the small woody islands that abound in the rivers in India, or द्वीप a tiger's spotted skin, derived from द्वि two; इ to go or be, प affix: and इनि as before.
20224: द्वीपिशत्रु m. (-त्रुः) A plant, (Asparagus racemosus.)  E. द्वीपिन् a tiger, and शत्रु obnoxious. शतावर्य्याम् । द्वीपिनः व्याघ्रस्य शत्रुरिव ।
20225: द्वीप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) Island, an islander, &c. 	 m. (-प्यः) 	 1. A sort of crow. 	 2. A name of VYĀSA.  E. द्वीप, and यत् aff.
20226: द्वृ r. 1st cl. (द्वारति) 	 1. To accept, to appoint. 	 2. To cover.
20227: द्वेधा ind. In two ways: see द्विधा.
20228: द्वेष m. (-षः) Hate, enmity.  E. द्विष to hate, affix घञ्.
20229: द्वेषण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Inimical, hostile. 	 m. (-णः) An enemy. 	 n. (-णं) Hate, enmity.  E. द्विष् to hate, and ल्यु or युच् aff.
20230: द्वेषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Hostile, inimical, adverse, obnoxious. 	 m. (-षी) An enemy.  E. द्विष् to hate, णिन् aff.
20231: द्वेष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) Hating, inimical, an enemy.  E. द्विष to hate, तृच् aff.
20232: द्वेष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्य) Hateful, detestable.  E. द्विष to hate, affix ण्यत् । द्वेष्टु-मर्हः यत् कर्मणि ण्यत् वा ।
20233: द्वेष्यता f. (-ता) Aversion, dislike, detestableness.  E. द्वेष्य and तल् aff.
20234: द्वैगुणिक m. (-कः) A usurer, a money lender.  E. द्वि two, गुण number, affix ठक्; who requires cent. per cent.
20235: द्वैगुण्य n. (-ण्यं) 	 1. Duality. 	 2. The possession of two out of the three qualities. 	 3. Doubling.  E. द्विगुण and अण् aff.
20236: द्वैजात mfn. (-तः-ती-तं) Twice-born.  E. द्विजात, and अण् aff.
20237: द्वैत n. (-तं) 	 1. Duplication, doubling or being doubled. 	 2. Duality, in philosophy, the assertion of two principles, as the distinctness of life and soul, spirit and matter, god and the universe.  E. द्वि two तल् affix, द्वित double, two-fold, abstract affix अण्. द्विधा इतं द्वीतं तस्य भावः स्वार्थे वा अण् ।
20238: द्वैतवादिन् m. (-दी) A philosopher who asserts two principles.  E. द्वैत, and वादिन् who asserts. द्वैतं जीवभेदं जीवेश्वरयोः भेदं वा वदति वद णिनि जीवभेदवादिनि जीवेश्वरयोः भेदवादिनि च नैयायिकादौ ।
20239: द्वैतीयीक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Second.  E. द्वितीय second, pleonastic affix अण् and ईकक् added.
20240: द्वैध mfn. (-धः-धी-धं) Two-fold, of two sorts. 	 n. (-धं) 	 1. A double resource, a stratagem, a secondary arrangement or array, a reserve. 	 2. Contest, dispute, difference. 	 3. A two-fold form or state.  E. द्वैधम् and ड added.
20241: द्वैधम् ind. In two ways.  E. द्वि, and धमुञ् aff.
20242: द्वैधीकरण n. (-णं) Making two, separating, disuniting.  E. द्वैध and करण making, च्वि augment.
20243: द्वैधीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Separated. 	 2. made into two, sundered. E. द्वैध and कृत made, च्वि augment.
20244: द्वैधीभाव m. (-वः) 	 1. Sowing dissension, causing tho separation of allies. 2. Dividing into two. 	 3. The nature or property of being two or distinct.  E. द्वैध, and भाव property, च्वि aff.
20245: द्वैधीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Being two, being separated or disunited.  E. द्वैध and भूत become, च्वि augment.
20246: द्वैप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) 	 1. Made of a tiger's skin. 	 2. Island, islander. 	 m. (-षः) A car covered or hung with a tiger's skin.  E. द्वीप a tiger's skin, and अञ् aff.
20247: द्वैपायन् m. (-नः) A name of VYĀSA, the author or compiler of the Vedas and Purānas.  E. द्वीप an island, फक् affix; the island-born, the place of his nativity being a small island in Jamunā.
20248: द्वैप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) Of or belonging to an island.  E. द्वीप an island, यञ् aff.
20249: द्वैमातुर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Having two mothers, or the natural mother and a step-mother. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A name of GANESA. 	 2. An epithet of JARĀSANDHA: see जरासन्ध.  E. द्वि two, मातृ a mother, अण् affix, उ substituted for the penultimate: see द्विमातृज.
20250: द्वैमित्रि mfn. (-त्रिः-त्री-त्रि) Born of two friends, the children, &c.  E. द्वि, and मित्र a friend, इञ् aff.
20251: द्वैयह्निक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of or belonging to two days.  E. द्व्यहन्, and ठञ् aff.
20252: द्वैरथ m. (-थः) Single combat in chariots.  E. द्विरथ two cars, अण् aff.
20253: द्वैरात्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of or belonging to a period of two nights. E. द्विरात्र, and ठञ् aff.
20254: द्वैवर्षिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) After two years, of or belonging to two years to come.  E. द्वि, वर्ष a year, ठञ् aff.
20255: द्वैविध्य n. (-ध्यं) The state of being two-fold.  E. द्विविध, and ष्यञ् aff.
20256: द्वैहायन n. (-नं) The age of two years.  E. द्विहायन, and अण् aff.
20257: द्व्यंश m. (-शः) Two shares.  E. द्वि, and अंश part.
20258: द्व्यक्षर n. (-रं) A word of two syllables.  E. द्वि, and अक्षर a syllable.
20259: द्व्यङ्गुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Measuring two fingers. 	 n. (-लं) Two fingers. E. द्वि two, अङ्गुलि a finger, if wood (काष्ठ) is implied, the fem. form is द्व्यङ्गुलि.
20260: द्व्यञ्जल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Measuring, &c. two Anjalis. 	 m. (-लिः) Two Anjalis collectively.  E. द्वि, and अञ्जलि a certain measure, टच् affix; also with the final retained द्व्यञ्जलि.
20261: द्व्यणुक n. (-कं) The aggregation of two atoms, the first step in the formation of substances, and when they become perceptible, The molecule of two atoms.  E. द्वि and अणु an atom, कन् added.
20262: द्व्यन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Accompanied, &c. by two others. 	 n. (-न्यं) Two others collectively.  E. द्वि, and अन्य another.
20263: द्व्यर्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 	 1. Having two senses, meaning two things. 	 2. Having two objects. 	 m. (-र्थः) Two-fold meaning, double-entendre. E. द्वि, and अर्थ sense.
20264: द्व्यष्ट n. (-ष्टं) Copper.  E. द्वि two, (metals; gold and silvers.) अश to pervade, affix क्त; mixed as alloy with the fine metals; also the य being interchanged with its congener इ, द्विष्ट.
20265: द्व्यह m. (-हः) Two days.  E. द्वि two, and अह a day.
20266: द्व्यहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Of or belonging to two days.  E. द्व्यह, and ख aff.
20267: द्व्यात्मक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Comprising two, being two. 	 m. (-कः) A sign of the zodiac, Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, and Pisces.  E. द्वि, and आत्मन् self, कन् aff.
20268: द्व्यामुष्यायण m. (-णः) A boy who remains heir to his father though adopted by another.  E. द्वि, and आमुष्यायण a certain person. अमुष्य प्रसिद्धस्यापत्यम् फक् आमुष्यायणः द्वयोरामुष्यायणः ६ तत् पु० स० ।
20269: द्व्यायुष n. (-षं) Two lives.  E. द्वि, and आयुष् life.
20270: द्व्याहिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Produced, &c. in two days.  E. द्व्यह, and ठञ् aff.
20271: द्व्येकान्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Having two between, two off.  E. द्वि, and एकान्तर an interval, a line.
20272: ध The aspirated letter corresponding to the preceding, and expressed by Dh.
20273: ध m. (धः) 	 1. A name of BRAMHĀ. 	 2. A name KUVERA. 	 3. Virtue, moral merit n. (-धं) Wealth, property.  E. धा to have or possess, affix ड.
20274: धक्क r. 10th cl. (धक्कयति-ते) To destroy or annihilate. चुरा० उभ० सक० सेट् ।
20275: धट m. (-टः) 	 1. A balance, a pair of scales. 	 2. the sign Libra. 	 3. Ordeal by the balance. 	 f. (-टी) 	 1. Old cloth or raiment. 	 2. A piece of cloth worn over the privities.  E. धण् to sound, and ट substi-tuted for ण, affix अच्.
20276: धटक m. (-कः) A weight of forty-two Rattis.
20277: धटिनी f. (-नी) A cotton tie or string, fastened round the loins  E. धट a cloth, and इनि aff.
20278: धटीदान n. (-नं) Giving old cloth to a woman after impregnation. E. धटी, and दान giving.
20279: धण r. 1st cl. (धणति-ते) To sound. भ्वा० प० अक० सेट् ।
20280: धत्तूर m. (-रः) The thorn apple: see धुस्तर.  E. धेट to drink, उरच् affix, or more correctly, धययि धातून् धा-ऊर-पृ ।
20281: धन r. 1st cl. (धनति) To sound. r. 3rd cl. (दधन्ति) To bear or produce, (grain, &c.): restricted to the Vedas. भ्वा० प० अक० सेट् । जुहो० ।
20282: धन n. (-नं) 	 1. property of any description, thing, substance, wealth. 2. Wealth in cattle, property in herds. 	 3. A term of endearment 4. (In Algebra,) The affirmative quantity or plus.  E. धन to pro-duce, (a crop,) affix अच्.
20283: धनकेलि m. (-लिः) KUVERA, the Hindū Plutus; also धनकेलिक.  E. धन wealth, and केलि who sports.
20284: धनगर्व्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) purse-proud.  E. धन, and गर्व्वित arrogant.
20285: धनच्छु m. (-च्छुः) The Numidian crane.  E. धन the wealth, (of fields,) and च्छो to destroy, affix टु Note; as a synonym of करेटुखगे this word would seem to mean the bird stated: the name itself is more analogous to the Dhanesa of the dialects or the Indian Buceros.
20286: धनजात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Springing from wealth.  E. धन, and जात born.
20287: धनञ्जय m. (-यः) 	 1. The deity of fire. 	 2. A name of ARJUNA. 	 3. One of the Nāgas or infernal serpents. 	 4. One of the five vital airs, that which is supposed to fatten. 	 5. A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.)  E. धन wealth, जि to conquer or possess, affix खच् मुम् च ।
20288: धनतृष्णा f. (-ष्णा) Covetousness.  E. धन, and तृणा thirst.
20289: धनद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Beneficent, liberal, who gives away pro-perty, &c. 	 m. (-दः) A name of KUVERA.  E. धन wealth, देङ् to drink, or दा to give, affix क, or धनं दयते दे पालने ।
20290: धनदण्ड m. (-ण्डः) Fine, amercement.  E. धन and दण्ड punishment.
20291: धनदर्प m. (-र्पः) Pride of wealth.  E. धन and दर्प pride.
20292: धनदानुज m. (-जः) RĀVANA.  E. धनद KUVERA अनुज younger brother.
20293: धनदायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Liberal, munificent. 	 m. (-यी) 	 1. The deity of fire. 	 2. A benefactor, a donor.  E. धन wealth, दा to give, णिनि aff.
20294: धनन्ददा f. (-दा) One of the Śaktis, or female personifications of Divine power peculiar to the Bauddhas  E. धन wealth, दद to give, affix खश्
20295: धनपति m. (-तिः) The god of riches, KUVERA.  E. घन wealth, and पति master or lord.
20296: धनपिचाशिका f. (-का) Avarice, thirst of wealth.  E. धन wealth, पिचाशि a she-demon, affix कन्.
20297: धनपिशाची f. (-धी) Extreme desire of riches, avarice. E. See the preceding.
20298: धनप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fond of wealth. 	 f. (-या) A vegetable, (Ardisia solanacea.)  E. धन, and प्रिय dear to.
20299: धनमद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Proud, inflated with the pride of wealth,  E. धन wealth, मद to be intoxicated, affix अप्.
20300: धनमूल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Proceeding from wealth. 	 n. (-लं) Principal, capital E. धन, and मूल root.
20301: धनलुब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Miserly, avaricious, greedy of wealth, merce-nary.  E. धन, and लुब्ध desirous.
20302: धनलोभ m. (-भः) Desire of wealth, greediness, avarice,  E. धन, and लोभ desire.
20303: धनवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Wealthy, opulent. 	 f. (-वती) The constellation Dhanishṭhā.  E. धन wealth, and मतुप् possessive aff.
20304: धनव्यय m. (-यः) Expenditure, extravagance.  E. धन and व्यय expense.
20305: धनसम्पत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Accumulation of wealth.  E. धन, and सम्पत्ति acquire-ment.
20307: धनस्थक m. (-कः) A plant: see गोक्षुर.
20308: धनहर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 	 1. Inheriting, an heir. 	 2. Stealing, a thief. 	 3. Taking wealth, &c. 	 f. (-री) A sort of perfume, commonly called Chor.  E. धन wealth, हृ to steal, affix अप् or ट.
20309: धनहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) A thief, a pilferer. E. See the last.
20310: धनहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 	 1. Inheriting, an heir. 	 2. A thief.  E. धन and हारिन् who takes.
20311: धनहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Poor, reduced to poverty.  E. धन and हीन deprived of.
20312: धनागम m. (-मः) Accession of wealth.  E. धन, and आगम coming.
20313: धनादान n. (-नं) Acceptance of money.  E. धन and आदान taking.
20314: धनाधिकारिन् mf. (-री-रिणी-रि) An heir, an heiress. 	 m. (-रीः) A treasurer, a collector.  E. धन and अधिकारिन् having a right to.
20315: धनाधिकृत m. (-तः) A treasurer.  E. धन and अधिकृत placed over.
20316: धनाधिप m. (-पः) 	 1. A name of KUVERA. 	 2. A treasurer.  E. धन riches and अधिप lord; also similar compounds, धनाधिपति, &c.
20317: धनाध्यक्ष m. (-क्षः) 	 1. A name of KUYERA. 	 2. A treasurer.  E. धन wealth, अध्यक्ष superintendent.
20318: धनापहार m. (-रः) 	 1. Fine, amercement. 	 2. Plunder.  E. धन, and अपहार taking away.
20319: धनार्च्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wealthy, opulent.  E. धन, and अर्च्चित respected by.
20320: धनार्ज्जन n. (-नं) Acquisition of property.  E. धन and अर्ज्जन acquiring.
20321: धनार्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) Seeking for wealth, covetous, miserly.  E. धन, and अर्थिन् who wants.
20322: धनाशा f. (-शा) Thirst of wealth, longing after riches.  E. धन wealth आशा hope, wish.
20323: धनाश्री f. (-श्री) One of the Rāginis.
20324: धनिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Pious, virtuous, excellent. 	 2. Rich, opulent. m. (-कः) 	 1. A wealthy man. 	 2. A creditor. 	 3. A husband. 	 4. Coriander. 	 f. (-का) 	 1. A virtuous or excellent woman. 	 2. A wife. 	 3. A young woman. 	 4. A tree: see प्रियङ्गु.  E. धन wealth, affix ठन् धनमादेयत्वेन अस्ति अस्य ।
20325: धनिन् mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि) Wealthy, opulent. 	 m. (-नी) 	 1. A rich man. 	 2. A creditor,  E. धन wealth, इनि aff. धनमस्ति अस्य धन + इनि ।
20326: धनिष्ठा f. (-ष्ठा) The twenty-fourth Nakshatra or lunar mansion, it com-prises four stars, and is figured by a drum or tabor.  E. धन to produce, (as corn,) affix अच् and मतुप् added, धनवत् again, इष्ठन् added, and मतुप् rejected, fem. affix टाप्.
20327: धनीका f. (-का) A young woman.  E. धन wealth, ठक् affix, and the vowel made long.
20328: धनीयक n. (-कं) Coriander-seed.  E. धन to be produced, (as corn,) affix छ and कन् added see धन्याक.
20329: धनु m. (-नुः) 	 1. A bow. 	 2. The sign Sagittarius. 	 3. A tree: see पियाल. 	 4. A measure of four cubits.  E. धन here meaning to cast as an arrow, Unādi affix उन् also धनुस्.
20330: धनुःकाण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A bow and arrow.  E. धनुस्, and काण्ड an arrow.
20331: धनुःखण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A bow, the stick or horns of the bow. धनुस् and खण्ड a part.
20332: धनुःपट m. (-टः) The Piyasal tree, (Buchanania latifolia, Rox.)  E. धनुस् a bow, and पट width; bending like a bow. धनुष इव पटो विस्तारो दले यस्य ।
20333: धनुःशाखा f. (-खा) A plant, from the leaves of which a tough thread is extracted, of which bow strings were formerly made: see मूर्व्वा, (Sanseviera zeylanica, Rox. but called by Sir WM. JONES, Aletris hyacinthoides.)  E. धनुस् a bow, शाखा a branch. धनुरवयव इव शाखा यस्याः । पियालतरौ, मूर्ब्बायाम् ।
20334: धनुःश्रेणी f. (-णी) A plant: see the last.  E. धनुस् a bow, and श्रेणी a line.
20335: धनुर्गुण mf. (-णः-णा) A bow string. 	 f. (-णा) A plant, from which bow strings are made: see the two last.  E. धनुस् a bow, and गुण a string. धनुषो गुणो यस्याः सकाशात् ।
20336: धनुर्द्रुम m. (-मः) A bamboo.  E. धनुस् and द्रुम a tree. धनुषः साधनं द्रुमः । वंशवृक्षे । ततएव धनुषो जननात् ।
20337: धनुर्धर m. (-रः) An archer, a bowyer, one armed with a bow.  E. धनुस् a bow, and धर who possesses. धनुर्धारयति धृ-अच् ।
20338: धनुर्धारिन् m. (-री) An archer, a bowyer.  E. धनुस् and धारिन् who has.
20339: धनुर्भृत् m. (-त्) An archer.  E. धनुस् a bow, and भृत् who possesses: see the last. धनुर्भिभत्ति भृ कर्त्तरि क्विप् तुक् ६ तत् पु० स० ।
20340: धनुर्मध्य n. (-ध्यं) The middle part of a bow.  E. धनुस् a bow, मध्य the centre.
20341: धनुर्मार्ग n. (-र्गं) A curve line.  E. धनुस् an arc, मार्ग a road.
20342: धनुर्माला f. (-ला) A plant, from the leaves of which bow strings were made: see मूर्व्वा.  E. धनुस् a bow, and माला a garland.
20343: धनुर्य्यास m. (-सः) A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.)  E. धनुस् for धन्वन् a dry soil, and यास here said to mean effort; also धन्वयास धनुरिव यासः । दुरालभायाम् ।
20344: धनुर्लता f. (-ता) The moon plant. धनुरवयवयोग्या लता । सोमवल्ल्याम् ।
20345: धनुर्वृक्ष m. (-क्षः) 	 1. A plant; also called Dhāminiya. 	 2. A bamboo. 	 3. A measure of four cubits. 	 4. An are, a portion of the circum-ference of a circle.  E. धनुस् bow, and वृक्ष a tree.
20346: धनुष्कर m. (-रः) A bowyer, an archer.  E. धनुस् a bow, and कर who makes or practises.
20347: धनुष्पट m. (-टः) A tree: see धनुःपट.  E. धनुस् a bow, पट breadth.
20348: धनुष्पाणि mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि) Armed with a bow. 	 m. (-णिः) An archer. E. धनुस्, and पाणि hand.
20349: धनुष्मत् m. (-ष्मान्) An archer, a bowyer.  E. धनुस् a bow, मतुप् aff.
20350: धनुस् mfn. (-नुः-नुः-नु) Armed with a bow. 	 mn. (-नुः-नु) 	 1. A. bow. 	 2. Sagittarius, the sign. 	 m. (-नुः) The piyal tree, (Buchanania latifolia, Rox.)  E. धन to produce, (as grain,) to throw forth, (darts, &c.) Unādi affix उसि; also with उ affix धनु, and with ऊ affix, धनू.
20351: धनू m. (-नूः) A bow: see the last.
20352: धनेयक n. (-कं) Coriander: see धन्याक.  E. धन grain, ढक् affix, and कन् added.
20353: धनेश m. (-शः) KUVERA.  E. धन, and ईश lord.
20354: धनेश्वर m. (-रः) KUVERA, the Hindū PLUTUS.  E. धन wealth, ईश्वर lord.
20355: धनैषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Wishing or claiming property. 	 m. (-षी) A creditor.  E. धन, and ऐषिन् who wishes.
20356: धनोपचय m. (-यः) Accumulation of wealth.  E. धन, and उपचय assembling.
20357: धन्य mfn. (-न्य-न्या-न्यं) 	 1. Fortunate, well fated, lucky. 	 2. Good, virtuous. m. (-न्यः) 	 1. An infidel, an atheist. 	 2. A virtuous or fortunate man. f. (-न्या) 	 1. Emblic myrobalan. 	 2. A nurse. 	 3. Coriander. 	 n. (-न्यं) Wealth.  E. धन to produce, (grain, &c.) or धन wealth, and यत् affix of fitness.
20358: धन्यत्व n. (-त्वं) Luck, good fortune.  E. धन्य, and त्व affix; also with तल् affix धन्यता.
20359: धन्याक n. (-कं) A plant, bearing a small pungent seed used by the Hindus as a condiment, (Coriandrum sativum.)  E. धन to produce, (as grain,) deriv. irr. धन्यते भक्ष्यार्थिभिः । धनिया इति ख्याते पदार्थे ।
20360: धन्व n. (-न्वं) A bow: see धन्वन्. धन्व गतौ सौ० भ्वा० प० सक० सेट् । r. 1st cl. (धन्वति) To go.
20361: धन्वदुर्ग n. (-र्गं) A desert.  E. धन्व the same, and दुर्ग strong-hold.
20362: धन्वन् mn. (-न्वा-न्वं) A bow. 	 m. (-न्वा) A country scantily supplied with water, a desert, a waste. 	 n. (-न्वं) A firm spot, land, ground.  E. धन्वि Sautra root, to go or move, (by or on which,) and कनिन् Unādi affix; also with अच् affix धन्व.
20363: धन्वन् m. (-न्वः) A medicinal plant, commonly called Dhāminiya or Dhamin.
20364: धन्वन्तरि m. (-रिः) 	 1. The physician of the gods, who was produced at the churning of the ocean. 	 2. A celebrated physician; also काशिराज, being the same as the preceding in another existence: he appears to have been the founder of the Hindu medical school. 3. The sun. 	 4. A name of SIVA. 	 5. One of the nine gems of the court of VIKRAMĀDITYA. धनोः तन्निमित्त शल्यस्य अन्तं पारं ऋच्छति ऋ गतौइन् किच्च । समुद्रोत्थिते देववैद्यभेदे ।
20365: धन्वन्तरिग्रस्ता f. (-स्ता) A medicinal plant: see कटुकी.  E. धन्वन्तरि, and ग्रस्त eaten.
20366: धन्वयवास m. (-सः) A plant, (Hedysarum alhaji.)  E. धन्व dry soil, यु to unite, आसच् affix; also with कन् added धन्वयवासक. मरुभवे यवास भेदे, दुरालभाभेदे ।
20367: धन्वयास m. (-सः) A plant: see the last, alse simply यास, &c.
20368: धन्विन् m. (-न्वी) 	 1. An archer, a bow-man. 	 2. A name of ARJUNA. 	 3. A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.) 	 4. A wag, a wit, a sharp or shrewd man.  E. धन्व a bow, इनि aff. धन्वं चापोऽस्ति अस्य धम ध्माने सौ० पर० सक० सेट् । धमति । To blow.
20369: धम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) One who blows a fire or a trumpet. 	 m. (-मः) 	 1. A name of the moon. 	 2. KRISHNĀ. 	 3. A name of Yama. 	 4. BRAMHĀ, or the Supreme Spirit,  E. ध्मा to blow, affix अच् ।
20370: धमक m. (-कः) A blacksmith.  E. ध्मा to blow, (the forge.) क्वुन् Unādi aff. धमादेशश्च ।
20371: धमधमा ind. Blowing reiteratedly, or the sort of sound made by blow-ing with a bellows or a trumpet.  E. धम + प्रकारे द्वित्वम् ।
20372: धमन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. One who blows a bellows, a trumpet, &c. 	 2. Cruel. 	 m. (-नः) 	 1. A reed, (Arundo tibialis or karka.) 	 2. Blowing, (a wind instrument.) 	 f. (-निः or -नी) 	 1. E. धम from ध्मा to blow, &c. affix युच् fem. affix इन् or ङीष्; or ध्मा as before, Unādi affix अनि, and ङीप् optionally added.
20373: धम्मल m. (-लः) The breast ornamented with gold or jewels: see धम्मिल्ल.
20374: धम्मिल्ल m. (-ल्लः) Braided and ornamented hair, tied round the head, and intermixed with flowers, pearls, &c.  E. धम a Sautra root, to breathe, affix विच्, मिल to meet, लच् or क affix, and the two conjoined.
20375: धया mfn. (-यः-या-यी-यं) Who or what drinks. 	 f. (-या) A little girl, female infant.  E. धे to drink, affix श ।
20376: धर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Who or what has or holds. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A mountain. 2. A flock of cotton. 	 3. The tortoise Avatāra. 	 4. One of the demi-gods called VASUS. 	 f. (-रा) 	 1. The earth. 	 2. The uterus or womb. 3. Marrow. 	 4. A vessel of the body. 	 5. A golden globe or heap of valuables, representing the earth, and given to Brāhmans.  E. धृञ् to have or hold, to contain or support. &c. affix अच्, or ट fem. affix टाप् or ङीष्.
20377: धरण mn. (-णः-णं) 	 1. Holding, possessing, having. 	 2. A sort of measure, a weight of ten Palās. 	 3. A weight of silver, sixteen Māshās. 	 m. (-णः) 	 1. The Himālayā mountain considered as king of mountains. 2. The sun. 	 3. A world. 	 4. A breast, a female breast. 	 5. Rice. 	 6. A ridge of land answering the purpose of a bridge, the edge of a river, the skirt of a mountain, a bridge. 	 f. (-णी) 	 1. The earth. 	 2. The silk cotton tree. 	 3. A vessel of the body. 	 4. An esculent root. E. धृ to hold, to uphold or support, affix युच्, भावे ल्युट्, fem, affix ङीप् ।
20378: धरणि f. (-णिः) The earth.  E. धृ to be contained, (animals, &c.) Unādi affix अणि; also धरणी as above.
20379: धरणिधर m. (-रः) A name of VISHNŪ.  E. धरणि the earth and धर who sustains; also धरणीधर, धरणीं धरति धृ-अच् ।
20380: धरणिस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Being or staying on earth.  E. धरणि, and स्थ what stays or is.
20381: धरणीकन्द m. (-न्दः) An esculent root or bulb.  E. धरणी the earth, कन्द a root.
20382: धरणीकीलक m. (-कः) A mountain.  E. धरणी the earth, कीलक a pin or bolt.
20383: धरणीधर m. (-रः) 	 1. VISHNŪ. 	 2. A mountain. 	 3. A tortoise see धरणिधर.
20384: धरणीपूर m. (-रः) The ocean.  E. धरणी the earth, पूर to surround com-pletely, affix अच्.
20385: धरणीप्लव m. (-वः) The ocean.  E. धरणी the earth, and प्लव what swims; in which the earth floats. धरण्याः प्लवः यस्मात् ।
20386: धरणीश्वर m. (-रः) A name of SIVA.  E. धरणी, and ईश्वर lord; lord of the world. शिवे, भूमिपतौ, विष्णौ च ।
20387: धरणीसुता f. (-ता) A name of SĪTĀ, the wife of RĀMA.  E. धरणी the earth, and सुता daughter; the earth-born; being turned up from the soil by a plough, as JANAKA was ploughing a spot to prepare it for a sacrifice.
20388: धरसंस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थ) Like a mountain, as huge as, &c.  E. धर, and संस्थ what is, or is like.
20389: धराकदम्ब m. (-म्बः) The Kadamba tree, (Nauclea kadamba;) also धराकदम्बक ।
20390: धरात्मज m. (-जः) The planet Mars or its regent.  E. धरा the earth, and आत्मज son, terræ-filius; also similar compounds, as धरासुत, धरापुत्त्र &c. मङ्गलग्रहे । तारकासुरे च ।
20391: धराधर m. (-रः) 	 1. A name of VISHNŪ. 	 2. A mountain.  E. धरा the earth, and धर who or what sustains. विष्णौ, पर्वते, अनन्ते च ।
20392: धराशय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Sleeping on the ground.  E. धरा, and शय who sleeps.
20393: धरामर m. (-रः) A Brāhman.  E. धरा and अमर a deity. धरायाममर इव ।
20394: धरित्री f. (-त्री) The earth.  E. धृ to contain, (beings.) इत्र Unādi affix, fem. affix ङीप्.
20395: धरिमन् m. (-मा) 	 1. Form, figure, semblance. 	 2. A balance, a pair of scales.  E. धृ to have or hold, Unādi affix इमनिच्.
20396: धरिममेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Measurable by weight.  E. धरिम, and मेय to be measured.
20397: धरुण m. (-णः) 	 1. A name of BRAMHĀ. 	 2. Heaven, paradise. 	 3. Water. 4. Opinion, conception.  E. धृ to hold or uphold, affix उनन्.
20398: धर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 	 1. To be uphold or supported. 	 2. To be had or possessed. 	 3. To be placed or fixed. 	 4. To be fallen or alighted by. E. धृ to hold, तव्य aff.
20399: धर्त्तृ mfn. (-त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) Who or what has or holds.  E. धृ to have, तृन् aff.
20400: धर्त्र n. (-र्त्रं) 	 1. A house. 	 2. Sacrifice. 	 3. Virtue, moral merit.  E. धृ to contain, Unādi affix त्र.
20401: धर्म्म mn. (-र्म्मः-र्म्मं) 	 1. Virtue, moral and religious merit, according to the law and the Vedas. 	 2. Usage, practice, the customary observances of caste, sect, &c. 	 3. Duty, especially that enjoined by the Vedas. 	 4. Fitness, propriety. 	 5. Nature, character, proper or natural state or disposition, 6. Innocence, innoxiousness. 	 7. Resemblance. 	 8. Any sacrifice. 	 9. An Upanishad or theological portion of a Veda. 	 10. Any peculiar or prescribed practice or duty; thus, giving alms, &c. is the dharma of a householder; administering justice, the dharma of a king; piety, that of a Brāhman; courage, that of a Kshetriya, &c. 	 11. Kind and virtuous speech or discourse. 	 12. Law. 	 m. (-र्म्मः) 	 1. A name of YAMA, ruler of the lower regions, and judge of the dead. 	 2. A drinker of the juice of the acid asclepias, at certain sacrifices. 	 3. Virtue personified, born from the right breast of BRAMHĀ. 	 4. A bow. 	 5. Associating with the virtuous. 	 6. The fifteenth of the twenty-four jaina pontiffs of the present age. 	 7. A pious or virtuous man. 	 8. The bull of SIVA, a personification or type or virtue.  E. धृ to maintain or support, &c. Unādi affix मन्, what supports all men. ध्रियते लोकोऽनेन, धरति लोकं वा ।
20402: धर्म्मकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Acting according to some or any indispensable act of piety or duty.  E. धर्म्म, and कर्म्मन् act.
20403: धर्म्मकाय m. (-यः) A jina or jaina deified saint.  E. धर्म्म virtue, and काय body; virtue personified. धर्मार्थं कायोऽस्य, बुद्धे ।
20404: धर्म्मकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 	 1. Any indispensable act of religion, &c. 	 2. Religious or virtuous conduct.  E. धर्म्म piety, and कार्य्य act.
20405: धर्म्मकील m. (-लः) An edict, a royal order, decree, or grant.  E. धर्म्म virtue, कील proper stay; also with कन् added धर्म्मकीलक m. (-कः) धर्मस्य कील इव । राजशासने ।
20406: धर्म्मकृत्य n. (-त्यं) Any moral or religious observance.  E. धर्म्म and कृत्य to be done.
20407: धर्म्मकेतु m. (-तुः) A jaina deified saint.  E. धर्म्म virtue, केतु an emblem or banner. धर्मः अहिंसारूपकर्म केतुः यस्य ।
20408: धर्म्मकोष m. (-षः) Store or treasure of virtue.  E. धर्म्म, and कोष treasury. धर्मः कोष इव धर्मस्य कोषः समूहो वा ।
20409: धर्म्मक्रिया f. (-या) 	 1. Righteous conduct, acting according to law. 	 2. any religious act.  E. धर्म्म, and क्रिया act.
20410: धर्म्मक्षेत्र n. (-त्रं) A plain in the north west of India near Dehli, the scene of the great battle between the Kurus and Paṇḍus. 	 m. (-त्रः) A man of piety and virtue.  E. धर्म्म. virtue, holiness, and क्षेत्र a field, literally or figuratively.
20411: धर्म्मग्रहण n. (-णं) Observance of moral or religious institutes accepting or following the law.  E. धर्म्म, and ग्रहण taking.
20412: धर्म्मघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) immoral, unlawful, contrary to law or duty. E. धर्म्म, and घ्न what destroys.
20413: धर्म्मचक्र m. (-क्रः) A Jaina deified saint.  E. धर्म्म, and चक्र a wheel, &c. or धर्मसमूहे ।
20414: धर्म्मचक्रभृत् m. (-त्) A Jaina deified saint.  E. धर्म्म virtue, चक्र a circle, and भृत् possessing. धर्मचक्रं विभर्त्ति भृ-क्विप तुक् । धर्म्मसमूहधारके त्रि० ।
20415: धर्म्मचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Virtuous, moral, dutiful f. (-रिणी) A virtuous woman, an honest wife.  E. धर्म्म duty and चर to follow, affixes णिनि and ङीष्. धर्म्मं तत्साधनकर्मे चरति ।
20416: धर्म्मचिन्तन n. (-नं) Virtuous reflection.  E. धर्म्म, and चिन्ता reflection. चिन्ति भावे ल्युट् ।
20417: धर्म्मचिन्ता f. (-न्ता) Virtuous reflection.  E. धर्म्म, and चिन्ता reflection: see the last. चिन्ति भावे अ ।
20418: धर्म्मजीवन m. (-नः) Brahman who lives according to rule: one who practises the outward acts of the law.  E. धर्म्म, and जीवन living.
20419: धर्म्मज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Knowing one's duty, conversant with virtue. E. धर्म्म, and ज्ञ who knows. धर्मं जानाति ज्ञा-क ।
20420: धर्म्मज्ञान n. (-नं) Knowledge of moral, legal, and religious duty.  E. धर्म्म and ज्ञान knowledge.
20421: धर्म्मण m. (-णः) 	 1. A sort of tree, commonly Dhāminiya. 	 2. A kind of large snake, not poisonous, commonly Dhamna. धर्माय नम्यते नम-वा-कर्मणि-ड । धामनि ।
20422: धर्म्मतस् ind. Rightly, justly, righteously.  E. धर्म्म and तसि aff.
20423: धर्म्मत्व n. (-त्वं) 	 1. Morality, piety. 	 2. Inherent nature, peculiar property, &c.  E. धर्म्म, and त्व aff.
20424: धर्म्मद्रवी f. (-वी) The Ganges.  E. धर्म्म virtue, द्रु to shed. affix अच्.
20425: धर्म्मद्रोहिन mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Wicked. 	 m. (-ही) A Rākshasa.  E. धर्म्म, and द्रोहिन् rebellious. धर्माय परस्य धर्माचरणाय द्रुह्यति । द्रुह णिनि । ४ तं ।
20426: धर्म्मधातु m. (-तुः) A Jaina saint.  E. धर्म virtue, धातु essence, root. धर्मं दधाति । धा-तुन् ।
20427: धर्म्मध्वजिन् m. (-जी) A religious hypocrite or imposter, one who makes a livelihood by assumed devotion.  E. धर्म्म piety, ध्वज an emblem, इनि affix; having every outward mark of piety, matted hair, ragged garments, &c.
20428: धर्म्मनिबन्ध m. (-न्धः) Piety, virtue.  E. धर्म्म, and निबन्ध attachment.
20429: धर्म्मनिबन्धिन् mfn. (-न्धी-न्धिनी-न्धि) Pious, holy, engaged in or conductive to virtue.  E. धर्म्म, निबन्ध connexion, and इनि aff.
20430: धर्मनिष्पत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Duty, moral or religious observance, discharge or fulfilment of duty.  E. धर्म, and निष्पत्ति completion.
20431: धर्मपत्तन n. (-नं) 	 1. Pepper. 	 2. The name of a district or city.  E. धर्म virtue, पत्तन a city; pepper grows there, whence is said to be its name.
20432: धर्मपत्नी f. (-त्नी) A man's first wife and of the same class.  E. धर्म, and पत्नी a wife. धर्मार्थं पत्नी । निर्दोषायाम् पत्न्याम् ।
20433: धर्मपत्र (-त्रं) Glomerous fig tree, (Ficus glomerata)  E. धर्म sacrifice, and पत्र leaf.
20434: धर्मपर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Righteous, pious.  E. धर्म, and पर addicted to. धर्मःपरो यस्य ।
20435: धर्मपाठक m. (-कः) A teacher of law.  E. धर्म, and पाठक who teaches.
20436: धर्मपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) 	 1. A name of the Pāndu prince, YUDHISHṬHIRA. 	 2. One so considered, as a son for piety or duty; also धर्मपुत्त्रक.  E. धर्म a proper name, and पुत्त्र a son, the son of DHARMA or YAMA.
20437: धर्मप्रधान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Eminent in piety.  E. धर्म, and प्रधान chief.
20438: धर्मप्रवक्तृ m. (-क्ता) A teacher or expounder of the law.  E. धर्म, and प्रवक्तृ who explains. धर्मं सन्दिग्धार्थे अयं धर्म इति प्रवक्ति प्र + वच-तृच् ।
20439: धर्मभागिनी f. (-नी) A virtuous and amiable wife.  E. धर्म, and भागिनी who shares.
20440: धर्मभाणक m. (-कः) A lecturer, a public reader of the Mahābhārat and other sacred works which are read aloud, and explained to large assemblies of Hindūs at particular seasons.  E. धर्म virtue, and भण् to utter, to speak, affix ण्वुल्.
20441: धर्मभ्रातृ m. (-ता) A fellow religious student.  E. धर्म, and भ्रातृ a brother. धर्मतः कृतो भ्राता ।
20442: धर्मभिक्षुकः m. (-कः) A mendicant Brāhman, one who is so, or has become so from meritorious motives.  E. धर्म, and भिक्षुक a beggar.
20443: धर्ममय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Moral, righteous, made up or replete with virtue, &c.  E. धर्म, and मयट् aff.
20444: धर्ममूल n. (-लं) The foundation of Hindu law and religion (the Vedas.) E. धर्म, and मूल root.
20445: धर्मयु mfn. (-युः-युः-यु) Virtuous righteous.  E. धर्म virtue, यु to go, affix क्विप् ।
20446: धर्मयुज् mfn. (-युक्) Righteous, pious, just.  E. धर्म virtue, युज् to join, affix क्विप् धर्मेण युज्यते युज-कर्मणि-क्विप् ।
20447: धर्मराज m. (-जः) 	 1. A Jain or deified saint, according to the Jaina sect. 2. A name of YAMA, regent of the dead. 	 3. A name of YUDHISH-THIRA. 	 4. Also of ARJUNA. 	 5. A king in general.  E. धर्म virtue, Justice, and राज who shines, affix अच्; or राज from राजन् a king; lord of justice or धर्मेण राजते । राज-क्विप् ।
20448: धर्मरोधिन् mfn. (-धी-धिनी-धि) Illegal, immoral.  E. धर्म, and रोधिन् opposed to.
20449: धर्मलक्षण n. (-णं) An essential ingredient in ethics or law, (as place, time, &c.)  E. धर्म, and लक्षण mark. धर्मो लक्ष्यते ज्ञायते अनेन लक्ष-करणे ल्युट् ।
20450: धर्मवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Virtuous, pious, upright, just.  E. धर्म as above, मतुप् poss, aff. अस्त्यर्थे मतुप् । मस्य वः ।
20451: धर्मवासर m. (-रः) The day of full moon.  E. धर्म virtue, and वासर a day; peculiar sacrifices being performed on this day. धर्मस्य तत्साधनस्य वासरः ।
20452: धर्मवाहन m. (-नः) A name of SIVA.  E. धर्म the bull of this god, virtue typified, and वाहन a vehicle. धर्मं वाहयति प्रापयति नरान् । वाहि-ल्यू ।
20453: धर्मविद् mfn. (-द् or -त्) 	 1. Virtuous, pious, moral. 	 2. Acquainted with the law.  E. धर्म, and विद् who knows. धर्मं वेत्ति विद् क्विप् ।
20454: धर्मविधि f. (-धिः) Course of law, legal precepts or injunctions. E. धर्म, and विधि manner.
20455: धर्मविप्लव m. (-वः) Immorality, wickedness.  E. धर्म, and विप्लव sub-mersion.
20456: धर्मविवेचन n. (-नं) Judicial investigation.  E. धर्म, and विवेचन delibera-tion.
20457: धर्मशाला f. (-ला) A court of justice, a tribunal.  E. धर्म justice, and शाला a hall. धर्मार्थं शाला । धर्मार्थमन्नादिदानाधिकरणशालायाम् ।
20458: धर्मशास्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) 	 1. The body or code of Hindu law. 	 2. Any work on the subject.  E. धर्म virtue, and शास्त्र a treatise. शिष्यते अनेन शास करणे ष्ट्रन् । ६ त० स० ।
20459: धर्मशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Virtuous, just, pious.  E. धर्म virtue, शील attached to. धर्मः धर्मसाधनं शीलमस्य, धर्मं शीलयति शील अण् वा ।
20460: धर्मसंहिता f. (-ता) A code of laws, especially the work of some saint or divine person, as MANU, YĀJÑAVALKYA, &c.  E. धर्म virtue, and सम् prefixed to धा, to have or possess, affix क्त, fem. affix टाप्; a compilation made for the purpose of teaching and maintaining virtue.
20461: धर्मसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. Virtue. 	 2. Hypocrisy.  E. धर्म, and सङ्ग addiction to, real or seeming.
20462: धर्मसन्तानसू mfn. (-सूः-सूः-सू) Virtuous, producing virtuous offspring or actions.  E. धर्म, सन्तान progeny, सू who bears.
20463: धर्मसभा f. (-भा) A tribunal, a court of justice.  E. धर्म justice, and सभा assembly.
20464: धर्मसाधन n. (-नं) Any act or virtue essential to a system of duties. E. धर्म, and साधन instrument.
20466: धर्मसुत m. (-तः) A name of YUDHISHṬHIRA.  E. धर्म YAMA and सुत a son; also धर्मसूनु, धर्मात्मज, &c.
20467: धर्मात्मन् m. (-त्मा) A saint, a pious or virtuous person  E. धर्म virtue, आत्मन् self. धर्म आत्मा स्वभावोयस्य ।
20468: धर्माधर्मपरीक्षा f. (-क्षा) Ordeal by drawing lots or slips of black and white paper.  E. धर्म, अधर्म iniquity, परीक्षा trial.
20469: धर्माधिकरण n. (-णं) A court of justice. 	 m. (-णः) A judge.  E. धर्म, and अधिकरण supervision. धर्मोऽधिक्रियते अत्र । अधि + कृ आधारे ल्युट् ।
20470: धर्माधिकरणिन् m. (-णी) A judge, a sovereign, an administrator of the law.  E. धर्माधिकरण, and affix इनि ।

A son. 4. A name of SIVA. 	 f. (-ली) 	 1. Silk cotton tree, 2. Indian spikenard. 3. A sort of perfume: see शङ्क्षिनी. Saffron. 	 4. The letter ह as used in the Tantras.  E. न not, कुल race or heap, fem. affix ङीष्.
20887: नकुलेश m. (-शः) 	 1. A Bhairava, an attendant on or emanation from SIVA. 	 2. The letter ह as used mystically in Tantras.  E. नकुल, and ईश master.
20888: नकुलेष्टा f. (-ष्टा) A plant: see रास्ना.  E. नकुल an ichneumon, and इष्ट wished; the mungoose, if wounded in a conflict with a poisonous snake, is supposed to prevent the effects of the venom by the use of this plant; also नकुलेष्टका.

20892: नक्तचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Going or moving about at night. 	 m. (-री) 1. A cat. 	 2. An owl. 	 3. A goblin. 	 4. A thief.  E. नक्त by night, चर् to go, णिनि aff.
20893: नक्तञ्चर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Going at night. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A goblin, a demon. 2. A tree, the Bdellium tree: see गुग्गुल. 	 3. An owl, 4. A thief. E. नक्त by night, and चर who goes. नक्तं रात्रौ चरति चर-ट ।

20897: नक्तमुखा f. (-खा) Night.  E. नक्तम् by night, उख् to produce, affix क । नक्तव्रताङ्गं मुखमाद्यभागोऽस्याः ।

20899: नक्र n. (-क्रं) The upper timber of a door-frame. 	 nf. (-क्रं-क्रा) The nose. 	 f. (क्रा) A string of bees or wasps m. (-क्रः) A crocodile.  E. न not, क्रम् to go affix ड. न क्रामति दूरस्थानम् ।
20900: नक्रराज् m. (-राट्) or नक्रराज m. (-जः) A shark, but applied also differ-ently: see ग्राह.  E. नक्र a crocodile, and राज् or राज king.
20901: नक्षत्र n. (-त्र) 	 1. A star in general. 	 2. 20902: नक्षत्रचक्र n. (-र्क्र) 	 1. A particular diagram for astrological calculations 2. The lunar asterisms collectively.  E. नक्षत्र and चक्र a circle.

20904: नक्षत्रप m. (-पः) The moon.  E. नक्षत्र and प who cherishes.
20905: नक्षत्रमाला f. (-ला) 	 1. A necklace containing twenty-seven pearls. 	 2. The table of the asterisms in the moon's path. 	 3. A kind of dance. E. नक्षत्र a constellation, and माला a garland.
20906: नक्षत्रेश m. (-शः) 	 1. The moon. 	 2. Camphor.  E. नक्षत्र an asterism, and ईश lord.
20907: नख r. 1st cl. (नखति) To move. भ्वा० पर० सक० सेट् ।
20908: नख mf. (-खः-खी) A finger nail. 	 m. (-खः) A part, a portion. 	 nf. (-खं-खी) A perfume, a dried substance, of a brown colour, and of the shape of a nail; apparently, a dried shell-fish, used as a perfume. f. (-खी) A vegetable perfume, different from the one above, though known by the same name, NAKHI.  E. न privative, ख sense; or नह् to bind ख Unādi affix, the radical ह rejected. नखम् छिद्रम् अत्र ।
20909: नखकुट्ट m. (-ट्टः) A barber.  E. नख a nail, and कुट्ट who cuts, (barbers in India trim the nails, नखं कुट्टति कुट्ट-छेदे अण् उप० स० ।
20910: नखखादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Who or what eats with nails or tal-ons.  E. नख, and खादिन् eating.
20911: नखदारण m. (-णः) A falcon.  E. नख a nail, and दारण tearing.
20912: नखपद n. (-दं) A scratch, the mark of a finger nail.  E. नख, and पद a mark.
20913: नखभिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Torn, or torn off with a nail.  E. नख, and भिन्न divided.
20914: नखमुच m. (-चः) A bow.  E. नख a nail, मुच् to let loose, क aff.
20915: नखम्पच mfn. (-चः-चा-चं) What scalds the nail.  E. नख, and पच् to cook, खश् aff. मुम् च ।
20916: नखर m. (-रः) A finger nail. 	 f. (-री) A perfume: see नखी.  E. न not, खन् to go, and डर affix; or नख a nail, रा to go or be, affix ड. or नखं-राति-रा + क ।
20917: नखरञ्जनी f. (-नी) A nail-parer.  E. नख, and रञ्जनी beautifying.
20918: नखरायुध m. (-धः) 	 1. A lion. 	 2. Any beast of prey. 	 3. A cook.  E. नखर a nail, आयुध a weapon.
20919: नखलेखा f. (-खा) A scratch  E. नख, and लेखा a line.
20920: नखविलेख m. (-खः) A scratch.  E. नख, and विलेखा a mark.
20921: नखविष्किर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) What tears or rends, (as a bird of prey, &c.) E. नख, and विष्किर what scatters.
20922: नखव्रण n. (-णं) A scratch.  E. नख, and व्रण a wound.
20923: नखशङ्ख m. (-ङ्खः) A small shell.  E. नख a nail, शङ्ख a shell, one as small as a nail.
20924: नखांशु m. (-शुः) Elegance of the finger nails.  E. नख, and अंशु a ray.
20925: नखाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 	 1. A scratch, a mark of the nail. 	 2. A sort of perfume. E. नख a nail, and अङ्क a mark.
20926: नखायुध m. (-धः) 	 1. A tiger. 	 2. A lion. 	 3. A cock. 	 4. Any beast or bird having talons.  E. नख, and आयुध a weapon.
20927: नखालि m. (-लिः) A small.  E. नख a nail, and आलि a line; also नखालिका
20928: नखाशिन् m. (-शी) An owl.  E. नख a nail, and अशिन् who eats, using its claws in feeding.
20929: नखिन् mfn. (-खी-खिनी-खि) Nailed, clawed, having nails or talons. E. नख, and इनि aff.
20930: नग m. (-गः) 	 1. mountain. 	 2. A tree.  E. न not, गम् to go, affix ड, im-moveable; or दह् to burn, Unādi affix ग, ह rejected, and द changed to न.
20931: नगज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Mountain, mountaineer. 	 m. (-जः) An elephant. E. नग a mountain, and ज born.
20933: नगनन्दिनी f. (-नी) The goddess DURGĀ.  E. नग mountain, and नन्दिनी a daughter, being in one of her characters the daughter of Himā-laya, the snowy mountain personified.
20934: नगपति m. (-तिः) Himālaya, the personified range of snowy mountains dividing India from Tārtāry, &c.  E. नग mountain, and पति lord.
20935: नगभिद् m. (-द् or -त्) 	 1. A plant, (Plectranthus scutellaroides.) 	 2. An axe, a crow. 	 3. INDRA.  E. नग, and भिद्, what breaks. नगं भिनत्ति भिद-क्विप-६ त० स ।
20936: नगभू mfn. (-भूः-भूः-भु) Mountain, mountaineer.  E. नग, and भू born. नगे भवति-भू-क्विप् ७ त० स ।
20937: नगमूर्द्धन् m. (-र्द्धा) The crest or brow of a mountain.  E. नग, and मूर्द्धन् forehead.
20938: नगर nf. (-रं-री) A town, a city.  E. नग a tree, or according to some, a mountain, रल् affix; having trees or houses like mountains. नगा इव प्रासादाः सन्ति अत्र बा० र ।
20939: नगरघात m. (-तः) An elephant,  E. नगर a city, and घात who destroys or subverts. नगरं हन्ति अमनुष्य कर्त्तृ कत्वेन टकं बाधिन्वा अण् उप० स० । हस्तिनि हन-भावे घञ् ६ त० । नगरस्थलोकस्य हनने च ।
20940: नगरजन m. (-नः) Towns-folk, citizen.  E. नगर, and जन people.
20941: नगरस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) City, citizen.  E. नगर, and स्थ who or what stays.

20943: नगरीवक m. (-कः) A crow.  E. नगरी, and वक a crane, the town-crane.
20944: नगरोपान्त n. (-न्तं) Suburb, skirts of the town.  E. नग, and उपान्त vicinity.
20945: नगरौषधि (धी) f. (-धिः) The plantain.  E. नगर a city, and औषधि a medica-ment.
20946: नगाटन m. (-नः) A monkey.  E. नग a mountain, अट् to go, affix ल्युट्.
20947: नगाधिप m. (-पः) Himālaya; see नगपति.  E. नग mountain, and अधिप a lord; also नगाधिराज, &c.
20948: नगाश्रय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Living in or frequenting mountains.  E. नग, and आश्रय abode. हस्तिकन्दवृक्षे, पर्वतवासिनि ।
20949: नगोच्छ्राय n. (-यं) The elevation of a mountain.  E. नग and उच्छ्राय heighth.
20950: नगौकस् m. (-काः) 	 1. A bird in general 2. A lion 3. A fabulous animal: see शरभ. 	 4. A crow.  E. नग a tree, a mountain, and ओकस् a house or dwelling.
20951: नग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) Naked. 	 m. (-ग्नः) 	 1. A naked mendicant. 	 2. A Bauddha. 	 3. A bard. 	 f. (-ग्ना) A naked woman.  E. नज् to be as-hamed, affix कर्त्तरि क्त.
20952: नग्नक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Naked.  E. कन् added to the last.
20953: नग्नजित् m. (-जित्) The name of a king, father of one of KRISHṆA'S wives E. नग्न Bauddha, and जित् who conquers.
20954: नग्नत्व n. (-त्वं) Nudity, nakedness.  E. त्व added to नग्न; also with तल्, नग्नता.
20955: नग्नहू mn. (-हूः-हु) Ferment, a drug used to throw the mixture for spirituous liquor into fermentation.  E. नग्न naked, and ह्वे to call, affix क्विप्, what is called for by the bare-faced, shameless, &c.
20956: नग्नाट m. (-टः) 	 1. A naked man, but especially a kind of religious men-dicant, who wanders about without clothes. 	 2. A Bauddha. 	 3. A Jain.  E. नग्न naked, and अट who goes; also with कन् added नग्नाटक, नग्न एव अटति अट-अच् स्वार्थे क अट-ण्वुल् वा ।
20957: नग्निका f. (-का) 	 1. A girl before menstruation or about ten years old. 2. A naked woman.  E. नग्न naked, संज्ञायां कन् added: and the fem. from, see नग्नक ।
20958: नग्नीकरण n. (-णं) Stripping, undressing.  E. नग्न, and करण making, च्वि augment.
20959: नग्नीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Undressed, stripped, naked.  E. नग्न, and कृत made, च्वि aff.
20960: नज (ओ ई) ओनजी r. 6th cl. (नजते) also (इ, ओ) (ओनजि) r. 1st cl. (नञ्जते) To be ashamed, to be modest or bashful. तुदा० आ० अक० सेट् भ्वा० इदित् च ।

20963: नट m. (-टः) 	 1. A dancer, a mime, an actor, a Nata, &c. in modern times: in caste, the son of a degraded Kshetriya by a woman of the second caste. 	 4. 20965: नटनारायण m. (-णः) A Rāga or mode of music, according to some, the sixth, or to others, a subdivision of Dīpaka or of Megha.  E. नट, and नारायण VISHṆU: the supreme with dancers, &c.
20968: नटमण्डन m. (-नः) Yellow orpiment.  E. नट an actor, and मण्डन adorning; dying theatrical raiment. नटं मण्डयति-मण्डि-ल्यु हरिताले ।
20969: नटवर m. (-रः) A chief dancer or actor.  E. नट, and वर best.

20971: नटश्रेष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A chief or excellent dancer or actor.  E. नट, and श्रेष्ठ best.
20972: नटान्तिका f. (-का) Shame, modesty,  E. टन dancing, and अन्त destroying, affixes कन् and टाप्; it is also read नटान्धिका ।
20973: नटेश्वर m. (-रः) A name of SIVA,  E. नट a dancer, and ईश्वर a deity, the god of the dancers.
20974: नड r. 1st cl. (नडति) To be thick or impervious. r. 10th cl. (नाडयति-ते) To fall off or from. भ्रंशे भ्वा० प० चुरा० उभ० अक० सेट् ।
20975: नड (ल) m. (-डः or -लः) 	 1. A sort of reed, (Arundo tibialis, or karka;) also नल. 	 2. A particular tribe whose employment is making a sort of glass bracelets.  E. नड् to be thick, affix अच् । नल वन्धे अच् वा डस्य-लः ।
20976: नडकोय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Abounding in reeds, (a field, &c.)  E. नड a reed, छ affix, and कुक् augment.
20977: नडप्राय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Abounding in reeds.  E. नड, and प्राय aboun-dance.
20978: नड(ल)मीन m. (-नः) A small fish a kind of sprat haunting reedy places. E. नड a reed, and मीन a fish. “चिंडौ” मत्स्ये ।
20979: नडसंहति f. (-तिः) A quantity of reeds.  E. नड, and संहति assemblage; also any analogous compound.
20980: नडह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Lovely, beautiful, desirable.  E. नड here said to be mental anxiety, derived form नड् to fall off or from, हन् to destroy, affix ड ।
20981: नड्या f. (-ड्या) A quantity of reed.  E. नड a reed, affix यत्.
20982: नड्वन् mfn. (-ड्वान्-ड्वती-ड्वत्) Reedy, abounding in reeds.  E. नड, and नतुप् aff.
20983: नड्वल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Reedy, abounding in reeds.  E. नड, and ड्वलच् aff.
20984: नड्वाभू f. (-भूः) A house or hut of reeds.  E. नड्व, and भू being, with आङ् prefixed.
20985: नत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Bent, bowed, reclining. 	 2. Crooked, curved. 	 n. (-तं) 	 1. The arc or distance of any planet from the Zenith. 	 3. A plant or its root: see तगर and तगरमूल.  E. नम् to bow or bend, affix कर्त्तरि-क्त ।
20986: नतनाडिका f. (-का) Any hour of birth, after moon or before midnight. E. नत, and नाडिका a period of twenty-four minutes.
20987: नतनासिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Flat-nosed.  E. नत bowed, and नासिक the nose.
20988: नतभाग m. (-गः) (In Astronomy,) Zenith distance.  E. नत and भाग a part.
20989: नतभ्रु mfn. (-भ्रुः-भ्रुः-भ्रु) Frowning.  E. नत, and भ्रु the brow.
20990: नतमुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Down-faced, looking down.  E. नत, and मुख the face.
20991: नतमूर्द्धन् mfn. (-र्द्धा-र्द्धा-र्द्ध) Looking down, hanging down the head.  E. नत, मूर्द्धन् the forehead.
20992: नतांश n. (-र्शं) Zenith distance, (in Astronomy.)  E. नत, and अंश a degree.
20993: नताङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Bent, curved, bowed, stooping. 	 f. (-ङ्गी A woman E. नत, and अङ्ग the body.
