21100: नमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Bowed, making salutation or obeisance. 	 2. Bowed, bent down.  E. नम् to bend, causal form, affix णिच् क्त वा ह्रस्वः ।
21101: नमुचि m. (-चिः) 	 1. The deity of love. 	 2. A demon so named.  E. न nega-tive, मुच् to loose, and कि aff.
21102: नमुचिमूदन m. (-नः) A name of INDRA.  E. नमुचि the demon, and सूदन des-troyer; also similar names, as नमुचिद्विष्, &c. नमुचिं सूदयति हिनस्ति सूदि-ल्यु ।
21103: नमेरु m. (-रुः) The seed of the Elæocarpus.  E. न not, मेरु the mountain Meru. or नम वा एरु ।
21104: नमोगुरु m. (-रुः) A spiritual teacher.  E. नमस् reverence, and गुरु a teacher.
21105: नम्ब r. 1st cl. (नम्बति) To go, to move.
21106: नम्र mfn. (-म्रः-म्रा-म्रं) Crooked, curved, bent, bowed.  E. नम् to bow, affix र.
21107: नम्रक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Bent or bowed, stooping.  E. कत् added to the last. नम्र इव कायति कै-क ।
21108: नम्रमुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Looking down, having the head bent.  E. नम्र, and मुख the face.
21109: नम्रमूर्त्ति mfn. (-र्त्तिः-र्त्तिः-र्त्ति) Bending down, stooping, bowed,  E. नम्र, and मूर्त्ति form.
21110: नम्राङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Bent, bowed, stooping.  E. नम्र, and अङ्ग the body.
21111: नय r. 1st cl. (नयते) To go, to move: see णय and णी । भ्वा० आ० सक० सेट् ।
21112: नय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. Fit, right, proper. 	 2. Leading, conducting, (who or what does so.) 	 m. (यः) 	 1. Guiding, directing, (literally or figura-tively, as in morals, &c.) 	 2. Polity, civil and military government. 3. The theological part of the Vedas. 	 4. A sort of dice or men for playing with. 	 5. A guide, a conductor.  E. नय् to go, affix घञ्, or णी to guide, &c. affix भावे अच् ।
21113: नयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 	 1. Leading, guiding. 	 2. Tending or conducing to. 	 3. Informing, certifying, giving in evidence. 	 4. Obtaining.  E. णी to obtain, शतृ aff.
21114: नयन n. (-नं) 	 1. The eye. 	 2. Leading, guiding, (literally or figuratively.) 3. Attaining, obtaining. 	 4. Bringing. 	 f. (-ना) The pupil of the eye. E. णी to guide, affix करणे ल्युट् । नीयते वुद्धि वृत्तिः स्वसंयुक्तविषयान् अनेन ।
21115: नयनवारि n. (-रि) Tears.  E. नयन, and वारि water.
21116: नयनामोषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Sight-stealing, blinding.  E. नयन, and आमोषिन् what steals.
21117: नयनोत्सव m. (-वः) 	 1. A lamp. 	 2. Any lovely or desired object.  E. नयन the eye, and उत्सव a festival.
21118: नयनोपान्त m. (-न्तः) The outer angle or canthus of the eye.  E. नयन, and उपान्त extremity. अपाङ्गे ।
21119: नयनौषध m. (-धः) Green sulphate of iron, or the salt in a state of par-tial decomposition by exposure to the atmosphere.  E. नयन the eye, and औषध a medicament, being used as a collyrium. पुष्पकासीसे ।
21120: नयपीठी f. (-ठी) The board or cloth on which dice are played. E. नय dice, पीठी a stool. (छक् ।)
21121: नयप्रयोग m. (-गः) Policy, political address.  E. नय, and प्रयोग application.
21122: नयविशारद m. (-दः) A politician, a statesman.  E. नय, and विशारद skilled in.
21123: नयसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Political success, accomplishing any thing by good management.  E. नय, and सिद्धि success.
21124: नर m. (-रः) 	 1. Man, individually or generally. 	 2. The Eternal, the divine imperishable spirit pervading the universe. 	 3. A name of ARJUNA. 	 4. VISHṆU. 	 5. A gnomon. 	 6. A man or piece at chess, draughts, &c. 	 7. A Muni, an incarnation of VISHṆU. 	 n. (-रं) A fragrant grass, commonly Rāmkappur. 	 f. (-रौ) Woman in general: see नारी.  E. नॄ or नृ to lead or guide, affix नये-अच् । गणितशास्त्रोक्ते छायाप्रमाण ज्ञानोपयोगिनि शङ्कौ च ।
21125: नरक mn. (-कः-कं) Hell, the infernal regions, including a number of places of torture of various descriptions. 	 m. (-कः) The name of a Daitya or demon.  E. नृ to guide or lead, affix वुन्, whither the wicked are conducted: It is sometimes read नारक ।
21126: नरककुण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A well or pit in Tartarus, eighty-six such are enu-merated.  E. नरक, and कुण्ड a pit.
21127: नरकजित् m. (-जित्) A name of VISHṆU.  E. नरक tke demon, and जित् subduing. नरकम् असुरभेदं जयति स्म । जि-भूते क्विप् ६ त० स० ।
21128: नरकदेवता f. (-ता) Misfortune, personified as a goddess.  E. नरक, and देवता divinity. निऋतौ ।
21129: नरकस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Living or being in Tartarus, who or what is there. 	 f. (-स्था) The river of hell named “Baitarany”.  E. नरक hell, स्थ who stays or abides, fem. affix टाप् ।
21130: नरकान्तक m. (-कः) VISHṆU.  E. नरक hell, and अन्तक destroyer.
21131: नरकामय m. (-यः) The soul after death.  E. नरक hell, and आमय sickness.
21132: नरकीलक m. (-कः) The murderer of his spiritual preceptor.  E. नर man-kind, and कील a stake, affix कन् ।
21133: नरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Pimples of the face. 	 n. (-ङ्गं) The penis.  E. नृ to guide or lead, Unādi affix अङ्गच्.
21134: नरदेव m. (-वः) A sovereign, a king.  E. नर a man, and देव a deity,
21135: नरनारायण m. dual. (-णौ) Two sages, incarnations of VISHṆU, and born again, as KRISHṆA and ARJUNA.  E. नर, and नारायण, each severally the name of a sage.
21136: नरपति m. (-तिः) A king, a sovereign, a prince.  E. नर man, पति lord.
21137: नरप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Favourable or friendly to mankind.  E. नर, and प्रिय fond of. नीलवृक्षे च ।
21138: नरभू f. (-भूः) Bhārata Varsha, India, or the central of the known conti-nent. 	 2. The birth or birthplace of men.  E. नर man, and भू land; also नरभूमि f. (-मिः)
21139: नरमानिनी f. (-नी) A woman who has a beard.  E. नर a man, मन् to re-gard or think, and णिनि affix; also with कन् affix in the feminine form, नरमानिका; these words are also written नरमालिनी, &c. नरं मन्यते मन-णिनि-ङीप् ।
21140: नरमाला f. (-ला) A string or girdle of skulls.  E. नर, and माला a garland.
21141: नरमालिनी f. (-नी) A woman with a beard.  E. नर a man, माला a necklace, इनि aff.
21142: नरमेध m. (-धः) A human sacrifice.  E. नर, and मेध a sacrifice. मिध आधारे घञ् ।
21143: नरवाहन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Borne or carried by men. 	 m. (-नः) A name of KUVERA.  E. नर a man, and वाहन a vehicle.
21144: नरवाहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) Carried by men, (a vehicle.)  E. नर, and वाहिन् what bears.
21145: नरविष्वण m. (-णः) An imp or goblin.  E. नर man, विष्वण who devours.
21146: नररूप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) Having the form of man. 	 n. (-पं) The human form. E. नर, and रुप form.
21147: नररूपिन् mfn. (-पी-पिणी-पि) Having the human form.  E. नररूप, and इनि aff.
21148: नरसिंह m. (-हः) VISHṆU in his fourth Avatār or descent, the lion-headed man. 	 2. A chief, a man of eminence or power.  E. नर a man and सिंह a lion.
21149: नरहरि m. (-रिः) VISHṆU in his fourth Avatār. see the last.  E. नर, and हरि a lion.
21150: नराधम m. (-मः) A low or vile man, a wretch.  E. नर, and अधम low.
21151: नराधारा f. (-रा) The earth.  E. नर man, आधार receptacle.
21152: नराधिप m. (-पः) A king.  E. नर and अधिप ruler.
21153: नरान्तक m. (-कः) 	 1. Death. 	 2. A Rākshasa, a son of RĀVANA.  E. नर, and अन्तक destroyer.
21154: नरायण m. (-णः) A name of VISHṆU.  E. नर man, and अयण going; see नारायण ।
21155: नरेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 	 1. A king, an anointed sovereign. 	 2. A dealer in anti-dotes, a juggler.  E. नर a man, इन्द्र chief.
21156: नरेश m. (-शः) A king.  E. नर, and ईश master.
21157: नरेश्वर m. (-रः) A king.  E. नर, and ईश्वर a sovereign.
21159: नर्त्तक m. (-कः) 	 1. An actor, a mime. 	 2. A juggler, a dancer, a player of any description. 	 3. A bard, a herald. 	 4. An elephant. 	 5. A reed, (Arundo karka, Rox.) 	 6. A peacock. 	 f. (-की) 	 1. An actress, female dancer or singing girl. 	 2. A female elephant. 	 3. A peahen.  E. नृत् to dance or act, ष्वुन् aff.
21160: नर्त्तन n. (-नं) Dancing, gesticulating, acting.  E. नृत् to dance, &c. affix भावे ल्युट् ।
21161: नर्त्तनप्रिय m. (-यः) A peacock.  E. नर्त्तन dancing, and प्रिय fond of.
21162: नर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Danced, dancing.  E. नृत् to dance, णिच् कर्मणि क्त aff.
21163: नर्द्द r. 1st cl. (नर्द्दति प्रनर्द्दति) To sound: the radical न is not convertible to ण after a preposition, &c. see णर्द्द । शब्दे अक० गतौ सक० भ्वा० पर० सेट् ।
21164: नर्द्दटक n. (-कं) A kind of metre, containing seventeen letters. “यदि भवतो नजौ भजजलागुरुर्नर्दष्टकम्” इत्युक्त लक्षणे सप्तदशाक्षरे छन्द्वोभेदे ।
21165: नर्द्दत् mfn. (-र्द्दन्-र्द्दन्ती-र्द्दत्) 	 1. Sounding. 	 2. Praising aloud, proclaiming. E. नर्द्द, and शतृ aff.
21166: नर्द्दन n. (-नं) 	 1. Sounding, roaring, making a noise. 	 2. Celebrating, praising aloud.  E. नर्द्द to sound, affix भावे ल्युट् ।
21167: नर्द्दनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. To be sounded. 	 2. To be celebrated or praised aloud.  E. नर्द्द sound, and अनीयर् aff.
21168: नर्द्दित mfn. (-तः-तः-तं) 	 1. Sounded, made as a noise. 	 2. Celebrated, prai-sed aloud. 	 n. (-तं) Sound, roar, bellowing.  E. नर्द्द to sound, क्त aff.
21169: नर्द्धटक n. (-कं) A stanza of four parts, having seventeen syllables in each.
21170: नर्ब्ब r. 1st. cl. (नर्ब्बति) To go, to move भ्वा० प० सक० सेट् ।
21171: नर्म्मकील m. (-लः) A husband.  E. नर्म्म amusement, कील a drop or stay.
21172: नर्म्मगर्भ m. (-र्भः) A secret lover.  E. नर्म्म, and गर्भ source.
21173: नर्म्मट m. (-टः) 	 1. The sun. 	 2. A potsherd.  E. नर्म्म, and अट what goes, deriv. irr. or नर्म अटन् पृषो० ।
21174: नर्म्मठ m. (-ठः) 	 1. The nipple. 	 2. A rake, a lecher, a libertine. 	 3. Sport, amusement. 	 4. Coition.  E. नर्म्म pleasure, स्था to abide, ड affix, deriv. irr. or नर्मणि कुशलः नर्मन् + अठन ।
21175: नर्म्मद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Delighting, making happy, giving pleasure. 	 m. (-दः) The associate or companion of a person's sports or amuse-ments. 	 f. (-दा) 	 1. The Narmadā river, which rising in the Vindhya mountains, runs westward to the gulf of Cambay. 	 2. A plant: see पृक्का.  E. नर्म्म pleasure, and द what gives. नर्म ददाति दा-क ६ त० स० ।
21176: नर्म्मद्युति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Happy, merry. 	 f. (-तिः) Enjoyment of a joke or any amusement.  E. नर्म्म, and द्युति lustre.
21177: नर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 	 1. Sport, amusement, pastime, diversion. 	 2. Jest, joke. 3. Wit, humour.  E. नृ to guide, affix मनिन् ।
21178: नर्म्मसचिव m. (-वः) A companion, an associate, the promoter and parta-ker of a person's amusements, especially of a prince or man of rank.  E. नर्म्मन, and सचिव a minister.
21179: नर्म्मसाचिव्य n. (-व्यं) Superintendance or provision of a prince's amuse-ments, partaking a person's amusements.  E. नर्म्मसाचिव, and ष्यञ् aff.
21180: नर्म्मस्फूर्ज्ज m. (-र्ज्जः) Happiness or amusement ending in alarm.  E. नर्म्म, and स्फूर्ज्ज thundering.
21181: नर्म्मस्फोट m. (-टः) Slight or inferior amusement.  E. नर्म्म, and स्फोट opening.
21182: नल r. 10th cl. (नालयति) 	 1. To shine. 	 2. To bind or confine.
21183: नल r. 10th cl. (-लः) 	 1. A reed, (Arundo karka, Rox.) 	 2. The name of a king, son of NISHADHA, and hero of several poetical works famous amongst the Hindus, especially the poem called Naishadha. 	 3. Another prince, the son of VĪRASENA. 	 4. A deified progenitor or Pitrideva. 	 5. The name of a monkey chief. 	 6. A demon. 	 f. (-ली) Red arsenic. 	 2. A perfume, commonly called by the same name of Nali. 	 n. (-लं) 	 1. The water lily, (Nelumbium speciosum.) 	 2. Smell, odour.  E. नल् to shine, affix अच् ।
21184: नलक n. (-कं) A bone of either of the extremities, any long bone. E. नल a reed, and कन् affix of resemblance.
21185: नलकिनी f. (-नी) The knee cap or pan.  E. नलक as above, and इनि affix; connecting the bones of the lower extremity.
21186: नलकील m. (-लः) The knee.  E. नल a reed, or reed-like bone, and कील a pin or bolt.
21187: नलकूवर m. (-रः) The son of KUVERA.  E. नल a reed, कूवर a carriage yoke.
21188: नलद n. (-दं) Indian spikenard, (Valeriana jatamansi.) 	 f. (-दा) 	 1. The honey or nectar of a flower. 	 2. The root of the Andropogon muri-catum.  E. नल here said to mean, fragrance, and द what gives.
21189: नलपट्टिका f. (-का) A sort of mat made with reeds, a coarse mat.  E. नल a reed, and पट्ट a cloth, कन् affix of similitude.
21190: नलमीन m. (-नः) A kind of sprat of according to some, a shrimp or prawn.  E. नल a reed, and मोन a fish; frequenting reedy spots. See नडमीन ।
21191: नलिका f. (-का) A perfume: see नली.  E. नली, and कन् added.
21192: नलिन n. (-नं) 	 1. A lotus or water lily, (Nelumbium speciosum, or Nym-phæa nelumbo.) 	 2. Water. 	 3. Indigo. 	 m. (-नः) 	 1. The Indian crane. 2. A small fruit, Karonda. 	 f. (-नी) 	 1. An assemblage of lotus flowers. 	 2. A place abounding in lotuses. 	 3. The flexible stalk of a water lily. 	 4. A pond in which the lotus grows or may grow. 	 5. The Ganges of heaven. 	 6. The fermented and intoxicating juice of the cocoanut.  E. नल् to be bright, Unādi affix इनन् ।
21193: नलिनीरुह m. (-हः) 	 1. BRAMHĀ. 	 2. n. (-हं) The fibres of the lotus stalk. E. नलिनी, and रुह what grows and क affix.
21194: नलिनेशय m. (-यः) A name of VISHṆU.  E. नलिने in a lotus, and शय who sleeps. नलिने व्रह्मनाभिकमले शेते शी-अच् । अलुक़् स० ।
21195: नल्व m. (-ल्वः) A furlong, a distance measured by four hundred cubits. E. नल् to be as a reed in length, and व aff.
21196: नल्ववर्त्मगा f. (-गा) The orange tree.  E. नल्व as above, वर्त्म a road, and ग what goes.
21197: नव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) New. 	 m. (-वः) Praise, panegyric, celebration.  E. नु to praise, &c. affix. कर्मणि भावे वा अप् ।
21198: नवकारिक f. (-का) 	 1. A bride, a woman newly married. 	 2. A new com-ment.  E. नव new, and कारिका agent.
21199: नवकालिका f. (-का) A young woman, either one recently married or one in whom menstruation has lately commenced.  E. नव new, काल time, कन् added with the fem. form.
21200: नवग्रहा m. plu. (-हाः) The nine planets, or sun, moon, five planets, and the ascending and descending nodes.  E. नव for नवन्, and ग्रह a planet.
21201: नवछात्र m. (-त्रः) A student, a novice.  E. नव new, and छात्र a disciple.
21202: नवत m. (-तः) An elephant's painted or variegated housings.  E. नव new, तन् to spread, affix ङ or नू-अतच् ।
21203: नवता f. (-ता) Novelty.  E. तल् added to नव; also with त्व, नवत्वं;
21204: नवति f. (-ति or -ती) Ninety.  E. नव nine, and क्तिन् aff.
21205: नवतिका f. (-का) A painting brush.  E. नवति ninety, (hairs,) कन् aff.
21206: नवतिधा ind. Ninety-fold.  E. नवति, and धा aff.
21207: नवतिशस् ind. Ninety by ninety.  E. नवति, and शस् aff.
21208: नवदल n. (-लं) 	 1. The new leaf of a lotus. 	 2. Any young leaf.  E. नव new, and दल a leaf.
21209: नवदीधिति m. (-तिः) Mars, the planet or its deified regent.  E. नव nine, दोधिति a ray.
21210: नवदुर्गा f. (-र्गा) The nine forms of DURGĀ.  E. नव, and दुर्गा the goddess.
21211: नवदोला f. (-ला) A litter borne by nine men.  E. नव, and दोल a litter.
21212: नवद्वार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Having nine doors; an epithet applied to the body, which has nine inlets or outlets, as the nostrils, ears, mouth, &c.  E. नव, and द्वार a door.
21213: नवधा ind. Nine-fold, in nine ways.  E. नव nine, and धा aff.
21216: नवनीत n. (-तं) Fresh butter.  E. नव new, and नीत procured from milk, &c.)
21217: नवनीतक n. (-कं) Clarified butter.  E. कन् added to the last.
21218: नवनीतधेनु f. (-नुः) A quantity of butter as a present to Brāhmans. E. नवनीत, and धेनु a milch cow.
21219: नवपल्लव n. (-वं) A new shoot or sprout.  E. नव, and पल्लव a shoot.
21220: नवफलिका f. (-का) 	 1. A bride, a newly married woman. 	 2. A girl in whom menstruation has recently begun.  E. नव new, फल fruit, and ठक् aff.
21221: नवब(व)धू f. (-धूः) A bride, a newly married woman.  E. नव, and बधू a wife.
21222: नवम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) Ninth. 	 f. (-मी) The ninth day of a lunar half month.  E. नव nine, and डढि-मट् aff.
21223: नवमल्लिका f. (-का) Double jasmine: see the next.
21224: नवमालिका f. (-का) Double jasmine, (J. Zambac.)  E. नव excellent, praised, and मालिका or मल्लिका jasmine: see the last.
21225: नवयौवना f. (-ना) A young woman.  E. नव new, and यौवन young.
21226: नवरक्तक n. (-कं) A newly dyed garment.  E. नव, रक्त red, and कन् aff.
21227: नवरङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) Gift to five and acceptance by fours persons of the best Kayastha families.  E. नव, and रङ्ग colour.
21228: नवरत्र n. (-त्रं) 	 1. Nine precious gems, or a pearl, ruby, topaz, diamond, emerald, lapis lazuli, coral, sapphire, and one called Gomedā. 	 2. The nine men of letters at the court of VIKRAMĀDITYA, or DHAN-WANTARI, KSHAPANAKA, AMARASINHA, SANKU, VETĀLABHATTA, GHATAKARPARA, KĀLIDĀSA, VARĀHAMIHIRA, and VARARŪCHI. E. नव and रत्र a jewel.
21229: नवरात्र n. (-त्रं) The period of nine days, from the first of the light half of Aswin to the ninth; part of the time devoted to the worship of DURGĀ.  E. नव, and रात्रि a night.
21230: नववरिका f. (-का) A newly married woman.  E. नव new, वर a blessing, affix कन् added, fem. affix टाप् ।
21231: नववस्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) New cloth.  E. नव, new, and वस्त्र cloth.
21232: नवशस् ind. Nine by nine.  E. नव, and शस् aff.
21233: नवशस्य n. (-स्य) Grain of the year's harvest.  E. नव, and शस्य grain.
21234: नवशस्येष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A sacrifice performed on eating the new rice or grain of the year, नवशस्य, and इष्टि sacrifice.
21235: नवशायक m. (-कः) A name given to any of nine inferior classes, the cowherd, gardener, oilman, weaver, confectioner, betel seller, potter, blacksmith, and barber.
21236: नवश्राद्ध n. (-द्धं) The first series of Shrāddhas collectively, or funeral offer-ings on the first, third, fifth, seventh, ninth, and eleventh days after a person's demise.  E. नव, and श्राद्ध obsequial rite.
21237: नधसूतिका f. (-का) 	 1. A milch cow. 	 2. A woman recently delivered. E. नव new, and सूत offspring, and कन् affix, fem. form.
21238: नवांश m. (-शः) A ninth, a ninth part.  E. नव, and अंश share,
21239: नवान्न n. (-न्नं) 	 1. New rice or grain. 	 2. A ceremony observed on first eating the rice, &c. of the last harvest.  E. नव, and अन्न food.
21240: नवाम्बर n. (-रं) New and unbleached cloth.  E. नव new, and अम्बर cloth.
21241: नवार्च्चिस् m. (-र्च्चिः) The planet Mars or its deified personification.  E. नव nine, and अर्च्चिस् light.
21242: नवाह m. (-हः) 	 1. A new day. 	 2. The first day of the fortnight.  E. नव new, and अह a day.
21243: नवीकरण n. (-णं) Renewing, doing or making anew,  E. नव, करण making, च्वि augment.
21244: नवीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Renewed, revived, done or made anew,  E. नव, and कृत made, च्वि augment.
21245: नवीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) New.  E. नव new, ख pleonasm, and the semi-vowel changed.
21246: नवीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Renewed, revived.  E. नव, and, भूत become, च्वि augment.
21247: नवै ind. Not so perhaps, a particle implying doubt.  E. न not, वै expletive.
21248: नवोढा f. (-ढा) A newly married woman, a bride.  E. नव new, and ऊढा a wife.
21249: नवोद्धृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Newly extracted or drawn up. 	 n. (-तं) 	 2. Fresh butter.  E. नव new, उद्धृत made or drawn up.
21250: नव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) New, recent, young, modern. &c. 	 m. (-व्यः) Praise, panegyric.  E. नव new, and स्वार्थे यत् aff. रक्तपुनर्नवायाम् च ।
21251: नशाक mf. (-कः-का) A bird, said to be a sort of crow.  E. नश् to destroy, affix आक ।
21252: नशितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Destroying.  E. णश to destroy, affix तृच् with इट् augment, else with a nasal augment नष्टृ ।
21253: नश्यत् mfn. (श्यन्-श्यन्ती-श्यत्) Perishing, decaying, wasting, being destroy-ed.  E. नश् to perish, and शतृ aff.
21254: नश्यत्प्रसूतिका f. (-का) A female bearing a dead child.  E. नश्यत्, प्रसूतिका a mother.
21255: नश्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Mischievous. 	 2. Destructive, perishable.  E. णशि to destroy, affix छरप् ।
21256: नष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Lost, destroyed, removed, annihilated.  E. णश to perish, affix क्त ।
21257: नष्टचन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) The moon on the fourth lunation of either half of Bhādra.  E. नष्ट, and चन्द्र the moon: it is is very unlucky to see the moon on these days.
21258: नष्टचेतन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fainted, insensible.  E. नष्ट, and चेतन conscious.
21259: नष्टचेष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Insensible, inert.  E. नष्ट, and चेष्टा effort.
21260: नष्टचेष्टता f. (-ता) Fainting, swooning, insensibility, proceeding either from joy or sorrow, &c.  E. नष्ट lost, चेष्टता effort. हर्षशोकादिभिः सर्व-चेष्टाराहित्ये ।
21261: नष्टसंस्मृति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Unmindful, forgetful.  E. नष्ट, and संस्मृति recollection.
21262: नष्टाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) A Brāhman or householder who has lost his conse-crated fire.  E. नष्ट lost, and अग्नि fire.
21263: नष्टाप्तिसूत्र n. (-त्रं) Booty, plunder.  E. नष्ट lost, आप्ति gain, and सूत्र thread or chain.
21264: नष्टार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) Reduced, become poor.  E. नष्ट, and अर्थ wealth.
21265: नष्टेन्दुकला f. (-ला) The day of new moon when it rises invisible.  E. नष्ट, and इन्दुकला a digit.
21266: नस् f. (-नाः) The nose.  E. नस् to sound, affix क्विप् ।
21267: नसा f. (-सा) The nose: see नासा and नासिका ।
21268: नस्त m. (-स्तः) The nose. 	 n. (-स्तं) A sternutatory, snuff, &c. 	 f. (-स्ता) A hole bored in the septum of the nose.  E. णस् to make crooked, affix संज्ञायां त ।
21269: नस्तित m. (-तः) An ox or any other draft animal, with a string through his nose, the sort of rein usually employed in India. 	 f. (-ता) Nozzled.  E. नस्त as above, the nose, formed into a nominal verb, and क्त added, nozzled or nose-led. णस्-तार-इतच् । (नाकफोडा) ।
21270: नस्तोत mf. (-तः) An ox led by a string through his nose: see the last; also नस्योत. नसि नासिकायां सम्यक् ऊतः आ + वे-क्त ।
21271: नस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Nasal, relating or belonging to the nose. 	 n. (-स्यं) A sternutatory, snuff. 	 f. (-स्या) The nose.  E. नसा the nose, यत् aff.
21272: नस्योत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) An ox or other animal led by a string through the septum of the nose.  E. नसा the nose, यत् affix of relation or fitness, and ऊत woven: see नस्तित । आ + वे + क्त ।
21273: नह (-औ) औनह r. 4th cl. (नह्यति-ते) To bind: see णह ।
21274: नहि ind. No, not.  E. णह् to bind or tie, affix इन् ।
21275: नहुष m. (-षः) 	 1. The name of a Nāga or serpent. 	 2. The name of a king, one of the lunar race, son of AYUS and grandson of PURŪ-RAVAS.  E. णह् to bind, Unādi affix उषन्.
21276: नहुषात्मज m. (-जः) A king, also YAYĀTI.  E. नहुष as above, आत्मज son.
21277: ना ind. No, not (another form of न ।)
21278: नाक m. (-कः) Heaven, paradise, æther. sky, atmosphere.  E. न not with अक derived from क happiness, and the privative अ prefixed misery; in which there is no unhappiness. न कम् अकम् दुःखम् तत् नास्ति यत्र ।
21279: नाकनाथ m. (-थः) A name of INDRA.  E. नाक paradise, and नाथ lord; also with कन् added नाकनाथक ।
21280: नाकनायक m. (-कः) INDRA.  E. नाक, and नायक a chief.
21281: नाकवनिता f. (-ता) A nymph of heaven.  E. नाक, and वनिता a wife.
21283: नाकसद् m. (-सत्) A deity.  E. नाक, and सद् who dwells in.
21284: नाकिन् m. (-की) A deity, a god.  E. नाक heaven, and इनि aff.
21285: नाकु m. (-कुः) 	 1. An ant or mole hill, a burrow. 	 2. A mountain. 	 3. A name of a Muni or saint.  E. न privative, अक् to go, affix उ, or नम् to be crooked or bowed, Unādi affix उ, and नाक substituted for the radical letters.
21286: नाकुल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Relating or belonging to an ichneumon. 	 f. (-ली) 1. A plant; the ichneumon plant, a vegetable supposed to furnish the mungoose with an antidote, when bitten in a conflict with a snake, (Serpent ophioxylon) 	 2. The root of the Simul tree, (कुक्कुटोकन्द) A sort of pepper, (Piper chavya)  E. नकुल the ichneu-mon, affixes अण् and ङीष् । चविके, (चै) राम्नायां, यवतिक्तायां, श्वेत-कण्टकार्य्यां च ।
21287: नाकुलान्ध्य n. (-न्धं) Weakness of sight  E. नाकुल, and अन्ध्य blindness.
21288: नाकुसद्मन् m. (-द्मा) A snake.  E. नाकु a mound of earth, सद्मन् a dwelling.
21289: नाक्षत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं) Relating or belonging to the luner asterisms. 	 n. (-त्रं) A month, one computed by the moon's passage through the twenty-seven mansions, or of thirty days of sixty Gharis each. E. नक्षत्र, and अण् aff.
21290: नाक्षत्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating or belonging to the lunar asterisms. m. (-कः) A month of twenty-seven days, each day being the period of the moon's passage through a luner asterism, f. (-की) The state or condition to which a person is subjected agreeably to the asterism presiding over his nativity.  E. नक्षत्र as above, and ठञ् aff.
21291: नाग m. (-गः) Nāga or demi-god so called, having a human face, with the tail of a serpent, and the expanded neck of the Koluber Nāga; the race of these beings is said to have sprung from KADRU, the the wife of KĀSYAPA, in order to people Pātāla or the regions below the earth. 	 2. A serpent in general or especially the specta-cle snake, or cobra capella, (Coluber Nāga.) 	 3. An elephant. 	 4. A cruel or tyrannical person. 	 5. A cloud. 	 6. (In composition,) Pre-eminent. 	 7. A pin or nail projecting from a wall to hang any thing upon. 	 8. A small tree, (Mesua ferrea.) 	 9. A sort of grass, (Cyperus pertenuis.) 	 10. A tree used in dying, (Rottleria tinctoria.) 11. One of the airs of the body, that which is expelled by belching. 12. Betel or Pān. 	 13. The name of a country. 	 14. A shark. 	 n. (-गं) 	 1. Tin. 	 2. Lead. 	 3. One of the astronomical periods called Karaṇas; it is one of those termed invariable, and always corresponds to the last half of Āmavasya or new moon. 	 4. The effects of that period on any thing done or happening during it.  E. नग a moun-tain, and अण् affix; living or produced in mountainous regions, &c. नगे पर्वते भवः अण् न गच्छति अगः न अगो वा ।
21292: नागकेशर m. (-रः) A small tree, commonly Nageshwar, (Mesua ferrea). E. नाग, and केशर synonymes of the same plant compounded; the word is also written नागकेसर.
21293: नागगर्भ n. (-भं) Red lead.  E. नाग lead. and गर्भ origin. सिन्दुरे ।
21294: नागज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced by or of a Nāga. &c. 	 n. (-जं) 	 1. Red lead. 	 2. Tin.  E. नाग lead, &c. and ज produced.
21295: नागजिह्वा f. (-ह्वा) A plant, (Asclepias pseudosarsa:) see शारिवा  E. नाग a snake, and जिह्वा a tongue.
21296: नागजिह्विका f. (-का) Red arsenic.  E. नाग a snake, जिह्वा a tongue, कन् affix of comparison. मनःशिलायाम् ।
21297: नागजीवन m. (-नः) Tin.  E. नाग lead, जीवन proceeding.
21298: नागदन्त m. (-न्तः) 	 1. Elephant's tooth or ivory; also the tooth of the ele-phant. 	 2. A shelf, a pin or bracket projecting from a wall, and used to hang things upon. 	 f. (-न्ती) 	 1. A sort of sun-flower, (Helio-tropium Indicum.) 	 2. A whore.  E. नाग an elephant, and दन्त a tooth.
21299: नागदन्तिक m. (-कः) A wooden pin or bracket, projecting from a wall, a shelf.  E. नागदन्त an elephant's tooth, and कन् affix of resemblance.
21300: नागदन्तिका f. (-का) A plant, commonly called Rāmadūtī, see विशल्या । E. नागदन्ती a plant, and कन् affix of resemblance. (विछाति ।)
21301: नागदलोपम m. (-मः) A sort of tree commonly Parusha.  E. नाग one of the plants so called, दल a leaf, and उपमा resemblance.
21302: नागद्रु m. (-द्रुः) Euphorbia  E. नाग a snake, and द्रु a tree; being used in offerings to the snake goddess MANASĀ. सि वृक्षे ।
21303: नागनिर्य्यूह m. (-हः) A large pin or bracket, projecting from a wall like a shelf.  E. नाग an elephant, and निर्य्यूह projection.
21304: नागपाश m. (-शः) 	 1. A weapon of VARUṆA the regent of water. 	 2. A sort of magical noose or knot, used in battle to entangle an enemy.  E. नाग an elephant, and पाश a binding.
21305: नागपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) 	 1. A tree in used in dyeing, (Rottleria tinctoria.) 	 2. Nāgeshwar, (Mesua ferrea.) 	 3. The Champaka, (Michelia champa-ca)  E. नाग an elephant, and पुष्प flower.
21306: नागबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.)  E. नाग an elephant and बन्धु friendly, liked.
21307: नागबल m. (-लः) A name of BHĪMA. 	 f. (-ला) A creeping plant, (Hedy-sarum lagopodioides.)  E. नाग an elephant, and बल strong. (गोरक्ष चाकुलिया ।)
21308: नागभिद् m. (-भिद्) A sort of snake, (Amphisbæna.)  E. नाग an elephant, and भिद् destroying; the word is sometimes written नागभृत्, from भृत् cherishing.
21309: नागमल्ल m. (-ल्लः) The elephant of INDRA.  E. नाग an elephant, and मल्ल a boxer.
21310: नागमातृ f. (-ता) 	 1. A name of MANASĀ, a goddess supposed to preside over snakes. 	 2. Red arsenic.  E. नाग a snake, and मातृ a mother.
21311: नाममार m. (-रः) A sort of potherb; also केशराज  E. नाग a snake, and मार destroying; considered as an antidote.
21312: नागयष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A piece of wood erected in a newly dug pond for showing the depth of water.  E. नाग a snake, and यष्टि a staff; also नागयष्टिका ।
21313: नागर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 	 1. Clever, sharp, knowing, (as a buck, a blood, a wag. &c.) 	 2. Town-born or bred, citizen. 	 3. Nameless. 	 4. Rela-ting to a city. 	 5. Polite, civil 6. Bad, vile. 	 n. (-रं) 	 1. Dry ginger. 2. A short of grass, (Cyperus pertenuis). 	 3. A form of writing, the “Devanāgari alphabet.” m. (-रः) 	 1. A husband's brother. 	 2. An orange. 	 3. A lecturer. 	 4. Denial of knowledge. 	 5. Fatigue. 	 6. Desire of final beatitude. 	 f. (-री) 	 1. A sort of Euphorbia. 	 2. A clever or intriguing woman.  E. नगर a city अण् aff. नगरे भवः अण् ।
21314: नागरक m. (-कः) 	 1. The orange; see नागरङ्ग 2. A thief. 	 3. An artist. E. नागर, and वुञ् aff.
21315: नागरक्त m. (-क्तः) Red lead.  E. नाग mountain, and रक्त red. सिन्दुरे ।
21316: नागरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The orange; in India usually applied to the Sylhet orange, (Citrus aurantium.)  E. नाग an elephant, रङ्ग to be sick, affix घञ्; on which elephants feed till they become ill; or नाग red lead, and रङ्ग colour, of the colour of red lead. (नाराङ्गी नेवु ।)
21318: नागराज m. (-जः) ANANTA, the chief of the Nāgas.  E. नाग, and राज king.
21319: नागरीट m. (-टः) A libertine, a debauchee, a rake, a blackguard. E. नागरी an intriguing woman, अट् to accompany, affix अच्, deriv. irr. or more appropriately नागरी-मेटति-इट-गतौ-क ।
21320: नागरुक m. (-कः) The orange: see नागरङ्ग ।
21321: नागरेणु m. (-णुः) Red lead.  E. नाग, and रेणु oxid. सिन्दुरे ।
21322: नागरेयक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) City, citizen.  E. नगर a town, and ढकञ् aff.
21323: नागलता f. (-ता) The penis.  E. नाग a snake, and लता a creeper.
21324: नागलोक m. (-कः) The Nāga regions below the earth.  E. नाग a Nāga, and लोक world.
21325: नागवल्लिका f. (-का) The betel plant: see the next.
21326: नागवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) The betel plant, (Peper betel.)  E. नाग the infernal Nāga, and वल्ली a creeper; the creeper of the lower regions; also with कन् added नागवल्लिका ।
21327: नागवारिक m. (-कः) Garuda, the bird of VISHNŪ. 	 2. A peacock. 	 3. A royal elephant. 	 4. An elephant driver or keeper. 	 5. The chief person in a court or assembly.  E. नाग an elephant, वृ to cherish, &c. affix ठक् ।
21328: नागवीट m. (-टः) A rake: see नागरीट ।
21329: नागवीथी f. (-थी) The path of Airāvata, “the milky way.”  E. नाग the elephant, वीथी a road or path.
21330: नागसम्भव n. (-वं) Minium or red lead.  E. नाग lead, and सम्भव pro-duction.
21331: नागसुगन्धा f. (-न्धा) The ichneumon plant: see नाकुली.  E. नाग a snake, and सुगन्ध perfume.
21332: नागाख्य m. (-ख्यः) A plant: see नागकेसर.  E. नाग an elephant, and आख्या a name.
21334: नागाञ्चला f. (-ला) A stick or pole driven into a square piece of earth in the centre of a newly dug pond, a boring rod.  E. नाग a snake, and अञ्चला end of a garment; it is also written नागाञ्चना f. (-ना) see नागयष्टि ।
21335: नागाधिप m. (-पः) The great serpent ANANTA.  E. नाग a serpent, and अधिप a king.
21336: नागान्तक m. (-कः) Garuda, the bird and vehicle of VISHṆU.  E. नाग a snake, and अन्तक a destroyer; this and similar compounds are also applied to the “Ardea Argala,” the peacock, and other birds who are natural enemies of the serpent genus.
21337: नागारूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Mounted or riding upon an elephant.  E. नाग, and आरूढ mounted.
21338: नागाशन m. (-नः) Garuda: see नागान्तक.  E. नाग a snake, and अशन food.

E. नदि to be happy, in the causal form, affix इन्, and ङीप्; delighting the gods, &c. or procuring happiness for mankind. नन्दन्ति देवा अत्र नन्द-घञ् पृषो० वृद्धिः ङीप् ।

21446: नारिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Watery, aqueous. 	 2. Spiritual.  E. नर or नार and ठक् aff.
21447: नारिकेर m. (-रः) The cocoanut: see the next.
21448: नारिकेल mf. (-लः-ली) The cocoanut.  E. नारिक watery (place), ईर् to go or grow, affix क, and र optionally changed to ल; also with इन्, नारिकेलि, and ड being substituted for र, नाडिकेर, &c. नल-इन् नालिः केन वायुना जलेन वा इलति चलति, इल-क-कर्म-रलयोरैक्यम् ।
21449: नारी f. (-री) 	 1. A woman in general, a female. 	 2. A species of the Madhya metre.  E. नर a man, अञ् and ङीप् affs. or नृ + नर + वा जातौ ङीष् निपातने ।
21450: नारीकवच m. (-चः) A king of the solar line, the son of ASMAKA.
21451: नारीकेल mf. (-लः-ली) The cocoanut. 	 f. (-ली) Fermented liquor made from the water of the cocoanut: see नारिकेल &c.
21452: नारीच n. (-चं) An esculent root, Arum colocasia: see नाडीच (नालिता)
21453: नारीतरङ्गक m. (-कः) A catamite.  E. नारी a woman, तरङ्ग capricious, and कन् affix of comparison. नारिं तरङ्गयति तरङ्ग + कृतौ-णिच्-ण्वुल् ।
21454: नारीदूषण n. (-णं) A vice or breach of duty in a woman, of which six cases are reckoned, drinking spirits, keeping bad company, quit-ting a husband, rambling abroad, and sleeping or dwelling in a strange house.  E. नारी a woman, दूषण defect.
21455: नारीप्रसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Libertinism, lechery.  E. नारी, and प्रसङ्ग addiction.
21456: नारीयान n. (-नं) A litter or other conveyance for women.  E. नारी, and यान a carriage.
21457: नार्य्यङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The orange tree; also नागरङ्ग । नार्य्यं नरहितसम्बन्धिनं गच्छति गम-ड । मुम् च ।
21458: नाल mfn. (-लः-ला or -ली-लं) 	 1. A hollow or tubular stalk, the stalk of the water lily, &c. 	 2. Any pipe or tube. 	 3. A handle. 	 n. (-लं) Yellow orpiment. 	 f. (-ली) 	 1. A stalk or culm.. 	 2. An instrument for perfora-ting an elephant's ear. 	 3. A period of time, a Ghati, twenty-four minutes. 	 4. Any tubular vessel of the body. 	 5. The pulse.  E. णल् to bind, affix ण, fem. affix टाप्, and ङीष्, &c.
21459: नालि(ली) f. (-लिः or ली) 	 1. Any tubular vessel of the body. 	 2. A hollow stalk.  E. ल interchanged with ड; see नाडि. नल-णिच्-इन् वा ङीप् ।
21460: नालिक m. (-कः) A buffalo. 	 n. (-कं) A lotus. 	 f. (-का) 	 1. A tubular stalk. 2. An instrument for piercing an elephant's ear. 	 3. A plant, commonly Charmaghās. 	 4. A sort of potherb, (Hibiscus canna-binus.) 	 5. Any plant growing on a hollow stem, as San, safflower, a mushroom, &c. 	 6. A flute.  E. नाली as above, and कन् aff. or नाल्या कायति कै-क ।
21461: नालिकास्त्र n. (-स्त्रम्) Cannon.  E. नालिक as above, and अस्त्र a missile weapon. (क्षुद्रनालिक means a pistol.)
21462: नालिकेर m. (-रः) The cocoanut.  E. नल् to bind, affix इन, नालि a leaf, &c. क air, wind, and इर what goes; fluttering in the wind. see नारिकेल ।
21463: नालिजङ्घ m. (-ङ्घः) A raven or the carrion crow.  E. नालि a tube, and जङ्घा the leg.
21464: नालिता f. (-ता) An esculent root, (Arum colocasia.)
21465: नालीक m. (-कः) 	 1. An arrow. 	 2. A dart, a javelin, a pike. 	 3. A lotus. 4. The fibrous stalk of the lotus. 	 n. (-कं) An assemblage of lotus flowers.  E. नाली a fibrous stalk, affix ठन्.
21466: नालीकिनी f. (-नी) A multitude of lotus flowers.  E. नालीक, and इनि aff.
21467: नालीव्रण m. (-णः) A fistulous or sinus sore; see नाडीव्रण, ल and ड being interchanged.
21468: नावमिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Ninth.  E. नवम and, ठञ्.
21469: नाविक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging to a vessel, or a boat, &c. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. The helmsman of a vessel, the steersman, the pilot. 	 2. A. sailor. E. नौ a boat, affix ठन्.
21470: नाव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 	 1. Navigable. 	 2. Belonging to a boat. 	 n. (-व्यं) Newness, novelty.  E. नौ a boat or vessel, and यत् affix; or नव new, ष्यञ् aff. नावा तीर्य्यते असौ, नवस्य भावः वा ।
21471: नाश m. (-शः) 	 1. Annihilation, loss, destruction, disappearance, ruin. 	 2. Death. 	 3. Flight, retreat. 	 4. Abandonment, desertion. (In Arith-metic.) 	 5. Elimination.  E. णश् to cease to be, affix भावे घञ्.
21472: नाशन n. (-नं) 	 1. Destruction, perishing. 	 2. Removal, expulsion.  E. णश् to perish, affix णिच्. ल्युट्.
21473: नाशयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) destroying annihilating.  E. णश् to perish, causal form, शतृ aff.
21474: नाशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Destroyed.  E. नश् to perish, causal form. क्त aff.
21475: नाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) 	 1. Destructive, destroying, a destroyer. 	 2. Perishing, being lost or destroyed.  E. नश् to cease to be, in the causal from, affix इनि; or नाश, and इनि aff.
21476: नाष्टिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging or relating to any thing lost. 	 m. (-कः) The owner of any thing lost.  E. नष्ट, and ठक् aff.
21477: नासत्य m. du. (-त्यौ) The two sons of AŚHWINĪ, and physicians of Swarga. 	 f. (-त्या) The constellation AŚHWINĪ.  E. न not, असत्य impure.
21478: नासा f. (-सा) 	 1. The nose. 	 2. The upper timber of a door. 	 3. The trunk of an elephant.  E. णस् to sound, to stand, अच् aff.
21479: नासाछिन्नी f. (-न्नी) A sort of bird; also पूर्णिका.  E. नासा the nose, छिन्न cut, fem. affix ङीप्.
21480: नासादक्षिणावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) Wearing the nose-ring in the right nostril by women who have money and children.  E. नासा the nose, दक्षिण the right, and आवर्त्त a turning.
21481: नासादारु m. (-रुः) The upper timber of a door: see नासा.
21482: नासानाह m. (-हः) Thickening of the membrance of the nose, stoppage of the nostrils.  E. नासा, and नाह binding
21483: नासापरिस्राव m. (-वः) 	 1. Running at the nose. 	 2. A running cold.  E. नासा and परिस्राव flow.
21484: नासारन्ध्र n. (-न्ध्रं) The nostril.  E. नासा, and रन्ध्र a hole.
21485: नासालु m. (-लुः) A plant, commonly Kāyaphal: see कट्फल.  E. नासा the nose, and लु to cut, affix डु.
21486: नासावंश m. (-शः) The bridge of the nose.  E. नासा and वंश bamboo.
21487: नासावामावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) Wearing the nose-ring in the left nostril, a mark of sorrow or distress.  E. नासा the nose. वाम the left side, आवर्त्त a turning.
21488: नासाशोष m. (-षः) Dryness of the nostrils.  E. नासा and शोष drying.
21489: नासिकन्धम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Blowing or breathing through the nose, snoring, &c.  E. नासिका the nose, ध्मा to blow &c. affix खश्. मुम् ह्रस्वश्च ।
21490: नासिकन्धय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Drinking through the nose.  E. नासिका, and घेट् to drink, affix. खञ् ।
21491: नासिका f. (-का) 	 1. The nose. 	 2. The upper timber, or nose as it were, of a door. 	 3. A name of the nymph AŚHwini.  E. नासा as above, affix कन् fem. form. or नास शब्दे ण्वुल् । The same as नासा ।
21492: नासिकाग्र m. (-ग्रं) The tip of the nose.  E. नासिका, and अग्र end.
21493: नासिकामल n. (-लं) The mucus of the nose, snot.  E. नासिका, and मल excrement; it may also be नासामल । शिङ्घाणे ।
21494: नासिक्य m. du. (-क्यौ) 	 1. The two sons of Aśhwini. 	 2. A nasal sound. n. (-क्यं) The nose.  E. नासिका, and यत् affix of identity or descent.
21495: नासिक्यक n. (-कं) The nose.  E. कन् added to the preceding.
21496: नासीर n. (-रं) Advancing or skirmishing in front of an army, leaving the line, and defying the enemy by shouts and gestures. 	 m. (-रः) The van, or a champion who advances before the line.  E. णास् to sound, affix ईरन्; or नासाय शब्दाय इर्त्ते इर-क ।
21497: नास्ति ind. Non-existence, not so, it is not.  E. न negative, and अस्ति is, third person, singular, present tense of अस् to be.
21498: नास्तिक m. (-कः) An atheist, but applied by the orthodox Hindūs, to any one who denies the divine authority of the Vedas, or doubts the legends of the Purānas, or a future life or the existence of a ruler, or creator of the universe.  E. नास्ति there is not (a god &c.) and ठन् aff.
21499: नास्तिकता f. (-ता) Atheism, denial of the deity, of a future state, of the divinity of the Vedas; Buddhism, heresy, &c.  E. तल् abs-tract affix added to the preceding: also with त्व नास्तिकत्व, or with यत् affix नास्तिक्य ।
21500: नास्तिक्य n. (-क्यं) Infidelity, atheism, heresy.  E. नास्तिक, and यत् aff.
21501: नास्तित्व n. (-त्वं) Non-existence.  E. त्व added to नास्ति; also with तल् affix नास्तिता; ।
21503: नास्य n. (-स्यं) The rein of an ox passed through the septum of the nostrils.  E. नासा the nose, शरीरावयवत्वात् यत् aff. नासायां भवम् ।
21504: नाह m. (-हः) 	 1. Binding, confinement. 	 2. A trap, a snare for catching deer, &c. 	 3. Obstruction in any organ or secretion of the body, as costiveness, &c.  E. णह् to bind, affix भावे घञ् ।
21505: नाहल m. (-लः) A man of a barbarous or outcast tribe.
21506: नाहुषि m. (-षिः) The name of a king; also YAYĀTI.  E. नहुष, and इञ् affix of descent. Also नाहुष ।
21507: निःकारण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Causeless, unfounded.  E. निर् neg. कारण cause.
21508: निःकासन n. (-नं) Expulsion, exile, turning out.  E. निर्, and कस् to go, causal form, ल्युट् affix; also निःकाशन ।
21509: निःकासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Turned out or forth, expelled, removed. E. निर् out, कस् to go, in the causal form, affix क्त; also निष्कासित, निःकाशित and निष्काशित ।
21510: निःक्रामित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Expelled, turned out.  E. निः for निर् out, क्रामित caused to go, also निष्क्रामित ।
21511: निःक्षत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) Having none of the military tribe, (in a city, &c.)  E. निर् not, चत्र a Kshetriya.
21512: निःक्षिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 	 1. Thrown or sent away. 	 2. Spent. 	 3. Passed. E. निर् before, क्षिप्त to throw, &c. affix क्त ।
21513: निःक्षिप्य ind. 	 1. Having thrown or sent away. 	 2. Having spent, (as time.) 	 3. Having wiped away, (as tears,) &c.  E. निर् before, क्षिप् to throw, and ल्यप् aff.
21514: निःक्षेप m. (-पः) 	 1. Throwing, sending, putting away. 	 2. Spending. 3 Passing, (as time.) 	 4. Wiping away, (as tears)  E. निर् and क्षिप् to throw, घञ् aff.
21515: निःप्रभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Gloomy, dark, obscured.  E. निः for निर् priva-tive, and प्रभा light; also निष्प्रभ.
21516: निःफल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Fruitless, barren.  E. निर् neg. फल fruit, more commonly निष्फल.
21517: निःशंसय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Undoubted.  E. निः for निर्, शंसय doubt.
21518: निःशङ्क mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं) Fearless.  E. निर् and शङ्का apprehension.
21519: निःशलाक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Solitary, private.  E. निः for निर् privative, and शलाका the maina; not even frequented by birds; also निश्शलाक.
21520: निःशब्द mfn. (-ब्दः-ब्दा-ब्दं) Silent, voiceless.  E. निः for निर्, and शब्द sound.
21521: निःशूक m. (-कः) Rice without any awn or beard.  E. निः for निर् and शूक beard of corn.
21522: निःशेष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Complete, entire.  E. निः for निर् negative, and शेष remainder; also निश्शेष.
21523: निःशोध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) Cleansed, cleared, purified.  E. निः for निर् implying completion, and शोध्य pure; also निश्शोध्य.
21524: निःश्रयणी f. (-णी) Wooden steps, a ladder, a staircase.  E. निः for निर् out, forth, श्रि to go, affix ल्युट्; also with अच् affix, and इनि added, निःश्रयिणी.
21525: निःश्रेणि f. (-णिः-णी) 	 1. A ladder or staircase, a flight of steps. 	 2. The wild date tree.  E. निः for निर् implying certainty, and श्रेणी a line also निश्श्रेणी.
21526: निश्रेयसः n. (-यः) 	 1. Final beatitude, the release of the soul from the body, and its reunion with the primary and universal spirit. 	 2. Happiness, welfare. 	 3. Knowledge, learning. 	 4. Belief, faith, devotedness. 	 5. Apprehension, conception. 	 m. (-याः) A name of SIVA.  E. निः for निर् implying eternity or certainty, श्रेयस् best, अच् added; also निश्श्रेयस.
21527: निःश्वसन n. (-नं) 	 1. Sighing, &c. 	 2. Breathing out.  E. निर् and श्वसन breathing.
21528: निःश्वसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Sighed, sig hing. 	 2. Breathing out. 	 n. (-तं) 	 1. Expiration. 	 2. Sighing.  E. निर् and श्वस् to breathe, क्त aff.
21529: निःश्वस्य ind. Having sighed.  E. निर् and श्वस् to breathe, affix ल्यप्.
21530: निःश्वास m. (-सः) 	 1. Breathing out, expiration. 	 2. Sighing.  E. निर्, and श्वस् to breathe, भावे घञ् aff.
21531: निःश्वासपरम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Sorrowful.  E. निःश्वास and परम best.
21532: निःषमम् ind. 	 1. A particle of reproof, (improperly, unseasonably.) 2 A term of regret, (das!)  E. निर् not, सम equal to, र is changed to Visarga, and स becomes ष.
21533: निःसङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) 	 1. Separated, unconnected. 	 2. Regardless, indifferent, free from attachment or desire.  E. निर् not, सङ्ग associa-tion.
21534: निःसंज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Senseless, insensible.  E. निर् not, संज्ञा sign of life.
21535: निःसत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) False, untrue.  E. निर् neg. सत्य true.
21536: निःसत्यता f. (-ता) Insincerity, falsehood.  E. निर् neg. सत्यता truth.
21537: निःसत्व mfn. (-त्वः-त्वा-त्वं) 	 1. Weak, impotent. 	 2. Insignificant, mean, low. 	 3. Non-existent. 	 4. Insubstantial. 	 n. (-त्वं) 	 1. Insignificance, absence of power or consideration. 	 2. Non-existence.  E. निर् neg. सत्व substance, &c.
21538: निःस(ष)न्धि mfn. (-न्धिः-न्धिः-न्धि) Firm, well-knit, compact.  E. निर् not, सन्धि junction; the joints of which are not perceivable. निष्क्रान्तः सन्धेः सुश्लिष्टित्वात् निरादिस० सुषमा-षत्वम् ।
21539: निःसम्पात m. (-तः) 	 1. Without motion. 	 2. Midnight.  E. निर् neg. सम्पात going, from पत् to go, with सम् prefix, and घञ् aff.
21540: निःसरण n. (-णं) 	 1. Death, dying. 	 2. A means or expedient. 	 3. Exit, a going forth or out. 	 4. Final beatitude. 	 5. The entrance into a house or town, &c. the gate, the gate-way.  E. निर् forth or out, सृ, to go, भावे ल्युट् aff.
21541: निःसह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 	 1. Intolerable, unbearable. 	 2. Irresistible. 	 3. Unable to support or bear.  E. निर् neg. सह bearing.
21542: निःसहत्व n. (-त्वं) 	 1. Inability to bear or support. 	 2. Impatience, unen-durance.  E. निःसह, and त्व affix; also with तल् निःसहता.
21543: निःसाध्वस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Bold, fearless.  E. निर् and साध्वस fear.
21544: निःसार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Sapless, pithless. 	 2. Worthless, vain, insubs-tantial. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A plant, (Trophis aspera.) 	 2. Going forth. 	 f. (-रा) The plantain.  E. निर् privative, सार essence, pith; or निर् out, सृ to go, घञ् aff.
21545: निःसारण n. (-णं) 	 1. Going forth or out. 	 2. The entrance of a house or town, &c. the passage, the road of ingress and egress.  E. निर् forth or out, and सृ to go णिच्ल्युट् aff; see निःसरण.
21546: निःसारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Turned forth or out, expelled, dismissed. E. निर् out, and सारित caused to go. निर सृ-णिच् कर्मणि क्त ।
21547: निःसुख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) 	 1. Disagreeable, distressing. 	 2. Unhappy. E. निर् neg. सुख pleasure.
21548: निःसृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone forth or out.  E. निर्, and सृ to go, affix क्त.
21549: निःस्नेह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 	 1. Dry, not greasy or unctuous. 	 2. Cold, in-sensible, unfeeling. 	 f. (-हा) Linseed, (Linum utilitissimum.) E. निर् forth, out, and स्नेह oil; whence oil is extracted or expressed, &c. or निर् privative, स्नेह oil or affection.
21550: निःस्पृह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 	 1. Free from desire. 	 2. Disregarding, indiffer-ent to.  E. निर् neg. स्पृहा wish.
21551: निःस्राव m. (-वः) The moisture or water of boiled rice.  E. निर forth, and स्राव what is oozing or निर-स्रु-ण (फेन) ।
21552: निःस्व mfn. (-स्वः-स्वा-स्वं) Poor, indigent.  E. निर् not, nothing, स्व own property.

22281: निष्कारुष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Of a noble, not degraded.

22283: निष्काश(स) m. (-शः or सः) 	 1. A portico, a vārāndā. 	 2. Exit, egress. 	 3. Day break.  E. निर् and कश् to go, भावे घञ् aff.
22284: निष्काशित mfn. (-तः -ता -तं) 	 1. Expelled: see the next.
22285: निष्कासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Expelled, dismissed, turned out. 	 2. Gone forth or out, issued. 	 3. Placed, deposited. 	 4. Placed over, appoint-ed, stationed. 	 5. Reviled, reproached, 6. Opened out, blown, expanded.  E. निर् out, कस् to go, in the causal form, aff. क्त, र be-comes ष or Visarga: see निःकासित; also निष्काशित.
22286: निष्कासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Who or what expels. 	 f. (-नी) A female slave not restrained by her master.  E. निर् forth, कस् to go, causal form, णिनि aff.
22287: निष्कुट m. (-टः) 	 1. A pleasure grove near a house. 	 2. A field. 	 3. A door. 4. The private apartments, the Zenana. 	 5. The harem of a king. E. निर् without, कुट the house. 	 f. (-टा, also -टिः or -टी) Large carda-moms.  E. निर् out, कुट the shell or husk, aff. क, with टाप् fem. aff. or कि with ङीष् optionally added.
22288: निष्कुम्भ m. (-म्भः) A plant, commonly Danti.  E. निर् forth, ष्कुम्भ a Sautra root, to spread, aff. अच्; also निःकुम्भ.
22289: निष्कुषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Expelled, extracted, forced or drawn out. E. निर् neg. कुष् to extract, aff. निष्कर्षे-क्त ।
22290: निष्कुह m. (-हः) The hollow of a tree.  E. निर् affirmative prefix, कुह् to astonish, aff. अच्.
22291: निष्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Regardless, negligent. 	 2. Disregarded, thought nothing of. 	 3. Pardoned. 	 4. Undone.  E. निर् neg. कृत made.
22292: निष्कृति f. (-तिः) 	 1. Pardon, absolution. 	 2. Expiration. 	 3. Escaping from, avoiding the consequence of anything. 	 4. Undoing, doing away. 	 5. Disregarding, neglecting. 	 6. Acquittance, compensation, discharge of a debt or obligation.  E. निर् neg. कृ to do, क्तिन् affix.
22293: निष्कोषन n. (-नं) 	 1. Taking away. 	 2. Extracting, extirpating. 	 3. Hus-king, shelling.  E. निर् before, कुष् to expel, aff. ल्युट्.
22294: निष्कोषितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be taken away.  E. निर् out, कुष् to expel, तव्य aff.; also निष्कोषणीय ।
22295: निष्क्रम m. (-मः) 	 1. Any intellectual faculty, as attention, comprehen-sion, &c. 	 2. Degradation, baseness, inferiority of tribe, family, &c. 3. Going out, exit. 	 4. Intellectual faculty.  E. निर् assuredly or forth, and क्रम going.
22296: निष्क्रमण n. (-णं) 	 1. Going forth or out. 	 2. Taking a child for the first time out of the house, in the fourth month, considered as an essential ceremony, and accompanied by sacrifice, &c. E. निर् forth, क्रम to go, ल्युट् aff.
22297: निष्क्रम्य ind. Going forth,  E. निर्, क्रम् to go, ल्यप् aff.
22298: निष्क्रय m. (-यः) 	 1. Hire, wages. 	 2. Reward. 	 3. Barter. 	 4. Price. 	 5. Ran-som.  E. निर् before, क्री to buy, aff. अच्.
22299: निष्क्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Gone out, gone, departed.  E. निर् out, क्रम् to go, aff. क्त.
22300: निष्क्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. Abstaining from ceremonial rites. 	 2. Idle, unoccupied. 	 n. (-यं) BRAMHĀ or the Supreme Spirit.  E. निर neg. क्रिया act.
22301: निष्क्वाथ m. (-थः) Broth, soup.  E. निर् before, क्वथ् to decoct, aff. घञ्.
22302: निष्ट्य m. (-ष्ट्यः) A man of one of the outcast or barbarous tribes.
22303: निष्टप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 	 1. Well done, dressed or cooked. 	 2. Burnished, made bright.  E. निर्, and तप्त heated.
22304: निष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) 	 1. Staying, being in, who or what stays or is in or on anything. 	 2. Believing, faithful. 	 3. Skilled in. 4. Devoted to. 	 f. (-ष्ठा) 	 1. The catastrophe of a drama, the conclusion of a fable. 	 2. Conclusion in general, end, termination. 	 3. Disappearance, loss, destruction. 	 4. Confirmation, completion. 	 5. Asking, begging. 	 6. Ordinary and uniform practice or profession. 	 7. Good conduct, excellence. 8. Religious practice, devout and austere exercise. 	 9. Faith, belief. 	 10. Condition, state. 	 11. Fixed time of life, &c. 	 12. Trouble, distress, anxiety. 	 13. The technical term for the past participial affixes क्त and क्तवतु.  E. नि completely, assuredly, स्था to stay or stop, क्त aff.
22305: निष्ठान n. (-नं) Sauce, condiment.  E. नि before, स्या to stay, aff ल्युट्.
22306: निष्ठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Firm, fixed. 	 2. Certain, ascertained. 	 3. En-gaged in, attached to, devoted to. 	 4. Staying, being in or on. E. नि before, स्था to stay, क्त aff.
22308: निष्ठीवन n. (-नं) Spitting, spitting out, ejecting any thing from the mouth.  E. नि before, ष्ठिव to object, aff. ल्युट्; also निष्ठेवन and निष्ठीव ।
22309: निष्ठुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Harsh, contumelious (as speech.) 	 2. Hard, solid. 	 3. Cruel. 	 4. Severe.  E. नि before, स्था to be, to be firm, aff. उरच् ।
22310: निष्ठुरता f. (-ता) Harshness of speech, reviling, abuse.  E. निष्ठुर, and तल् aff., also with त्व, निष्ठुरत्व.
22311: निष्ठ्यूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Cast, thrown, sent, directed, despatched. 	 2. Ejected from the mouth, spit.  E. नि before, ष्ठिव् to eject, aff. क्त, deriv. irr.
22312: निष्ठ्यूति f. (-तिः) Spitting, spitting out.  E. नि before, ष्थिव् to eject from the mouth, aff. क्त.
22313: निष्ठेव subst. 	 mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Spitting, spitting out, ejecting any thing from the mouth.  E. नि before, ष्ठिव् to eject, aff. घञ्; also निष्ठीव.
22314: निष्ठेवन n. (-नं) Spitting. E. See the last; also निष्ठीव.
22315: निष्ण mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं) Skilful, &c. see the next.  E. नि + स्ना + क ।
22316: निष्णात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Skiful, clever, conversant, learned. 	 2. Perfect, superior, supreme. 	 3. (In law,) Agreed upon.  E. नि before, स्ना to bathe, aff. कर्त्तरि-क्त; also with ड, निष्ण.
22317: निष्पक्क mfn. (-क्वः-क्वा-क्वं) Decocted, infused, boiled.  E. निर् before, पक्व ripe or cooked.
22318: निष्पङ्क mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं) Pure, free from mud or filth.  E. निर् neg. पङ्क mud.
22319: निष्पतत् mfn. (-तन्-तन्ती-तत्) Issuing, going forth or out.  E. निर् before, पत् to go, शतृ aff.
22320: निष्पतन n. (-नं) Going forth or out, issuing.  E. निर्, and पतन going.
22321: निष्पत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 	 1. Completion, conclusion, termination, consumma-tion. 	 2. Birth, production. 	 3. Going forth or out.  E. निर् negative, पद् to go, aff. क्तिन्.
22322: निष्पत्राकृति f. (-तिः) Excessive bodily pain.  E. निष्पत्र + डाच् + क-भावे क्तिन् ।
22323: निष्पन्द mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं) Motionless.  E. निर् not, स्पदि to shake or move, aff: अच्; also निष्पन्न.
22324: निष्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 	 1. Done, finished, concluded, completed. 	 2. Born, produced. 	 3. Motionless. 	 4. Gone forth or out of.  E. निर् affirmation or negation, and पन्न gone, from पद् to go, aff. क्त.
22325: निष्पराक्रम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Weak, destitute of power.  E. निर् neg. पराक्रम valour.
22326: निष्परिग्रह m. (-हः) An ascetic, one who has no family nor dependants. E. निर् neg. परिग्रह dependants.
22327: निष्पादन nf. (-नं-ना) 	 1. Doing, effecting, accomplishing. 	 2. Concluding. 3. Producing, causing, engendering.  E. निर् forth, पद् to go, causal form, aff. युच् ।
22328: निष्पादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Done, effected, made produced.  E. निर् forth, पद् to go, causal form, क्त aff.
22329: निष्पाद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) To be done, to be effected or accomplished. E. निर forth, पद् to go, causal form यत् aff.; also निष्पादनीय and निष्पादयितव्य.
22330: निष्पाद्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being done or made, in the course of com-pletion.  E. निर् before, पद् to go, causal form, शानच् aff.
22331: निष्पान n. (-नं) Drinking.  E. निर् before, पान drinking.
22332: निष्पाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Certain, indubitable. 	 m. (-वः) 	 1. Winnowing, cleaning corn, &c. 	 2. Wind, air. 	 3. The wind of the winnowing sieve or basket. 	 4. Straw, chaff. 	 5. A legume, a pod. 	 6. A sort of pulse, (Phaseolus radiatus.)  E. निर् before, पू to purify, aff. करणे घञ्.
22333: निष्पिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Ground, reduced to dust or powder. 	 2. Beaten, oppressed.  E. निर्, and पिष्ट ground.
22334: निष्पुत्त्र mfn. (-त्त्रः-त्त्रा-त्त्रं) Sonless,  E. निर्, and पुत्त्र a son.
22335: निष्पुरुष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Feminine, neuter, not male. 	 m. (-षः) 	 1. a eunuch or impotent man. 	 2. A coward.  E. निर् neg. पुरुष a man.
22336: निष्प्रतिभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Stupid, frigid, dull, apathetic, ignorant. E. निर् privative, प्रतिभ brilliance.
22337: निष्प्रत्यूह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Unobstructed, unimpeded. 	 n. adv. (-हं) Freely, without hindrance.  E. निर् neg. प्रत्यूह obstacle.
22338: निष्प्रभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Gloomy, dark, obscure.  E. निर privative, and प्रभा light.
22339: निष्प्रयोजन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Causeless, groundless.  E. निर् negative, प्रयोजन, motive, cause.
22340: निष्पृह mfn. (-हृः-हा-हं) Content, not envying any person, nor covet-ing any thing. 	 f. (-हा) A plant; also अमूला and विष्णुवल्लभा.  E. निर् not, स्पृहा envy, &c.
22341: निष्प्रवाण(णि) mfn. subst. (-णः-णी-णं) New and unbleached cloth.  E. निर् gone, प्रवाणी here said to mean the weaver's brush; also निष्प्रवाणि mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि) the forms are irregular.
22342: निष्फल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Barren, unfruitful. 	 2. Seedless, impotent. 	 f. (-ला or -ली) A woman past child-bearing: one in whom menstrua-tion has ceased: see निष्कल.  E. निर् priv. and फल fruit.
22344: निसर्ग m. (-र्गः) 	 1. The natural state, nature, peculiar character or condition. 	 2. Form. 	 3. Creation. 	 4. Relinquishment, abandon-ing. 	 5. Transfer, barter. 	 6. Voiding excrement.  E. नि before, सृज् to create, or to abandon, aff. घञ् ।
22345: निसर्गज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 	 1. Cognate, innate. 	 2. Produced at crea-tion.  E. निसर्ग, and ज produced.
22346: निसिन्धु m. (-न्धुः) A shrub, (Vitex negundo:) it is also read निसिन्ध, and with कन् added निसुन्धक; the words are considered as barbar-ous: see सिन्धुवार ।
22347: निसूदन n. (-नं) Killing, slaughter.  E. नि before, सूद् to kill, aff. भावे ल्युट्ः also निषूदन ।
22348: निसृता f. (-ता) A plant commonly Teori.  E. नि + सृ-क्त स्त्रियां-आप् ।
22349: निसृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Delivered, deposited. 	 2. Centrical, middle. 3. Permitted. 	 4. Abandoned.  E. नि before, सृज् to go, aff कर्मणि-क्त ।
22350: निसृष्टार्थ m. (-र्थः) A messenger, an envoy, an ambassador: one who decides upon his own discretion, knowing the intents of both parties.  E. निषृष्ट deposited, अर्थ meaning.
22351: निस्तनी f. (-नी) A pill, a bolus, a sort of force-meat ball.  E. नि before, स्तन a breast, ङीप् diminutive aff.
22352: निस्तरण n. (-णं) 	 1. Going out or forth. 	 2. Crossing over or pass-ing. 	 3. Extraction, getting rid of or free from. 	 4. Means of suc-cess, an expedient, a plan,  E. निर् before, तॄ to cross or pass over, aff. करणे ल्युट् ।
22353: निस्तब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) 	 1. Paralysed, numbered. 	 2. Stopped, fixed. E. नि before, स्तम्भ् to stop, aff. क्त ।
22354: निस्तर्हण n. (-णं) Killing, slaughter.  E. निर् before, तृहू to kill or hurt, aff. भावे ल्युट् ।
22355: निस्तल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Round, globular. 	 2. Trembling, shaking, moving. 	 3. Down, below.  E. निर् negative or affirmative, and तल a support or stay; or depth, bottom.
22356: निस्तार m. (-रः) 	 1. Getting over or across. 	 2. Getting rid of, or away from, extraction, escape. 	 3. Acquittance, requital. 	 4. Means, expedient. 	 5. Final liberation.  E. निर्, and तॄ to cross, घञ् aff.
22357: निस्तारवीज n. (-ञः) The cause of final liberation, faith in any deity. &c.  E. निस्तार, and वीज seed.
22358: निस्तितीर्षत् mfn. (-र्षन्-र्षन्ती-र्षत्) 	 1. Desirous or anxious to cross. 	 2. Wishing for salvation, or to traverse the world.  E. निर् before, तॄ to cross, desid. form, शतृ aff.
22359: निस्तुष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Freed from the chaff, (corn, &c.)  E. निर् neg. तुष chaff.
22360: निस्तुषक्षीर m. (-रः) Wheat.  E. निस्तुष, and क्षीर milk.
22361: निस्तुषरत्न n. (-त्नं) Crystal.  E. निस्तुष, and रत्न a gem.
22362: निस्तुषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Left abandoned, deserted. 	 2. Skinned, peeled. 3. Pared, made thin.  E. निर् before, तुष् husk or skin, converted in to a nominal verb, and क्त participial aff.
22363: निस्तेजस् mfn. (-जाः-जाः-जः) 	 1. Dull, obscure. 	 2. Dull, spiritless. 3. Powerless, impotent,  E. निर् neg. तेजस् light, &c.
22364: निस्त्रंश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Fearless, unapprehensive.  E. निर् neg. त्रशि to fear, aff अच्.
22365: निस्त्रिंश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Merciless, unfeeling, unpitying. 	 m. (-शः) A scimitar, a sacrificial knife.  E. निर् forth, त्रिंशत् thirty, ड aff; being of thirty finger's length, &c.
22366: निस्त्रिंशधारिन् m. (-री) A soldier armed with a sword.  E. निस्त्रिंश, and धारिन् who bears.
22367: निस्त्रैगुण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) Destitute of the qualities, truth, passion, and darkness.  E. निर् neg. त्रैगुण्य three qualities.
22368: निस्नाव m. (-वः) The remainder of articles, &c. after a sale or market.
22369: निस्पन्द mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं) Still, steady, immoveable. 	 m. (-न्दः) Thro-bbing, trembling.  E. नि before, स्पद् to go, aff घञ् ।
22370: निस्पृह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Content, unenvious. 	 f. (-हा) 	 1. A plant. (Gloriosa superba.) 	 2. Contentment.  E. नि neg. स्पृहा desire.
22371: निस्यन्द m. (-न्दः) Trickling, oozing, issuing.  E. नि before, स्यन्द to ooze, aff. घञ् ।
22372: निस्राव m. (-वः) 	 1. The scum of boiled rice. 	 2. A torrent.  E. नि before, स्रु to ooze or drop, aff घञ्.
22373: निस्वन m. (-नः) 	 1. Sound. 	 2. Silence,  E. नि before, स्वन् to sound, aff. अप्.
22374: निस्वान m. (-नः) Sound.  E. नि before, स्वन with घञ् aff.: see to last.
22375: निहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Killed, slain.  E. नि affir. हत killing.
22376: निहनन n. (-नं) Killing, slaughter,  E. नि before, हन to kill, तृच् aff.
22377: निहन्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) Murderous, who or what kills.  E. नि before, हन् to kill, तृच् aff.
22378: निहन्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Killed.  E. नि, हन to kill, pass. v. शानच् aff.
22379: निहव m. (-वः) Calling, calling to.  E. नि before, ह्वे to call, अप् aff.
22380: निहाका f. (-का) An iguana or the Gangetic alligator.  E. नि before, हा to quit, Unādi aff. कन्.
22381: निह्यर m. (-रः) Frost, dew: see नीहार.  E. नि + हृ + कर्मणि घञ् वा दीर्घः ।
22382: निहिंसन n. (-नं) Killing, slaughter.  E. नि before, हिंस् to kill or hurt, aff. भावे ल्युट्
22383: निहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Deposited, delivered, given, entrusted. 	 2. Applied to, bestowed upon. 	 3. Laid, (as dust by rain.)  E. नि before, धा to have, aff. क्त; हिरादेशः ।
22384: निहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) A low man, an outcast.  E. नि before, हीन abandoned.
22385: निह्नव m. (-वः) 	 1. Denial or concealment of knowledge, dissimulation, secrecy. 	 2. Concealment in general. 	 3. Mistrust, doubt, suspicion. 4. Wickedness. 	 5. A secret. 	 6. Excuse.  E. नि before, ह्नु to hide or secrete aff. अप्.
22386: निह्नववादिन् m. (-दी) A defendant or witness who prevaricates or tries to hide the truth.  E. निह्नव and वादिन् who speaks.
22387: निह्नवोत्तर n. (-रं) An evasive reply or defence.  E. निह्नव, and उत्तर answer.

22519: नृचक्षस् m. (-क्षाः) A demon, a Rākshasa, a goblin.  E. नृ a man, and चक्षस् an eater; from चक्ष् to eat, असुन् aff.

22523: नृतू m. (-तूः) 	 1. A dancer, a mime, an actor. 	 2. Earth. 	 3. A worm. 	 4. Length.  E. नृत् to dance, and कू aff.
22524: नृत्त m. (-त्तं) Dancing.  E. नृत् to dance, aff. क्त.
22525: नृत्य n. (-त्यं) Dancing, acting, the actor's practice in general.  E. नृत् to dance, aff. क्यप्.
22526: नृत्यत् mfn. (-त्यन्-त्यन्ती-त्यत्) Dancing.  E. नृत् to dance, शतृ aff.

22528: नृधर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Acting as a man, doing a man's duty, &c. m. (-र्म्मा) A name of KUVERA. 	 n. (-र्म्म) Manly property or duty. E. नृ man, धर्म्म virtue, अनिच् aff.
22529: नृप m. (-पः) A king, a sovereign.  E. नृ man, पा to protect, aff. क.

22532: नृपद्रुम m. (-मः) A tree, (Cassia fistula.)  E. नृप, and द्रुम a tree.
22533: नृपप्रिय m. (-यः) A thorny species of bamboo, (Bambusa spinosa.) E. नृप a king, and प्रिय fond of. (वेड्वांँश) ।
22534: नृपमन्दिर n. (-रं) A royal palace.  E. नृप a king, and मन्दिर a residence.
22535: नृपमान n. (-नं) Sound of music, made to give warning to kings when eating or feasting.  E. नृप, and मान measure.
22536: नृपलक्ष्मन् n. (-क्ष्म) 	 1. The royal umbrella. 	 2. Any of the royal insignia. E. नृप, and लक्ष्मण a mark or sign.
22537: नृपलिङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) Any emblem or mark of royalty.  E. नृप, and लिङ्ग a mark.
22538: नृपलिङ्गधर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Assuming the insignia of sovereignty. 	 2. Taking, (fraudulently,) the emblem or marks of the royal or mi-litary caste.  E. नृपलिङ्ग, and धर who has.
22539: नृपवल्लभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) 	 1. A king's friend. 	 2. A prepared oil or ghee containing medicinal properties. 	 f. (-भा) A queen.  E. नृप, and वल्लभ beloved.
22540: नृपसंश्रय m. (-यः) Service of princes.  E. नृप, and संश्रय dependance.

22544: नृपाध्वर m. (-रः) A sort of sacrifice; the Rājasūya, held by a lord pa-ramount, in which all the offices are performed by tributary princes.  E. नृप a king, अध्वर a sacrifice.

22546: नृपामय m. (-यः) Consumption.  E. नृप, and आमय disease.
22547: नृपावर्त्त n. (-र्त्तं) A kind of gem.  E. नृप, and आवर्त्त what revolves.
22548: नृपासन n. (-नं) A throne.  E. नृप a king, and आसन a seat.
22549: नृपोचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Kingly, princely, suited to a king.  E. नृप, and उचित proper.
22550: नृयज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) Hospitality.  E. नृ a man, and यज्ञ sacrifice.
22551: नृवराह m. (-हः) The third or the boar incarnation of VISHṆU.  E. नृ a man, वराह a boar; being delineated with the figure of a man, and the head of the wild boar.
22552: नृशंस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Malicious, wicked, hurtful, injurious, mischievous, destructive.  E. नृ man, शसि to hurt, aff. अण ।
22553: नृशंसवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Practising mischief.  E. नृशंस, and वृत्त engaged in.

22555: नृसेन(ना) nf. (-नं-ना) An army of men.  E. नृ a man, and सेना an army.
22556: नृसोम m. (-मः) An illustrious or great man, a prince or chief.  E. नृ mankind, and सोम the moon, here implying superiority, or ex-cellence.
22557: नृहरि m. (-रिः) VISHṆU as the man-lion.  E. नृ and हरि a lion.
22558: नेजक m. (-कः) A washerman.  E. णिज् to cleanse, aff. ण्वुल् ।
22559: नेतव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be taken, to be carried or conducted.  E. णी to take, तव्य aff.
22560: नेतृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Leading, conducting, one who guides or leads, &c. 	 m. (-ता) 	 1. A master, an owner. 	 2. A guide.  E. णी to lead, aff. तृच् ।

The string of a churning rope. 	 6. An enema-pipe. 	 7. The number “two”. 	 mn. (-त्रः-त्रं) Any tubular vessel. 	 f. (-त्री) 	 1. A river. 	 2. The goddess LAKSHMĪ.  E. णी to guide or gain, Unādi aff. ष्ट्रन्, fem. aff. ङीप् ।

22598: नैचिक n. (-कं) The head of an ox. 	 f. (-की) A capital cow.  E. नीकैस् low, down, चर् to go, ठक् aff. and the radical finals rejected; also नीचिकी, &c.
22599: नैज mfn. (-जः-जी-जं) Own  E. निज, and अण् aff.

22606: नैपालिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Produced in or brought from Nepal &c. 	 n. (-कं) Copper.  E. नेपाल, and ठेक् aff.
22607: नैपुण n. (-णं) Dexterity, cleverness, skill.  E. निपुण skilful, aff. अण; also with ष्यञ् aff., नैपण्य n. (ण्यं) ।
22609: नैमित्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Occasional. 	 n. (-कं) 	 1. An effect (opposite to “cause”) 	 2. Occasional, periodical act or rite. 	 m. (-कः) An astro-loger, a prophet.  E. निमित्त cause, ठक् aff.

22844: पञ्चप्राण m. plu. (-णाः) The five airs supposed to be in the body, and necessary to life. viz:--प्राण, अपान, व्यान, उदान, समान ।  E. पञ्च, and प्राण vital air.
22845: पञ्चप्रासाद m. (-दः) A temple with four pinnacles and a steeple. E. पञ्च, and प्रासाद a palace.
22846: पञ्चबन्ध m. (-न्धः) A fine equal to the fifth part of any thing lost or stolen.  E. पञ्च five, and बन्ध binding.
22847: पञ्चभद्र mfn. (-द्रःद्री-द्रं) A horse with five auspicious marks; or spotted on the chest, back, face, and flanks. 	 n. (-द्रं) A sauce or condiment of five vegetables.  E. पञ्च five, and भद्र fortunate.
22848: पञ्चभूत mn. (-तः-तं) The five elements; earth, air, fire, water, Ākās. E. पञ्च, and भूत an element.
22849: पञ्चभूतात्मन् m. (-त्मा) Man as formed of the five elements.  E. पञ्चभूत, and आत्मन् one with.

It is called Panchama, from being said to be formed by air drawn from five places; the navel, the breast, the heart, the throat, and forehead. 	 2. One of the RĀGAS or modes of music. 	 f. (-मी) 	 1. A name of DRAUPADĪ, the wife of the five Pāndus. 	 2. A che-quered cloth for playing at draughts, &c. a chess board. 	 3. The fifth day of a half month. 	 4. The ablative case, (in gram.) 	 n. (-मं) 	 1. The fifth. 	 2. Sexual intercourse.  E. पञ्चन् five, and डटि aff. with मट augment; or पञ्चपतीन् मिनोति वध्नाति प्रेम्णा । मी-वन्धे ।
22851: पञ्चमकार n. (-रं) The five essentials of the left hand Tantra ritual; “Madya” wine, “Maṃsa” flesh, “Matsya” fish, “Maithuna” copu-lation, “Mudra” gesticulation.  E. पञ्च, and मकार the letter M; all beginning with that letter.
22852: पञ्चमवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having the fifth of any thing.  E. पञ्चम, and मतुप् aff.
22853: पञ्चमहापातक n. (कं) The five great sins. They are thus described in Vāchaspatya. viz:--ब्रह्महत्या सुरापानं स्तेयं गुर्वङ्गनागमः । महान्ति पातकान्याहुः संसर्गश्चापि तैः सह ॥
22854: पञ्चमहायज्ञ m. plu. (-ज्ञाः) The five great sacraments of the Hindus, or the worship of spirits, progenitors, gods, Vedas, and man-kind, by offerings of perfumes and flowers, obsequial rites, oblations with fire, the study of the Vedas, and hospitality. E. पञ्च five, महा great, and यज्ञ sacrifice.
22855: पञ्चमार m. (-रः) The son of BALADEVA. पञ्चविधकामे च ।
22856: पञ्चमाषिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of five Māshas, relating to, worth, amount-ing to five Māshas.  E. पञ्च, माष a measure of silver, ठक् aff.
22857: पञ्चमास्य m. (-स्यः) The Kokila or Indian cuckoo.  E. पञ्चम, the musical note, and आस्य mouth.
22858: पञ्चमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Being in the fifth year of one's age. E. पञ्चम, and इनि aff.
22859: पञ्चमुख m. (-खः) 	 1. A name of SĪVA. 	 2. A lion.  E. पञ्च five, and मुख face.
22860: पञ्चमुद्रा f. (-द्रा) Five gestures to be made in the usual presentation of offerings to an idol.  E. पञ्च, and मुद्रा gesture.
22861: पञ्चमूत्र n. (-त्रं) The urine of the cow, goat, sheep, buffalo, and ass. E. पञ्च, and मूत्र urine.
22862: पञ्चमूल n. (-लं) The assemblage of five roots, viz:--The Bel, Premna longi-folia, Cassia, Gmelian arborea, and the Trumpet flower. 	 f. (-ली) A similar aggregate of five roots, considered as the similar one, viz:--Hedysarum gangeticum, H. logopodioides, Solanum melon-gena, S. Jacquini, and Tribulus lanuginosus.  E. पञ्च five, मूल a root; the fem. aff. has a diminutive import.
22863: पञ्चयज्ञ m. plu, (-ज्ञाः) The five rites of a house-keeper: see पञ्चमहायज्ञ । E. पञ्च, and यज्ञ a sacrifice.
22864: पञ्चरत्न n. (-त्नं) A collection of five precious objects; viz:--Gold, a diamond, a pearl, a ruby, an amethyst.  E. पञ्च and रत्न a gem. For particulars see Vāchaspatya.
22865: पञ्चरसा f. (-सा) Emblic myrobalan.  E. पञ्च five, रस flavour, taste. (आम्लकी)
22866: पञ्चलक्षण n. (-णं) A Purāna or mythological poem.  E. पञ्च five, and लक्षण a mark; Puraṇa should comprehend five topics; the creation of worlds, their destruction and renovation, the genea-logy of gods and heroes, the reigns of the MANUS, and the ac-tions of their descendants.
22867: पञ्चलवण n. (-णं) Five kinds of salt.  E. पञ्च, and लवण salt. viz:--काचकं सैन्धवं चैव सामुद्रं विडमेवच । सौवर्चल तथा पञ्चलवणं परिकीर्त्तितम् ॥
22868: पञ्चलाङ्गलक n. (-कं) Gift of land to the extent requiring five ploughs. E. पञ्च, लाङ्गल a plough, कन् aff.
22869: पञ्चलोह n. (-हं) A metallic alloy containing five metals; copper, brass, tin, lead, and iron.  E. पञ्च five, and लोह iron.
22870: पञ्चवक्त्र m. (-क्त्रा) 	 1. SIVA. 	 2. A lion.  E. पञ्च five, and वक्त्र a face.
22871: पञ्चवट m. (-टः) The Brāhminical thread as worn across the breast; also पञ्चावट. 	 f. (-टी) 	 1. Five fig-trees, viz:--the Indian and the holy fig, the Bel, Grislea tomentosa, Rox. E. पञ्च, and वट the Indian fig.
22872: पञ्चवर्ग m. (-र्गः) A class of five persons or things.  E. पञ्च, and वर्ग a class.
22873: पञ्चवल्कल n. (-लं) A collection of the bark of five trees, the Indian and the holy fig, the opposite-leaved fig, the wavy-leaved fig, and a sort of reed; other trees are sometimes taken.  E. पञ्च five, and वल्कल a bark.
22874: पञ्चवाण m. (-णः) KĀMADEVA, The Indian Cupid.  E. पञ्च five, and वाण an arrow; being armed with five arrows.
22875: पञ्चशर m. (-रः) KĀMADEva.  E. पञ्च five, and शर an arrow: see the last.
22876: पञ्चशाख m. (-खः) 	 1. The hand. 	 2. An elephant.  E. पञ्च five, शाखा a branch, the five-fingered.
22877: पञ्चशिख m. (-खः) 	 1. A lion. 	 2. The name of a Muni, the son of DHA-RMA by HINSĀ.  E. पञ्च spreading, शिखा a crest or mane.
22878: पञ्चशैरीषक n. (-कं) The bark of five trees.  E. पञ्च, and शिरीष Mimosa sirisha, ठञ् aff. शिरीषवृक्षस्य पुष्पमूलफलपत्रवल्कलेषुच ।
22879: पञ्चष mfn. plu. (-षाः-षाः-षाणि) Five or six.  E. पञ्च, and षष् six, with डच् aff.
22880: पञ्चसुगन्धक n. (-कं) The aggregate of five aromatic vegetable substances; cloves, nutmeg, camphor, aloe wood, and Kakkola.  E. पञ्च five, सुगन्ध fragrance, कन् added.
22881: पञ्चसूना m. plu. (-नाः) The five things in a house by which animal life may be accidentally destroyed; viz:--the fire place, the slab on which condiments are ground, the broom, the pestle and mortar, and the waterpot.  E. पञ्च five, and सूना place of slaughter.
22882: पञ्चाग्नि n. (-ग्नि) 	 1. 22883: पञ्चाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Having five limbs or members, five parts or subdivisions, consisting of five things, &c. 	 n. (-ङ्गं) 	 1. Any aggregate of five parts or five things. 	 2. 22884: पञ्चाङ्गगुप्त m. (-प्तः) A tortoise.  E. पञ्च five, अङ्ग limb, and गुप्त hidden; covering his head and legs beneath his shell.
22885: पञ्चाङ्गुल mfn. (-लः-ला-ली-लं) Measuring five fingers. 	 m. (-लः) The castor-oil plant.  E. पञ्च five, अङ्गुलि a finger, aff. अच्: the leaves having five lobes compared to fingers.
22886: पञ्चाङ्गुलि mfn. (-लिः-लिः-लि) Having five fingers, or finger-like divisions. E. पञ्च five, अङ्गुलि a finger.
22887: पञ्चातपा f. (-पा) Doing penance with five fires, or four fires and the sun.  E. पञ्च, and आतप heat.
22888: पञ्चानन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Very passionate. 	 m. (-नः) 	 1. A name of SĪVA. 2. (With the mouth wide open) A lion. 	 3. A title used at the end of the names of learned men to express veneration or high scho-larship.  E. पञ्च five or spreading, आनन a face.
22889: पञ्चामृत n. (-तं) 	 1. A mixture of milk, curds, sugar, ghee, and honey. 2. The aggregate of any five drugs of supposed efficacy.  E. पञ्च, and अमृत ambrosia.
22890: पञ्चाम्नाय m. plu. (-याः) Five Shāstras supposed to have proceeded from the five mouths of SĪVA, constituting the basis of the Tantra ritual.  E. पञ्च, and आम्नाय a scripture.
22891: पञ्चाम्ल n. (-म्लं) The aggregate of five acid plants; the jujube, prome-granate, sorrel, spondias, and citron.  E. पञ्च five, and अम्ल sour.
22892: पञ्चारी f. (-री) A chequered cloth for playing draughts upon: see पञ्चाली.
22893: पञ्चार्च्चिस m. (-र्च्चिः) The planet Mercury.  E. पञ्च five, अर्च्चिस् a ray.
22894: पञ्चाल m. (लः) 	 1. A country in the north of India. 	 2. It may either be applied to its people or their king. 	 f. (-ली) 	 1. A chequered cloth for playing at draughts, &c. 	 2. A doll, a puppet. 	 3. A style of singing. E. पचि to spread, Unādi aff. कालन्; also with कन् added पञ्चालिका.
22895: पञ्चावट m. (-टः) The sacrificial cord, as worn crossed upon the breast, the ends hanging over the shoulders.  E. पञ्च spreading, वट् to surround, aff. अच्, आङ् prefixed to the root; also पञ्चवट ।
22896: पञ्चावस्थ m. (-स्थः) A corpse.  E. पञ्च five, (elements,) अवस्था state or condition.
22897: पञ्चाशत् f. (-शत्) Fifty.  E. पञ्च, with शत् aff. and आ augment.
22898: पञ्चास्य mf. (-स्यः-स्या) 	 1. A lion. 	 2. SĪVA,  E. पञ्च spreading, and आस्य a face.
22899: पञ्चेन्द्रिय n. (-यं) 	 1. The five organs of sense; the eye, ear, nose, tongue, and skin; or those of action, as hands, feet, windpipe, anus, and parts of generation.  E. पञ्च five, and इन्द्रिय an organ of sense.
22900: पञ्चेषु m. (-षुः) A name of KĀMADEVA, the Hindu Cupid.  E. पञ्च five, इषु an arrow.
22901: पञ्चेष्मन् m. plu. (-ष्माणः) The five digestive fires supposed to be in the body.  E. पञ्च, and उष्मन् heat.
22902: प(पि)ञ्जर mn. (-रः-रं) A skeleton. 	 n. (-रं) 	 1. A cage, an aviary, a dove-cot. 2. The ribs. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. The body. 	 2. The Kali age.  E. पजि for पिजि to dwell, &c. Unādi aff. अरच्; also पिञ्जर.
22903: पञ्जराखेट m. (-टः) A sort of basket or wicker trap in which fish are caught.  E. पञ्जर a cage, आखेट hunting. “पोलो” इति भाषा ।
22904: पञ्जि(ञ्जी) f. (-ञ्जिः-ञ्जी) 	 1. The ball or whisp of cotton from which thread is spun. 	 2. A journal, a register. 	 3. An almanack.  E. पजि for पिजि to touch, &c. aff. इन् and ङीष् optionally added; also पिञ्जि.
22905: पञ्जिका f. (-का) 	 1. The ball or skein of cotton from which thread is spun: see the last. 	 2. A perpetual commentary. 	 3. A calendar, an almanack. 	 4. A journal, a register. 	 5. The register or journal of YAMA, the record of human actions.  E. स्वार्थेक added to पञ्जि; also पञ्जीका.
22906: पञ्जिकाकारक m. (-कः) 	 1. A writer, a man of the Kāyastha tribe. 	 2. An almanack-maker.  E. पञ्जिका a journal, &c. and कारक who makes.
22907: पञ्जीकर m. (-रः) 	 1. The Kāyastha or scribe. 	 2. An almanack-maker. E. पञ्जी a journal, &c. कर who makes.
22908: पट r. 1st cl. (पटति) To go, to move. r. 10th cl. (पटयति-ते) 	 1. To string. 2. To surround or encompass. 	 3. To share, to portion, to distri-bute. (पाटयति-ते) 	 1. To speak. 	 2. To shine. 22909: पट mn. (-टः-टं) 	 1. Fine cloth. 	 2. Coloured cloth. 	 3. A leaf or sheet of cloth, &c. on which any figures may be painted. 	 4. A veil or screen. 	 5. A tablet for writing or painting. 	 m. (-टः) 	 1. A kind of tree: see पियाल. 	 2. Any thing well made or polished. 	 f. (-टी) 	 1. A particular sort of cloth, coarse thick cloth, canvas. 	 2. 22910: पटक m. (-कः) A camp, an encampment.  E. पट to surround, वुन् aff.
22911: पटकार m. (-रः) 	 1. A weaver. 	 2. A painter.  E. पट cloth, and कार maker.
22912: पटकुटी f. (-टीः) A tent.  E. पट cloth, कुटी a house.
22913: पटच्चर n. (-रं) Old cloth. 	 m. (-रः) A thief.  E. पटत् imitative sound, and चर going. पटदिव वेष्टित इव चरति चर-अच् ।
22914: पटमण्डप m. (-पः) A tent.  E. पट cloth, and मण्डप a house.
22915: पटमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of cloth. 	 n. (-यं) 	 1. A tent, a canvas house. 	 2. A petticoat.  E. पट cloth, मयट् aff.
22916: पटल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) A heap, a number, a quantity or multitude. nf. (-लं-ली) 	 1. A chapter of a book. 	 2. A tree. 	 3. A stalk. 	 mf. (-लः-ला) A roof, a thatch. 	 n. (-लं) 	 1. A coat or film over the eyes. E. पट् to go, कलच् aff.
22917: पटलप्रान्त m. (-न्तः) The edge of a thatch.  E. पटल a thatch, and प्रान्त end.
22918: पटवाप m. (-पः) A tent.  E. पट cloth, and वाप what is woven.
22919: पटवास m. (-सः) 	 1. A tent. 	 2. A petticoat. 	 3. Perfumed powder. E. पट cloth, वास abode, or वस् to perfume, aff. अच्.
22920: पटवासक m. (-कः) Perfumed powder.  E. कन् added to the last.
22921: पटवेश्मन् n. (-श्म) A tent.  E. पट, and वेश्मन् a house.
22922: पटह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) A kettle-drum. 	 m. (-हः) 	 1. A war-drum, or one used in battle. 	 2. Injury, killing, slaughter. 	 4. Tumult.  E. पट imitative sound, हा to quit or make, aff. ड ।
22923: पटाक m. (-कः) A kind of bird. 	 f. (-का) A flag, a banner.  E. पट to go, आक Unādi aff.
22924: पटालुका f. (-का) A leech.  E. पट् to go, आलुच् aff., कन् added.
22925: पटि(टी) f. (-टिः or -टी) 	 1. A kind of cloth. 	 2. An aquatic plant: see कुम्मिका. 	 3. The curtain of a stage. 	 4. A screen of a cloth surround-ing a tent.  E. पट् to surround, &c. aff. इन् or ङीप् । see पट and पटी.
22926: पटिका f. (-का) Cloth.  E. वुन् added to पटी.
22927: पटिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Very clever.  E. पटु and irr. superlative.
22928: पटीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Very clever or able.  E. पटु clever, ईयसुन् aff. of the superlative.
22929: पटीर n. (-रं) 	 1. Sandal-wood. 	 2. A field. 	 3. Bamboo manna. 	 4. A radish. 	 5. The belly. 	 6. A sieve. 	 7. Height. 	 8. Khayar. 	 9. Rheu-matism. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. KANDARPA. 	 2. A cloud.  E. पट् to go, Unādi aff. ईरन्.
22930: पटु mfn. (-टुः-ट्वी-टु) 	 1. Clever, dexterous, skilful. 	 2. Diligent. 	 3. Smart, sharp. 	 4. Hale, healthy. 	 5. Warm, hot. 	 6. Blown, ex-panded. 	 7.
