22931: पटुक m. (-कः) A sort of gourd.  E. कन् added to the preceding.
22932: पटुकल्प mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं) Not so clever, a little less able, &c.  E. पटु clever, and कल्प aff. of incompleteness; also in a similar sense पटुदेश्य, and पटुदेशीय ।
22933: पटुजातीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Of a clever sort, &c.  E. पटु as above, and जातीय aff. of kind.
22934: पटुत्व n. (-त्वं) 	 1. Cleverness. 	 2. Eloquence.  E. त्व added to पटु; also with तल्, पटुता.
22935: पटुपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A medicinal sort of moon plant.  E. पटु a sort of gourd, and पर्ण a leaf, fem. aff. ङीष्; also पटुपत्रक n. (-कं) and पटुपत्रिका f. (-का.)
22936: पटुरूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Very clever.  E. पटु, and रूप here implying much.
22937: पटोटज m. (-जं) A tent.  E. पट and उटज a house.
22938: पटोल m. (-लः) A kind of cucumber, commonly Parwor, (Trichosanthes diœca.) 	 n. (-लं) A sort of cloth, a kind of chintz. 	 f. (-ली) A small cucumber, either the same as above, (Trichosanthes diœca,) or another kind, (Luffa acutangula.)  E. पट् to go, in the causal form, aff. ओलच्; removing malady.
22939: पटोलक m. (-कः) An oyster.  E. पटोल as above, and कन् aff. of res-emblance; compared to the shape of the Trichosanthes.
22940: पटोलिका f. (-का) A small cucumber, (Trichosanthes diœca:) it is also applied to Luffa acutangula.  E. कन् with the fem. form added to पटोली.
22941: पट्ट m. (-ट्टः) 	 1. Cloth. 	 2. Coloured cloth, wove silk. 	 4. A turban, &c. or cloth for that purpose. 	 5. A coloured silk turban. 	 6. A fillet bound round the head. 	 7. A bandage, a ligature, a cloth bound round a sore, &c. 	 8. An upper or outer garment. 	 9. A plant, com-monly called Pāt, (Corchorus,) from the fibres of the bark of which, (called jute) a coarse sack-cloth and cordage are prepared. 10. A stone for grinding with a mullar. 	 11. A plate of metal for inscription or engraving. 	 12. A royal grant or order written on copper, stone, &c. 	 13. A shield. 	 14. A place where four roads meet. 	 15. A chair, a stool. 	 n. (-ट्टं) A city, a town, a village, the Pettāh probably of the south. 	 f. (ट्टा) 	 1. An ornament of the fore-head. 	 2. Red Lodh. 	 3. A horse's girth.  E. पट् to surround, क्त aff. and त changed to ट.
22942: पट्टक m. (-कः) Cloth, a bandage, &c.  E. कन् added to the preceding.
22943: पट्टज n. (-जं) A sort of cloth, probably a kind of canvas or sack-cloth. E. पट्ट as above, and ज produced; made from jute. कौशेयवस्त्रेच ।
22944: पट्टदेवी f. (-वी) A principal queen.  E. पट्ट a fillet or tiara, देवी a queen.
22945: पट्ट(त्त)न n. (-नं-नी) A city:  E. पट(त)न्ति जना यत्र पट पत, वा तनन् नेट् ।
22946: पट्टबन्धन n. (-नं) Crowing, binding the head with a fillet or tiara. E. पट्ट, and बन्धन binding.
22947: पट्टमहिषी f. (-षी) A principal queen.  E. पट्ट a fillet or tiara, and महिषी a queen. (पाटराणी) ।
22948: पट्टरङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) A plant used in dying, (Cœsalpinia sappan.)  E. पट्ट cloth, and रञ्ज to dye, aff. करणे घञ् (वकम्) ।
22949: पट्टरञ्जन n. (-नं) Sappen wood.  E. पट्ट cloth, and रञ्जन colouring: with कन् added, पट्टरञ्जक.
22950: पट्टशाक n. (-कं) A sort of potherb, commonly called Nālita, (Corchorus capsularis.)  E. पट्ट Corchorus, and शाक a potherb; the leaves re-sembling to those of the Pāt. नालिता, वा पाटशाक् ।
22951: पट्टारोहा f. (-हा) A principal queen.  E. पट्ट, and आरोह what mounts.
22952: पट्टिका f. (-का) Lodh.  E. पट्टी the same, कन् added: again with आख्या a name; it is read also पट्ठिकाख्य, mf. (-ख्यः-ख्या)
22953: पट्टिन् m. (-ट्टी) Red Lodh; also पट्टी.
22954: पट्टिल m. (-लः) A plant, (Cæsalpinia bonduccella.)  E. पट्ट + अस्त्यर्थे -इलच् ।
22955: पट्टि(का)लोध्र m. (-ध्रः) A sort of tree, the bark of which is used as an astringent; the red species of the Lodh, (Symploces racemosa, Rox.)  E. पट्टी the same plant, लोध्र the Lodh; also with कन् added पट्टिलोध्रक.
22956: पट्टिश(स) m. (-शः -or -सः) A sort of weapon, a kind of axe.  E. पट् to go, aff. टिश् or टिस्; whence it is also read पट्टिस.
22957: पट्टोलिका f. (-का) 	 1. A title deed, a Pāttā, a lease, &c. 	 2. A written legal opinion.  E. पट्ट a royal mandate, &c. ओलच् aff., कन् in the fem form added.
22958: पठ r. 1st. cl. (पठति) To speak articulately, to declaim, to recite or read. भ्वा० पर० सक० सेट् ।
22959: पठत् mfn. (-ठन्-ठन्ती-ठत्) Reading, reciting.  E. पठ् to read, शतृ part. aff.
22960: पठन n. (-नं) Reading, reciting.  E. पठ् to read, ल्युट् aff.
22961: पठनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Readable, to be read.  E. पठ् to read, अनीयर् aff.
22962: पठमञ्जरी f. (-री) A Rāgīni, one of the wives of SRĪRĀGA.
22963: पठि f. (-ठिः-ठी) Reading, perusal.  E. पठ् to read, aff. इन्, ङीष् option-ally added.
22964: पटित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Read, studied. 	 2. Recited, repeated.  E. पठ् to read, क्त aff.
22965: पठितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be read, what may or ought to be read. E. पठ् to read, तव्य aff.
22966: पठितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Reading, reciting, a reader.  E. पठ् to read, तृच् aff.
22967: पठ्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being read or recited.  E. पठ् to read, poss. v. शानच् aff.
22968: पड (इ) पडि r. 1st. cl. (पण्डते) To go, to move. r. 1st. and 10th. cls. (पण्डति पण्डयति-ते) 	 1. To destroy, to annihilate. 	 2. To heap together, to accumulate. गतौ भ्वा० आ० सक०-सेट्-इदित् । राशीकरणे चु० उभ० सक० सेट् ।
22969: पण r. 1st cl. (पणते) also 10th. cl. (पणयति) 	 1. To negociate, to treat or transact business. 	 2. To bet or stake at play. (पणायति) To praise. व्यवहारे स्तुतौच भ्वा० आ० सक० सेट् ।
22970: पण m. (-णः) 	 1. Measure of account, in cowries or shells, twenty gandās or eighty cowries; also a weight of copper of similar value. 	 2. Wages or hire. 	 3. A stake at play, a bet, a wager. 	 4. Gaming, playing. 	 5. Playing with dice. 	 6. Price. 	 7. Wealth, property 8. A commodity for sale. 	 9. Business. 	 10. A distiller. 	 11. A house, a dwelling. 	 12. A stipulation, a treaty. 	 13. A vendor. 	 14. A shop.  E. पण् to do business, aff. अप् ।
22971: पणग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) A fair, a market.  E. पण a commodity, ग्रन्थि a knot.
22972: पणता f. (-ता) 	 1. The state or condition of a pledge or stake. 	 2. Price, value.  E. तल् added to पण; also with त्व, पणत्वं.
22973: पणन n. (-नं) 	 1. Sale, selling. 	 2. Betting.  E. पण् to do business, aff. भावे ल्युट्.
22974: पणव mf. (-वः-वा) A sort of musical instrument; a small drum or tabor.  E. पण् business or price, वा to sound, aff. क; it is also read प्रणव.
22975: पणस m. (-सः) A commodity, an article of sale or traffic.  E. पण् to do business, Unādi aff. कर्मणि-असच् ।
22976: पणाङ्गना f. (-ना) A prostitute, a whore,  E. पण price, अङ्गना a woman.
22977: पणाया f. (-या) Business, affair, transaction, buying and selling, &c. 2. Profits or receipts of trade. 	 3. A market place. 	 4. Gambling. 5. Praise.  E. पण् to negociate, in the causal form, अच् and टाप् affs.; or पण, and आय income, it also occurs mas. (-यः).
22978: पणायित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Praised. 	 2. Transacted.  E. पण् to praise, aff. स्वार्थे-आय-क्त.
22979: पणार्पण n. (-णं) Agreement, engagement, contract.  E. पण price, अर्पण delivering.
22980: पणस्थि n. (-स्थि) The small shell used as coin, a Cowri.  E. पण busi-ness, and अस्थि a bone; also with कन् added पणस्थिक.
22981: पणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Prasied. 	 2. Transacted as business.  E. पण to praise, aff. क्त; also पणायित.
22982: पणितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 	 1. Vendible, fit or intended for sale. 	 2. To be transacted, negotiable. 	 3. To be praised.  E. पण to deal, aff. तव्य.
22983: पण्ड mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं) 	 1. A catamite. 	 2. An eunuch. 	 f. (-ण्डा) 	 1. Wisdom, understanding. 	 2. Science, learning.  E. पडि to go, aff. अच् or पण् to deal, Unādi aff. ड, तस्य नेत्वम्; also with कन् added पण्डक.
22984: पण्डापूर्व n. (-र्वं) Non-occurrence of the results of fate or destiny. E. पण्ड, and अपूर्व unprecedented.
22985: पण्डित m. (-तः) 	 1. A scholar, a teacher, a Pandit, a learned Brāhman, or one read in sacred science, and teaching it to his disciples. 2. Incense. 	 3. Clever. 	 4. Proficient.  E. पण्डा learning, तार० इतच् aff.
22986: पण्डितम्मन्य m. (-न्यः) An ignorant and vain person, a pedant, one who thinks himself a Pandit or scholar.  E. पण्डित learned, मन् to think, खश् aff.; also with णिनि aff. पण्डितमानिन्.
22987: पण्डितमानिन् m. (-नी) An arrogant and ignorant man: E. see the last.
22988: पण्डितायमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Become wise from a state of ignorance. E. पण्डित used as a verb, शानच् aff.
22989: पण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) 	 1. To be sold, salable, vendible. 	 2. To be praised, 3. To be transacted as business. 	 n. (-ण्यं) 	 1. A ware. 	 2. Price. 	 3. Traffic. 	 f. (-ण्या) Heart pea: see पिण्या.  E. पण to deal, कर्मणि-यत् aff.
22990: पण्यफलत्व n. (-त्वं) Prosperity in trade, profit.  E. पण्य, and फलत्व fruitfulness.
22991: पण्यमूल्य n. (-ल्यं) The price of a commodity.  E. पण्य, and मूल्य price.
22992: पण्यवीथी f. (-थी) 	 1. A stall, &c. 	 2. A market: see the last.
22993: पण्यवीथिका f. (-का) 	 1. A stall, a shop, a place of sale. 	 2. A market. E. पण्य vendible, and वीथी a shop, &c. कन् added.
22994: पण्यशाला f. (-ला) 	 1. A market. 	 2. A shop, a ware-room.  E. पण्य vendible, and शाला a hall.
22995: पण्यस्त्री f. (-स्त्री) A whore.  E. पण्य vendible, and स्त्री a woman.
22996: पण्याङ्गना f. (-ना) A prostitute, a whore.  E. पण्य to be sold, अङ्गना a woman; also पणाङ्गना.
22997: पण्यजीव m. (-वः) A trader. 	 n. (-वं) A market, a fair,  E. पण्य a vendible, and आजीव a livelihood.
22998: पण्याजीवक n. (-कं) A market.  E. कन् added to the last; also पण्यजीवकं.
22999: पण्यार्ह mfn. (-र्ह-र्हा-र्हं) Salable, vendible.  E. पण्य, and अर्ह fit for.
23000: पत(ऌ)पतॢ r. 1st. cl. (पतति) r. 10th cl. (पतयति-ते or पातयति-ते) 	 1. To go, to move, but especially downwards, as, to fall, to descend, to alight. 	 2. To possess supreme or superhuman power. r. 4th cl. (पत्यते) To be rich or powerful. With अति prefixed. To excel or surpass. With अभि or अव, To descend. With आङ्, To arrive, to come. With उत्, To ascend. With नि 1. To gain or get. 	 2. To happen. With निर, To abscond. With परि, 1. To go fast. 	 2. To be valuable. With प्र and नि, To fall prostrate, to salute, to worship. With वि and निर, To turn, to turn back. With सम्, 1. To go with. 	 2. To gain. With आङ्, To purify or cleanse. With सम् and उत्, To fly. With सम् and नि, To go forth or out. गतौ अद० चु० उभ० सक० ऐश्ये० अक सेट् । ऐश्ये दि० आ० अक० सेट् । गतौ भ्वा० पर० सक० ऐश्ये अक० ज्वला० सेट् ।
23001: पत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cherished, protected. 	 m. (-तः) 	 1. Going, 2. Fall-ing, alighting. 	 3. Flying, flight.  E. पत् to go, अच् aff. or a various reading of पात.
23002: पतक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Who or what falls, descends, &c. 	 m. (-कः) An astronomical table.  E. पत् to fall, to go, वुन् aff.
23003: पतग m. (-गः) A bird.  E. पत् to go, Unādi aff. अगच्.
23004: पतङ्ग mf. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी) 	 1. A grasshopper. 	 2. A bird. 	 3. A sort of rice. 	 4. The sun. 	 n. (-ङ्गं) 	 1. Quicksilver. 	 2. A kind of Sandal.  E. पत् falling, गम् to proceed, aff.; खच्; or पत् to fall, अङ्गच् Unādi aff. also पतङ्गम ।
23005: पतङ्गम mf. (-मः-मा) 	 1. A bird. 	 2. A grasshopper.  E. पत, and गम what goes; see the last. पतन् उत्प्लवन् सन् गच्छति गम-खच् ।
23006: पतङ्गिका f. (-का) 	 1. A sort of bee. 	 2. A small bird.  E. कन् implying resemblance, with the fem. form added to पतङ्ग ।
23008: पतञ्ज(ञ्च)लि m. (-लिः) 	 1. The name of a saint or Muni and teacher of the Yoga philosophy, thence called after him PĀTANJALA; also the author of Mahābhāshya or commentary on PĀNINI. 	 2. A name of the poet VARARUCHI.  E. पत् falling, अञ्जलि the hands joined as a mark of respect; having fallen from heaven, it is said, in the shape of small snake, into the hands of the saint PĀNINI as he was performing this act of reverence.
23009: पतत् mfn. (तन्-तन्ती-तत्) Falling, coming down, alighting, &c. 	 m. (-तन्) A bird.  E. पत् to go, to alight, participial aff. शतृ or अति
23010: पतत्र n. (-त्रं) 	 1. A wing. 	 2. A vehicle.  E. पत् to go, अत्रन् करणे । Unādi aff.
23011: पतत्रि m. (-त्रिः) A bird.  E. पत् to go, अत्रिन् Unādi aff.
23012: पतत्रिन् m. (-त्री) 	 1. A bird. 	 2. An arrow. 	 3. A horse.  E. पतत्र a wing, इनि poss. aff.
23013: पतत्रिराज m. (-जः) VISHṆU'S bird, “Gadura.”  E. पतत्रिन्, and राज king.
23014: पतद्ग्रह m. (-हः) 	 1. A spitting pot. 	 2. The reserve of an army.  E. पतत् what falls, and ग्रह what takes. (पिक्दानी) ।
23015: पतद्भीरु m. (-रुः) A hawk, a falcon.  E. पतत् a bird, and भीरु fearful.
23016: पतन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Who or what goes, falls, descending. &c. 	 n. (-नं) 	 1. Falling. 	 2. Alighting, descending. 	 3. Falling from dignity, virtue, &c. 	 4. Sin. 	 5. Going. 	 6. Subtraction. 	 7. The latitude of a planet.  E. पत् to fall, युच् or भावे-ल्युट् aff.
23017: पतम m. (-मः) 	 1. The moon. 	 2. A bird. 	 3. A grasshopper.  E. पत् to go, अमच् Unādi aff.
23018: पतयालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Falling, liable or accustomed to fall.  E. पत् to go, &c. in the causal form, आलुच् aff. तत्पर्युदानेन न णि लोपः ।
23019: पतस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) 	 1. A bird. 	 2. The moon. 	 3. A caterpillar.  E. पत् to go, Unādi aff. असच्.
23020: पताका f. (-का) 	 1. A flag or banner. 	 2. A flagstaff. 	 3. An emblem carried as an ensign or banner, a symbol, a sign. 	 4. A mark. 	 5. An episode, or episodical incident in a drama. 	 6. Good fortune, auspiciousness.  E. पत् to go, अकन् Unādi aff. पत्यते ज्ञायते योधो अनया पत-णि-आक ।
23021: पताकिन् m. (-की) 	 1. An ensign, a standard bearer. 	 2. A scheme for casting a nativity. 	 f. (-नी) An army.  E. पताका a flag, and इनि aff.
23022: पतापत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Who or what goes, &c. much or frequently. E. पत् to go, अच् aff. repeated, and आच् augment.
23023: पति m. (-तिः) 	 1. A master, an owner. 	 2. A husband. 	 3. A root. 4. Ruler 5. Going, motion.  E. पा to nourish, Unādi aff. डति, or पत् to go, with the same aff.
23024: पतिघ्नी f. (-घ्नी) 	 1. The murderess of her husband. 	 2. A line on the hand, indicating that a woman will be faithless or treacherous to her husband,  E. पति and घ्न who kills, fem. aff. ङीप्.
23025: पतिघ्नीलक्षण n. (-णं) Sign of a murderess of a husband.  E. पतिघ्नी, and लक्षण a mark.
23026: पतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Fallen, alighted. 	 2. Fallen from virtue, wicked, abandoned. 	 3. Fallen in war, defeated, overthrown. 4. Degraded, outcaste. 	 5. Gone.  E. पत् to go, aff. कर्त्तरि क्त.
23027: पतितसावित्रीक m. (-कः) A man of the first three classes, whose investi-ture has not been duly performed.  E. पतित, and सावित्री the mys-tical verse, कन् added.
23028: पतितेक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Looked at by an outcaste.  E. पतित, and ईक्षित seen.
23029: पतितोत्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Born of an outcaste.  E. पतित, and उत्पन्न born.
23030: पतित्व n. (-त्वं) The conjugal state.  E. पति, and त्व aff.
23031: पतित्वा ind. Having fallen or fallen down, having alighted, &c.  E. पत् to fall, क्त्वा aff.
23032: पतिप्राणा f. (-णा) A faithful wife.  E. पति, and प्राण life.
23033: पतिंवरा f. (-रा) 	 1. A bride choosing her husband. 	 2. A pungent seed, (Nigella Indica.)  E. पति a husband, वृ to choose, खच् aff.
23034: पतिवत्री f. (-त्री) A married woman, a wife whose husband is living. E. पति a husband, मतुप् aff. fem. form irr., नुक् being inserted.
23035: पतिव्रता f. (-ता) A good and virtuous wife.  E. पति a husband, व्रत a religious obligation; who never violates her marriage vow.
23036: पतिसेवा f. (-वा) Devotion to a husband.  E. पति, and सेवा service.
23037: पतीयत्री f. (-न्ती) A woman wishing or fit for a husband.  E. पति, and क्यच् added, aff. शतृ.
23038: पतेर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Going, moving, one who goes or moves. 	 m. (-रः) 1. A bird 2. An Arhaka, a measure so called. 	 3. A hole.  E. पत् to go, एरक् Unādi aff.
23039: पत्काषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Pedestrian, going on foot. 	 m. (-षी) A footman, a foot soldier, &c.  E. पत् for पाद foot, कष् to injure, णिनि aff. पदादेशः ।
23040: पत्तङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) Red sanders: see पत्रङ्ग, of which it appears to be a local corruption. (वकम्) ।

23261: परदुःख n. (-खं) The pain or sorrow of another.  E. पर, and दुख pain.
23262: परदेश m. (-शः) A foreign country.  E. पर, and द्रेश place.
23263: परदेशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Foreign, exotic. 	 m. (-शी) 	 1. A foreigner. 	 2. One residing abroad.  E. परदेश, and इनि aff.
23264: परदेशसेविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Living abroad, travelling, traveller.  E. पर देश, and सेविन् who frequents.
23265: परदोषकीर्त्तन n. (-नं) Scandal, calumny, censoriousness.  E. पर, दोष fault, कीर्त्तन proclaiming.
23266: परद्वेषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Hostile, inimical, adverse.  E. पर another, द्विष् to hate, घिणुन् aff.
23267: परद्रव्य n. (-व्यं) Another's property.  E. पर, and द्रव्य thing.
23268: परद्रोहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Tyrannising over another.  E. पर, and द्रोहिन् injurious.
23269: परधन n. (-नं) Another's wealth.  E. पर, and धन wealth.
23270: परधनास्वादनसुख n. (-खं) Feeding luxuriously at another's expense. E. परधन, आस्वादन eating, सुख pleasure.
23271: परधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) Another's duty or business, the occupation of another caste.  E. पर, and धर्म्म duty. उत्कृष्ट धर्मेच ।
23272: परध्यान n. (-नं) Intent absorption or abstraction in the subject of medi-tation.  E. पर, and ध्यान meditating.
23273: परन्तप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Vexing or annoying another, subduing a foe. 	 m. (-पः) A conqueror.  E. पर another, तप to heat or inflame, aff. खच् ।
23274: परपद n. (-दं) 	 1. Eminence, high station. 	 2. Final felicity.  E. पर supreme, पद, a place.
23275: परपरिग्रह m. (-हः) The family or dependants of another.  E. पर, and परिग्रह dependants.
23276: परपाक m. (-कः) What is dressed or cooked by another, another's food. E. पर, and पाक cooking.
23277: परपाकनिवृत्त m. (-त्तः) One who dresses his own food without observing the expiatory sacrifice for the five Sūnas, or places of destruction to animal life: see पञ्चसूना.  E. पर another, पाक cooking, and निवृत्त ceased.
23278: परपाकरत m. (-तः) One who observes all the due ceremonies prepara-tory to cooking, but lives upon others.  E. पर another, पाक cooking, रत constant.
23279: परपाकरुचि m. (-चिः) A constant guest at other's tables.  E. पर another, पाक cooking, and रुचि shining.
23280: परपिण्ड n. (-ण्डं) Food given by another.  E. पर, and पिण्ड a ball of rice or meat.
23281: परपिण्डाद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Feeding at another's cost.  E. परपिण्ड, and आद who takes.
23282: परपुरुष m. (-षः) 	 1. A name of VISHṆU. 	 2. Another man.  E. पर supreme, or other, and पुरुष a man.
23283: परपुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्ठा-ष्टं) 	 1. Fostered, nourished, &c. by a stranger. 	 m. (-ष्टः) The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. 	 f. (-ष्टा) 	 1. A harlot, a whore. 	 2. A parasite plant.  E. पर another, पुष्ट cherished.
23284: परपुष्टमहोत्सव m. (-वः) The mango.  E. परपुष्ट the cuckoo, महा great, and उत्सव festival.
23285: परपूर्व्वा f. (-र्व्वा) A woman formerly married.  E. पर another, (husband,) पूर्व्व prior, fem. aff. टाप् ।
23286: परपूर्व्वापति m. (-तिः) The husband of a woman remarried.  E. परपूर्व्वा, and पति a husband.
23287: परप्रतिनप्तृ m. (-प्ता) A great-great-grandson.  E. पर subsequent, प्रति after, नप्तृ a grandson.
23288: परप्रपौत्र m. (-त्रः) A great-great-grandson.  E. पर, subsequent, प्रपौत्र great-grandson.
23289: परप्रेष्यत्व n. (-त्वं) Servitude, slavery.  E. पर, and प्रेष्यत्व service.
23290: परव्रह्मन् n. (-ह्म) The supreme Being.  E. पर, and व्रह्म the same.
23291: परभाग m. (-गः) 	 1. Excellence, superior merit, supremacy. 	 2. Good fortune, prosperity. 	 3. The last part, residue, remainder.  E. पर best, and भाग portion.
23292: परभाग्य n. (-ग्यं) Another's wealth or prosperity.  E. पर, and भाग्य good fortune.
23293: परभुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Possessed or enjoyed by another.  E. पर, and भुक्त enjoyed.
23294: परभुमि f. (-मिः) A foreign or an enemy's country.  E. पर, and भूमि land.
23295: परभूमिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Living or being in a foreign or an enemy's country.  E. परभूमि, and स्थ who stays.
23296: परभूषण n. (-णं) Another's ornament. 	 m. (-णः) Peace purchased by ceding the produce of lands.  E. पर, and भूषण ornament.
23297: परभृत् m. (-भृत्) A crow.  E. पर another, (the cuckoo,) and भृत् who nourishes.
23298: परभृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cherished or nourished by a stranger, fostered, adopted. 	 m. (-तः) The Indian cuckoo, which is supposed to leave its eggs in the nest of the crow to be hatched.  E. पर another, and भृत nourished.
23299: परभेदक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Destroying or subduing a foe,  E. पर, and भेदक who breaks.
23300: परम् ind. A particle of command. 	 2. Of dismissal or refusal. 	 3. Here-after, afterwards.
23301: परम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 	 1. Best, most excellent. 	 2. Chief principal, preced-ing 3. First, chief part. 	 4. Adequate. ind. (-मं) 	 1. A term of assent, yes 2. A term of command.  E. पर best, मा to mete, aff. ड or डम्.
23302: परमगति f. (-तिः) 	 1. Chief object or refuge, as a god, protector. 	 2. Final felicity.  E. परम, and गति going.
23303: परमगव mf. (-वः-वी) An excellent bull or cow.  E. परम, and गो a cow.
23304: परमगहन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Very mysterious or profound.  E. परम, and गहन thick.
23305: परमत n. (-तं) A different opinion or doctrine.  E. पर, and मत thought.
23306: परमपद n. (-दं) 	 1. Eminence, high station. 	 2. Final felicity  E. परम, and पद station.
23307: परमब्रह्मन् n. (-ह्म) The Supreme Spirit.  E. परम, and ब्रह्मन् the same.
23308: परमराज m. (-जः) A supreme monarch.  E. परम, and राजन् a king, टच् aff.
23309: परमर्षि m. (-र्षिः) A Rishi or divine sage, of a peculiar order or division, comprising the Muni BHELA and others.  E. परम excellent, and ऋषि a divine sage.
23310: परमर्म्मज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) One who knows another's character or disposition. E. पर, and मर्म्म a vital point, and ज्ञ who knows.
23311: परमस्वधर्म्मन् m. (-र्म्मा) A virtuous or pious man, one who attends scrupu-lously to the proper duties of his tribe or station.  E. परम best, स्व own, धर्म्म virtue or duty, and अनिच् added.
23312: परमहंस m. (-सः) An ascetic, a religious man who has subdued all his senses by abstract meditation.  E. परम best or first, हंस devotee.
23313: परमागति f. (-तिः) Final beatitude.  E. परमा best, गति going.
23314: परमाङ्गना f. (-ना) A beautiful woman.  E. परम, and अङ्गना a woman.
23315: परमाणु m. (-णुः) 	 1. An atom, the invisible base of all aggregate bodies; thirty of them are supposed to form a mote in a sunbeam; the lowest measure of weight; in Logic, six of them form the first perceptible object. 	 2. A measure of time, the sun's passage past an atom of matter.  E. परम first, and अणु an atom.
23316: परमाण्वङ्गक m. (-कः) A name of VISHṆU.  E. परमाणु an atom, अङ्ग the body, कप् aff., deriv. irr.; smaller than the smallest; as he is larger than the largest, &c.
23317: परमात्मन् m. (-त्मा) The Supreme Being, considered as the soul of the universe.  E. परम first, आत्मन् spirit or soul.
23318: परमाद्वैत n. (-तं) Pure unitarianism. 	 m. (-तः) VISHṆU, the only supreme. E. परम, and अद्वैत without duality.
23319: परमान्न n. (-न्नं) An oblation of rice to progenitors or gods, boiled with milk and sugar.  E. परम best, and अन्न boiled rice; or परम the best, the supreme, (deities, &c.) and अन्न food.
23320: परमापम m. (-मः) 	 1. The inclination of a planet's orbit to the ecliptic. 2. The sine of the sun's greatest declination.  E. परम, and अपम declination.
23321: परमायुष m. (-षः) A particular tree: see असन ।
23322: परमायुस् m. (-युः) The longest period of life, either in men or animals. E. परम and आयुस life.
23323: परमार्थ m. (-र्थः) 	 1. Truth, fitness. 	 2. Spiritual knowledge. 	 3. Any excel-lent or important aim or object. 	 4. The best sense. 	 5. The best kind of wealth  E. परम, and अर्थ object.
23324: परमार्थविद् m. (-वित्) A sage, a philosopher, one who knows the truth. E. परमार्थ, and विद् who knows.
23325: परमार्थविन्द् mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं) Who or what acquires knowledge of truth, the best kind of wealth, &c.  E. परमार्थ, and विद् to acquire, श aff. मुम् augment.
23326: परमावधि f. (-धिः) Utmost term or limit.  E. परम, and अवधि limit.
23327: परमार्हत m. (-तः) A king and holy saint, apparently the same as SĀLI-BĀHANA.  E. परम excellent, अर्हत a Jina.
23328: परमृत्यु m. (-त्युः) A crow.  E. पर another, and मृत्यु death; having many enemies.
23329: परमेश्वर m. (-रः) 	 1. The Supreme Being. 	 2. SĪVA. 	 3. VISHṆU. 	 f. (-री) DURGĀ.  E. परम best, ईश्वर lord.
23330: परमेष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Supreme, superior. 	 m. (-ष्ठः) 	 1. BRAMHĀ. 	 2. A deity.  E. परमे, in heaven, and स्थ who stays or is.
23331: परमेष्ठिन् m. (-ष्ठी) 	 1. A name of BRAMHĀ. 	 2. A Jina or deified teacher of the Jaina sect. 	 3. A kind of Sālagrām stone. 	 4. A Guru or spiritual guide.  E. परमे in the most exalted place, in heaven, स्था to be, Unādi aff. निन्.
23332: परम्पद n. (-दं) 	 1. Eternal felicity. 	 2. The abode of VISHṆU.  E. पर् an-other, पद degree.
23333: परम्पर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Successive, proceeding from one to another, from father to son, &c. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A sort of deer. 	 2. A great-great-grand-son. 	 f. (-रा) 	 1. Race, progeny, lineage. 	 2. Order, method, continu-ous arrangement, regular series or succession. 	 2. Hurting, killing, injury.  E. पर subsequent, repeated, and the nasal augment.
23334: परम्परतस् ind. Mutually.  E. परम्पर, and तसि aff.
23335: परम्पराक n. (-कं) Immolating animals in sacrifice.  E. परम्पर tradi-tionary or successive, and अक going or worshipping; or परम् much, पर the best, and अक going, custom.
23336: परम्परीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 	 1. Hereditary, what has come by inheritance or descent. 	 2. Traditional.  E. परम् another, and पर again, another, ख aff.
23337: पररु m. (-रुः) A potherb, (Eclipta prostrata;) also केशराज.  E. पर much, रुह् to grow, डु aff.
23338: पररूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) परस्य रूपमिव रूपमस्य । स्वोत्तरवर्त्तिपरस्येव रूपवति “एङिपररूपम्” पानिनि ।
23339: परलोक m. (-कः) Heaven, paradise.  E. पर another, and लोक world.
23340: परलोकगम m. (-मः) Death, dying.  E. पर another, लोक world, and गम going.
23341: परवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Dependent, subject.  E. पर another, मतुप् aff.
23342: परवश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) 	 1. Subservient, dependant, subject. 	 2. Deceived. E. पर another, and वश subjection.
23343: परवाच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) Reprehensible, blamable. 	 n. (-च्यं) Fault, defect.  E. पर, and वाच्य to be named, not to be spoken of.
23344: परवाणि m. (-णिः) 	 1. A Judge, a ruler. 	 2. A year. 	 3. The peacock on which the god KĀRTIKEYA rides.  E. पर best, वा to go, णि aff,
23345: परव्रत m. (-तः) A name of DHRITARĀSHTRA.  E. पर best, व्रत, religi-ous observance.
23346: परश m. (-शः) A kind of stone, the touch of which turns iron into gold, the philosopher's stone.
23347: परशव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Fit or proper for a hatchet.  E. परशु an axe, यञ् aff.
23348: परशु m. (-शुः) An axe, a hatchet.  E. पर another, शु to injure, Unādi aff. कु, डिच्च ।
23349: परशुधर m. (-रः) 	 1. A soldier armed with an axe. 	 2. A name of GANESA. 3. PARASURĀMA: see the next.  E. परशु an axe, धर who holds.
23350: परशुराम m. (-मः) A hero and demigod; the first of the three RĀMAS, and the sixth Avatāra or descent of the deity VISHṆU: who appeared in the world as the saint JAMADAGNI, for the purpose of repressing the tyranny and punishing the violence of the Kshetriya, or military tribe; PARASURĀMA appears to typify the tribe of Brāmhans and their contests with the Kshetrityas. 23351: परश्व(स्व)ध m. (-धः) An axe, a hatchet.  E. पर another, an enemy, श्व derived from श्वि, to grow or thrive; परश्व the prosperity of a foe, धे to drink, क aff.; what drinks the blood or destroys the life of an enemy; also पारश्वध and परस्वध.
23352: परश्वस् ind. The day after to-morrow.  E. पर after, अवस् to-morrow; also परःश्वस्.
23353: परस् ind. Beyond, further, more than, on the other side of, &c. (Not used by itself in classical Sanskrit.)  E. पर, पञ्चम्याद्यर्थे बा असि ।
23354: परसङ्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Associated with another. 	 2. Fighting or engaged with another.  E. पर, and सङ्गत gone with.
23355: परसंज्ञक m. (-कः) The soul.  E. पर best, संज्ञा name or title; aff. कप्.
23356: परसम्बन्ध m. (-न्धः) Relation or connexion with another.  E. पर, and सम्बन्ध connexion.
23357: परसम्बन्धिन् mfn. (-न्धी-न्धिनी-न्धि) 	 1. Related to another. 	 2. Belonging to another.  E. परसम्बन्ध, and इनि aff.
23358: परस्तात् ind. 	 1. Subsequently, afterwards. 	 2. Behind.  E. पर, and अस्ताति aff.
23359: परस्पर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Mutual, interchanging.  E. पर another repeated: from one to another.
23360: परस्परज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A friend, an intimate.  E. परस्पर, and ज्ञ who know.
23361: परस्परानुमति f. (-तिः) Mutual concurrence or assent.  E. परस्पर, and अनुमति agreement.
23362: परस्पराम ind. Mutually.  E. परस्पर, and आम् aff.
23363: परस्परोपकार m. (-रः) 	 1. Mutual assistance. 	 2. Offensive and defensive alliance.  E. परस्पर, उपकार aid.
23364: परस्परोपकारिन् m. (-री) 	 1. An ally. 	 2. An associate, a helper.  E. इनि added to the last.
23365: परस्मैपद n. (-दं) The transitive or active verb.  E. परस्मै to another, पद an inflected word.
23366: परस्व n. (-स्वं) Another person's property.  E. पर, and स्व own.
23367: परस्वत्व n. (-त्वं) Another's right.  E. पर, and स्वत्व own right.
23368: परस्वत्वापादन n. (-नं) Conferring a right upon another as by gift, &c. E. परस्वत्व, and आपादन producing.
23369: परस्वध m. (-धः) An axe: see परश्वध.
23370: परस्वादायिन् mfn. (यी-यिनी-यि) Extortionary, extortioner.  E. परस्व, and आदायिन् taking.
23371: परस्वोपजीविक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Dependent, living on the property of others.  E. परस्व, and उपजीविक subsisting.
23372: परहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Friendly, benevolent. 	 2. Good or profitable form for another.  E. पर, and हित favourable.
23373: परा ind. A participle and prefix implying, 1. Supremacy. 	 2. Libera-tion. 	 3. Inverted order. 	 4. Pride, contumely. 	 5. Encounter, mutual presence. 	 6. Excess, exceeding. 	 7. Overcoming, surpass-ing. 	 8. Going. 	 9. Killing, destroying, injuring. As पराक्रम supe-rior power or valour; पराजय defeat; पराभव disgrace; परावर्त्त turning back, &c. see the following.  E. पॄ to fill, aff. अप्, and आ added.
23374: पराक् ind. Crooked, crookedly.  E. परा away, अच् to go, aff. क्विप्.
23375: पराक m. (-कः) 	 1. A religious obligation of an expiatory kind, fasting for twelve days and nights, and keeping the mind attentive, and organs subdued. 	 2. A sacrificial sword or scimitar.  E. परा best, अक what goes.
23376: पराकरण n. (-णं) Disdaining, disregarding, rejecting.  E. परा before, कृ to do, ल्युट् aff.
23377: पराकुर्व्वन् mfn. (-र्व्वन्-र्व्वन्ती-र्व्वत्) Throwing off or aside, rejecting, dis-daining.  E. परा, and कुर्व्वन् making.
23378: पराकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Rejected, set aside, thrown off, disdained. E. पर, and कृत made.
23379: पराक्रम m. (-मः) 	 1. Power, strength. 	 2. Exertion. 	 3. Valour, prowess. 4. Going out or forth, exit or issue. 	 5. Attacking an enemy. 6. Attempt, enterprise. 	 7. A name of Vishṇu.  E. परा supremacy, opposition, &c. and क्रम going, करणे घञ् aff.
23380: पराक्रमज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Knowing the power, (of the enemy.) E. पराक्रम, and ज्ञ who knows.
23381: पराग m. (-गः) 	 1. The pollen or farina of a flower. 	 2. Dust. 	 3. Fra-grant powder used after bathing. 	 4. Sandal. 	 5. The name of a mountain. 	 6. Fame, celebrity. 	 7. An eclipse of the sun or moon. 8. Following one's own inclinations.  E. परा implying supremacy, &c. and ग who goes, ड aff.
23382: परागवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Laden with pollen.  E. पराग, and मतुप् aff.
23383: परागत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Spread, expanded. 	 2. Budded, blown.  E. पर, and आङ् before, गम् to go, aff. क्त.
23384: परागिन् mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि) Laden with pollen.  E. पराग, and इनि aff.
23385: पराङ्गद m. (-दः) A name of ŚIVA.  E. पर another, (DURGĀ,) अङ्ग form and द who gives; forming with the goddess a deity, half male and half female; or better, पर an enemy, KĀMADEVA, अङ्ग body, and द who gives; restoring the body of that deity to shape, after having reduced it to ashes in a rage.
23386: पराङ्गव m. (-वः) Ocean.  E. पर another, (river,) अङ्ग substance, water, and व who receives.

24229: पाटलोपल n. (-लं) A ruby.  E. पाटल, and उपल, a stone.

24249: पाठ्य mfn. (-ठ्यः-ठ्या-ठ्यं) To be read or studied.  E. पठ् to read, ण्यत् aff.; also पठनीय, &c.

24251: पाण m. (-णः) 	 1. Trade, traffic. 	 2. A trader. 	 3. An agreement. 	 4. Praise. 	 5. The hand.  E. पण् to be of price, &c. भावे घञ् aff.

24292: पाण्डुपुत्र m. (-त्त्रः) Either of the Pāṇḍava princes.  E. पाण्डु, and पुत्त्र son; also similar compounds, as पाण्डुनन्दन, &c.

There are eighteen acknowledged Purāṇas. 	 1. BRAHMA. 2. Padma, or the lotus. 	 3. Brahmāṇḍa, or the egg of BRAHMĀ. 4. Āgneya, or Agni, fire. 	 5. VAISHNAVA, or of VISHṆU. 	 6. Garu-da. 	 7. Brahmavaivarta, or transformations of BRAHMĀ, that is of KRISHṆA, identified with the Supreme. 	 8. SAIVA, or of ŚIVA. 	 9. Linga. 	 10. NĀRADĪYA. 	 11. SKANDA. 	 12. MĀRKAṆḌEYA, so called from a Muni of that name. 	 13. Bhavishyat, or prophetic. 	 14. Matsya, or the fish. 	 15. Varāha, or boar. 	 16. Kaurma, or of the Kurma or tortoise. 	 17. Vāmana, or dwarf. 	 18. Bhāgavat, or life of KRISHṆA, which last is by some considered as a spurious and modern work: the Brahmavaivarta is also of very modern origin. The Purāṇas ars reckoned to contain four hundred thousand stanzas: there are also eighteen Upapurāṇas or similar poems of inferior sanctity, and different appellations: the whole constitute the popular or poetical creed of the Hindus, and some of them or particular parts of them, are very generally read, and studied. 	 m. 25671: पूर्णकाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Satisfied, satiated.  E. पूर्ण fulfilled, काम desire.
25672: पूर्णकुम्भ m. (-म्भः) 	 1. A water vessel, one filled with holy water, used at the consecration of a king. 	 2. A full cup or jar.  E. पूर्ण full, and कुम्भ a water jar.
25673: पूर्णपात्र n. (-त्रं) 	 1. A full cup or vessel. 	 2. A vessel filled with clothes or ornaments, which are scrambled for by the guests and relations at a festival. 	 3. A vessel full of rice, presented at a sacrifice to the superintending and officiating priests; the Pūrṇa Pātra is pro-perly a measure of 256 handfuls of rice; it may also be composed of as much as will satisfy one great eater.  E. पूर्ण full, and पात्र a vessel.
25674: पूर्णमा f. (-मा) The day of full moon.  E. पूर्ण full, मा the moon; also पूर्णिमा, &c.
25675: पूर्णमास m. (-सः) A monthly sacrifice, performed on the day of full moon; also पौर्णमास. 	 f. (-सी) Day of full moon.  E. पूर्ण complete, मास the month.
25676: पूर्ण(वी)बीज m. (-जः) The citron.  E. पूर्ण, and बीज seed.
25677: पूर्णानक n. (-कं) 	 1. A vessel full of clothes, &c. at a feast: see पूर्णपात्र. 2. The sound of a drum. 	 3. A moon-beam.  E. पूर्ण full, अन् to go, or be, aff. बुन्; also read पूर्णालक.
25678: पूर्णालक n. (-कं) A vessel of clothes or ornaments to be scrambled for. E. पूर्ण full, अल् to ornament, aff. ण्वुल्; also sometimes written पूर्णानक.
25679: पूर्णिमा f. (-मा) Day of full moon.  E. पूर्ण full, (the moon,) इमक् aff.
25680: पूर्णेन्दु m. (-न्दुः) The moon, the full moon.  E. पूर्ण, and इन्दु the moon.
25681: पूर्णोपमा f. (-मा) A complete simile, in which the four requisites, namely उपमेय, उपमान, साधारणधर्म्म, and उपमावाचक must all be expressed.
25682: पूर्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) 	 1. Filled, full, complete. 	 2. Covered, concealed. 	 n. (-र्त्त) 	 1. An act of pious liberality, as digging a well, planting a grove, building a temple, &c. 	 2. Nourishing, cherishing. It is thus defined in Vāchaspatya:--“वापीकूपतडागादि देवता यतनानि च । अन्न प्रदानमारामः पूर्तमित्यभिघीयते” ॥  E. पृ to cherish or fill, aff. क्त, and the vowel changed.
25683: पूर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) 	 1. Fullness, completion. 	 2. Satisfaction.  E. पॄ to satisfy or fill, aff. क्तिन् ।
25684: पूर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति) Filling, completing. 	 2. Effective.  E. पॄ to satisfy, णिनि aff.
25685: पूर्ब्ब r. 1st cl. (पूर्ब्बति) To fill. 10th cl. (पूर्ब्बयति-ते) 	 1. To dwell. 	 2. To invite: the root is written either पूर्ब्ब or पूर्व्व । निमन्त्रणे सक० निवासे अक० चु० उभ० सेट् । अन्तस्थात्नु भ्वा० प० सेट् ।
25686: पूर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वी-र्व्वं) 	 1. First, former, prior, preceding, initial. 	 2. East, eastern. 	 3. All, entire. 	 4. Before, in front of. 	 m. plu. (-र्व्वाः) Ancestors, forefathers. 	 f. (-र्ब्बा) The east. 	 n. (-र्व्वं) An ancient tradi-tion.  E. पूर्ब्ब or पूर्व्व to fill, to dwell, &c. aff. अच्; hence to derivative and its compounds may be written either with व or व; the second of the duplicate consonants may also be rejected, making it पूर्ब or पूर्व ।
25687: पूर्ब्बक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Prior, before, preceding. 	 m. (-कः) A forefather. E. पूर्ब्ब, and कन् added.
25689: पूर्ब्बकाल n. (-लं) Former time.  E. पूर्ब्ब, and काल time.
25690: पूर्व्वकालीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Ancient, belonging to former times.  E. पूर्ब्बकाल and ख aff.
25691: पूर्ब्बकाष्ठा f. (-ष्ठा) The east, the eastern quarter.  E. पूर्व्व, and काष्ठा quarter.
25692: पूर्ब्बकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Done formerly, or in a prior existence.  E. पूर्ब्ब, and कृत done.
25693: पूर्व्वकोटि f. (-टि) The starting point, the first statement of a debatable question.
25694: पूर्व्वगङ्गा f. (-ङ्गा) The Narmada river.  E. पूर्ब्ब formerly, (called) गङ्गा the Ganges.
25695: पूर्व्वचोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Formerly stated, before-mentioned, aforesaid. E. पूर्व्व, and चोदित said.
25696: पूर्ब्बज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 	 1. Born or produced before, either in time or place. 	 2. Eastern, born in the east. 	 3. Elder. 	 m. (-जः) 	 1. An elder brother. 	 2. The son of the elder wife, even though last born. 	 m. plu. (-जाः) 	 1. The deified progenitors of mankind. 	 2. Ancestors, forefathers in general.  E. पूर्ब्ब formerly or first, ज born.
25697: पूर्ब्बजिन m. (-नः) A Bauddha teacher; also MANJUGHOSHA. 	 m. plu. (-नाः) The twenty-four Jinas or Jaina saints of a former æra. E. पूर्ब्ब, and जिन a Jina.
25698: पूर्व्वतन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Former.  E. पूर्ब्ब, and तनट् aff.
25699: पूर्ब्बदिक्पति m. (-तिः) A name of INDRA.  E. पूर्ब्ब east, दिश् quarter, and पति regent.
25700: पूर्व्वदिश् f. (-दिक्) The eastern region.  E. पूर्ब्ब, and दिश् a quarter.
25701: पूर्व्वदृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Formerly seen.  E. पूर्व्व, and दृष्ट seen.
25702: पूर्व्वदेव m. (-वः) 	 1. An Asura or demon. 	 2. A Pitri, or progenitor.  E. पूर्व्व before, देव a god; the first being the elder offspring of KĀSYAPA, the parent of both gods and demons, and the second being the progenitor of gods and men.
25703: पूर्व्वदेवता f. (-ता) A primeval deity, a Pitri or progenitor of gods as well as men.  E. पूर्व्व, and देवता a divinity.
25704: पूर्ब्बदेश m. (-शः) The eastern country, or eastern part of India.  E. पूर्व्व eastern, देश country.
25705: पूर्व्वदेह m. (-हः) A former body, a prior existence.  E. पूर्व्व, and देह body.
25706: पूर्व्वपक्ष m. (-क्षः) 	 1. A proposition, an assertion; the first part of an argument, to which assent or refutation is necessary. 	 2. The first half of a lunar month.  E. पूर्व्व first, पक्ष argument, &c.
25707: पूर्व्वपक्षपाद m. (-दः) The first division of legal proceeding, the plaint. E. पूर्व्वपक्ष, and पाद quarter.
25708: पूर्व्वपद n. (-दं) The first member of a compounded word, of a sentence, a verse. &c.  E. पूर्व्व preceeding, and पद a ward, &c.
25709: पूर्व्वपदिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Relating to the first member of a compound term.  E. पूर्व्वपद, and इकन् aff.
25710: पूर्व्वपर्व्वत m. (-तः) The eastern mountain, behind which to sun is suppo-sed to rise.  E. पूर्व्व eastern, and पर्व्वत a mountain.
25711: पूर्व्वप्रवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Formerly fixed, or done.  E. पूर्व्व, and प्रवृत्त undertaken.
25712: पूर्व्वफल्गुनी f. (-नी) The eleventh lunar asterism; the first Phalguni, the twelfth Nakshatra, being termed Uttara or subsequent; this asterism figured by a couch contains two stars, one of which is the Leonis.  E. पूर्व्व first, and फल्गुनी the name of the two asterisms.
25713: पूर्व्वफल्गुनाभव m. (-वः) The planet Jupiter.  E. पूर्व्वफल्गुनी as above, and भव being born.
25714: पूर्व्वभाद्रपदा f. (-दा) The first of the two lunar asterisms, called Bhādra-padā, and twenty-sixth, of the whole, containing two stars. E. पूर्व्व first, भाद्रपदा the asterism so named; it is also read पूर्व्वभद्रपदा ।
25715: पूर्व्वभाषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Polite, complaisant, condescending to speak first.  E. पूर्व्व, and भाषिन् who speaks.
25716: पूर्व्वभुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Prior possession.  E. पूर्व्व, and भुक्ति enjoyment.
25717: पूर्व्वमारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Dying first.  E. पूर्व्व, मृ to die, घिणुन् aff.
25718: पूर्व्वमीमांसा f. (-सा) An inquiry into the ritual portion of the Veda. It is called पूर्व्वमीमांसा in contradistinction to the Vedānta system which is considered to be a sequel to Jaimini's system and is styled उत्तर मीमांसा; there is however very little in common between the two systems.
25719: पूर्व्वयक्ष m. (-क्षः) One of the Jinas or Jaina teachers.  E. पूर्व्व formerly, यक्ष a demi-god.
25720: पूर्व्वरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The commencement of a drama, or the prelude to to instrumental or vocal performance; a prologue, an overture. E. पूर्व्व first, रङ्ग a stage.
25721: पूर्व्वराग m. (-गः) Affection arising from some cause before the parties meet.  E. पूर्व्व, and राग passion.
25722: पूर्व्वरात्र m. (-त्रः) The first part of the night.  E. पूर्व्व preceding, रात्रि night, and the final changed to अ ।
25723: पूर्व्वरूप n. (-पं) 	 1. Indication of some approaching change. 	 2. Retention of the first of two concurrent vowels or consonants. 	 3. Symptom of occurring disease.  E. पूर्व्व previous, रूप form.
25724: पूर्व्वलक्षण n. (-णं) Indication of something about to occur, as sickness, &c, E. पूर्व्व, and लक्षण sign.
25725: पूर्व्ववत् Ind. As before, as aforesaid, &c.  E. पूर्व्व, and वति aff.
25726: पूर्व्ववाद n. (-दं) A former plaint or averment.  E. पूर्व्व former, and वाद speech.
25727: पूर्व्ववादिन् m. (-दी) One who has made a former plea or complaint. E. पूर्व्ववाद, and इनि aff.
25728: पूर्व्वशैल m. (-लः) The eastern mountain, behind which the sun is sup-posed to rise.  E. पूर्व्व eastern, शैल a mountain.
25729: पूर्व्वसर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Preceding, going before.  E. पूर्व्व first, सृ to go, aff. ट ।
25730: पूर्व्वसन्ध्या f. (-न्ध्या) Dawn, daybreak.  E. पूर्व्व prier, and सन्ध्या junction, (of the day.)
25731: पूर्व्वसार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Going eastwards.  E. पूर्व्व east, and सृ to go, aff. अण् ।
25732: पूर्व्वसाहस n. (-सं) The first or heaviest of the three fines, or punishment. E. पूर्व्व, and साहस infliction.
25733: पूर्व्वाचरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Done or followed formerly.  E. पूर्व्व, and आचरित observed.
25734: पूर्व्वाद्रि m. (-द्रिः) The eastern mountain.  E. पूर्व्व eastern, and अद्रि mountain: see पूर्व्वशैल ।
25735: पूर्व्वापर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) First and last, prior and subsequent. 	 n. (-रं) Proof, and thing to be proved.  E. पूर्व्व, and अपर after.
25736: पूर्व्वाभ्यास m. (-सः) Former practice, or experience.  E. पूर्व्व, and अभ्यास practice.
25737: पूर्व्वार्द्ध n. (-र्द्धं) The first or east half of any thing.  E. पूर्व्व, and अर्द्ध half.
25738: पूर्व्वावतर m. (-रः) First accession or attack, (of any passion, disease, &c.) E. पूर्व्व, and अवतर befalling.
25739: पूर्व्वावेदक m. (-कः) A plaintiff, one who has made a complaint before another.  E. पूर्व्व, and आवेदक who represents.
25740: पूर्व्वाषाढा f. (-ढा) The first of two constellations, each called Āshāḍhā, and the 20th of the lunar asterisms, containing two stars of which one is Sagitarii.  E. पूर्व्व first, आषाढा Āshāḍhā.
25741: पूर्व्वाह्ण m. (-ह्णः) The first part of the day, the forenoon.  E. पूर्व्व first, and अहन् day.
25742: पूर्व्वाह्णेतन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Belonging or relating to the forenoon. E. पूर्व्वाह्ण as above, द्यु aff. form irr.
25743: पूर्व्वेण Ind. In the east, easterly, eastward.  E. पूर्व्व the east, and the form of the 3rd case used as a participle.
25744: पूर्व्वेद्युस् Ind. 	 1. A former day, yesterday. 	 2. The morning, dawn, the first part of the day. 	 3. A day or portion of a day on which religious ceremonies are to be performed.  E. पूर्व्व former or first, and एद्युस् aff. for द्यु a day.
25745: पूर्व्वोक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Said formerly, before-mentioned, aforesaid. E. पूर्व्व, and उक्त said.
25746: पूर्व्वोत्तर nf. (-रं-रा) The north-east.  E. पूर्व्व east, and उत्तर north.
25747: पूर्व्वोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Aforesaid, afore-mentioned.  E. पूर्व्व, and उदित said.
25748: पूल् r. 1st and 10th cls. (पूलति पूलयति-ते) To accumulate, to collect or heap. चु० उभ० पक्षे भ्वा० पर० सक० सेट् ।
25749: पूष् r. 1st cl. (पूषति) 	 1. To increase or grow. 	 2. To nourish. see पुष् अक० भ्वा० पर० सेट् ।
25750: पूष m. (-षः) The mulberry. (Morus Indica.)  E. पूष् to grow, aff. क. “तुंँत् ।”
25751: पूषन् m. (-षा) The sun.  E. पूष् to nourish, aff. कनिन् ।
25752: पूषभासा f. (-षा) The capital of INDRA.  E. पूष the sun, भास् light, aff. टाप्, splendid as the sun.
25753: पूषासुहृत् m. (-हृत्) SĪVA.  E. पूष the sun, and सुहृत् a friend.
25754: पृ r. 3rd cl. (पिपर्त्ति) 	 1. To protect, to nourish. 	 2. To fill. जुहो० पर० सक० अनिट् वा दीर्घे सेट् । 5th cl. (पृणोति) To satisfy, to please or content. प्रीतौ अक० प्रीणने सक० स्वादि० पर० अनिट् । r. 1st and 10th cls. (परति पारयति-ते) To fill, as the stomach or a vessel. चु० उभ० सक० सेट् । r. 6th cl. (But with वि and आङ् prefixed, and ङ aff.) व्यापृङ् (व्याप्रियते) To be busy or active, to labour, to make exertions; तु० आत्म० अक० अनिट्ः see पृ ।
25755: पृक्का f. (-क्का) A gramineous plant, (Trigonella corniculata.)  E. स्पृश् to touch, कन् aff., deriv. irr.
25756: पृक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Touched, mixed, in contact or combination with. 	 n. (-क्तं) Wealth, possessions.  E. पृच् to mix, aff. क्त ।
25757: पृक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Touch, contact.  E. पृच् to touch, क्तिन् aff.
25759: पृच्(ई)पृची r. 2nd cl. (पृक्ते) r. 7th cl. (पृणक्ति) To touch, to be or bring in contact. r. 1st and 10th cls. (पर्चति पर्चयति-ते) 	 1. To hinder or restrain. 	 2. To touch. सम्पर्के अदा० आत्म० अक० सेट् । संयमने सक० सम्पर्के अक० चु० उभ० पक्षे भ्वा० पर० सेट् ।
25760: पृच्छक m. (-कः) An inquirer, an investigator, an inquisitive person. E. प्रच्छ् to ask, वुन् aff. र changed to ऋ ।
25761: पृच्छन n. (-णं) Asking, inquiring.  E. पृच्छ् to ask, ल्युट् aff., र changed to ऋ ।
25762: पृच्छा f. (-च्छा) Asking, questioning a question or inquiry.  E. प्रच्छ् to inquire, affs. अङ् and टाप्, the semi-vowel changed to the corres-ponding vowel.
25763: पृज्(ई)पृजी r. 2nd cl. (पृक्ते) To touch, to be in contact with. अदा० आ० अक० सेट् ।
25764: पृड् r. 6th cl. (पृडति) To delight. तु० पर० अक० सेट् ।
25765: पृण् r. 6th cl. (पृणति) To please or gratify. तुदा० पर० सक० सेट् ।
25766: पृत् f. An army. This word has no form, for the first five cases; accord-ing to some it is an optional substitute for the next.
25767: पृतना f. (-ना) 	 1. An army. 	 2. A small army or division consisting of 243 elephants, as many chariots, 729 horse, and 1215 foot. 	 3. Fight, encounter.  E. पृ to fill, तनन् aff.
25768: पृतनासाह् m. (-षाट्) INDRA.  E. पृतना an army, सह् to bear or be equal to, ण्वि aff.
25769: पृथ् r. 10th (पर्थयति-ते) To throw or cast, to send or direct. चु० उभ० सक० सेट् ।
25770: पृथक् Ind. 	 1. Without, except. 	 2. Separately, severally.  E. पृथ् to throw or dismiss, aff. ठक् ।
25771: पृथक्करण n. (-णं) Separating, distinguishing, analysing.  E. पृथक्, and करण making.
25772: पृथक्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Separated, sundered, made distinct.  E. पृथक्, and कृत made.
25773: पृथक्क्षेत्र m. plu. (-त्राः) Children of one father by wives of different classes.  E. पृथक् separately, and क्षेत्र a wife.
25774: पृथकत्व n. (-त्वं) Individuality, separateness, severalty.  E. त्व added to पृथक्; also with तल्, पृथक्ता ।
25775: पृथक्त्वचा f. (-चा) A plant, commonly Mūrvā, (Sanseviera zeylanica.) E. पृथक् separately, त्वच् skin; having a fibrous bark from which bows-strings are made.
25776: पृथक्पर्णी f. (-र्णीं) A plant, (Hemionites cordifolia Rox.)  E. पृथक् separate, पर्ण a leaf, aff. ङीप् ।
25777: पृथक्पिण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A relation connected by ablation of water only. E. पृथक्, and पिण्ड obsequial cake.
25778: पृथगात्मता f. (-ता) Discrimination, judgment.  E. पृथक् severally, आत्मन् real nature, तल् aff.; distinguishing the different nature of different things.

26366: प्रति Ind. As a prefix to verbal themes it means,--1. In the direction of, towards. 	 2. In opposition to. 	 3. Back, in return. 4. Down upon. As a prefix to nouns not immediately derived from verbs it means,--1. Likeness, resemblance. 	 2. Rivalry. As a particle and prefix it means. --I. Substitution, (instead, in lieu;) as प्रद्युम्नः केशवात् प्रति. 	 2. Several order, (severally, each by each;) as वृक्षं प्रति सिञ्चति; प्रतिवेद each Veda; प्रतिदिनं every day; प्रतिछिद्रं each opening; प्रतिगर्भ every birth; प्रत्येक one by one. 	 3. Direction, (to, towards, upon;) as वृक्षं प्रति विद्योतते विद्युत्. 	 4. Beloning to, (as a part or portion.) 	 3. Exchange, return, (again, back again,) as तिलेभ्यः प्रति माषान् यच्छति. 	 6. A little, &c. as शाकप्रति, सूपप्रति. 	 7. Opposition, in place, as प्रतिसूर्य्यं against the sun, प्रतिवात against the wind. 	 8. With respect to, अनेकभार्य्यं, प्रत्याह. 	 9. 26777: प्रतीयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being believed or trusted.  E. प्रति before, इ to go, pass. v., शानच् aff.
26778: प्रतीयिवस् mfn. (-वान्-युसी-वस्) Coming back, returning.  E. प्रति back, ईय् to go, क्कसु aff.
26779: प्रतीर n. (-रं) A shore or bank.  E. प्र beyond, तीर shore, aff. क ।
26780: प्रतीवाप m. (-पः) 	 1. Calcining or fluxing metals. 	 2. Throwing one sub-stance into another to alter its form or state. 	 3. Adding any thing to a medicine during or after decoction. 	 4. Mixing whey with milk. 	 5. A public danger or calamity, as a plague, &c. E. प्रति before, वप् to spread, aff. घञ्, whence the vowel of the prefix is lengthened.

26782: प्रतीवेशिन mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) A neighbour, living in the neighbourhood. E. प्रतिवेश a neighbourhood, and इनि aff; also प्रतिवेशिन् ।
26783: प्रतीहार m. (रः) 	 1. A door. 	 2. A porter, a warder. 	 3. An agreement for return of assistance, alliance, confederacy. 	 f. (-री) A female door-keeper; (though this word is a feminine in form, is not necessarily so in sense.)  E. प्रति severally, mutually, हृ to convey, aff. घञ्; also प्रतिहार ।
26784: प्रतीहास m. (-सः) A plant, (Nerium odorum.)  E. प्रति before, हस् to smile, aff. घञ् ।
26785: प्रतुद m. (-दः) 	 1. A bird of game, a falcon, a hawk, or rather one that kills or strikes with his beak, including also the owl, parrot, crow, raven, peacock, &c. 	 2. An instrument for pricking. E. प्र before, तुद् to torment, (with the beak,) and क aff.
26787: प्रतुष्टुषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) 	 1. Wishing to praise. 	 2. Wishing to prepare or make ready.  E. प्र before, ष्टु to praise, desid. v., उ aff.
26788: प्रतूणी f. (-णी) Pain shooting from the rectum along the bowels.
26789: प्रतूर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Quick, fleet.  E. प्र before, त्वर् to make haste, क्त aff.
26790: प्रतोद m. (-दः) 	 1. A long whip. 	 2. A goad.  E. प्र thoroughly, तुद् to tor-ment, aff. घञ् ।
26791: प्रतोली f. (-ली) A high street, the principal road through a town or village.  E. प्र before, तुल् to weigh, aff. अच् गौरा० ङीष् ।
26792: प्रतोलीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Having a high street, (a town.)  E. कन् added to the last.

26794: प्रत्तवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Giving, presenting.  E. प्र before, दा to give, क्तवतु aff.
26795: प्रत्न mfn. (-त्नः-त्ना-त्नं) 	 1. Old, ancient. 	 2. Traditional, customary.  E. प्र for प्रगे here said to mean old, त्न aff. and गे rejected.
26796: प्रत्यक Ind. 	 1. Subsequent, behind, following in time or place. 	 2. In an opposite direction. 	 3. Against. 	 4. In the interior. 	 5. Uniform, unmixed. 	 6. Western. 	 7. Formerly, in old days: see प्रत्यच् ।
26797: प्रत्यक्पर्णी f. (-र्णी) A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.)  E. प्रत्यच् uniform, and पर्ण a leaf. “अपामार्गे” ।
26798: प्रत्यक्पुष्पी f. (-ष्पी) A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.)  E. प्रत्यच् uniform, पुष्प a flower. “अपामार्गे ।”
26799: प्रत्यक्श्रेणी f. (-णी) 	 1. A plant, commonly Dantī. 	 2. A plant, (Sal-vinia cucullata.)  E. प्रत्यक् western, and श्रेणी line or row. “मूषिकपर्ण्याञ्च ।”
26800: प्रत्यक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) 	 1. Perceptible, perceivable, present, cognizable by any of the organs of sense. 	 2. Distinct, clear, evident. 	 3. Direct, immediate. 	 4. Corporeal. 	 n. (-क्षं) Ocular evidence, apprehension by the senses, perception, (considered as a mode of proof. In Phil.) E. अक्ष an organ of sense with प्रति indicative prefix.

26802: प्रत्यक्षज्ञान n. (-नं) Knowledge obtained by perception.
26803: प्रत्यक्षतस् Ind. Evidently, perceptibly.  E. प्रत्यक्ष, and तम् aff.
26804: प्रत्यक्षदर्शन m. (-नः) A witness, an eye-witness.  E. प्रत्यक्ष what is present, and दर्शन seeing.
26805: प्रत्यक्षप्रमा f. (-मा) Correct knowledge obtained through perception by the senses.
26806: प्रत्यक्षप्रमाण n. (-णं) 	 1. Ocular proof, evidence of the senses. 	 2. An organ or faculty of perception.  E. प्रत्यक्ष and प्रमाण proof.
26808: प्रत्यक्षभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Manifested, become visible.  E. प्रत्यक्ष and भूत become.
26809: प्रत्यक्षभोग m. (-गः) Enjoyment or use of any thing with the con-sciousness of the owner.  E. प्रत्यक्ष, and भोग enjoyment.
26810: प्रत्यक्षवादिन् m. (-दी) A Bauddha.  E. प्रत्यक्ष, and वादिन् who declares; admitting of no other evidence than actual presence.
26812: प्रत्यक्षिन् mfn. (-क्षी-क्षिणी-क्षि) Seeing, perceiving, conscious of what is perceptible.  E. प्रत्यक्ष perceptible, and इनि aff.
26813: प्रत्यक्षीकरण n. (-णं) Making manifest or apparent.  E. प्रत्यक्ष, करण mak-ing, च्वि aug.
26814: प्रत्यक्षीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Manifested, displayed, made present or visible.  E. प्रत्यक्ष and कृत made, च्वि aug.
26815: प्रत्यक्स्रोतस् Adj. Flowing towards the west. 	 f. (-तः) An epithet of Narmadā, the river.
26818: प्रत्यगाशापति m. (-तिः) A name of VARUṆA.  E. प्रत्यक् west, आशा a quarter, पति regent or lord.
26820: प्रत्यग्र mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं) 	 1. New, fresh, recent. 	 2. Pre-purified. 	 3. Repea-ted.  E. प्रति before, अग्र first.
26821: प्रत्यग्रता f. (-ता) Newness, freshness.  E. तल् added to प्रत्यग्र; also with त्व, प्रत्यग्रत्वं ।
26822: प्रत्यग्रथ m. (-थः) A country; also अहिच्छत्र ।
26823: प्रत्यग्रवयस् n. (-यः) Youth.  E. प्रत्यग्र, and वयस् age.
26824: प्रत्यङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) An organ of perception. 	 n. Adv. (-ङ्गं) On the body, or the limbs severally. 	 n. Subst. (-ङ्गं) 	 1. A minor member of the body, as the chin, nose, ear, &c. 	 2. A subdivision of science, &c. E. प्रति belonging to, अङ्ग the body.
26825: प्रत्यङ्गिराः f. (-रा) A form of DURGĀ, one of the goddesses of the Tantrīkas.
26826: प्रत्यङ्मुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Facing the west.  E. प्रत्यञ्च, and मुख face.
26827: प्रत्यच् or प्रत्यञ्च् mfn. (-प्रत्यङ्-प्रतीची or according to some प्रत्यञ्ची-प्रत्यक्) 1. Behind or subsequent, following in time or place. 	 2. Turned away. 	 3. West, western. 	 4. Uniform, unmixed.  E. प्रति before, अञ्च् to go, aff. क्विप् or विच्; the neuter form is used as a particle: see प्रत्यक् ।
26828: प्रत्यदन n. (-नं) 	 1. Eating. 	 2. Food.  E. प्रति before, अदन eating.
26829: प्रत्यनन्तर n. Adv. (-रं) Next in succession.  E. प्रति, अनन्तर without an interval.
26830: प्रत्यनीक m. (-कः) An enemy. 	 n. (-कं) Injuring one who cannot retaliate. E. प्रति against, अनीक an army.
26831: प्रत्यन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्त) Bordering, skirting, contiguous. 	 m. (-न्तः) The country of the Mlechchhas or savages.  E. प्रति about, अन्त the end.
26832: प्रत्यन्तपर्व्वत m. (-तः) A small hill near a mountain.  E. प्रत्यन्त skirting, and पर्व्वत a mountain.
26833: प्रत्यभिज्ञात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Recognised, known.  E. प्रति, and अभि before, ज्ञा to know, aff. क्त ।
26834: प्रत्यभिज्ञान n. (-नं) Recognition, knowing, recognising.  E. प्रति and अभि before, ज्ञा to know, ल्युट् aff.
26837: प्रत्यभियोग m. (-गः) A counter plaint or charge, an accusation brought against the accuser or plaintiff.  E. प्रति against, अभियोग accusation.

26839: प्रत्यय m. (-यः) 	 1. Trust, faith, belief, confidence. 	 2. Oath, ordeal. 	 3. Cause, motive. 	 4. Usage, custom, practice. 	 5. Fame, celebrity. 6. Certainty, ascertainment. 	 7. Knewledge, apprehension. 	 8. A termination or an affix to roots and words forming derivatives and inflections, (in Gram.) 	 9. A dependent, a subject, 10. Instrument, means of agency, a helpmate or associate, applicable either to persons or things. 	 11. A householder who keeps a sacred fire. 12. Religious contemplation. 	 13. A hole.  E. प्रति again, against, to or towards, इण् to go, aff. अच् ।
26840: प्रत्ययकारिणी f. (-णी) A seal, a signet.  E. प्रत्यय confidence, and कारिणी causing.
26841: प्रत्ययित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Trusted, confidential.  E. प्रत्यय confidence, and इतच् aff.
26842: प्रत्ययिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Trusting, believing, having faith in.  E. प्रत्यय, and इनि aff.
26843: प्रत्यर्थ n. (-र्थं) 	 1. A reply, an answer, a counter-representation. 	 2. Oppo-sition, hostility. 	 f. (-र्था) Useful, expedient.  E. प्रति successive order, and अर्थ representation.
26845: प्रत्यर्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) 	 1. Hostile, inimical. 	 2. Opposing, contra-dicting, rejecting. 	 m. (-र्थी) 	 1. An enemy. 	 2. (In law,) A defendant. E. प्रति again, against (re), अर्थ meaning, intention, &c. इनि aff.
26846: प्रत्यर्पण n. (-णं) The returning of a thing.  E. प्रति back, अर्पण delivering.
26847: प्रत्यर्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Returned, restored, re-delivered.  E. प्रति again, अर्पित delivered.

26849: प्रत्यवमर्ष m. (-र्षः) Patience, constant in pursuit or exertion.  E. प्रति, अव before, मृष् to bear, aff. घञ् ।

26858: प्रत्यवेक्षण n. (-णं) Looking after, taking care of.

26865: प्रत्याख्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Removed, set aside. 	 2. Informed, apprised. 3. Discouraged, prohibited, forbidden. 	 4. Denied, refused. 	 5. Celebrated, notorious.  E. प्रति before, आख्यात said, declared.
26866: प्रत्याख्यान n. (-नं) 	 1. Rejection, refutation, disallowance, disregard. 	 2. Denial, refusal. 	 3. Reproach.  E. प्रति reverse, आङ् before, ख्या to say and ल्युट् aff.
26867: प्रत्याख्येय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. To be declined or refused. 	 2. To be refuted, denied, &c.  E. प्रति and आङ् before, ख्या to speak, यत् aff.
26868: प्रत्यागत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Come back, returned. 	 2. Arrived at.  E. प्रति again, आगत come.

26873: प्रत्यादेश m. (-शः) 	 1. Rejection, disallowance. 	 2. Information, apprising, informing. 	 3. Warning, caution. 	 4. Refusal, denial. 	 5. Putting to shame, obscuring. 	 6. Heavenly annunciation or declaration.  E. प्रति, आङ् before, दिश् to shew, aff. घञ् ।
26874: प्रत्यानयन n. (-नं) 	 1. Bringing back, recovering.  E. प्रति, आङ् before, णी to lead, aff. ल्युट् ।

26876: प्रत्यानीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Brought back.  E. प्रति and आङ् before, णी to obtain, क्त aff.

26882: प्रत्यावर्त्तन n. (-नं) Returning, coming back.  E. प्रति and आङ् before, वृत् to be, ल्युट् aff.
26883: प्रत्यावृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Returned, come back.  E. प्रति and आङ् before, वृत् to be, क्त aff.

26888: प्रत्यासङ्कलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Added to. 	 2. Ascertained, determined. E. प्रति and आङ् before, सङ्कलित added.
26889: प्रत्यासत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 	 1. Close contact. 	 2. An agony.

26891: प्रत्यास(सा)र m. (-रः) 	 1. The rear of an army. 	 2. An array behind an array.  E. प्रति and आङ् before, सृ to go, अप् aff.

26893: प्रत्याहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Repelled, resisted, repulsed.  E. प्रति, and आहत struck.

(In gram. E. प्रति and आङ् before, हृ to seize or convey, aff. घञ् ।
26897: प्रत्याहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Withheld. 	 2. Restrained. 	 3. Resumed, &c.: E. प्रति and आङ् before, हृ to take, क्त aff.

E. प्र before, मा to measure, aff. ल्युट्; that by which all is measured; this word is gener-ally restricted to the singular number, as वेदाः प्रमाणं the Vedas are the authority; it is also confined to the neuter gender, as पुत्त्रः प्रमाणं the boy is a witness; some exceptions occur however, as प्रमाणः पुरुषः, प्रमाणा स्त्री the man witness, the woman witness; and in the following rule, प्रत्यक्षानुमानोपमानशब्दाः प्रमाणानि perception, inference, comparison, and sound, are proofs. 28234: फलकृष्ण m. (-ष्णः) A small fruit, (Carissa carandas.)  E. फल fruit and कृष्ण black. “पानिआमलके” ।
28235: फलकेशर m. (-रः) The cocoanut-tree.  E. फल the fruit and केशर hair, covered with a fibrous coat-like hair.
28236: फलकोषक m. (-कः) 	 1. The cocoanut-tree. 	 2. The testicle.  E. फल fruit, कोष sheath, and कन् aff. of comparison.
28237: फलखण्डन n. (-नं) Disappointing.  E. फल and खण्डन destroying.
28238: फलग्रहि mfn. (-हिः-हिः-हि) Fruitful, bearing fruit in due season.  E. फल fruit, ग्रह् to take, aff. इन्, also फलेग्रहि ।
28239: फलग्राहिन् m. (-ही) A tree.  E. फल fruit, ग्रह् to take, aff. णिनि ।
28240: फलचमस m. (-सः) The bark of the Indian fig, ground and eaten with curds, by way of penance.
28241: फलत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्) Yielding fruit, profit, &c.  E. फल् to bear fruit, शतृ aff.
28242: फलत्रय n. (-यं) 	 1. Three sorts of fruit collectively, as the fruit of the vine, the Parush, and the Gmelina arborea. 	 2. The three myrobal-ans.  E. फल fruit and त्रय three.
28243: फलत्रिक n. (-कं) The three myrobalans collectively.  E. फल fruit, and त्रिक three-fold. “शुण्ठीपिप्पली मरिचरूपायाम् च” ।

28245: फलन n. (-नं) Fructifying, bearing fruit, producing consequences. E. फल, and ल्युट् aff.
28246: फलनिवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Cessation of consequences.  E. फल and निवृत्ति stop.
28247: फलनिर्वृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Final consequence or result.  E. फल and निर्वृत्ति completion.
28248: फलनिष्पत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 	 1. Bearing fruit. 	 2. Yielding profit or desired re-sults.  E. फल and निष्पत्ति putting forth.
28249: फलपाक m. (-कः) 	 1. The ripening of fruit. 	 2. The fulness of conse-quences. 	 3. The Caronda.  E. फल fruit and पाक ripening.
28250: फलपाकान्ता f. (-न्ता) An annual plant.  E. फल fruit, पाक ripening or ripe-ness, and अन्त end; dying after bearing fruit.
28251: फलपातन n. (-नं) Knocking down or gathering fruit.  E. फल and पातन felling.
28252: फलपुच्छ m. (-च्छः) A sort of esculent root or bulb.  E. फल fruit and पुच्छ a tail.
28253: फलपूर m. (-रः) Common citron, (Citrus medica.)  E. फल fruit and पूर् to fill, aff. क ।
28254: फलपूरक m. (-कः) Common citron.  E. कन् added to the last.
28255: फलप्रद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Yielding fruit, productive, yielding a reward, &c.  E. फल and प्रद what gives.
28256: फलप्रदान n. (-नं) 	 1. A ceremony at weddings. 	 2. The giving of fruits.
28257: फलप्रयुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Connected with or producing consequences, yielding fruit, &c.  E. फल and प्रयुक्त applied.
28258: फलप्राप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Obtaining the desired result or fruit.  E. फल and प्राप्ति acquiring.
28260: फलबन्धिन् Adj. Forming or developing fruits.
28261: फलभाज् mfn. (-भाक्) Having or receiving fruit, consequence, &c.  E. फल and माज् who shares.
28262: फलभूमि f. (-मिः) Any region not included in the known continent, as heaven, hell, &c.  E. फल fruit, (of actions,) and भूमि land.
28263: फलभोग m. (-गः) 	 1. Receipt or enjoyment of consequences. 	 2. Possess-ion of rent or profit, usufruct.  E. फल and भोग enjoyment.
28264: फलभोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) Who receives the profits, consequences, &c.  E. फल and भोगिन् who enjoys.
28266: फलमुद्गरिका f. (-का) A sort of date.  E. फल fruit and मुद्गर a mallet, aff. कन् in the fem. form. “पिण्डीखेजुर” ।
28267: फलयोग m. (-गः) 	 1. The attainment of an object. 	 2. Remuneration, wages.
28269: फलवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 	 1. Bearing fruit. 	 2. Yielding results or con-sequences.  E. फल fruit and मतुप् poss. aff.
28270: फलशाडव m. (-वः) The promegranate.  E. फल fruit, शाड् to extol, aff. अव ।
28271: फलशालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Bearing or yielding fruit.  E. फल and शलिन् having.
28272: फलश्रेष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) The mango.  E. फल fruit and श्रेष्ठ best.
28273: फलस m. (-सः) The jack or bread-fruit.  E. फल fruit, सह् to be able. aff. डः also read फलशः see पनस ।
28274: फलसम्पद् f. (पद् or -पत्) Prosperity, success.  E. फल and सम्पत् abundance.
28275: फलसम्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced in or by fruit.  E. फल and सम्भव born also फलसम्भू ।
28276: फलसाधन n. (-नं) Means or instrument of success.  E. फल and साधन means.
28277: फलसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Realising an object, reaping the fruit of any act. E. फल and सिद्धि perfection.
28278: फलहानि f. (-निः) Loss of fruit or profit.  E. फल and हानि abandonment.
28279: फलहारी f. (-री) An epithet of Durgā.
28280: फलाकाङ्क्षा f. (-ङ्क्षा) Hope or expectation of favourable consequences. E. फल and आकाङ्क्षा desire.
28282: फलादन m. (-नः) A parrot.  E. फल fruit, अदन eating.
28283: फलाध्यक्ष m. (-क्षः) A tree, commonly Khirani, (Mimusops Kauki.)  E. फल fruit, अध्यक्ष superintendent.
28284: फलान्त m. (-न्तः) A bamboo.  E. फल fruit or blossom, अन्त end.
28286: फलानुमेय Adj. Inferable from consequences of results.
28287: फलानुसरण n. (-णं) Rate or aggregate of profits.  E. फल and अनुसरण conformity.
28288: फलापेक्षा f. (-क्षा) Regard to or expectation of consequences.  E. फल and अपेक्षा expectation.
28289: फलापेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unproductive, unfertile.  E. फल and अपेत de-prived.
28290: फलाभोग m. (-गः) Non-enjoyment of profits, &c.  E. फल and अभोग non-use.
28292: फलाशन m. (-नः) A parrot.  E. फल fruit and अशन food.
28293: फलाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Living on fruits.  E. फल and अशिन् who eats.
28294: फलासक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 	 1. Doing any thing for the sake of reward. 2. Fond of or seeking to pluck fruit.  E. फल and आसक्त attached to.
28295: फलि m. (-लिः) A kind of fish. “फलुइ” ।
28297: फलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Fruitful, bearing fruit. 	 2. Successful, yielding a result. 	 m. (-तः) A tree. 	 f. (-ता) A woman in her courses.  E. फल fruit and इतच् aff.
28298: फलिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) 	 1. Bearing fruit, fruitful. 	 2. Productive of consequences. 	 m. (-नी) 	 1. A sort of fish, commonly Phalūi, (Mys-tus kapirat.) 	 2. A tree, (especially in fruit.) 	 f. (-नी) 	 1. A medicinal plant, commonly Priyangu. 	 2. A potherb, (Echites dichotoma.) 3. A flower, (Celosia cristata.)  E. फल fruit, and इनि aff.
28299: फलूष m. (-षः) A sort of creeper.  E. फल fruit, and ऊषन् Unādi aff.
28300: फलेग्रहि mfn. (-हिः-हिः-हि) Bearing fruit in season, fruitful.  E. फल fruit, ग्रह् to take, aff. इन्; ए substituted irregularly for the final of फल; also फलग्रहि and फलेग्राहिन् ।
28301: फलेग्राहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Bearing fruit in due season. E. As above, णिनि aff.
28302: फलेपुष्पा f. (-ष्पा) A kind of flower known as “द्रोणपुष्पी” ।
28303: फलेरुहा f. (-हा) The trumpet-flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.)  E. फल fruit, in the seventh case, रुह् to grow, aff. क । “पाटलिवृक्षे” ।
28304: फलोच्चय m. (-यः) 	 1. Collecting of fruits. 	 2. A collection of fruits.  E. फल and उच्चय abundance.
28305: फलोत्तमा f. (-मा) 	 1. A small sort of grape without stones. 	 2. The three myrobalans collectively. 	 3. The benefit arising from sacred study. E. फल fruit, उत्तम best.
28306: फलोत्पति(त्ति) m. (-तिः or त्ति) The mango. 	 f. (-त्तिः) Production of fruit. E. फल fruit, उत् over, पति ruler; or फलाय उत्पत्तिरस्य ।
28307: फलोदय m. (-यः) 	 1. Gain, profit. 	 2. Heaven, paradise. 	 3. Joy, happiness. 4. Consequence, result.  E. फल fruit, gain, &c. उदय rising.
28308: फलोद्देश m. (-शः) Regard to results.  E. फल and उद्देश pointing out.
28310: फलोपेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Having or yielding fruit, &c.  E. फल and उपेत possessing.
28311: फल्क m. (-ल्कः) An expanded or extended body.  E. फल् to separate, Unādi aff. क । “विशोधिताङ्गे च” ।
28312: फल्ग mfn. (-ल्गुः-ल्गुः-ल्गु) 	 1. Pithless, sapless. 	 2. Vain, unprofitable, unmeaning, useless. 	 3. Weak, feeble. 	 f. (-ल्गुः) 	 1. The opposite leaved fig-tree, (F. oppositi-folia, Rox.) 	 2. The name of a river which is said to run underneath Gya. 	 3. Falsehood, false or lying speech. 	 4. A red powder, usually of the root of wild ginger, col-oured with sappan wood, and thrown over one another by the Hindus, at the Holi festival. 	 5. The spring season.  E. फल् to bear fruit, Unādi aff. गुक ।
28313: फल्गुन m. (-नः) 	 1. A name of ARJUNA. The month Phālguna. 	 f. (-नी) The constellation Phalguni.  E. फल् to bear fruit, Unādi aff. उनन् and गुक् aug.: see फाल्गुन ।
28314: फल्गुनाल m. (-लः) The month Phālguna.  E. फल्गु, and अल equal to, the same.
28315: फल्य n. (-ल्यं) A bud, a flower.  E. फल fruit, यत् aff.
28316: फल्लकिन् m. (-की) A fish, caught in ponds, commonly Phalūi, (Mystus kapirat.)
28317: फाट् Ind. An interjection of calling.
28318: फाणि f. (-णिः) 	 1. Unrefined sugar, molasses. 	 2. Flour or meal mixed with curds.  E. स्फायी to swell, Unādi aff. नि, deriv. irr.
28319: फाणित n. (-तं) Raw sugar, the inspissated juice of the sugarcane.  E. फण् to go, causal form, aff. क्त ।
28320: फाण्ट mfn. (-ण्टः-ण्टा-ण्टं) Readily prepared, made by an extemporaneous easy process, (decoction, &c.) 	 n. (-ण्टं) 	 1. Diluted decoction, decoc-tion, easily prepared. 	 2. The first particles of butter that are produced by churning.  E. फण् to prepare easily, aff. क्त, deriv. irr.
28321: फाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Made of cotton, (vesture.) 	 m. (-लः) 	 1. A name of SĪVA. 	 2. A name of BALARĀMA. 	 3. A citron tree. 	 n. (-लं) The share of a plough.  E. फल् to divide, in the causal form. aff. घञ् or फल fruit and अण् aff.
28322: फालकृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Furrowed, ploughed. 	 n. (-ष्टं) A ploughed-field. E. फाल and कृष्ट furrowed.
28323: फाल्गुन m. (-नः) 	 1. A name of ARJUNA. 	 2. A sort of tree, (Pentaptera Arjuna.) 	 3. A month, commonly called by the name Phālguna, (February-March.) 	 f. (-नी) 	 1. Day of full moon on the month of Phālguṇa, on which Holi or great vernal festival of the Hindus is celebrated. 	 2. A name common to the eleventh and twelfth lunar asterisms, distinguished by the epithets first and last, or पूर्व्व and उत्तरफाल्गुनीः see पूर्व्वफाल्गुनी &c.
28324: फाल्गुनानुज m. (-जः) Spring.  E. फाल्गुन the month, अनु according, ज born.
28325: फाल्गुनिक m. (-कः) The month Phālguna.  E. फाल्गुनी day of full moon in this month, and ठक् aff.
28326: फि m. (फिः) Anger, passion.  E. फल् to separate, aff. डि ।
28327: फिङ्गक m. (-कः) The fork-tailed shrike.  E. फिङ्ग imitative sound, कै to utter, aff. ड ।
28328: फिरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. The country of the Franks. 	 2. A particular disease. It is a word of foreign origin.
28330: फुट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) 	 1. Blown. 	 2. Burst. 	 3. The hood or expanded neck of a snake.  E. स्फुट् to swell, aff. क, deriv. irr.

28332: फुत्कर m. (-रः) Fire.  E. फुत् boiling and कर who makes.
28333: फुत्कार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Arrogant, contemptuous, disdainful. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. The sound of bubbling or breathing into, (as to cool it.)  E. फुत् expression of contempt, and कार who makes.
28334: फुत्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Blown up, (as a bubble.) 	 2. Blown into, cooled by blowing into it.  E. फुत् and कृत made.
28335: फुप्फुस m. (-सः) The lungs see पुप्फुस ।
28336: फुल्ल r. 1st cl. (फुल्लति) To blow or blossom, to bud or flower.
28337: फुल्ल mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं) 	 1. Blown, opened, expanded, (as a flower.) 	 2. Opened, (as the eyes with pleasure, &c.), smiling, gay.  E. फुल्ल् to blow, aff. अच्; also फुल्त ।
28338: फुल्लदामन् n. (-म) A species of the Atidhriti metre.
28339: फुल्लनयन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Full or large-eyed. 	 2. Smiling, looking hap-py.  E. फुल्ल and नयन the eye; also similar compounds, as फुल्लनेत्र, फुल्लदृष्टि, &c.
28340: फुल्लफाल m. (-लः) Winnowing corn.  E. फुल्ल blown, and फाल for स्फाल् spreading.
28342: फुल्ललोचन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Full-eyed. 	 2. Looking pleased or happy. 	 n. (-नं) A large full eye. 	 m. (-नः) A species of the antelope.  E. फुल्ल् full, expanded, and लोचन the eye.
28343: फुल्लवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Blossoming, blowing.  E. फुल्ल् to blow, क्तवतु aff.
28344: फुल्लवदन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Looking pleased or happy.  E. फुल्ल् and वदन the face.
28345: फुल्लि f. (-ल्लिः) Blowing, blossoming.  E. फुल्ल् to blow, aff. इन् ।
28346: फुल्लति f. (-तिः) Flowering, blossoming.  E. फुल्ल् to blow, क्तिन् aff.
28347: फूत् Ind. Imitative sound of bubbling, sobbing, &c.: see फुत्.
28348: फूत्कार m. (-रः) 	 1. Bubbling. 	 2. Sobbing. 	 3. Blowing or breathing into any liquid.  E. फूत् and कार making.
28349: फूत्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Bubbled, bubbling, made to sound so. 	 2. Blown or breathed into, (a liquid.) 	 3. Sounded, as in sobbing. E. फूत्, and कृत made.
28350: फे(ण)न m. (-नः) 	 1. Froth, foam. 	 2. Cuttle-fish-bone, supposed to be the indurated foam of the sea. 	 3. Vapour.  E. स्फायी to swell, नक् Unādi aff., deriv. irr.
28351: फे(ण)नक m. (-कः) Cuttle-fish-bone. 	 f. (-का) 	 1. Rice, ground and boiled with water. 	 2. The soap berry.  E. फेन froth, and कन् aff.
28352: फेनता f. (-ता) Frothiness, vapour.  E. तल् added to फेन; also with त्व, फेनत्वं ।
28353: फेनल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Frothy, foamy.  E. फेन froth, अलच् poss. aff.; also with इलच् similar aff. फेनिल, and with the usual possessive मतुप्, फेनवत् ।
28354: फेनवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Frothy, foaming, bubbling.  E. फेन froth and मतुप् aff.

28356: फेनाग्र n. (-ग्रं) A bubble.  E. फेन foam, and अग्र top.
28357: फेनायमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Foaming, frothing.  E. फेन nom. verb to foam, शनच् aff.

28359: फेनि(णि)का f. (-का) 	 1. Froth arising from treacle. 	 2. A kind of sweet-meat called Patty. “खाजा” ।  E. फेन foam, कन् added, fem. form.
28360: फेनिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Frothy, foamy. 	 m. (-लः) The soap plant, (Sapin-dus detergens, Rox.) 	 n. (-लं) 	 1. The fruit of the jujube. 	 2. The fruit of the Vangueria spinosa.  E. फेन froth or foam, इलच् aff.
28362: फेरण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A jackal.  E. फे imitative sound, रम् to sport, aff. ड ।
28363: फेरव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 	 1. Fraudulent, crafty, a rogue or cheat. 	 2. Mali-cious, noxious, injurious. 	 m. (-वः) 	 1. A jackal. 	 2. A demon, a goblin.  E. फे imitative sound, रु to utter, aff. अप् ।
28364: फेरु m. (-रुः) A jackal.  E. फे imitative sound, रु to cry, aff. डु ।
28365: फेल (ऋ) फेऌ r. 1st cl. (फेलति) To go or move.

28367: फेला f. (-ला) Orts, leavings.  E. फेल् to go, अच् aff. fem. aff. टाप्; also फेलक and फेलि ।
28368: फेलि f. (-लिः or -ली) Orts, leavings.  E. फेल् to go, इन् aff.; ङीप् optionally added; also with टाप् and कन् added, फेलिका f. (-का) ।

28371: ब m. (बः) 	 1. A name of VARUṆA. 	 2. A water jar. 	 3. Ocean. 	 4. The vulva.  E. बण् to sound, &c. aff. ड ।
28372: बंहिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Very much, excessively many.  E. बहु much, इष्ठन् superlative aff. form irr.

28849: ब्रह्मकन्यका f. (-का) The goddesss SARASWATĪ.  E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ, and कन्या the daughter; being born from the head of that deity.
