28851: ब्रह्यघातक m. (-कः) The slayer of a Brāhman.  E. ब्रह्म and घातक who kills; also ब्रह्मघातिन् m. (-ती) ।
28852: ब्रह्मघातिनी f. (-नी) A woman on the second day of the menses.
28853: ब्रह्मघ्न m. (-घ्नः) The slayer of a Brāhman.  E. ब्रह्म and घ्न who kills.
28854: ब्रह्यचर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) The Brahmacharya or Brahmachārī, the religious student: see ब्रह्मचारिन् n. (-र्य्यं) The order or condition of the reli-gious student.  E. ब्रह्म the Veda and चर्य्य observance.
28855: ब्रह्मचर्य्यस्खलन n. (-नं) Incontinence.  E. ब्रह्मचर्य्य and स्खखन deviating from.
28856: ब्रह्मचारिन् m. (-री) The Brahmachārī or religious student; the young Brāhman, from the time of his investiture with the cord, to the period of his becoming a householder: it is also applied to a per-son, who continues with his spiritual teacher, through life, study-ing the Vedas and observing the duties of the student; it is also given as a title to Pandits learned in the Vedas; to a class of ascetics; by the Tantras, it is assigned to persons whose chief virtue is the observance of continence; and it is assumed by many religious vagabonds. 	 f. (-रिणी A woman leading a life of con-tinence.  E. ब्रह्म the Veda and चर् to go or follow, aff. णिनि ।
28857: ब्रह्मजन्मन् n. (-न्म) Second or spiritual birth, investiture.  E. ब्रह्म the Vedas and जन्मन् birth.
28858: ब्रह्मजीविन् m. (-वी) An impure Brāhman, one who converts his religious duties into a trade, and performs sacrifice, teaches the Veda, &c. for hire.  E. ब्रह्मन् an officiating priest, and जीविन् who gets a living.
28859: ब्रह्मज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A sage, one who has spiritual wisdom.  E. ब्रह्म and ज्ञ who knows.
28860: ब्रह्मज्ञान n. (-नं) Spiritual wisdom.  E. ब्रह्म and ज्ञान knowledge.
28861: ब्रह्मण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) Relating to or connected with BRAHMĀ or a Brāhman. 	 m. (-ण्यः) 	 1. The mulberry tree, (Morus Indica.) 	 2. The planet SATURN.  E. ब्रह्मन् and यत् aff.
28862: ब्रह्मतत्त्व n. (-त्त्वं) The true knowledge of Supreme Spirit.  E. ब्रह्म and तत्त्व truth.
28863: ब्रह्मत्व n. (-त्वं) 	 1. Identification with BRAHMĀ or God. 	 2. God-head. E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ, त्व aff. of the abstract; also with तल् aff. ब्रह्मता, or with भूय added ब्रह्मभूय n. (-यं) ।
28864: ब्रह्मद m. (-दः) A spiritual teacher.  E. ब्रह्म the Veda or holy knowledge, and द who gives, also ब्रह्मदातृ, ब्रह्मदायिन, &c.
28865: ब्रह्मदण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 	 1. A plant. see ब्रह्मयष्टि. 	 2. A curse, an anathema. 3. The tribute paid to a Brāhmana in the shape of a fine.  E. ब्रह्म a Brāhman and दण्ड a stick.
28866: ब्रह्मदत्त m. (-त्तः) One of the sovereigns of the race of Ikshwāku enumerated by the Jains.  E. ब्रह्म by or to BRAHMĀ, दत्त given.
28867: ब्रह्मदर्भा f. (-र्भा) A plant, (Ligusticum ajwaen, Rox.)  E. ब्रह्म and दर्भा sacrificial grass. “यमानिकायाम् ।”
28868: ब्रह्मदान n. (-नं) Instruction in the Vedas.  E. ब्रह्म and दान gift.
28869: ब्रह्मदारु m. (-रुं) The mulberry, (Morus Indica.)  E. ब्रह्म and दारु wood.
28870: ब्रह्मन् m. (-ह्मा) 	 1. BRAHMĀ, the first deity of the Hindu triad, and the operative creator of the world. 	 2. A Brāhman. 	 3. The superin-tending or presiding priest at the sacrifice. 	 4. One of the astrono-mical Yogas. 	 5. One of the principal servants of the Jinas. 	 n. (-ह्म) 1. The divine cause and essence of the world, from which all created things are supposed to emanate and to which they return; the unknown God. 	 2. The practice of austere devotion. 	 3. The Vedas or scripture. 	 4. Holy knowledge.  E. वृह् to increase, (man-kind) aff. मनिन् and the initial letter changed to ब ।
28871: ब्रह्मनाभ m. (-भः) VISHṆU.  E. ब्रह्मन् BRAHMĀ and नाभि the navel; BRAH-MĀ having arisen to create the world, in a lotus, which sprang from the navel of VISHṆU.
28872: ब्रह्मनिर्व्वाण n. (-णं) Absorption into or identification with the Supreme. E. ब्रह्म, and निर्व्वाण final absorption.
28873: ब्रह्मपद n. (-दं) The place or nature of spiritual being. 	 2. The station or rank of a Brahman or of BRAHMĀ.  E. ब्रह्म, and पद to place.
28874: ब्रह्मपादप m. (-पः) The Palāsh tree, (Butea frondosa.)  E. ब्रह्म a Brāhman, and पादप a tree.
28875: ब्रह्मपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) 	 1. A sort of poison. 	 2. The Brahmaputra river, which rises in the Himālaya and with the Ganges falls into the Bay of Bengal. 	 2. A place of pilgrimage, probably the source of the stream. 	 f. (-त्री) 	 1. The SARASWATĪ river. 	 2. The goddess SARAS-WATĪ.  E. ब्रह्मन् BRAHMĀ and पुत्त्र offspring.
28876: ब्रह्मपुरी f. (-री) The capital of BRAHMĀ on the mountain Kailasā. E. ब्रह्मन् and पुरी the city.
28877: ब्रह्मबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) 	 1. The epithet or appellative of a BRĀHMAN. 	 2. A term of abuse.  E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ and बन्धु a friend.
28878: ब्रह्मभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Become one with the Supreme spirit.  E. ब्रह्म and भूत become.
28879: ब्रह्मभूति f. (-तिः) Twilight.  E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ and भूति being.
28880: ब्रह्मभूय n. (-यं) Identification with BRAHMĀ.  E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ, and भूय being.
28881: ब्रह्ममय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Consisting of or identified with spirit. 	 2. Belong-ing to or fit for a BRĀHMAN, &c.  E. ब्रह्म and मयट् aff.
28882: ब्रह्ममूर्द्धभृत् m. (-भृत्) ŚIVA.  E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ, मूर्द्धन् the forehead and भृत् who has: having in a dispute cut off one of BRAHMĀ'S heads.
28883: ब्रह्मयज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) The study of the Vedas.  E. ब्रह्म a Veda or the Supreme being, and यज्ञ sacrifice.
28884: ब्रह्मयष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A plant, (Ligusticum ajwaen, Rox.)  E. ब्रह्म a Brāhman and यष्टि a stick; also with कन् added in the fem. form, ब्रह्मयष्टिका, for with ङीप् added ब्रह्मयष्टी ।
28885: ब्रह्मयोग m. (-गः) Cultivation of spiritual knowledge.  E. ब्रह्म and योग addition to.
28886: ब्रह्मयोनि m. (-निः) A particular mountain. Adj. Sprung from BRAHMĀ. E. ब्रह्म and योनि place of production.
28887: ब्रह्मरन्ध्र n. (-न्ध्रं) An aperture in the crown of the head, through which the soul is supposed to escape.
28888: ब्रह्मंराक्षस m. (-सः) A demon or fiend of the Brāhminical class.  E. ब्रह्म and राक्षम a goblin.
28889: ब्रह्मरात्रि m. (-त्रिः) 	 1. A name of YĀJNYAVALKYA, a saint and legislator. E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ, रा to give, ष्ट्रिन् aff.; conferring the knowledge of BRAHMĀ upon JANAKA in return for his bounty. 	 2. A night of BRAHMĀ, equal to a thousand divine ages.  E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ and रात्रि night.
28890: ब्रह्मरीति f. (-तिः) Brass.  E. ब्रह्म and रीति calx.
28891: ब्रह्मरेखा f. (-खा) The lines written by BRAHMĀ on the forehead of a man indicative of his lot in this world: also ब्रह्मलेखा ।
28892: ब्रह्मर्षि m. (-र्षिः) A divine saint, a Rishi of a particular class, including VĀSISHṬHA, &c.  E. ब्रह्म a Brāhman, and ऋषि a saint; the saints of this class are supposed to be of the Brāhminical order.
28893: ब्रह्मर्षिदेश m. (-शः) A part of India, including the four countries of Kuru-kshetra, Matsya, Panchāla, and Surasena or Mathurā. E. ब्रह्मर्षि a Rishi, देश country.
28894: ब्रह्मलोक m. (-कः) A division of the universe, the supposed eternal resi-dence of the spirits of the pious.  E. ब्रह्मन् BRAHMĀ and लोक a world.
28895: ब्रह्मवद्य n. (-द्यं) Knowledge or declaration of BRAHMĀ, the knowledge of the universal permeation of one spirit, as taught by the Vedānta system of philosophy. E. BRAHMĀ or the spiritual deity, वद् to speak or declare, aff. क्यप्, also with the aff. यत्, and the semi-vowel changed, ब्रह्मोद्य n. (-द्यं).
28896: ब्रह्मवर्च्चस् n. (-र्च्चः) The power or sanctity of a Brāhman.  E. ब्रह्म and वर्च्चस् splendour.
28897: ब्रह्मवर्च्चस n. (-सं) 	 1. Holiness, resulting from the study and observance of the Vedas. 	 2. The sanctity or superhuman power of a Brāh-man.  E. ब्रह्म the Velas, and वर्च्चस splendour, aff. अच् ।
28898: ब्रह्मवर्च्चस्विन् mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि) 	 1. Endowed with sanctity, pure, pious. 2. Having Brāhminical power or virtue.  E. ब्रह्मवर्च्चस्, and विनि aff.
28899: ब्रह्मवर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A district of western India; also ब्रह्मावर्त्त.  E. ब्रह्म a Brāhman, and वृत् to abide, aff. अच् ।
28900: ब्रह्मवर्द्धन n. (-नं) Copper.  E. ब्रह्म a Brāhman, and वर्द्धन increasing, favour-ing; being highly proper for utensils of worship. &c.
28901: ब्रह्मवाद m. (-दः) 	 1. Citing the Vedas. 	 2. Declaring or teaching spiritual knowledge.  E. ब्रह्म scripture, and वाद speaking.
28902: ब्रह्मवादिन् m. (-दी) 	 1. A follower of the Vedānta system of philosophy, one who maintains all things are spirit. 	 2. A defender or ex-pounder of the Veda.  E. ब्रह्म the Veda or BRAHMĀ, GOD, and वादिन् who recites.
28903: ब्रह्मविद् m. (-वित् or -विद्) A sage, one who knows the nature of the Supreme Spirit.  E. ब्रह्म and विद् who knows.
28904: ब्रह्मविद्या f. (-द्या) Knowledge of spirit.  E. ब्रह्म, and विद्या science.
28905: ब्रह्मविन्दु m. (-न्दुः) A drop of saliva sputtered out in reading the Vedas. E. ब्रह्म scripture, and विन्दु a drop.
28906: ब्रह्मवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) 	 1. The Palāsh tree, (Butea frondosa.) 	 2. The glomer-ulus fig-tree.  E. ब्रह्म a BRAHMĀ and वृक्ष a tree.
28907: ब्रह्मवृन्दा f. (-न्द्रा) The capital of BRAHMĀ.  E. ब्रह्मन् and वृन्द heap, assemblage.
28908: ब्रह्मवेद m. (-दः) 	 1. Knowledge of BRAHMĀ, monotheism. 	 2. Knowledge of the Vedas.  E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ and वेद knowing.
28909: ब्रह्मवेदि f. (-दिः) A country. see ब्रह्मावर्त्त.  E. ब्रह्म a Brāhman and बेदि a country.
28910: ब्रह्मवेदिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Knowing or acquainted with the Vedas, with spiritual knowledge, &c.  E. ब्रह्म and वेदिन् who knows.
28911: ब्रह्मशल्य m. (-ल्यः) A tree, (Mimosa Arabica.)  E. ब्रह्म a Brāhman, and शल्य a stake. “वाव्ला” ।
28912: ब्रह्मशासन n. (-नं) An edict or grant, &c. addressed to Brāhmans.  E. ब्रह्म a Brāhman and शासन governing or an edict, &c.
28913: ब्रह्मसत्र n. (-त्रं) 	 1. Study and teaching of the Vedas. 	 2. The constant study of them.  E. ब्रह्म and सत्र sacrifice.
28914: ब्रह्मसर्प m. (-र्पः) A sort of snake.  E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ and सर्प a snake.
28915: ब्रह्मसम्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Born or produced from BRAHMĀ. 	 m. (-वः) The second of the persons called VĀSUDEVA or KRISHṆA by the Jains. E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ and सम्भव offspring.
28916: ब्रह्मसायुज्य n. (-ज्यं) Identification with BRAHMĀ.  E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ and सायुज्य intimate union.
28917: ब्रह्मसार्ष्टिता f. (-ता) Equality with BRAHMĀ.  E. ब्रह्म and सार्ष्टिता sameness.
28918: ब्रह्मसुवर्च्चला f. (-ला) A plant, an infusion of which is to be drank in ex-piation of having anything touched by a dog, cat, &c.  E. ब्रह्म, and सुवर्च्चला linseed.
28919: ब्रह्मसू m. (-सूः) 	 1. ANIRUDDHA, the son of KĀMA. 	 2. KĀMADEVA.  E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ and सू the son.
28920: ब्रह्मसूत्र n. (-त्रं) 	 1. The sacrificial or Brāhminical thread. 	 2. An aphor-ism of the Vedānta philosophy.  E. ब्रह्म a Brāhman and सूत्र thread.
28921: ब्रह्मसूनु m. (-नुः) A sovereign according to the Jains, of the race of Iksh-wāku.  E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ and सूनु son.
28922: ब्रह्मस्वरूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Of the nature of spirit, of the same essence as the God-head.  E. ब्रह्म and स्वरूप nature.
28923: ब्रह्महत्या f. (-त्या) 	 1. Brāhminicide, killing a Brāhman. 	 2. Any crime equally heinous.  E. ब्रह्म and हत्या killing.
28924: ब्रह्महन् m. (-हा) The murderer or slayer of a Brāhman.  E. ब्रह्मन् and हन् who kills.
28925: ब्रह्महुत n. (-तं) The performance of hospitality, &c., that one of the great sacraments which consists in the veneration of mankind. E. ब्रह्म a Brāhman हुत worshipped; being the most worthy of res-pect, &c.
28926: ब्रह्माक्षर m. (-रः) The sacred and mysterious name of the deity.  E. ब्रह्म GOD, अक्षर a letter, the Omkāra.
28928: ब्रह्माञ्जलि m. (-लिः) 	 1. Joining both hands together, whilst reading the Vedas, either as an act of humility or to mark the accentuation of the Sāma-Veda. 	 2. Paying obeisance to the spiritual preceptor at the beginning or end of a lecture.  E. ब्रह्म the Vedas and अञ्चलि the hands joined.
28929: ब्रह्माणी f. (-णी) 	 1. The female energy of BRAHMĀ. 	 2. A sort of perfume, commonly Renukā. 	 3. A kind of brass; “वेङापितल” ।  E. ब्रह्मन् BRAHMĀ, fem. aff. ङीप्.
28930: ब्रह्माण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 	 1. The globe, the world. 	 2. One of the Purānas.  E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ and अण्ड an egg, to which it is compared; in creation there are said to have been innumerable Brahmāndas.
28931: ब्रह्माधिगमन n. (-नं) Perusal of the Vedas.  E. ब्रह्म and अघिगमन going through; also ब्रह्माधिगम ।
28932: ब्रह्माधिगामिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating or contributing to a course of sacred study.  E. ब्रह्माधिगम and ठञ् aff.
28933: ब्रह्माभ्यास m. (-सः) Study or repetition of scripture.  E. ब्रह्म and अभ्यास exercise.
28934: ब्रह्माम्भस् n. (-म्भं) Cow's urine.  E. ब्रह्मन् a Brāhman and अम्भस् water.
28935: ब्रह्मारण्य n. (-ण्यं) A place where the Vedas are read and explained. E. ब्रह्म the Veda and अरण्य a wood.
28936: ब्रह्मावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) The country to the north-west of Delhi, lying between the rivers Saraswatī and Drishadwati.  E. ब्रह्म a Brāh-man आवर्त्त abode.
28937: ब्रह्मासन n. (-नं) A posture suited to devout and religious meditation. E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ and आसन sitting.
28938: ब्रह्मास्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) The BRAHMĀ'S weapon, a fabulous weapon originally from BRAHMĀ. 	 2. The imprecation of a Brāhman.  E. ब्रह्म and अस्त्र a weapon.
28939: ब्रह्माहूति f. (-तिः) An oblation of ghee.  E. ब्रह्म the Veda, and आहूति an offering.
28940: ब्रह्मो f. (-ह्मी) 	 1. A sort of fish, commonly Pāncāl, (Macrognathus Pan-calus, HAM.) 	 2. A plant, (Siphonanthus Indica.)  E. वृह् to grow or increase, affs. मनिन् and ङीप्; also ब्राह्मी.
28941: ब्रह्मोज्झता f. (-ता) Neglecting or forgetting the Veda.  E. ब्रह्म, उज्झता abandonment.
28942: ब्रह्मोद्य n. (-द्यं) Reciting or explaining the Vedas.  E. ब्रह्म, वद् to speak, aff. क्यप् ।
28943: ब्रह्मौदन n. (-नं) Boiled-rice distributed to priests at a sacrifice.  E. ब्रह्मन् a Brāhman and ओदन boiled-rice.
28944: ब्रा (व्रा) ह्म mfn. (ह्मः-ह्मी-ह्मं) Relating or belonging to BRAHMĀ, the Vedas, &c. 	 n. (-ह्यं) 	 1. The part of the hand under the root of the thumb. 	 2. One of the eight forms of marriage, the presentation of the bride elegantly adorned, by the father to the bridegroom whom he has invited. 	 3. The missile presided over by BRAHMĀ. 	 m. (-ह्मः) NĀRADA the sage and son of BRAHMĀ. 	 f. (-ह्मी) One of the eight divine mothers of created beings, or the personified energies of the gods; the Saktī or energy of BRAHMĀ. 	 2. The goddess of speech, SARASWATĪ. 	 3. The moon plant, (Asclepias acida.) 	 4. A sort of potherb, (Ruta grave-olens. 	 5. A shrub, (Siphonanthus Indica.) 	 6. A sort of fish. 	 7. The asterism Rohini. 	 8. A she-frog. 	 9. A yellow-coloured ant. 	 10. The wife of a Brāhman.  E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ, &c. अण् aff.
28945: ब्राह्मण m. (-णः) A man of the first Hindu tribe, a Brāhman. 	 n. (-णं) 	 1. An assemblage of Brāhmans, a council, a conclave. 	 2. A portion of the Vedas, that which comprises the precepts that inculcate reli-gious duties, the maxims which explain those precepts and the arguments which relate to theology; it is, however, now often blended with other portions. 	 f. (-णी) 	 1. The wife of a Brāhman, or a woman of the Brāhminical tribe. 	 2. A kind of wasp. 	 3. A small ant. 	 4. a potherb, (Ruta graveolens.) 	 5. A shrub, (Sipho-nanthus Indica.) 	 5. A sort of grass, (Trigonella corniculata.) E. ब्रह्मन् the Veda, &c. अण् aff. and the final syllable of the ori-ginal word retained.
28946: ब्राह्मणचाण्डाल m. (-लः) An outcaste Brāhman, one who is attended by a wife of another caste or the son of a Sudra by a Brāhman female. E. ब्राह्मण and चाण्डाल an outcaste.
28947: ब्राह्मणजाति f. (-तिः) The Brāhminical tribe or caste.  E. ब्राह्मण and जाति tribe.
28948: ब्राह्मणजातीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Belonging to the Brāhminical race.  E. ब्राह्मण and जातीय generic.
28949: ब्राह्मणजीविका f. (-का) The occupation or subsistence of a Brāhman. E. ब्राह्मण and जीविका livelihood.
28950: ब्राह्मणता f. (-ता) Brāhmanhood.  E. ब्राह्मण and तल् aff.; also with त्व, ब्राह्मणत्वं ।
28951: ब्राह्मणबध m. (-धः) Brāhminicide.  E. ब्राह्मण and बध killing.
28952: ब्राह्मणब्रुव m. (-वः) A Brāhman by birth but not by attention to his du-ties; one who subsists by avocations properly limited to the other tribes.  E. ब्राह्मण a Brāhman and ब्रुव who speaks, who calls himself, (improperly.) a Brāhman.
28953: ब्राह्मणयष्टिका f. (-का) A shrub, (Siphonanthus Indica.)  E. ब्राह्मण a Brāh-man and यष्टि a staff, aff. कन् । “वामनहाटी” ।
28954: ब्राह्मणसंस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Belonging to or abiding with a Brāhman. E. ब्राह्मण and संस्थ what stays with.
28955: ब्राह्मणहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Suitable to or fit for a Brāhman.  E. ब्राह्मण and हित proper.
28956: ब्राह्मणातिक्रम m. (-मः) Disregarding or disrespecting Brāhmans.  E. ब्राह्मण and अतिक्रम going over or beyond.
28957: ब्राह्मणात्मक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Belonging to, or with one containing Brāhmans, the Brāhmana section of the Vedas, &c.  E. ब्राह्मण and आत्मक own.
28958: ब्राह्मणादर्शन n. (-नं) Absence of Brāhminical instruction or guidance. E. ब्राह्मण and अदर्शन not showing or teaching.
28959: ब्राह्मणाभ्युपपत्ति f. (-त्तिः) The protection of a Brāhman. E. ब्राह्मण and अभ्युपपत्ति defence.
28960: ब्राह्मणायण m. (-णः) A Brāhman, sprung from a learned and holy proge-nitors.  E. ब्राह्मण and फक् affs.
28961: ब्राह्मणीगामिन् m. (-मी) The gallant of a woman of the Brāhminical tribe or the wife of a Brāhman.  E. ब्राह्मणी a female Brāhman. and गामिन् who goes to or with.
28962: ब्राह्मण्य m. (-ण्यः) The planet SATURN. 	 n. (-ण्यं) 	 1. An assembly of Brāh-mans. 	 2. The state, quality or business of a Brāhman, Brāhman-hood.  E. ब्रह्मन् and यञ् aff.; or ब्राह्मन and यत् aff.
28963: ब्राह्मदेया f. (-या) A girl to be wedded by the Brāhma form.  E. ब्राह्म and देय to be given.
28965: ब्राह्ममुहूर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A particular period of the early part of the day.
28966: ब्राह्माहोरात्र m. (-त्र) A day and night of BRAHMĀ, a period of two thou-sand ages of the gods or two Kalpas of mortals.  E. ब्राह्मण relating to BRAHMĀ, अहन् a day and रात्रि a night.
28967: ब्राह्मिका f. (-का) A shrub, (Siphonanthus Indica.)  E. ब्राह्मी and कन् aff.
28968: ब्राह्मीपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) The son of a woman married according to the Brāhma form.  E. ब्राह्मी and पुत्त्र a son.
28969: ब्राह्म्य n. (-ह्म्यं) 	 1. The worship or veneration of Brāhmans, considered as one of the great sacraments. 	 2. Astonishments.  E. ब्रह्म and ष्यञ् aff.
28970: ब्राह्महुत n. (-तं) Respect shown to guests, especially to Brāhmans, hos-pitality.  E. ब्राह्म्य and हुत sacrifice.
28971: ब्रुवत् mfn. (-वन्-वन्ती-वत्) Speaking, saying.  E. ब्रु to speak, शतृ aff.
28972: ब्रूवाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Speaking, saying.  E. ब्रू to speak, शानच् aff.
28973: ब्रू (ञ) ब्रूञ् r. 2nd cl. (ब्रवीति or आह) To speak or tell: आह is option-ally substituted for this root before the first five inflections of the present tense and वच in several other tenses.
28975: भ The twenty-fourth consonant of the Nāgari alphabet and aspirate of the last letter, or Bh.
28976: भ n. (-भं) 	 1. A star. 	 2. An asterism. 	 3. A planet. 	 4. The number twenty-seven. 	 m. (-भः) 	 1. A name of SUKRA, regent of the planet VENUS. 	 2. A bee. 	 2. Error, delusion. 	 f. (-भा) 	 1. Light, lustre, splendour. 	 2. A ray of light. 	 f. (-मी) Fear.  E. भा to shine, or भी to fear, aff. ड ।

28979: भक्तकर m. (-रः) Factitious incense, incense prepared from various fra-grant resins and perfumes.  E. भक्त dressed, and कर making.
28980: भक्तकार m. (-रः) A cook.  E. भक्त boiled rice, and कार who makes.
28981: भक्तछन्द n. (-न्दं) Appetite, wish for food.  E. भक्त and छन्द will.
28983: भक्तता f. (-ता) Devotedness, implied faith in and attachment to  E. भक्त and तल् aff.; also with त्व, भक्तत्वं ।
28984: भक्ततूर्य्य n. (र्य्यं) Music played at the hour of eating, amongst princes and great men.  E. भक्त rice or food. and तूर्य्यं a musical instrument.
28985: भक्तद m. (-दः) A supporter, a maintainer.  E. भक्त and द who gives: also भक्तदायक, भक्तदायिन्, &c.
28986: भक्तदातृ m. (-ता) A maintainer, a feeder.  E. मक्त food and दातृ a donor.
28987: भक्तदास m. (-सः) A slave, one maintained in consideration of service. E. भक्त food, दास a slave.
28988: भक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 	 1. Service, worship. 	 2. Faith, belief. 	 3. Devotion or attachment to. 	 4. Part, portion. 	 5. Fracture, division. 	 6. Meto-nymy.  E. भज् to serve, or भञ्ज् to break, aff. क्तिन् ।
28989: भक्तिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Faithful, devoted to.  E. भक्ति and मतुप् aff.
28990: भक्तियोग m. (-गः) Devotion or worship. as shewn by implicit faith in any divinity.  E. भक्ति and योग devotion.
28991: भक्तिल m. (-लः) 	 1. A good horse. 	 2. A follower, a votary.  E. भक्ति ser-vice, &c. ला to afford, aff. क ।
28992: भक्ष् r. 1st and 10th cls. (-भक्षति भक्षयति-ते) 	 1. To eat. 	 2. To waste. 	 3. To bite.
28993: भक्षक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Gluttonous, voracious, gourmand. 	 2. A feeder, an eater, who or what eats. 	 f. (-क्षिका) A meal, a feed.  E. भक्ष् to eat, aff. ण्वल् ।
28994: भक्षकार m. (-रः) A confectioner, a pastry cook.  E. भक्ष् food, कार who prepares; also भक्षङ्कार ।
28995: भक्षण n. (-णं) Eeating.  E. भक्ष् to eat, aff. ल्युट् ।
28996: भक्षणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Eatable, to be eaten.  E. भक्ष् and अनीयर् aff.
28997: भक्षमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Eating.  E. भक्ष to eat, शानच् aff.
28998: भक्षयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Eaten.  E. भक्ष् to eat, शतृ aff.
28999: भक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Eaten.  E. भक्ष् to eat, aff. क्त ।
29000: भक्षितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be eaten, what may be eaten.  E. भक्ष् to eat, तव्य aff.; also भक्षयितव्य ।
29001: भक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्य) Eatable. 	 n. (-क्ष्यं) Food.  E. भक्ष् to eat, aff. यत् ।
29002: भक्ष्यकार m. (-रः) A baker.  E. भक्ष्य eatable and कार who makes or pre-pares; also भक्ष्यंकार ।
29003: भक्ष्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) To be eaten.  E. भक्ष् to eat, pass. v., शानच् aff.
29004: भग n. (गं) 	 1. Pudendum muliebre. 	 2. Fortune, prosperity. 	 3. Beauty, splendour. 	 4. Excellence, greatness. 	 5. Desire, wish, love. 	 6. Strength, vigour. 	 7. Effort, exertion. 	 8. Fame, glory. 	 9. Know-ledge. 	 10. Absence of passion, the tranquillity of the religious man, who has divested himself of worldly excitability. 	 11. Omni-potence, supreme or divine power. 	 12. Virtue, moral merit. 	 13. Final emancipation. 	 m. (-गः) 	 1. The sun. 	 2. One of the twelve suns or Ādityas. 	 3. The moon. 	 4. A form of ŚIVA.  E. भज् to serve, &c. ग aff.
29005: भगण m. (-णः) 	 1. The whole multitude of stars. 	 2. Revolution of the planets in the Zodiac. 	 3. The Zodiac.
29006: भगदेवता f. (-ता) Hymeneal divinity.  E. भग and देवता divinity.
29007: भगन्दर m. (-रः) Fistula in ano.  E. भग the vulva, दृ to divide, aff. खश् ।
29008: भगवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Respectable, worshipful, adorable, and hence the common appellative of a prince or deity. 	 m. (-वान्) One of the generic titles of a Jina or Jaina deified sage. 	 f. (-वती) 	 1. A name of GAURĪ. 	 2. Any goddess.  E. भग fortune, supremacy, &c., and मतुप् poss. aff.
29009: भगाङ्कुर m. (-रः) The clitoris.  E. भग and अङ्कुर a shoot.
29010: भगाल m. (-लः) The human skull.  E. भग ŚIVA, अल् to adorn, aff. अच् ।
29011: भगालिन् m. (-लो) A name of ŚIVA.  E. भगाल a skull, and इनि aff.
29012: भगिन् f. (-नी) Adj. 	 1. Prosperous, fortunate. 	 2. Grand, splendid.
29013: भगिनी f. (-नी) 	 1. A sister. 	 2. A lucky woman. 	 3. A woman in general. E. भग prosperity, desire, इनि and ङीप् affs.
29014: भगीरथ m. (-थः) A king of the solar dynasty, whose austerities brought down GANGĀ, the river, from heaven to the earth.
29016: भगोस् Ind. A particle used as a respectful term of address.  E. भगवत् reverend and ओस् irregularly substituted for the three final letters.
29017: भग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) 	 1. Torn, broken. 	 2. Overcome, defeated. 	 3. Disre-garded, despised. 	 4. Disappointed. 	 5. Destroyed. 	 6. Checked. 	 n. (-ग्नं) Fracture of the leg.  E. भञ्ज् to break, aff. क्त ।
29018: भग्नजानु mfn. (-नुः-नुः-नु) Having a broken leg.  E. भग्न and जानु the knee.
29019: भग्नपृष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Confronting, encountering, coming before or in front of.  E. भग्न disregarded and पृष्ठ the back, heedless of what is behind.
29020: भग्नप्रक्रम m. (-मः) 	 1. Disorder, confusion. 	 2. Want of method or arrange-ment in composition.  E. भग्न and प्रक्रम proceeding.
29021: भग्नसन्धिक n. (-कं) Butter milk.  E. भग्न broken, सन्धि union, and कप् aff.; divided by churning.
29022: भग्नात्मन् m. (-त्मा) The moon.  E. भग्न broken and आत्मन् the body; having been cut in two by the trident of ŚIVA, as a punishment for having violated the wife of VRIHASPATĪ.
29023: भग्नाश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Disappointed.  E. भग्न and आशा expectation.
29024: भग्नी f. (-ग्नी) A sister.  E. भञ्ज् to share, aff. क्त, fem. aff. ङीप् ।
29025: भग्नोद्यम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 	 1. Labouring in vain. 	 2. Baffled.  E. भग्न, उद्यम effort.
29027: भङ्क्तृ mfn. (-क्ता-क्त्री-क्तृ) Breaking, a breaker, who or what breaks.  E. भञ्ज् to break, तृच् aff.
29028: भङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. Breaking, splitting. 	 2. A chasm, a fissure, a division. 3. Defeat, discomfiture. 	 4. Disappointment. 	 5. Fear. 	 6. Dishonesty, fraud, circumvention, cheating. 	 7. Going, motion. 	 8. A wave. 	 9. A water-course, a canal. 	 10. Disease in general. 	 11. A disease, (hemi-plegia, palsy.) 	 12. Interruption of the voice. 	 f. (-ङ्गा) 	 1. Hemp, (Cannabis sativa.) 	 2. A plant, commonly Teori. 	 3. A fibrous plant from which a sort of flax is obtained, (Crotolaria juncea.)  E. भञ्ज् to break, aff. अच् ।
29029: भङ्गभाज् mfn. (-भाक्) Breaking, being broken.  E. भङ्ग, and भाज् partaking.
29031: भङ्गसार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) Crafty, fraudulent, dishonest.  E. भङ्ग breaking, fraud, &c., स for सम् with, and अर्थ object.
29032: भङ्गान m. (-नः) A sort of fish, (Cyprinus Banggana, HAM.)  E. भङ्ग a wave, अन् to live, aff. अच् ।
29034: भङ्गि f. (-ङ्गिः-ङ्गी) 	 1. Fracture, division, separation. 	 2. Fraud, deception, trick, disguise. 	 3. Irony. 	 4. Wit, repartee. 	 5. A wave. 	 6. A crooked path. 	 7. A step. 	 8. Modesty. 	 9. A current. 	 10. Interval. 11. Circumlocation.  E. भञ्ज् to break, aff. इन्, ङीप् optionally added.
29035: भङ्गील n. (-लं) Defeat in the organ of sense.
29036: भङ्गुर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 	 1. Crooked, bent. 	 2. Fraudulent, crafty, dishon-est. 	 3. Perishable. 	 m. (-रः) The bend or elbow of a river.  E. भञ्ज् to break, aff. घुरच् ।
29037: भङ्ग्य n. (-ङ्ग्यं) A field of hemp.  E. भङ्गा hemp, यत् aff.

29039: भजत् mfn. (-जन्-जन्ती-जत्) 	 1. Serving, waiting upon. 	 2. Enjoying, (carnal-ly.) 	 3. Dividing, sharing.  E. भज् to serve, &c., शतृ aff.

29041: भजमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Serving, waiting. 	 2. Enjoying, possessing, (carnally.) 	 3. Dividing, sharing. 	 4. Right, fit, proper.  E. भज् to serve, &c., शानच् aff.

29044: भञ्जत् mfn. (-ञ्जन्-ञ्जन्ती-ञ्जत) Breaking, destroying  E. भञ्ज्, and शतृ aff.

29050: भटित्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) Rosted on a spit, (meat, &c.)  E. भट to nourish, इत्र aff.

29657: भूतेतृ m. (-ता) A king, a sovereign.  E. भू the earth, and नेतृ a leader.

29668: भूनय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of or consisting the earth. 	 f. (-यी) A name of Chhāyā or shadow personified, the wife of the sun.  E. भू earth, and मयट् aff.

29676: भूमिदेव m. (-वः) A Brāhman.  E. भूमि the earth, and देव a divinity.

29678: भूमिप m. (-पः) A prince, a sovereign.  E. भूमि the earth, and प who protects.
29679: भूमिपक्ष m. (-क्षः) A horse of a good breed.  E. भूमि the earth, and पक्ष part or side.
29680: भूमिपति m. (-तिः) A king.  E. भूमि and पति master.
29681: भूमिपतित्व n. (-त्वं) Princedom, sovereignty.  E. त्व added to the last.
29682: भूमिपिशाच m. (-चः) The palmyra tree, (Borassus flabelliformis.)  E. भूमि earth, पिशाच goblin.
29683: भूमिभृत् m. (-भृत्) 	 1. A king. 	 2. A mountain.  E. भूमि and मृत् who nourishes.
29684: भूमिमण्डा f. (-ण्डा) Arabian jasmine, (Jasminum zambac.)  E. भूमि the earth, मडि to ornament, aff. अच् ।
29685: भूमिरक्षक m. (-कः) A horse of a good breed.  E. भूमि the earth, रक्ष् to preserve, aff. वुन्; it is also written भूमिरक्ष and भूमिपक्ष ।
29686: भूमिलाभ m. (-भः) Death, dying, (in figuratively.)  E. भूमि earth, लाभ acquisition.

29688: भूमिवर्द्धन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Increasing or adding to the earth. 	 mn. (-नः-नं) A corpse.  E. भूमि the earth and वर्द्धन increasing.
29689: भूमिशय mfn. (-यः-यी यं) Sleeping on the ground.  E. भूमि and शी to sleep, श aff.
29690: भूमिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Standing or staying on the earth.  E. भूमि and स्थ who or what stays.

29695: भूम्यामलकी f. (-की) A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta.)  E. भूमि the earth, आमलकी a myrobalan; also भूम्यासनी f. (-नी ।)
29696: भूय n. (-यं) Abstract state, but used in composition, as व्रह्मभूय the state of BRAHMĀ, or identification with BRAHMĀ, becoming of the same nature, &c.  E. भू to be, aff. क्यप् ।

29702: भूरिज् f. (-रिक्) The earth.  E. भृ to support, इजि Unādi aff. and ऋ changed to ऊर् ।
29703: भूरिधामन् mfn. (-मा-मा-म) 	 1. Splendid, bright. 	 2. Illustrious.  E. भूरि, and धामन् Splendour.

29707: भूरिफेना f. (-ना) A plant, commonly Charmakasā.  E. भूरि much, and फेन cuttle-fish-bone.
29708: भूरिमाय m. (-यः) A jackal.  E. भूरि much, माय deceit.
29710: भूरिलाभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Very profitable or beneficial. 	 n. (-भं) Great gain.  E. भूरि and लाभ gain.
29711: भूरिशस् Ind. Manifold, many by many.  E. भूरि many, शस् aff.

32340: यक्षराज m. (-जः) KUVERA: see the last.
32341: यक्षराट्पुरी f. (-री) Alakā, the capital of KUVERA, supposed to be seated on mount Kailāsa.  E. यक्षराज, पुरी city.
32342: यक्षरात्रि f. (-त्रिः) The night of the day of full moon in the month of Kārtika: see दीपाली.  E. यक्ष the demi-god, रात्रि night; these spirits being supposed to be then abroad.
32343: यक्षवित्त Adj. One who stores up wealth but never uses it.
32344: यक्षामलक m. (-कः) A tree, described as a sort of date.  E. यक्ष a Yaksha, आमलक myrobalan. “पिण्डीखेजुर ।”
32345: यक्षावास m. (-सः) The Indian fig-tree, (Ficus Indica.)  E. यक्ष a demi-god, आवास abode. “वटवृक्षे ।”
32346: यक्षिणी f. (-णी) 	 1. The wife of KUVERA. 	 2. The wife of a Yaksha. 	 3. A sort of female fiend, attached to the service of DURGĀ, and frequently maintaining, like a sylph or fairy, an intercourse with mortals.  E. यक्षिन् a name of KUVERA, and ङीष् aff.
32347: यक्षेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A name of KUVERA.  E. यक्ष, and इन्द्र lord.
32348: यक्षेश m. (-शः) KUVERA.  E. यक्ष, and ईश lord; also यक्षेश्वर and the like.
32349: यक्षोडुम्बुरक n. (-कं) The fruit of the Ficus religiosa.
32350: यक्ष्मघ्नी f. (-घ्नी) The raisin, dried-grape.  E. यक्ष्म consumption, घ्न destroyer.
32351: यक्ष्मन् m. (-क्ष्मा) Pulmonary consumption.  E. यक्ष् to worship, and मनिन् Unādi aff.; also with मन् aff., यक्ष्म m. (-क्ष्मः).
32352: यक्ष्मिन् f. (-क्ष्मिणी) One who suffers from consumption.
32353: यक्ष्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Proposing or wishing to worship.  E. यक्ष् to worship, desid. v., शानच् aff.
32354: यङ्न्त m. (-न्तः) The frequentative deponent verb, (in gram.)  E. यङ्, अन्त termination.
32355: यङ्लुगन्त m. (-न्तः) The frequentative active verb.  E. यङ्, लुक् dropped, and अन्त termination.
32356: यज् r. 1st. cl. (यजति-ते) 	 1. To worship a deity. 	 2. To associate with. 	 3. To present or endow.
32357: यजत् mfn. (-जन्-जन्ती-जत्) Sacrificing, worshipping. E.  E. यज् to wor-ship, शतृ aff.
32358: यजत m. (-तः) The officiating priest at a sacrifice.  E. यज् to worship, अतच् aff.
32359: यजति m. (-तिः) A term for those sacrifices to which the verb यजति is applied, as distinguished from those rites to which the verb जुहोति applies. Sarvajnya-Nārāyana renders जुहोति by उपविष्टहोम and यजति by तिष्ठद्धोम्  E. यज-अतिच ।
32360: यजत्र m. (-त्रः) A Brāhamana who has maintained his consecrated fire. E. यज् to sacrifice, अत्रन् Unādi aff.
32361: यजन n. (-नं) Offering sacrifices, performing worship.  E. यज् to worship, ल्युट् aff.
32362: यजन्त m. (-न्तः) A sacrificer, a worshipper.  E. यज् to sacrifice, aff. झच्.
32363: यजमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Worshipping. 	 m. (-नः) 	 1. An employer of priests at sacrifice, the person who institutes its performance, and pays the expence of it. 	 2. A patron, a host.  E. यज् to worship, शानच् aff. of the present participle, with मक् augment.
32364: यजाक m. (-कः) A donor, a benefactor, a liberal giver of presents, &c. E. यज् to present, Unādi aff. आकन् ।
32365: यजि m. (-जिः) A sacrificer, one who institutes or performs a sacrifice. E. यज् to sacrifice, aff. इन् ।
32366: यजुर्वेद n. (-दं) The Yajur-Veda: see the next.  E. यजुस्, वेद a Veda.
32367: यजुस् n. (-जुः) The Yajur or Yajush, one of the four Vedas; it is di-vided into two principal portions, the white and black, or Vāja-saneyi and Taittirīya, the former of which is attributed to the saint YĀJNAWALKYA, to whom it was revealed by the sun, in the form of a horse; and the latter to TAITTIRI, to whom it was communicated by YĀSKA, the first pupil of its original author, the sage VAIŚAMPĀYANA: according to the Purāṇas the Taittirīya portion was named from Tittiri a partridge; the disciples of VAIŚAMPĀYANA being changed into those birds, to pick up the texts of the Veda as they were disgorged in a tangible shape by YĀJNAWALKYA, at the command of VAIŚAM-PĀYANA: both portions of this Veda are very full on the sub-ject of religious rites, and the prayers peculiar to it, are chiefly in measured and poetical prose.  E. यज् to worship, Unādi aff. उसि ।
32368: यज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A sacrifice, a ceremony in which oblations are presented. E. यज् to worship, aff. नङ् ।
32369: यज्ञकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Any sacrificial act of ceremony.  E. यज्ञ, and कर्म्मन् act.
32370: यज्ञकल्प Adj. Of the nature of a sacrifice.
32371: यज्ञकीलक m. (-कः) The post to which the victim is fastened at a sacri-fice.
32372: यज्ञकुण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A hole in the ground built for receiving the sacrificial fire.
32373: यज्ञकृत् m. (-कृत्) A sacrificer, a worshipper, or priest conducting a sacrifice.  E. यज्ञ sacrifice, कृत् who makes.
32374: यज्ञक्रतु m. (-तुः) 	 1. A complete rite. 	 2. VISHṆU.
32375: यज्ञद्रुह् m. (-ध्रुक्) A Rākshasa, an imp.  E. यज्ञ, द्रुह् to wrong, क्विप् aff.
32376: यज्ञपशु m. (-शुः) 	 1. A horse. 	 2. Any animal offered in sacrifice.  E. यज्ञ a sacrifice, and पशु an animal.
32377: यज्ञपात्र n. (-त्रं) A sacrificial vessel.  E. यज्ञ, and पात्र a vessel.
32378: यज्ञपुरुष m. (-षः) A name of VISHṆU.  E. यज्ञ sacrifice, पुरुष man or male.
32379: यज्ञभाजन n. (-नं) A sacrificial vessel.  E. यज्ञ sacrifice, and भाजन vessel.
32380: यज्ञभूमि f. (-मिः) Place prepared for a sacrifice, or where it is offered. E. यज्ञ, and भूमि land.
32381: यज्ञवराह m. (-हः) VISHṆU in his boar-incarnation.  E. यज्ञ, and वराह the boar.
32382: यज्ञवल्लि f. (-ल्लिः-ल्ली) The Soma plant; also यज्ञश्रेष्ठा ।
32383: यज्ञवाट m. (-टः) A place prepared and enclosed for a sacrifice.  E. यज्ञ a sacrifice, वाट inclosure.
32385: यज्ञवेदि f. (-दिः or दी) A sacrificial altar.
32386: यज्ञशरण n. (-णं) A building or a temporary structure under which a sacrifice is performed.
32387: यज्ञशिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) What is left from a sacrifice or oblation. E. यज्ञ, शिष्ट remainder.
32388: यज्ञशेष m. (-षः) The relics of a sacrifice or oblation.  E. यज्ञ, शेष remainder.
32389: यज्ञसदस् n. (-दः) An assembly of people at a sacrifice.
32390: यज्ञसार m. (-रः) The glomerous fig-tree, (Ficus glomerata, Rox.) E. यज्ञ sacrifice, सार essence. “यज्ञोडुम्बर वृक्षे ।”
32391: यज्ञसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) 	 1. Performance of sacrifice. 	 2. Obtaining the objects of a sacrifice.  E. यज्ञ, and सिद्धि accomplishment.
32392: यज्ञसूत्र n. (-त्रं) The characteristic thread, worn by the three principal classes of Hindus.  E. यज्ञ sacrifice, and सूत्र thread.
32393: यज्ञस्थान n. (-नं) A place of sacrifice.  E. यज्ञ and स्थान place.
32394: यज्ञाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. The glomerous fig, (Ficus glomerata, Rox.) 	 2. A plant, (Siphonanthus Indica.) 	 3. A part of any sacrificial cere-mony.  E. यज्ञ a sacrifice, अङ्ग a member.
32395: यज्ञान्त m. (-न्तः) A supplementary sacrifice.  E. यज्ञ the principal, अन्त end, finish.
32396: यज्ञारि m. (-रिः) 	 1. A name of ŚIVA. 	 2. A demon, a goblin.  E. यज्ञ a sacrifice, अरि enemy.
32397: यज्ञिक m. (-कः) The Palāsh tree, (Butea frondosa.)  E. यज्ञ, ठन् aff.
32398: यज्ञिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. Proper for or suitable to a sacrifice. 	 2. Pious. 3. Sacred. 	 m. (-यः) 	 1. The third Yuga or Dwāpara age. 	 2. A god, a deity.  E. यज्ञ sacrifice, and घ aff.
32399: यज्ञियदेश f. (-शः) The country of Hindus; those districts in which the ritual and institutes of the Hindu system are enforced; properly the country in which the black deer or antelope is native. E. यज्ञिय sacrificial, and देश a country.
32400: यज्ञियशाला f. (-ला) A temple, a shrine, a place of sacrifice.  E. यज्ञिय to be sacrificed, (where,) शाला hall.
32402: यज्ञोडुम्बर m. (-रः) The glomerous fig-tree, (Ficus glomerata, Rox.) E. यज्ञ sacrifice, उडुम्बर the same.
32403: यज्ञोपकरण n. (-णं) Any utensil or implement necessary for a sacrifice.
32404: यज्ञोपवीत n. (-तं) The sacrificial cord, originally worn by the three principal casts of Hindus: at present from the loss of the pure Kshetriya and Vaiśya casts in Bengal, confined to the Brāh-minical order.  E. यज्ञ sacrifice, उपवीत thread.
32405: यज्ञोपवीतिन् m. (-ती) A Brāhmana, &c. invested with the sacred thread. E. यज्ञोपवीत, इनि aff.
32406: यज्यु m. (-ज्युः) A Brāhmana, conversant with the Yajur-Veda.  E. यज् to worship, Unādi aff. युच् ।
32407: यज्वन् m. (-ज्वा) 	 1. A sacrificer in due form, or agreeably to the ritual of the Vedas. 	 2. VISHṆU. 	 f. (-ज्वरी) Sacrificing, worshipping. E. यज् to worship, वनिप् aff.
32408: यज्वनापति m. (-तिः) The moon.  E. यज्वन् a sacrificer in the sixth case plural, पति master.
32409: यत् (ई) यती r. 1st cl. (यतते) To resolve or determine in consequence of a wish or desire, to apply or endeavour strenuously, to energize, to persevere. r. 10 cl. (यातयति-ते) 	 1. To distress or afflict. 	 2. To beat. 	 3. To order. 	 4. To collect, to assemble. 	 5. To work, to make or manufacture. 	 6. To prevent, to remove. 	 7. To return, to give back, to requite. 	 8. To barter or exchange. 	 9. To purify. 	 10. To encourage. With निर or वि prefixed, To chastise, to punish, to inflict pain. With निस् or प्रति, 1. To restore. 	 2. To requite.
32410: यत् Ind. Because as, since, wherefore, correlative of तत् thence, there-fore, &c.  E. यत् to check, to restrain, क्विप् and तुक् affs.
32411: यत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Governed, controlled. 	 2. Limited, restrained. 	 n. (-तं) The stirring of an elephant by means of the rider's feet. E. यम् to check, क्त aff.
32412: यतचित्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Resigned, subdued, one of well-governed thoughts or feelings.  E. यत and चित्त the mind.
32413: यतचित्तात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Having power over the soul and spirit, of subdued mind.  E. यतचित्त, आत्मन् self.
32414: यतत् mfn. (-तन्-तन्ती-तत्) Striving, making effort.  E. यत् to make effort, शतृ aff.
32415: यतन n. (-नं) Making effort or exertion.  E. यत् to make effort, ल्युट् aff.
32416: यतनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be exerted, or persevered, to be made as an effort.  E. यत् to make effort, अनीयर् aff.
32417: यतम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Which, (of many.)  E. यद् which, डतमच् aff.
32418: यतमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Making effort, striving, struggling, persevering. E. यत् to strive, शानच् aff.
32419: यतमैथुन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Disinclined to sexual intercourse, abstaining from it.  E. यत, and मैथुन coition.
32420: यतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रत्) Which, (of two), whether.  E. यद् which, डतरच् aff.
32421: यतव्रत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Firm to an engagement or vow.  E. यत, व्रत a vow.
32422: यतस् Ind. Because, as, since, whence: see यत्  E. यद् which, what, and तसिल् substituted for the termination of the 5th case.
32423: यतस्ततस् Ind. 	 1. From any place whatsoever. 	 2. From any person.
32424: यतात्मत् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Of subdued or well-governed spirit.  E. यत, आत्मन् self.
32425: यतात्मवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Self-subdued, having the mind and all its powers in subjection.  E. यतात्म, and मतुप् aff.
32426: यताहार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Temperate, abstemious.  E. यत, and आहार food.
32427: यति Pron. How many, as many, (declined only in the plural, nomi-native and accusative यति).
32428: यति m. (-तिः) 	 1. A sage, whose passions are completely under subjec-tion. 	 2. A religious mendicant, especially one of the Jaina sect. 	 3. Stopping, ceasing, rest, term. 	 4. Restraining, controlling, cheek-ing. 	 f. (-तिः) 	 1. A pause in poetry or metre, a stop, a rest. 	 2. Uni-on, joining. 	 3. Restraint, check. 	 4. Guidance.  E. यत् endeavour, &c., aff. इन्; or यम् to restrain, aff. क्तिन् ।
32429: यतित f. (-ता) Adj. Attempted, striven after.
32430: यतिन् m. (-ती) A sage with subdued passions. 	 f. (-नी) A widow.  E. यत restraining, from यम् with क्त aff. and इनि added.
32431: यतिपात्र n. (-त्रं) A vessel for collecting alms, made of wood, or a hol-low bamboo, an earthen bowl, or a gourd.  E. यति and पात्र a vessel.
32432: यतिमैथुन n. (-नं) The copulation or cohabitation of holy personages. E. यति as above, and सैथुन coition.
32433: यतु(तू)का f. (-का) A plant, Chakāwat commonly. “वेतोशाक ।”
32434: यतीन्द्रय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Chaste, pure, of subdued passions.  E. यत, इन्द्रिय an organ of sense.
32435: यतेन्द्रिय Adj. 	 m. (-यः) Of subdued passions, pious, pure.
32436: यतोयतस् Ind. 	 1. From whatever place. 	 2. Wherever.
32437: यत्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Doing what.  E. यत् and कृ to do, अच् aff.
32438: यत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Striven, resolved, exerted.  E. यत् to resolve, क्त aff.
32439: यत्न m. (-त्नः) Effort, exertion, perseverance, energy.  E. यत् to endea-vour strenuously or continuously, aff. नङ् ।
32440: यत्नतस् Ind. Vigorously, strenuously.  E. यत्न and तसि aff.
32441: यत्नवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Persevering, diligent, making effort or exer-tion.  E. यत्न effort, मतुप् aff.
32442: यत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) To be exerted or made as an effort.  E. यत् to exert, यत् aff.
32443: यत्न Ind. 	 1. Where, in what place. 	 2. When. 	 3. Because, since, as that.  E. यद् what, and त्रल् aff.
32444: यत्र् (इ) यत्रि r. 1st and 10th cls. (यन्त्रति-ते यन्त्रयति-ते) To confine, to res-train, to subdue or regulate: the root may also be written यन्त्र ।
32445: यथा Ind. As, according to; correlative to तथा so: it is also commonly used in composition to form adverbs; as यथाकालं seasonably, यथा-क्रमं regularly, यथान्यायं fitly, suitably, यथाशास्त्रं according to scrip-ture, &c.  E. यद् what, थाल् aff.
32446: यथांशतस् Ind. Proportionably, in due proportion.  E. यथा as, according to, अंश part, तसि aff.
32447: यथाकथा Ind. As much as, tantum quantum; it is especially used as a term of disrespect.  E. यथा as, and कथा how.
32448: यथाकथाच Ind. Rarely, unfrequently, seldomer than proper.  E. यथा as much, कथा how much, with च the particle aff.
32449: यथाकर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) What is right or proper to be done.  E. यथा कर्त्तव्य to be done.
32450: यथाकर्म Ind. According to action, duties or circumstances.
32451: यथाकल्प Adv. 	 n. (-ल्पं) As designed.  E. यथा and कल्प making.
32452: यथाकाम Adv. 	 n. (-म) At pleasure, as you please.  E. यथा, and काम desire.
32453: यथाकामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Wilful, independent, uncontrolled, follow-ing one's own inclinations.  E. यथा as, according to, काम desire, इनि aff.
32454: यथाकालम् Ind. At the right moment.
32456: यथाक्रम Adv. 	 n. (-मं) In order, orderly, successively, methodically. E. यथा agreeably to, क्रम order.
32458: यथागत Adv. 	 n. (-तं) Applied to a person's being sent away or returning as he came.  E. यथा and गत gone.
32459: यथाजात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Foolish, stupid, a fool, a natural. 	 2. Bar-barous, outcast.  E. यथा as, जात born, as simple as at birth.
32460: यथाज्ञानम् Ind. To the best of one's knowledge.
32461: यथातथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Right, true Ind. or adv. 	 n. (-थं) 	 1. Properly, suitably. 	 2. Precisely, exactly. Noun. (-थः) Narrative of events, history.  E. यथा as, and तथा so, with the termination of the neuter gender.
32462: यथातथा Adv. In any way, any how.  E. यथा and तथा, &c.
32463: यथापूर्व्व n. Adv. (-र्व्वं) 	 1. In order or succession. 	 2. Formerly, pre-cedingly, in prior time or place.  E. यथा as, पूर्व्व formerly, before.
32464: यथाप्राणम् Ind. With all one's might.
32465: यथाभागम् Ind. 	 1. According to share. 	 2. Each in his respective place.
32466: यथाभिमतम् Ind. According to one's wish or purpose.  E. यथा, and अभिमत purposed.
32468: यथामुखीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Like, resembling, shewing, similarly or reflecting. 	 2. Looking strait at, (with a genitive.)  E. यथा as, मुख the countenance, and ख aff.
32469: यथायथम् Ind. 	 1. As, thereto, appertaining. 	 2. Rightly.  E. यथा repeated, with the termination of the neuter gender.
32470: यथार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 	 1. Right, proper. 	 2. According to the sense. 	 n. Adv. or ind. (-र्थं) Properly, suitably.  E. यथा as, अर्थ property.
32471: यथार्थता f. (-ता) Rectitude, propriety; fitness.  E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, यथार्थत्वं ।
32472: यथार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) Proper, suitable, appropriate. 	 n. adv. or ind. (-र्हं) Properly, suitably.  E. यथा as, अर्ह properly.
32473: यथार्हतस् Adv. Properly, fitly.  E. यथार्ह and तसि aff.
32474: यथार्हवर्ण m. (-र्णः) A spy, a secret emissary.  E. यथार्ह properly, suitably, वर्ण form, colour.
32475: यथावकाश Adv. 	 n. or ind. (-शं) 	 1. According to opportunity. 	 2. In the proper place.  E. यथा, and अवकाश season.
32476: यथावत् Ind. 	 1. Truly, exactly, as it was, according to law or usage. 	 2. accordingly, conformably.  E. यथा and वत्रि aff.
32477: यथावसर Adv. 	 n. or ind. (-रं) According to opportunity.  E. यथा and अवसर opportunity.

A festival. 	 8. A crow. 	 9. A name of the planet SATURN. 	 10. YAMA, the deity of Naraka or hell, where his capital is placed, in which he sits in judgment on the dead, and distributes rewards and punishments, sending the good to Swarga, and the wicked to the division of Naraka or Tartarus appropriated to their crimes: he corresponds with the Grecian god PLUTO, and the judge of hell MINOS, and in Hindu mythology often identified with Death and Time: he is the son of SŪRYA, or the sun, and brother of the personified YA-MUNĀ or Jamunā river. 	 n. 32548: ययाति m. (-तिः) A monarch of India the fifth of the lunar race and son of NAHUSA. At first he married Devajāni, the only child of SŪKRA, the preceptor of the demons and subsequently ŚARMISHṬHĀ the daughter of VRISHAPARVAN, who was ordered by her father to attend on Devajāni as a servant, as a punishment for her throwing her in a well. For his marrying and making love to ŚARMISHṬHĀ Yajāti became old and infirm before his time through the curse of SUKRA, but having appeased his father-in-law obtained permission to transfer his decrepitude to any one who would consent to take it. Out of his five sons PURU complied with his father's wishes. The King being endowed with renovated youth, passed his time in the enjoyment of pleasures for a full thousand years, and after which he restored his youth to PURU and resuming his own de-crepitude departed to the wood of penance.  E. यस्य वायोरिव याति-सर्वत्र रथगतिरस्य ।

32699: यावन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Belonging or relating to a Yavana, Ionian, &c. 	 m. (-नः) Incense.  E. यवन the country of the Yavanas, अण् aff.
32700: यावनाल m. (-लः) A kind of grain, (Zea mays.) “जनार”. 	 f. (-ली) Sugar prepared from Zea mays.  E. यवनाल, अण् pleonasm.
32701: यावशूक m. (-कः) Nitre, salt-petre.  E. यव barley, शूक the spike, अण् aff.
32702: यावस m. (-सः) A quantity or heap of grass.  E. यु to mix, Unādi aff. असच् with the effect of णित्, which makes the vowel long.
32703: याव्य mfn. (-व्या-व्या-व्यं) To be mixed or joined, miscible.  E. यु to join or mix, aff. ण्यत् ।
32704: याशोधरेय m. (-यः) The son of ŚĀKYAMUNI, the probable founder of the Bauddha sect.
32705: याष्टीक m. (-कः) A warrior armed with a club.  E. यष्टि a stick, a club, ठक् aff., and both vowels made long; or यष्टिः-ईकक् ।
32706: यास m. (-सः) 	 1. A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi) “दुरालभायाम्”. 	 2. Effort. 	 f. (-सा) A sort of bird, the Sālika.  E. यस् to endeavour, aff. घञ् ।
32707: यास्क m. (-स्कः) Name of the author of NIRUKTA.
32708: यास्यत् mfn. (-स्यन्-स्यती-स्यत्) Going, who or what will be going.  E. या to go, शतृ aff. with the future tense.
32709: यियक्षमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Purposing or wishing to worship.  E. यज् to worship, desid. v., शानच् aff.
32710: यियक्षु mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु) Desirous of sacrificing.  E. यज् to worship, desid. v., उ aff.
32711: यियविषा f. (-षा) Wish to mix, blend, &c.  E. यु to mix, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् affs.
32712: यियविषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to mix or blend.  E. यु to mix, desid. v., उ aff.
32713: यु r. 2nd cl. (योति) 	 1. To mix, to join, to blend. 	 2. To separate or not mix. r. 10th cl. (यावयते) To censure, to blame, to disrespect, to despise. (ञ) युञ् r. 9th cl. (युनाति युनीते) To bind, to tie.
32715: युक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 	 1. Joined, combined, united, identified. 	 2. Right, fit, proper. 	 3. Proved, concluded by inference or argument. 	 4. Mo-derate, limited. 	 5. Possessing, endowed with, as virtues, qualities, &c. 	 6. Intent on, attached to, as a study or pursuit. 	 7. Employed or engaged in business, &c. 	 8. Occupied in performance of the reli-gious exercise called Yoga. 	 m. (-क्तः) The sage who has acquired the command of his feelings and passions, and who performs the cus-tomary devotional offices without any regard to their result. 	 n. (-क्तं) 	 1. A measure of four cubits. 	 2. A team, a yoke. 	 f. (-क्ता) A plant, commonly Elāni.  E. युज् to join or mix, aff. क्त ।
32716: युक्तरसा f. (-सा) A plant, commonly Elāni, (Mimosa octandra.)  E. युक्त mixed, joined, रस juice.
32717: युक्तायस् n. (-यः) A sort of wooden spade or shovel.  E. युक्त bound, joined, अयस् iron.
32718: युक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 	 1. Union, connection, joining. 	 2. Propriety, fitness. 	 3. Usage, custom, traditionary and unwritten law. 	 4. Inference, de-duction from circumstance or argument, the reason of a thing or argument. 	 5. Insertion of circumstances in written evidence, specification in writting of place, time, &c., considered as one of the means of verifying such evidence. 	 6. A figure of rhetoric, emble-matic or mystical expression of purpose, so as to conceal it form all but its immediate object. 	 7. Supplying an ellipsis. 	 8. Connec-tion of dramatic events, the production of one incident by ano-ther. 	 9. Alloying of metals.  E. युज् to join, &c., aff. क्तिन् ।
32720: युक्तियुक्त Adj. 	 1. Expert. 	 2. Suitable, fit. 	 3. Proved.
32721: युग् (इ) युगि r. 1st cl. (युङ्गति) To except, to abandon.
32722: युग n. (-गं) 	 1. A pair, a couple, a brace. 	 2. An age, as the Śatya or Krita, Tretā, Dwāpara, and Kali. 	 3. A lustre, or period of five years. 	 m. (-गः) 	 1. A yoke. 	 2. A measure of four cubits. 	 3. An ex-pression for the numbers “four and “twelve”. 	 4. Life, birth. 	 5. A drug, commonly Riddhi.  E. युज् to join, aff. अच, the final changed.
32723: युगकीलक m. (-कः) The pin of a yoke.  E. युग a yoke, कील a pin, कन् added.
32724: युगक्षय m. (-यः) Destruction of the world.  E. युग and क्षय destruction.
32725: युगन्धर mn. (-रः-रं) 	 1. The pole of a carriage, or wood to which the yoke is fixed. 	 2. The name of a mountain.  E. युग a yoke, धृ to hold or support, खच् aff.
32726: युगपत् Ind. 	 1. At one time, at once. 	 2. Together, conjointly.  E. यु to join, गपतक aff.
32727: युगप(पा)त्र m. (-त्रः) 	 1. A sort of ebony. 	 2. The Ashmantā a tree. 	 3. The Lodh or Lodhra tree, (symplocos racemosa.): see the next.
32728: युगपत्रक m. (-कः) Mountain-ebony, (Bauhinia variegata.) “रक्त्रकाञ्चनार-वृक्षे”. 	 f. (-त्रिका) 	 1. The Sishu-tree, (Dalbergia Sishu.) “शिंशपावृक्षे.” 2. The Sarsapa-tree, (sinapis dichotoma.)  E. युग a pair, पत्र a leaf, aff. कन्, double-leaved.
32729: युगपार्श्वग m. (-गः) A young ox in training.  E. युग a yoke, पार्श्व a side, and ग who goes, or with कन् aff. युगपार्श्वक m. (-कः) ।
32730: युगल n. (-लं) A pair, a brace, a couple.  E. युग a pair, लच् aff.
32731: युगलक n. (-कं) 	 1. A hair. 	 2. Two verses forming one sentence.
32732: युगांशक m. (-कः) A year.  E. युग an age, and अंशक a part.
32733: युगान्त m. (-न्तः) 	 1. A destruction of the universe. 	 2. The end of an age. 3. Mid-day, noon. 	 4. The end of a yoke.  E. युग an age, either ge-nerally or individually, and अन्त end.
32734: युगान्तबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) A real friend, a friend in need.  E. युगान्त, बन्धु a friend.
32735: युग्म n. (-ग्मं) 	 1. A pair, a couple, a brace. 	 2. A twin. 	 3. Mixing, unit-ing. 	 4. A couple of verses. 	 5. The sign Gemini of the Zodiac. 	 f. (-ग्मा) Even.  E. युज् to join, Unādi aff. मक्, the final changed to ग.
32736: युग्मक n. (-कं) 	 1. A couple. 	 2. A couple of verses connected by the con-struction of the sentence, the sense being completed only by the two together.  E. कन् added to the last.
32737: युग्मपत्र m. (-त्रः) 	 1. A tree, (Alstonia scholaris. Syn. Echites scholaris.) 2. The Sishu-tree. 	 3. The Rakta-Kānchana tree, (Bauhinia varie-gata.) 	 4. The Bhūrja-patra tree.  E. युग्म a couple, and पत्र a leaf, doble-leaved: see युगपत्रक ।
32738: युग्मपत्रिका f. (-का) A timber-tree, (Dalbergia Sisu.): see the last.
32740: युग्य mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) Fit or proper to be yoked or harnessed. 	 n. (-ग्यं) Any vehicle or conveyance. 	 m. (-ग्यः) An animal yoked, a carriage-horse.  E. युज् to join, aff. यत् or क्यप्; जस्य ग ।
32741: युच्छ् r. 1st cl. (युच्छति) To be inattentive or negligent, to err or mistake.
32742: युज् (औ) युजी r. 4th cl. (युज्यते) 	 1. To confine the thoughts, to keep the mind fixed in abstract meditation. 	 2. To be fit. 	 3. To be right. r. 1st and 10th cls. (योजति योजयति-ते) 	 1. To bind, to tie, to connect. 2. To yoke. 	 3. To instigate. 	 4. To oblige. 	 5. To put to. With नि, To yoke. With सम, To unite. (योजयते) To blame. (औ इर्,) औ युजिर् r. 7th cl. (युनक्ति युङ्क्ते) 	 1. To join, to mix, to unite, &c. 	 2. To apply, to use. 	 3. To prepare, to make ready. 	 4. To meditate. 	 5. To grant to endow. 	 6. To design, to intend, &c. With अनु prefixed, 1. To ask, to inquire. 	 2. To reprove. With अभि, 1. To utter, to speak. 	 2. To accuse. 	 3. To claim. With उत्, 1. To make effort. 	 2. To prepare. With उप, 1. To seize, to take, to lay hold of. 	 2. To eat. 	 3. To use. With नि, 1. To order, to appoint, (with a loc.) 	 2. To join. With प्र 1. To be fit or due. 	 2. To attach or apply to. 	 3. To lend money. 4. To make effort. 	 5. To combine or connect. 	 6. To give. 	 7. To move. 	 8. To perform on the stage. With वि, 1. To separate, to sunder. 	 2. To send. 	 3. To leave, to abandon. With वि and नि, 1. To appoint or employ. 	 2. To expend. 	 3. To send. 	 4. To involve in or force upon. With वि and प्र, To separate, to part, to divide. With सम्, To unite, to combine. With सम् and आङ्, To think profoundly.
32743: युज् n. (युक्) A pair, a couple. 	 m. (-युक्-युग्) A sage, one who devotes his time to abstract contemplation. Dual. (-जौ) The twin-sons of AŚHWINĪ, and physicians of Swarga. 	 m. (-युङ्) A joiner, one who joins, or unites. 	 f. (-युक्) A measure of three hundred poles.  E. युज् to join to meditate, &c., aff. क्विप्; also युजिर् the same, with the same aff., when न is inserted after the vowel, before the first five affixes in the masculine and feminine genders.
32744: युञ्जत् mfn. (-ञ्जन्-ञ्जन्ती-ञ्जत्) 	 1. Uniting, Joining. 	 2. Uniting spiritually, practising devotion.  E. युज् to join, &c., शतृ aff.
32745: युञ्जान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Uniting, combining, joining with. 	 m. (-नः) 	 1. A charioteer. 	 2. A Brāhmana engaged in the religious exercise called Yoga.  E. युज् to join, &c., aff. शानच् and नुम् inserted.
32746: युत् (ऋ) युतृ r. 1st cl. (योतते) To shine.
32748: युत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Joined, combined, connected, identified. 	 2. Atta-ched to, engaged in or by. 	 3. Endowed with, possessed of. 	 4. Sepa-rated. 	 n. (-तं) A measure of four cubits.  E. यु to join, &c., aff. क्त ।
32749: युतक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Joined, combined. 	 n. (-कं) 	 1. Doubt, uncertainty. 2. A pair, a brace. 	 3. Nuptial presents. 	 4. The end of a cloth worn by women. 	 5. A garment worn by women; it is applied, both to the petti-coat and the upper wrapper or cloth. 	 6. The ends of a cloth. 	 7. The edge of a winnowing basket. 	 8. Asylum. 9. Forbearance, cessation. 	 10. Alliance, acquaintance, forming an alliance, friendship.  E. युत joined, &c., कन् added.
32750: युति f. (-तिः) 	 1. Joining, uniting. 	 2. Obtaining possession of. 	 3. A con-junction, (in astro.) 	 4. (In arith.) Addition.  E. यु to join, क्तिन् aff.
32751: युद्ध n. (-द्धं) 	 1. War, battle, contest. 	 2. Conflict of the planets, (in as-tronomy.)  E. युध् to fight, aff. क्त ।
32752: युद्धरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. KĀRTIKEYA. 	 2. A battle-arena.  E. युद्ध war, and रङ्ग delight.
32753: युद्धवीर m. (-रः) 	 1. A warrior. 	 2. A warlike hero in a poem. 	 3. The sentiment of heroism.
32754: युद्धसार m. (-रः) A horse.  E. युद्ध war, सृ to go, aff. घञ् ।
32755: युद्धोन्मत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Fierce or frantic in battle.  E. युद्ध, उन्मत्त frantic.
32756: युध् (औ) औयुध् r. 4th cl. (युध्यते) To fight, to contend in battle, to slay.
32757: युध् f. (युत् or युद्) War, battle.  E. युध् to fight, aff. क्विप् or टाप् also युध्य.
32758: युधान m. (-नः) A man of the second or military order, a warrior.  E. युध् to fight, Unādi aff. आनच्, and the radical vowel unchanged.
32759: युधिष्ठिर m. (-रः) The elder of the five Pāṇḍava princes, and leader in the great war, between them and the Kurus, in the beginning of the fourth age; the nominal son of PĀṆḌU whom he succeeded in the sovereignty of India, but according to the legend, begotten on Kunti by the deity YAMA.  E. युधि in war or battle, and ष्ठिर for स्थिर firm; it is also sometimes read युद्धस्थिर ।
32760: युध्म m. (-ध्मः) 	 1. War, battle. 	 2. A bow. 	 3. An arrow. 	 4. A warrior, a combatant.  E. युध् to fight, मक् Unādi aff.
32761: युध्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fighting, warring.  E. युध् to fight, शानच् aff.
32762: युप् (इर्) युपीर r. 4th cl. (युप्यति) To confuse, to perplex. 	 2. To trouble. 3. To efface.
32764: युयुक्खुर m. (-रः) A hyena.  E. युयुक् joined, खुर a hoof.
32765: युयुक्षमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Wishing to join or unite. 	 2. Devout, wish-ing to effect spiritual union with the divine essence.  E. युज् to be devout or to join, desid. v., शानच् aff.
32766: युयुत्सा f. (-त्सा) Wish or purpose to fight, enmity, pugnacity.  E. युध् to fight, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् affs.
32767: युयुत्सारहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cowardly, having no intention to fight.  E. युयुत्सा, रहित void of.
32768: युयुत्सु mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु) Wishing or ready to make war or fight, pug-nacious, hostile, ambitious. 	 m. (-त्सुः) A combatant.  E. युध् to make war, desid. v., उ aff.
32769: युयुधान m. (-नः) 	 1. A proper name, one of the chiefs of the Pāṇḍus. 	 2. A warrior.  E. युध् to fight, in the reduplicate form, कानच् aff.
32770: युवखलति mfn. (-तिः-तिः or ती-ति) Bald in youth.  E. युवन् and खलति bald; also युवाखलति, and fem. युवतिःखलति ।
32771: युवगण्ड m. (-ण्डः) Eruptions on the face peculiar to youth.  E. युव a young person, from युवन्, and गण्ड what affects the cheek.
32772: युवजरत् mfn. (-रन्-रती-रत्) Being old as it were in youth, old-fashioned, or prematurely infirm.  E. युवन्, and जरत् old; also युवाजरत् and in the fem. युवतिःजरती ।
32773: युवजानि m. (-निः) Having a young wife.  E. युव, and जानि wife.
32774: युवति f. (-तिः or ती) A young woman.
32775: युवन् mfn. (युवा युवतिः or -ती or यूनी-युव) 	 1. Young. 	 2. Best, excellent. 	 3. Endowed with native or natural strength. 	 m. (Nom. -युवा-वानी-वानः acc. plu. युनः) 	 1. A younger descendant, the elder being alive. 	 m. (-वा) A young man or one of the virile age, or from sixteen to seventy. 	 f. (-तिः-ती or यूनी) A young woman, one from sixteen to thirty. 	 f. (-तिः) Turmeric.  E. यु to mix or associate, Unādi aff. क्वनिन्, the fem. form takes ति, and optionally adds ङीष् in one form, with which affix the semi-vowel व is changed to its con-gener उ, and the two short vowels coalesce into one long one, making यूनी.
32776: युवनाश्वज m. (-जः) A name of MĀNDHĀTṚ, an early sovereign of the Solar dynasty.  E. युवनाश्व his father, who appears as the eighth monarch of the Solar line, and ज born.
32777: युवपलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Grey-haired in youth.  E. युवन्, and पलित grey-haired; also युवापलित, and fem. युवतिःपलिता ।
32778: युवराज m. (-जः) 	 1. A young prince, especially the heir apparent, asso-ciated to the throne. 	 2. One of the Jaina pontiffs.  E. युव young, राजन् a prince, टच् aff.
32779: युवराज्य n. (-ज्यं) The dignity of heir apparent and associate in the throne.  E. युवराज, and यत् aff.
32780: युष्मद् 2nd personal pronoun. 	 mfn. (-त्वं) Thou.  E. युष a Sautra root, to serve, to worship, Unādi aff. मदिक्.
32781: युष्मद्वाच्य n. (-च्यं) (In gram.) The second person.  E. युष्मद्, and बाच्य to be said.
32782: यू f. (-यूः) The water in which pulse, &c. has been boiled, pease-soup, &c.  E. यु to mix, aff. क्किप्, and vowel made long.
32783: यूक mf. (-कः-का) A louse.  E. यु to mix, (with the hair,) Unādi aff. कन्, and the vowel made long.
32784: यूति f. (-तिः) Joining, mixing.  E. यु to join, aff. क्तिच्, and the vowel made long.
32785: यूथ n. (-थं) A multitude of birds or beasts, a herd, a flock. 	 f. (-थी) A kind of jasmine, (Jasminum auriculatum.)  E. यु to mix, थक् Unādi aff., and the vowel made long.
32786: यूथनाथ m. (-थः) A large elephant, the leader of a wild herd.  E. यूथ a multitude, (of elephants,) and नाथ lord.
32787: यूथप m. (-पः) The leader of a wild herd of elephants.  E. यूथ a herd, and प who protects: see the last.
32788: यूथभ्रष्ट m. (-ष्टः) An elephant turned out or driven from a herd.  E. यूथ a herd, भ्रष्ट expelled.
32789: यूथशस् Adv. Gregariously, in flocks.  E. यूथ and शसि aff.
32790: यूथिका f. (-का) 	 1. A sort of jasmine, (Jasminum auriculatum.) 	 2. Globe amaranth.  E. यूथी the jasmine, कन् aff., fem. form.
32791: यूनि f. (-निः) Joining, union, junction.  E. यु to join or mix, aff. क्तिन्, न substituted for the final, and the vowel made long.
32792: यूप mn. (-पः-पं) 	 1. A sacrificial post, a pillar usually made of bamboos, or the wood of the Khadira, to which the victim at a sacrifice is bound. 	 2. A trophy, a column erected in honour of a victory. E. यु to bind, (the victim,) प Unādi aff.
32793: यूपकटक m. (-कः) A wooden ring on the top of a sacrificial post, or according to some authorities, an iron ring at its base.  E. यूप the post, and कटक a ring, &c.
32794: यूपकर्ण m. (-र्णः) A part of a sacrificial post sprinkled with ghee.  E. यूप the post, कर्ण the ear.
32795: यूपद्रु m. (-द्रुः) The Khayar, (Mimosa catechu.)  E. यूप a sacrificial post, and द्रु a tree; the wood of this tree being especially fit for the sacrificial post; also यूपद्रुम m. (-मः) । “रक्तखदिरे ।”
32796: यूपलक्ष्य m. (-क्ष्यः) A bird.  E. यूप a sacrificial post, put for any post, and लक्ष्य an aim; a sort of net being made about a post, on which birds may alight.
32797: यूपाग्र m. (-ग्रः) The top of the sacrificial post.  E. यूप as above, अग्र top.
32798: यूपोच्छ्रय m. (-यः) The ceremony of erecting the sacrificial post.  E. यूप a sacrificial post, and उच्छ्रय elevation.
32799: यूष् r. 1st cl. (यूषति) To hurt, to injure, to wound or kill.

32805: योग m. (-गः) 	 1. Junction, joining, union. 	 2. Combination, association, meeting, conflux. 	 3. Religious and abstract meditation. 	 4. Keep-ing the body in a fixed posture. 	 5. Devotion, spiritual worship of GOD, or union with the Supreme Being by means of abstract contemplation; this does not necessarily imply an abandonment of the world or relinquishment of the usual observances of re-ligion, but it involves internal indifference to objects of pleasure and pain, and utter disregard of the consequences or fruit of ceremonial rites. 	 6. The particular practice of the preceding sort of devotion, or the exercise of that abstraction by which union with God is supposed to be obtained; in the Gītā it is described as sitting on Kuśa grass, with the body firm, the eyes fixed on the tip of the nose, and the mind intent on the Deity; in the Tan-tras a fanciful operation is prescribed, by which the vital spirit sea-ted in the lower part of the body, and the etherial spirit placed in the head, are supposed to be brought into combination in the brain, when the devotee becomes united with BRAHMĀ. 	 7. The sys-tem of philosophy which treats of the union of the soul with BRAH-MĀ or GOD; it is the same as the Patanjalī doctrine, and consti-tutes one of the six Darshanas or philosophical schools of the Hindus. 	 8. Magic, or the acquisition of supernatural powers by the mystical and magical worship of ŚIVA and DURGĀ especially. 	 9. Consequence, result, the main end or object of any thing or act. 10. Connection of one thing with another, as of cause with effect, predicate with subject, quality with substance, &c. 	 11. Acquisi-tion of something not possessed before, accession of property or wealth; in grammar this application is assigned to any unusual construction of words or compounds, unauthorised by rule, but sanctioned by the authority that employs them. 	 12. A rule, an aphorism. 	 13. Propriety, fitness. 	 14. Side, part, cause or argument to be maintained or defended. 	 15. Thing, substance. 	 16. Wealth. 17. A drug, a medicament, especially a compound of various, in-gredients. 	 18. Fraud, trick. 	 19. A logician. 	 20. A spy, an informer. 21. A violator of truth or confidence. 	 22. A conveyance, a carriage, a boat, &c. 	 23. A means, an expedient. 	 24. Armour. 	 25. Putting on armour. 	 26. Lucky conjuncture. 	 27. (In arithmetic,) Addition. 28. (In astronomy,) The leading or principal star of a lunar man-sion. 	 29. The twenty-seventh part of 3600 of a great circle measur-ed on the plane of the ecliptic, and used in calculating the longitu-des of the sun and moon; each Yoga has a distinct name; as-trologers also enumerate twenty-eight Yogas differently named from the foregoing, and corresponding with the twenty-eight Nak-shatras, or the divisions of the moon's path, but varying accor-ding to the day of the week. 	 30. A period, or the time during which the sum of the motions of the sun and moon amount to one Nakshatra, the mean duration of which is 23hs. 474 4444.  E. युज् to join literally or figuratively, (as with GOD,) aff. घञ् ।
