33521: राजान्न m. (-न्नः) A sort of rice, of a superior quality, said to grow in the Āndhra country.  E. राज, and अन्न food.
33522: राजाम्र m. (-म्रः) A superior sort of mango.  E. राज royal, अम्र mango.
33523: राजाम्ल m. (-म्लः) A kind of dock or sorrel: see अम्लवेतस ।
33524: राजार्क m. (-र्कः) Gigantic swallow wort, (Asclepias gigantea, with white flowers.)  E. राज royal, and अर्क swallow wort. “श्वेतआकन्दे” ।
33525: राजार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) Royal, noble, fit or proper for a king. 	 n. (-र्हं) Aloe-wood, (Amyris agallochum, Rox.) “अगुरुकाष्ठे”.  E. राज a sover-eign, and अर्ह proper.
33526: राजालुक m. (-कः) An esculent root, a sort of yam. “रशुने”.  E. राज royal, आलु a yam, कन् added.
33527: राजावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A gem, described as an inferior kind of diamond, brought from the country Birāta.  E. राज a king, आवर्त्त a turning; it is considered as a lucky possession for princes, though not es-teemed as an ornament.
33528: राजावलि f. (-लिः-ली) A line of kings, a royal dynasty or genealogy. E. राज and आवली a line.
33529: राजाहि m. (-हिः) A sort of snake said to be two-headed.  E. राज royal, अहि a snake.
33530: राजि f. (-जिः-जी) 	 1. A row, a line. 	 2. An unbroken row, a continuous line. 	 3. A small vessel of the body.  E. राज् to shine, इन् Unādi aff., ङीष् optionally added.
33531: राजिका f. (-का) 	 1. Black mustard, (Sinapis racemosa, Rox.) 	 2. A field. 3. A line, a row, a range. 	 4. A continuous or unbroken line. E. राज to shine, क्वुन् aff., fem. form; or राजि as above, कन् added.
33532: राजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Adorned, embellished. 	 2. Illuminated, irradia-ted.  E. राज to shine, क्त aff.
33533: राजिल m. (-लः) A sort of snake, (Amphisbæna.) “ढ्ॐडासाप”.  E. राजि a line, लच् aff.
33534: राजीव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Attending on or living about a prince. 	 m. (-वः) 	 1. A large fish, (Cyprinus niloticus, BUCH.) 	 2. A kind of deer. 	 3. An elephant. 	 n. (-वं) A lotus, (Nelumbium speciosum.)  E. राजी a line, a row, व aff.
33535: राजेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) An emperor.  E. राज, and इन्द्र chief.
33536: राजेभ m. (-भः) A state elephant.  E. राज, and इभ an elephant.
33537: राजेय m. (-यः) A kind of cucumber: see पटोल ।
33538: राज्ञी f. (-ज्ञी) A queen. नील्यां, कांस्ये, जातीपुष्यवृक्षे, पित्तलेच ।
33539: राज्य n. (-ज्यं) 	 1. A government, a country, a principality, a kingdom. 2. Administration or exercise of sovereignty or government. E. राज for राजन् a prince, and यत् or यक् aff.
33540: राज्यच्युत m. (-तः) A prince who has lost his kingdom.  E. राज्य, and च्युत fallen from.
33541: राज्यच्युति f. (-तिः) Deposal, loss of sovereignty.  E. राज्य, and च्युति falling.
33542: राज्यतन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) Science of government, system of administration.
33543: राज्यधुरा f. (-रा) Administration, burden or yoke of government. E. राज्य, धुरा burthen.
33544: राज्यभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Subversion of sovereignty.  E. राज्य and भङ्ग breaking.
33545: राज्यभाज् m. (-भाक्) A king.  E. राज्य, and भाज् who has.
33546: राज्यभ्रंश m. (-शः) 	 1. Deposal or loss of a kingdom.  E. राज्य and भ्रंश falling.
33547: राज्यभ्रष्ट m. (-ष्टः) A deposed sovereign.  E. राज्य, भ्रष्ट fallen.
33548: राज्यरक्षा f. (-क्षा) Protection or defence of a kingdom.  E. राज्य, रक्षा preservation.
33549: राज्यलोभ m. (-भः) Ambition.  E. राज्य and लोभ desire.
33550: राज्याङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) A requisite of regal administration; variously enu-merated, as seven, eight, or nine, viz.:--first, the monarch; second, the prime minister; third, a friend or ally; fourth, trea-sure; fifth territory; sixth a strong-hold; and seventh, an army; the eighth is the population or companies of citizens, and the ninth the Purohita or spiritual adviser.  E. राज्य royalty, and अङ्ग limb or part.
33551: राज्याधिकार m. (-रः) 	 1. Government of a kingdom. 	 2. Right or title to a sovereignty.  E. राज्य and अधिकार superintendance, &c.
33552: राज्याभिषेक m. (-कः) Inauguration of a king.
33553: राटि f. (-टिः) War, battle.  E. रट् to speak, to sound, aff. ङीप् ।
33554: राढा f. (-ढा) 	 1. Beauty, splendour, light, lustre. 	 2. A country or dis-trict, part of Bengal to the west of the Hugli-river.  E. रह to quit, aff. घञ्, and ह changed to ढ ।
33555: राण n. (-णं) 	 1. A leaf. 	 2. A peacock's tail.  E. रण् to sound, aff. घञ् ।
33556: रात्रक n. (-कं) A period of five nights collectively. 	 m. (-कः) A man who takes up his abode in a harlot's house for one year.  E. रात्रि night, and कन् aff.
33557: रात्रि f. (-त्रिः-त्री) Night, the darkness of night.  E. रा to give, (pleasure or rest,) त्रिप् Unādi aff., ङीप् optionally added.
33559: रात्रिचर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Going or moving at night. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A goblin, a fiend, a ghost or evil spirit. 	 2. A thief, a robber. 	 3. A guard, a patrole.  E. रात्रि night, (by night,) and चर who goes.
33560: रात्रिचर्या f. (-र्या) 	 1. Night-roving. 	 2. A nightly act or ceremony.
33561: रात्रिज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Nocturnal, born or produced at night. 	 n. (-जं) A star, a constellation.  E. रात्रि night, and ज born.
33562: रात्रिजल n. (-लं) Dew, mist, fog.  E. रात्रि night, and जल water.
33563: रात्रिजागर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Keeping watch at night, sitting up at night. m. (-रः) A dog.  E. रात्रि night, and जागर who wakes.
33564: रात्रिजागरण n. (-णं) Sitting up all night.  E. रात्रि, and जागरण waking.
33565: रात्रिजागरद m. (-दः) A musquito, a gnat.  E. रात्रिजागर waking by night, and द who gives or makes, from दा to give, or from दो to cut, who stings.
33566: रात्रिञ्चर m. (-रः) A ghost, a goblin.  E. रात्रि night, चर् to go, ट aff., मुम् aug.; also रात्रिचर ।
33567: रात्रितरा f. (-रा) The dead of night.
33568: रात्रिपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) A lotus-flower opening at night.
33569: रात्रिमट m. (-टः) 	 1. A ghost, a goblin. 	 2. A thief. 	 3. A guard. 	 4. A night-walker.  E. रात्रि night, अट् to go, aff. अच्, and मुम् augment.
33570: रात्रिमणि m. (-णिः) The moon.  E. रात्रि night, मणि a jewel.
33571: रात्रिम्मन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Thinking it night.  E. रात्रि, मन्य who believes, खच् aff.
33572: रात्रियोग m. (-गः) Coming on of night.  E. रात्रि, and योग joining.
33574: रात्रिवासस् n. (-सः) 	 1. Night-dress. 	 2. Darkness.  E. रात्रि night, and वासस् vesture.
33575: रात्रिविगम m. (-मः) Dawn, day-light.  E. रात्रि night, विगम stop, cessation.
33576: रात्रिविश्लेषगामिन् m. (-मी) The ruddy-goose.  E. रात्रि night, विश्लेष separa-tion, and गामिन् who goes: these birds being supposed to pass the night apart. “चक्रवाकपक्षिणि” ।
33577: रात्रिवेद m. (-दः) A cock.  E. रात्रि night, वेद who knows, its measure or duration.
33578: रात्रिवेदिन् m. (-दी) A cock.  E. रात्रि night, वेदिन् who knows: see the last.
33579: रात्रिहास m. (-सः) The white lotus.  E. रात्रि night, and हास what smiles, blossoming at night. “श्वेतोत्पले” ।
33580: रात्रिहिण्डक m. (-कः) A guard of the interior or women's apartments.  E. रात्रि, हिडि to go, क्कुन् aff.
33581: रात्र्यट m. (-टः) 	 1. An imp, a goblin. 	 2. A ghost. 	 3. A thief. 	 4. A night-walker.  E. रात्रि, अट् to go, aff. अच्; also with nasal inserted, रात्रिमट ।
33583: राद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 	 1. Cooked, dressed. 	 2. Perfected, as a religious vow; observed, as a fast, &c. 	 3. Perfect, in mysterious or magical power, adept, initiated. 	 4. Perfect in general, accomplished, mature, &c. 	 5. Successful, fortunate. 	 6. Propitiated, conciliated. E. राध् to accomplish or be accomplished, aff. क्त ।
33584: राद्धान्त m. (-न्तः) Demonstrated truth, proved and established fact or conclusion, a dogma.  E. राद्ध established, अन्त end, result.
33586: राध्(औ)औराध r. 4th cl. (राध्यति) 	 1. To be favourable or merciful. 	 2. To be ready, to be successful. 	 3. To kill. With अनु or आ, To propitiate, to adore. With अप, (usually used with a loc., but sometimes with a gen.) 	 1. To offend, to miss, to err. 	 2. To injure. With वि, To injure, to offend, to hurt. Caus. (रोधयति-ते) With आ, 1. To please. 	 2. To serve. r. 5th cl. (राध्नोति) 	 1. To bring anything to fulness or completion, to finish, to effect, to accomplish, to complete. 	 2. To attain completion, to succeed, to be finished or accomplished. 	 3. To destroy. With अप prefixed, To offend, to be in fault. With आङ्, To worship, to propitiate by worship.
33587: राध m. (-धः) The month Vaiśākha, (April-May.) 	 f. (-धा) 	 1. The asterism, in which the moon is full in the month Vaiśākha; the sixteenth of the Nakshatras, containing four stars in the shape of a festoon. 	 2. A celebrated Gopi, the favourite mistress of KRISH-ṆA, during his residence in Brindāvana amongst the cow-herds. 	 3. Name of the foster mother of KARṆA. 	 4. Prosperity. 	 5. Lightning. 	 6. An attitude in shooting, standing with the feet a span apart. 	 7. Emblic myrobalan. 	 8. A flower, (Clitoria ternata.) E. राध् to accomplish, aff. अच्, fem. aff. टाप्; or राधा the asterism, अण् aff. of reference.
33588: राधन n. (-नं) 	 1. Completing, accomplishing, succeeding, effecting. 	 2. Obtaining, acquisition. 	 3. Pleasure, satisfaction. 	 4. The means or instrument of accomplishing any thing. 	 f. (-ना) Speech, speaking. E. राध् to accomplish, aff. ल्युट् or युच् ।
33589: राधरङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 	 1. A plough. 	 2. Thin-rain. 	 3. Hail.
33590: राधाकान्त m. (-न्तः) A name of KRISHṆA.  E. राधा, and कान्त beloved.
33591: राधातनय m. (-यः) KARṆA.  E. राधा, and तनय son; see राधासुत ।
33592: राधानाथ m. (-थः) A name of KRISHṆA.  E. राधा, and नाथ lord.
33593: राधापुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) KARṆA.  E. राधा, and पुत्त्र son: see राधासुत ।
33594: राधाभेदिन् m. (-दी) A name of ARJUNA.  E. राधा the mistress of KRISHṆA, and भेदिन् dividing; having prevailed on KRISHṆA to abandon her.
33595: राधावल्लभ m. (-भः) A name of KRISHṆA.  E. राधा, and वल्लभ beloved.
33596: राधावेधिन् m. (-धी) ARJUNA.  E. राधा the mistress of KRISHṆA, and वेधिन् who hurts or wounds: see राधाभेदिन् ।
33597: राधासुत m. (-तः) KARṆA.  E. राधा the name of the wife of the charioteer of DHRITARĀSHTRA, (by whom the prince, after exposure by his own mother KUNTĪ, was found and fostered,) and सुत a son.
33598: राधेय m. (-यः) A name of KARṆA.  E. राधा a proper name, ढक् aff.
33599: राप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) To be said or spoken.  E. रप् to speak, aff. ण्यत् ।
33600: राम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 	 1. Black. 	 2. White. 	 3. Beautiful, pleasing. 	 m. (-मः) 1. A name common to three incarnations of VISHṆU, viz:-firstly, PARAŚURĀMA, the son of the Muni JAMADAGNI, born at the com-mencement of the second or TRETA YUGA, for the purpose of punishing the tyrannical kings of the Kshetriya race. Secondly, RĀMACHANDRA, the son of DAŚARATHA, king of Oudh, born at the close of the second age, to destroy the demons who infested the earth, and especially RĀVAṆA the Daitya-sovereign of Ceylon. Thirdly, BALARĀMA, (the elder and half-brother of KRISHṆA,) the son of BĀSUDEVA by ROHINI, born at the end of the DWĀPARA or third age. 	 2. A name of VARUṆA, regent of the waters. 	 3. A horse. 	 4. A sort of deer. 	 f. (-मा) 	 1. A woman, a female, a plea-sing or beautiful female. 	 2. Asafœtida. 	 3. A river. 	 4. Vermilion. n. (-मं) 	 1. A potherb, (Chenopodium album.) 	 2. A sort of Costus, (C. speciosus.)  E. रम् to sport, aff. घञ् ।
33601: रामकरी f. (-री) One of the Rāgīnis, or female personifications of the musical modes.  E. राम delighting, करी who makes; also रामकली ।
33602: रामकर्पूर m. (-रः) A fragrant sort of grass.  E. राम pleasant, and कर्पूर (smelling like,) camphor.
33603: रासकली f. (-ली) A Rāgīni.  E. राम pleasant, कला sound or note, ङीप् aff.
33604: रामगिरि m. (-रिः) The name of a mountain, variously applied, but espe-cially assigned to a mountain called COMPTEH or CHITRAKŪṬA in BUNDELKHUND, and to another near NĀGPORE, called now RĀMTEK. E. राम the hero RĀMA, and गिरि a mountain; being one of his halting places in his progress from Oudh to the Peninsula.
33605: रामचन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) The hero RĀMACHANDRA, the son of DASARATHA. E. राम and चन्द्र the moon, the moon-like RĀMA.
33606: रामजननी m. (-नी) The mother of BALARĀMA.  E. राम and जननी mother, hence it is equally applicable to RENUKĀ, the mother of PARAŚURĀMA, and to KAUŚALYA, the mother of RĀMACHANDRA.
33607: रामठ n. (-ठं) Asafœtida.  E. रम् to please, अठ Unādi aff., and the radi-cal vowel lengthened.
33608: रामणीयक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Beautiful, pleasing.  E. रमणीय the same, and वुञ् aff.
33609: रामदूत m. (-तः) The monkey HANUMĀNA, the friend and messenger of RAMĀ. 	 f. (-तिः-ती) A shrub, apparently a variety of basil with small leaves. “नाग्दोना”.  E. राम RĀMA, and दूत a messenger.
33610: रामनवमी f. (-मी) The ninth day in the light-half of Chaitra, the anni-versary of the birth of RĀMACHANDRA.
33611: रामपूग m. (-गः) A small species of the areca or betel-nut tree, (Areca triandra, Rox.)  E. राम RĀMA, पूग areca.
33612: रामभद्र m. (-द्रः) The hero RĀMACHANDRA.  E. राम the same, and भद्र auspicious.
33613: रामवीणा f. (-णा) A sort of Vina or lute.  E. राम RĀMA and वीणा a lute; it may be also ironically applicable to the horn blown by BALA-RĀMA, and called still the RĀMASINHĀ.
33614: रामशर m. (-रः) A variety of the Saccharum Sara, a sort of grass.
33615: रामसख m. (-खः) The monkey-king SUGRIVA.  E. राम RĀMA, and सख friend; RĀMA having restored him to his throne, whence he had been driven by his elder brother BĀLI.
33616: रामसेतु m. (-तुः) A bridge of sand, now a chain of islands, between the Indian Peninsula and Ceylon, popularly known by “Adam's bridge”.
33617: रामायण n. (-णं) 	 1. The first epic poem of the Hindus, written by the poet VĀLMIKI, recording the adventures of RĀMA, the son of DAŚA RATHA, sovereign of Oudh. 	 2. A name of several poems on the life and adventures of RĀMA.  E. राम the prince, and अयन abode.
33618: रामानुज m. (-जः) Name of the founder of a Vedāntic sect.
33619: रामिल m. (-लः) 	 1. KĀMA or CUPID. 	 2. A lover, a husband.  E. राम pleasing, agreeable, इलच् aff.
33620: राम्भ m. (-म्भः) The bamboo staff of a religious student.  E. रम्भा a bamboo, aff. अञ् ।
33621: रायण n. (-णं) 	 1. Pain. 	 2. Sounding, crying.  E. रै to sound, aff. ल्युट् ।
33622: रायभाटी f. (-टी) The current or flow of a river.
33623: रारस्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Crying aloud and repeatedly.  E. रस to cry, reit. v., शानच् aff.
33624: राल m. (-लः) Resin, the resinous and fragrant exudation of the Shorea robusta. “धुना”.  E. रा to give or get, aff. अलच्; also अराल ।
33625: राव m. (-वः) Sound, noise.  E. रु to cry or sound, aff. घञ् ।
33626: रावण m. (-णः) The Daitya-sovereign of Lankā or Ceylon, killed by RĀMACHANDRA. 	 n. (-णं) Noise, tumult.  E. रु to cry, (in the causal form,) aff. ल्युट; afflicting mankind.
33627: रावणारि m. (-रिः) The hero RĀMA.  E. रावण, अरि the foe.
33628: रावणि m. (-णिः) The eldest son of RĀVAṆA.  E. रावण, इञ् patronymic aff.
33629: राश्(ऋ)राशृ r. 1st and 4th cl. (राशते राश्यते) To sound.
33630: राशि m. (-शिः) 	 1. A heap, a quantity. 	 2. A sign of the zodiac. 	 3. Arith-metical or algebraic quantity. 	 4. A part and its divisor or nu-merator and denominator. 	 5. A congeries of number or quantity. E. अश् to pervade, इण् Unādi aff., and रुट् initial augment; or रश् to sound, with the same aff.
33631: राशिगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Heaped, accumulated. 	 2. Computed, sum-med either by arithmetic or algebra.  E. राशि, and गत gone to.
33632: राशिचक्र n. (-क्रं) The zodiac.  E. राशि, a sign, and चक्र a wheel or circle.
33633: राशित्रय n. (-यं) The rule of three.
33634: राशिभाग m. (-गः) A fraction.  E. राशि, भाग a part.
33635: राशिभोग m. (-गः) Passage of a planet through a sign of the zodiac. E. राशि, भोग enjoyment.
33636: राशीकरण n. (-णं) Heaping, piling, gathering.  E. राशि, करण making, च्वि augment.

34520: लोक m. (-कः) 	 1. Man, mankind. 	 2. A world, a division of the universe; in general three Lokas are enumerated; viz:--heaven, hell, and earth: another classification enumerates seven, exclusive of the infernal regions; viz:--Bhūr-loka the earth, Bhūvar-loka the space between the earth and the sun, the region of the Munis, Siddhas, &c.; Swar-loka the heaven of INDRA, between the sun and the polar star; Mahar-loka the usual abode of BHRIGU, and others saints, who are supposed to be co-existent with BRAHMĀ: during the conflagration of these lower worlds, the saints ascend to the next, or Jana-loka, which is described as the abode of BRAH-MĀ'S sons, SANAKA, SĀNANDA, SANĀTANA, and SANATKUMĀRA; above this, is the fifth world or the Tapo-loka, where the deities called Vairāgis reside; the seventh world, Satya-loka or Brahma-loka, is the abode of BRAHMĀ, and translation to this world exempts beings from further birth: the three first worlds are destroyed at the end of each Kalpa or day of BRAHMĀ; the three last at the end of his life, or of 100 of his years; the fourth Loka is equally permanent, but is uninhabitable from heat, at the time the three first are burning: another enumeration calls these seven worlds, earth, sky, heaven, middle region, place of births, mansion of the blest, and abode of truth, placing the sons of BRAHMĀ in the sixth division, and stating the fifth or Jana-loka to be that, where animals destroyed in the general conflagration are born again. The seven lower regions descending from the earth one below the other are:--ATALA, BITALA, SŪTALA, RASĀTALA, TALĀTALA, MAHĀTALA, PĀTĀLA, respectively. 	 3. The human race. 4. The earth. 	 5. The subjects. 	 6. A class, a community. 	 7. A region. 	 8. The number “seven.” 9. Common life, or usage, (oppo-rite to Shāstra and Veda respectively.) 	 10. Sight, seeing. 	 11. An element, a primary or radical part of being.  E. लोक् to see, aff. घञ् ।

35617: वह् r. 1st cl. (वहति) To bear, to carry, to convey or transport. (वहते) To flow, (as a stream.) Desid. (विवक्षति-ते) [This is one of those roots which take two accusatives.] 1. To transport. 	 2. To move on. 	 3. To flow. 4. To blow. 	 5. To marry. 	 6. To be responsible for. 	 7. To waft, to propel. 	 8. To bear the load of. 	 9. To possess. With अति, To pass, (as time.) With अप, 1. To carry off. 	 2. To deduct. With आ, 1. To cause to bring about. 	 2. To flow. 	 3. To have, to possess. With उद्, 1. To raise, to elevate, to bear up. 	 2. To marry. 	 3. To bear the burden of. 	 4. To wear. 	 5. To have. With उप, To commence. With नि, To support. With निस्, To be finished. With परि, To overflow. With प्र, 1. To draw, to carry. 	 2. To blow. 	 3. To flow. 4. To waft, (as scent.) 	 5. To bear the burden of. With वि, To marry. With सम, 1. To bear along. 	 2. To take a wife. 	 3. To press together. 	 4. To display. Caus. (वाहयति-ते) 	 1. To cause to draw or carry. 	 2. To traverse, to go over. With अति, To lead, (as life.) With आ, To invoke. With निस्, To perform, to manage, to com-plete. With सम्, To press together, to rub. 35751: वाचस्पति m. (-तिः) 	 1. VRIHASPATĪ: see the last. 	 2. A title of the great scholar Professor TĀRĀ-NĀTHA TARKA-BĀCHASPATĪ, son of the illustrious Pandit KĀLI-DĀSA SĀRBABHOUMA and grandson of the Venerable Pandit RĀM-RĀM TARKASIDDHĀNTA, the commentator of the six different schools of Hindu philosophy: (Vide Mr. ADAM'S report on the researches of the Pandits of Bengal.) He was born at KĀLNĀ, situated on the bank of the river BHĀGIRATHĪ, in the District of BURDWĀN in the year 1806 A. D. and died at the sacred city of BENARES in 1885, at the ripe age of eighty, where he retired for abstract meditation and contemplation of the Supreme Spirit. He is the commentator “of SĀNKHYA-TATWA-KOUMUDĪ,” of BĀCHASPATĪ MISHRA, “SIDDHĀNTA-KOUMUDĪ,” the most authoritative grammar of PĀNINĪ methodised by BHATTOJI-DIKSHITA, and several Sanskrit dramas; he is also the author of “SHABDĀRTHARATNA”, a useful work on the philosophy of grammar, “SIDDHĀNTABINDUSĀRA,” &c.; he is also the compiler of “ĀSHUBODH,” the well known Sanskrit grammar, “DHĀTURUPA,” the easy treatise on the paradigm of Sanskrit conjugations, both meant for beginners, “VĀCHASPATYA,” the first voluminous Sanskrit dictionary with derivations in al-phabetical order and “SHABDASTOMA-MAHĀNIDHĪ”, the most useful handy Sanskrit dictionary, and other works in almost all the bran-ches of Sanskrit language too numerous to mention, all of which he wrote single-handed.  E. वाच् speech, in the sixth case, पति master.

36146: वाल्मीक m. (-कः) VĀLMĪKA or VĀLMĪKI, the first poet and the famous author of the Rāmāyaṇa. Though a Brāhmana by birth he led a depraved life and was a notorious cut-throat, but was reclaimed by Nārada. One day while he was engaged in his devotions, he saw a fowler in the act of shooting at a pair of curlews and a curse fell from his mouth in the shape of a regular stanza. The sage discovered that it was a new mode of composition and by the advice of BRAHMĀ he composed the Rāmāyaṇa in that style. SITĀ when repudiated by her husband, took refuge with this sage who brought up her twin sons. 36304: विकसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Blown, as a flower, budded, opened, expanded. E. वि apart, कस् to go, aff. क्त; also विकशित ।
36305: विकस्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Opening, expanding.  E. वि apart, कस् to go, aff. वरच्; also derived from कश् or कष्, विकश्वर, and विकष्वर ।
36306: विकार m. (-रः) 	 1. Change of form or nature, alteration or deviation from the natural state. 	 2. Sickness, disease, change from the state of health. 	 3. Passion, feeling, emotion, transition from the natural or quiescent condition of the soul. 	 4. Anything evolved from a previous source, (in Sānkhya Philosophy.)  E. वि implying alteration, कृ to make, aff. घञ् ।
36307: विकारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Changed, converted, made to undergo a changing. 	 2. Rendered unfavourable or unfriendly.  E. वि before, कृ to make, causal v., क्त aff.
36308: विकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 	 1. Producing a change. 	 2. Undergoing a change.  E. वि before, कृ to make, णिनि aff.; or विकार, इनि aff.
36309: विकाल m. (-लः) Twilight, the close of day.  E. वि implying prohibition, (of peculiar ceremonies,) and काल time.
36310: विकालक m. (-कः) Evening, twilight. 	 f. (-लिका) A perforated copper-vessel, which is placed in a pan of water, and being filled at the expiration of a certain period, defines that period: a sort of Clep-sydra, or water-clock. “तांँवी”.  E. वि before, काल time, and कन् added; or वि before, कल् to go, aff. क्कुन् ।
36311: विकाश m. (-शः) 	 1. Solitude, loneliness, privacy. 	 2. Display, manifes-tation, open or splendid appearance. 	 3. Opening, expanding. 	 4. Budding, blowing, (as a flower.) 	 5. Pleasure, enjoyment. 	 6. Ether, heaven. 	 7. An open course. 	 8. An oblique course. 	 9. Retreat. 	 10. Eagerness.  E. वि before, काश to shine, aff. घञ्; the vowel of the prefix is more usually made long: see वीकाश ।
36312: विकाशता f. (-ता) 	 1. Appearance, display. 	 2. Loneliness. 	 3. Expansion. E. विकाश shining, aff. तल्; also with त्व, विकाशत्वं ।
36313: विकाशन n. (-नं) 	 1. Expansion, extent. 	 2. Manifestation. 	 3. Blowing, (of a flower.)  E. विकाश and ल्युट् aff.
36314: विकाशभृत् mfn. (-भृत्) 	 1. Expanding, being full. 	 2. Blown, budded. E. विकाश, भृत् who or what has.
36315: विकाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Expanding, spreading, opening.  E. वि before, कश् to go, aff. घिनुण्; or काश, णिनि aff.
36316: विकाषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Expanding, &c.  E. वि before, कष् to go, aff. घिनुण् ।
36317: विकासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Expanding, opening, budding, blowing. E. वि before, कस् to go, aff. घिनुण्; also with कश् or कष् the same, विकाशिन् and विकाषिन् as above.
36318: विकिर m. (-रः) 	 1. A bird in general. 	 2. A well. 	 3. A fallen fragment, a scattered portion. 	 4. Scattering. 	 5. A tree.  E. वि apart, &c., कॄ to scatter, क aff.
36319: विकिरण n. (-णं) 	 1. Scattering, spreading about or abroad. 	 2. Killing. 3. Knowledge. 	 m. (-णः) Gigantic swallow wort, (Asclepias gigan-tea.)  E. वि before, कॄ to scatter, aff. यु ।
36320: विकिरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) Throwing, scattering, sprinkling.  E. वि be-fore, कृ to scatter, शतृ aff.
36321: विकीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 	 1. Scattered, extended, diffused. 	 2. Cele-brated, famous.  E. वि implying extension, कृ to scatter, aff. क्त ।
36322: विकीर्य्य Ind. Having or being scattered.  E. वि, कृ to scatter, aff. ल्यप् ।
36323: विकीर्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being tossed, agitated, scattered, &c.  E. वि before, कृ to scatter, pass. v., शानच् aff.
36324: विकुर्व्वाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 	 1. Joyful, cheerful, happy. 	 2. Undergoing or making a change of form, &c.  E. वि before, कृ to do, शानच् aff.
36325: विकुस्र m. (-स्रः) The moon.  E. वि before, कस् to shine, रक् Unādi aff., and उ substituted for the radical vowel.
36327: विकूणन n. (-नं) A side-glance, a leer, a wink.  E. वि before, कूण् to con-tract or close, (the eyes,) aff. ल्युट् ।
36328: विकूणिका f. (-का) The nose.  E. वि before, कूण् to sound, aff. ण्वुल्, fem. form.
36329: विकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Entertaining the feeling of disgust, averse, estranged. 	 2. Sick, diseased. 	 3. Altered, changed, either in form or feeling. 	 4. Imperfect, unfinished, incomplete. 	 5. Over-come by feeling or passion. 	 6. Strange, extraordinary. 	 7. Loath-some, hideous. 	 n. (-तं) 	 1. Disgust, aversion. 	 2. Sickness. 	 3. Change. E. वि implying reverse, and कृत made.
36330: विकृतवदन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Having the face distorted.  E. विकृत, वदन face.
36331: विकृताकार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Changed in aspect, form, or appearance. E. विकृत and आकार form; also विकृताकृति ।
36332: विकृताङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Distorted, deformed.  E. विकृत, अङ्ग the limbs.
36333: विकृति f. (-तिः-ती) 	 1. Change of any kind, as of purpose, mind, form, nature, &c., either permanent or temporary. 	 2. Sickness, disease, change from the natural or healthy state. 	 3. Fear, apprehension. 4. Spirituous liquor. 	 5. A species of metre: the stanza consists of four lines of two syllables each, variously arranged.  E. वि implying alteration or reverse, कृ to make, aff. क्तिन् ।
36334: विकृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Pulled, drawn, (as a bow-string.) 	 2. Attract-ed. 	 3. Dragged, drawn. in general. 	 4. Extended, protracted. 	 5. Sounded, making a noise.  E. वि before, कृष् to draw, aff. क्त ।
36335: विकेश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Bald. 	 f. (-शी) 	 1. A small braid or tress of hair, first tied up severally, and then collected into the Venī or larger braid. 	 2. A woman without hair. 	 3. A woman with loose hair. E. वि severally or privative, केश hair.
36336: विकेशिका f. (-का) A pledget, a piece of rag smeared with ghee or other substances and applied as a dressing to a sore.
36337: विकोष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Uncovered, denuded, unsheathed.  E. वि pri-vative, and कोष a sheath, a cover; also विकोश ।
36338: विकौतुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Incurious, indifferent.  E. वि, कौतुक curious.
36339: विक्क m. (-क्कः) A young elephant.  E. विक imitative sound, कै to utter, aff. ड । विक्कणति वि + क्कण-ड ।
36340: विक्रम m. (-मः) 	 1. Heroism, prowess, heroic valour. 	 2. Great power or strength. 	 3. Walking, going, proceeding. 	 4. Overpowering, over-coming. 	 5. Strength in general. 	 6. A step, a stride, (as in त्रिविक्रम ।) 	 7. The name of a sovereign of Ougein: see विक्रमादित्य. E. वि before, क्रम् to go, to move, to walk, aff. अच् ।
36341: विक्रमण n. (-णं) The stride of VISHṆU.
36342: विक्रममाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 	 1. Going, proceeding. 	 2. Overpowering.  E. वि before, क्रम् to go, शानच् aff.
36343: विक्रमादित्य m. (-त्यः) The name of a celebrated prince, the sovereign of Ougein, and reputed founder of an æra still in use amongst the Hindus, commencing 56 years before the Christian æra; there are however many princes of this name, and it has been applied to BHOJA-Rāja, to SĀLIVĀHANA, and PRITHVĪ Rāja, as well as to five or six others; the name also occurs variously written, as VIKRAMĀDITYA, VIKRAMASENA, VIKRAMASINHA, VIKRAMĀRKA, &c.  E. विक्रम power, and आदित्य the sun.
36344: विक्रमार्क m. (-र्कः) A name of the sovereign VIKRAMĀDITYA: see the last.  E. विक्रम heroism, अर्क the sun.
36345: विक्रमार्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Conquered, acquired by valour.  E. विक्रम and अर्ज्जित gained.
36346: विक्रमिन् m. (-मी) 	 1. A lion. 	 2. A hero.  E. विक्रम strength, valour, इनि aff.
36347: विक्रय m. (-यः) Sale, selling, vending.  E. वि before, क्री to buy, अच् aff.
36348: विक्रयानुशय m. (-यः) Rescission of sale.  E. विक्रय, अनुशय doubt.
36349: विक्रयण n. (-णं) Selling, vending.  E. वि reverse, क्री to buy, ल्युट् aff.
36350: विक्रयिक m. (-कः) A vender, a dealer, a salesman.  E. विक्रय sale, ठन् aff.
36351: विक्रयिन् m. (-यी) A seller, a vender.  E. विक्रय sale, इनि aff.
36353: विक्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 	 1. Valiant, mighty. 	 2. Overcoming victorious. m. (-न्तः) 	 1. A hero, a warrior. 	 2. A lion. 	 n. (-न्तं) 	 1. Valour. 	 2. A step, a stride.  E. वि before, क्रम् to go, aff. क्त, in an active sense.
36354: विक्रान्ति f. (-न्तिः) 	 1. A horse's canter or gallop. 	 2. Prowess, heroic strength and valour. 	 3. Great power or strength. 	 4. Striding. E. वि before, क्रम् to go, aff. क्तिन् ।
36355: विक्रान्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) 	 1. Valiant. 	 2. Victorious. 	 m. (-न्ता) A hero, a victor.  E. वि before, क्रम् to go, तृच् aff.
36356: विक्रायक m. (-कः) A vender, a seller.  E. वि before, कृ to buy, ण्वुल् aff.
36357: विक्रिया f. (-या) 	 1. Change of mind, form, purpose, condition, &c. 	 2. Emotion, perturbation, passion. 	 3. Anger, dis-satisfaction. 	 4. Contraction. 	 5. Vitiation, intermixture.  E. वि implying reverse, and क्रिया action: see विकार ।
36358: विक्रीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sold.  E. वि before, क्री to buy, aff. क्त ।
36359: विक्रीय Ind. Having sold.  E. वि before, कृ to buy, ल्यप् aff.
36360: विक्रुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Harsh, rugged or unkind, (as speech.) 	 2. Called out, exclaimed. 	 n. (-ष्टं) 	 1. A cry of alarm or for help. 	 2. Abuse.  E. वि before, क्रुश् to call, aff. क्त ।
36361: विक्रेतृ m. (-ता) A vender, a seller.  E. वि before, क्री to buy, aff. तृच् ।
36362: विक्रेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Vendible, saleable.  E. वि before, क्री to buy, aff. यत् ।
36363: विक्रोशन n. (-नं) 	 1. Abusing, reviling. 	 2. Calling out.  E. वि before, क्रुश् to curse, ल्युट् aff.
36364: विक्रोष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) 	 1. Who reviles, abuses, speaks harshly, &c. 2. Who calls or cries out.  E. वि before, क्रुश् to cry, तृच् aff.
36365: विक्लव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Overcome with fear or agitation, confused, con-founded, lost, bewildered.  E. वि before, क्लु to go, aff. अच् ।
36366: विक्लवता f. (-ता) Timidity, fear.  E. विक्लव, तल् aff.; also with त्व, विक्लवत्वं ।
36367: विक्लिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 	 1. Old. 	 2. Withered, shrivelled, decayed. 	 3. Wet, moist.  E. वि before, क्लिद् to moisten, aff. क्त ।
36368: विक्लिष्ट f. (-ष्टा) Afflicted, distressed, injured. 	 n. (-ष्टं) A fault in pronunciation.
36369: विक्षण Adv. 	 n. (-णं) Momentarily, for a moment.  E. वि, क्षण a moment.
36370: विक्षत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Struck, hurt, wounded.  E. वि before, क्षत torn.
36371: विक्षाव m. (-वः) 	 1. Cough. 	 2. Sound.  E. वि before, क्षु to sound, aff. घञ् ।
36372: विक्षिपत् mfn. (-पन्-पन्ती-पत्) 	 1. Throwing, tossing. 	 2. Agitating.  E. वि before, क्षिप् to throw, and शतृ aff.
36373: विक्षिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 	 1. Scattered, dispersed. 	 2. Thrown, cast. 	 3. Agitated, bewildered, perplexed. 	 4. Sent, dispatched. 	 5. Refuted, falsified.  E. वि severally, क्षिप्त thrown or sent.
36374: विक्षीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Wasted, destroyed.  E. वि before, क्षै to decay, क्त aff.
36375: विक्षीणक m. (-कः) 	 1. The chief of a class of demigods, enumerated amongst those attached to ŚIVA, and the ministers of destruction amongst men by plague, pestilence, &c. 	 2. A meeting or assembly of the gods. 	 3. A place prohibited to eaters of meat.  E. वि before, क्षीण wasted, (by whom,) and कन् added.
36377: विक्षेप m. (-पः) 	 1. Casting, or throwing away. 	 2. Sending, dispatching. 3. Confusion, perplexity, fear proceeding from ignorance or error. 	 4. Looking about vaguely or wildly, as of a woman for her absent lover. 	 5. Refuting an argument, establishing its falsehood. 6. Celestial latitude.  E. वि before, क्षिप् to throw, aff. घञ् ।
36378: विक्षेपण n. (-णं) 	 1. Scattering, dispersing. 	 2. Sending, dispatching. 	 3. Throwing. 	 4. Confusion.  E. वि before, क्षिप् to throw, ल्युट् aff.
36379: विक्षेपध्रुव m. (-वः) (In astronomy), The greatest inclination of a planet's orbit.  E. विक्षेप, ध्रुव an arc.
36380: विक्षोभ n. (-भं) 	 1. Agitating, shaking. 	 2. Conflict, struggle. 	 3. Fearing. E. वि before, क्षुभ् to stir, and घञ् aff.
36382: विखण्डित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Broken, divided. 	 2. Refuted.  E. वि before, खण्डित the same.
36385: विखुर m. (-रः) A goblin, a demon, a Rākshasa. 	 2. A thief.  E. वि before, खुर् to cut, aff. क ।
36386: विख्य mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं) Noseless.  E. वि privative prefix, and ख्य substi-tuted, for नस or नासिका; also other as arbitrary terms, or विख, विग्र, बिग्र, &c.
36387: विख्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Known, famous. 	 2. Avowed, confessed.  E. वि before, ख्या to say or tell, aff. क्त ।
36388: विख्याति f. (-तिः) Fame, celebrity.  E. वि before, ख्या to say, or tell, aff. क्तिन् ।
36389: विख्यापन n. (-नं) 	 1. Confessing, acknowledging, avowing, declaring. 	 2. Explaining, expounding.  E. वि, ख्या to say, causal form, aff. ल्युट् ।
36391: विख्रु mfn. (-ख्रुः-ख्रुः-ख्रु) Noseless; also विख and विखु.
36392: विगणन n. (-नं) 	 1. Reckoning, computing. 	 2. Considering, deliberating. 3. Discharge of a debt.  E. वि before, गणन counting.
36393: विगणय्य Ind. 	 1. Having deliberated or weighed. 	 2. Having reckoned. E. वि before, गण् to number, ल्यप् aff.
36394: विगणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Reckoned, calculated. 	 2. Weighed, consi-dered. 	 3. Discharged, (as a debt.)  E. वि before, गण् to count, क्त aff.
36395: विगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Gone, departed, disappeared. 	 2. Separated, severed, parted. 	 3. Freed or exempt from. 	 4. Lost. 	 5. Gloomy, dark, obscured. 	 6. Dead.  E. वि implying disunion, (of light, &c.) गत gone.
36396: विगतकल्मष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) 	 1. Pure, righteous. 	 2. Unsoiled.  E. विगत and कल्मष sin.
36397: विगतज्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Exempted from decay. 	 2. Cured of fever. E. विगत and ज्वरा decay, or ज्वर fever.
36398: विगतराग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Devoid of passion or affection.  E. विगतं and राग passion.
36399: विगतश्रीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Unfortunate, unprosperous.  E. विगत gone, श्री prosperity, कप् aff.
36400: विगतस्पृह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Indifferent, devoid of wish or desire.  E. विगत, स्पृहा desire.
36401: विगतार्त्तवा f. (-वा) A woman past child-bearing.  E. विगत gone, आर्त्तव the menstrual excretion.
36402: विगम m. (-मः) 	 1. Separation, parting. 	 2. Destruction, death. 	 3. Relin-quishment.  E. वि apart, and गम going.
36403: विगर m. (-रः) 	 1. An abstemious man, one who feeds on wind. 	 2. A naked man. 	 3. A mountain.
36404: विगर्हण nf. (-णं-णा) Abuse, abusing, censure, reproach.  E. वि before, गर्ह to abuse, ल्युट् aff.
36405: विगर्हणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Bad, wicked, reprehensible.  E. वि before, गर्ह् to abuse, अनीयर् aff.
36406: विगर्हित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Abused, reviled. 	 2. Low, vile. 	 3. Bad, wicked. 4. Condemned, reprobated.  E. वि before, गर्ह् to abuse, aff. क्त ।
36407: विगर्ह्य mfn. (र्ह्यः-र्ह्या-र्ह्यं) Blamable, reprehensible. Ind. Having blamed or reviled.  E. वि before, गर्ह् to abuse, यत् or ल्यप् aff.
36408: विगर्ह्यकथा f. (-था) Scandal, abuse.  E. विगर्ह्य and कथा speech.
36409: विगलत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्) 	 1. Oozing, dropping, flowing. 	 2. Fading, dispersing, weakening, (as emotion, &c.)  E. वि before, गल् to ooze, शतृ aff.
36410: विगलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Fallen, dropped, oozed, flowing. 	 2. Removed, gone. 	 3. Dissipated, dispersed. 	 4. Decayed, impaired. 	 5. Slackened, united, (as a knot.) 	 6. Loose, disordered, (as dress.) 	 7. Dissolved. E. वि before, गल् to ooze, aff. क्त ।
36411: विगलितकेश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Having the hair dishevelled.  E. विगलित, केश hair.
36412: विगाढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 	 1. Immersed, plunged, bathing. 	 2. Much, excess-ive, deep. 	 3. Flowing copiously.  E. वि, गाह् to bathe, aff. क्त ।
36413: विगान n. (-नं) 	 1. Ill-report, detraction, scandal. 	 2. Censure, reproach. E. वि depreciative prefix, गै to sing or sound, aff. ल्युट् ।
36414: विगाह m. (-हः) 	 1. Bathing. 	 2. Plunging into, literally or figuratively, (as water, a crowd, &c.) वि before, गाह् to bathe, अच् aff.
36415: विगाहमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Beholding, perceiving. 	 2. Knowing. 	 3. Bathing. 	 4. Going, proceeding.  E. वि, गाह् to agitate, aff. शानच् ।
36416: विगाह्य Ind. Having bathed or plunged in.  E. वि, गाह् to agitate, ल्यप aff.

36547: विजितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Victorious, conquering.  E. वि before, जि to conquer, क्तवतु aff.
36548: विजितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be apprehended or feared.  E. विज् to fear, तव्य aff.
36549: विजितात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Self-subdued.  E. विजित and आत्मन् self.

36554: विजिन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Mixed with rice-gruel, &c. (sauce or condiments.) E. विज् to shake, aff. इनच् ।
36555: विजिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Mixed with rice-water or gruel, (sauce or condi-ments, &c.)  E. विज् to shake, aff. इलच् ।
36556: विजिविल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Mixed with rice-water, sauces, &c.

36558: विजिहीर्षु mfn. (-र्षुः-र्षुः-र्षु) Wishing or speaking for sport or amusement. E. वि before, हृ to take, desid. v., उ aff.

36564: विजेतृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Victorious, a victor.  E. वि, जि to conquer, तृच् aff.
36565: विज्जन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Mixed with rice-water or gruel, (sauce, gravy, &c.): see विजिल; it is also occurs विज्जल ।

36575: विज्ञानपाद m. (-दः) An epithet of VYĀSA.
36576: विज्ञानमातृक m. (-कः) A name of BUDDHA, the founder of the Bauddha religion.  E. विज्ञान knowledge, मातृक parent.
36577: विज्ञानिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Clever, skilful, conversant; also वैज्ञानिक. E. विज्ञान, ठक् aff.
36578: विज्ञापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what makes known. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. An informant. 	 2. An instructor.  E. वि, ज्ञा to know, causal v., ण्वुल् aff.

36581: विज्ञापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Apprised, informed. 	 2. Instructed.  E. वि be-fore, ज्ञा to know, causal v., क्त aff.
36582: विज्ञाय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Cognizable, comprehensible, what is to be or may be known or understood.  E. वि implying discrimination, ज्ञा to know, यत् participle aff.
36583: विज्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Exempt from decay. 	 2. Free from fever.  E. वि, ज्वरा decay, or ज्वर fever.
36584: विझर्झर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Harsh, disagreeable, (as sound.)  E. वि before, झर्झर clanging.
36585: विञ्जामर n. (-रं) The white of the eye.
36586: विञ्जोली f. (-ली) A line, a row, a range.
36587: विट् r. 1st cl. (वेटति) 	 1. To sound. 	 2. To curse. (इ) विटि r. 10th cl. (विण्टयति-ते) To decay.
36588: विट m. (-टः) 	 1. A catamite, a pathic. 	 2. A rogue, a cheat. 	 3. 36590: विटप mn. (-पः-पं) 	 1. The branch of a tree or creeper with its new sprout or shoot. 	 2. A new shoot. 	 3. A branch. 	 4. Expansion, spreading. 	 5. A clump, a cluster. 	 6. A bush. 	 7. 36600: विट्लवण n. (-णं) A fetid salt: see विड.  E. विट् ordure, लवण salt.

36612: विडम्बयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 	 1. Assuming, putting on, (as a borrowed dress or appearance. 	 2. Imitating.  E. वि before, डवि to heap, aff. शतृ ।

37116: विभात् mfn. (-भान्-भान्ती or भाती-भात्) Shining, splendid.  E. वि before, भा to shine, शतृ aff.

E. वि various, and भाव property, disposition.
37119: विभावक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Discussing, shewing, illustrating.  E. वि before, भू to think, ण्वुल् aff.
37120: विभावन nf. (-नं-ना) 	 1. Discussion, examination, discrimination. 	 2. Per-ceiving, seeing, distinguishing. 	 3. Conceiving, imagination. 	 4. Ascertaining or judging of facts. 	 5. 37121: विभावनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Distinguishable, ascertainable, to be judged or determined.  E. वि and भू to think, अनीयर् aff.

37128: विभाषा f. or Ind. (-षा) Alternative, either of two ways.  E. वि alternative, and भाषा speech.

37135: विभीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fearless.  E. वि priv., भीत afraid.

37146: विभूषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Adorned, decorated.  E. वि variously, भूष् to adorn, क्त aff.

37148: विभेद m. (-दः) 	 1. Dividing, breaking. 	 2. Wounding, piercing. 	 3. Variety, distinction. 	 4. Bewildering, perplexing. 	 5. A division or separation. 	 6. Enmity, opposition. 	 7. Contradiction.  E. वि before भिद् to break, घञ् aff.
37149: विभेदन n. (-नं) 	 1. Breaking, dividing. 	 2. Separating, literally or figur-atively, as setting at variance.  E. वि before भिद् to divide, ल्युट् aff.

37159: विभ्रान्ति f. (-न्तिः) 	 1. Error, confusion. 	 2. Hurry, flurry, precipitation. 3. Whirling, going round.  E. वि before भ्रम् to err, aff. क्तिन् ।

37168: विमन्यु Adj. 	 1. Free from anger. 	 2. Free from grief.
37169: विमय m. (-यः) Barter, exchange.  E. वि before मि to scatter, aff. अच् ।
37170: विमर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) 	 1. Rubbing, friction. 	 2. The trituration of perfumes. 3. Touch, contact. 	 4. Destroying, killing. 	 5. Crushing, bruising. 6. Rubbing the body with unguents. 	 7. 37175: विमर्शन n. (-नं) Investigating, discussing.  E. वि, मृश् to judge, ल्युट् aff.

37178: विमर्षिन् mfn. (-र्षी-र्षिणी-र्षि) 	 1. Impatient, intolerant. 	 2. Averse, disliking.  E. विमर्ष and इनि aff.
37179: विमल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Clean, pure, (either literally, as clothes, &c. or figuratively, as the heart or mind.) 	 2. Beautiful. 	 3. White. 	 4. Transparent. 	 f. (-ला) 	 1. 37180: विमलमणि m. (-णिः) Crystal.  E. विमल clean, clear, मणि a jewel.
37181: विमलात्मक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Clean, pure.  E. विमल clean, आत्मन् nature, aff. कन् ।

37187: विमातृ f. (-ता) A step-mother, a father's wife.  E. वि different, मातृ mother.
37188: विमातृज m. (-जः) A step-mother's son.  E. विमातृ, and ज born.
37189: विमान mn. (-नः-नं) 	 1. A car or chariot of the gods, sometimes serving as a seat or throne, and at others carrying them through the skies self-directed and self-moving; hence it also applies to the sky. 2. Any car or vehicle. 	 3. A horse. 	 4. A palace, the palace of an emperor, or supreme monarch. 	 5. A seven-storied palace. 	 6. Disrespect, dishonour. 	 7. Measure.  E. वि before मन् to under-stand, with घञ् aff.; or मा to measure, aff. ल्युट्; to वि priv., मान honour.
37191: विमानित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dishonoured.  E. विमान, and इतच् aff.
37192: विमार्ग m. (-र्गः) 	 1. A broom, a brush. 	 2. A bad road. 	 3. A wrong road, literally or figuratively, evil conduct.  E. वि before मृज् to clean, aff. घञ्; or वि privative, and मार्ग a road.
37193: विमार्गण n. (-णं) Searching, seeking.  E. वि before मृग् to search, ल्युट् aff.
37195: विमुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 	 1. Loosed, liberated. 	 2. Hurled, thrown. 	 3. Quitted, abandoned. 	 4. Issued or let loose from, given vent to. E. वि before मुक्त the same.
37196: विमुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 	 1. Liberation, especially final emancipation from future existence. 	 2. Separation, parting.  E. वि, मुक्ति the same.
37197: विमुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) 	 1. Averted, having the face cast down or turned away. 	 2. Opposed, averse, disinclined. 	 3. Void of.  E. वि reverse, and मुख the countenance.
37198: विमुखता f. (-ता) 	 1. Disappearance, departure. 	 2. Turning away. 	 3. Oppo-sition.  E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, विमुखत्वं ।
37199: विमुखिता f. (-ता) 	 1. Turning away from, enmity. 	 2. Departure. 	 3. Oppo-sition.  E. विमुखिन्, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, विमुखित्वं ।
37200: विमुखिन् mfn. (-खी-खिनी-खि) 	 1. Averted, turned away. 	 2. Hostile, averse to or from.  E. विमुख, and इनि aff.
37201: विमुखीकरण n. (-णं) Turning away from, leaving.  E. विमुख, करण doing, च्वि augment.
37202: विमुखीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Turned away from, averted, departed. E. विमुख, कृत made, च्वि augment.
37203: विमुग्ध mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं) Bewildered, absorbed.  E. वि, मुह् to be bewildered, क्त aff.
37204: विमुच्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being let loose or liberated, in the act of spreading abroad.  E. वि before मुच् to be loosed, शानच् aff.
37205: विमुद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं) 	 1. Blown, budded, opened as a bud or flower. 	 2. Unsealed, unclosed.  E. वि privative, मुद्रा a seal.
37206: विमूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 	 1. Bewildered, discomposed. 	 2. Foolish. 	 3. Be-guiled, led astray, seduced, tempted.  E. वि, मुह् to be foolish, aff. क्त ।
37207: विमूढसंज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Senseless, unconscious.  E. विमूढ, संज्ञा sense.
37208: विमूढात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Beguiled, foolish.  E. विमूढ, आत्मन् self.
37209: विमृदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Rubbed. 	 2. Ground, pounded.  E. वि, मृद् to rub, क्त aff.
37210: विमृश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) To be discussed or reflected upon. Ind. Hav-ing considered.  E. वि, मृश् to reflect, युच् or ल्यप् aff.
37211: विमृश्यकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Acting after due deliberation.  E. विमृश्य and कारिन् who acts.
37212: विमृष्ट f. (-ष्टा) 	 1. Rubbed of, cleansed. 	 2. Considered, reflected upon.
37213: विमोक्ष m. (-क्षः) 	 1. Liberation, freedom, being or letting loose. 	 2. Dis-charging, shooting. 	 3. Final emancipation.  E. वि before मोक्ष the same.
37214: विमोक्षण nf. (-णं-णा) Quitting, abandoning, resigning.  E. वि before मोक्षण the same.
37215: विमोचन n. (-नं) Liberating, unyoking.  E. वि, मुच् to set free, ल्युट् aff.
37216: विमोचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Liberated, set free.  E. वि before मुच् to liberate, causal v., aff. क्त ।
37217: विमोहन mfn. (-नः-ना or -नी-नं) 	 1. Fascinating, seducing, bewitching, tempting, (the instrument or agent.) 	 2. Name of a division of hell. 	 n. (-नं) Seducing, tempting, confounding the mind and exciting the passions, (the act.)  E. वि before मुह् to be foolish, in the causal form, aff. ल्युट् ।
37218: विमोहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fascinated, beguiled.  E. वि before मुह् to be foolish, causal v., क्त aff.
37219: विम्ब mn. (-म्बः-म्बं) 	 1. The disk of the sun or moon. 	 2. An image, a picture, a shadow, a reflected or represented form. 	 3. The gourd of the Momordica monadelpha. 	 nf. (-म्बं-म्बा or -म्बी) A cucurbitaceous plant with red fruit, (Momordica monadelpha.)  E. वि to go, to shine, बन् Unādi aff., मुम् aug.; the radical vowel made short.
37220: विम्बक n. (-कं) 	 1. The disk of the sun or moon. 	 2. The gourd of the Momordica monadelpha or the plant itself. “तेलाकुचा.”  E. कन् added to the last.
37221: विम्बजा f. (-जा) Momordica monadelpha or the gourd.  E. विम्ब the plant and ज born.
37222: विम्बट m. (-टः) The mustard plant, (Sinapis dichotoma, Rox.)  E. विम्ब as above, अट् to go or grow, (like,) aff. अच् deriv. irr.
37223: विम्बागत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Reflected.  E. विम्ब and आगत arrived.
37224: विम्बिका f. (-का) 	 1. A cucurbitaceous plant bearing a bright red gourd, (Momordica monadelpha.) 	 2. The disk of the sun or moon.  E. कन् in the fem. form, added to विम्ब as above.
37225: विम्बित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pictured, imaged, reflected.  E. विम्ब, इतच् aff.
37226: विम्बु m. (-म्बुः) The betel-nut tree, (Areca faufel.)
37227: विम्बोष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठी-ष्ठं) Red-lipped, having lips like the Vimba fruit. E. विम्ब as above, and ओष्ठ the lip; also विम्बौष्ठ ।
37228: विम्लान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Fresh, pure, free from soil or decay. 	 2. Re-freshed.  E. वि priv., म्लान decayed.
37229: विम्लापन n. (-नं) 	 1. Cleaning, wiping. 	 2. Refreshing, reviving.  E. वि priv., म्ले to decay, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
37230: वियच्चारिन् m. (-री) A kite.  E. वियत् the sky, and चारिन् who goes.
37231: वियत् n. (-यत्) Sky, heaven, æther, atmosphere.  E. वि privative, यम् to refrain or cause, aff. क्विप् and तुक् final.
37232: वियति m. (-तिः) A bird.  E. वि, यत् to endeavour, कि aff.
37233: वियद्गङ्गा f. (-ङ्गा) The Ganges or river of heaven.  E. वियत् heaven, गङ्गा the river.
37234: वियद्गति f. (-तिः) Moving in the air.  E. वियत्, गति motion.
37235: वियद्भूति f. (-तिः) Darkness.  E. वियत् the sky, and भूति superhuman power.
37236: वियन्मणि m. (-णिः) The sun.  E. वियत् the sky, and मणि a gem.
37237: वियम m. (-मः) 	 1. Forbearance, restraint. 	 2. Rest, cessation, stop. 	 3. Pain or distress of various kinds.  E. वि before यम् to check or res-train, aff. अप्; also वियाम ।
37238: वियात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Shameless, impudent, ill-behaved. 	 2. Bold. E. वि implying prevention, and यात wished; wishing for what is prohibited or improper.
37239: वियाम m. (-मः) 	 1. Forbearance, restraint. 	 2. Rest, stop, cessation. 	 3. Pain or distress of various kinds.  E. वि, यम् to restrain, aff. घञ् ।
37240: वियुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Separated, sundered.  E. वि priv., युक्त joined.
37241: वियुत f. (-ता) Separated from, deprived of.
37242: वियोग m. (-गः) 	 1. Absence, separation, especially of lovers. 	 2. Disunion, disjunction. 	 3. Loss, absence.  E. वि privative, and योग union.
37243: वियोगभाज् mfn. (-भाक) Suffering separation.  E. वियोग separation, भज् to serve, to be subject to, causal form, aff. क्विप् ।
37244: वियोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) Separated, absent, remote, apart. 	 m. (-गी) The ruddy goose.  E. वि, युज् to join, घिनुण् aff.
37245: वियोगिनी f. (-नी) 	 1. A woman separated from her lover. 	 2. Name of a metre.
37246: वियोजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Separated, disjoined, disunited. 	 2. Parted from, deprived of.  E. वि privative, योजित joined.
37247: वियोनि f. (नि or नी) 	 1. Manifold birth. 	 2. An ignominious birth.
37248: विरक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 	 1. Averse, indifferent, free from inclination or affection. 	 2. Stoical, void of attachment to worldly objects. 	 3. Impassioned, interested, feeling passion or regard for any person or any thing. 	 4. Discoloured.  E. वि privative or pleonastic, before रञ्ज् to feel passion, aff. क्त ।
37249: विरक्तभाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Disinclined to, disliking.  E. विरक्त, भाव quality.
37250: विरक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 	 1. Aversion, disinclination. 	 2. Absence of affection. E. वि before रञ्ज् to affect, क्तिन् aff.
37251: विरचत् mfn. (-चन्-चन्ती-चत्) Making, composing, fabricating, embellish-ing, &c.  E. वि before रच् to make, aff. शतृ ।
37252: विरचन nf. (-नं-ना) 	 1. Making, arranging. 	 2. Composing, Embellishing. 4. Embellishment, any artificial and ornamental fabric or contri-vance.  E. वि before रच to make, युच् aff.
37253: विरचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Made, prepared, effected. 	 2. Written, com-posed. 	 3. Trimmed, ornamented. 	 4. Contrived, constructed, arranged. 	 5. Put on, worn. 	 6. Set, inlaid.  E. वि pleonasm, and रच् to be made, क्त aff.
37254: विरच्य Ind. Having made.  E. वि, रच् to make, ल्यप् aff.
37255: विरज m. (-जः) VISHṆU. 	 f. (-जा) Free from dust.
37256: विरजस् mfn. (-जाः-जाः-जः) 	 1. Free from dust. 	 2. Free from passion. f. (-जाः) A woman who has ceased to menstruate.  E. वि privative, रजस् the menses, &c.
37257: विरजस्तमस् m. (-माः) A virtuous man, one free from the two properties of ignorance and passion.  E. वि privative, रजस् the quality of pass-ion, and तमस् that of ignorance.
37258: विरजा f. (-जा) 	 1. A plant, commonly कवित्थानी 2. A sort of grass, commonly Durbā.
37259: विरजीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Freed from passion. 	 2. Clean, freed from dust, &c.  E. वि priv., रजस् passion, &c., कृत made, च्वि augment.
37260: विरजीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Free from passion, pure, holy. 	 2. Clean, clear.  E. वि priv., रजस् passion, भूत become, च्वि augment.
37261: विरञ्च m. (-ञ्चः) BRAHMĀ.  E. वि before रच् to create, aff. अच् and नुम् augment; more properly विरिञ्च ।
37262: विरट m. (-टः) 	 1. The name of a king. 	 2. The shoulder. 	 3. A black kind of Agallochum.
37263: विरण n. (-णं) A fragrant grass, (Andropogon schœnanthum.) E. See वीरण । “वेणार मूल ।”
37264: विरत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Stopped, ceased, rested.  E. वि before रम् to stop or rest, aff. क्त ।
37265: विरति f. (-तिः) 	 1. Stop, cessation, term, rest. 	 2. End, term.  E. वि be-fore रम् to play, क्तिन् aff.
37267: विरमत् mfn. (-मन्-मन्ती-मत्) 	 1. Resting, stopping. 	 2. Sporting.  E. वि, रम् to sport, शतृ aff.

37270: विरलजानुक m. (-कः) A man with bandy legs.  E. विरल wide, जानु the knee, कन् added.

37272: विरस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) 	 1. Insipid. 	 2. Painful. 	 m. (-सः) Pain.  E. वि, रस flavour.
37273: विरह m. (-हः) 	 1. Separation, parting, absence, especially the separa-tion of lovers. 	 2. Forbearance, cessation, relinquishment.  E. वि be-fore रह् to abandon, aff. अच् ।
37274: विरहज्वर m. (-रः) The anguish of separation.
37275: विरहय्य Ind. Having abandoned.  E. वि before, रह् to quit, causal form, ल्यप् aff.
37276: विरहानल m. (-लः) The fire of separation.
37277: विरहार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Pained by the absence of a lover.  E. विरह, आर्त्त pained.
37278: विरहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Left, abandoned, deserted, relinquished. 	 2. Void of, exempt, or free from.  E. वि before रह् to abandon, aff. क्त ।
37279: विरहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Separate, sundered, absent or apart from. f. (-हिणी) 	 1. Wages, hire. 	 2. A woman absent from her husband or lover.  E. विरह absence, णिनि aff.

37282: विराग m. (-गः) 	 1. The absence of desire or passion, indifference, philoso-phy, the disregard of all sensual enjoyment either in this world or the next. 	 2. Change of colour. 	 3. Dissatisfaction.  E. वि priva-tive, and राग passion, desire.
37283: विरागार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) Void of passion or desire.  E. विराग the absence of desire, and अह worthy.
37284: विरागिन् mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि) Void of passion or desire.  E. विराग and इनि aff.

37286: विराजत् mfn. (-जन्-जन्ती-जत्) Shining, splendid, handsome.  E. वि and राज् to shine, aff. शतृ ।
37287: विराजमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Splendid, brilliant, handsome.  E. वि before राज् to shine, शानच् aff.
37288: विराजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Illuminated, irradiated, splendid. 	 2. Ma-nifested, made visible.  E. वि before राज् to shine, क्त aff.
37289: विराट m. (-टः) 	 1. A country, one of the midland division of India, pro-bably Berār. 	 2. A sovereign.  E. वि before रट् to sound, aff. घञ् ।
37290: विराटक m. (-कः) An inferior kind of diamond.
37291: विराटज m. (-जः) An inferior sort of diamond, said to be found in the country Virāṭa.  E. विराट the country, ज produced.
37292: विराणिन् m. (-णी) An elephant.  E. वि before रण battle, aff. अण् and इनि added.
37293: विराद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 	 1. Treated with disrespect, reviled, abused. 	 2. Opposed. 	 3. Offended.  E. वि before राध् to accomplish, क्त aff.
37294: विराद्धृ mfn. (-द्धा-द्ध्री-द्धृ) 	 1. Thwarting, opposing. 	 2. Offending, injuring. 3. Abusive, calumnious.  E. वि before राध् to accomplish, aff. तृच् ।
37295: विराध m. (-धः) 	 1. Opposition, prevention. 	 2. Vexation, annoyance. E. वि before राध् to accomplish, घञ् aff.
37296: विराधन n. (-नं) Pain, agony, anguish.  E. वि, राध to accomplish, ल्युट् aff.
37297: विराध्यत् mfn. (-ध्यन्-ध्यन्ती-ध्यत्) 	 1. Opposing, thwarting. 	 2. Offending, annoying, injuring.  E. वि before राध् to accomplish, शतृ aff.
37298: विराम m. (-मः) 	 1. End, conclusion, cessation, term. 	 2. Rest, cessation from labour. 	 3. Stop, pause of the voice. 	 4. Interval between words or sentences.  E. वि before रम् to stop, aff. घञ् ।
37299: विराल m. (-लः) A cat.  E. विडाल as above, and ड changed to र ।
37300: विराव m. (-वः) Sound, noise.  E. वि before रु to make a noise, aff. घञ् ।
37301: विराविन् mfn. (-वी-विणी-वि) Shouting, roaring, crying, &c. 	 f. (-णी) 	 1. A broom. 	 2. The name of a river. 	 3. Weeping, crying.  E. विराव noise, इनि and ङीप् affs.
37302: विरिक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Purged.  E. वि before रिच् to void by stool, क्त aff.
37304: विरिञ्जन m. (-नः) BRAHMĀ. see the next.
37305: विरिञ्चि m. (-ञ्चिः) 	 1. BRAHMĀ. 	 2. VISHṆU. 	 3. ŚIVA. 37306: विरिब्ध m. (-ब्धः) A note, a tone.  E. वि before रेभ् to sound, क्त aff., इट् aug.; form irr.
37307: विरुग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) 	 1. Broken, bent. 	 2. Blunted. 	 3. Destroyed.  E. वि before रुज् to be sick, क्त aff.
37308: विरुत f. (-ता) 	 1. Screamed. 	 2. Resounding. 	 n. (-तं) 	 1. Singing, chirp-ing. 	 2. Din, noise, clamour.

37530: विशस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 	 1. Praised, celebrated. 	 2. Arrogant, ill-man-nered, rude. 	 3. Cut up.  E. वि before शस् to praise, aff. क्त ।
37531: विशस्त्र mfn. (-स्त्रः-स्त्रा-स्त्रं) Disarmed, unarmed.  E. वि and शस्त्र a weapon.

37536: विशाखल n. (-लं) An attitude in shooting.  E. विशाखा, लच् pleonasm.

37538: विशारण n. (-णं) Killing, slaying, slaughter.  E. वि before शॄ to injure, aff. ल्युट् ।
37539: विशारद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 	 1. Learned, wise. 	 2. Confident, bold, pre-suming. 	 3. Famous, celebrated.  E. विशाल great, extensive, (fame, &c.) and दा to give, aff. क, the ल changed to र ।
37540: विशाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Great, large. 	 2. Broad. 	 3. Great, eminent, illustrious. 	 m. (-लः) 	 1. A sort of deer. 	 2. A sort of bird. 	 f. (-ला) 	 1. The city Ougein. 	 2. Bitter apple, (Cucumis colocynthis.) 	 3. Name of a river.  E. वि particle, and शालच् aff.; or विश् to enter, Unādi aff. कालन् ।
37541: विशालकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Well-born. 	 n. (-लं) An illustrious family.  E. विशाल, कुल race.
37542: विशालता f. (-ता) 	 1. Width, breadth. 	 2. Magnitude, bulk. 	 3. Eminence, distinction.  E. विशाल large, तल् aff. of the abstract; also विशालत्व n. (-त्वं) ।
37543: विशालत्वच् m. (-त्वक्) A tree, (Echites scholaris.) “सप्तच्छदवृक्षे”  E. विशाल large, त्वच् skin or bark.
37544: विशालाक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) Having large or beautiful eyes. 	 m. (-क्षः) 	 1. ŚIVA. 	 2. GARUḌA. 	 f. (-क्षी) PĀRVATĪ.  E. विशाल large, and अक्षि the eye, टच् aff.
37545: विशिख m. (-खः) 	 1. An arrow. 	 2. An iron crow. 	 3. A kind of reed. f. (-खा) 	 1. A spade, a hoe. 	 2. A highway, a broad or carriage road. 	 3. 37546: विशिञ्जान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Sounding.  E. वि before शिजि to sound, शानच् aff.
37547: विशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sharpened.  E. वि before शि to sharpen, क्त aff.
37548: विशिप n. (-पं) A palace, a temple.  E. विश् to enter, अप् Unādi aff., and इ substituted for the pen. vowel; or विश्-इपक् ।
37549: विशिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Endowed with, possessed of, having inherent or attached to. 	 2. Excellent, superior, distinguished. 	 3. Especial, peculiar. 	 4. Having distinctive and exclusive properties.  E. वि before शिष् to tell qualities, aff. क्त ।
37550: विशिष्टता f. (-ता) 	 1. Excellence, distinction. 	 2. Individuality, having distinguishing or characteristic qualities. 	 3. Peculiarity, as of duty &c.  E. तल् added to the last; also विशिष्टत्व n. (-त्वं) ।
37551: विशीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 	 1. Dry, dried up, withered, decayed. 	 2. Wasted, impaired. 	 3. Shattered. 	 4. Shrunk, shrivelled.  E. वि be-fore शॄ to injure, क्त aff.
37552: विशीर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To crumble or fall to ruin, likely or fit to.  E. वि, शॄ to injure, यत् aff.
37553: विशीर्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being wasted or destroyed, decaying, perishing.  E. वि before, शॄ to injure, pass. v., शानच् aff.
37554: विशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Ill-behaved, indecorous, immoral.  E. वि priv., शील behaved.
37555: विशुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 	 1. Pure, purified, clean, cleansed, free from vice or fault. 	 2. Pious, virtuous. 	 3. Humble, modest, compliant. 	 4. Corrected.  E. वि intensitive prefix, शुध् to be pure or clean, aff. क्त ।
37556: विशुद्धि f. (-द्धिः) 	 1. Purity, purification. 	 2. Equality, similarity. 	 3. Re-moval of doubt. 	 4. Correctness. 	 5. In Algebra, a subtractive quantity.  E. वि before शुद्धि purity.
37557: विशुद्धिभाज् mfn. (-भाक्) Pure, free from soil or vice.  E. विशुद्धि, and भाज् who shares.
37559: विशृङ्खल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Unchecked, unrestrained, unfettered, (liter-ally or figuratively.) 	 2. Dissolute.  E. वि privative, शृङ्खला a chain.
37560: विशेष m. (-षः) 	 1. Sort, kind, manner. 	 2. Difference, individual or specific identity and consequent distinction from every other individual or species. 	 3. (In logic,) The peculiar attribute, (predi-cabile proprium,) the cause of preception or conclusion. 	 4. Excellence, superiority. 	 5. A limb, a member. 	 6. A mark on the forehead with Sandal. 	 7. A figure of rhetoric, distinguished as of three kinds all implying variety of means or effect. 	 8. A change for the better, a favourable turn, (as in sickness.) 	 9. Name of the mundane egg. 	 10. Individuality, considered as one of the seven Padārthas in Vaiśeshika Phil. 	 11. A word which limits the meaning of another word.  E. वि discriminative prefix, शिष् to attribute or distinguish by attributes, aff. घञ् ।
37561: विशेषक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Discriminative, distinguishing, attributive, characteristic. 	 mn. (-कः-कं) 	 1. A mark on the forehead made with Sandal, &c. and worn either as an ornament or sectarial distinc-tion. 	 2. An attribute, a predicate. 	 3. An arrangement of poetical composition.  E. वि before, शिष् to attribute or distinguish, aff. ण्वुल् ।
37562: विशेषकाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Amorous, desirous.  E. विशेष, काम who desires.

37564: विशेषज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Wise, intelligent.  E. विशेष, and ज्ञ who knows.
37565: विशेषण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Discriminative, attributive. 	 2. Distinctive, (as a property, &c.) 	 n. (-णं) 	 1. Distinguishing, discriminating. 	 2. An epithet, an attributive, an adjective, (opposed to विशेष्य.)  E. वि before शिष् to distinguish by attributes, aff. ल्युट् or युच् ।
37566: विशेषणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be discriminated or distinguished, what may or ought to be marked as distinct.  E. वि before शिष् to dis-tinguish, अनीयर् aff.
37567: विशेषतस् Ind. Especially, particularly, specifically.  E. विशेष and तसि aff.
37568: विशेषधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) Peculiar or different duty.  E. विशेष, and धर्म्म duty.
37569: विशेषभावना f. (-ना) 	 1. Reflecting on or perceiving differences. 	 2. (In algebra,) Composition by the difference of the products.  E. विशेष, and भावना considering.
37570: विशेषलक्षण n. (-णं) Specific or characteristic mark or sign.  E. विशेष, and लक्षण mark.
37571: विशेषवचन n. (-नं) Special or different text.  E. विशेष and वचन a text.
37572: विशेषविद्वस् m. (-द्वान्) A philosopher.  E. विशेष excellence, विद्वान् learned.

37579: विशोधनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be cleaned or purified, to be freed from soil, fault, &c.  E. वि before शुध् to be pure, causal v., अनीयर् aff.; also विशोधितव्य and विशोध्य ।
37580: विशोधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Purified, cleansed, freed from soil, &c.  E. वि before शुध् to be pure, causal v., क्त aff.

37582: विशोधिन् mfn. (-धी-धिनी-धि) 	 1. Cleaning, purifying. 	 2. Clearing.  E. वि before, शुध् to be pure, causal v., णिनि aff.

37591: विश्रम m. (-मः) Rest, repose, cessation from fatigue or work.  E. वि pri-vative, श्रम् to be weary, aff. अच्; also with घञ्, विश्राम ।
37592: विश्रमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wearied, exhausted.  E. विश्रम, and इतच् aff.

37599: विश्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 	 1. Rested, reposed. 	 2. Ceasing, desisting from. 3. Calm, composed.  E. वि before श्रान्त the same.
37600: विश्रान्ति f. (-न्तिः) Rest, repose, cessation from toil or occupation.  E. वि before श्रम् to be weary, aff. क्तिन् ।
37601: विश्राम m. (-मः) 	 1. Rest, repose. 	 2. Pause, stop, cessation. 	 3. Tranquility, composure.  E. वि before श्रम् to be weary, aff. घञ् ।
37602: विश्राव m. (-वः) 	 1. Fame, celebrity. 	 2. Flowing, dropping.  E. वि before श्रु to hear or drop, aff. घञ् ।

37604: विश्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Famous, celebrated, renowned. 	 2. Known. 3. Pleased, happy. 	 4. Dropped, flowing.  E. वि before श्रुत heard.

37606: विश्लथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Languid, relaxed, untied.  E. वि before श्लथ loose.
37607: विश्लथाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Weak, relaxed.  E. विश्लथ, अङ्ग the body.
37608: विश्लिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Separated, disunited.  E. वि, श्लिष् to unite, क्त aff.

37610: विश्लेषजाति f. (-तिः) (In arithmetic,) The assimilation of difference, the reduction of fractional difference.  E. विश्लेष, and जाति kind.
37612: विश्व mfn. (-श्वः-श्वा-श्वं) All, entire, whole, universal. 	 n. (-श्वं) The world, the universe. 	 m. Plu.
