37619: विश्वकसेन m. (-नः) 	 1. VISHṆU. 	 2. A particular form of that deity, to whom the fragments of a sacrifice to VISHṆU are offered. 	 f. (-ना) A plant, commonly priyangu.  E. विश्वक् every way, and सेना an army; more properly विष्वक्सेन ।
37620: विश्वगन्ध m. (-न्धः) An onion. 	 n. (-न्धं) Myrrh. 	 f. (-न्धा) The earth.  E. विश्व all, universal, and गन्ध fragrance.
37621: विश्वगायत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Spreading or going in every direction. E. विश्वक, आयत् going.
37622: विश्वगोप्तृ m. (-प्ता) 	 1. VISHṆU. 	 2. INDRA.  E. विश्व all, गोप्तृ preserver.
37623: विश्वङ्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) All-creating, making all. 	 m. (-रः) The eye.  E. विश्व all, and कर making.
37624: विश्वजन n. (-नं) All men, mankind.  E. विश्व, जन people.
37625: विश्वजनीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Good for or suitable to all men.  E. विश्वजन, ख aff.
37626: विश्वजनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Suitable or relating to all men.  E. विश्व all, जन mankind, छ aff.
37627: विश्वजन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Fit or good for all men.  E. विश्वजन, यत् aff.
37628: विश्वजित् mfn. (-जित्) All-subduing. 	 m. (-जित्) 	 1. A particular ceremony or sacrifice. 	 2. The cord of noose of VARUṆA.  E. विश्व all, and जित् what subdues.
37629: विश्वञ्च् mfn. (-श्वङ्-शुची-श्वक्) Going every where. Ind. Adv. or n. (-श्वक्) Every where, universally.  E. विश्व all, अञ्च् to go, aff. क्विप्; it is more usually written both in simple and compound forms विष्वञ्च्, from a different etymology.
37630: विश्वतस् Ind. Every where, all around, universally.  E. विश्व all, तसि aff.
37633: विश्वदेव m. (-वः) A Viśvadeva, a deity of a particular class: see विश्व. 	 f. (-वा) A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.)  E. विश्व all, दिव् to sport, aff. घञ् ।
37634: विश्वद्र्यञ्च् mfn. (-द्र्यङ्-द्रीची-द्र्यक्) Moving every where, or universally. E. विश्वक every where, अद्रि substituted for the final, अञ्च् to go, aff. क्विप्; also विष्वद्र्यञ्च् ।
37635: विश्वधारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) All-sustaining. 	 m. (-री) A deity. 	 f. (-रिणी) The earth.  E. विश्व all, and धारिन् upholding.
37636: विश्वनाथ m. (-थः) A name of Śiva, especially as the object of peculiar adoration at Benares.  E. विश्व the universe, नाथ lord.
37637: विश्वपा m. (-पाः) 	 1. The sun. 	 2. The moon. 	 3. Fire. 	 4. The protector of all.  E. विश्व, and पा who nourishes.
37639: विश्वप्सन् m. (-प्सा) 	 1. Fire, or the deity of fire. 	 2. The moon. 	 3. The sun. 	 4. A god. 	 5. The earth.  E. विश्व all, प्सा to eat, Unādi aff. कनिन् ।
37640: विश्वबोध m. (-धः) A Buddha or Bauddha deified saint.  E. विश्व all, and बोध who explains.
37641: विश्वभुज् mfn. (-भुक्) 	 1. Enjoying or possessing all things. 	 2. Eating all things.  E. विश्व, and भुज् who possesses.
37642: विश्वभू m. (-भूः) The third of the seven Buddhas, according to some systems.  E. विश्व all, and भू being.
37643: विश्वभेषज n. (-जं) Dry ginger.  E. विश्व all, (diseases,) भेषज a medicament.
37644: विश्वभोजन n. (-नं) Eating all sorts of food.  E. विश्व, and भोजन food.
37645: विश्वभोजस् m. (-जाः) One who enjoys all things.  E. विश्व all, भुज् to enjoy, Unādi aff. असि ।
37646: विश्वमदा f. (-दा) One of the seven tongues of fire.  E. विश्व all, मद् to in-toxicate, affs. अङ् and टाप् ।
37647: विश्वम्मर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) All-sustaining. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. VISHṆU. 	 2. INDRA. 	 f. (-रा) The earth.  E. विश्व all, (things,) भृ to support or nourish, अच् aff., मुम् augment.
37648: विश्वम्भराधिप m. (-पः) A king.  E. विश्वम्भरा the earth, and अधिप ruler.
37649: विश्वयु m. (-युः) Air, wind.  E. विश्व all, यु to join, aff. क्विप् ।
37650: विश्वराज् m. (-राट् or राड्) A universal sovereign.  E. विश्व all, राज् who rules.
37651: विश्वरूप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) Taking all forms, existing in all forms, universal, omnipresent. 	 m. (-पः) VISHṆU. 	 n. (-पं) Agallochum. E. विश्व all, रूप form.
37652: विश्वरेतस् m. (-ताः) BRAHMĀ.  E. विश्व all, रेतस् seed.
37653: विश्वरोचन m. (-नः) An esculent root, (Arum colocasia.)  E. विश्व all, रोचन digestive.
37654: विश्वविधायिन् m. (-यी) A deity, a creator.  E. विश्व, विधायिन् who makes.
37655: विश्ववेदस् m. (-दाः) 	 1. A sage, a saint, one who knows all things. 	 2. An epithet of AGNI.  E. विश्व all, विदि to know, aff. असि ।
37656: विश्वव्यापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) All-pervading, every where diffused.  E. विश्व, and व्यापक what pervades.
37657: विश्वव्यापिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) All-diffused or pervading.  E. विश्व, and व्यापिन् what spreads.
37658: विश्वव्याप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Universal diffusion or permeation.  E. विश्व, and व्याप्ति spreading.
37659: विश्वसन n. (-नं) Trusting, confiding in.  E. वि before श्वस् to breathe, ल्युट् aff.
37660: विश्वसनीय f. (-या) Capable of inspiring confidence.
37661: विश्वसह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) All-enduring. 	 f. (-हा) 	 1. The earth. 	 2. One of the seven tongues of fire.  E. विश्व all, सह् to bear, affs. अच् and टाप् ।
37662: विश्वसारक n. (-कं) The prickly pear, (Cactus Indicus, Rox.) “फणिमन्सा.” E. विश्व all, सार essence, and कन् added.
37663: विश्वसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Trusted, believed or confided in.  E. वि before श्वस् to breathe, aff. क्त, with इट् augment.
37664: विश्वसृज् m. (-सृक्, सृग्, सृट् or सृड्) BRAHMĀ.  E. विश्व all, (the universe,) सृज् to create, aff. क्विन् ।
37665: विश्वस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Trusted, confided in, faithful. 	 f. (-स्ता) A widow.  E. वि implying kind or sort, or in the fem. form, privation, and श्वस् to live or breathe, aff. क्त ।
37666: विश्वस्रष्टृ m. (-ष्टा) The creator of all.  E. विश्व, स्रष्टृ creator.
37667: विश्वाची f. (-ची) One of the Apsarās or courtezans of Swarga.  E. विश्वमञ्चति अन्च्-क्विप् ।
37668: विश्वात्मन् m. (-त्मा) BRAHMĀ. 	 n. (-त्म) The soul of the world, the univer-sal spirit, GOD.  E. विश्व all, and आत्मन् soul.
37669: विश्वाधायस् m. (-याः) A deity, a god.  E. विश्व all, आङ् before धा to hold or support, असि aff., form irr.
37670: विश्वामित्र m. (-त्रः) A Muni, the son of GĀDHĪ, originally of the military order, but who became by long and painful austerities a Brahmarshi, in which character he appears in the RĀMĀYAṆA, as the early preceptor and counsellor of RĀMA.  E. विश्व all, मित्र the friend, and the vowel of the prefix made long in this sense; if attributively used, the compound is विश्वमित्र ।
37671: विश्वामित्रप्रिय m. (-यः) The cocoanut tree.  E. विश्वामित्र the saint VIŚWĀ-MITRA, and प्रिय beloved, having been created by the saint.
37672: विश्वावसु m. (-सुः) One of the Gandharbas or celestial singers. 	 f. (-सुः) A particular night.
37673: विश्वास m. (-सः) 	 1. Trust, faith, confidence. 	 2. A confidential commu-nication.  E. वि before श्वस् to breathe or live, aff. घञ् ।
37674: विश्वासकारण n. (-णं) Cause or motive of trust.  E. विश्वास, कारण cause.
37675: विश्वासकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) Inspiring confidence or faith.  E. विश्वास, and कृत् who or what makes.
37676: विश्वासघात m. (-तः) Violation of trust, treachery.  E. विश्वास, and घात destroying.
37677: विश्वासघातक m. (-कः) A traitor, one who betrays confidence.  E. विश्वास, and घातक who destroys; also विश्वासघातिन् ।
37678: विश्वासपात्र n. (-त्रं) A confidential agent, one worthy to be trusted. E. विश्वास, and पात्र person.
37679: विश्वासप्रतिपन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Confiding, trusting.  E. विश्वास, and प्रतिपन्न possessed of.
37680: विश्वासप्रद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Inspiring confidence.  E. विश्वास, प्रद who gives.
37681: विश्वासभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Breach of faith, violation of confidence.  E. विश्वास, and भङ्ग breaking.
37682: विश्वासभूमि f. (-मिः) An object of trust, a person worthy of confidence. E. विश्वास, and भूमि place.
37683: विश्वासस्थान n. (-नं) An object or person of trust or confidence.  E. विश्वास, and स्थान place.
37684: विश्वासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Inspired with confidence.  E. वि before श्वस् to breathe, causal v., क्त aff.
37685: विश्वासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) 	 1. Trusting, confiding in. 	 2. Honest, trusty. E. विश्वास, and इनि aff.
37686: विश्वास्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) 	 1. To be trusted or depended on, to be believed. 	 2. To be encouraged or inspired with confidence. Ind. Having encouraged or inspired with confidence.  E. वि before श्वस् to breathe, ण्यत् aff; or causal v., and यत् or ल्यप् aff.
37687: विश्वास्यता f. (-ता) Trust-worthiness.  E. विश्वास्य, and तल् aff.
37689: विश्वेश m. (-शः) ŚIVA.  E. विश्व all, ईश lord: see the next.
37690: विश्वेश्वर m. (-रः) ŚIVA, under a form or appellation in which espe-cially he is worshipped at Benares, where a celebrated temple is appropriated to him in the character of lord or god of the uni-verse.  E. विश्व the universe, and ईश्वर god; also similar compounds, as विश्वेश, विश्वनाथ, &c.
37691: विष् r. 6th cl. (विषति) To pervade. (औ) औविष r. 9th cl. (विष्णाति) To have no occasion or use for, to separate or withdraw from, to disjoin. (उ) विषु r. 1st cl. (वेषति) To sprinkle. (औ इर ऌ) औ इर विषॢ r. 3rd cl. (वेवेष्टि-वेविष्टे) 	 1. To pervade, to spread or extend through nature, &c. 	 2. To go to, to go against.
37692: विष् f. (-विट्) 	 1. Fæces, ordure. 	 2. Diffusion, spreading. 	 3. A virgin. E. विष् to pervade, aff. क्विप् ।
37693: विष mn. (-षः-षं) Poison, venom. 	 n. (-षं) 	 1. Water. 	 2. The fibres attached to the stalk of the lotus. 	 3. Gum-myrrh. 	 4. A vegetable poison, (Aconitum ferox.) 	 f. (-षा) A tree, the bark of which is used in dye-ing of a red colour.  E. विष् to pervade, aff. क ।
37694: विषकृमिन्याय m. (-यः) The maxim of a worm in poison. It denotes a state of things which, though fatal to others, is not so to those who are born therein or naturalized thereto.
37695: विषक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 	 1. Clinging or adhering to closely. 	 2. In contact with.  E. वि before षञ्ज् to embrace, क्त aff.
37696: विषघा f. (घा) A twining shrub, (Menispermum cordifolium.)  E. विष poison, हन् to destroy, aff. ड, घ substituted for the final. “गुडूच्याम्”.
37697: विषघातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) Antidotic, an antidote. 	 m. (-ती) A tree, (Mimosa sirisa.)  E. विष poison, and घातिन् removing.
37698: विषघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Antidotic, an antidote. 	 m. (-घ्नः) 	 1. A tree, (Mimosa sirisa.) 	 2. A plant, (Hedysarum alhaji.) 	 3. Beleric myrobalan. (Terminalia belerica.) 	 f. (-घ्नी) 	 1. A potherb, (Hingtsha repens.) 2. A plant, commonly Bichhati. 	 3. Turmeric. 	 4. Bitter apple or colocynth.  E. विष poison, and घ्न what destroys.
37699: विषजुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Poisoned, suffering from poison. 	 2. Poison-ous.  E. विष, and जुष्ट united with.
37700: विषज्वर m. (-रः) A buffalo.  E. विषमिव प्राणहन्ता ज्वरो यस्य ।
37701: विषणि m. (-णिः) A sort of snake.
37702: विषण्ड n. (-ण्डं) The fibres of the stalk of the water-lily. “मृणाले ।”
37703: विषण्ण mfn. (-ण्णः-ण्णा-ण्णं) Dejected, desponding, spiritless, disinclined to exertion.  E. वि before सद् to go, aff. क्त ।
37704: विषण्णता f. (-ता) Dejection, lassitude, want of energy or spirit, espe-cially as one of the effects of unsuccessful love.  E. विषण्ण relaxed, तल् aff. of the abstract; also with त्व विषण्णत्वं ।
37705: विषण्णवदन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Looking sad or dejected.  E. विषण्ण, and वदन face: also विषण्णमुख, &c.
37706: विषतुल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Fatal, deadly.  E. विष, and तुल्य equal to.
37708: विषद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 	 1. Yielding or giving poison. 	 2. Shedding water. m. (-दः) A cloud. 	 n. (-दं) Green vitriol.  E. विष poison or water, and दा to give, aff. क; or वि + षद्-अच् ।
37709: विषदंष्ट्रा f. (-ष्ट्रा) A medicinal plant and antidote, commonly Sarpa-kankāli.  E. विष venom, दंष्ट्र a tooth.
37710: विषदन्तक m. (-कः) A snake.  E. विष poison, दन्त tooth, and कप् added.
37711: विषदर्शनमृत्युक m. (-कः) The Chakora bird.  E. विष poison, (perhaps put for the snake,) दर्शन seeing, मृत्युक who dies.
37712: विषधर mfn. (-रः-रा or री-रं) Venomous, poisonous. 	 m. (-रः) A snake. E. विष poison, धर who has.
37714: विषधात्री f. (-त्री) The wife of JARATKĀRU, and goddess presiding over snakes.  E. विष venom, धात्री a nurse.
37715: विषनाशन m. (-नः) 	 1. A tree, (Mimosa sirisa.) 	 2. An antidote. 	 n. (-नं) Removing or curing poison.  E. विष poison, and नाशन destroying.
37716: विषनाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Antidote. 	 f. (-नी) A plant: see विषदंष्ट्रा. E. विष venom, नाशिन् destroying.
37717: विषनुद् m. (-नुत्) A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) “श्योनाकवृक्षे”.  E. विष poison, नुद् to eject, aff. क्विप् ।
37718: विषपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A plant, (Vangueria spinosa.) 	 n. (-ष्पं) The blue lotus. E. विष poison, and पुष्प flower.
37719: विषपुष्पक m. (-कः) Sickness or disease induced by eating poisonous flowers.  E. विष poison, पुष्प a flower; or विषपुष्प the Vangueria, &c., कन् aff. in this sense.
37720: विषप्रयोग m. (-गः) Employing or administering poison.  E. विष and प्रयोग application.
37721: विषभक्षण n. (-णं) Taking poison.  E. विष, and भक्षण feeding.
37722: विषभिषज् m. (-षक्) A dealer in antidotes, a snake-catcher, or one who pretends to cure the bite of a snake.  E. विष poison, भिषज् a doctor.
37723: विषभुजङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A poisonous snake.  E. विष poison, and भुजङ्ग a snake.
37724: विषभृत् mfn. (-भृत्) Venomous, poisonous. 	 m. (-भृत्) A snake.  E. विष, and भृत् who or what has.
37725: विषम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 	 1. Difficult, (of access,) rough, uneven. 	 2. Diffi-cult, &c., (of comprehending,) as a book. 	 3. Painful, difficult, troublesome. (in general.) 	 4. Odd, (in numbers.) 	 5. Unparalleled, unequalled. 	 6. Wicked, dishonest. 	 7. Fearful, frightful, awful. 8. Irregular, unequal. 	 9. Adverse, unpropitious. 	 n. (-मं) 	 1. Difficulty, pain. 	 2. Unevenness, inequality. 	 3. Oddness, (in numeration.) 	 4. An inaccessible place, a thicket, a precipice. 	 5. (In rhetoric.) Description of unusual or incompatible cause and effect.  E. वि privative or contra-indicative, before सम even, smooth, equal, &c. and स after the इ of the prefix, changed to ष ।
37726: विषमकर्ण m. (-र्णः) The hypothenuse of a right-angled triangle, formed between the gnomon and the two sides of the shadow. विषम, and कर्ण hypothenuse.
37727: विषमकर्म्मन् n. (र्म्म) 	 1. An odd or unparalleled act. 	 2. (In arithmetic,) The finding of quantities from their difference or that of their squares.  E. विषम and कर्म्मन् act.
37728: विषमखात n. (-तं) An irregular excavation or one with unequal sides. E. विषम and खात excavation.
37729: विषमचतुरस्र n. (-स्रं) An unequal four-sided figure, a trapezium.  E. विषम, चतुरस्र four-angled.
37730: विषमच्छद m. (-दः) A plant, (Echites scholaris.)  E. विषम odd, and छद a leaf; having seven leaves on a stalk. “सप्तच्छद वृक्षे ।”
37731: विषमच्छाया f. (-या) The shadow of the gnomon at noon when the sun is in the equinoxes.  E. विषम oblique, and छाया shadow.
37732: विषमज्वर m. (-रः) 	 1. A violent fever. 	 2. Irregularly remittent fever. E. विषम and ज्वर a fever.
37733: विषमत्रिभुज m. (-जः) A scalene triangle.  E. विषम unequal, त्रिभुज triangle.
37734: विषमनयन m. (-नः) ŚIVA.  E. विषम odd, नयन an eye; having a third eye in his forehead.
37735: विषमन्त्र m. (-न्त्रः) A snake-catcher, one who by pretended charms, &c. attracts snakes and cures the bite. 	 n. (-न्त्रं) A charm for curing snake bites.  E. विष poison, मन्त्र a charm.
37736: विषममय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Resulting from or produced by inequality.  E. विषम, and मयट् aff.
37737: विषमरूप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) Resulting from or produced by unequal quantities or qualities.  E. विषम uneven, and रूप्य aff. in this sense.
37738: विषमविभाग m. (-गः) Unequal division of property amongst co-heirs. E. विषम uneven, विभाग portion of inheritance.
37739: विषमशायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Sleeping irregularly.  E. विषम and शायिन् who sleeps.
37740: विषमशिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Unjust, unfair, (division)  E. विषम, शिष्ट left.
37741: विशमशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Uneven. 	 2. Uneasy.  E. विषम, शील having.
37742: विषमसाहस n. (-सं) Temcrity, daring.  E. विषम and साहस violence.
37743: विषमस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 	 1. Standing unevenly. 	 2. Inaccessible, safely posted. 	 3. Being in difficulty, &c.  E. विषम uneven, स्थ who stays.
37744: विषमाक्ष m. (-क्षः) ŚIVA.  E. विषम odd, अक्षि the eye, aff. टच्; having a third eye, or one in his forehead.
37745: विषमायुध m. (-धः) KĀMADEVA.  E. विषम odd, आयुध a weapon; armed with five arrows.
37746: विषमाशन n. (-नं) Eating irregularly, either as to quantity or time.  E. विषम and अशन eating.
37747: विषमाशय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Crafty, dishonest.  E. विषम and आशय asylum.
37748: विषमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Made or become uneven, irregular, &c. 	 2. Made difficult.  E. विषम and इतच् aff.
37749: विषमीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Produced or resulting from inequalities. E. विषम uneven, and छ aff.
37750: विषमुष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A kind of shrub of medicinal properties, commonly termed Bishdori or Kadhsinh.  E. विष poison, मुष्टि a handful.
37751: विषमृत्यु m. (-त्युः) The Chakora bird.  E. विष poison, and मृत्यु death.
37752: विषमेक्षण m. (-णः) ŚIVA.  E. विषम odd, (three,) ईक्षण eye.
37753: विषमेषु m. (-षुः) KĀMADEVA.  E. विषम odd, (five,) इषु an arrow.
37754: विषय m. (-यः) 	 1. Any object of sense, any thing perceivable by the senses, as colour, form, flavour, odour and sound; they are five for the five Indriyas, viz:--शब्द for the ear, स्पर्श for the skin, रूप for the eye, रस for the tongue, गन्ध for the nose. 	 2. An object in general, as of affection or desire, &c. 	 3. Worldly object or pursuit, affair, business, transaction, &c. 	 4. A country, whether inhabited or uninhabited. 	 5. Refuge, asylum. 	 6. Department, sphere, element, home, province, that which is peculiarly known or frequented, as a particular study by its professors, a particular town by its townsfolk, water by fish, air by birds, &c. 	 7. A collec-tion of villages. 	 8. Any thing indigenous or peculiar to a province, &c. 	 9. A religious obligation or observance. 	 10. Semen virile. 	 11. A lover, a husband. 	 12. Sensual enjoyment, sensuality. 	 13. Sub-ject, topic, subject-matter. 	 14. The subject of an Adhikaraṇa, (in Phil.) 	 15. A thing aimed at. 	 16. Scope, range, compass, reach. 17. A realm, a kingdom, a domain.  E. वि before षि to bind, aff. अच् ।
37755: विषयक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Relating to, concerning, (any object.)  E. विषय and कन् added.
37756: विषयकत्व n. (-त्वं) State of an affair, circumstance or thing.  E. त्व added to the preceding.
37757: विषयकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Worldly concern or act.  E. विषय, कर्म्म act.
37758: विषयकाम m. (-मः) Desire of worldly goods or pleasures.  E. विषय, काम desire.
37759: विषयग्राम m. (-मः) The aggregate of the objects of sense.
37760: विषयवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Engaged in the affairs of life  E. विषय and वासिन् who abides.
37761: विषयात्मक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Identical with or affecting sensual or worldly objects.  E. विषय and आत्मक own.
37762: विषयाभिरति f. (-तिः) Attachment to the objects of sense.
37763: विषयायिन् m. (-यी) 	 1. A king. 	 2. An organ of sense. 	 3. KĀMADEVA. 	 4. An epicurean, a sensualist, one heedful of objects of sense or attentive to worldly objects. 	 5. A materialist, one who disbelieves the existence of that which is not cognizable by the senses. E. विषय an object of sense, अय् to go, to follow, and इनि aff.
37764: विषयासक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Attached to objects of sense, devoted to the world.  E. विषय and आसक्त attached to.
37765: विषयिन् mfn. (-यी-यिणी-यि) 	 1. Attached to objects of sense, carnal, sen-sual. 	 2. Conversant with or interested in worldly occupations or enjoyments. 	 n. (-यि) An organ of sense. 	 m. (-यी) 	 1. A king. 	 2. The deity KĀMA. 	 3. A sensualist. 	 4. A materialist, one who denies the existence of any thing which is not an object of sense. 5. A man of business.  E. विषय an organ of sense, aff. इन् ।
37766: विषयोपसेवा f. (-वा) Sensuality.  E. विषय and उपसेवा addiction to.
37767: विषल m. (-लः) Poison, venom.  E. विष poison, लच् aff.
37768: विषविद्या f. (-द्या) The administration of antidotes, the cure of poisons by drugs or charms.  E. विष poison, विद्या science.
37769: विषविधान n. (-नं) Administering poison judicially, or by way of ordeal. E. विष, विधान rule.
37770: विषवेग m. (-गः) Absorption of venom, as shewn by some bodily effects or changes.  E. विष poison, and वेग natural excretion.
37771: विषवैद्य m. (-द्यः) A dealer in antidotes, one professing by charms, &c. to cure the bite of a snake.  E. विष poison, and वैद्य physician.
37772: विषशालूक m. (-कः) The root of the lotus.
37773: विषशूक m. (-कः) A wasp.  E. विष venom, and शूक a parrot.
37774: विषशृङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) A wasp.  E. विष poison, शृङ्ग a horn, and इनि poss. aff.
37775: विषसूचक m. (-कः) The Greek partridge, (Perdix rufa.) “चकोर खगे” E. विष poison, and सूचक informer.
37776: विषसृक्कन् m. (-क्का) A wasp.  E. विष poison, सृक्कन् the corner of the mouth.
37777: विषहर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) An antidote, removing venom. 	 f. (-रा or री) The goddess of the serpent race, the sister of VĀSUKI, and wife of JARATKĀRU.  E. विष venom, हृ to take, aff. अप् or टच् ।
37778: विषहृदय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Malicious, malignant, cherishing hatred or hostility.  E. विष, and हृदय the heart.
37779: विषह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) 	 1. To be borne or endured. 	 2. Possible to be determined. Ind. Having borne.  E. वि, षह् to bear, aff. यत् or ल्यप् ।
37780: विषा Ind. Apotte noun. Intellect, understanding. 	 f. (-षा) Ordure, feces. E. षो to destroy, (ignorance,) with वि prefixed, and ओ Unādi aff.
37781: विषाङ्कुर m. (-रः) A spear, a dart.  E. विष poison, अङ्कुर a shoot.
37782: विषाण Subst. 	 mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) 	 1. The horn of an animal. 	 2. The tusks of an elephant. 	 3. The tusk or fang of the boar. 	 f. (-णी) 	 1. A plant, the fruit of which is compared to the horn of a ram, &c. com-monly Mesa Sringī. 	 2. A medicinal root: see क्षीरकाकोली. 	 n. (-णं) A sort of Costus, (C. speciosus.)  E. वि before अस् to be, चानश् aff.; the initial of the radical rejected, and स changed to ष; otherwise, वि before षण् to serve, aff. घञ्; or विष वा-कानच् ।
37783: विषाणिका f. (-का) A sort of plant, commonly Mesha Shringī.  E. विषाणी as above, and कन् pleonasm; fem. form.
37784: विषाणिन् m. (-णी) 	 1. An elephant. 	 2. A bull. 	 3. Any animal with horns. 	 f. (-णिनी) Having tusks or horns.  E. विषाण a horn, इनि aff.
37785: विषाद m. (-दः) 	 1. Lassitude, dejection, lowness of spirits, want of energy, especially as the result of unrequited love. 	 2. Distress, affliction. 	 2. Disappointment.  E. वि before षद् to go, aff. घञ् ।
37786: विषादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Dejected, disconsolate.  E. विषाद, इनि aff.
37787: विषानन m. (-नः) A snake.  E. विष poison, and आनन the face.
37788: विषान्तक m. (-कः) ŚIVA.  E. विष poison, अन्तक destroyer; having swallow-ed the poison that was produced at the churning of the ocean.
37789: विषापह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Antidotic, an antidote. 	 f. (-हा) A kind of birth-wort, (Aristolochia Indica.)  E. विष poison, and अपह removing.
37790: विषायुध m. (-धः) A snake.  E. विष poison, and आयुध a weapon.
37791: विषार m. (-रः) A snake.  E. विष poison, ऋ to go, aff. अच् ।
37792: विषालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Venomous, poisonous.  E. विष, and आलुच् aff.
37793: विषास्य m. (-स्यः) A snake. 	 f. (-स्या) Marking-nut plant, (Semicarpus anacardium.)  E. विष poison, and आस्य face.
37794: विषीदत् mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्) Sorrowing, despairing.  E. वि before षद् to go, शतृ aff.
37795: विषु Ind. 	 1. Many, various. 	 2. Equally, same, like.  E. विष, कु aff.
37796: विषुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Having or possessing various or uniform motion or extension.  E. विष्वञ्च् going every where, न poss. aff., and the final consonant of the primitive rejected.
37797: विषुप n. (-पं) The equinox: see the next.
37798: विषुव n. (-वं) The first point of ARIES or LIBRA into which the sun enters at the vernal or autumnal equinox.  E. विषु equally, (the night and day,) and व or प aff.; also विषुप ।
37799: विषुवच्छाया f. (-या) The shadow of the gnomon at noon when the sun is in the equinoctial points.  E. विषुव and छाया shade.
37800: विषुवत् n. (-वत्) The equinoctial point.  E. विषु equally, (long, the day and night,) and मतुप् poss. aff.
37801: विषुवदिन n. (-नं) The day of the equinox.  E. विषुव and दिन day.
37803: विषुवसङ्क्रान्ति f. (-न्तिः) The passage of the sun to the next sign at the equinoxes.  E. विषुव, and सङ्क्रान्ति sun's entrance into a sign.
37804: विष्क् r. 10th cl. (विष्कयति-ते) To see, to perceive. (विष्कयते) To injure or kill.
37805: विष्कन्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) Going, going in various directions, dispersing. E. वि before स्कदि to go, तृन् aff.; also विस्कन्तृ ।
37806: विष्कन्द m. (-न्दः) Going, dispersing.  E. वि before स्कदि to go, अच् aff.; also विस्कन्द ।
37807: विष्कन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 	 1. Gone. 	 2. Gone in various directions, dis-persed.  E. वि before स्कन्द् to go, क्त aff.
37808: विष्कम्भ m. (-म्भः) 	 1. The first of the twenty-seven astronomical periods, called Yogās or Yoga star of the first lunar mansion. 	 2. Obstacle, hindrance, impediment, resistance. 	 3. Spreading, extension. 	 4. Act, doing any thing. 	 5. A posture of the devotees called Yogīs. 6. One of the performers at a dramatic entertainment, either an actor who in the intervals of the scenes explains to the audience the progress of the story, or one or two of the personages of the drama, who do the same in a soliloquy or dialogue. 	 7. A tree. 	 8. The bolt or bar of a door. 	 9. A post, the roof-tree of a house. 	 10. The diameter of a circle.  E. वि before ष्कभि to stop or hinder, aff. घञ्; or वि + स्कन्भ्-अच्; also with कन् added, विष्कम्भक ।
37809: विष्कम्भक m. (-कः) A Yoga, &c.: see the last.
37810: विष्कम्भिन् mfn. (-म्भी-म्भिनी-म्भि) Obstructive, impeding. 	 m. (-म्भी) The bolt or bar of a door.  E. विष्कम्भ obstruction, and इनि aff.
37811: विष्किर m. (-रः) 	 1. A bird in general. 	 2. Pulling or tearing to pieces. 	 3. A cock.  E. वि before कॄ to scatter, and क aff., with सुट् aug.
37812: विष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Entered, penetrated, pervaded. 	 f. (-ष्टा) Fæces. E. विष् to pervade, aff. क्त ।
37813: विष्टप mn. (-पः-पं) A world.  E. विश् to enter, (into which,) कपन् aff., तुट् aug.; also विष्टभ ।
37814: विष्टभ n. (-भं) A world.  E. विश् to pervade, अभच् aff., the vowel unchan-ged; deriv. irr.
37815: विष्टब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) 	 1. Hindered, obstructed. 	 2. Stayed, fixed, firm, well-supported. 	 3. Placed in or upon. 	 4. Paralysed, made stiff or motionless.  E. वि before स्तभि to stop, क्त aff.
37816: विष्टम्भ m. (-म्भः) 	 1. Impediment, hindrance, obstacle. 	 2. Stopping, stay-ing. 	 3. Placing in or upon. 	 4. A disease, obstruction of urine or fæces, ischury, constipation. 	 5. Paralysis, loss of motion.  E. वि before स्तभि to stop or hinder, aff. घञ् ।
37817: विष्टम्भिन् mfn. (-म्भी-म्भिनी-म्भि) 	 1. Stopping, impeding, what hinders or obstructs. 	 2. Checking, (as perspiration,) chilling. 	 3. Making motionless.  E. वि before स्तभि to stop, णिनि aff.
37818: विष्टर m. (-रः) 	 1. A tree. 	 2. A handful of Kuśa or sacred grass. 	 3. A seat, a stool, a chair, a couch, &c. 	 4. The seat of the Brāhman, either real or in effigy, as presiding at a sacrifice. 	 5. A bed. 	 6. A seat made of twenty-five straws of Kuśa grass tied up in a sheaf. E. वि before स्तृ to spread, aff. अप् and स changed to ष ।
37819: विष्टरश्रवस् m. (-वाः) VISHṆU.  E. विष्टर a tree, श्रु to hear, aff. असुन् ।
37820: विष्टरस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Sitting on a seat, or reclining on a bed of leaves.  E. विष्टर and स्थ who stays.
37821: विष्टार m. (-रः) A form of metre, a species of the order termed Panktī, consisting of a verse of four lines, the first and last of which consist of eight syllables each, and the second and third of twelve each.  E. वि before स्तृ to spread, aff. घञ्, and स changed to ष ।
37822: विष्टि mfn. (-ष्टिः-ष्टिः-ष्टि) Working, labouring, a workman. 	 f. (-ष्टिः) 	 1. Unpaid labour, working without wages. 	 2. Occupation, act, action. 3. Hire, wages. 	 4. The seventh of the variable Karaṇas, or astro-logical periods so termed, each answering to half a lunar day. 	 5. Sending, dispatching. 	 6. Consigning to torture, casting into hell, &c.  E. विश् to enter, (into pain by it,) and क्तिन् or क्तिच् aff.
37823: विष्ठल n. (-लं) A place situated remote or apart.  E. वि implying apart, स्थल a place, and स changed to ष ।
37824: विष्ठा f. (-ष्ठा) 	 1. Fæces, ordure, excrement. 	 2. The belly.  E. वि before स्था to stay, (in the intestines,) affs. अङ् and टाप् ।
37825: विष्णु m. (-ष्णुः) VISHṆU, one of the three principal Hindu deities, and the preserver of the world: during the periods of temporary anni-hilation, he is supposed to sleep on the waters floating on the serpent Śesha: BRAHMĀ is fabled to have sprung from a lotus, which originally grew from the navel of VISHṆU, and the holy river Ganges is said to spring from his foot: the different Avatārs are considered as emanations of this deity, and in KRISHṆA, he is supposed to have been really and wholly incarnate: LAKSHMĪ is his wife, and he is usually represented as a mild and benevolent deity. 	 2. AGNI or fire. 	 3. One of the demigods called Vasus. 	 4. A pure or pious man. 	 5. The name of an ancient law-giver.  E. विश् to enter or pervade, (the universe,) नुक् Unādi aff.
37826: विष्णुक्रान्ता f. (-न्ता) A flower, (Clitorea ternatea.)  E. विष्णु VISHṆU, and क्रान्त overcome. “अपराजिता ।”
37827: विष्णुगुप्त m. (-प्तः) The saint KAUṆḌILYA.  E. विष्णु, गुप्त hidden, having been concealed by VISHṆU when pursued by ŚIVA, whom he had incensed.
37828: विष्णुगृह n. (-हं) The name of a city or country; also Stambapurī.  E. विष्णु, गृह residence.
37829: विष्णुदैवत्या f. (-त्या) The eleventh and twelfth lunar day of each fort-night.  E. विष्णु VISHṆU, and दैवत्य divinity.
37830: विष्णुपद n. (-दं) 	 1. The sky, heaven, atmosphere. 	 2. The sea of milk. 	 3. A lotus. 	 f. (-दी) 	 1. The Ganges. 	 2. One of the twelve Sankrāntis or periods, at which the sun enters a sign of the zodiac, especially the first sign after the equinox.  E. विष्णु, and पद abode, or foot; where VISHṆU resides or rests, or proceeding from his foot.
37831: विष्णुप्रीति f. (-तिः) Land granted rent-free to a BRĀHMANA for the main-tenance of VISHNU'S worship.
37832: विष्णुरथ m. (-थः) Garuḍa, the bird and vehicle of VISHṆU.  E. विष्णु, and रथ car or conveyance.
37833: विष्णुलिङ्गी f. (-ङ्गी) A quail.  E. विष्णु VISHṆU, and लिङ्ग a mark, ङीप् diminutive aff.
37834: विष्णुवल्लभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Beloved by VISHṆU. 	 f. (-भा) 	 1. A plant, (Echites caryophyllata.) 	 2. A small fragrant shrub, (Ocymum sanctum.) 	 3. LAKSHMĪ.  E. विष्णु VISHṆU, वल्लभ the beloved.
37835: विष्णुवाहन m. (-नः) Garuḍa the bird and vehicle of VISHṆU.
37836: विष्पन्द m. (-न्दः) Throbbing, beating.  E. वि before स्पन्दि to go, अच् aff.
37837: विष्फार m. (-रः) The twang of a bow.  E. वि before स्फर् or स्फुर् to expand, aff. घञ्; in the latter, आ is substituted for the vowel, and स is changed to ष; also विस्फार ।
37838: विष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) Deserving death by poison.  E. विष venom, यत् aff.

38539: वेष्य m. (-ष्यः) Water.  E. विष् to pervade, Unādi aff. य ।

NIRVEDA, humility, self-abasement; 2. GLĀNI, weakness, exhaustion; 3. ŚANKĀ, apprehension; 4. ASŪĀ, calumny; 5. MADA, inebriety; 6. ŚHRAMA, fatigue; 7. ĀLASYA, indolence; 8. 38964: व्याघ्राट m. (-टः) A sky-lark.  E. व्याघ्र a tiger, and अट what goes, aff. अच्.

38973: व्यात्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Vast, expanded.  E. वि and आङ् before अत् to go, क्त aff.
38974: व्यात्युक्षी f. (-क्षी) Bathing for amusement, sporting in water.  E. वि and अति before उक्ष् to sprinkle, aff. णच् and अण् and ङीष् added.
38975: व्यादान n. (-नं) Opening, setting open or ajar.  E. वि and आङ् before दा to give, ल्युट् aff.

38978: व्याधभीत m. (-तः) A deer.  E. व्याध a hunter, भीत afraid of.
38979: व्याधाम m. (-मः) INDRA'S thunder-bolt.  E. वि and आङ् before धा to have, मन् aff.
38980: व्याधाव m. (-वः) INDRA'S thunder-bolt.  E. वि and आङ् before धू to trem-ble, causal form, aff. अच् ।

38982: व्याधिकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Causing sickness.  E. व्याधि and कर what makes.

38985: व्याधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sick, ill, disease.  E. व्याधि sickness, इतच् aff.
38986: व्याधियुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Sick, diseased.  E. व्यावि, युक्त joined.
38987: व्याधिरहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Free from disease, convalescent.  E. व्याधि, रहित left.

38990: व्यान m. (-नः) One of the five vital airs, that which is diffused through-out the body.  E. वि before अन् to breathe, aff. घञ् ।

38998: व्यापन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 	 1. Dead, deceased, expired. 	 2. Hurt, injured, killed. 	 3. Deranged, disordered. 	 4. Vitiated, diseased. 	 5. Fallen into misfortune. 	 6. Substituted.  E. वि, आङ् before पद् to go, aff. क्त ।

39044: व्यालीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Thick, clustering.  E. वि and आङ् before ली to waste, क्त aff.
39045: व्यालोल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Tremulous, shaking, waving.  E. वि and आङ् before लोल् to shake, अच् aff.

39047: व्यावकलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Subtracted.  E. वि with आङ् and अव before कल् to count, aff. क्त ।

39171: व्रीडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ashamed, modest.  E. व्रीड्, क्त aff.
39172: व्रीस् r. 1st and 10th cls. (व्रीसति व्रासयति-ते) To hurt or injure, to kill or wound.
39173: व्रीहि m. (-हिः) 	 1. Rice of various kinds: eight principal sorts are enu-merated by native authorities, but the varieties are more numer-ous. 	 2. Rice ripening in the rainy season.  E. व्री to choose, हि aff.
39174: व्रीहिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Having or bearing rice.  E. व्रीहि rice, ठन् aff.
39175: व्रीहिकाञ्चन m. (-नः) A sort of pulse, (Ervum lens or hirsutum, &c.)
39176: व्रीहिन् mfn. (-हि-हिणी-हि) Having rice, (a field, &c.)  E. व्रीहि rice, इनि aff.
39177: व्रीहिभेद m. (-दः) A sort of grain, (Panicum miliaceum.)
39178: व्रीहिमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made or consisting of rice. 	 m. (-यः) A rice-cake offered with ghee as an oblation.  E. व्रीहि rice, and मयट् aff.
39179: व्रीहिराजिक m. (-कः) 	 1. Panic-seed, (Panicum italicum.) 	 2. Another species, (Panicum miliaceum.)  E. व्रीहि rice, राजिक shining, excelling.
39180: व्रीह्यगार n. (-रं) A granary, a shed where rice or other grain is stored.  E. व्रीहि, अगार a house.
39181: व्रुड् r. 6th cl. (व्रुडति) 	 1. To cover. 	 2. To heap. 	 3. To sink.
39182: व्रूस् r. 1st and 10th cls. (व्रूसति व्रूसयति-ते) To hurt or kill.
39183: व्रैह mfn. (-हः-ही-हं) Made of or with rice.  E. व्रीहि rice, and अण् aff.
39184: व्रैहेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Fit for or sown with rice, (a field, &c.)  E. व्रीहि rice, ढक् aff.
39185: व्ली r. 9th cl. (व्लिनाति or व्लीनाति) 	 1. To choose or select. 	 2. To hold, to maintain. 	 3. To go.
39187: श The thirtieth consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet and first of the three sibilants; it is termed the palatal sibilant, and corresponds to “Sh” pronounced softly, as in Shun; in the Roman character it is distinguished by an accent, as Ś.
39188: श m. (-शः) 	 1. A name of ŚIVA. 	 2. A weapon. 	 3. A cutter, a destroyer. n. Adv. (-शं) or Ind. (शं or शम्) Happy, happily, auspiciously. E. शी to sleep or शी to pare, &c., aff. ड ।
39189: शंयु mfn. (-युः-युः-युं) Happy, prosperous, fortunate. 	 m. (-युः) A sort of snake.  E. शम् happily, and युस् aff.
39190: शंय्य mfn. (-य्यः-य्या-य्यं) Happy, fortunate. 	 f. (-य्या) Knowledge, under-standing.  E. शम् happily, and यस् aff.
39191: शंव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Fortunate, prosperous. 	 m. (-वः) 	 1. The thunder-bolt of INDRA. 	 2. The iron head of a pestle.  E. श good fortune, and व poss. aff.; also as differently derived, read शम्ब and सम्ब &c.
39192: शंवर n. (-रं) Water.  E. शं happily, वृ to choose or cover, aff. अच् or अरप्; more usually read शम्बर. q. v.
39193: शंस्(उ)शंसु r. 1st cl. (शसति) 	 1. To praise. 	 2. To hurt. 	 3. To wish. 	 4. To calumniate. 	 5. To suggest. 	 6. To report, to relate, (with a dat. or gen. of the person communicated to.) With अभि prefixed, To accuse wrongfully. With आङ्, 1. To hope. 	 2. To speak. 	 3. To wish. With प्र, To praise, to flatter; this root and its derivatives are sometimes read with the palatal sibilant final or शंश, &c.
39194: शंसन n. (-नं) 	 1. The act of reciting. 	 2. Praising.
39195: शंसा f. (-सा) 	 1. Narrating. 	 2. Wish, desire. 	 3. Praise, flattery, eulo-gium.  E. शंस् to praise, &c., affs. अङ् and टाप्.
39196: शंसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Established, ascertained. 	 2. Calumniated, falsely accused. 	 3. Said, declared. 	 4. Praised, celebrated. 	 5. Wished, desired.  E. शंस् to wish, aff. क्त ।
39197: शंसिन् f. (-नी) 	 1. Saying, indicating. 	 2. Praising, (used at the end of a compound.)
39198: शंस्तृ m. (-स्ता) An encomiast, a panegyrist, a flatterer.  E. शंस् to praise, तृन् Unādi aff.
39199: शंस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Happy, prosperous, well-faring.  E. शं happily, स्था to stay or be, aff. क ।
39200: शंस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) 	 1. Desirable, to be wished. 	 2. Meritorious, to be praised.  E. शस् to praise, &c., aff. ण्यत् or क्यप्; also शस्य ।
39201: शक् r. 4th cl. (शक्यति-ते) (इर ऌ) इरशकॢ r. 5th cl. (शक्नोति) 	 1. To bear patiently, to endure, to be patient. 	 2. To be able to effect, to be competent. 	 3. To be powerful, (generally with an inf.) (इ) शकि r. 1st cl. (शङ्कते) 	 1. To think probable, to suspect. 	 2. To fear, to apprehend. With आङ्, To dread.
39202: शक m. (-कः) 	 1. A sovereign, and prince who gives his name to an era, especially applied to SĀLIVĀHANA. 	 2. A particular caste, the followers or descendants of ŚAKA or SĀLIVĀHANA. 	 3. A country. m. plu. (-काः) 	 1. The inhabitants, the Sacæ, the Scythians. 	 2. An era: see शाक.  E. शक् to be able, aff. अच् ।
39203: शकट mfn. Subst. (-टः-टी-टं) A cart. 	 m. (-टः) 	 1. A Daitya slain by KRISHṆA. 	 2. A cart-load. 	 3. A form of military array resembling a wedge. 	 4. A measure of capacity equal to two thousand Panas. E. शक् to be able, अटन् Unādi aff.
39205: शकटहन् m. (-हा) KRISHṆA.  E. शकट the demon so named, and हन् des-troyer; also similar compounds, as शकटारि &c.
39206: शकटाल m. (-लः) The minister of NANDA: also read SAKATĀRA.
39207: शकटाह्वा f. (-ह्वा) The fourth lunar asterism, called Rohinī, the stars of which are represented as a cart.  E. शकट a cart, आह्व appellation.
39208: शकटिका f. (-का) A small cart, a toy-cart.  E. कन् added to शकटी ।
39209: शकन् n. (-का) Animal-dung; this word has no forms for the first five cases; according to some this is not a separate word but a substi-tute for शकृत् ।
39210: शकल mn. (-लः-लं) A part, a portion, a piece. 	 n. (-लं) 	 1. Skin. 	 2. Bark. 3. A kind of (black) pigment or die. 	 4. The scales of a fish.  E. शक् to be able, कलच् Unādi aff.
39212: शकलिन् m. (-ली) A fish.  E. शकल skin or scales, and इनि aff.
39213: शकलीकरण n. (-णं) Parting, dividing, cutting or breaking in pieces. E. शकल, करण making, with च्वि aug.
39214: शकलीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Parted, cut in pieces, wounded,  E. शकल, कृत made, च्वि aug.
39216: शकशकायत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Rustling, making a noise, (as the leaves of a tree in the wind.)  E. शकत् imitative sound, nominal v., शतृ aff.
39217: शकान्तक m. (-कः) 	 1. The prince VIKPAMĀDITYA. 	 2. The name of SĀLI-VĀHANA.  E. शक an era or a Scythian, अन्तक destroyer.
39218: शकाब्द n. (-ब्दं) 	 1. A year of the Saka era, or era of SĀLIVĀHANA. E. शक, अब्द a year.
39219: शकार m. (-रः) 	 1. A silly brother-in-law of a Rājā. 	 2. The brother of a king's concubine.
39220: शकरि m. (-रिः) VIKRAMĀDITYA, the celebrated sovereign of Oujein. E. शक a Saca or Scythian, अरि the foe.
39221: शकुन m. (-नः) 	 1. A bird in general. 	 2. A kind of bird, either the Indian vulture or the common kite, (Falco cheela;) it is also applied to the pondicherry eagle, (Falco ponticeriana.) 	 3. A sort of hymn or song, sung at festivals to solicit or secure lucky events. 	 n. (-न) Any lucky or inauspicious object or omen.  E. शक् to be able, उनन् Unādi aff.
39222: शकुनज्ञा f. (-ज्ञा) A small house-lizard.  E. शकुन a bird, and ज्ञ who knows.
39224: शकुनि m. (-निः) 	 1. A bird. 	 2. The maternal uncle of the Kaurava princes, and counsellor or DURYODHANA. 	 3. One of the astrono-mical periods called Karaṇas. 	 4. The Indian kite or eagle, (Falco cheela.) 	 f. (-नी) A hen-sparrow.  E. शक् to be able, उनि Unādi aff.
39225: शकुनिप्रपा f. (-पा) A trough or little well for watering birds.  E. शकुनि a bird, प्र before पा to drink, affs. अङ् and टाप् ।
39226: शकुनिवाद m. (-दः) 	 1. The sound of a bird. 	 2. The crowing of a cock.
39227: शकुनीश्वर m. (-रः) A name of GARUDA.  E. शकुनि a bird, and ईश्वर chief.
39228: शकुन्त m. (-न्तः) 	 1. A bird. 	 2. A kind of bird, the Indian vulture. 	 3. Another sort of bird, described as of aquatic habits, perhaps a kind of maritime or fishing-falcon. 	 4. A sort of insect. 	 5. The blue-jay. E. शक् to be able, उन्त Unādi aff.; also शकुन, &c.
39229: शकुन्तक m. (-कः) A bird. 	 f. (-न्तिका) 	 1. A kind of bird. 	 2. A locust. E. कन् added to the last.
39230: शकुन्तला f. (-ला) The daughter of MENAKĀ, the courtezan of Swarga, by the sage VISHWĀMITRA, brought up by KANWA the hermit, and afterwards married to DUSHYANTA, by whom she became the mother of BHARATA, the sovereign of all India.  E. शकुन्त a bird, ला to get, affs. क and टाप्, being born in a solitary forest, and protected by the birds till found by KANWA.
39231: शकुन्तलात्मज m. (-जः) BHARATA, the sovereign of India.  E. शकुन्तला as above, आत्मज the son.
39232: शकुन्ति m. (-न्तिः) 	 1. A bird in general. 	 2. A kind of bird: see शकुन्त, &c. E. शक् to be able, Unādi aff. उन्ति ।
39233: शकुन्तिका f. (-का) A locust, a cricket.  E. शकुन्त a bird, कन् aff. of comparison.
39234: शकुल mf. (-लः-ली) A kind of fish. “शील”.  E. शक् to be able, aff. उलच् ।
39235: शकुलगण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A kind of fish. “शालमाछ ।”
39236: शकुलाक्षक m. (-कः) Bent grass, (Panicum dactylon,) with white bloss-oms.  E. शकुल a kind of fish, अक्षि the eye, अच् substituted for the final vowel; the blossoms being compared to the eye of a fish.
39237: शकुलादनी f. (-नी) 	 1. A medicinal plant, commonly Kaṭuki, (Wrightea antidysenterica.) 	 2. A creeping plant, (Jussieua repens.) 	 3. A drug, commonly Kāyaphal. 	 4. An earth-worm.  E. शकुल a fish, अद् to eat, aff. ल्युट् ।
39238: शकुलार्भक m. (-कः) A sort of fish. “गडुइ माछ ।”  E. शकुल a fish, अर्भक a young one.
39239: शकृत् n. (-कृत्) Fæces, excrement.  E. शक् to be able, (to expel,) Unādi aff. ऋतन् ।
39240: शकृत्करि mf. (-रिः-री) A calf.  E. शकृत् ordure. कृ to make, इन् aff.
39241: शकृत्कार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Making ordure or fæces.  E. शकृत् ordure, and कार who or what makes.
39242: शकृद्द्वार n. (-रं) The anus.  E. शकृत् fæces, and द्वार passage.
39243: शक्कर m. (-रः) A bull. 	 f. (-री) 	 1. A river. 	 2. A zone, a girdle. 	 3. A form of metre, a stanza of four lines of fourteen syllables each. 	 4. A woman of an impure caste; it is also read शक्वर, q. v.
39244: शक्करि m. (-रिः) A bull: see the last.
39245: शक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 	 1. Able, capable, strong, powerful. 	 2. Speaking civilly, able to please by the manner of speaking. 	 3. Diligent, attentive, intent. 	 4. Opulent, rich. 	 5. Significant, expressive, (as a word.)  E. शक् to be able, aff. क्त ।
39246: शक्तता f. (-ता) Ability, power.  E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व शक्तत्वं ।
39247: शक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 	 1. Power, regal power as resulting from “प्रभुशक्ति” or “प्रभाव-शक्ति” majesty, “उत्साहशक्ति” energy, perseverance, “मन्त्रशक्ति” the power of god counsel: see शक्तित्रय. 	 2. Power, strength, prowess. 	 3. An iron spear or dart. 	 4. The energy or active power of a deity, per-sonified as his wife, as GAURĪ of ŚIVA, LAKSHMĪ of VISHṆU, &c. 5. The female organ as the counterpart of the phallic personifica-tion of ŚIVA, and worshipped either literally or figuratively by a sect of Hindus, thence termed ŚĀKTAS. 	 6. Allaying or appeasing opposition. 	 7. Force or signification of words, (op. to लक्षणा and व्यञ्जना.) 	 8. The relation of a word to the thing designated by it, (in Nyāya Phil.) 	 9. Poetic genius. 	 10. The inherent power of a cause to produce its effects, (in Nyāya Phil.)  E. शक् to be able, aff. क्तिन् ।
39248: शक्तिग्रह m. (-हः) 	 1. A name of ŚIVA. 	 2. KĀRTIKEYA. 	 3. A spearman, a lancer. 	 4. Apprehending the meaning or acceptation of a word. E. शक्ति a spear, and ग्रह who holds.
39249: शक्तितस् Ind. According to power or ability.  E. शक्ति and तसि aff.
39250: शक्तित्रय n. (-यं) The three ingredients of regal power; or king, minister, and vigour.  E. शक्ति, and त्रय triad: see शक्ति ।
39251: शक्तिधर m. (-रः) 	 1. A name of KĀRTIKEYA. 	 2. A spearman, a lancer. Adj. Developed, powerful  E. शक्ति a spear, धर the holder.
39252: शक्तिपर्ण m. (-र्णः) A tree, (Echites scholaris)  E. शक्ति strength, (giving it,) पर्ण a leaf.
39253: शक्तिपाणि m. (-णिः) 	 1. KĀRTIKEYA. 	 2. A spearman.  E. शक्ति a spear, पाणि the hand.
39254: शक्तिभृत् m. (-भृत्) 	 1. KĀRTIKEYA: see the last. 	 2. A soldier armed with a spear.  E. शक्ति a spear, and भृत् who holds.
39255: शक्तिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Powerful, mighty.  E. शक्ति, मतुप् poss. aff.
39256: शक्तिवैकल्य n. (-ल्यं) Inability, deficiency of power or strength.  E. शक्ति, वैकल्य imperfection.
39257: शक्तिहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Powerless, impotent.  E. शक्ति, हीन abandoned.
39258: शक्तिहेतिक m. (-कः) A spearman, a lancer, a soldier armed with an iron lance.  E. शक्ति a spear, हेति a weapon, and कप् added.
39259: शक्तु mn. (-क्तुः-क्तु) According to some authorities only. 	 m. plu. (शक्तवः) The powder or flour of barley and other grain, first fried and then ground.  E. शच् to go, &c., तुन् aff.; also read सक्तु ।
39260: शक्तुफला f. (-ला) The Śami tree, (Mimosa suma, Rox.)  E. शक्त farina, and फल fruit; also शक्तुफली, and सक्तुफला ।
39261: शक्त्यपेक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Being according to, or having reference to, ability, power, &c.  E. शक्ति and अपेक्षा regard to.
39262: शक्न mfn. (-क्नः-क्ना-क्नं) Speaking civilly or pleasingly: see the next.
39263: शक्नु mfn. (-क्नुः-क्नुः-क्नु) Speaking civilly or kindly.  E. शक् to be able, (to please by speaking,) aff. नु; also with क्ल aff. शक्ल ।
39264: शक्मन् m. (-क्मा) Power, strength.  E. शक् to be able, मनिन् Unādi aff.
39265: शक्य mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं) 	 1. Possible, practicable to be effected or done, (generally with an inf.) 	 2. Fit to be effected or accomplished. 	 3. Directly expressed, (as the meaning of a word.)  E. शक् to be able, aff. यत् ।
39266: शक्यता f. (-ता) Possibility.  E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, शक्यत्वं ।
39267: शक्यप्रतीकार m. (-रः) A possible remedy or counteragent.
39268: शक्र m. (-क्रः) 	 1. INDRA, the chief of the inferior gods, and ruler of Swarga or paradise. 	 2. A plant, (Wrightea antidysenterica.) 	 3. A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.) 	 4. An owl. 	 5. The number “fourteen” E. शक् to possess power, Unādi aff. रक् ।
39269: शक्रक्रीडाचल m. (-लः) Mount Meru.  E. शक INDRA, क्रीडा sport, pleasure, अचल a mountain.
39270: शक्रगोप m. (-पः) An insect of a red colour, “इन्द्रगोप”, (Coccinella or ladybird of various species.)  E. शक्र INDRA, गो light, &c., पा to preserve, aff. क; or शक्रं शक्रधनुर्गापायति समवर्णत्वात् गुप-अण् ।
39271: शक्रज m. (-जः) A crow  E. शक्र INDRA, and ज born.
39272: शक्रजात m. (-तः) A crow.  E. शक्र INDRA, and जात born.
39273: शक्रजित् m. (-जित्) MEGHANĀDA, the son of RĀVAṆA.  E. शक्र INDRA, जित् victor.
39274: शक्रधनुस् n. (-नुः) The bow of INDRA, the rain bow.  E. शक्र INDRA, and धनुस् the bow.
39275: शक्रध्वज n. (-जं) A pole or flag set up in honour of INDRA.  E. शक्र and ध्वज a flag.
39276: शक्रनन्दन m. (-नः) ARJUNA.  E. शक्र INDRA, नन्दन a son.
39277: शक्रपादप m. (-पः) 	 1. A sort of pine, (P. devadaru, Rox.) 	 2. The Kutaja-tree.  E. शक्र INDRA, पादप a tree.
39278: शक्रपुष्पी f. (-ष्पी) A sort of potherb; also Viśalyā.  E. शक्र the pentaptera arjuna, and पुष्प a flower; having similar flowers.
39279: शक्रभवन n. (-नं) Sky, heaven.  E. शक्र INDRA, भवन abode; being the god of the firmament: it also occurs शक्रभुवन, from भुवन a world.
39280: शक्रभिद् m. (-भिद्) The son of RĀVAṆA.  E. शक्र INDRA, भिद् defeater.
39282: शक्रमूर्द्धन् m. (-र्द्धा) An ant-hill, a hillock.  E. शक्र INDRA, मूर्द्धन् the head.
39283: शक्रवाहन m. (-नः) A cloud.  E. शक्र INDRA and वाहन a vehicle.
39284: शक्रशरासन n. (-नं) The rain-bow.  E. शक्र INDRA, शरासन a bow.
39285: शक्रशाला f. (-ला) A place prepared for sacrifices to be offered in.  E. शक्र INDRA, and शाला a hall.
39286: शक्रशिरस् n. (-रः) An ant-hill.  E. शक्र, शिरस the head.
39287: शक्रसारथि m. (-थिः) MĀTULI, the charioteer of INDRA.  E. शक्र, सारथि a coachman.
39288: शक्रसुत m. (-तः) 	 1. The monkey king BĀLĪ. 	 2. ARJUNA. 	 3. JAYANTA. E. शक्र INDRA, सुत son.
39289: शक्रसुधा f. (-धा) The resin of the Boswellia thurifera, or gum olibanum.  E. शक्र, सुधा ambrosia.

39428: शतावरी f. (-री) 	 1. A shrub, (Asparagus recemosus.) 	 2. The wife of INDRA.  E. शत a hundred, (roots,) आङ् before वृ to choose, aff. अच् ।
39429: शतावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) VISHṆU.  E. शत a hundred, आवर्त्त revolving.

39447: शत्रुन्तप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Subduing enemies.  E. शत्रु, तप् to harass, खच् aff.

39481: शब्दकार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Sounding, sonorous.  E. शब्द sound, &c., कृ to make, अण् aff.

39511: शम् Ind. A particle meaning “welfare, prosperity, blessing, health,” (with a dat. or gen.)
39512: शम m. (-मः) 	 1. 39898: शान्तरस m. (-सः) The sentiment of quietism.
39899: शान्तविवाद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Reconciled, appeased.  E. शान्त, and विवाद dispute.
39900: शान्तात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Calm, composed, of resigned or composed spirit.  E. शान्त, and आत्मन् self.
39901: शान्तार्च्चिस् mfn. (-र्च्चिः-र्च्चिः-र्च्चि) Extinguished, put or gone out.  E. शान्त, अर्च्चिस् flame.
39902: शान्ति f. (-न्तिः) 	 1. Quiet, tranquillity, stoicism, the absence of passion, and indifference to objects of pleasure or pain; it is especially applied to the tranquillity of devotion, or quietism, by which the mind is wholly fixed on the subject of its meditation or worship, and is utterly disregardless of external impressions. 	 2. Good-fortune, auspiciousness, felicity. 	 3. Rest, repose. 	 4. Expiatory or propitiatory rites to avert any evil. 	 5. Preliminary ceremonies to avert inauspicious accidents at any religious celebration. 	 6. Remission, alleviation. 	 m. (-न्तिः) 	 1. The sixteenth Jina or Jaina deified sage of the present, era. 	 2. One of the Jaina emperors of the universe.  E. शम् to be appeased, aff. क्तिन् ।

39904: शान्तिकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Tranquillising, calming, appeasing, &c.  E. शान्ति and कर who or what makes.

39906: शान्तिकाम m. (-मः) Desire of tranquillity and exemption from calamity. E. शान्ति peace, and काम desire.
39907: शान्तिगृह n. (-ह) A private apartment near the place of sacrifice.  E. शान्ति devotion, गृह a house.
39908: शान्तिद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Tranquillising, calming, allaying.  E. शान्ति, द who or what gives.
39909: शान्तिहोम m. (-मः) Burnt offerings, to prevent threatening or possible evils.  E. शान्ति, and हाम burnt offering.
39910: शान्त्युद n. (-दं) Water offered at sacrifices for propitiation.  E. शान्ति, and उद water; also शान्त्युदकं ।
39911: शान्त्युदकुम्भ m. (-म्भः) A vessel holding lustral water.  E. शान्त्युद, and कुम्भ a jar.
39912: शान्त्व r. 10th cl. (शान्त्वयति) To console, to comfort.

39915: शाप m. (-पः) 	 1. Oath, affirmation by oath or ordeal. 	 2. Curse, impreca-tion. 	 3. Abuse.  E. शप् to swear, aff. घञ् ।
39916: शापग्रस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Having incurred or suffering under a curse. E. शाप, ग्रस्त seized.
39917: शापज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Arising from a curse, being the effect of one.  E. शाप, ज born.
39919: शापमुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Freed from a curse.  E. शाप, and मुक्त released.
39920: शापान्त n. (-न्तं) The end of a curse or period of an imprecation.  E. शाप, and अन्त end.
39921: शापास्त्र m. (-स्त्रः) A Muni, a saint.  E. शाप a curse, and अस्त्र a weapon; a curse denounced by such a personage, being formidable even to the deities.
39922: शापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sworn, made to take an oath.  E. शप् to swear, causal v., क्त aff.
39923: शापोद्धार m. (-रः) Deliverance from a curse or its effects.  E. शाप, and उद्धार extricating.
39924: शाफरिक m. (-कः) A fisherman.  E. शफर a kind of fish, put for any, and ठक् aff.
39925: शाब्द mfn. (-ब्दः-ब्दी-ब्दं) 	 1. Sonorous, sounding. 	 2. Nominal, (as inflec-tion.) 	 f. (-ब्दी) 	 1. SARASWATĪ, goddess of speech and eloquence. 	 2. Relating to or derived from a word. 	 3. Relating to sound, (as opposed to आर्थ.)  E. शब्द sound or a word, and अण् attributive aff.
39926: शाब्दिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to sounds or words. 	 m. (-कः) A profi-cient in the senses and forms of nouns or words.  E. शब्द a sound, and ठक् aff.
39927: शामन् n. (-मं) Conciliation, appeasing, reconciling.  E. शम् to appease, aff. मनिन्, and the vowel made long; also शामन ।
39928: शामन n. (-नं) 	 1. Killing, slaughter. 	 2. Tranquillity, peace. 	 m. (-नः) An epithet of YAMA.  E. शम् to be pacified, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
39929: शामित्र n. (-त्रं) 	 1. Sacrificing. 	 2. Tying up cattle for sacrifice. 	 3. A sacrificial vessel.  E. शम् to appease, इत्रच् aff.
39930: शामीन n. (-नं) Ashes f. (-नी) A Sacrificial spoon.  E. शम् ईनञ् aff.
39931: शाम्बरी f. (-री) 	 1. A female-juggler. 	 2. Jugglery, sorcery.  E. शम्बर a demon, अण् added, and ङीष् fem. aff.
39932: शाम्बविक m. (-कः) A worker in shells.  E. शम्बु a shell, ठक् aff.
39933: शाम्बुक m. (-कः) A bivalve-shell.  E. अण् pleonasm added to शम्बु; also read शाम्बूक, &c.
39934: शाम्भव m. (-वः) 	 1. A sort of poison. 	 2. A worshipper of ŚIVA. 	 3. The son of ŚAMBHU or ŚIVA. 	 4. Camphor. 	 n. (-वं) The Devadāru tree. f. (-वी) PĀRVATI.  E. शम्भु a name of ŚIVA, अण् aff.
39935: शायक m. (-कः) 	 1. An arrow. 	 2. A sword.  E. शी to destroy, ण्वुल् aff.; also सायक ।
39936: शायिका f. (-का) Sleeping.  E. शी to sleep, ण्वुल् aff.
39937: शायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Lying down.  E. शी to sleep, णिनि aff.
39938: शार r. 10th cl. (शारयति-ते) 	 1. To be weak. 	 2. To weaken.
39939: शार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 	 1. Variegated, (in colour.) 	 2. Yellow. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. Air, wind. 	 2. A piece or man at chess, backgammon, &c. 	 3. Hur-ting, injuring. 	 4. A mixture of blue and yellow, a green. 	 5. Spotting, variegating. 	 f. (-री) Kuśa grass.  E. शॄ to injure, घञ् aff.
39940: शारङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Of a variegated colour. 	 m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. The Chātaka, (Cuculus melanoleucos.) 	 2. A deer. 	 3. An elephant. 	 4. A bee. 	 5. A peacock. 	 f. (-ङ्गी) A musical instrument, a stringed instrument played with a bow, a sort of fiddle.  E. शार injured or variegated, गम् to go or get, aff. खच्; more usually, सारङ्ग ।
39941: शारता f. (-ता) 	 1. Variegated of colour. 	 2. Yellowness.  E. तल added to शार ।
39942: शारद mfn. (-दः-दी-दं) 	 1. Modest, diffident. 	 2. New. 	 3. Produced in the sultry season. 	 4. Autumnal. 	 m. (-दः) 	 1. A year. 	 2. Grain or rice ripening in the sultry season. 	 3. A sort of kidney-bean, yellow Mūng. 	 4. Autumnal sickness. 	 5. Sunshine, (in autumn.) 	 f. (-दा) 1. A name of SARASWATĪ. 	 2. A title of DurGĀ. 	 3. A musical instrument, a sort of lute or guitar. 	 f. (-दी) 	 1. A plant, (Jussieua, repens.) 	 2. A tree, (Echites scholaris.) 	 3. Day of full-moon in the month of Kārtika, (October-November.) 	 n. (-दं) 	 1. The white lotus. 	 2. Corn, grain.  E. शरद् the autumn, अण् aff.

39944: शारदिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Autumnal.  E. शारद, and इनि aff.
39945: शारदीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Autumnal.  E. शारद, and छण् added.
39946: शारि m. (-रिः) 	 1. A piece or man at chess, draughts Chauper, &c. 	 2. An elephant's housings or armour. 	 3. Fraud, trick. 	 mf. (-रिः-री) A bird: see the next.  E. शॄ to injure, Unādi aff. इञ् or ङीप् ।
39947: शारिका f. (-का) 	 1. A bird, the proper or hill Mainā, (Gracula religiosa;) it is also applied to the small bird usually called Mainā in Bengal, (Turdus salica, BUCH.) of which several varieties are distinguished by the Hindus. 	 2. A bow or stick that may be used for playing the Vīṇa or any stringed instrument. 	 3. A man at chess.  E. शॄ to injure, aff. वुन् ।
39948: शारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Variegated, coloured.  E. शार, and इतच् aff.
39949: शारिफल n. (-लं) A chequered cloth or table for playing draughts, &c. E. शारि a piece, फल fruit; also with कन् added शारिफलक mn. (-कः-कं) ।
39950: शारिवा f. (-वा) A plant: as synonimous with Śhyāmā, (Echites frutes-cens,) but more usually considered synonimous with Ananta-mūla (Asclepias pseudosarsa,) the broad-leaved variety, the root of which has been used as a substitute for Sarsaparilla, &c.  E. शारि injuring, from शॄ with इञ् aff., and वन् added.
39951: शारिशृङ्खला f. (-ला) A sort of die or dice, used for playing with.  E. शारि a man or piece, and शृङ्खला a chain.
39952: शारीर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 	 1. Corporeal, bodily, belonging to or produced from the body. 	 2. Spiritual in connection with the body, incorpo-rate. 	 3. A bull. 	 n. (-रं) 	 1. 39953: शारीरक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Corporeal, relating to what is corporeal. 2. Incorporate.  E. कन् added to the last.
39954: शारीरिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to the body, corporeal. 	 2. Contained in the body, incorporate.  E. शरीर, ठक् aff.
39955: शारुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Mischievous, noxious, injurious.  E. शॄ to hurt, उकञ् aff.
39956: शार्क m. (-र्कः) Clayed or candied sugar.  E. शॄ to injure, aff. क.
39957: शार्कक m. (-कः) 	 1. The broth of milk, syllabub, cream. 	 2. A ball of meat, &c. 	 3. Clayed or candied sugar.  E. कन् added to the last.
39958: शार्कर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 	 1. Stony, gravelly. 	 2. Sugary. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. The froth or skim of milk. 	 2. Cream. 	 3. A gravelly place.  E. शर्करा sugar, gravel, &c., aff. अण्.
39959: शार्करक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Gravelly, stony, &c.  E. शार्कर the same, and कक् added; also from शर्कर with ठक् aff. शार्करिक.
39960: शार्करीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Stony, gravelly, &c.  E. शर्करा gravel, &c., and छ attributive aff.
39961: शार्ङ्ग mfn. (-र्ङ्गः-र्ङ्गी-र्ङ्गं) 	 1. Horny, made of horn, &c. 	 2. Holding a bow. 	 n. (-र्ङ्गं) 	 1. A bow in general. 	 2. The bow of VISHṆU.  E. शृङ्ग a horn, अण् aff.
39962: शार्ङ्गिन् m. (-र्ङ्गी) 	 1. A bowyer, an archer. 	 2. VISHṆU.  E. शार्ङ्ग a bow, इनि poss. aff.
39963: शार्दूल m. (-लः) 	 1. A tiger. 	 2. Another animal. 	 3. A Rākshasa. 	 4. A sort of bird. 	 5. (In composition,) Pre-eminent, excellent. 	 6. A form of metre, a variety of the class Dhritī, or stanza of four lines of 18 syllables each; also of the class Atidhritī, in which there are 19 syllables in the line.  E. शॄ to injure, दूलच् aff.
39964: शार्दूलललित m. (-तः) A species of the Dhritī metre, of 4 lines of 18 syllables each.
39965: शार्दूलवाहन m. (-नः) A Jaina teacher.  E. शार्दूल a tiger, and वाहन a vehicle.
39966: शार्दूलविक्रीडित m. (-तः) A form of metre, a variety of the class Atidhritī, or stanza of 4 lines of 19 syllables each.
39967: शार्वर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 	 1. Murderous, mischievous. 	 2. Nocturnal. 	 n. (-रं) Darkness, gloom. 	 f. (-री) Night.  E. शर्वरी night, अण् aff.
39968: शाल्(ऋ)शाऌ r. 1st cl. (शालते) 	 1. To flatter, to praise. 	 2. To boast. 	 3. To tell. 	 4. To be endowed with.
39969: शाल m. (-लः) 	 1. A kind of fish, (Ophiocephalus wrahl, HAM.) 	 2. The celebrated sovereign SĀLIVĀHANA. 	 3. The name of a river. 	 4. The name of a tree. 	 5. A tree in general. 	 6. An enclosure, a fence. 	 f. (-ला) 	 1. A house. 	 2. A hall. 	 3. A large branch of a tree. E. शल् to go, घञ् aff.; or शाल् to praise, aff. अच्; in several of the meanings it is also written साल ।
39970: शालग्राम m. (-मः) A particular sacred stone typical of VISHṆU.
39971: शालङ्कायन m. (-नः) 	 1. The name of a saint. 	 2. ŚIVA'S attendant NANDĪ.
39972: शालङ्कायनजीवसू f. (-सूः) The mother of VYĀSA.

39975: शालपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A shrub, (Hedysarum gangeticum.)  E. शाल the Śāl, and पर्ण a leaf, aff. ङीष्, having similar leaves; also सालपर्णी ।
39976: शालभञ्जिका f. (-का) 	 1. A doll, a puppet. 	 2. A whore, a harlot.  E. कन् added to the following.
39977: शालभञ्जी f. (-ञ्जी) A doll, a puppet.  E. शाल Śāl wood, भञ्ज् to rub, (to plane, &c., in order to make dolls,) affs. अच् and ङीष्; also with कन् added शालभञ्जिका ।
39979: शालवेष्ट m. (-ष्टः) Resin, the resin of the Śāl tree, used as incense, &c. E. शाल the Śāl tree, and वेष्ट exudation.
39980: शालसार m. (-रः) 	 1. A tree. 	 2. Asafœtida; also सालसार ।

39985: शालानी f. (-नी) A shrub, (Hedysarum gangeticum.)  E. शाल the ŚĀL tree, आङ् before नी to get, (to resemble in the leaf,) aff. क्विप् ।

39988: शालावृक m. (-कः) 	 1. A monkey. 	 2. A dog. 	 3. A jackal. 	 4. A deer. 	 5. A cat. 	 6. A wolf.  E. शाला a house, वृक a wolf.
39989: शालि n. (-लि) 	 1. Rice in general, but especially in two classes; one like white rice growing in deep water, and the other a red sort, requiring only a moist soil; there are a great many varieties of this grain. 	 3. (-द्धं) A funeral ceremony observed at various fixed periods and for different purposes, con-sisting of offerings with water and fire to the gods and manes, and gifts and food to the relations present and assisting Brāh-mans; it is especially performed for a present recently deceased, or for three paternal ancestors or for all ancestors collectively, and is supposed necessary to secure the ascent and residence of the souls of the deceased in a world appropriated to the manes, The following distributions of this ceremony are specified: the पार्व्वणं in honour of three ancestors, एकोद्दिष्टं of one, नित्यं regular, नैमित्तिकं occasionally, काम्यं for the attainment of some particular object, आह्निकं daily, वृद्धिः for the obtaining of increase of pros-perity, and सपिण्डनं in which the balls of meat offered to the deceased individually and collectively are blended together. There are many other kinds: those for a person recently decea-sed are one on the day after mourning expires, and twelve others in twelve successive months; one at the end of the third fort-night, one in the sixth month, and one in the twelfth, concluding with a Sapiṇḍaṇa, on the anniversary of the person's death; in general they are all performed in the course of the two or three first days, and the Śrāddha for the deceased is only annually repeated. There is also a short of Śrāddha performed daily during the days of mourning, usually ten, on which a funeral cake is presented, increasing one or more each day till ten cakes are offered.  E. श्रद्धा faith, अण् or ण aff. of possession or relation, as the abandonment or presentation of meat, &c., through faith of its efficacy, in behalf of the souls of the deceased.

42615: समाकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Agitated, bewildered, confused. 	 2. Crowded, thronged.  E. सम्, and आङ् before कुल् to accumulate, क aff.
42616: समाकुलत्व n. (-त्वं) Agitation, anxiety.  E. त्व added to the last; also with तल्, समाकुलता ।
42617: समाक्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 	 1. Pervaded, spread. 	 2. Overcome, surpass-ed.  E. सम, and आङ् before क्रम् to go, aff. क्त ।
42618: समाख्या f. (-ख्या) 	 1. Fame, reputation. 	 2. Appellation.  E. सम् all, आङ् before ख्या to tell or declare, affs. अङ् and टाप् ।
42619: समाख्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Famed, celebrated. 	 2. Notorious, public. 	 3. Reckoned up. 	 4. Declared.  E. सम्, and आङ् before ख्या to say, क्त aff.
42620: समागत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Arrived, approached. 	 2. Met, encountered. 3. United, joined.  E. सम् together, and आगत come.
42621: समागति f. (-तिः) 	 1. Arrival, approach. 	 2. Union, joining. 	 3. Encounter-ing, meeting. 	 4. Similar condition or progress.  E. सम् with, or सम् same, आङ् before गम् to go, aff. क्तिन् ।

42623: समाघात m. (-तः) 	 1. War, battle. 	 2. Striking, beating, killing.  E. सम् together, आघात striking.
42624: समाचर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Who or what observes, practices, proceeds, &c. E. सम् and आङ् before चर् to go, ट aff.

42626: समाचरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) Following, practising, behaving, proceeding, &c.  E. सम्, and आङ् before चर् to go, शतृ aff.
42627: समाचार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Equal or like in virtuous conduct. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. Proper practice or conduct. 	 2. Proceeding, going. 	 3. Information, tradition, news.  E. सम्, and आङ् before चर् to go, घञ् aff.
42628: समाच्छन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Covered with, involved in.  E. सम्, आच्छन्न covered.

42631: समाज्ञा f. (-ज्ञा) Fame, reputation.  E. सम् all, आङ् before ज्ञा to know, affs. अङ् and टाप् ।
42633: समादान n. (-नं) 	 1. Receiving suitable donations. 	 2. Taking. 	 3. The daily observances of the Jaina sect.  E. सम् with, आदान taking.
42634: समादाय Ind. 	 1. Having taken. 	 2. Having accepted.  E. सम्, and आङ् before दा to give, ल्यप् aff.
42635: समादिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Enjoined, commanded.  E. सम्, आदिष्ट enjoined.
42636: समादेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Acceptable, to be selected or taken.  E. सम्, and आङ् before दा to give, यत् aff.
42637: समादेश m. (-शः) Advice, direction, command, order.
42638: समाधा f. (-धा) 	 1. The act of collecting or composing. 	 2. Restraining the senses and fixing the mind in abstract contemplation on the true nature of spirit. 	 3. Profound absorption. 	 4. Contentment. 	 5. Answering an objection, replying to the Purva Paksha, (in logic.) 6. Agreeing, promising. 	 7. A leading incident which unexpectedly gives rise to the whole plot; also समाधान.  E. सम + आ + धा-अङ् ।
42639: समाधान n. (-नं) 	 1. Religious meditation, restraining the mind from external objects, and fixing it in profound absorption. 	 2. Promising, declaring. 	 3. (In the drama,) The leading incident, that which gives rise sometimes unexpectedly to the whole plot.  E. सम् in-tensitive, आङ् before धा to have or hold, aff. ल्युट्ः see the last.
42640: समाधाय Ind. Having fixed upon, (the mind,) being intent upon.  E. सम्, and आङ् before धा to have, ल्यप् aff.
42641: समाधि m. (-धिः) 	 1. Deep and devout meditation, restraining the senses and confining the mind to contemplation on the true nature of spirit, &c. 	 2. A religious vow or obligation. 	 3. Silence. 	 4. Promise, assent, engagement. 	 5. Composing or reconciling differences, put-ting a stop to a dispute. 	 6. Requital, return, retaliation. 	 7. At-tempting impossibilities; exertion or perseverance in extreme difficulties. 	 8. Storing corn on account of a dearth. 	 9. A Jaina saint of a future age. 	 10. A figure of rhetoric; connection or proximity of two events accidentally connected, and expressed by a common verb and the government of the verb by a double nominative, as उत्कण्ठिता च कुलटा जगामास्तञ्च भानुमान् the disloyal woman went sorrowfully, and the sun (went) down. 	 11. Collection, combination. 	 12. Demonstrated conclusion. 	 13. The joint of the neck. 	 14. A tomb, a grave.  E. सम् together, धा to have or hold, with आङ् prefix, and कि aff.
42642: समाधिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 	 1. Contemplative, engaged in meditation. 2. Making a promise, announcing assent or permission.  E. समाधि, and मतुप् aff.
42643: समाधिस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Devoted to meditation.  E. समाधि and स्थ who is.
42644: समाध्मात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Blown or puffed up, inflated.  E. सम् and आङ् before ध्मा to blow, क्त aff.
42645: समान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Like, similar. 	 2. Good, virtuous. 	 3. One, uniform, same. 	 4. Honoured. 	 m. (-नः) 	 1. One of the five vital airs, that which is considered essential to digestion and occupies the cavity of the navel. 	 2. A corresponding letter of the alphabet, as a long vowel to its short one, &c. 	 3. A friend.  E. सम all, अन् to breathe, aff. अण् or घञ्; or सम् and आङ् before णी to get, aff. अच् ।
42646: समानकालीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Occurring or produced at the same period. E. समान same, काल time, ख aff.
42647: समानगोत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) Of the same lineage or family: see सगोत्र.  E. समान, गोत्र family.
42648: समानजन्मन् mfn. (-न्मा-न्मा-न्म) Of equal age.  E. समान, and जन्मन् birth.
42649: समानजाति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Of a common tribe, sort, &c.  E. समान, and जाति sort.
42650: समानजातीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Of the same caste or species.  E. समान, जातीय of a caste.
42651: समानता f. (-ता) 	 1. Sameness, equality, likeness. 	 2. Community of kind or quality.  E. समान, and तल् aff.; also with त्व aff., समानत्वं ।
42652: समानयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 	 1. Making equal or like to. 	 2. Leading, bringing.  E. समान used as a verb, or सम् and आङ् before णी to get, शतृ aff.
42653: समानयन n. (-नं) Bringing, conducting.  E. सम् and आङ् before णी to take, ल्युट् aff.
42654: समानयम m. (-मः) The same pitch of voice.
42655: समानाधिकरण n. (-णं) 	 1. Common or generic property. 	 2. A predicament or condition including several things or persons. 	 3. Same location or predicament. 	 m. (-णः) A generic character. Adj. 	 1. Being in the same category or predicament, having a common substratum, (in phil.) 	 2. Being in the same case or same government, (in gram.) E. समान, and अधिकरण possession.
42656: समानाधिकार m. (-रः) 	 1. Similar or equal duty, office, or government. 2. Generic character.  E. समान, अधिकार office.
42657: समानित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Taken, led, conducted.  E. सम् and आङ् before णी to take, क्त aff.
42658: समानीय Ind. Having taken.  E. सम् and आङ् before णी to take, ल्यप् aff.
42659: समानोदक m. (-कः) A kinsman, one who when distinct from the Sapiṇḍa is next in order and succession, and is connected by oblations of water only, to the manes of common ancestors; this relationship extends to the fourteenth in descent, i. e. the seven first or Sapiṇḍas presenting water as well as the cakes, are also Samānodakas, whilst the seven next presenting water alone are Samānodakas only.  E. समान common, उदक water.
42660: समानोदर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A brother of whole blood.  E. समान same, उदर belly, यत् aff.
42661: समान्त n. (-न्तं) The end of a year.  E. समा a year, and अन्त end.
42662: समाप m. (-पः) Sacrificing, offering oblations to the gods.  E. सम् same, आप water; in which libations of water are made.
42663: समापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Filling, completing, finishing. 	 2. Killing. E. सम् together, आप् to get, aff. ण्वुल् ।
42665: समापन n. (-नं) Conclusion, completion, finish. 	 2. A section, a chapter, a division. 	 3. Killing, destroying. 	 4. Profound meditation. 	 5. Gain, acquisition.  E. सम् with, together with, आप् to obtain, aff. ल्युट् ।
42666: समापन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 	 1. Finished, done, completed, concluded. 	 2. Got, gained, obtained. 	 3. Distressed, afflicted. 	 4. Killed. 	 5. Accom-plished, perfect, (in any branch of study.) 	 6. Come, occurred. E. सम् implying completion, &c., आङ् before पद् to go, aff. क्त ।
42667: समापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Finished, done, concluded.  E. सम् before आप् to get, aff. क्त, and इट् inserted.
42668: समाप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 	 1. Finished, done, concluded, completed. 	 2. Clever. E. सम् before आप् to get, aff. क्त, without the augment.
42669: समाप्ति f. (-प्तिः) 	 1. End, completion, perfection, conclusion, finish. 	 2. Reconciling differences, putting an end to disputes, &c.  E. सम् implying completion, आप् to get or gain, aff. क्तिन् ।
42670: समाप्तिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Finite, final, concluding, completing. 	 m. (-कः) 1. One who has completed a course of holy study. 	 2. A finisher, an ender.  E. समाप्त, and ठक् aff.
42671: समाप्त्यर्था f. (-र्था) Part of a stanza given as a task or trial of skill to be completed.  E. समाप्ति completion, अर्थ sense.
42672: समाप्लुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Drenched, drowned.  E. सम् and आङ् before प्लु to go, क्त aff.
42675: समाम्नाय m. (-यः) 	 1. Traditional repetition or mention. 	 2. A traditional collection. 	 3. Revelation. 	 4. Enumeration, recitation. 	 5. Totality, the aggregate.  E. सम् and आङ् before म्ना to remember, घञ् and युक् affs.
42676: समाय m. (-यः) A visit, arrival.  E. सम् and आङ् before या to go, ड aff.
42677: समायत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Lengthened, extended.  E. सम् and आङ् before यम् to restrain, क्त aff.
42678: समायात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Come, arrived.  E. सम् and आङ् before या to go, क्त aff.
42679: समायुक्त f. (-क्ता) 	 1. Connected, united. 	 2. Prepared, made ready. 	 3. Charged, appointed. 	 4. Provided, supplied. 	 5. Devoted to.
42680: समायुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Joined, connected, attached to or united with. 	 2. Decorated, adorned. 	 3. Endowed with. 	 4. Collected, brought together.  E. सम् and आङ् before युत joined.
42681: समायोग m. (-गः) 	 1. Union, junction, connection, association. 	 2. Heap, multitude, assemblage. 	 3. Cause, origin, motive, object.  E. सम् and आङ् before युज् to join, aff. घञ् ।
42682: समारब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Begun, commenced.  E. सम् and आङ् before रभि to begin, क्त aff.
42683: समारम्भ m. (-म्भः) 	 1. Commencement, beginning. 	 2. An undertaking. 3. An unguent.  E. सम् and आङ् before रभि to commence, घञ् aff.
42685: समारूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 	 1. Ascended, gone up or upon. 	 2. Mounted. 	 3. Agreed to, determined.  E. सम् and आङ् before रुह् to grow, क्त aff.
42686: समारोपण n. (-णं) Placing or fixing in or on.  E. सम् and आङ् before रुह् to grow, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
42687: समारोपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Placed in or upon. 	 f. (-ता) 	 1. Caused to ascend. 	 2. Planted. 	 3. Delivered over. 	 4. Strung, (as a bow.) E. सम् and आङ् before रुह् to grow, causal v., क्त aff.
42688: समारोह m. (-हः) 	 1. Going up, ascending. 	 2. Mounting, riding upon. 	 3. Agreeing.  E. सम् and आङ् before रुह् to rise, घञ् aff.
42689: समार्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) 	 1. Desirous of equality. 	 2. Seeking peace. E. सम् and अर्थिन् who asks.
42690: समालम्बन n. (-नं) Resting upon, being supported by.  E. सम् and आङ् before लवि to depend, घञ् aff.
42691: समालम्भ m. (-म्भः) 	 1. Smearing the body with coloured perfumes, as with saffron, sandal, &c. 	 2. Seizing, (as a victim for sacrifice.)  E. सम् and आङ् before लभि to sound, aff. अच्; also with ल्युट् aff. समालम्भन ।
42692: समालम्भन n. (-नं) Smearing the body with coloured fragrant substances: see the last.
42693: समाली f. (-ली) A collection of flowers, a nosegay, &c.  E. स for सम् with, माला a garland, affs. अच् and ङीष् ।

42695: समावाय m. (-यः) 	 1. A multitude, a number, a heap or quantity. 	 2. Association. 	 3. Integral or inseparable aggregation.  E. सम् and आङ् implying aggregation, अय् to go, aff. घञ् ।
42696: समावास m. (-सः) Residence, abode.  E. सम् and आङ् before वस् to dwell, घञ् aff.
42697: समावासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sojourning, taking up a residence.  E. समावास, and इतच् aff.
42698: समाविष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Entered or engrossed by, absorbed by, (feeling, passion, &c.) possessed by, (as an evil spirit.) 	 2. Entered thoroughly. 	 3. Entered, (as a mansion.) 	 4. Seated, settled. 	 5. Well-instructed.  E. सम् and आङ् implying entireness, and विष्ट entered.
42699: समावृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Surrounded, encompassed. 	 2. Covered, enclosed, beset. 	 3. Viewed. 	 4. Protected. 	 5. Shut out, excluded. E. सम् and आङ् before वृ to choose, क्त aff.
42700: समावृत्त m. (-त्तः) A pupil who has completed his studies and taken leave of his preceptor.  E. सम् and आङ् before वृत् to be, aff. क्त; also with कन् added, समावृत्तक ।
42701: समावेद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) To be announced or communicated.  E. सम् and आङ् before विद् to know, causal v., यत् aff.
42702: समावेश m. (-शः) 	 1. Affection, passion, emotion. 	 2. Possession by evil spirits. 	 3. Entrance.  E. सम् and आङ् before विश् to enter, घञ् aff.
42703: समावेशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Placed, fixed. 	 2. Entered. 	 3. Brought in or into.  E. सम् and आङ् before विश् to enter, causal v., aff. क्त ।
42704: समाशङ्कित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Doubtful, fearing, apprehensive.  E. सम् and आङ् before शकि to doubt, क्त aff.
42705: समाश्रय m. (-यः) 	 1. Protection, refuge. 	 2. Seeking protection. 	 3. A dwelling place.  E. सम् intensitive, आश्रय asylum.
42706: समाश्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Protected, defended, cherished, refuged. E. सम् intensitive, and आश्रित refuged.
42707: समाश्रित्य Ind. 	 1. Depending upon, trusting to. 	 2. Having engaged in, agreed to, &c.  E. सम् and आङ् before श्री to serve, ल्यप् aff.
42709: समाश्वस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Trusting, confiding in.  E. सम् and आङ् before श्वस् to breathe, क्त aff.
42710: समाश्वास m. (-सः) 	 1. Trust, belief, confidence. 	 2. Relief, encouragement. 3. Recovering breath.  E. सम् and आङ् before श्वस् to breathe, घञ् aff.
42712: समास् m. (-माः) A year.  E. स for सह with, मास a month: see सम and समा ।
42713: समास m. (-सः) 	 1. Contraction, abridgment, conciseness. 	 2. Composition of words, formation of compound terms, (in grammar.) 	 3. Com-position of differences, reconciling quarrels. 	 4. Aggregation. assemblage, collection. 	 5. Whole.  E. सम् together, अस् to throw or direct, aff. घञ् ।
42714: समासक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 	 1. Joined, united. 	 2. Reached, attained. 	 3. Marked, affected by, &c. 	 4. Combined, comprehended.  E. सम् and आङ् before षञ्ज् to be in contact with, aff. क्त ।
42715: समासक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 	 1. Union. 	 2. Comprehension, inclusion. 	 3. Affection. E. सम् and आङ् before षञ्ज् to be in contact with, क्तिन् aff.
42716: समासञ्जत् mfn. (-ञ्जन्-ञ्जन्ती-ञ्जत्) Joining, or connecting with.  E. सम् and आङ् before षञ्ज् to unite, शतृ aff.
42717: समासञ्जन n. (-नं) Joining, uniting, union, combination, connection, contact.  E. सम् and आङ् before षञ्ज् to be in contact with, aff. ल्युट् ।
42718: समासतस् Ind. Briefly, summarily.  E. समास, and तसि aff.
42720: समासन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 	 1. Near, proximate. 	 2. Obtained, attained. E. सम् and आङ् implying union or contiguity, षद् to go, aff. क्त ।
42721: समासभावना f. (-ना) Composition by the sum of the products.  E. समास, and भावना contemplating.
42722: समासर्जन n. (-नं) Delivering, consigning, abandoning.  E. सम् and आङ् before सृज् to leave, ल्युट् aff.
42723: समासवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 	 1. Abridged, contracted. 	 2. Compounded. m. (-वान्) The Tūn tree, (Cedrela Tunna.)  E. समास, and मतुप् aff.
42724: समासादन n. (-नं) 	 1. Attaining, effecting, accomplishing. 	 2. Finding, obtaining.  E. सम् and आङ् before षद् to go, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
42725: समासादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Done, effected, attained, obtained, accom-plished.  E. सम् and आङ् before षद् to go, causal v., aff. क्त ।
