43187: सर्पमणि m. (-णिः) The snake-stone or carbuncle, or a jewel said to be found in the head of a snake, possessing also alexipharmic proper-ties.  E. सर्प a snake, and मणि a gem.
43188: सर्पमाला f. (-ला) A plant, commonly SARPA-KANKĀLI.
43189: सर्पराज m. (-जः) VĀSUKI, sovereign of the serpent race, inhabiting Pātāla or the regions under the earth.  E. सर्प a snake, राज a sovereign.
43190: सर्पसत्रिन् m. (-त्री) A name of the prince JANAMEJAYA, the son of PARIKSHIT.  E. सर्प a snake, and सत्र a sacrifice, इनि aff.; having compelled by Mantras all the snakes to be present at a sacrifice performed for their destruction, in retaliation of the death of his father who was killed by the bite of a snake; all were destroyed on this occasion except a few of the chiefs.
43191: सर्पसहा f. (-हा) A plant: see सर्पकङ्काली ।
43192: सर्पहन् m. (-हा) An ichneumon, a mungoose.  E. सर्प a snake, हन् who kills.
43193: सर्पाक्ष n. (-क्षं) The seed of the Elæocarpus. 	 f. (-क्षी) A plant, commonly Kankālikā.  E. सर्प a snake, अक्षि the eye.
43194: सर्पाख्य m. (-ख्यः) A plant, (Mesua ferrea.)  E. सर्प a snake, आख्या an appellation.
43195: सर्पाङ्गी f. (-ङ्गी) A plant, Sarpa-kankāli or a variety of it.
43196: सर्पाराति m. (-तिः) 	 1. GARUḌA. 	 2. An ichneumon. 	 3. A peacock.  E. सर्प a snake, अराति an enemy.
43197: सर्पारि m. (-रिः) An ichneumon.  E. सर्प a snake, and अरि an enemy; equally applicable to the peacock, &c.: see the last.
43199: सर्पाशन m. (-नः) A peacock.  E. सर्प a snake and अशन food: see the last.
43200: सर्पिन् mfn. (-र्पी-र्पिणी-र्पि) Going gently or tortuously, gliding, winding, creeping. 	 f. (-र्पिणी) 	 1. A female serpent. 	 2. A small medicinal shrub.  E. सर्प a snake, or going, &c., इनि aff.
43201: सर्पिष्मत् Adj. Seasoned with clarified butter.
43202: सर्पिस् n. (-र्पिः) Ghee, clarified butter.  E. सृप् to flow, इस् Unādi aff.
43203: सर्पिस्समुद्र m. (-द्रः) The sea of clarified butter, one of the seven seas. E. सर्पिस् Ghee, समुद्र the ocean.
43205: सर्ब्ब् r. 1st cl. (सर्ब्बति) To go, to move.
43206: सर्ब्ब mfn. (-र्ब्बः-र्ब्बा-र्ब्बं) All, whole, entire.  E. षर्ब्ब् to go, aff. अच्; as differently read, with a final semivowel, सर्व्वं q. v.
43207: सर्ब्बंसह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 	 1. Patient, enduring. 	 2. All-sustaining.  E. सर्ब्ब all, सह to bear, खच् aff.; see सर्व्वंसह below.
43208: सर्म्म m. (-र्म्म) 	 1. Sky, heaven. 	 2. Going, motion.  E. सृ to go, मन् Unādi aff.
43209: सर्व्व् r. 1st cl. (सर्व्वति) To hurt, to injure, to kill; more commonly षर्व्व q. v.
43210: सर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं) All, whole, complete, universal, entire. 	 m. (-र्व्वः) 1. ŚIVA. 	 2. VISHṆU.  E. सृ to go, to pervade, (the world,) वन् Unādi aff.; also according to some authorities preferable, सर्ब्ब as above.
43211: सर्व्वंसह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 	 1. Patient, enduring. 	 2. All-sustaining. 	 f. (-हा) The earth.  E. सर्व्व all, (men,) सह् to bear or suffer, aff. खश् ।
43212: सर्व्वक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) All, every.  E. कन् added to the last.
43213: सर्व्वकर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) BRAHMĀ.  E. सर्व्व all, (things,) कर्त्तृ maker.
43214: सर्व्वकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) All or every act. 	 m. (-र्म्मा) A man of all work.  E. सर्व्व, कर्म्मन् act.
43215: सर्व्वकर्म्मीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Performing or conversant with every business, pervading every action, &c.  E. सर्व्व all, कर्म्म act, ख aff.
43216: सर्व्वकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) The maker of all things.  E. सर्व्व, कारिन् who makes.
43217: सर्व्वकाल n. (-लं) All seasons or times.  E. सर्व्व, and काल time.
43218: सर्व्वकालीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Of all times or seasons.  E. सर्व्वकाल, and ख aff.
43219: सर्व्वके Ind. Every where, universally.  E. सर्व्व in all, and अकच् inserted before the final.
43220: सर्व्वकेशिन् m. (-शी) An actor, a dancer, a mime.
43221: सर्व्वचार m. (-रः) Any substance of an alkaline or soapy naure, as impure soda, pearl ash or potash, &c., which may be used in cleaning clothes.  E. सर्व्व all क्षार impure alkali or alkaline salt or ashes.
43222: सर्व्वग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Going every where, all-pervading. 	 n. (-गं) Water. m. (-गः) 	 1. ŚIVA. 	 2. BRAHMĀ. 	 3. Soul, spirit. 	 4. Air, wind. 	 f. (-गा) A plant, commonly Priyangu.  E. सर्व्व all, ग what goes.
43223: सर्व्वगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Omnipresent, universally diffused.  E. सर्व्व, गत gone.
43224: सर्व्वगन्ध m. (-न्धः) 	 1. A class of four aromatics, or kakkol, cloves, agallo-chum, and gum benjamin. 	 2. A perfume in general.  E. सर्व्व all, and गन्ध fragrance.
43225: सर्व्वग्रन्थिक n. (-कं) The root of long-pepper.  E. सर्व्व all, ग्रन्थि a knot, कन् aff.
43226: सर्व्वङ्कष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) 	 1. All-pervading, diffused, extended. 	 2. All-destroy-ing. 	 m. (-षः) A rogue, a wicked man.  E. सर्व्व, and कष् to go, खच् aff.
43227: सर्व्वचर्म्मीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Made of every kind of skin or leather.  E. सर्व्व all, चर्म्म skin, ख aff.
43228: सर्व्वजगत् f. (-त्) The universe, the whole world.  E. सर्व्व, and जगत् world.
43229: सर्व्वजनीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Belonging or relating to all men, fit for all, &c.  E. सर्व्व all, जन mankind, ख aff.
43230: सर्व्वजित् mfn. (-जित्) 	 1. All-subduing, irresistible. 	 2. All-surpassing, excellent, incomparable. 	 m. (-जित) The twenty-first year of the cycle.  E. सर्व्व all, जित् who subdues or surpasses.
43231: सर्व्वज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Omniscient, all-wise. 	 m. (-ज्ञः) 	 1. ŚIVA. 	 2. A Jina or Buddha, or deified sage peculiar to those sects.  E. सर्व्व all, and ज्ञ who knows.
43232: सर्व्वज्ञत्व n. (-त्वं) Omniscience.  E. त्व added to the last; also with तल्, सर्व्वज्ञता ।
43233: सर्व्वतःशुभा f. (-भा) A plant, (Priyangu.)  E. सर्व्वतस् wholly, शुभ auspicious.
43234: सर्व्वतन्त्र m. (-न्त्रः) A man who has studied the Tantra-Shāstras.  E. सर्व्व all, तन्त्र a Tantra, properly with an affix of derivation, &c., as ठक्, and that again rejected.
43235: सर्व्वतस् Ind. 	 1. Every way, all-round. 	 2. Wholly, entirely. 	 3. From every body.  E. सर्व्व all, तसिल् aff.
43236: सर्व्वतापन m. (-नः) Love or the deity KĀMA.  E. सर्व्व all, तापन inflamer.
43237: सर्व्वतेजस् n. (-जः) All-splendour or power.  E. सर्व्व, and तेजस् light, power.
43238: सर्व्वतेजोमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made, comprising or consisting of all splendour or power.  E. सर्व्वतेजस्, and मयट् aff.
43239: सर्व्वतोभद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं) Every where auspicious. 	 mn. (-द्रः-द्रं) A temple or palace of a square form, with an entrance opposed to each point of the compass. 	 m. (-द्रः) 	 1. The Nimba-tree, (Melia azadirachta.) 	 2. The carriage of VISHṆU. 	 3. A bamboo. 	 4. A form of military array. 	 5. A square mystical diagram, to be painted on the cloth which on particular occasions covers a sort of altar erected to VISHṆU. 	 6. A kind of charade, in which the same word answers several questions. 	 7. A whimsical form of verse, so con-trived that the sams meanings and words occur, whether the line be read back-wards or forwards, or in several other directions. f. (-द्रा) 	 1. A tree, (Gmelina arborea.) 	 2. An actress or the wife of an actor or dancer, &c. 	 3. A sort of yam, (Dioscorea.)  E. सर्व्वतस् on every side, भद्र auspicious.
43240: सर्व्वतोमुख n. (-खं) 	 1. Water. 	 2. Sky, heaven. 	 m. (-खः) 	 1. ŚIVA. 	 2. BRAHMĀ. 3. Soul, spirit. 	 4. A Brāhman. 	 5. Swarga, the heaven of INDRA. 6. Agni.  E. सर्व्वतस् on every side, मुख countenance.
43241: सर्व्वत्र Ind. 	 1. Every where, in all places. 	 2. Always, at all times. र्व्व  E. स all, त्रल् aff.
43242: सर्व्वत्रग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) All-pervading, going every where. 	 m. (-गः) Air, wind.  E. सर्व्वत्र every where, गम् to go, ड aff.
43243: सर्व्वत्रगामिन् m. (-मी) Air, wind.  E. सर्व्वत्र always, गामिन् going.
43244: सर्व्वथा Ind. 	 f. (-था) 	 1. In all ways, by all means. 	 2. Assuredly, certainly. 	 3. Exceeding, mostly. 	 4. Always.  E. सर्व्व all, थाल् aff.
43245: सर्व्वदमन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) All-subduing, irresistible. 	 m. (-नः) BHARATA, the son of ŚAKUNTALĀ.  E. सर्व्व all, दमन taming.
43246: सर्व्वदर्शिन् mfn. (-र्शी-र्शिनी-र्शि) All-seeing. 	 m. (-र्शी) A Buddha in general. E. सर्व्व all, and दर्शिन् seeing.
43247: सर्व्वदा Ind. Always, at all times.  E. सर्व्व all, and दाच् aff.
43248: सर्व्वदुःखक्षय m. (-यः) Final emancipation from transmigration.  E. सर्व्व all, दुःख pain, and क्षय destruction.
43249: सर्व्वदेवमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of or comprising all the gods.  E. सर्व्वदेव, मयट् aff.
43250: सर्व्वदेवमुख m. (-खः) A name of AGNI or fire.  E. सर्व्व all, देव a deity, and मुख mouth; being the medium of oblations to the gods.
43251: सर्व्वधन n. (-नं) 	 1. Whole wealth or property. 	 2. (In arithmetic,) Total of a sum in progression.  E. सर्व्व, and धन wealth.
43252: सर्व्वधर्म्मविद् m. (-विद् or वित्) One who knows the duties of all tribes and classes.  E. सर्व्व, धर्म्म duty, विद् who knows.
43253: सर्व्वधारी f. (-री) The twenty-second year of the cycle.  E. सर्व्व all, धृ to hold, अण् and ङीष् affs.
43254: सर्व्वधुरावह m. (-हः) An ox fit for any sorts of carriage.  E. सर्व्व all, धुर a burden, आङ् before वह् to bear, aff. अच् ।
43255: सर्व्वधुरीण m. (-णः) An ox, &c. fit for any carriage or draught.  E. सर्व्व all, धुर a burden, ख aff.
43256: सर्व्वनामता f. (-ता) The quality or condition of a pronoun.  E. सर्व्वनाम and तल् aff.
43257: सर्व्वनामन् n. (-म) A pronoun.  E. सर्व्व, and नामन् name.
43258: सर्व्वनाश m. (-शः) Total destruction, destruction of all.  E. सर्व्व, नाश destruction.
43259: सर्व्वन्दम m. (-मः) BHARATA.  E. सर्व्व all, दम् to tame or subdue, खच् aff.
43260: सर्व्वपथ m. (-थः) Every way, every direction. सर्व्व, पथ for पथिन् a path.
43261: सर्व्वपथीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) In or of every road or direction, (moving, passing, &c.)  E. सर्व्वपथ, and ख aff.
43262: सर्व्वपा f. (-पा) The wife of the Daitya BALI.  E. सर्व्व all, पा to drink, affs. अङ् and टाप् ।
43263: सर्व्वपूर्णत्व n. (-त्वं) Entire completion or fulness, complete preparation or provision.  E. सर्व्व all, and पूर्णत्व fulness.
43264: सर्व्वप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. Generally or universally beloved. 	 2. Generally friendly, loving all.  E. सर्व्व all, and प्रिय dear.
43265: सर्व्वभक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Omnivorous, eating all or any thing. 	 f. (-क्षा) A female goat.  E. सर्व्व all, and भक्ष who eats.
43266: सर्व्वभक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) 	 1. Eating any thing or all things, (a child.) 2. All-devouring, omnivorous.  E. सर्व्व, and भक्ष्य edible.
43267: सर्व्वभाव m. (-वः) Whole disposition, all one's thoughts and purpose. E. सर्व्व, and भाव disposition.
43268: सर्व्वभूत n. Plu. (-तानि) 	 1. All the elements. 	 2. All created things.  E. सर्व्व all, भूत an element.
43269: सर्व्वभूतकृत् mn. (-कृत्) 	 1. The maker of all things. 	 2. The cause of all elements or beings.  E. सर्व्वभूत, and कृत् who or what makes.
43270: सर्व्वभूतमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Comprising or comprehending all elementary matter. 	 m. (-यः) The supreme pervading spirit.  E. सर्व्वभूत, मयट् aff.
43271: सर्व्वभूतस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Present in all elements or beings.  E. सर्व्व all, भूत an element, and स्थ what stays; also सर्व्वभूतस्थित, &c.
43272: सर्व्वभूतात्मन् m. (-त्मा) Universal, all-pervading spirit.  E. सर्व्वभूत an element, and आत्मन् soul.
43273: सर्व्वभृत् mfn. (-भृत्) Cherishing or supporting all.  E. सर्व्व, भृत् who or what supports.
43274: सर्व्वभोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि) Enjoying all.  E. सर्व्व, भोगिन् who enjoys.
43275: सर्व्वभोगीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Good or beneficial for all, to be enjoyed or possessed by all.  E. सर्व्व, and भोग enjoyment, खश् aff.
43276: सर्व्वमङ्गला f. (-ला) DURGĀ.  E. सर्व्व all, मङ्गल auspicious.
43277: सर्व्वमय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) General, universal, comprehensive, comprehen-ding.  E. सर्व्व all, मयट् aff.
43278: सर्व्वमही f. (-ही) The whole earth.  E. सर्व्व, and मही earth.
43279: सर्व्वमूल्य n. (-ल्यं) A Cowrie or small coin represented by it.  E. सर्व्व all, (of all things,) मूल्य price.
43280: सर्व्वमूषक m. (-कः) Time.  E. सर्व्व all, (things,) मूष् to steal, वुन् aff.
43281: सर्व्वरस m. (-सः) 	 1. Resin, the exudation of the pine or Sāl. 	 2. A sort of of musical instrument, a kind of lute. 	 3. A learned man. 	 4. Saltness, salt, saline flavour or taste.  E. सर्व्व all, रस taste, real or figurative.
43282: सर्व्वरसोत्तम m. (-मः) The saline flavour, saltness, salt.  E. सर्व्व all, रस a flavour, उत्तम best.
43283: सर्व्वरात्र m. (-त्रः) The whole night.  E. सर्व्व all, रात्रि night, अच् substituted for the final.
43284: सर्व्वरीकर m. (-रः) The moon.  E. सर्व्वरी for शर्व्वरी night, कर who makes.
43286: सर्व्वर्त्तुपरिवर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A year.  E. सर्व्व all, ऋतु a season, परिवर्त्त a revolution.
43287: सर्व्वला f. (-ला) An iron club. “तोमरास्त्रे”  E. सर्व्व all, ला to take, affs. अङ् and टाप्; also read शर्व्वला and सर्व्वली ।
43288: सर्व्वलिङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) A heretic, an impostor; one who not belonging to the orthodox faith, wears the dress, and assumes the character of an ascetic.  E. सर्व्व all, लिङ्क mark, (of sect or caste,) इनि aff.
43289: सर्व्वलोक m. (-कः) The universe.  E. सर्व्व, and लोक world.
43290: सर्व्वलोह m. (-हः) An iron arrow.  E. सर्व्व all, लोह iron.
43291: सर्व्ववल्लभा f. (-भा) A disloyal or unchaste woman.  E. सर्व्व all, and वल्लभा a mistress.
43292: सर्व्वविद् mfn. (-वित्) Omniscient, all-wise.  E. सर्व्व, and विद् who knows.
43293: सर्व्ववेद m. (-दः) A Brāhman who has read the four Vedas.  E. सर्व्व all, वेद the Veda, and अण् or ठक् aff.; the effects of the aff. being subsequently rejected.
43294: सर्व्ववेदस् m. (-दाः) A man who gives away all his property to the priests who have been employed by him at particular sacrifices, of which such a destination of the principal's whole wealth is an essential part.  E. सर्व्व all, विद् to gain, causal form, aff. असुन् ।
43295: सर्व्ववेदिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Omniscient.  E. सर्व्व, and वेदिन् who knows.
43296: सर्व्ववेशिन् m. (-शी) An actor, a dancer.  E. सर्व्व all, वेश dress, &c. इनि aff.
43297: सर्व्वशस् Ind. 	 1. Wholly, universally. 	 2. On all sides.  E. सर्व्व, शसि aff.
43298: सर्व्वशान्तिकृत् m. (-कृत्) The sovereign of India. BHARATA.  E. सर्व्व all, शान्ति tranquillity, and कृत् who effects.
43299: सर्व्वशेष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) 	 1. What remains of the whole. 	 2. What is to continue or to be added to all.  E. सर्व्व, and शेष remainder.
43300: सर्व्वसङ्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) United or meeting with universally. 	 m. (-तः) A sort of rice of quick growth.  E. सर्व्व all, (by all,) सङ्गत known.
43301: सर्व्वसङ्ग्रह m. (-हः) 	 1. A general or universal collection. 	 2. Any collection.  E. सर्व्व, and सङ्ग्रह collection.
43302: सर्व्वसन्नहन n. (-नं) Assembling a complete army.  E. सर्व्व all, (the parts, or elephants, chariots, horse, and foot,) सन्नहन arming.
43303: सर्व्वसन्नाह m. (-हः) 	 1. The universal and pervading spirit. 	 2. Arming or assembling a complete army.  E. सर्व्व, सन्नाह arming, accoutring.
43304: सर्व्वसमता f. (-ता) 	 1. Sameness or identity with all things. 	 2. Equani-mity, equal regard for all.  E. सर्व्व, and समता sameness.
43305: सर्व्वसह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) All-enduring, bearing all things with patience and firmness. 	 m. (-हः) Bdellium. “गुग्गुलौ” f. (-हा) The earth.  E. सर्व्व all, सह् to suffer, aff. अच् ।

47203: हैमन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) 	 1. Cold, wintry. 	 2. Growing in winter. 	 3. Suitable to winter. 	 4. Made of gold. 	 m. (-नः) 	 1. The month Mārgaśīrsha. 	 2. The winter season.  E. हेमन्त winter, अण् aff., and the final optionally rejected.
47204: हैमन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ती-न्तं) 	 1. Wintry, cold. 	 2. Growing in winter, &c. 	 3. Suitable to the winter, (as abode or clothing, &c.) 	 n. (-न्तं) The winter season.  E. हेमन्त winter, अण् aff.
47205: हैमन्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Wintry, freezing, frigid. 	 2. Growing in winter.  E. हेमन्त, ठञ् aff.
47206: हैमल m. (-लः) Winter.  E. हिमल cold, अण् aff.
47207: हैमवत n. (-तं) BHĀRATA-VARSHA or India. 	 m. (-तः) A sort of poison. 	 f. (-ती) 	 1. PĀRVATĪ. 	 2. Chebulic myrobalan. 	 3. A medicinal kind of moon-plant. 	 4. A white kind of Orris root. 	 5. A tawny grape. 	 6. The Ganges. 	 f. (-ती) Adj. 	 1. Flowing from the Himālaya mountain. 2. Bred in or belonging to the Himālaya mountain. 	 3. Snowy. E. हिमबत् the snowy mountains skirting India, अण् aff., fem. aff. ङीप् ।
47208: हैयङ्गवीन n. (-नं) 	 1. Clarified butter prepared a day before it is used. 2. Clarified butter prepared from the milking of the previous day. E. ह्यम् yesterday, गोदोह milk, हियङ्ग substituted for them, खञ् aff.
47209: हैरिक m. (-कः) A thief.  E. हि-र हेरः तत्र प्रसूतः ठक् ।
47210: हैहय m. (-यः) KĀRTAVĪRYA, a sovereign: see the next.
47211: हैहेय m. (-यः) A prince; also KĀRTAVĪRYA, who was slain by PARAŚURĀMA.

47213: होड् (ऋ) होडृ r. 1st cl. (होडते) 	 1. To go, to move. 	 2. To disregard, to disrespect.
47214: होड m. (-डः) A raft, a float, a boat.  E. होड् to go, aff. अच् ।

47216: होढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Stolen. 	 n. (-ढं) Stolen goods.  E. हुड् to steal, क्त aff.
47217: होतृ m. (-ता) 	 1. A priest who at a sacrifice recites the prayers of the Rig-Veda; one conversant with the Veda. 	 2. A sacrificer. 	 f. (-त्री) Adj. Sacrificing, offering oblation into fire.  E. हु to sacrifice, Unādi aff. तृच् ।

47226: होमवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having performed sacrifice.  E. होम, मतुप् aff.
47227: होमवेला f. (-ला) The time of offering an oblation to the gods.
47228: होमाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) Sacrificial fire.  E. होम an oblation, अग्नि fire.
47229: होमि m. (-मिः) 	 1. Clarified butter. 	 2. Fire. 	 3. Water.  E. हु to sacrifice, मिन् aff., or इन aff, and मुट् augment.
47230: होमिन् m. (-मी) The offerer of an oblation.  E. हु to sacrifice, मिनि Unādi aff.; or होम, इनि aff.
47231: होम्य f. (-म्या) Belonging to or fit for an oblation.  E. होम, यत् aff.; also होमीय f. (-या).
47232: होरा f. (-रा) 	 1. The rising of a sign of the zodiac. 	 2. Part of the duration of a sign, the twenty-fourth part of a day, an hour. 	 3. A mark, a line. 	 4. A science or work in science, (on astrology.) E. होड् to go, to proceed, affs. अच् and टाप्, and ड changed to र ।

47234: होहौ Ind. 	 1. An interjection of calling. 	 2. An exclamation of challenging or defiance.  E. हो, and हौ both the same.
47235: हौ Ind. 	 1. An interjection of defiance or challenge. 	 2. A vocative particle.  E. ह्वेञ् to call, डौ aff.
47236: हौड् (ऋ) हौडृ r. 1st cl. (हौडते) 	 1. To go. 	 2. To disregard.
47237: हौतृक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating or appertaining to the Hotṛ or priest so named.  E. होतृ a priest, and ठञ् aff.
47238: हौत्र n. (-त्रं) The office of a Hotṛ-priest.
47239: हौम्य n. (-म्यं) Clarified butter.  E. होम burnt-offering, यञ् aff.
47240: हौम्यधान्य n. (-न्यं) Sesamum.  E. हौम्य relating to burnt-offering, and धान्य grain.
47241: ह्नु r. 2nd cl. (ह्नुते) 	 1. To take away, to rob. 	 2. To withhold, to conceal. 3. To hide from any one, (with a dative.) With अप prefixed, To conceal, to hide. With नि, 1. To conceal. 	 2. To deny before any one, (with a dative.)
47243: ह्मल् r. 1st cl. (ह्मलति) To move, to shake.
47244: ह्यस् Ind. Yesterday.  E. अहन् a day, deriv. irr.
47245: ह्यस्तन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Of yesterday, produced or occurred yesterday. E. ह्यस् yesterday, ट्युल् aff., तुट् augment.
47246: ह्यस्त्य mfn. (-स्त्यः-स्त्या-स्त्यं) Of yesterday: see the last.  E. ह्यस् yesterday, and त्यप् aff.
47247: ह्रग् (ए) ह्रगे r. 1st cl. (ह्रगति) To cover.
47248: ह्रणिया f. (-या) 	 1. Censure, reproach. 	 2. Shame.  E. हृणीङ् Kandwādi root, to feel ashamed, यक् aff., form irr.: see ह्रिणीया ।
47249: ह्रद m. (-दः) 	 1. A deep lake, a large or deep piece of water. 	 2. A ray of light.  E. ह्राद् to sound, aff. अच्, and the deriv. irr.
47250: ह्रदग्रह m. (-हः) An alligator, a crocodile.  E. ह्नद a lake, and ग्रह abode.
47251: ह्रदिनी m. (-नी) 	 1. A river in general. 	 2. Lightning.  E. ह्रद deep water, इनि and ङीप् affs.
47252: ह्रद्रोग m. (-गः) The sign Aquarius of the zodiac: see हृद्रोग. The word is of Greek origin.
47253: ह्रप् r. 10th cl. (ह्नापयति-ते) To speak articulately.
47254: ह्रस् r. 1st cl. (ह्रसति) 	 1. To sound. 	 2. To be small or few.
47255: ह्रसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Made little, diminished. 	 2. Sounded.  E. ह्रस् to sound, &c., क्त aff.
47256: ह्रसिमन् m. (-मा) Smallness, shortness.  E. ह्रस्व short, small, इमनिच् aff., and ह्रस substituted.

47260: ह्रस्वगवेधुका f. (-का) A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.)  E. ह्रस्व short, गवेधुका coix.
47261: ह्रस्वदर्भ m. (-र्भः) A short kind of Kuśa grass, the white sort.  E. ह्रस्व short, दर्भ Kuśa grass.

47275: ह्रिवेर n. (-रं) A perfume. E. see ह्रीवेर ।
47276: ह्री r. 3rd cl. (-जिह्रेति) To be modest, to blush. 	 2. To be ashamed of, (with an ablative or genitive.)
47277: ह्री f. (-ह्रीः) Shame, bashfulness.  E. ह्री to be ashamed, aff. क्विप् ।

47279: ह्रीकु mfn. (-कुः-कुः-कु) Ashamed, modest. 	 m. (-कुः) 	 1. Lac. 	 2. Tin.  E. ह्री to be ashamed, Unādi aff. उन्, कुक् augment: see ह्लीकु ।
47280: ह्रीच्छ् r. 1st cl. (ह्रीच्छति) To be modest or ashamed.

47282: ह्रीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Ashamed, bashful.  E. ह्री to be ashamed, aff. क्त, and त changed to ण; deriv. irr.
47283: ह्रीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ashamed, bashful, modest.  E. ह्री to be ashamed, aff. क्त.

47289: ह्रुड् (ऋ) ह्रुडृ r. 1st cl. (ह्रूहते) 	 1. To collect. 	 2. To go.
47290: ह्रेप् (ऋ) ह्रेपृ r. 1st cl. (ह्रेपते) To go.

47293: ह्रीपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Made ashamed, put to shame. 	 2. Excelled, surpassed.  E. ह्री to be ashamed, causal v., क्त aff.
47294: ह्रेष् (ऋ) ह्रेषृ r. 1st cl. (ह्रेषते) 	 1. To sound inarticulately, to neigh, (as horse.) 	 2. To go, to move. 	 3. To creep.
47295: ह्रेषा f. (-षा) Neighing as a horse.  E. ह्रेष् to neigh, affs. अ and टाप् see हेषा; also read ह्लेषा
47296: ह्रोड् (ऋ) ह्रोडृ r. 1st cl. (ह्रोडति) To go, to move.
47297: ह्रौड् (ऋ) हौडृ r. 1st cl. (ह्रौडते) To go.
47298: ह्लग् (ए) ह्णगे r. 1st cl. (ह्लगति) To cover.
47299: ह्लप् r. 10th cl. (ह्लापयति-ते) To speak, to speak articulately: also ह्रप् ।
47301: ह्लाद् (ई) ह्लादी r. 1st cl. (ह्लादते) 	 1. To gladden, to delight. 	 2. To be glad or delighted. 	 3. To sound, especially as a musical instrument. With आ, To be delighted.

47303: ह्लादन n. (-नं) Joy, delight.  E. ह्लाद् to be glad, and ल्युट् aff.
47304: ह्लादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Delighted, happy.  E. ह्लाद् to be happy, क्त aff.
47305: ह्लादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Happy, glad. 	 f. (-नी) 	 1. Lightning. 	 2. INDRA'S thunderbolt. 	 3. A river in general. 	 4. The Olibanum tree: see ह्रादिनी.  E. ह्लाद् pleasure, इनि and ङीष् affs.

47307: ह्लीकु mfn. (-कुः-कुः-कु) Ashamed, modest. 	 m. (-कुः) 	 1. Lac. 	 2. Tin.  E. ह्री to be ashamed, aff. कुक्, र changed to ल; otherwise read ह्रीकु ।
47308: ह्लेषा f. (-षा) Neighing, (as a horse,) braying, (as an ass, &c.)  E. ह्लेष् for ह्रेष् to neigh, &c., affs. अ and टाप् ।
47309: ह्वल् r. 1st cl. (-ह्वलति) 	 1. To move. 	 2. To shake.
47310: ह्वान n. (-नं) 	 1. The act of calling. 	 2. A cry.  E. ह्वे to call, ल्युट् aff.
47311: ह्वृ r. 1st cl. (ह्वरति) 	 1. To bend, to curve, to make crooked. 	 2. To be crooked in conduct, to deceive. 	 3. To be injured.
47312: ह्वे r. 1st cl. (ह्वयति-ते) 	 1. To call. 	 2. To invoke, to call upon. 	 3. To challenge. 	 4. To name. 	 5. To ask, to beg. 	 6. To emulate, to vie with, to wish to overcome or surpass. 	 7. To struggle or contend with. With आ, To call, to invite. With सम्, To call out together. With उप, नि, वि or सम्, the verb is deponent, (उपह्वयते); also with आङ् if rivalry be signified, (आह्वयते) He challenges. THE END.
